/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* the endpoint                                                        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function doPost(e) {
  if (e && e.parameter && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(e.parameter, 'appPublicEvidence')) return ucbacAppPublicEvidence_(e);
  if (e && e.parameter && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(e.parameter, 'appDailySummary')) return ucbacAppDailySummary_(e);
  var out;
  try {
    const raw = e && e.postData && e.postData.contents;
    const body = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
    if (body && body.kind === 'ad-order') out = adsReceive_(body);
    else if (body && body.kind === 'ad-rates') out = adsRatesPayload_();
    else out = { ok: false, error: 'This address takes advertising orders only.' };
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log('doPost: ' + (err && err.stack ? err.stack : err));
    out = { ok: false, error: 'The order could not be read. Please try again, or email ' + ADS.TO + '.' };
  }
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(out))
                       .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

/**
 * One order: validate, price, log, mail. Returns what the page shows.
 * body.test = true is the self-test: mailed to ADS.TO only, marked, not logged.
 */
function adsReceive_(body) {
  body = body || {};

  // A hidden field no person can see. A filled one is a bot; say yes and drop it.
  if (adsClean_(body.hp, 200)) return { ok: true, ref: 'AD-' + adsStamp_() + '-0000', dropped: true };

  const o = adsOrderFrom_(body);
  const week = adsWeek_();
  const sold = body.test ? [] : adsSold_();
  const problems = adsProblems_(o, week, sold);
  const logoCheck = body.logo ? adsLogoCheck_(body.logo) : null;
  if (logoCheck && logoCheck.error) problems.push(logoCheck.error);
  if (problems.length) return { ok: false, error: problems.join(' ') };

  const busy = body.test ? '' : adsThrottle_(o.email);
  if (busy) return { ok: false, error: busy };

  const price = adsPrice_(o, week);
  o.week = week;
  o.ref = 'AD-' + adsStamp_() + '-' + adsSuffix_();
  o.receivedAt = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), adsTz_(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm');
  o.total = price.total;
  o.lines = price.lines;

  // the logo, to Drive; a Drive failure loses the file, never the order
  o.logo = null; o.logoFailed = '';
  if (logoCheck && !body.test) {
    try { o.logo = adsSaveLogo_(logoCheck, o); }
    catch (err) {
      o.logoFailed = logoCheck.name;
      Logger.log('logo not saved for ' + o.ref + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    }
  }

  var logged = false;
  if (!body.test) {
    try {
      ensureTab_(ADS.TAB, ADS.COLS);
      const row = adsRow_(o);
      logged = appendRows_(ADS.TAB, [row]) === 1;
    } catch (err) {
      Logger.log('AdOrders write failed for ' + o.ref + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    }
  }

  var quota = -1;
  try { quota = MailApp.getRemainingDailyQuota(); } catch (err) {}
  var mailed = false, copied = false;
  if (quota === -1 || quota >= ADS.QUOTA_FLOOR) {
    try {
      const m = adsSummaryMail_(o, !!body.test);
      const mail = { to: ADS.TO, replyTo: o.email, subject: m.subject,
                     body: m.body, htmlBody: m.htmlBody, name: ADS.FROM_NAME };
      if (o.logo && o.logo.blob) mail.attachments = [o.logo.blob];
      MailApp.sendEmail(mail);
      mailed = true;
    } catch (err) {
      Logger.log('summary mail failed for ' + o.ref + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    }
    if (mailed && !body.test && (quota === -1 || quota >= ADS.COPY_FLOOR)) {
      try {
        const c = adsCopyMail_(o);
        MailApp.sendEmail({ to: o.email, replyTo: ADS.TO, subject: c.subject,
                            body: c.body, htmlBody: c.htmlBody, name: ADS.FROM_NAME });
        copied = true;
      } catch (err) {
        Logger.log('copy mail failed for ' + o.ref + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
      }
    }
  } else {
    Logger.log('order ' + o.ref + ' logged, mail skipped: ' + quota + ' messages left today');
  }
  if (logged) {
    try { adsMarkMailed_(o.ref, mailed ? (copied ? 'yes + copy' : 'yes') : 'no'); } catch (err) {}
  }

  return { ok: true, ref: o.ref, total: o.total, lines: o.lines,
           mailed: mailed, copied: copied, logged: logged,
           logo: o.logo ? { saved: true, name: o.logo.name } : (o.logoFailed ? { saved: false, name: o.logoFailed } : null) };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* the logo file                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** The file as the page sent it, checked; { error } when it is refused. */
function adsLogoCheck_(logo) {
  if (!logo || typeof logo !== 'object') return null;
  const name = (adsClean_(logo.name, 120) || 'logo').replace(/[\\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '-');
  const data = String(logo.data || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
  if (!data) return { error: 'The logo file arrived empty. Please attach it again, or paste a link.' };
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+=*$/.test(data)) return { error: 'The logo file could not be read. Please attach it again, or paste a link.' };
  const ext = (name.match(/\.([a-z0-9]+)$/i) || [0, ''])[1].toLowerCase();
  var type = adsClean_(logo.type, 80).toLowerCase();
  if (!ADS.LOGO.TYPES[type]) type = ADS.LOGO.EXT[ext] || '';
  if (!type) return { error: 'Logo files can be PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, SVG, PDF, AI or EPS.' };
  const bytes = Math.floor(data.length * 3 / 4) - (data.match(/=+$/) || [''])[0].length;
  if (bytes > ADS.LOGO.MAX_BYTES) return { error: 'The logo file is larger than 4 MB. Please send a smaller file, or paste a link.' };
  return { name: name, type: type, data: data, bytes: bytes };
}

/** Save it to the Drive folder, named by the order. */
function adsSaveLogo_(check, o) {
  const blob = Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(check.data), check.type, check.name);
  const file = adsLogoFolder_().createFile(blob);
  file.setName(o.ref + ' - ' + o.business + ' - ' + check.name);
  return { name: check.name, url: file.getUrl(), id: file.getId(), bytes: check.bytes, blob: blob };
}

function adsLogoFolder_() {
  const found = DriveApp.getFoldersByName(ADS.LOGO.FOLDER);
  if (found.hasNext()) return found.next();
  return DriveApp.createFolder(ADS.LOGO.FOLDER);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* reading the order                                                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function adsOrderFrom_(b) {
  const keys = function (list, table) {
    const out = [];
    (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).forEach(function (k) {
      k = adsClean_(k, 30);
      if (table[k] && out.indexOf(k) < 0) out.push(k);
    });
    return out;
  };
  const one = function (v, table) { v = adsClean_(v, 30); return table[v] ? v : ''; };
  const num = function (v, lo, hi, dflt) {
    const n = parseInt(v, 10);
    if (isNaN(n)) return dflt;
    return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n));
  };
  return {
    business:   adsClean_(b.business, 120),
    contact:    adsClean_(b.contact, 80),
    email:      adsClean_(b.email, 254).toLowerCase(),
    phone:      adsClean_(b.phone, 40),
    website:    adsClean_(b.website, 200),
    instagram:  adsClean_(b.instagram, 60).replace(/^@+/, ''),
    category:   adsClean_(b.category, 80),
    exclusivity: b.exclusivity === true || b.exclusivity === 'yes' || b.exclusivity === 'on',
    flagship:   one(b.flagship, ADS.FLAGSHIP),
    igTerm:     one(b.igTerm, ADS.IG_TERMS) || 'core',
    igWeeks:    num(b.igWeeks, 1, 5, 1),
    ig:         keys(b.ig, ADS.IG),
    webSeason:  one(b.webSeason, ADS.WEB_SEASONS) || 'inseason',
    webMonths:  num(b.webMonths, 1, 12, 1),
    webWeeks:   num(b.webWeeks, 1, 5, 1),
    web:        one(b.web, ADS.WEB),
    start:      adsClean_(b.start, 120),
    artwork:    adsClean_(b.artwork, 300),
    notes:      adsClean_(b.notes, 2000, true),
    pageEstimate: (typeof b.estimate === 'number' && isFinite(b.estimate)) ? Math.round(b.estimate) : null,
    pageWeek:   parseInt(b.pageWeek, 10) || 0,
    agree:      b.agree === true || b.agree === 'yes' || b.agree === 'on'
  };
}

function adsProblems_(o, week, sold) {
  const p = [];
  if (o.business.length < 2) p.push('Business name is missing.');
  if (o.contact.length < 2) p.push('Contact name is missing.');
  if (!adsEmailOk_(o.email)) p.push('A working email address is needed for the reply.');
  if (!o.flagship && !o.ig.length && !o.web) p.push('Choose at least one placement.');
  if (!o.agree) p.push('Please confirm that this is a request, not a booking.');
  if (o.flagship && !week.remaining) p.push('The flagship packages closed with Week 10.');
  if (o.ig.length && !o.flagship && week.seasonOver) p.push('The 2026 Instagram season has ended; website placements are still open.');
  if (o.ig.length && !o.flagship && !week.remaining && (o.igTerm === 'core' || o.igTerm === 'coreExt'))
    p.push('The Weeks 5-10 term has ended; choose a weekly test or the remaining playoff rounds.');
  const booked = [];
  if (o.flagship && sold.indexOf(o.flagship) >= 0) booked.push(ADS.FLAGSHIP[o.flagship].name);
  if (!o.flagship) {
    o.ig.forEach(function (k) { if (sold.indexOf(k) >= 0) booked.push(ADS.IG[k].name); });
    if (o.web && sold.indexOf(o.web) >= 0) booked.push(ADS.WEB[o.web].name);
  }
  if (booked.length) p.push('Already booked: ' + booked.join(', ') + '. Please choose another placement.');
  return p;
}

/** Text as typed, minus control characters and runaway length. */
function adsClean_(v, max, keepLines) {
  var s = (v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : String(v);
  s = s.replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]/g, '');
  s = keepLines ? s.replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n') : s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  s = s.trim();
  return s.length > max ? s.slice(0, max) : s;
}

/** An address MailApp could conceivably deliver to. */
function adsEmailOk_(e) {
  return !!e && e.length <= 254 && /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(e);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* pricing                                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Lines and a total from the rate card, for the given week. A flagship
 * includes every Instagram feature and both website placements, so with one
 * chosen nothing else is priced. The presenting partner has no weekly rate:
 * asked for weekly, it is priced at the remaining term and the line says so.
 * Once the core term is over, every Instagram term prices as the playoff
 * rounds, which is the extension price on its own.
 */
function adsPrice_(o, week) {
  week = week || adsWeek_();
  const lines = [];
  const add = function (label, amount) { lines.push({ label: label, amount: amount }); };

  if (o.flagship && week.remaining) {
    const base = adsCorePrice_(ADS.FLAGSHIP.flagship.price, week);
    if (o.flagship === 'flagshipPlayoffs')
      add(ADS.FLAGSHIP.flagshipPlayoffs.name + ' — ' + week.label + ' and the playoff rounds',
          base + (ADS.FLAGSHIP.flagshipPlayoffs.price - ADS.FLAGSHIP.flagship.price));
    else add(ADS.FLAGSHIP.flagship.name + ' — ' + week.label, base);
  } else {
    o.ig.forEach(function (k) {
      const r = ADS.IG[k];
      if (o.igTerm === 'weekly') {
        if (r.weekly) add(r.name + ' — weekly test, ' + o.igWeeks + ' week' + (o.igWeeks === 1 ? '' : 's'), r.weekly * o.igWeeks);
        else if (week.remaining) add(r.name + ' — ' + week.label + ' (no weekly rate)', adsCorePrice_(r.core, week));
        else add(r.name + ' — remaining playoff rounds (no weekly rate)', r.ext);
      } else if (o.igTerm === 'playoffs' || !week.remaining) {
        add(r.name + ' — remaining playoff rounds', r.ext);
      } else {
        add(r.name + ' — ' + week.label, adsCorePrice_(r.core, week));
        if (o.igTerm === 'coreExt') add(r.name + ' — playoff extension', r.ext);
      }
    });
    if (o.web) {
      const w = ADS.WEB[o.web];
      if (o.webSeason === 'offseason') add(w.name + ' — offseason, ' + o.webMonths + ' month' + (o.webMonths === 1 ? '' : 's'), w.month * o.webMonths);
      else if (o.webSeason === 'weekly') add(w.name + ' — weekly test, ' + o.webWeeks + ' week' + (o.webWeeks === 1 ? '' : 's'), w.weekly * o.webWeeks);
      else add(w.name + ' — in season, through December', w.season);
    }
  }
  var total = 0;
  lines.forEach(function (l) { total += l.amount; });
  return { lines: lines, total: total };
}

function adsMoney_(n) {
  return '$' + String(Math.round(n)).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function adsRound5_(n) { return Math.round(n / 5) * 5; }

/** A core-term price for the weeks still to come. */
function adsCorePrice_(base, week) {
  return adsRound5_(base * week.remaining / week.coreWeeks);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* the week                                                            */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * Where the season stands on a given day ('yyyy-MM-dd' in the script's zone),
 * or at a pinned week number. The same arithmetic runs inside the page.
 */
function adsWeekFor_(dateStr, pin) {
  const S = ADS.SCHEDULE;
  const days = function (s) {
    const p = String(s).split('-');
    return Math.round(Date.UTC(+p[0], +p[1] - 1, +p[2]) / 86400000);
  };
  const since = days(dateStr) - days(S.WEEK5_MONDAY);
  const current = pin ? pin : (since < 0 ? S.FIRST_WEEK : S.FIRST_WEEK + Math.floor(since / 7));
  const remaining = Math.max(0, S.LAST_WEEK - current + 1);
  return {
    current: current,
    remaining: remaining,
    coreWeeks: S.LAST_WEEK - S.FIRST_WEEK + 1,
    playoffRound: current >= S.LAST_WEEK ? current - S.LAST_WEEK + 1 : 0,
    seasonOver: current > S.LAST_WEEK + S.PLAYOFF_ROUNDS,
    label: remaining ? 'Weeks ' + current + '-' + S.LAST_WEEK : 'Playoff rounds'
  };
}

/** Today's week, unless ADS_WEEK pins one. */
function adsWeek_() {
  var pin = 0;
  try { pin = parseInt(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADS_WEEK'), 10) || 0; } catch (e) {}
  return adsWeekFor_(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), adsTz_(), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), pin);
}

/** What ADS_SOLD says is booked, limited to keys the rate card knows. */
function adsSold_() {
  var raw = '';
  try { raw = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADS_SOLD') || ''; } catch (e) {}
  return String(raw).split(',').map(function (k) { return k.trim(); })
    .filter(function (k) { return ADS.IG[k] || ADS.WEB[k] || ADS.FLAGSHIP[k]; });
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* sponsor clicks                                                      */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/**
 * The homepage banner (Index.html) reports each outbound click here through
 * google.script.run, for the sponsor's campaign report: one row per click on
 * the SponsorClicks tab. A visitor's repeated clicks inside a minute count
 * once. A pass-through in the WebApp.gs manner, kept here so the banner
 * needs no other file; nothing about the visitor is recorded beyond the
 * anonymous id the site already keeps for its own traffic count.
 */
function svcSponsorClick(placement, sponsor, route, visitorId, width) {
  return apiSponsorClick_(placement, sponsor, route, visitorId, width);
}

function apiSponsorClick_(placement, sponsor, route, visitorId, width) {
  const p = adsClean_(placement, 40), s = adsClean_(sponsor, 80);
  const r = adsClean_(route, 120), v = adsClean_(visitorId, 60);
  if (!p || !s) return { ok: false };
  try {
    const cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
    const key = 'spon:' + p + ':' + s + ':' + (v || 'anon');
    if (cache.get(key)) return { ok: true, repeat: true };
    cache.put(key, '1', 60);
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    ensureTab_(ADS.CLICKS_TAB, ADS.CLICKS_COLS);
    appendRows_(ADS.CLICKS_TAB, [{
      ClickedAt: Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), adsTz_(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),
      Placement: p, Sponsor: s, Route: r || 'home', VisitorID: v,
      Width: parseInt(width, 10) || ''
    }]);
  } catch (e) {
    Logger.log('sponsor click not written: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
    return { ok: false };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

/** The live card the page asks for when it loads. */
function adsRatesPayload_() {
  return {
    ok: true,
    rates: { ig: ADS.IG, flagship: ADS.FLAGSHIP, web: ADS.WEB },
    week: adsWeek_(),
    sold: adsSold_(),
    schedule: ADS.SCHEDULE,
    asOf: Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), adsTz_(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* the tab                                                             */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function adsRow_(o) {
  return {
    OrderID: o.ref, ReceivedAt: o.receivedAt, Status: 'NEW',
    Business: o.business, Contact: o.contact, Email: o.email, Phone: o.phone,
    Website: o.website, Instagram: o.instagram, Category: o.category,
    Exclusivity: o.exclusivity ? 'yes' : '',
    Flagship: o.flagship ? ADS.FLAGSHIP[o.flagship].name : '',
    InstagramTerm: o.ig.length && !o.flagship ? ADS.IG_TERMS[o.igTerm] : '',
    InstagramWeeks: o.ig.length && !o.flagship && o.igTerm === 'weekly' ? o.igWeeks : '',
    InstagramItems: o.flagship ? '' : o.ig.map(function (k) { return ADS.IG[k].name; }).join('; '),
    WebsiteSeason: o.web && !o.flagship ? ADS.WEB_SEASONS[o.webSeason] : '',
    WebsiteMonths: o.web && !o.flagship && o.webSeason === 'offseason' ? o.webMonths : '',
    WebsiteWeeks: o.web && !o.flagship && o.webSeason === 'weekly' ? o.webWeeks : '',
    WebsiteItem: o.web && !o.flagship ? ADS.WEB[o.web].name : '',
    PreferredStart: o.start, Artwork: o.artwork,
    LogoFile: o.logo ? o.logo.url : (o.logoFailed ? 'NOT SAVED: ' + o.logoFailed : ''),
    Notes: o.notes,
    SeasonWeek: o.week ? o.week.current : '',
    Estimate: o.total, PageEstimate: o.pageEstimate === null ? '' : o.pageEstimate,
    Lines: o.lines.map(function (l) { return l.label + ': ' + adsMoney_(l.amount); }).join('\n'),
    Mailed: '', Decision: '', DecisionNote: ''
  };
}

function adsMarkMailed_(ref, value) {
  if (!hasColumn_(ADS.TAB, 'Mailed')) return;
  const rows = rowsOf_(ADS.TAB);
  for (var i = rows.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (String(rows[i].OrderID) === ref) {
      const head = tabHeader_(ADS.TAB);
      getTab_(ADS.TAB).getRange(rows[i].__row, head.indexOf('Mailed') + 1).setValue(value);
      delete __tableCache[ADS.TAB];
      return;
    }
  }
}

function adsPairs_(o) {
  const pairs = [
    ['Reference', o.ref],
    ['Received', o.receivedAt],
    ['Business', o.business],
    ['Contact', o.contact],
    ['Email', o.email],
    ['Phone', o.phone || '—'],
    ['Website', o.website || '—'],
    ['Instagram', o.instagram ? '@' + o.instagram : '—'],
    ['Business category', o.category || '—'],
    ['Category exclusivity', o.exclusivity ? 'Requested' : 'Not requested'],
    ['Preferred start', o.start || '—'],
    ['Artwork link', o.artwork || '—'],
    ['Logo file', o.logo ? o.logo.name + ' — attached, and in Drive: ' + o.logo.url
                : o.logoFailed ? o.logoFailed + ' — the upload did not save; ask them to resend it'
                : 'None attached']
  ];
  if (o.week) {
    const w = o.week;
    pairs.push(['Season week', 'Week ' + w.current +
      (w.remaining ? ' (' + w.label + ', ' + w.remaining + ' week' + (w.remaining === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' left in the term)'
                   : w.seasonOver ? ' (Instagram season over)' : ' (playoff Round ' + w.playoffRound + ')') +
      (o.pageWeek && o.pageWeek !== w.current ? ' — the page was showing Week ' + o.pageWeek : '')]);
  }
  return pairs;
}

function adsSummaryMail_(o, test) {
  const subject = (test ? '[TEST] ' : '') + 'Advertising request ' + o.ref + ' — ' + o.business +
                  ' — ' + adsMoney_(o.total);
  const pairs = adsPairs_(o);
  const mismatch = o.pageEstimate !== null && o.pageEstimate !== o.total;

  const text = [];
  text.push('New advertising request from the UCBAC Stats site.');
  text.push('Reply to this email to accept or decline; it goes straight to ' + o.contact + ' at ' + o.email + '.');
  text.push('');
  pairs.forEach(function (p) { text.push(p[0] + ': ' + p[1]); });
  text.push('');
  text.push('PLACEMENTS');
  o.lines.forEach(function (l) { text.push('  ' + l.label + ' — ' + adsMoney_(l.amount)); });
  text.push('  Estimated total — ' + adsMoney_(o.total));
  if (mismatch) text.push('  (the page showed the advertiser ' + adsMoney_(o.pageEstimate) + '; the rate cards differ — check both)');
  if (o.notes) { text.push(''); text.push('NOTES'); text.push(o.notes); }
  text.push('');
  text.push('Logged on the ' + ADS.TAB + ' tab of the database workbook' + (test ? ' (not for a test)' : '') + '.');

  const h = [];
  h.push('<div style="font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif;max-width:640px;color:#1b1b2f">');
  h.push('<h2 style="margin:0 0 6px;font-size:20px">Advertising request ' + adsEsc_(o.ref) + (test ? ' <span style="color:#b45309">[TEST]</span>' : '') + '</h2>');
  h.push('<p style="margin:0 0 16px;color:#42546a">Reply to this email to accept or decline; the reply goes to ' +
         adsEsc_(o.contact) + ' at ' + adsEsc_(o.email) + '.</p>');
  h.push(adsH2_('Advertiser'));
  h.push(adsRows_(pairs));
  h.push(adsH2_('Placements'));
  h.push(adsRows_(o.lines.map(function (l) { return [l.label, adsMoney_(l.amount)]; })
                   .concat([['Estimated total', adsMoney_(o.total)]])));
  if (mismatch) h.push('<p style="margin:8px 0;color:#b45309">The page showed the advertiser ' + adsMoney_(o.pageEstimate) +
                       '. The two rate cards differ — check both before replying.</p>');
  if (o.notes) { h.push(adsH2_('Notes')); h.push('<p style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin:0">' + adsEsc_(o.notes) + '</p>'); }
  h.push('<p style="margin:22px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:#6b7c8f">Logged on the ' + adsEsc_(ADS.TAB) +
         ' tab of the database workbook' + (test ? ' (not for a test)' : '') + '. Rates from the ' + ADS.SEASON + ' media kit.</p>');
  h.push('</div>');
  return { subject: subject, body: text.join('\n'), htmlBody: h.join('') };
}

function adsCopyMail_(o) {
  const subject = 'We received your UCBAC Stats advertising request (' + o.ref + ')';
  const text = [];
  text.push('Hi ' + o.contact + ',');
  text.push('');
  text.push('Thanks for your interest in advertising with UCBAC Stats. This is a copy of your request, reference ' + o.ref + '.');
  text.push('It is a request, not yet a booking: UCBAC Stats will reply to this address to accept or decline, and to confirm campaign weeks, artwork and the final total.');
  text.push('');
  text.push('PLACEMENTS');
  o.lines.forEach(function (l) { text.push('  ' + l.label + ' — ' + adsMoney_(l.amount)); });
  text.push('  Estimated total — ' + adsMoney_(o.total));
  text.push('');
  text.push('Business: ' + o.business);
  if (o.phone) text.push('Phone: ' + o.phone);
  if (o.website) text.push('Website: ' + o.website);
  if (o.instagram) text.push('Instagram: @' + o.instagram);
  if (o.category) text.push('Category: ' + o.category + (o.exclusivity ? ' (exclusivity requested)' : ''));
  if (o.start) text.push('Preferred start: ' + o.start);
  if (o.artwork) text.push('Artwork: ' + o.artwork);
  if (o.logo) text.push('Logo file: ' + o.logo.name + ' (received)');
  else if (o.logoFailed) text.push('Logo file: ' + o.logoFailed + ' did not save on our side. Please reply to this email with it attached.');
  if (o.notes) { text.push(''); text.push('Your notes: ' + o.notes); }
  text.push('');
  text.push('Questions in the meantime: reply to this email or write to ' + ADS.TO + '.');
  text.push('');
  text.push('UCBAC Stats');

  const h = [];
  h.push('<div style="font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif;max-width:640px;color:#1b1b2f">');
  h.push('<p>Hi ' + adsEsc_(o.contact) + ',</p>');
  h.push('<p>Thanks for your interest in advertising with UCBAC Stats. This is a copy of your request, reference <strong>' + adsEsc_(o.ref) + '</strong>.</p>');
  h.push('<p>It is a request, not yet a booking: UCBAC Stats will reply to this address to accept or decline, and to confirm campaign weeks, artwork and the final total.</p>');
  h.push(adsH2_('Placements'));
  h.push(adsRows_(o.lines.map(function (l) { return [l.label, adsMoney_(l.amount)]; })
                   .concat([['Estimated total', adsMoney_(o.total)]])));
  h.push(adsH2_('Your details'));
  h.push(adsRows_(adsPairs_(o).filter(function (p) { return p[0] !== 'Reference' && p[0] !== 'Received'; })));
  if (o.notes) { h.push(adsH2_('Your notes')); h.push('<p style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin:0">' + adsEsc_(o.notes) + '</p>'); }
  h.push('<p style="margin:22px 0 0">Questions in the meantime: reply to this email or write to ' + adsEsc_(ADS.TO) + '.</p>');
  h.push('<p>UCBAC Stats</p></div>');
  return { subject: subject, body: text.join('\n'), htmlBody: h.join('') };
}

function adsH2_(t) {
  return '<h3 style="font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6b7c8f;margin:20px 0 6px">' + adsEsc_(t) + '</h3>';
}
function adsRows_(pairs) {
  const out = ['<table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px">'];
  pairs.forEach(function (p) {
    out.push('<tr><td style="padding:4px 12px 4px 0;color:#42546a;vertical-align:top">' + adsEsc_(p[0]) + '</td>' +
             '<td style="padding:4px 0;font-weight:600;vertical-align:top">' + adsEsc_(p[1]) + '</td></tr>');
  });
  out.push('</table>');
  return out.join('');
}
function adsEsc_(v) {
  return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
    .replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]; });
}

function adsTz_() {
  try { return Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'America/New_York'; } catch (e) { return 'America/New_York'; }
}
function adsStamp_() { return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), adsTz_(), 'yyyyMMdd'); }
function adsSuffix_() {
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
  var s = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) s += alphabet.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * alphabet.length));
  return s;
}

/**
 * Too many orders from one address, or from everyone, inside an hour. Returns
 * the message to show, or '' to proceed. Counts live in the script cache, so
 * they reset on their own.
 */
function adsThrottle_(email) {
  var cache;
  try { cache = CacheService.getScriptCache(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
  const bump = function (key, cap) {
    const n = parseInt(cache.get(key), 10) || 0;
    if (n >= cap) return true;
    cache.put(key, String(n + 1), 3600);
    return false;
  };
  if (bump('ads:all', ADS.PER_HOUR)) return 'The order desk is busy right now. Please try again in an hour, or email ' + ADS.TO + '.';
  if (bump('ads:' + email, ADS.PER_EMAIL_HOUR)) return 'That address has sent several requests in the last hour. UCBAC Stats has them; please wait for a reply, or email ' + ADS.TO + '.';
  return '';
}

/**
 * Run from the editor: sends a sample order to ADS.TO, marked [TEST], and
 * writes nothing to the tab. Proves the deployment can mail before the page
 * goes live.
 */
function adsSelfTest() {
  const r = adsReceive_({
    kind: 'ad-order', test: true,
    business: 'Sample Hardware Co.', contact: 'Sam Sample', email: ADS.TO,
    phone: '410-555-0100', website: 'https://example.com', instagram: '@samplehardware',
    category: 'Hardware store', exclusivity: true,
    igTerm: 'coreExt', ig: ['slate', 'top10'], web: 'both', webSeason: 'inseason',
    start: 'Week 6', notes: 'Self-test from the Apps Script editor.', estimate: 1800, agree: true
  });
  const msg = r.ok ? 'Test order ' + r.ref + ' priced at ' + adsMoney_(r.total) + ', mailed: ' + r.mailed + '. Check ' + ADS.TO + '.'
                   : 'Refused: ' + r.error;
  Logger.log(msg);
  return msg;
}


===== src/Aggregation.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — Aggregations.gs
 *
 * The derivation chain. PlayerGameStats is the only input; everything else is
 * computed and disposable.
 *
 *   PlayerGameStats -> PlayerSeasonStats -> PlayerCareerStats
 *                   -> TeamSeasonStats   -> Standings
 *                   -> Leaders
 *
 * TWO RULES THAT MATTER:
 *   1. blank != zero. A blank cell means "not reported" and must not become 0.
 *   2. grain precedence per player+season+category:
 *        if any GAME rows exist      -> sum the GAME rows
 *        else if SEASON_TOTAL exists -> use it
 *      SEASON_REF is NEVER summed. It exists only to reconcile against.
 */

const SUM_FIELDS = [
  'PassAtt','PassComp','PassYds','PassTD','PassInt',
  'RushAtt','RushYds','RushTD','RushFum',
  'Rec','RecYds','RecTD','RecFum','Pancakes',
  'TackleSolo','TackleAssist','TFL','Sacks','Int','FF','FR','PassDef','DefTD',
  'FGM','FGA','XPM','XPA','Punts','PuntYds','KR','KRYds','PR','PRYds','Blocks',
  // milestone-game counts. Nobody ENTERS these — computePlayerSeasonStats
  // counts them from the game rows — but they live in this list so career
  // totals and multi-season ranges sum them like any other column.
  'Rush100G','Rec100G','Pass200G'
];

/**
 * A stat line nobody official has confirmed yet: a player's own entry. It
 * publishes grey and sits in the review queue until a coach or an
 * administrator approves it, or a coach writes the line himself. A coach's
 * upload (FILE_IMPORT) is NOT provisional - it is the coach's word, official
 * as it lands, and he uploads again to change it. Every "is this
 * provisional?" test goes through here so nothing can drift.
 */
function provisionalSource_(v) {
  const t = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim();
  return t === 'PLAYER_ENTRY';
}

/** Number or null — blank/non-numeric never becomes zero. */
function numOrNull_(v) {
  if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return null;
  var n = Number(v);
  return isNaN(n) ? null : n;
}

function addInto_(acc, rec) {
  for (var i = 0; i < SUM_FIELDS.length; i++) {
    var f = SUM_FIELDS[i];
    var v = numOrNull_(rec[f]);
    if (v === null) continue;
    acc[f] = (acc[f] === undefined ? 0 : acc[f]) + v;
  }
}

/**
 * Season totals per player.
 * Returns [{PlayerID, SeasonID, TeamID, GamesPlayed, SourceGrain, ...sums}]
 */
function computePlayerSeasonStats_() {
  const stats = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS);
  const buckets = {};          // playerId|seasonId -> bucket

  for (var i = 0; i < stats.length; i++) {
    var r = stats[i];
    var pid = String(r.PlayerID || '').trim();
    var sid = String(r.SeasonID || '').trim();
    if (!pid || !sid) continue;

    var grain = String(r.grain || r.Grain || '').trim();
    if (grain === CONFIG.GRAIN.SEASON_REF) continue;      // reference only

    var key = pid + '|' + sid;
    var b = buckets[key];
    if (!b) {
      b = buckets[key] = {
        PlayerID: pid, SeasonID: sid, TeamID: String(r.TeamID || '').trim(),
        game: {}, season: {}, games: {}, gyds: {}, hasGame: false, hasSeason: false,
        prov: false
      };
    }
    if (!b.TeamID && r.TeamID) b.TeamID = String(r.TeamID).trim();

    if (grain === CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME) {
      b.hasGame = true;
      // one unapproved player-entered line taints the whole total: the sum
      // contains a number no official has confirmed, and the site shows it grey
      if (provisionalSource_(r.SourceType)) b.prov = true;
      addInto_(b.game, r);
      var gid = String(r.GameID || '').trim();
      if (gid) b.games[gid] = true;
      else if (r.week !== '' && r.week !== null) b.games['wk' + r.week] = true;
      // per-game yardage, for the 100/200-yard milestone counts
      var gk = gid || ('wk' + r.week);
      var gy = b.gyds[gk] || (b.gyds[gk] = { rush: 0, rec: 0, pass: 0 });
      gy.rush += numOrNull_(r.RushYds) || 0;
      gy.rec  += numOrNull_(r.RecYds)  || 0;
      gy.pass += numOrNull_(r.PassYds) || 0;
    } else if (grain === CONFIG.GRAIN.SEASON_TOTAL) {
      b.hasSeason = true;
      addInto_(b.season, r);
    }
  }

  const out = [];
  Object.keys(buckets).forEach(function (k) {
    var b = buckets[k];
    var use = b.hasGame ? b.game : (b.hasSeason ? b.season : null);
    if (!use) return;
    var rec = {
      PlayerSeasonStatID: 'PSS-' + b.SeasonID.replace('SEA-', '') + '-' + b.PlayerID,
      PlayerID: b.PlayerID, SeasonID: b.SeasonID, TeamID: b.TeamID,
      GamesPlayed: b.hasGame ? Object.keys(b.games).length : '',
      SourceGrain: b.hasGame ? CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME : CONFIG.GRAIN.SEASON_TOTAL,
      Provisional: (b.hasGame && b.prov) ? 'TRUE' : '',
      ComputedAt: new Date()
    };
    for (var i = 0; i < SUM_FIELDS.length; i++) {
      var f = SUM_FIELDS[i];
      rec[f] = (use[f] === undefined) ? '' : use[f];
    }
    // Milestone games are countable only where game rows exist. A season filed
    // as one total stays blank — unknowable, not zero.
    if (b.hasGame) {
      var r100 = 0, c100 = 0, p200 = 0;
      Object.keys(b.gyds).forEach(function (gk) {
        if (b.gyds[gk].rush >= 100) r100++;
        if (b.gyds[gk].rec  >= 100) c100++;
        if (b.gyds[gk].pass >= 200) p200++;
      });
      rec.Rush100G = r100; rec.Rec100G = c100; rec.Pass200G = p200;
    }
    out.push(rec);
  });
  return out;
}

/** Career totals — aggregate on PlayerID across every season and team. */
function computePlayerCareerStats_(seasonRows) {
  const byPlayer = {};
  for (var i = 0; i < seasonRows.length; i++) {
    var r = seasonRows[i];
    var b = byPlayer[r.PlayerID];
    if (!b) {
      b = byPlayer[r.PlayerID] = { PlayerID: r.PlayerID, seasons: {}, teams: {}, gp: 0,
                                   sums: {}, prov: false };
    }
    if (String(r.Provisional || '') === 'TRUE') b.prov = true;
    b.seasons[r.SeasonID] = true;
    if (r.TeamID) b.teams[r.TeamID] = true;
    var gp = numOrNull_(r.GamesPlayed);
    if (gp !== null) b.gp += gp;
    for (var j = 0; j < SUM_FIELDS.length; j++) {
      var f = SUM_FIELDS[j];
      var v = numOrNull_(r[f]);
      if (v === null) continue;
      b.sums[f] = (b.sums[f] === undefined ? 0 : b.sums[f]) + v;
    }
  }
  const out = [];
  Object.keys(byPlayer).forEach(function (pid) {
    var b = byPlayer[pid];
    var rec = {
      PlayerID: pid,
      SeasonsPlayed: Object.keys(b.seasons).length,
      TeamsPlayed: Object.keys(b.teams).length,
      GamesPlayed: b.gp || '',
      Provisional: b.prov ? 'TRUE' : '',
      ComputedAt: new Date()
    };
    for (var j = 0; j < SUM_FIELDS.length; j++) {
      var f = SUM_FIELDS[j];
      rec[f] = (b.sums[f] === undefined) ? '' : b.sums[f];
    }
    out.push(rec);
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Who lost a forfeit, or ''.
 *
 * A forfeited game is a decision, not a draw, but it is often filed as 0-0 —
 * and 0-0 walks straight into the tie branch below, which is how Elkton's
 * 2025 read 10-1-1 against an outside record of 11-1, and Harford Tech's
 * 1-8-1 against 1-9. One row, two wrong records.
 *
 * The forfeiting team is named either in a ForfeitBy column, or in the
 * game's Notes ("Harford Tech forfeit"). Nothing is inferred: a forfeit
 * naming nobody, or naming both teams, is left out of the standings
 * entirely rather than recorded as a tie somebody could quote.
 */
/**
 * Which SIDE forfeited — 'HOME', 'AWAY', or '' when nothing says.
 *
 * A side, not a TeamID, because the team that forfeits may not have one. A
 * non-conference opponent is carried on the game by name alone, with no row in
 * the Teams tab and often no id at all, and Benjamin Franklin forfeiting to
 * Joppatowne could not be recorded at all while this answered in ids: there
 * was no id to give it, and matching by name only consulted the Teams tab,
 * where it does not appear.
 *
 * So each side is matched against every name it answers to: its id, its name
 * in the Teams tab, and the name written on the game itself — the last being
 * the only one an outside opponent has.
 */
function forfeitSide_(g, teams) {
  if (String(g.Status || '').trim().toUpperCase() !== 'FORFEIT') return '';
  const home = String(g.HomeTeamID || '').trim(), away = String(g.AwayTeamID || '').trim();
  const named = String(g.ForfeitBy || '').trim();
  if (named && named === home) return 'HOME';
  if (named && named === away) return 'AWAY';

  const namesFor = function (id, sideName) {
    const out = [];
    if (id) out.push(id.toLowerCase());
    const t = teams.filter(function (x) { return String(x.TeamID).trim() === id; })[0];
    const nm = String((t && t.DisplayName) || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (nm) out.push(nm);
    const sn = String(sideName || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (sn && out.indexOf(sn) < 0) out.push(sn);
    return out;
  };
  const hn = namesFor(home, g.HomeTeamName), an = namesFor(away, g.AwayTeamName);
  const decide = function (hit, ait) {
    if (hit && !ait) return 'HOME';
    if (ait && !hit) return 'AWAY';
    return '';                    // both named, or neither: not a decision
  };

  // ForfeitBy may hold a name rather than an id
  if (named) {
    const q = named.toLowerCase();
    const byName = decide(hn.indexOf(q) >= 0, an.indexOf(q) >= 0);
    if (byName) return byName;
  }

  const note = String(g.Notes || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!note) return '';
  const inNote = function (names) {
    return names.some(function (n) { return note.indexOf(n) >= 0; });
  };
  return decide(inNote(hn), inNote(an));
}

/**
 * Where a game falls in the season, as one comparable number: the week,
 * with playoff rounds counted past the last regular week. The same rule
 * Api.gs uses for the schedule, kept here so the standings need nothing
 * from the site layer.
 */
function standingsOrder_(g) {
  const w = numOrNull_(g.Week) || 0;
  const phase = String(g.Phase || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const playoff = phase === 'ROUND' || phase === 'PLAYOFF' ||
                  String(g.GameType || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'PLAYOFF';
  return playoff ? 100 + w : w;
}

/**
 * Standings from Games. Forfeits count; games without a score do not.
 *
 * With `throughOrder`, only games up to and including that week count — the
 * standings as they stood then. Without it, every scored game counts, and
 * each row also carries PrevRank: the team's place as of the week BEFORE
 * the latest week with a result, so the site can show who moved. There is
 * no PrevRank when the latest week is the first with results, and none when
 * the week before it is week 0 — a week-0 table of two or three games is not
 * a standing anybody fell from.
 */
function computeStandings_(seasonId, throughOrder) {
  const games = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES);
  const teams = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS);
  const rec = {};
  const modernStandings = conferenceStandingsApplies_(seasonId);
  teams.forEach(function (t) {
    if (modernStandings && String(t.IsConferenceMember).toLowerCase() === 'false') return;
    rec[t.TeamID] = { TeamID: t.TeamID, TeamName: t.DisplayName, SeasonID: seasonId,
                      W: 0, L: 0, T: 0, ConfW: 0, ConfL: 0, PF: 0, PA: 0 };
  });
  const cutoff = (throughOrder === undefined || throughOrder === null) ? null : Number(throughOrder);

  games.forEach(function (g) {
    if (String(g.SeasonID).trim() !== seasonId) return;
    if (modernStandings && !conferenceStandingsFinal_(g)) return;
    var hs = numOrNull_(g.HomeScore), as = numOrNull_(g.AwayScore);
    if (cutoff !== null && standingsOrder_(g) > cutoff) return;
    var h = rec[String(g.HomeTeamID).trim()], a = rec[String(g.AwayTeamID).trim()];
    var conf = String(g.GameType).trim() === 'CONFERENCE' && (!modernStandings || conferenceStandingsRegular_(g));
    var isForfeit = String(g.Status || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'FORFEIT';

    /* A forfeit is decided by who forfeited, not by the scoreboard, and it
       counts whether or not anybody entered a score. Nobody plays a forfeit,
       so there is often no score to enter, and requiring one meant the game
       vanished from the standings entirely — the win simply never arrived.

       An unequal score is left to the ordinary reckoning below: 2-0 written
       against a forfeit is somebody recording the outcome by the convention
       for it, and the scoreboard and the status then agree. */
    if (isForfeit && (hs === null || as === null || hs === as)) {
      const side = forfeitSide_(g, teams);
      if (!side) {
        // a forfeit naming nobody: better absent than filed as a draw
        Logger.log('standings: ' + String(g.GameID) + ' is a forfeit with no team named — skipped. ' +
                   'Put the forfeiting team in Notes or a ForfeitBy column.');
        return;
      }
      const win = side === 'HOME' ? a : h;
      const lose = side === 'HOME' ? h : a;
      // the points stand as recorded, where any were - a forfeit earns a win,
      // not a scoring record
      if (hs !== null && as !== null) {
        if (h) { h.PF += hs; h.PA += as; }
        if (a) { a.PF += as; a.PA += hs; }
      }
      if (win) { win.W++; if (conf) win.ConfW++; }
      if (lose) { lose.L++; if (conf) lose.ConfL++; }
      return;
    }
    if (hs === null || as === null) return;

    if (h) {
      h.PF += hs; h.PA += as;
      if (hs > as) { h.W++; if (conf) h.ConfW++; }
      else if (hs < as) { h.L++; if (conf) h.ConfL++; }
      else h.T++;
    }
    if (a) {
      a.PF += as; a.PA += hs;
      if (as > hs) { a.W++; if (conf) a.ConfW++; }
      else if (as < hs) { a.L++; if (conf) a.ConfL++; }
      else a.T++;
    }
  });

  // 2023 exists only as season aggregates — no game rows, so the loop above
  // finds nothing for it. A team with no scored games takes its record from
  // the TeamSeasons tab instead; points stay blank where nobody recorded
  // them, never zero. Records there include playoffs, which is the intent.
  if ((!modernStandings || cutoff === null) && hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAM_SEASONS)) {
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAM_SEASONS).forEach(function (t) {
      if (String(t.SeasonID).trim() !== seasonId) return;
      var r = rec[String(t.TeamID).trim()];
      if (!r || r.W + r.L + r.T > 0) return;          // played games are authoritative
      var w = numOrNull_(t.Wins), l = numOrNull_(t.Losses);
      if (w === null && l === null) return;
      r.W = w || 0; r.L = l || 0;
      r.ConfW = numOrNull_(t.ConfWins) || 0;
      r.ConfL = numOrNull_(t.ConfLosses) || 0;
      r.PF = numOrNull_(t.PointsFor);
      r.PA = numOrNull_(t.DefPointsAllowed);
    });
  }

  const out = Object.keys(rec).map(function (k) { return rec[k]; })
    .filter(function (r) { return r.W + r.L + r.T > 0; });
  out.forEach(function (r) {
    r.Diff = (numOrNull_(r.PF) === null || numOrNull_(r.PA) === null) ? '' : r.PF - r.PA;
    if (r.PF === null) r.PF = '';
    if (r.PA === null) r.PA = '';
    r.WinPct = (r.W + r.L) ? Math.round(r.W / (r.W + r.L) * 1000) / 1000 : '';
    // NOTE: do NOT store a "W-L" string. Sheets coerces "11-1" into a duration
    // ("6s") — the same corruption that destroyed the 2023 records in the source
    // workbook. W/L/ConfW/ConfL are the atoms; the site formats them for display.
    r.ComputedAt = new Date();
  });
  // Keep archived seasons under the rules used to publish them. The new policy
  // begins in 2026 and is retained when CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON advances.
  var conferenceOrder = modernStandings ? conferenceStandingsOrder_(out, games, teams, seasonId, cutoff) : null;
  out.sort(function (x, y) {
    if (conferenceOrder) return conferenceOrder.position[x.TeamID] - conferenceOrder.position[y.TeamID];
    return (y.ConfW - y.ConfL) - (x.ConfW - x.ConfL) || (y.W - y.L) - (x.W - x.L) ||
           (numOrNull_(y.Diff) || 0) - (numOrNull_(x.Diff) || 0);
  });
  out.forEach(function (r, i) { r.Rank = conferenceOrder ? conferenceOrder.ranks[r.TeamID] : i + 1; });

  if (cutoff === null) {
    /* the week before the latest week with a result, and where everyone
       stood then - blank when there is no such week worth comparing to */
    const played = games.filter(function (g) {
      if (String(g.SeasonID).trim() !== seasonId) return false;
      if (modernStandings && !conferenceStandingsFinal_(g)) return false;
      if (modernStandings && String(g.Status).toUpperCase() === 'FORFEIT' && forfeitSide_(g, teams)) return true;
      return numOrNull_(g.HomeScore) !== null && numOrNull_(g.AwayScore) !== null;
    }).map(standingsOrder_);
    const latest = played.reduce(function (m, o) { return Math.max(m, o); }, -1);
    const before = played.filter(function (o) { return o < latest; })
      .reduce(function (m, o) { return Math.max(m, o); }, -1);
    const prev = {};
    if (latest > before && before >= 1) {
      computeStandings_(seasonId, before).forEach(function (r) { prev[r.TeamID] = r.Rank; });
    }
    out.forEach(function (r) {
      r.PrevRank = prev[r.TeamID] === undefined ? '' : prev[r.TeamID];
    });
  }
  // Append after PrevRank, preserving the app's existing A:O public contract.
  out.forEach(function(r) {
    var c = conferenceOrder && conferenceOrder.records[r.TeamID];
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, 'PrevRank')) r.PrevRank = '';
    r.ConfT = c ? c.t : '';
    r.ConfPct = c ? conferenceStandingsPct_(c.w,c.l,c.t) : '';
    r.RankReason = conferenceOrder ? conferenceOrder.reasons[r.TeamID] : '';
    r.RankTied = conferenceOrder ? !!conferenceOrder.tied[r.TeamID] : false;
    r.ConfMarginAvg = c && c.scored ? c.margin/c.scored : '';
    r.StandingsRule = conferenceOrder ? CONFERENCE_STANDINGS.version : 'LEGACY';
  });
  return out;
}

/** Force the rank columns back to plain numbers, whatever they were given. */
function standingsPlainNumbers_() {
  try {
    const sh = db_().getSheetByName('Standings');
    if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) return;
    const head = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0]
      .map(function (h) { return String(h || '').trim(); });
    ['Rank', 'PrevRank'].forEach(function (col) {
      const i = head.indexOf(col);
      if (i < 0) return;
      sh.getRange(2, i + 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 1).setNumberFormat('0');
    });
  } catch (ignore) {}        // a formatting nicety must never fail a rebuild
}

/** Top-N leaders per category, with a qualifier so rate stats stay honest. */
function computeLeaders_(seasonId, seasonRows) {
  const players = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS), function (p) { return p.PlayerID; });
  const teams   = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS),   function (t) { return t.TeamID; });

  const CATS = [
    { key: 'PassYds',  label: 'Passing Yards' },
    { key: 'PassTD',   label: 'Passing TD' },
    { key: 'RushYds',  label: 'Rushing Yards' },
    { key: 'RushTD',   label: 'Rushing TD' },
    { key: 'RecYds',   label: 'Receiving Yards' },
    { key: 'RecTD',    label: 'Receiving TD' },
    { key: 'Sacks',    label: 'Sacks' },
    { key: 'Int',      label: 'Interceptions' },
    { key: 'TFL',      label: 'Tackles for Loss' }
  ];

  const out = [];
  CATS.forEach(function (cat) {
    var pool = seasonRows.filter(function (r) {
      return String(r.SeasonID).trim() === seasonId && numOrNull_(r[cat.key]) !== null;
    });
    // combined tackles are derived, never stored
    pool.sort(function (a, b) { return numOrNull_(b[cat.key]) - numOrNull_(a[cat.key]); });
    pool.slice(0, 25).forEach(function (r, i) {
      var p = players[r.PlayerID] || {};
      var t = teams[r.TeamID] || {};
      out.push({
        SeasonID: seasonId, Category: cat.key, CategoryLabel: cat.label, Rank: i + 1,
        PlayerID: r.PlayerID, PlayerName: p.DisplayName || r.PlayerID,
        TeamID: r.TeamID, TeamName: t.DisplayName || r.TeamID,
        Value: numOrNull_(r[cat.key]), GamesPlayed: r.GamesPlayed,
        SourceGrain: r.SourceGrain, Provisional: String(r.Provisional || ''),
        ComputedAt: new Date()
      });
    });
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Rebuild the whole derived layer. Safe to run any time — it is idempotent
 * and every output tab is disposable.
 */
function rebuildDerived_() {
  if (typeof appPublicDirectWrite_ === 'function' && !__appPublicWriteDepth) return appPublicDirectWrite_(function () { return rebuildDerived_(); });
  const t0 = new Date().getTime();
  const log = [];

  const seasonStats = computePlayerSeasonStats_();
  // explicit headers: replaceRows reuses the sheet's existing header row by
  // default, which would silently drop columns added since the last rebuild
  log.push('PlayerSeasonStats  ' + replaceRows_('PlayerSeasonStats', seasonStats,
    seasonStats.length ? Object.keys(seasonStats[0]) : null));

  const career = computePlayerCareerStats_(seasonStats);
  log.push('PlayerCareerStats  ' + replaceRows_('PlayerCareerStats', career,
    career.length ? Object.keys(career[0]) : null));

  var allStandings = [], allLeaders = [];
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.SEASONS).forEach(function (s_) {
    var sid = String(s_.SeasonID).trim();
    allStandings = allStandings.concat(computeStandings_(sid));
    allLeaders   = allLeaders.concat(computeLeaders_(sid, seasonStats));
  });
  // headers from the rows, so PrevRank lands in a tab written before it existed
  log.push('Standings          ' + conferenceStandingsWrite_(allStandings));
  /* Rank and PrevRank are places in a table. A cell carrying date formatting
     hands them back from getValues as a Date, which reads as milliseconds —
     that is how "down 2208787200001 places" came to sit beside the league
     leader. Rewriting the tab replaces the values but not the cell FORMAT, so
     it is set back to plain here rather than waiting to be noticed again. */
  standingsPlainNumbers_();
  log.push('Leaders            ' + replaceRows_('Leaders', allLeaders));

  const secs = ((new Date().getTime() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1);
  const msg = 'Rebuilt derived layer in ' + secs + 's\n  ' + log.join(' rows\n  ') + ' rows';
  Logger.log(msg);
  return msg;
}

===== src/AllConference.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — AllConference.gs
 *
 * Objective All-Conference projection, implementing the UCBAC Implementation
 * Spec v1.0 against the live database.
 *
 * Eligibility comes from PlayerSeasons.Positions — the controlled multi-select
 * a coach fills in through the roster editor. A player listed "RB|CB|ATH" is
 * ranked in all three pools; resolveDuplicates() then decides which award he
 * actually occupies.
 *
 * SIX DEPARTURES from the spec as written, each forced by the data and each
 * visible in the output rather than applied silently:
 *
 *  1. §6 says Non-Sack TFL = MAX(0, TFL - Sacks). Measured against the real
 *     data, 15 of 31 team-seasons already record TFL as EXCLUDING sacks — three
 *     of them report TFL < Sacks on every single row. Blanket subtraction would
 *     erase real production for half the conference, so the convention is
 *     detected per team-season instead of assumed.
 *  2. §1.1 requires conference-only statistics, but a SEASON_TOTAL row cannot be
 *     split into conference and non-conference. Those players are scored when
 *     their team played >= 80% conference games, and flagged Provisional.
 *  3. §4.3 removes a player whose material fields are incomplete. Eight of
 *     fifteen teams reported 2025 defense as season totals only; the strict rule
 *     would delete most of the conference from the ballot. Incompleteness lowers
 *     the multiplier and the confidence instead.
 *  4. §5.5 Offensive Line is not ranked at all — the spec says so itself, as no
 *     snap, pressure or block-grade data exists.
 *  5. §2.3 opportunity thresholds are season figures — 35 carries, 20 tackles —
 *     and the ballot is published from week two. Held at full size in September
 *     they admitted nobody: two games in, a back averaging thirteen carries a
 *     game had 26 and was not on the ballot behind one with 35. Each threshold
 *     is scaled to the share of the conference schedule the player's team has
 *     played, so the bar is the same pace all year and reaches the spec's
 *     number at the end of it. Confidence still asks the unscaled question.
 *  6. A blank defensive count is a zero when the team keeps that count. A
 *     coach's sheet writes an interception on the boy who made it and nothing
 *     on the rest, so the blank was arriving as "not reported", the term was
 *     dropped from the player's score and his remaining terms renormalized -
 *     which meant a linebacker with no interceptions was not scored against
 *     the one with two, and the weight on interceptions moved nobody. Now, for
 *     TFL, sacks, interceptions, forced and recovered fumbles, passes defensed
 *     and defensive touchdowns: when any of a team's conference rows for the
 *     season carries the figure, a teammate with a defensive line and no
 *     figure has zero. A team whose sheet never carries it is still "not
 *     reported", and departure 3 still applies.
 */

/* AC-1.1: a tackle is a tackle. Solo and assisted count the same, and the
   separate solo term is gone from every defensive position.

   AC-1.2: one quarterback rating in place of its own four parts. Completion %,
   yards per attempt, TD rate and interception rate were carrying .10+.10+.10+
   .08 of a quarterback's score between them — and those four ARE the passer
   rating, which is why adding a rating term on top would have counted each of
   them twice. QBRtg replaces the four at their combined .38, so the weight a
   quarterback's efficiency carries is unchanged and it is now expressed as the
   number a coach reads on MaxPreps. Volume keeps its own weight, so an
   efficient backup with sixty attempts still does not outrank a starter.

   AC-1.3: opportunity thresholds scale with the schedule (departure 5 above).
   No weight changed; a row from before this cannot be compared on who was
   allowed into the pool, which is why the version moves.

   AC-1.4: defensive touchdowns become a measure for ILB, OLB, EDGE and DL
   (they were reaching those positions only through the disruption index),
   and a linebacker's interception now outweighs his fumble recoveries and
   passes defensed, as a safety's already did. ILB: Int .04 -> .07, DefTD
   .04 added, PassDef .05 -> .04, FR .05 -> .03, Tack .32 -> .30, FF .10 ->
   .09, DIP .05 -> .04. OLB: Int .04 -> .08, DefTD .04 added, PassDef .07 ->
   .05, FR .05 -> .03, Tack .27 -> .25, FF .10 -> .09, DIP .05 -> .04. EDGE
   and DL: DefTD .03 added, from Tack. S, CB and every offensive list are
   unchanged. Every list still sums to 1.00.
   The same version adds departure 6 (above): a blank defensive count is a
   zero when the team keeps that count. Without it the new weights moved
   nobody, because a boy with no interceptions had the term dropped and his
   score renormalized over what was left.

   AC-1.5: Athlete and Ironman are decided by production, not by the roster.
   Three games into 2026 the Athlete ballot was empty while thirteen players
   were clearing its gate - quarterbacks who run, backs who catch - because
   every one of them was listed QB or RB and nobody had typed ATH. Ironman
   was emptier still: it took a player's best offensive ranking and best
   defensive ranking, and a boy listed only on one side has no ranking on the
   other, however many tackles he made. No roster position names Ironman at
   all. So a player who meets the Athlete gate is in the Athlete pool whether
   or not a coach listed him there; the one-award-per-side rule still decides
   whether he takes Athlete or his listed position. And for Ironman, a side
   the roster does not list is scored the way it would be if it were - the
   player is placed in every pool on that side his numbers qualify for and
   the best of them stands in. Those stand-in scores are marked * in the
   note and never appear on the position ballots themselves. No weight
   changed. */
const AC_FORMULA_VERSION = 'AC-1.5';
const AC_TAB = 'AllConference';

/** (metric, weight, invertLowerIsBetter) — verbatim from the spec. */
const AC_WEIGHTS = {
  QB:  [['PassYds',.20,0],['PassYdsPG',.15,0],['PassTD',.12,0],['QBRtg',.38,0],
        ['PPE',.05,0],['RushYds',.05,0],['RushTD',.05,0]],
  RB:  [['RushYds',.20,0],['RushYdsPG',.15,0],['YPC',.15,0],['RushTD',.15,0],
        ['RushAtt',.08,0],['FumRate',.07,1],['Rec',.08,0],['RecYds',.07,0],['RecTD',.05,0]],
  WR:  [['RecYds',.20,0],['RecYdsPG',.15,0],['Rec',.15,0],['RecPG',.12,0],
        ['YPR',.13,0],['RecTD',.15,0],['FumRate',.05,1],['RushYds',.05,0]],
  ATH: [['TotYds',.25,0],['TotYdsPG',.15,0],['TotTD',.20,0],['TouchEff',.10,0],
        ['MultiDim',.15,0],['PrimaryEff',.10,0],['FumRate',.05,1]],
  /* A tackle is a tackle. The spec ranked solo tackles a second time, on top
     of a Tack figure that already counted an assist as half of one, so the
     same play was worth anything from a half to one and a half depending on
     who wrote the sheet — and half the conference reports a combined total
     with no split to read. The separate solo term is folded into Tack, which
     now counts both kinds as one. Every list still sums to 1.00. */
  /* AC-1.4: a takeaway that ends in the end zone is a measure for every front-
     seven position, not only the secondary, and an interception outranks a
     recovered fumble or a pass broken up for a linebacker as it already did for
     a safety. Tackles and tackles for loss remain the bulk of the score. */
  ILB: [['Tack',.30,0],['TackPG',.12,0],['NsTFL',.15,0],
        ['Sacks',.12,0],['FF',.09,0],['FR',.03,0],['PassDef',.04,0],['Int',.07,0],['DefTD',.04,0],['DIP',.04,0]],
  OLB: [['Tack',.25,0],['TackPG',.10,0],['NsTFL',.17,0],
        ['Sacks',.15,0],['FF',.09,0],['FR',.03,0],['PassDef',.05,0],['Int',.08,0],['DefTD',.04,0],['DIP',.04,0]],
  EDGE:[['Tack',.15,0],['NsTFL',.22,0],['Sacks',.25,0],
        ['FF',.12,0],['FR',.05,0],['PassDef',.05,0],['DefTD',.03,0],['DIP',.08,0],['DisrPG',.05,0]],
  DL:  [['Tack',.22,0],['NsTFL',.25,0],['Sacks',.20,0],
        ['FF',.12,0],['FR',.05,0],['DefTD',.03,0],['DIP',.08,0],['DisrPG',.05,0]],
  S:   [['Tack',.25,0],['NsTFL',.08,0],['Sacks',.05,0],
        ['FF',.10,0],['FR',.05,0],['PassDef',.17,0],['Int',.20,0],['DefTD',.05,0],['DIP',.05,0]],
  CB:  [['Tack',.13,0],['NsTFL',.04,0],['FF',.08,0],['FR',.05,0],
        ['PassDef',.27,0],['Int',.28,0],['DefTD',.10,0],['DIP',.05,0]],
  /* Pancake blocks are the only offensive-line stat the conference records, so
     the OL projection ranks on them alone: volume first, rate close behind. */
  OL:  [['Pancakes',.60,0],['PancakesPG',.40,0]]
};
