===== src/CoachInvites.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — CoachInvites.gs
 *
 * Invite the conference's coaches to sign in.
 *
 * A coach whose email is on the Coaches tab already has an account in every
 * way that matters: the portal's one-time code goes to that address, and the
 * roster editor, stat entry and approvals open to him the moment he redeems
 * it. Nobody had told the coaches. This mails each one a short note with the
 * link and what is behind it.
 *
 * Recipients are read from the CoachInvites tab (Team, Name, Email), never
 * from code — addresses live in the workbook, where the administrator can see
 * and edit the list. A dry run writes a verdict beside every row and sends
 * nothing; SEND mails the rows the dry run said it would, once: a row marked
 * SENT is never mailed again by a later run.
 *
 * A coach on the list who is not yet on the Coaches tab is seated there first,
 * on SEND, so the sign-in the message promises actually works. "(HC)" after a
 * name makes him the head coach; anyone else is an assistant. A coach whose
 * email already holds an ACTIVE account is skipped — he was not asked for.
 */
const COACHINVITE = {
  TAB: 'CoachInvites',
  COLS: ['Team', 'Name', 'Email', 'Result', 'Note'],
  REPLY_TO: 'contact@example.invalid',
  SIGNOFF: 'Javin Taylor\nUCBACstats.com'
};

function ciEnsureTab_() {
  if (hasTab_(COACHINVITE.TAB)) return db_().getSheetByName(COACHINVITE.TAB);
  const sh = db_().insertSheet(COACHINVITE.TAB);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, COACHINVITE.COLS.length).setValues([COACHINVITE.COLS])
    .setFontWeight('bold').setFontColor('#FFFFFF').setBackground('#1F3B54');
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  __tabMap = null;
  return sh;
}

/** "Derrick Krumholtz (HC)" -> { name: 'Derrick Krumholtz', head: true, last: 'Krumholtz' } */
function ciName_(raw) {
  const s = String(raw || '').trim();
  const head = /\(\s*hc\s*\)/i.test(s);
  const name = s.replace(/\(\s*hc\s*\)/ig, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const parts = name.split(' ');
  return { name: name, head: head, last: parts.length ? parts[parts.length - 1] : '' };
}

/** ACTIVE, PENDING (or another non-active status), or '' for no account. */
function ciAccountStatus_(email) {
  if (!hasTab_('Accounts')) return '';
  const want = String(email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const rows = rowsOf_('Accounts');
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (String(rows[i].Email || '').toLowerCase().trim() !== want) continue;
    const st = String(rows[i].Status || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    return st || 'PENDING';
  }
  return '';
}

/** The live Coaches row carrying this email, or null. */
function ciCoachRow_(email) {
  if (!hasTab_('Coaches')) return null;
  const want = String(email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const rows = rowsOf_('Coaches');
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (String(rows[i].Email || '').toLowerCase().trim() !== want) continue;
    if (String(rows[i].Active).toUpperCase() === 'FALSE') continue;
    return rows[i];
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * The sign-in link: the published /exec address plus ?page=portal.
 *
 * Never ScriptApp.getService().getUrl(). From the spreadsheet menu that names
 * the project's internal head deployment - an address nobody was ever given,
 * and the first dry run of this mailer printed it as the link. The address to
 * hand out is the one a real page load remembered (doGet stores it on every
 * visit), and failing that the newest one this site has already mailed inside
 * an account notification. With neither on record the mailer refuses rather
 * than guess: nineteen coaches with a dead link is worse than a day's delay.
 */
function ciLink_() {
  var base = '';
  try {
    const key = (typeof CORRMAIL !== 'undefined' && CORRMAIL.BASE_PROP) || 'EXEC_URL';
    base = String(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty(key) || '').trim();
  } catch (e) { base = ''; }
  if (!base && typeof corrBaseFromSentMail_ === 'function') {
    try { base = String(corrBaseFromSentMail_() || '').trim(); } catch (e) { base = ''; }
  }
  if (!base || base.indexOf('script.google.com/macros/s/') < 0 || base.indexOf('/exec') < 0) return '';
  return base.split('?')[0] + '?page=portal';
}

/**
 * The message. Short: what it is, three steps in, five things behind the
 * door. The coach-page line goes only to a head coach, whose page it is.
 */
function ciMessage_(who, teamName, link) {
  const hello = 'Coach ' + (who.last || '');
  const steps = [
    'Open ' + link,
    'Enter this email address',
    'Type the six-digit code it sends you'
  ];
  const can = [
    'Enter box scores and stats after each game, or upload the sheet or PDF you already keep',
    'Manage your roster: numbers, positions, heights and weights, captains',
    'Approve or fix stats your players enter themselves',
    'Keep your players eligible for the All-Conference projections, which follow the positions on your roster'
  ];
  if (who.head) can.splice(3, 0, 'Fill in your own coach page');

  const subject = 'Your UCBAC Stats coach sign-in';
  const intro = 'UCBACstats.com has a coach sign-in for ' + teamName + ', and yours is ready. ' +
                'No password, no form:';
  const tail = 'If the code does not arrive, check your spam folder. Questions: reply to this email.';

  const body = hello + ',\n\n' + intro + '\n\n' +
    steps.map(function (s, i) { return '  ' + (i + 1) + '. ' + s; }).join('\n') + '\n\n' +
    'Once you are in, you can:\n' +
    can.map(function (s) { return '  - ' + s; }).join('\n') + '\n\n' +
    tail + '\n\n' + COACHINVITE.SIGNOFF + '\n';

  const esc = function (s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c];
    });
  };
  const htmlBody = '<div style="font:15px/1.5 -apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:#111;max-width:560px">' +
    '<p>' + esc(hello) + ',</p>' +
    '<p>' + esc(intro) + '</p>' +
    '<ol>' +
      '<li>Open <a href="' + esc(link) + '">' + esc(link) + '</a></li>' +
      '<li>' + esc(steps[1]) + '</li>' +
      '<li>' + esc(steps[2]) + '</li>' +
    '</ol>' +
    '<p>Once you are in, you can:</p>' +
    '<ul>' + can.map(function (s) { return '<li>' + esc(s) + '</li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>' +
    '<p>' + esc(tail) + '</p>' +
    '<p>' + COACHINVITE.SIGNOFF.split('\n').map(esc).join('<br>') + '</p>' +
    '</div>';
  return { subject: subject, body: body, htmlBody: htmlBody };
}

/**
 * The run. `send` false writes a verdict beside every row and mails nobody;
 * true mails the rows a dry run would, seating on the Coaches tab first
 * whoever is not there yet. Returns the report as text.
 */
function ciRun_(send) {
  const out = [];
  out.push(send ? 'SENDING coach invitations' : 'DRY RUN — nothing is sent, nothing is written but the verdicts');
  out.push('');

  const sh = ciEnsureTab_();
  const data = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const head = data[0].map(function (h) { return String(h || '').trim(); });
  const col = {};
  head.forEach(function (h, i) { if (h) col[h] = i; });
  ['Result', 'Note'].forEach(function (h) {
    if (col[h] === undefined) {
      col[h] = head.length; head.push(h);
      sh.getRange(1, head.length).setValue(h).setFontWeight('bold');
    }
  });
  if (col.Team === undefined || col.Name === undefined || col.Email === undefined) {
    const m0 = 'The ' + COACHINVITE.TAB + ' tab needs Team, Name and Email columns.';
    out.push(m0);
    return ciReport_(out);
  }

  const link = ciLink_();
  if (!link) {
    out.push('No published address on record yet, so there is no link to send.');
    out.push('Open the site once in a browser (any page), then run this again.');
    return ciReport_(out);
  }

  const plan = [], verdicts = [];   // verdicts: [sheetRow, Result, Note]
  const seen = {};
  for (var r = 1; r < data.length; r++) {
    const row = data[r];
    const teamRaw = String(row[col.Team] || '').trim();
    const nameRaw = String(row[col.Name] || '').trim();
    const emailRaw = String(row[col.Email] || '').trim();
    const already = String(row[col.Result] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!teamRaw && !nameRaw && !emailRaw) continue;
    const sheetRow = r + 1;
    const verdict = function (res, note) { verdicts.push([sheetRow, res, note || '']); };

    const email = (typeof authMailable_ === 'function') ? authMailable_(emailRaw)
                : (/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(emailRaw.toLowerCase()) ? emailRaw.toLowerCase() : '');
    /* A row already mailed keeps its verdict, and its address stays claimed:
       a second row carrying the same address was skipped as a duplicate the
       first time only because this one came first, and would go out on the
       next run if this one no longer spoke for the address. */
    if (already === 'SENT') {
      if (email && !seen[email]) seen[email] = sheetRow;
      verdict('SENT', String(row[col.Note] || ''));
      continue;
    }
    if (!email) { verdict('SKIP', '"' + emailRaw + '" is not an email address'); continue; }
    if (seen[email]) { verdict('SKIP', 'same address as row ' + seen[email]); continue; }
    seen[email] = sheetRow;

    const teamId = siTeamByName_(teamRaw);
    if (!teamId) { verdict('SKIP', 'no school called "' + teamRaw + '"'); continue; }
    const teamName = teamNameOf_(teamId) || teamRaw;

    const st = ciAccountStatus_(email);
    if (st === 'ACTIVE') { verdict('SKIP', 'already has an account'); continue; }

    const who = ciName_(nameRaw);
    if (!who.last) { verdict('SKIP', 'no name'); continue; }

    const onTab = ciCoachRow_(email);
    var note = '';
    if (onTab && String(onTab.TeamID || '').trim() !== teamId) {
      verdict('SKIP', 'on the Coaches tab for ' + (teamNameOf_(String(onTab.TeamID).trim()) || onTab.TeamID) +
                      ', not ' + teamName + ' — fix the Coaches tab first');
      continue;
    }
    const notes = [];
    if (!onTab) notes.push((send ? 'seated' : 'will be seated') + ' on the Coaches tab as ' +
                           (who.head ? 'head coach' : 'assistant coach') + ' for ' + teamName);
    if (st) notes.push('has a ' + st.toLowerCase() + ' account request; the sign-in works regardless');
    note = notes.join('; ');

    plan.push({ sheetRow: sheetRow, email: email, who: who, teamId: teamId, teamName: teamName,
                seat: !onTab, note: note, verdict: verdict });
  }

  if (send && plan.length) {
    var quota = -1;
    try { quota = MailApp.getRemainingDailyQuota(); } catch (e) { quota = -1; }
    if (quota < 0) {
      out.push('The site cannot send mail right now — the script needs to be re-authorized: ' +
               'open the Apps Script editor, run any function once, approve the permissions.');
      return ciReport_(out);
    }
    if (quota < plan.length) {
      out.push('Only ' + quota + ' message' + (quota === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' left in today\'s mail quota and ' +
               plan.length + ' to send. Nothing sent — try again tomorrow, or shorten the list.');
      return ciReport_(out);
    }
  }

  var sent = 0, seated = 0;
  plan.forEach(function (p) {
    if (!send) { p.verdict('WOULD SEND', p.note); return; }
    if (p.seat) {
      appendRows_('Coaches', [{
        Email: p.email, DisplayName: p.who.name, TeamID: p.teamId, Role: 'COACH',
        Active: true, AddedAt: new Date(), CoachType: p.who.head ? 'HEAD' : 'ASSISTANT'
      }]);
      delete __tableCache['Coaches'];
      seated++;
    }
    const m = ciMessage_(p.who, p.teamName, link);
    MailApp.sendEmail({ to: p.email, subject: m.subject, body: m.body, htmlBody: m.htmlBody,
                        name: 'UCBAC Stats', replyTo: COACHINVITE.REPLY_TO });
    sent++;
    p.verdict('SENT', (p.note ? p.note + '; ' : '') + 'sent ' +
              Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'America/New_York', 'MMM d h:mm a'));
  });

  // verdicts beside every row
  verdicts.forEach(function (v) {
    sh.getRange(v[0], col.Result + 1, 1, 2).setValues([[v[1], v[2]]]);
  });

  const skipped = verdicts.filter(function (v) { return v[1] === 'SKIP'; });
  out.push((send ? 'Sent: ' + sent : 'Would send: ' + plan.length) +
           '   skipped: ' + skipped.length +
           (send ? '   seated on the Coaches tab: ' + seated : '') +
           '   already sent earlier: ' + verdicts.filter(function (v) { return v[1] === 'SENT' && !send; }).length);
  out.push('Link in the message: ' + link);
  out.push('');
  plan.forEach(function (p) {
    out.push('  ' + (send ? 'SENT  ' : 'WOULD ') + p.teamName + ': ' + p.who.name +
             (p.who.head ? ' (HC)' : '') + ' <' + p.email + '>' + (p.note ? '  — ' + p.note : ''));
  });
  if (skipped.length) {
    out.push('');
    out.push('Skipped:');
    skipped.forEach(function (v) { out.push('  row ' + v[0] + ': ' + v[2]); });
  }
  out.push('');
  out.push(send ? 'Every row\'s outcome is beside it on the ' + COACHINVITE.TAB + ' tab. A row marked SENT is never mailed again.'
                : 'Nothing was sent. Run Coach invites (SEND) to mail these.');
  return ciReport_(out);
}

function ciReport_(out) {
  const msg = out.join('\n');
  Logger.log(msg);
  try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Coach invites', msg, SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK); } catch (e) {}
  return msg;
}

function menuCoachInvitesTab()  { const sh = ciEnsureTab_(); db_().setActiveSheet(sh); }
function menuCoachInvitesDry()  { return ciRun_(false); }
function menuCoachInvitesSend() { return ciRun_(true); }


===== src/CoachProfile.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — CoachProfile.gs
 *
 * A coach's public page and the form behind it.
 *
 * The page is addressed by TEAM — #/coach/TEAM-014 is "Perryville's head
 * coach" — because that is the stable fact. A head coach who has never
 * registered still gets a page carrying his name from the Teams tab; one who
 * has an account fills in the rest himself through the portal, and the page
 * grows as he does. The same page is the program's coaching staff page:
 * assistants publish their own cards on it through the same portal form, so
 * every coach's name, anywhere on the site, has one place to point.
 *
 * Profile fields ride on the Coaches tab beside the access columns. The email
 * is the join key everywhere here and ships to no payload, public or portal.
 */

const COACH_PROFILE = {
  TAB: 'Coaches',
  // access columns first (Roster.gs createed them); profile columns appended
  COLS: ['CoachID', 'CoachType', 'BirthYear', 'Hometown', 'AlmaMater',
         'HCSince', 'YearsCoaching', 'Highlights', 'XHandle', 'HighSchool', 'InstagramHandle'],
  FIELDS: {
    birthYear:       { col: 'BirthYear',       min: 1940, max: 2012 },
    // Hometown stays on the tab for what was seeded, but the page and the
    // form carry the high school in its place
    hometown:        { col: 'Hometown',        len: 40 },
    highSchool:      { col: 'HighSchool',      len: 60 },
    almaMater:       { col: 'AlmaMater',       len: 60 },
    hcSince:         { col: 'HCSince',         min: 1970, max: 2100 },
    yearsCoaching:   { col: 'YearsCoaching',   min: 0,    max: 60 },
    highlights:      { col: 'Highlights',      len: 160 },
    xHandle:         { col: 'XHandle',         len: 15 },
    instagramHandle: { col: 'InstagramHandle', len: 30 }
  },
  HANDLE: { xHandle: /^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,15}$/, instagramHandle: /^[A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,30}$/ }
};

/** Append any profile column the Coaches tab does not have yet. */
function coachEnsureColumns_() {
  ensureCoachesTab_();
  const sh = getTab_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB);
  const head = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0].map(String);
  const missing = COACH_PROFILE.COLS.filter(function (c) { return head.indexOf(c) < 0; });
  if (!missing.length) return;
  sh.getRange(1, head.length + 1, 1, missing.length)
    .setValues([missing]).setFontWeight('bold');
  delete __tableCache[COACH_PROFILE.TAB];
}

function coachNorm_(v) {
  return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
    .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z ]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

/** Active coaching rows for one team. */
function coachRowsFor_(teamId) {
  if (!hasTab_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB)) return [];
  return rowsOf_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB).filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.TeamID) === s_(teamId) && String(r.Active) !== 'false' &&
           r.Active !== false && s_(r.Role) !== 'ADMIN';
  });
}

/**
 * The team's head coach row, or null. CoachType decides where it is filled;
 * where it is not — rows seeded before the column existed — the name on the
 * Teams tab decides, since that is the name players verify against.
 */
function coachHeadRowFor_(teamId, teamRow) {
  const rows = coachRowsFor_(teamId);
  const typed = rows.filter(function (r) { return s_(r.CoachType).toUpperCase() === 'HEAD'; });
  if (typed.length) return typed[0];
  const want = coachNorm_(teamRow && teamRow.HeadCoach);
  const named = rows.filter(function (r) { return want && coachNorm_(r.DisplayName) === want; });
  return named[0] || null;
}

/** The staff line for a team page: the head coach by name, then assistants. */
function coachStaff_(teamId) {
  const t = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS).filter(function (x) { return s_(x.TeamID) === s_(teamId); })[0];
  const headRow = coachHeadRowFor_(teamId, t);
  const headName = (headRow && s_(headRow.DisplayName)) || s_(t && t.HeadCoach);
  const assistants = coachRowsFor_(teamId).filter(function (r) {
    return r !== headRow && coachNorm_(r.DisplayName) !== coachNorm_(headName);
  }).map(function (r) { return s_(r.DisplayName); }).filter(Boolean).sort();
  return { head: headName || '', assistants: assistants };
}

/** One coach row, published: never the email, never a birth date — the year
 * becomes an age and stays home. */
function coachCard_(row, year) {
  const by = num_(row.BirthYear);
  return {
    name: s_(row.DisplayName),
    type: s_(row.CoachType).toUpperCase() === 'HEAD' ? 'Head Coach' : 'Assistant Coach',
    age: by ? year - by : null,
    highSchool: s_(row.HighSchool), almaMater: s_(row.AlmaMater),
    yearsCoaching: num_(row.YearsCoaching),
    highlights: s_(row.Highlights), x: s_(row.XHandle), ig: s_(row.InstagramHandle),
    hasProfile: !!(by || s_(row.HighSchool) || s_(row.AlmaMater) ||
                   num_(row.YearsCoaching) || s_(row.Highlights) || s_(row.XHandle) || s_(row.InstagramHandle))
  };
}

/**
 * The program's coaching-staff page. Only what a program publishes about its
 * coaches: never an email, never a birth date.
 */
function apiCoach_(teamId) {
  teamId = s_(teamId);
  const t = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS).filter(function (x) { return s_(x.TeamID) === teamId; })[0];
  if (!t) return null;
  const row = coachHeadRowFor_(teamId, t) || {};
  const name = s_(row.DisplayName) || s_(t.HeadCoach);
  if (!name) return null;

  const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  const by = num_(row.BirthYear), since = num_(row.HCSince);
  const st = (typeof apiStandings_ === 'function' ? apiStandings_(CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON) : [])
    .filter(function (r) { return r.teamId === teamId; })[0] || null;

  return {
    teamId: teamId, team: s_(t.DisplayName), name: name, type: 'Head Coach',
    age: by ? year - by : null,
    highSchool: s_(row.HighSchool), almaMater: s_(row.AlmaMater),
    hcSince: since || null,
    hcYears: since ? Math.max(1, year - since + 1) : null,
    yearsCoaching: num_(row.YearsCoaching),
    highlights: s_(row.Highlights),
    x: s_(row.XHandle), ig: s_(row.InstagramHandle),
    staff: coachStaff_(teamId).assistants,
    // every assistant as his own card, profile fields and all - the page is
    // the whole program's staff, not one man
    staffProfiles: coachRowsFor_(teamId).filter(function (r2) {
      return r2 !== (coachHeadRowFor_(teamId, t) || null) &&
             coachNorm_(r2.DisplayName) !== coachNorm_(name) && s_(r2.DisplayName);
    }).map(function (r2) { return coachCard_(r2, year); })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name); }),
    standing: st ? { w: st.w, l: st.l, cw: st.cw, cl: st.cl } : null,
    hasProfile: !!(by || s_(row.HighSchool) || s_(row.AlmaMater) || since ||
                   num_(row.YearsCoaching) || s_(row.Highlights) || s_(row.XHandle) || s_(row.InstagramHandle))
  };
}

/**
 * What the public record says about each program's head coach — hire
 * announcements, school pages, local coverage. The admin's research, not the
 * coach's words, so it is applied as a SEED: it fills a field the coach has
 * left blank and never touches one he has written or deliberately cleared.
 * Keys are TeamIDs; fields are the portal's own (COACH_PROFILE.FIELDS), so
 * the same bounds apply. A team with no entry is skipped.
 *
 * Birth years appear only where a dated article stated the coach's age.
 * Sources are kept with the repository notes, not here.
 */
const COACH_SEED_2026 = {
  'TEAM-001': { // Aberdeen — Kaleb Myers
    almaMater: 'Edgewood High School' },
  'TEAM-002': { // Bel Air — Eric Siegel
    hcSince: 2019, almaMater: 'Bel Air High School', xHandle: 'BAHSCoachSiegel',
    highlights: '2022: first unbeaten regular season in program history and the UCBAC Chesapeake title; Ravens HS Coach of the Week; 2024 3A state quarterfinal.' },
  'TEAM-003': { // Bohemia Manor — Vince Ricci
    highlights: 'Eagles head coach since at least 2023; the 2024 team went 7-4 with a playoff win over Kent County.' },
  'TEAM-004': { // C. Milton Wright — Bryan Hansrote

/**
 * Apply COACH_SEED_2026. Dry run lists every change; apply writes it, with an
 * AuditLog row per field so the seed's provenance is as visible as a coach's
 * own edit. A head coach with no Coaches row yet gets one, without an email;
 * the approval flow claims it the day he signs up.
 */
function seedCoachProfiles_(apply) {
  coachEnsureColumns_();
  const me = { email: 'seed', role: 'ADMIN' };
  const out = [];
  var setCount = 0, keptCount = 0, made = 0;

  // fields a coach edited himself, even to blank — never seeded over
  const edited = {};
  if (hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT)) {
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT).forEach(function (a) {
      if (s_(a.EntityType) === 'Coach' && s_(a.Action) === 'PROFILE_EDIT')
        edited[s_(a.EntityID) + '|' + s_(a.Field)] = true;
    });
  }

  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS).forEach(function (t) {
    const teamId = s_(t.TeamID), seed = COACH_SEED_2026[teamId];
    if (!seed) return;
    const headName = s_(t.HeadCoach);
    if (!headName) { out.push(s_(t.DisplayName) + ': no head coach on the Teams tab — skipped.'); return; }

    var row = coachHeadRowFor_(teamId, t);
    if (!row) {
      out.push(s_(t.DisplayName) + ': ' + headName + ' has no Coaches row — ' +
               (apply ? 'created one (no email; claimed at sign-up).' : 'would create one.'));
      made++;
      if (!apply) row = { __row: null, DisplayName: headName };
      else {
        appendRows_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB, [{ Email: '', DisplayName: headName, TeamID: teamId,
          Role: 'COACH', Active: true, AddedAt: new Date(), CoachType: 'HEAD' }]);
        delete __tableCache[COACH_PROFILE.TAB];
        row = coachHeadRowFor_(teamId, t);
        if (!row) { out.push('  could not re-read the new row — skipped.'); return; }
      }
    }

    var coachId = s_(row.CoachID);
    const updates = [], audit = [], lines = [];
    Object.keys(COACH_PROFILE.FIELDS).forEach(function (k) {
      if (!(k in seed) || seed[k] === null || seed[k] === undefined || seed[k] === '') return;
      const f = COACH_PROFILE.FIELDS[k];
      var v = seed[k];
      if (f.min !== undefined) {
        v = Number(v);
        if (isNaN(v) || v < f.min || v > f.max) { lines.push('  ' + k + ': seed value out of bounds — skipped'); return; }
      } else {
        v = String(v).trim();
        if (COACH_PROFILE.HANDLE[k]) v = v.replace(/^@+/, '');
        if (v.length > f.len) v = v.slice(0, f.len);
      }
      const have = row[f.col];
      if (String(have === null || have === undefined ? '' : have).trim() !== '') {
        keptCount++; lines.push('  ' + k + ': kept "' + s_(have) + '"'); return;
      }
      if (coachId && edited[coachId + '|' + f.col]) {
        keptCount++; lines.push('  ' + k + ': the coach cleared this himself — kept blank'); return;
      }
      setCount++;
      lines.push('  ' + k + ': ' + (apply ? 'set' : 'would set') + ' "' + v + '"');
      if (apply) {
        if (!coachId) {
          coachId = nextIdLocked_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB, 'CoachID', 'CH-', 6);
          updates.push({ row: row.__row, field: 'CoachID', value: coachId });
        }
        updates.push({ row: row.__row, field: f.col, value: v });
        audit.push(auditRow_(me, 'PROFILE_SEED', 'Coach', coachId, f.col, have, v, teamId));
      }
    });

    out.push(s_(t.DisplayName) + ' — ' + s_(row.DisplayName || headName));
    out.push.apply(out, lines.length ? lines : ['  nothing to seed']);
    if (apply && updates.length) {
      updateCells_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB, updates);
      delete __tableCache[COACH_PROFILE.TAB];
      if (audit.length) { ensureOpsTabs_(); appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, audit); }
    }
  });

  if (apply) CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot']);
  const msg = (apply ? 'COACH PROFILES — SEEDED' : 'COACH PROFILES — DRY RUN') +
    '\n' + (apply ? 'set ' : 'would set ') + setCount + '   kept ' + keptCount +
    '   rows created ' + made + '\n\n' + out.join('\n');
  Logger.log(msg);
  return msg;
}

function menuSeedCoachProfilesDry()   { return coachSeedAlert_(seedCoachProfiles_(false)); }
function menuSeedCoachProfilesApply() { return coachSeedAlert_(seedCoachProfiles_(true)); }
function coachSeedAlert_(msg) {
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Coach profiles',
      msg.length > 6000 ? msg.slice(0, 6000) + '\n\n…full report in View > Logs' : msg,
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
  } catch (e) {}
  return msg;
}

/** The signed-in coach's own row, by session email. */
function coachMyRow_() {
  const email = authEmail_();
  if (!email) throw new Error('Sign in first.');
  const rows = hasTab_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB) ? rowsOf_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB) : [];
  const mine = rows.filter(function (r) {
    return String(r.Email || '').toLowerCase().trim() === email &&
           String(r.Active) !== 'false' && r.Active !== false;
  })[0];
  if (!mine) throw new Error('This account is not on the coaching staff of any school.');
  return mine;
}

function apiMyCoachProfile_() {
  coachEnsureColumns_();
  const r = coachMyRow_();
  const out = { teamId: s_(r.TeamID), team: teamNameOf_(s_(r.TeamID)) || s_(r.TeamID),
                name: s_(r.DisplayName),
                isHead: s_(r.CoachType).toUpperCase() === 'HEAD' };
  Object.keys(COACH_PROFILE.FIELDS).forEach(function (k) {
    const f = COACH_PROFILE.FIELDS[k];
    out[k] = f.min !== undefined ? num_(r[f.col]) : s_(r[f.col]);
  });
  return out;
}

function apiSaveCoachProfile_(patch) {
  patch = patch || {};
  coachEnsureColumns_();
  const r = coachMyRow_();
  const me = { email: authEmail_(), role: 'COACH' };

  const updates = [], audit = [], refused = [];
  var coachId = s_(r.CoachID);
  if (!coachId) {
    coachId = nextIdLocked_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB, 'CoachID', 'CH-', 6);
    updates.push({ row: r.__row, field: 'CoachID', value: coachId });
  }

  Object.keys(COACH_PROFILE.FIELDS).forEach(function (k) {
    if (!(k in patch)) return;
    const f = COACH_PROFILE.FIELDS[k];
    var v = patch[k];
    if (f.min !== undefined) {
      v = (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) ? '' : Number(v);
      if (v !== '' && (isNaN(v) || v < f.min || v > f.max)) {
        refused.push(k + ' must be between ' + f.min + ' and ' + f.max + '.');
        return;
      }
    } else {
      v = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim();
      if (COACH_PROFILE.HANDLE[k]) {
        v = v.replace(/^@+/, '');
        if (v && !COACH_PROFILE.HANDLE[k].test(v)) {
          refused.push(k === 'xHandle' ? 'That is not an X handle.' : 'That is not an Instagram handle.');
          return;
        }
      }
      if (v.length > f.len) v = v.slice(0, f.len);
    }
    const before = r[f.col];
    if (String(before === null || before === undefined ? '' : before) === String(v)) return;
    updates.push({ row: r.__row, field: f.col, value: v });
    audit.push(auditRow_(me, 'PROFILE_EDIT', 'Coach', coachId, f.col, before, v, s_(r.TeamID)));
  });

  if (updates.length) {
    updateCells_(COACH_PROFILE.TAB, updates);
    delete __tableCache[COACH_PROFILE.TAB];
    if (audit.length) { ensureOpsTabs_(); appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, audit); }
  }
  return { saved: audit.length, refused: refused,
           message: refused.length ? refused.join(' ')
                  : audit.length ? 'Saved.' : 'Nothing changed.' };
}


===== src/ConferenceStandings.js =====
/** UCBACstats conference standings policy, effective with the 2026 season.
 * Public website ordering, not an official championship or playoff-seeding rule.
 * Resolve whole tied groups: a pairwise head-to-head comparator is not transitive.
 */
const CONFERENCE_STANDINGS = { version: 'UCBAC-2026.2', firstYear: 2026 };
function conferenceStandingsApplies_(season) {
  var match = /^SEA-(\d{4})$/.exec(String(season));
  return !!match && Number(match[1]) >= CONFERENCE_STANDINGS.firstYear;
}
function conferenceStandingsFinal_(g) {
  return /^(FINAL|COMPLETE|COMPLETED|FORFEIT)$/.test(String(g.Status || '').trim().toUpperCase());
}
function conferenceStandingsRegular_(g) {
  return !/PLAYOFF|POST.?SEASON|TOURNAMENT|SCRIMMAGE|PRE.?SEASON|EXHIBITION/i.test(String(g.Phase || '') + ' ' + String(g.GameType || ''));
}
function conferenceStandingsType_(g) { return String(g.GameType || '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[ -]/g, '_'); }
function conferenceStandingsPct_(w, l, t) { var n = w + l + t; return n ? (w + t / 2) / n : null; }
function conferenceStandingsOpponent_(g, side, memberIds) {
  var id = String(g[side + 'TeamID'] || '').trim(), name = String(g[side + 'TeamName'] || '').trim();
  if (memberIds[id]) return '';
  // Preserve exact opponent identity. Do not fuzzy-merge North East/Northeast,
  // Kent/Kent Island, or schools in different states merely because names resemble.
  return (id || name) ? (id ? 'id:' + id : 'name:' + name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')) : '';
}
function conferenceStandingsOrder_(rows, games, teams, season, cutoff) {
  var members = {}, records = {}, played = [], reasons = {}, tied = {}, ranks = {}, position = {};
  teams.forEach(function(t) { if (String(t.IsConferenceMember).toLowerCase() !== 'false') members[String(t.TeamID).trim()] = true; });
  rows.forEach(function(r) { records[r.TeamID] = {w:0,l:0,t:0,margin:0,scored:0,decisions:0}; });
  games.forEach(function(g) {
    if (String(g.SeasonID).trim() !== season || !conferenceStandingsFinal_(g) || !conferenceStandingsRegular_(g) ||
        (cutoff !== null && standingsOrder_(g) > cutoff)) return;
    var type = conferenceStandingsType_(g);
    if (type !== 'CONFERENCE' && type !== 'NON_CONFERENCE') return;
    var h = String(g.HomeTeamID || '').trim(), a = String(g.AwayTeamID || '').trim();
    var hs = numOrNull_(g.HomeScore), as = numOrNull_(g.AwayScore), result;
    var forfeit = String(g.Status || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'FORFEIT';
    if (forfeit && (hs === null || as === null || hs === as)) {
      var side = forfeitSide_(g, teams); if (!side) return;
      result = side === 'HOME' ? -1 : 1;
    } else {
      if (hs === null || as === null) return;
      result = hs > as ? 1 : hs < as ? -1 : 0;
    }
    var item = {h:h,a:a,result:result,conf:type === 'CONFERENCE',hs:hs,as:as,forfeit:forfeit,
      ho:conferenceStandingsOpponent_(g,'Home',members),ao:conferenceStandingsOpponent_(g,'Away',members)};
    played.push(item);
    if (!item.conf) return;
    [[h,result,hs,as],[a,-result,as,hs]].forEach(function(x) {
      var r = records[x[0]]; if (!r) return;
      r.decisions++; if (x[1] > 0) r.w++; else if (x[1] < 0) r.l++; else r.t++;
      // A forfeit decides W/L and head-to-head, never an invented scoring margin.
      if (!forfeit && x[2] !== null && x[3] !== null) {
        r.scored++; r.margin += (x[2]-x[3]);
      }
    });
  });
  function fraction(w,l,t) { return {n:2*w+t,d:2*(w+l+t)}; }
  function compare(a,b) { return a.n*b.d-b.n*a.d; }
  function split(group, values) {
    if (group.some(function(id){return !values[id] || !values[id].d;})) return [group];
    var sorted = group.slice().sort(function(a,b){return -compare(values[a],values[b]) || a.localeCompare(b);});
    var parts=[]; sorted.forEach(function(id){var last=parts[parts.length-1];if(last && compare(values[last[0]],values[id])===0)last.push(id);else parts.push([id]);});
    return parts;
  }
  function headToHead(group) {
    var totals={},pairs={}; group.forEach(function(id){totals[id]={w:0,l:0,t:0};});
    played.filter(function(g){return g.conf && totals[g.h] && totals[g.a];}).forEach(function(g){
      pairs[g.h+'|'+g.a]=pairs[g.a+'|'+g.h]=true;
      if(g.result>0){totals[g.h].w++;totals[g.a].l++;}else if(g.result<0){totals[g.a].w++;totals[g.h].l++;}else{totals[g.h].t++;totals[g.a].t++;}
    });
    var complete=group.every(function(a){return group.every(function(b){return a===b || pairs[a+'|'+b];});});
    if(complete){var vals={};group.forEach(function(id){var r=totals[id];vals[id]=fraction(r.w,r.l,r.t);});return split(group,vals);}
    // With an incomplete mini-league only an unbeaten sweep of EVERY tied rival
    // or losses to EVERY rival supplies a valid head-to-head separation.
    var top=group.filter(function(id){return group.every(function(other){return id===other || pairs[id+'|'+other];}) && totals[id].w>0 && totals[id].l===0 && totals[id].t===0;});
    var bottom=group.filter(function(id){return group.every(function(other){return id===other || pairs[id+'|'+other];}) && totals[id].l>0 && totals[id].w===0 && totals[id].t===0;});
    var middle=group.filter(function(id){return top.indexOf(id)<0 && bottom.indexOf(id)<0;});
    return [top,middle,bottom].filter(function(p){return p.length;});
  }
  function commonOpponents(group) {
    var results={};group.forEach(function(id){results[id]={};});
    played.filter(function(g){return !g.conf;}).forEach(function(g){
      [[g.h,g.ao,g.result],[g.a,g.ho,-g.result]].forEach(function(x){
        if(!results[x[0]] || !x[1])return;
        var r=results[x[0]][x[1]] || (results[x[0]][x[1]]={w:0,l:0,t:0});
        if(x[2]>0)r.w++;else if(x[2]<0)r.l++;else r.t++;
      });
    });
    var common=Object.keys(results[group[0]]).filter(function(op){return group.every(function(id){return !!results[id][op];});});
    if(!common.length)return [group];
    var values={};group.forEach(function(id){var w=0,l=0,t=0;common.forEach(function(op){var r=results[id][op];w+=r.w;l+=r.l;t+=r.t;});values[id]=fraction(w,l,t);});
    return split(group,values);
  }
  function pointMargin(group) {
    var values={};group.forEach(function(id){var r=records[id];if(r.scored)values[id]={n:r.margin,d:r.scored};});
    return split(group,values);
  }
  function resolve(group) {
    if(group.length<2)return [group];
    var criteria=[headToHead,commonOpponents,pointMargin],labels=['head-to-head','common nonconference opponents','average conference point differential'];
    for(var i=0;i<criteria.length;i++){
      var parts=criteria[i](group);
      if(parts.length>1){group.forEach(function(id){reasons[id]=labels[i];});return parts.reduce(function(all,p){return all.concat(resolve(p));},[]);}
    }
    group.forEach(function(id){reasons[id]='unresolved tie';tied[id]=true;});
    // A stable name order makes refreshes predictable without awarding a place.
    return [group.slice().sort(function(a,b){var ar=rows.filter(function(r){return r.TeamID===a;})[0],br=rows.filter(function(r){return r.TeamID===b;})[0];return String(ar.TeamName).localeCompare(String(br.TeamName)) || a.localeCompare(b);})];
  }
  var values={},known=[],unknown=[];
  rows.forEach(function(r){var id=r.TeamID,c=records[id];
    r.ConfW=c.w;r.ConfL=c.l;
    if(c.decisions){values[id]=fraction(c.w,c.l,c.t);known.push(id);}else unknown.push(id);
    reasons[id]='conference winning percentage';
  });
  var groups=split(known,values).filter(function(p){return p.length;}).reduce(function(all,g){return all.concat(resolve(g));},[]);
  if(unknown.length){unknown.forEach(function(id){reasons[id]='no completed conference games';tied[id]=unknown.length>1;});groups.push(unknown.sort());}
  var next=1;groups.forEach(function(g){g.forEach(function(id){ranks[id]=next;position[id]=Object.keys(position).length;});next+=g.length;});
  return {records:records,ranks:ranks,position:position,reasons:reasons,tied:tied};
}
/** Append the six explanatory columns without moving the existing A:O contract. */
function conferenceStandingsWrite_(all) {
  var headers=all.length?Object.keys(all[0]):null,sh=db_().getSheetByName('Standings');
  if(sh && headers && sh.getMaxColumns()<headers.length)sh.insertColumnsAfter(sh.getMaxColumns(),headers.length-sh.getMaxColumns());
  return replaceRows_('Standings',all,headers);
}
/** Run from Apps Script once after deployment; rewrites ONLY derived Standings. */
function refreshConferenceStandings() {
  var lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(10000))throw new Error('Rebuild already running; retry later.');
  try {
    var run=function(){
      var all=[];rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.SEASONS).forEach(function(s){all=all.concat(computeStandings_(String(s.SeasonID).trim()));});
      conferenceStandingsWrite_(all);standingsPlainNumbers_();
      clearApiCache_();PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty(TRG.LAST_BUILD_KEY,new Date().toISOString());
      var result={rule:CONFERENCE_STANDINGS.version,rows:all.length,standingsOnly:true};Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result));return result;
    };
    return typeof appPublicDirectWrite_==='function'?appPublicDirectWrite_(run):run();
  } finally {lock.releaseLock();}
}
