/* Only typed, validated segments are rendered. Model output never becomes HTML. */
var UcbacDailySummary=(function(){
  'use strict';
  function escape(text){return String(text==null?'':text).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];});}
  function segments(parts){
    if(!Array.isArray(parts)||parts.length>60)throw new Error('Invalid paragraph');
    return parts.map(function(p){
      if(!p||typeof p.text!=='string'||p.text.length>1200)throw new Error('Invalid text');
      var text=escape(p.text);
      if(!p.type)return text;
      if(['player','team','coach'].indexOf(p.type)<0||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(p.id))throw new Error('Invalid profile');
      return '<a href="#/'+p.type+'/'+encodeURIComponent(p.id)+'">'+text+'</a>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function markup(data){
    if(!data||data.schema!==1||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(data.day||''))return '';
    try{
      var editions=data.editions,body='';
      ['players','teams'].forEach(function(kind,i){
        var e=editions[kind],name=kind==='players'?'Players':'Teams';
        if(!e||typeof e.headline!=='string'||e.headline.length>120||!Array.isArray(e.paragraphs)||e.paragraphs.length!==3)throw new Error('Invalid edition');
        var paras=e.paragraphs.map(function(p){return '<p class="daily-summary-paragraph">'+segments(p)+'</p>';});
        body+='<article class="daily-summary-panel" id="daily-panel-'+kind+'" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="daily-tab-'+kind+'" tabindex="'+(i?-1:0)+'"'+(i?' aria-hidden="true" inert':'')+'>'+
          '<div class="daily-summary-title"><h2>'+escape(e.headline)+'</h2><span class="daily-summary-ai">AI generated</span></div>'+paras[0]+
          '<div class="daily-summary-extra" id="daily-extra-'+kind+'" hidden>'+paras[1]+paras[2]+'</div>'+
          '<button class="daily-summary-more" type="button" data-daily-more="'+kind+'" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="daily-extra-'+kind+'" aria-label="Read full '+name.toLowerCase()+' summary">'+
          '<span>Read full summary</span><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4 6 4 4 4-4"/></svg></button></article>';
      });
      return '<section class="daily-summary" aria-label="Daily summaries" id="daily-summary">'+
        '<div class="daily-summary-header">'+
        '<div class="daily-summary-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Daily summary editions">'+
        '<button type="button" role="tab" id="daily-tab-players" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="daily-panel-players" data-daily-tab="players">Players</button>'+
        '<button type="button" role="tab" id="daily-tab-teams" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="daily-panel-teams" data-daily-tab="teams" tabindex="-1">Teams</button></div></div>'+
        '<div class="daily-summary-panels">'+body+'</div></section>';
    }catch(error){return '';}
  }
  function collapse(section,kind){
    var button=section.querySelector('[data-daily-more="'+kind+'"]');
    section.querySelector('#daily-extra-'+kind).hidden=true;
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');button.querySelector('span').textContent='Read full summary';
    button.setAttribute('aria-label','Read full '+kind+' summary');
  }
  function select(section,kind,focus){
    ['players','teams'].forEach(function(k){
      var selected=k===kind,tab=section.querySelector('[data-daily-tab="'+k+'"]'),panel=section.querySelector('#daily-panel-'+k);
      collapse(section,k);tab.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(selected));tab.tabIndex=selected?0:-1;
      panel.tabIndex=selected?0:-1;
      if(selected){panel.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');panel.removeAttribute('inert');}else{panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');panel.setAttribute('inert','');}
      if(selected&&focus)tab.focus({preventScroll:true});
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(event){
    var button=event.target.closest('button[data-daily-tab],button[data-daily-more]');if(!button)return;
    var section=button.closest('.daily-summary');if(!section)return;
    if(button.dataset.dailyTab){if(button.getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true')select(section,button.dataset.dailyTab,false);return;}
    var kind=button.dataset.dailyMore,expanded=button.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true';
    section.querySelector('#daily-extra-'+kind).hidden=!expanded;
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(expanded));button.querySelector('span').textContent=expanded?'Show less':'Read full summary';
    button.setAttribute('aria-label',(expanded?'Collapse ':'Read full ')+kind+' summary');
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(event){
    var tab=event.target.closest('[data-daily-tab]');if(!tab||event.altKey||event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey)return;
    var kind;
    if(event.key==='Home')kind='players';else if(event.key==='End')kind='teams';
    else if(event.key==='ArrowLeft'||event.key==='ArrowRight')kind=tab.dataset.dailyTab==='players'?'teams':'players';else return;
    event.preventDefault();select(tab.closest('.daily-summary'),kind,true);
  });
  function skeleton(){return '<div class="daily-summary daily-summary-skeleton" aria-hidden="true"><div class="daily-summary-header"><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-tabs"></i></div><div class="daily-summary-panels"><div class="daily-summary-panel"><div class="daily-summary-title"><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-title"></i><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-ai"></i></div><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-line"></i><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-line"></i><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-line"></i><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-line"></i><i class="skeleton daily-summary-sk-button"></i></div></div></div>';}
  // The host supplies escaped links to the existing account portal.
  var inviteDialog=null,inviteSeen=false,inviteKey='ucbac_member_invite_seen_v1';
  function closeInvite(){if(inviteDialog){var d=inviteDialog;inviteDialog=null;d.close();}}
  function showInvite(signupLink,loginLink){
    if(inviteDialog||inviteSeen||(!signupLink&&!loginLink)||document.hidden)return false;
    try{if(localStorage.getItem(inviteKey)==='1')return false;}catch(e){}
    if(document.querySelector('dialog[open],#mdl'))return false;
    var d=document.createElement('dialog');if(typeof d.showModal!=='function')return false;
    d.id='member-invite';d.className='member-invite';d.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','member-invite-title');d.setAttribute('aria-describedby','member-invite-description');
    d.innerHTML='<div class="member-invite-head"><h2 id="member-invite-title">Go beyond the scoreboard</h2>'+
      '<button type="button" class="member-invite-close" data-invite-close aria-label="Close account invitation" autofocus><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button></div>'+
      '<p id="member-invite-description">Create a free fan, player or coach account. Members 18 and older can ask Blitz AI and explore daily Players and Teams stories.</p>'+
      '<div class="member-invite-actions">'+signupLink+loginLink+'</div>';
    var opener=document.activeElement,oldOverflow=document.body.style.overflow;
    d.addEventListener('close',function(){
      if(inviteDialog===d)inviteDialog=null;d.remove();document.body.style.overflow=oldOverflow;
      if(opener&&opener.isConnected&&opener.focus)opener.focus({preventScroll:true});
    },{once:true});
    d.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target.closest('[data-invite-close]'))closeInvite();});
    d.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key!=='Tab')return;
      var fields=d.querySelectorAll('a[href],button:not([disabled])'),first=fields[0],last=fields[fields.length-1];
      if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}
      else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}
    });
    // Only a press and release on the backdrop dismiss; dragging from content does not.
    var backdropDown=false;
    function outside(e){var b=d.getBoundingClientRect();return e.clientX<b.left||e.clientX>b.right||e.clientY<b.top||e.clientY>b.bottom;}
    d.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){backdropDown=e.target===d&&outside(e);});
    d.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(backdropDown&&e.target===d&&outside(e))closeInvite();backdropDown=false;});
    document.body.appendChild(d);
    try{d.showModal();}catch(e){d.remove();return false;}
    inviteDialog=d;inviteSeen=true;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
    try{localStorage.setItem(inviteKey,'1');}catch(e){}
    return true;
  }
  window.addEventListener('hashchange',closeInvite);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',closeInvite);
  return {markup:markup,skeleton:skeleton,showInvite:showInvite,closeInvite:closeInvite};
})();

===== src/Database.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — Database.gs
 * Generic sheet access. ONE getValues() per tab per execution, then work in memory.
 * Never call getRange().getValue() in a loop.
 */

var __tableCache = {};   // per-execution memo
var __tabMap = null;     // normalized tab name -> real Sheet object

/** Diagnostic: list every tab with its exact name and row count. */
function listTabs_() {
  const out = ['TABS IN THIS SPREADSHEET', ''];
  db_().getSheets().forEach(function (sh) {
    var nm = sh.getName();
    out.push('  "' + nm + '"' +
             (nm !== nm.trim() ? '   <- has leading/trailing space' : '') +
             '   rows=' + Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1));
  });
  const msg = out.join('\n');
  Logger.log(msg);
  try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tabs', msg, SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK); } catch (e) {}
  return msg;
}

function normName_(s_) {
  return String(s_).replace(/[\s_\-]+/g, '').toLowerCase();
}

/** Resolve a tab tolerantly: exact -> trimmed -> case/space/underscore-insensitive. */
function getTab_(tabName) {
  var sh = db_().getSheetByName(tabName);
  if (sh) return sh;

  if (!__tabMap) {
    __tabMap = {};
    db_().getSheets().forEach(function (s_) { __tabMap[normName_(s_.getName())] = s_; });
  }
  sh = __tabMap[normName_(tabName)];
  if (sh) return sh;

  const have = db_().getSheets().map(function (s_) { return '"' + s_.getName() + '"'; }).join(', ');
  throw new Error('Missing tab: ' + tabName + '\nTabs present: ' + have +
                  '\nRun listTabs_() to see exact names.');
}

/**
 * Read a whole tab as an array of objects keyed by its header row.
 * Blank cells become '' — callers use numOrNull() to distinguish blank from zero.
 */
function readTable_(tabName) {
  if (__tableCache[tabName]) return __tableCache[tabName];

  const sh = getTab_(tabName);
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) {
    __tableCache[tabName] = { headers: [], rows: [] };
    return __tableCache[tabName];
  }

  const values  = sh.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getValues();
  const headers = values[0].map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); });

  const rows = [];
  for (var r = 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    var obj = {}, blank = true;
    for (var c = 0; c < headers.length; c++) {
      if (!headers[c]) continue;
      var v = values[r][c];
      obj[headers[c]] = v;
      if (v !== '' && v !== null) blank = false;
    }
    if (!blank) { obj.__row = r + 1; rows.push(obj); }
  }
  __tableCache[tabName] = { headers: headers, rows: rows };
  return __tableCache[tabName];
}

function rowsOf_(tabName) {
  if (typeof appPublicRows_ === 'function') { var snapshot = appPublicRows_(tabName); if (snapshot !== null) return snapshot; }
  return readTable_(tabName).rows;
}

/** True if a tab carries this column. For writes that are genuinely optional —
    a cosmetic field on a tab an older workbook may predate — so the caller can
    leave it out rather than have updateCells_ refuse the whole change. */
function hasColumn_(tabName, field) {
  try { return readTable_(tabName).headers.indexOf(field) >= 0; }
  catch (e) { return false; }
}

/** True if a tab exists (tolerantly), without throwing. */
function hasTab_(tabName) {
  try { getTab_(tabName); return true; } catch (e) { return false; }
}

/** Build an in-memory index: key -> row (or array of rows when multi=true). */
function indexBy_(rows, keyFn, multi) {
  var map = {};
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var k = keyFn(rows[i]);
    if (k === null || k === undefined || k === '') continue;
    if (multi) { (map[k] = map[k] || []).push(rows[i]); }
    else if (map[k] === undefined) { map[k] = rows[i]; }
  }
  return map;
}

/** Append many rows in ONE write. objects are matched against the header row. */
function appendRows_(tabName, objects) {
  if (!objects || !objects.length) return 0;
  const sh = getTab_(tabName);
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0]
                    .map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); });

  const matrix = objects.map(function (o) {
    return headers.map(function (h) {
      var v = o[h];
      return (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : v;
    });
  });

  sh.getRange(sh.getLastRow() + 1, 1, matrix.length, headers.length).setValues(matrix);
  delete __tableCache[tabName];
  return matrix.length;
}

/** Replace a tab's data (header preserved) in ONE write. Used for derived tables. */
function replaceRows_(tabName, objects, headers) {
  var sh;
  try { sh = getTab_(tabName); } catch (e) { sh = db_().insertSheet(tabName); __tabMap = null; }

  if (!headers) {
    if (sh.getLastColumn() > 0 && sh.getLastRow() > 0) {
      headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0]
                  .map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); })
                  .filter(function (h) { return h; });
    }
    if (!headers || !headers.length) {
      headers = objects.length ? Object.keys(objects[0]) : [];
    }
  }
  sh.clear();
  if (!headers.length) return 0;

  const matrix = [headers];
  for (var i = 0; i < objects.length; i++) {
    matrix.push(headers.map(function (h) {
      var v = objects[i][h];
      return (v === undefined || v === null) ? '' : v;
    }));
  }
  sh.getRange(1, 1, matrix.length, headers.length).setValues(matrix);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length)
    .setFontWeight('bold').setFontColor('#FFFFFF').setBackground('#1F3B54');
  delete __tableCache[tabName];
  return objects.length;
}

/**
 * Update specific cells by row number.
 *
 * A field the tab has no column for used to be skipped in silence, and the
 * count nobody reads was the only sign. That is the worst way for a write to
 * fail: an approval reports success, a roster edit reports saved, and the
 * sheet never moved. A column that is merely absent from SOME rows is not the
 * case here — the header row is the whole contract — so a field that is not in
 * it is a bug in the caller or a renamed column, and both want saying out loud.
 * Fields that did write are kept: rolling them back would leave the row in a
 * state no source describes.
 */
function updateCells_(tabName, updates) {
  if (!updates || !updates.length) return 0;
  const sh = getTab_(tabName);
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0]
                    .map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); });
  var n = 0;
  const missing = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < updates.length; i++) {
    var col = headers.indexOf(updates[i].field) + 1;
    if (col < 1) { missing.push(updates[i].field); continue; }
    sh.getRange(updates[i].row, col).setValue(updates[i].value);
    n++;
  }
  delete __tableCache[tabName];
  if (missing.length) {
    throw new Error(tabName + ' has no column named ' + missing.join(', ') +
                    ', so ' + (n ? 'part of this change was' : 'this change was') +
                    ' not saved. An administrator should run ensureSchema().');
  }
  return n;
}

/** Sequential ID generator, lock-protected against concurrent writers. */
function nextId_(tabName, field, prefix, pad_) {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS);
  try {
    const rows = rowsOf_(tabName);
    var max = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var v = String(rows[i][field] || '');
      var m = v.match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
      if (m) max = Math.max(max, parseInt(m[1], 10));
    }
    var n = String(max + 1);
    while (n.length < (pad_ || 6)) n = '0' + n;
    return prefix + n;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/** Create the operational tabs the seed workbook does not include. */
function ensureOpsTabs_() {
  const specs = {};
  specs[CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT] = ['AuditID','Timestamp','UserID','Role','Action','EntityType',
                              'EntityID','Field','OldValue','NewValue','RequestID','Notes'];
  specs[CONFIG.TABS.SUBMISSIONS] = ['SubmissionID','GameID','TeamID','SeasonID','Week',
                                    'SubmittedBy','SubmittedAt','Method','Status','RowCount',
                                    'ErrorCount','WarningCount','PublishedAt','Notes'];
  specs[CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS] = ['CorrectionID','StatID','GameID','PlayerID','Field',
                                    'OldValue','NewValue','CorrectedBy','Role','CorrectedAt',
                                    'Reason'];
  var made = [];
  Object.keys(specs).forEach(function (name) {
    if (!hasTab_(name)) {
      const sh = db_().insertSheet(name);
      sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, specs[name].length).setValues([specs[name]])
        .setFontWeight('bold').setFontColor('#FFFFFF').setBackground('#1F3B54');
      sh.setFrozenRows(1);
      made.push(name);
      __tabMap = null;
    }
  });
  return made;
}

===== src/Fantasy.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — Fantasy.gs
 *
 * A PPR fantasy scoring board over the statistics the conference already keeps.
 *
 * It is a way of READING the box score, not a competition: there is no league,
 * no draft, no roster and no team to build. One player, one number, and the
 * arithmetic that produced it shown in full — which is the point. A fantasy
 * score is only interesting if you can see where every point came from, so the
 * player view returns the same four columns a scoring settings page shows:
 * category, points per, how many, and what that came to.
 *
 * One scoring system: PPR. There is no format switch, because a page offering
 * three of them is asking a reader to make a decision the page could just make
 * for them — and PPR is the one nearly every league runs.
 *
 * Three commitments, and every decision below is one of them:
 *
 *  1. The scoring is the standard one, not a house one. Passing yards at a
 *     point per 25 and touchdowns at four, rushing and receiving at a point per
 *     ten and six, a point per catch, minus two for a giveaway. Anybody who has
 *     played fantasy football recognises the table without being told it.
 *  2. Every position on the roster scores something. A site that tracks fifteen
 *     schools' defences and then hands a linebacker a zero would be advertising
 *     a page that does not work for half its players, so defenders score on the
 *     standard IDP table and the one blocking statistic the conference records
 *     is worth a point. The two additions are labelled as what they are.
 *  3. blank != zero, as everywhere else. A category nobody filed is absent from
 *     a player's table rather than printed as a nought, and it contributes
 *     nothing to his total. A total built by treating unreported as zero would
 *     rank the boys whose coaches file carefully BELOW the ones who do not.
 *
 * The numbers come from the same grain-resolved player-season table the Stats
 * page reads, so a fantasy total and a stat line can never disagree.
 */

const FANTASY_CACHE_PREFIX = 'fant2:';    // bump the digit to invalidate every key
const FANTASY_CACHE_TTL    = 120;
const FANTASY_LIMIT        = 50;
const FANTASY_MAX_LIMIT    = 75;

const FANTASY_LABEL = 'PPR';
const FANTASY_NOTE  = 'a point per reception';

/**
 * One part of the game at a time, and no combined total.
 *
 * A two-way player's offensive points and his defensive points are scored on
 * two different tables and answer two different questions, so adding them
 * produces a number that ranks him against nobody: a running back who never
 * plays defence and a linebacker who never touches the ball are not competing,
 * and a total across all three puts the boys who play both ahead of everyone
 * for reasons that have nothing to do with how they played. Pick a side and
 * the board is a board.
 *
 * There is deliberately no ALL. Offense is the default because it is the one
 * everybody means by "fantasy points" — but a position filter overrides it,
 * since a linebacker asked for on the offensive board is an empty screen.
 */
const FANTASY_SIDES = ['OFFENSE', 'DEFENSE', 'SPECIAL'];
const FANTASY_SIDE_LABEL = { OFFENSE: 'Offense', DEFENSE: 'Defense', SPECIAL: 'Special Teams' };

/**
 * The scoring table.
 *
 * A label NAMES THE UNIT, singular: the column beside it says what one of them
 * pays, so "Sack, 2" is the sentence and "Each Sack" says the same word twice.
 * Yardage stays plural, because nobody has ever written "Passing Yard".
 *
 * `fields` are SUM_FIELDS keys, summed together — a fumble lost is a fumble
 * lost whether he was carrying it or catching it. `pts` per `per` units, so a
 * point per 25 passing yards is {pts:1, per:25}; the screen divides it out and
 * prints 0.04, because the column beside it is a count and the two have to
 * multiply. `short` is the board's column heading, where a label will not fit.
 *
 * `house` marks a category standard fantasy football does not score at all.
 * There are exactly two kinds and both are deliberate: the defensive block is
 * the standard IDP table, which every league that scores defenders uses, and
 * the pancake is ours, because the conference records it and an offensive
 * lineman deserves better than a page of zeros. Both are declared to the
 * client so the scoring key can say so out loud rather than quietly passing
 * them off as canon.
 */
const FANTASY_RULES = [
  // ── passing
  { key: 'PassYds',      label: 'Passing Yards',        short: 'PASS YDS', side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Passing',   fields: ['PassYds'],      pts: 1,   per: 25 },
  { key: 'PassTD',       label: 'Passing Touchdown',    short: 'PASS TD',  side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Passing',   fields: ['PassTD'],       pts: 4 },
  // Two categories are called INT in football and they are opposites. The one
  // he threw says so on the board, or a quarterback reads as a ball hawk.
  { key: 'PassInt',      label: 'Interception Thrown',  short: 'INT THR',  side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Passing',   fields: ['PassInt'],      pts: -2 },

  // ── rushing
  { key: 'RushYds',      label: 'Rushing Yards',        short: 'RUSH YDS', side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Rushing',   fields: ['RushYds'],      pts: 1,   per: 10 },
  { key: 'RushTD',       label: 'Rushing Touchdown',    short: 'RUSH TD',  side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Rushing',   fields: ['RushTD'],       pts: 6 },

  // ── receiving
  { key: 'Rec',          label: 'Reception',            short: 'REC',      side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Receiving', fields: ['Rec'],          pts: 1 },
  { key: 'RecYds',       label: 'Receiving Yards',      short: 'REC YDS',  side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Receiving', fields: ['RecYds'],       pts: 1,   per: 10 },
  { key: 'RecTD',        label: 'Receiving Touchdown',  short: 'REC TD',   side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Receiving', fields: ['RecTD'],        pts: 6 },

  // A giveaway costs the same wherever it happened.
  { key: 'FumLost',      label: 'Fumble Lost',          short: 'FUM',      side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Ball security',
    fields: ['RushFum', 'RecFum'], pts: -2 },

  // ── kicking. Distance is not collected, so a field goal is a field goal:
  // scoring 0-39 / 40-49 / 50+ would mean inventing a distance for every kick
  // in the database. A miss is not penalised — the flat three already declines
  // to reward the long ones, and taking a point off a fourteen-year-old's card
  // for a miss is not what this page is for.
  { key: 'FGM',          label: 'Field Goal Made',      short: 'FGM',      side: 'SPECIAL', group: 'Kicking',   fields: ['FGM'],          pts: 3 },
  { key: 'XPM',          label: 'Extra Point Made',     short: 'XPM',      side: 'SPECIAL', group: 'Kicking',   fields: ['XPM'],          pts: 1 },

  // ── returns
  { key: 'KRYds',        label: 'Kick Return Yards',    short: 'KR YDS',   side: 'SPECIAL', group: 'Returns',   fields: ['KRYds'],        pts: 1,   per: 25 },
  { key: 'PRYds',        label: 'Punt Return Yards',    short: 'PR YDS',   side: 'SPECIAL', group: 'Returns',   fields: ['PRYds'],        pts: 1,   per: 25 },

  // ── the standard IDP table
  { key: 'TackleSolo',   label: 'Solo Tackle',          short: 'SOLO',     side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['TackleSolo'],   pts: 1,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'TackleAssist', label: 'Assisted Tackle',      short: 'AST',      side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['TackleAssist'], pts: 0.5, house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'TFL',          label: 'Tackle for Loss',      short: 'TFL',      side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['TFL'],          pts: 1,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'Sacks',        label: 'Sack',                 short: 'SACK',     side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['Sacks'],        pts: 2,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'Int',          label: 'Interception',         short: 'INT',      side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['Int'],          pts: 3,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'PassDef',      label: 'Pass Defended',        short: 'PD',       side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['PassDef'],      pts: 1,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'FF',           label: 'Forced Fumble',        short: 'FF',       side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['FF'],           pts: 2,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'FR',           label: 'Fumble Recovery',      short: 'FR',       side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['FR'],           pts: 2,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'DefTD',        label: 'Defensive Touchdown',  short: 'DEF TD',   side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['DefTD'],        pts: 6,   house: 'IDP' },
  { key: 'Blocks',       label: 'Blocked Kick',         short: 'BLK',      side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',   fields: ['Blocks'],       pts: 2,   house: 'IDP' },

  // ── the one blocking statistic the conference keeps
  { key: 'Pancakes',     label: 'Pancake Block',        short: 'PAN',      side: 'OFFENSE', group: 'Blocking',  fields: ['Pancakes'],     pts: 1,   house: 'UCBAC' }

const FANTASY_BY_KEY = (function () {
  const m = {};
  FANTASY_RULES.forEach(function (r) { m[r.key] = r; });
  return m;

/**
 * Team Defense — the D/ST table, which is a different scoring system from the
 * IDP one above and not a sum of it. A league scores an individual linebacker
 * on tackles; it scores a DEFENCE on takeaways, sacks and what it gave up.
 *
 * Three standard categories are absent because the conference does not record
 * them, and the page says so rather than letting a reader think his defence
 * came up short: the kickoff return touchdown, the punt return touchdown, and
 * the safety. Our one DefTD field covers the interception and fumble returns,
 * which is where the standard table also puts 6 points, so those are exact.
 */
const FANTASY_TEAM_RULES = [
  { key: 'Sacks',  label: 'Sack',                    short: 'SACK',   side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',
    fields: ['Sacks'],  pts: 1 },
  { key: 'Int',    label: 'Interception',            short: 'INT',    side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',
    fields: ['Int'],    pts: 2 },
  { key: 'FR',     label: 'Fumble Recovery',         short: 'FR',     side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',
    fields: ['FR'],     pts: 2 },
  { key: 'Blocks', label: 'Blocked Punt, PAT or FG', short: 'BLK',    side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',
    fields: ['Blocks'], pts: 2 },
  // Interception and fumble returns both score 6 in the standard table, and
  // both land in this one field, so not being able to tell them apart costs
  // the arithmetic nothing.
  { key: 'DefTD',  label: 'Interception or Fumble Return TD', short: 'DEF TD', side: 'DEFENSE', group: 'Defense',
    fields: ['DefTD'],  pts: 6 }
];

const FANTASY_TEAM_BY_KEY = (function () {
  const m = {};
  FANTASY_TEAM_RULES.forEach(function (r) { m[r.key] = r; });
  return m;
})();

/**
 * Points allowed, in the standard bands.
 *
 * The band is a PER-GAME band and is applied per game, which is the whole
 * point of it: a defence that allowed 140 points across ten games played ten
 * ordinary games, and running its season total through this table would call
 * it a 46+ defence and take five points off it.
 */
const FANTASY_PA_TIERS = [
  { key: 'PA0',     max: 0,       label: 'Shutout — 0 points allowed', short: 'SHO', pts: 5 },
  { key: 'PA1_6',   max: 6,       label: '1-6 points allowed',              short: '1-6', pts: 4 },
  { key: 'PA7_13',  max: 13,      label: '7-13 points allowed',             short: '7-13', pts: 3 },
  { key: 'PA14_17', max: 17,      label: '14-17 points allowed',            short: '14-17', pts: 1 },
  { key: 'PA18_27', max: 27,      label: '18-27 points allowed',            short: '18-27', pts: 0 },
  { key: 'PA28_34', max: 34,      label: '28-34 points allowed',            short: '28-34', pts: -1 },
  { key: 'PA35_45', max: 45,      label: '35-45 points allowed',            short: '35-45', pts: -3 },
  { key: 'PA46',    max: 1e9,     label: '46+ points allowed',              short: '46+', pts: -5 }
];

function fantasyTier_(pointsAllowed) {
  for (var i = 0; i < FANTASY_PA_TIERS.length; i++) {
    if (pointsAllowed <= FANTASY_PA_TIERS[i].max) return FANTASY_PA_TIERS[i];
  }
  return FANTASY_PA_TIERS[FANTASY_PA_TIERS.length - 1];
}

/**
 * What one of the thing is worth: "0.04", "0.1", "4", "-2", "0.5".
 *
 * The multiplier, not the ratio — the column is called Pts Per and the row
 * beside it is a count, so the three columns have to read across as
 * "0.1 x 26 = 2.6". Printing "1 per 10" there is a different sum from the one
 * the numbers next to it are doing.
 */
function fantasyPtsLabel_(rule) {
  const each = rule.pts / (rule.per || 1);
  return String(Math.round(each * 1000) / 1000);
}

/** Fantasy points carry one decimal, the way every scoreboard shows them. */
function fantasyRound_(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || typeof v !== 'number' || isNaN(v)) return null;
  return Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
}

/**
 * Score one player's summed statistics.
 *
 * Returns every line that has something behind it, plus the total. A category
 * the player did not record — or recorded as a genuine nought — yields no line
 * at all: "0 interceptions thrown, 0.0 points" is a row that tells the reader
 * nothing and pushes the rows that do off the screen.
 */
function fantasyScore_(sums, side) {
  const lines = [], counts = {};
  var total = 0, any = false;
  FANTASY_RULES.forEach(function (rule) {
    if (side && rule.side !== side) return;
    var count = null;
    rule.fields.forEach(function (f) {
      const v = numOrNull_(sums[f]);
      if (v === null) return;
      count = (count === null ? 0 : count) + v;
    });
    if (count === null || count === 0) return;
    const score = (count / (rule.per || 1)) * rule.pts;
    any = true;
    total += score;
    counts[rule.key] = Math.round(count * 100) / 100;
    lines.push({
      key: rule.key, label: rule.label, short: rule.short, group: rule.group,
      ptsLabel: fantasyPtsLabel_(rule),
      count: counts[rule.key],
      score: fantasyRound_(score),
      house: rule.house || ''
    });
  });
  // Nobody who filed nothing gets a 0.0 — that is a score, and he has none.
  return { lines: lines, counts: counts, total: any ? fantasyRound_(total) : null };
}

/**
 * Every player in range, with his points.
 *
 * Deliberately the same shape and the same gates as statsPlayerRows(): filters
 * apply to the SEASON row so a boy who transferred out of the county is scored
 * only for the seasons he played there, and a player whose roster row names no
 * position is judged on what he actually recorded rather than dropped for his
 * coach's paperwork.
 */
function fantasyAccum_(q, ctx) {
  const src = ctx.playerSource || statsSeasonSource_();
  const players = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS), function (p) { return s_(p.PlayerID); });

  const posOf = {}, gradOf = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).forEach(function (r) {
    var sid = s_(r.SeasonID), pid = s_(r.PlayerID), grad = s_(r.GradYear);
    if (pid && grad && !gradOf[pid]) gradOf[pid] = grad;
    if (!ctx.inRange[sid]) return;
    posOf[pid + '|' + sid] = parsePositions_(r.Positions);
  });

  const acc = {};
  src.rows.forEach(function (r) {
    var pid = s_(r.PlayerID), sid = s_(r.SeasonID);
    if (!pid || !ctx.inRange[sid]) return;
    if (q.playerId && pid !== q.playerId) return;

    var tid = s_(r.TeamID), team = ctx.teams[tid];
    if (q.teamId && tid !== q.teamId) return;
    if (q.county && (!team || team.county !== q.county)) return;

    var codes = posOf[pid + '|' + sid] || [];
    var posUnknown = false;
    if (q.position) {
      if (!positionMatches_(codes, q.position)) {
        if (codes.length) return;
        posUnknown = true;
      }
    }

    var b = acc[pid];
    if (!b) {
      b = acc[pid] = { playerId: pid, sums: {}, gp: null, gpMissing: 0, seasons: [],
                       positions: {}, newest: '', newestTeam: '', posUnknown: false,
                       positionConfirmed: false, prov: false };
    }
    if (s_(r.Provisional) === 'TRUE') b.prov = true;
    addInto_(b.sums, r);

    var gp = numOrNull_(r.GamesPlayed);
    if (gp === null) b.gpMissing++;
    else b.gp = (b.gp === null ? 0 : b.gp) + gp;

    if (b.seasons.indexOf(sid) < 0) b.seasons.push(sid);
    codes.forEach(function (c) { b.positions[c] = true; });
    if (posUnknown) { if (!b.positionConfirmed) b.posUnknown = true; }
    else if (q.position) { b.posUnknown = false; b.positionConfirmed = true; }
    if (sid > b.newest) { b.newest = sid; b.newestTeam = tid; }
  });

  const out = [];
  var inferred = 0;
  Object.keys(acc).forEach(function (pid) {
    var b = acc[pid];
    if (b.posUnknown) {
      if (!statsProfileFits_(b.sums, q.position)) return;
      inferred++;
    }
    var scored = fantasyScore_(b.sums, q.side);
    // A player in range who scored nothing at all is not a fantasy row. He is
    // on the Stats page with whatever he did record; a board of 0.0s is not a
    // leaderboard, it is a roster.
    if (scored.total === null && ctx.keepZero && fantasyHasReported_(b.sums, q.side)) scored.total = 0;
    if (scored.total === null) return;

    var p = players[pid] || {};
    var team = ctx.teams[b.newestTeam] || null;
    var seasons = b.seasons.slice().sort().reverse();
    // Per-game means nothing off a partial game count: a two-season total
    // divided by the one season that filed games roughly doubles the rate.
    var fppg = (b.gp !== null && b.gp > 0 && !b.gpMissing)
             ? fantasyRound_(scored.total / b.gp) : null;

    out.push({
      playerId: pid,
      player: s_(p.DisplayName) || pid,
      teamId: b.newestTeam,
      team: team ? team.name : b.newestTeam,
      county: team ? team.county : '',
      grad: s_(p.GradYear) || gradOf[pid] || '',
      positions: formatPositions_(statsOrderedCodes_(b.positions)),
      seasonIds: seasons,
      seasons: seasons.map(function (id) { return ctx.seasonIdx.byId[id].label; }).join(', '),
      gp: b.gp,
      gpPartial: b.gpMissing > 0,
      prov: !!b.prov,
      fpts: scored.total,
      fppg: fppg,
      cats: scored.counts,
      lines: scored.lines
    });
  });
  ctx.inferredPositions = inferred;
  return out;
}

// ── Team Defense ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * One bucket per conference team: what its defence recorded, and what it gave
 * up game by game.
 *
 * Two independent halves, for the same reason statsTeamRows has two. Points
 * allowed come from Games, because they must be read one game at a time for
 * the band to mean anything, and because a defence allowed what it allowed
 * whether the other side was a conference member or not. Sacks, takeaways and
 * blocks come from PlayerGameStats with grain resolved per player-season
 * FIRST, so a player holding both GAME rows and a SEASON_TOTAL row contributes
 * once and a mid-season transfer lands on both teams.
 */
function fantasyTeamAccum_(q, ctx) {
  const acc = {};
  function bucket(tid) {
    if (!ctx.teams[tid]) return null;                 // conference members only
    var b = acc[tid];
    if (!b) {
      b = acc[tid] = { teamId: tid, sums: {}, pa: null, gp: 0, tiers: {},
                       seasons: {}, prov: false };
    }
    return b;
  }

  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).forEach(function (g) {
    var sid = s_(g.SeasonID);
    if (!ctx.inRange[sid] || (ctx.acceptGame && !ctx.acceptGame(g))) return;
    var hs = numOrNull_(g.HomeScore), as = numOrNull_(g.AwayScore);
    if (hs === null || as === null) return;           // unplayed contributes nothing
    [[s_(g.HomeTeamID), as], [s_(g.AwayTeamID), hs]].forEach(function (persp) {
      var b = bucket(persp[0]);
      if (!b) return;
      b.pa = (b.pa === null ? 0 : b.pa) + persp[1];
      b.gp++;
      b.seasons[sid] = true;
      var t = fantasyTier_(persp[1]);
      b.tiers[t.key] = (b.tiers[t.key] || 0) + 1;
    });
  });

  const pacc = {};
  var rowIdx = 0;
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS).forEach(function (r) {
    rowIdx++;
    var sid = s_(r.SeasonID);
    if (!ctx.inRange[sid]) return;
    var grain = s_(r.grain || r.Grain);
    if (ctx.acceptGame) {
      const game = fantasyCalendar_().games[s_(r.GameID)];
      if (grain !== CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME || !game || s_(game.SeasonID) !== sid || !ctx.acceptGame(game)) return;
    }
    if (grain !== CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME && grain !== CONFIG.GRAIN.SEASON_TOTAL) return;
    var tid = s_(r.TeamID);
    if (!ctx.teams[tid]) return;

    // A stat row that never resolved to a PlayerID is still the team's
    // production. Dropping it would understate every school that had an
    // import miss.
    var pid = s_(r.PlayerID);
    if (!pid) pid = s_(r.player_raw) ? '~raw:' + s_(r.player_raw).toLowerCase() : '~row:' + rowIdx;

    var key = pid + '|' + sid;
    var p = pacc[key];
    if (!p) p = pacc[key] = { seasonId: sid, game: {}, season: {}, hasGame: false, provTeams: {} };
    if (grain === CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME) {
      p.hasGame = true;
      if (provisionalSource_(r.SourceType)) p.provTeams[tid] = true;
      if (!p.game[tid]) p.game[tid] = {};
      addInto_(p.game[tid], r);
    } else {
      if (!p.season[tid]) p.season[tid] = {};
      addInto_(p.season[tid], r);
    }
  });

  Object.keys(pacc).forEach(function (key) {
    var p = pacc[key];
    var use = p.hasGame ? p.game : p.season;
    Object.keys(use).forEach(function (tid) {
      var b = bucket(tid);
      if (!b) return;
      var sums = use[tid];
      FANTASY_TEAM_RULES.forEach(function (rule) {
        rule.fields.forEach(function (f) {
          if (sums[f] === undefined) return;
          b.sums[f] = (b.sums[f] === undefined ? 0 : b.sums[f]) + sums[f];
        });
      });
      b.seasons[p.seasonId] = true;
      if (p.hasGame && p.provTeams[tid]) b.prov = true;
    });
  });

  const out = [];
  Object.keys(acc).forEach(function (tid) {
    var b = acc[tid];
    var scored = fantasyTeamScore_(b);
    if (scored.total === null) return;
    var team = ctx.teams[tid];
    var seasons = Object.keys(b.seasons).sort().reverse();
    out.push({
      playerId: tid,                       // the sorter and the client key on this
      teamId: tid,
      player: team.name, team: team.name,
      county: team.county, positions: '', grad: '',
      seasonIds: seasons,
      seasons: seasons.map(function (id) { return ctx.seasonIdx.byId[id].label; }).join(', '),
      gp: b.gp || null,
      gpPartial: false,
      prov: !!b.prov,
      pa: b.pa,
      fpts: scored.total,
      fppg: (b.gp > 0) ? fantasyRound_(scored.total / b.gp) : null,
      cats: scored.counts,
      lines: scored.lines
    });
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Score one defence.
 *
 * The points-allowed bands are emitted as one line per band that actually
 * happened — "7-13 points allowed, 3 points each, 4 games, 12.0" — which is
 * exactly the four columns the rest of the page uses. A band worth nothing
 * still gets its line, unlike every other category on the site: the bands
 * together have to account for every game played, and one silently missing
 * makes the games stop adding up.
 */
function fantasyTeamScore_(b) {
  const lines = [], counts = {};
  var total = 0, any = false;

  FANTASY_TEAM_RULES.forEach(function (rule) {
    var count = null;
    rule.fields.forEach(function (f) {
      const v = numOrNull_(b.sums[f]);
      if (v === null) return;
      count = (count === null ? 0 : count) + v;
    });
    if (count === null || count === 0) return;
    const score = count * rule.pts;
    any = true; total += score;
    counts[rule.key] = Math.round(count * 100) / 100;
    lines.push({ key: rule.key, label: rule.label, short: rule.short, group: rule.group,
                 ptsLabel: fantasyPtsLabel_(rule), count: counts[rule.key],
                 score: fantasyRound_(score), house: '' });
  });

  FANTASY_PA_TIERS.forEach(function (t) {
    const games = b.tiers[t.key] || 0;
    if (!games) return;
    const score = games * t.pts;
    any = true; total += score;
    lines.push({ key: t.key, label: t.label, short: t.short, group: 'Points allowed',
                 ptsLabel: String(t.pts), count: games,
                 score: fantasyRound_(score), house: '' });
  });
  if (b.pa !== null) counts.PA = b.pa;

  return { lines: lines, counts: counts, total: any ? fantasyRound_(total) : null };
}

/** The board's columns for a defence: the five categories, then what it gave up. */
function fantasyTeamColumns_(rows, sortBy) {
  const present = {};
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    Object.keys(r.cats || {}).forEach(function (k) { present[k] = true; });
  });
  const cols = FANTASY_TEAM_RULES
    .filter(function (r) { return present[r.key] || sortBy === r.key; })
    .map(function (r) {
      return { key: r.key, label: r.short, full: r.label, group: r.group,
               ptsLabel: fantasyPtsLabel_(r), house: '' };
    });
  if (present.PA || sortBy === 'PA') {
    // fewest allowed is the good end, so this one column opens ascending
    cols.push({ key: 'PA', label: 'PA', full: 'Points allowed',
                group: 'Points allowed', ptsLabel: 'banded', house: '', asc: true });
  }
  return cols;
}

/** The team scoring key, bands and all. */
function fantasyTeamKey_() {
  return FANTASY_TEAM_RULES.map(function (r) {
    return { key: r.key, label: r.label, short: r.short, group: r.group,
             ptsLabel: fantasyPtsLabel_(r), house: '' };
  }).concat(FANTASY_PA_TIERS.map(function (t) {
    return { key: t.key, label: t.label, short: t.short, group: 'Points allowed',
             ptsLabel: String(t.pts), house: '' };
  }));
}

function fantasyNormalizeQuery_(query) {
  const raw = query || {};
  const q = {};
  q.scope = String(raw.scope || 'PLAYER').toUpperCase() === 'TEAM' ? 'TEAM' : 'PLAYER';
  const askedSide = s_(raw.side).toUpperCase();
  q.side = FANTASY_SIDES.indexOf(askedSide) >= 0 ? askedSide : 'OFFENSE';
  q.timeRange = String(raw.timeRange || 'CURRENT').toUpperCase();
  if (['CURRENT', 'WEEK', 'SEASON', 'LAST4', 'ALL'].indexOf(q.timeRange) < 0) q.timeRange = 'CURRENT';
  q.seasonId = s_(raw.seasonId);
  q.weekKey = /^[WR][1-9][0-9]*$/.test(s_(raw.weekKey)) ? s_(raw.weekKey) : '';
  if (q.timeRange === 'CURRENT') {
    const current = fantasyCalendar_().current;
    q.timeRange = 'WEEK'; q.seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
    q.weekKey = current ? current.key : '';
  }
  q.county   = s_(raw.county);
  q.teamId   = s_(raw.teamId);
  q.playerId = s_(raw.playerId);
  q.search   = s_(raw.search).slice(0, 40);
  q.position = s_(raw.position).toUpperCase();
  if (q.position && !POS_BY_CODE[q.position]) q.position = '';
  if (q.scope === 'TEAM') q.position = '';           // a defence has no position
  /* Asking for linebackers on the offensive board is asking for an empty
     screen. A position implies its side, unless the reader named one — which
     is the same bargain the Stats page strikes, for the same reason. */
  if (q.position && !askedSide) {
    const implied = statsSideForPosition_(q.position);
    if (implied && FANTASY_SIDES.indexOf(implied) >= 0) q.side = implied;
  }
  /* Total, per game, or any one of the scoring categories — a column on a
     leaderboard that cannot be sorted by is decoration. Anything else asked
     for falls back to the projected-points default rather than to an empty board. */
  const asked = s_(raw.sortBy);
  const known = q.scope === 'TEAM'
    ? (FANTASY_TEAM_BY_KEY[asked] || asked === 'PA')
    : !!(FANTASY_BY_KEY[asked] && FANTASY_BY_KEY[asked].side === q.side);
  q.sortBy = asked.toUpperCase() === 'PPG' || asked.toUpperCase() === 'FPPG' ? 'PPG'
           : asked.toUpperCase() === 'PTS' ? 'PTS' : known ? asked : 'PRED';
  q.sortDir = String(raw.sortDir || '').toUpperCase() === 'ASC' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
  var limit = numOrNull_(raw.limit);
  q.limit = limit === null ? FANTASY_LIMIT
          : Math.max(1, Math.min(FANTASY_MAX_LIMIT, Math.floor(limit)));
  var offset = numOrNull_(raw.offset);
  q.offset = offset === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.floor(offset));
  return q;
}

function fantasyCacheKey_(q) {
  return FANTASY_CACHE_PREFIX + [apiTodayStr_(), CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON, q.weekKey, q.scope, q.side, q.timeRange, q.seasonId, q.county, q.teamId,
    q.position, q.playerId, q.sortBy, q.sortDir, q.limit, q.offset,
    q.search.toLowerCase()].join('|');
}

/** The range this query covers, resolved exactly as the Stats page resolves it. */
function fantasyContext_(q) {
  const sIdx = statsSeasonIndex_();
  /* A defence's season can stand on scored games alone — points allowed need
     no box score. A player's cannot. */
  const withData = q.timeRange === 'WEEK' ? {} : statsSeasonsWithData_(q.scope === 'TEAM' ? 'TEAM' : 'PLAYER', 'ALL');
  if (!q.seasonId) {
    for (var i = 0; i < sIdx.newestFirst.length; i++) {
      if (withData[sIdx.newestFirst[i]]) { q.seasonId = sIdx.newestFirst[i]; break; }
    }
    if (!q.seasonId) q.seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  }
  var range;
  if (q.timeRange === 'WEEK') {
    range = { seasons: sIdx.byId[q.seasonId] ? [q.seasonId] : [], inRange: {}, excluded: [] };
    range.seasons.forEach(function (sid) { range.inRange[sid] = true; });
  } else range = statsResolveSeasons_(q, sIdx, withData);
  const ctx = { seasonIdx: sIdx, seasons: range.seasons, inRange: range.inRange,
           excluded: range.excluded, teams: statsTeamIndex_(),
           source: q.timeRange === 'WEEK' ? 'Game-level records' : statsSeasonSource_().source, inferredPositions: 0 };
  if (q.timeRange === 'WEEK') {
    ctx.acceptGame = function (g) { return s_(g.SeasonID) === q.seasonId && periodKey_(g) === q.weekKey; };
    ctx.keepZero = true;
    if (q.scope !== 'TEAM') ctx.playerSource = fantasyGameSource_(ctx.acceptGame, q.side);
  }
  return ctx;
}

/**
 * Blanks last in both directions, with a stable tiebreak so paging is steady.
 * A category sort reads through `cats`, where a player who never recorded one
 * has no entry at all — which is how he sorts last rather than as a nought.
 */
function fantasySorter_(sortBy, dir) {
  const mul = dir === 'ASC' ? 1 : -1;
  const read = sortBy === 'PTS' ? function (r) { return r.fpts; }
             : sortBy === 'PPG' ? function (r) { return r.fppg; }
             : sortBy === 'PRED' ? function (r) { return r.prediction; }
             : function (r) { return (r.cats || {})[sortBy]; };
  return function (x, y) {
    var a = read(x), b = read(y);
    var an = (a === null || a === undefined || a === '');
    var bn = (b === null || b === undefined || b === '');
    if (an && bn) return String(x.playerId).localeCompare(String(y.playerId));
    if (an) return 1;
    if (bn) return -1;
    return ((a - b) * mul) || String(x.playerId).localeCompare(String(y.playerId));
  };
}

/**
 * The scoring key, as the page prints it: every category and what it is worth,
 * whether or not anybody scored in it.
 */
function fantasyKey_(side) {
  return FANTASY_RULES.filter(function (r) { return !side || r.side === side; })
    .map(function (r) {
      return { key: r.key, label: r.label, short: r.short, side: r.side, group: r.group,
               ptsLabel: fantasyPtsLabel_(r), house: r.house || '' };
    });
}

function fantasyBuild_(q) {
  const ctx = fantasyContext_(q);
  const team = q.scope === 'TEAM';
  var rows = fantasyRows_(q, ctx);

  if (team) {
    if (q.county) rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.county === q.county; });
    if (q.teamId) rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.teamId === q.teamId; });
  }

  if (q.search) {
    var needle = q.search.toLowerCase();
    rows = rows.filter(function (r) {
      return String(r.player || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(needle) >= 0 ||
             String(r.team || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(needle) >= 0;
    });
  }

  /* The board carries a column per scoring category, in the order the rules
     are declared, so a reader sees WHERE the points came from without opening
     anybody. A category nobody in this view recorded is dropped rather than
     printed as a stripe of blanks — filter to quarterbacks and the tackles
     and pancakes go away by themselves. The sorted column always stays, or
     the order would have no visible cause. */
  var columns;
  if (team) {
    columns = fantasyTeamColumns_(rows, q.sortBy);
  } else {
    const present = {};
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      Object.keys(r.cats || {}).forEach(function (k) { present[k] = true; });
    });
    columns = FANTASY_RULES
      .filter(function (r) { return r.side === q.side; })
      .filter(function (r) { return present[r.key] || q.sortBy === r.key; })
      .map(function (r) {
        return { key: r.key, label: r.short, full: r.label, group: r.group,
                 ptsLabel: fantasyPtsLabel_(r), house: r.house || '' };
      });
  }

  rows.sort(fantasySorter_(q.sortBy, q.sortDir));
  const total = rows.length;
  const page = rows.slice(q.offset, q.offset + q.limit).map(function (r, i) {
    return { rank: q.sortBy === 'PTS' && r.fpts === null ? null : q.offset + i + 1, playerId: r.playerId, player: r.player,
             teamId: r.teamId, team: r.team, positions: r.positions, grad: r.grad,
             seasons: r.seasons, seasonIds: r.seasonIds, gp: r.gp,
             gpPartial: r.gpPartial, prov: r.prov, fpts: r.fpts, fppg: r.fppg,
             cats: r.cats, prediction: r.prediction, predictionGames: r.predictionGames,
             predictionProvisional: r.predictionProvisional, predictionTeam: r.predictionTeam };
  });

  const warnings = [];
  if (ctx.inferredPositions) {
    warnings.push(ctx.inferredPositions + ' player' + (ctx.inferredPositions === 1 ? '' : 's') +
      ' included on what they recorded: their roster row named no position.');
  }
  if (q.timeRange !== 'SEASON' && rows.some(function (r) { return r.gpPartial; })) {
    warnings.push('Points per game is left blank where a season was filed as a ' +
                  'total with no game count behind it.');
  }

  return {
    rows: page,
    columns: columns,
    scoring: team ? fantasyTeamKey_() : fantasyKey_(q.side),
    meta: Object.assign(fantasyPeriodFields_(q, ctx), {
      scope: q.scope,
      side: team ? 'DEFENSE' : q.side,
      sideLabel: team ? 'Team Defense' : FANTASY_SIDE_LABEL[q.side],
      sides: FANTASY_SIDES.map(function (k) { return { key: k, label: FANTASY_SIDE_LABEL[k] }; }),
      formatLabel: FANTASY_LABEL, formatNote: FANTASY_NOTE,
      timeRange: q.timeRange, seasonId: q.seasonId,
      seasons: ctx.seasons.map(function (id) {
        return { id: id, label: ctx.seasonIdx.byId[id].label };
      }),
      seasonsExcluded: ctx.excluded,
      county: q.county, teamId: q.teamId, position: q.position, search: q.search,
      sortBy: q.sortBy, sortDir: q.sortDir,
      limit: q.limit, offset: q.offset, total: total, returned: page.length,
      inferredPositions: ctx.inferredPositions,
      source: ctx.source, warnings: warnings,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  };
}

/**
 * The fantasy board.
 *
 * query {scope, timeRange, seasonId, county, teamId, position, search,
 *        sortBy, sortDir, limit, offset}
 * -> {rows[], columns[], scoring[], meta}
 *
 * Nothing here reads an identity, so nothing user-specific can leak into the
 * shared cache — and nothing user-specific may ever be added to it.
 */
function apiFantasy_(query) {
  const q = fantasyNormalizeQuery_(query);
  q.playerId = '';                    // the board is everybody; one row is below
  return cacheGet_(fantasyCacheKey_(q), FANTASY_CACHE_TTL, function () { return fantasyBuild_(q); });
}

/**
 * One player's card: category, points per, how many, what it came to, total.
 *
 * ONE SIDE of the game, like the board. A two-way player has an offensive
 * total and a defensive total and they are not addends — they are scored on
 * different tables and answer different questions, and a card that summed
 * them would print a number that means nothing and rank him against nobody.
 *
 * The rank travels with it, worked out over the SAME range and side with no
 * position, team or county filter applied — "12th in the conference" has to
 * mean the conference, not twelfth of whatever happened to be on screen.
 */
function apiFantasyPlayer_(playerId, query) {
  const q = fantasyNormalizeQuery_(query);
  q.playerId = s_(playerId);
  if (!q.playerId) throw new Error('Which player?');
  q.position = ''; q.teamId = ''; q.county = ''; q.search = '';

  return cacheGet_(fantasyCacheKey_(q), FANTASY_CACHE_TTL, function () {
    const ctx = fantasyContext_(q);
    const rows = fantasyRows_(q, ctx);
    const me = rows[0] || null;

    /* Everybody, over the same range AND on the same side, so his place is a
       real place: "3rd of 214" has to mean third among the boys scored on the
       table he is being scored on. */
    var rank = null, of = 0;
    if (me) {
      const all = fantasyRows_(Object.assign({}, q, { position: '', teamId: '', county: '', playerId: '' }), ctx)
        .filter(function (r) { return r.fpts !== null; });
      all.sort(fantasySorter_('PTS', 'DESC'));
      of = all.length;
      for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
        if (all[i].playerId === q.playerId) { rank = i + 1; break; }
      }
    }

    return {
      playerId: q.playerId,
      found: !!me,
      player: me ? me.player : '',
      teamId: me ? me.teamId : '', team: me ? me.team : '',
      positions: me ? me.positions : '', grad: me ? me.grad : '',
      seasons: me ? me.seasons : '', seasonIds: me ? me.seasonIds : [],
      gp: me ? me.gp : null, gpPartial: me ? me.gpPartial : false,
      prov: me ? me.prov : false,
      rows: me ? me.lines : [],
      total: me ? me.fpts : null,
      fppg: me ? me.fppg : null,
      prediction: me ? me.prediction : null, predictionGames: me ? me.predictionGames : 0,
      predictionProvisional: me ? me.predictionProvisional : false,
      rank: rank, of: of,
      scoring: fantasyKey_(q.side),
      meta: Object.assign(fantasyPeriodFields_(q, ctx), {
        scope: 'PLAYER',
        side: q.side, sideLabel: FANTASY_SIDE_LABEL[q.side],
        sides: FANTASY_SIDES.map(function (k) { return { key: k, label: FANTASY_SIDE_LABEL[k] }; }),
        formatLabel: FANTASY_LABEL, formatNote: FANTASY_NOTE,
        timeRange: q.timeRange, seasonId: q.seasonId,
        seasons: ctx.seasons.map(function (id) {
          return { id: id, label: ctx.seasonIdx.byId[id].label };
        }),
        source: ctx.source, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      })
    };
  });
}

/**
 * One defence's card, in the same four columns — with the points-allowed
 * bands spelled out one line per band, so a reader can count the games back.
 */
function apiFantasyTeam_(teamId, query) {
  const q = fantasyNormalizeQuery_(query);
  q.scope = 'TEAM';
  q.playerId = s_(teamId);
  if (!q.playerId) throw new Error('Which team?');
  q.position = ''; q.teamId = ''; q.county = ''; q.search = '';

  return cacheGet_(fantasyCacheKey_(q), FANTASY_CACHE_TTL, function () {
    const ctx = fantasyContext_(q);
    /* Fifteen schools: computing them all and picking one out is cheaper than
       a second code path, and it is what the rank needs anyway. */
    const all = fantasyRows_(Object.assign({}, q, { playerId: '' }), ctx);
    all.sort(fantasySorter_('PTS', 'DESC'));
    var me = null, rank = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      if (all[i].teamId === q.playerId) { me = all[i]; rank = me.fpts === null ? null : i + 1; break; }
    }

    return {
      playerId: q.playerId,
      found: !!me,
      player: me ? me.player : (ctx.teams[q.playerId] ? ctx.teams[q.playerId].name : ''),
      teamId: q.playerId, team: me ? me.team : '',
      positions: '', grad: '',
      seasons: me ? me.seasons : '', seasonIds: me ? me.seasonIds : [],
      gp: me ? me.gp : null, gpPartial: false, prov: me ? me.prov : false,
      pa: me ? me.pa : null,
      rows: me ? me.lines : [],
      total: me ? me.fpts : null,
      fppg: me ? me.fppg : null,
      prediction: me ? me.prediction : null, predictionGames: me ? me.predictionGames : 0,
      predictionProvisional: me ? me.predictionProvisional : false,
      rank: rank, of: all.filter(function (r) { return r.fpts !== null; }).length,
      scoring: fantasyTeamKey_(),
      meta: Object.assign(fantasyPeriodFields_(q, ctx), {
        scope: 'TEAM',
        formatLabel: FANTASY_LABEL, formatNote: FANTASY_NOTE,
        timeRange: q.timeRange, seasonId: q.seasonId,
        seasons: ctx.seasons.map(function (id) {
          return { id: id, label: ctx.seasonIdx.byId[id].label };
        }),
        source: ctx.source, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      })
    };
  });
}


===== src/FantasyPeriods.js =====
/** Calendar periods and deterministic fantasy projections. Public statistics only. */
var __fantasyCalendar = null;
var __fantasyForecasts = {};

function fantasyCalendar_() {
  if (__fantasyCalendar) return __fantasyCalendar;
  const today = apiTodayStr_(), currentSeason = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  // UTC arithmetic on an already localized date avoids DST and server-zone drift.
  const day = new Date(today + 'T12:00:00Z');
  day.setUTCDate(day.getUTCDate() - (day.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7);
  const monday = day.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  day.setUTCDate(day.getUTCDate() + 6);
  const sunday = day.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const bySeason = {}, games = {}, currentGames = [];
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).forEach(function (g) {
    const sid = s_(g.SeasonID), key = periodKey_(g), id = s_(g.GameID);
    if (id) games[id] = g;
    if (!sid || !key) return;
    if (!bySeason[sid]) bySeason[sid] = {};
    const date = apiDateStr_(g.GameDate);
    var p = bySeason[sid][key];
    if (!p) p = bySeason[sid][key] = {
      key: key, label: isPlayoffPhase_(g) ? playoffRoundLabel_(num_(g.Week)) : 'Week ' + num_(g.Week),
      seasonId: sid, order: gameOrder_(g), date: date || '', inWeek: 0
    };
    if (date && (!p.date || date < p.date)) p.date = date;
    if (date && date >= monday && date <= sunday) p.inWeek++;
    if (sid === currentSeason) currentGames.push(g);
  });
  // Match Home: the first dated, unscored upcoming game determines the period.
  // An undated old fixture must not pin the forecast to an abandoned week.
  const upcoming = currentGames.filter(function (g) {
    const date = apiDateStr_(g.GameDate);
    return (numOrNull_(g.HomeScore) === null || numOrNull_(g.AwayScore) === null) && (!date || date >= today);
  }).sort(function (a, b) {
    const ad = apiDateStr_(a.GameDate), bd = apiDateStr_(b.GameDate);
    return (ad || '9999').localeCompare(bd || '9999') || gameOrder_(a) - gameOrder_(b);
  });
  const periods = Object.keys(bySeason[currentSeason] || {}).map(function (key) {
    return bySeason[currentSeason][key];
  }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.order - b.order; });
  const next = upcoming.length ? bySeason[currentSeason][periodKey_(upcoming[0])] : null;
  const thisWeek = periods.filter(function (p) { return p.inWeek; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return b.inWeek - a.inWeek || b.order - a.order; });
  const current = thisWeek[0] || next || periods[periods.length - 1] || null;
  const nextTeams = {};
  upcoming.forEach(function (g) {
    if (!next || periodKey_(g) !== next.key) return;
    [s_(g.HomeTeamID), s_(g.AwayTeamID)].forEach(function (tid) {
      nextTeams[tid] = (nextTeams[tid] || 0) + 1;
    });
  });
  return (__fantasyCalendar = { today: today, bySeason: bySeason, games: games,
    current: current, next: next, nextTeams: nextTeams });
}

/** Count a recorded zero, but never convert an entirely unreported side to zero. */
function fantasyHasReported_(sums, side) {
  return FANTASY_RULES.some(function (rule) {
    return rule.side === side && rule.fields.some(function (f) { return numOrNull_(sums[f]) !== null; });
  });
}

/** Combine category rows within a game before counting one appearance. */
function fantasyGameSource_(accept, side) {
  const cal = fantasyCalendar_(), perGame = {}, seasons = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS).forEach(function (r) {
    if (s_(r.grain || r.Grain) !== CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME) return;
    const g = cal.games[s_(r.GameID)], pid = s_(r.PlayerID), tid = s_(r.TeamID);
    if (!g || !pid || !tid || !accept(g) || s_(r.SeasonID) !== s_(g.SeasonID)) return;
    const key = pid + '|' + s_(g.GameID) + '|' + tid;
    var b = perGame[key];
    if (!b) b = perGame[key] = { PlayerID: pid, TeamID: tid, SeasonID: s_(g.SeasonID), sums: {}, prov: false };
    addInto_(b.sums, r);
    if (provisionalSource_(r.SourceType)) b.prov = true;
  });
  Object.keys(perGame).forEach(function (key) {
    const g = perGame[key];
    if (!fantasyHasReported_(g.sums, side)) return;
    const skey = g.PlayerID + '|' + g.SeasonID + '|' + g.TeamID;
    var b = seasons[skey];
    if (!b) b = seasons[skey] = { PlayerID: g.PlayerID, TeamID: g.TeamID,
      SeasonID: g.SeasonID, GamesPlayed: 0, Provisional: 'FALSE' };
    b.GamesPlayed++;
    addInto_(b, g.sums);
    if (g.prov) b.Provisional = 'TRUE';
  });
  return { rows: Object.keys(seasons).map(function (key) { return seasons[key]; }), source: 'Game-level records' };
}

function fantasyPeriodFields_(q, ctx) {
  const cal = fantasyCalendar_(), options = [];
  ctx.seasonIdx.newestFirst.forEach(function (sid) {
    const season = ctx.seasonIdx.byId[sid], label = season ? season.label : sid;
    options.push({ value: sid, label: label + ' season' });
    Object.keys(cal.bySeason[sid] || {}).map(function (k) { return cal.bySeason[sid][k]; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return a.order - b.order; }).forEach(function (p) {
        options.push({ value: sid + '@' + p.key, label: label + ' · ' + p.label });
      });
  });
  const sid = ctx.seasonIdx.byId[q.seasonId];
  const period = q.timeRange === 'WEEK' && (cal.bySeason[q.seasonId] || {})[q.weekKey];
  const nextSeason = ctx.seasonIdx.byId[CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON];
  return {
    weekKey: q.weekKey || '', timeOptions: options,
    currentWeekLabel: cal.current ? (nextSeason ? nextSeason.label : CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON) + ' · ' + cal.current.label : '',
    periodLabel: q.timeRange === 'WEEK' ? (sid ? sid.label : q.seasonId) + ' · ' + (period ? period.label : 'No scheduled week') : '',
    prediction: { seasonId: CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON, weekKey: cal.next ? cal.next.key : '',
      label: cal.next ? (nextSeason ? nextSeason.label : CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON) + ' · ' + cal.next.label : 'No upcoming week',
      method: 'Average fantasy points per recorded game this season, before the upcoming week. Multiplied by scheduled games if a team plays more than once. No estimate without prior game records or an upcoming fixture.' }
  };
}

/** Projections do not depend on the year/week the visitor is viewing. */
function fantasyForecast_(q, ctx) {
  const key = q.scope + '|' + q.side;
  if (__fantasyForecasts[key]) return __fantasyForecasts[key];
  const next = fantasyCalendar_().next;
  // All counties, teams and historical filters share the same public forecast.
  // Cache it independently so each new filter does not rescan prior games.
  return (__fantasyForecasts[key] = cacheGet_(FANTASY_CACHE_PREFIX + 'forecast|' +
    apiTodayStr_() + '|' + CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON + '|' + (next ? next.key + '|' + next.date : 'none') + '|' + key, FANTASY_CACHE_TTL,
    function () { return fantasyForecastBuild_(q, ctx); }));
}

function fantasyForecastBuild_(q, ctx) {
  const cal = fantasyCalendar_(), out = { byId: {}, candidates: [] };
  if (!cal.next) return out;
  const sid = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  function earlier(g) {
    if (s_(g.SeasonID) !== sid || gameOrder_(g) >= cal.next.order) return false;
    const date = apiDateStr_(g.GameDate);
    // Undated games cannot establish that a performance precedes the forecast.
    if (!date || date > cal.today || (cal.next.date && date >= cal.next.date)) return false;
    if (q.scope === 'TEAM' && (numOrNull_(g.HomeScore) === null || numOrNull_(g.AwayScore) === null)) return false;
    if (date === cal.today && (numOrNull_(g.HomeScore) === null || numOrNull_(g.AwayScore) === null)) return false;
    return true;
  }
  const hist = { seasonIdx: ctx.seasonIdx, seasons: [sid], inRange: {}, excluded: [],
    teams: ctx.teams, inferredPositions: 0, keepZero: true, acceptGame: earlier };
  hist.inRange[sid] = true;
  const team = q.scope === 'TEAM';
  if (!team) hist.playerSource = fantasyGameSource_(earlier, q.side);
  const rows = team ? fantasyTeamAccum_({ side: 'DEFENSE' }, hist)
    : fantasyAccum_({ side: q.side }, hist);
  const roster = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).forEach(function (r) {
    if (s_(r.SeasonID) === sid) roster[s_(r.PlayerID)] = r;
  });
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    const ps = roster[r.playerId], tid = team ? r.teamId : ps ? s_(ps.TeamID) : '';
    if (!tid || !cal.nextTeams[tid] || !r.gp || r.fppg === null) return;
    const t = ctx.teams[tid];
    // A past player's history must not imply that he is on this year's roster.
    if (!team && (!ps || !t)) return;
    const prediction = fantasyRound_(r.fpts / r.gp * cal.nextTeams[tid]);
    const item = { value: prediction, games: r.gp, scheduledGames: cal.nextTeams[tid], provisional: r.prov,
      team: t ? t.name : tid };
    out.byId[r.playerId] = item;
    const copy = Object.assign({}, r, { teamId: tid, team: t ? t.name : r.team,
      county: t ? t.county : r.county, positions: team ? '' : formatPositions_(parsePositions_(ps.Positions)),
      fpts: null, fppg: null, gp: null, cats: {}, lines: [], prov: false,
      prediction: prediction, predictionGames: r.gp, predictionProvisional: r.prov });
    out.candidates.push(copy);
  });
  return out;
}

/** Actual rows plus eligible forecasts while a current/upcoming week is unplayed. */
function fantasyRows_(q, ctx) {
  const team = q.scope === 'TEAM';
  var rows = !ctx.seasons.length ? [] : team ? fantasyTeamAccum_(q, ctx) : fantasyAccum_(q, ctx);
  const forecast = fantasyForecast_(q, ctx), cal = fantasyCalendar_(), seen = {};
  rows.forEach(function (r) { seen[r.playerId] = true; });
  if (q.timeRange === 'WEEK' && q.seasonId === CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON &&
      ((cal.current && q.weekKey === cal.current.key) || (cal.next && q.weekKey === cal.next.key))) {
    forecast.candidates.forEach(function (r) {
      if (seen[r.playerId] || (q.playerId && q.playerId !== r.playerId)) return;
      if (q.teamId && q.teamId !== r.teamId) return;
      if (q.county && q.county !== r.county) return;
      if (q.position && !positionMatches_(parsePositions_(r.positions), q.position)) return;
      rows.push(Object.assign({}, r));
    });
  }
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    const p = forecast.byId[r.playerId];
    r.prediction = p ? p.value : null;
    r.predictionGames = p ? p.games : 0;
    r.predictionProvisional = p ? p.provisional : false;
    r.predictionTeam = p ? p.team : '';
  });
  return rows;
}

/** One request for the Fantasy view, including its filters on the first visit. */
function apiFantasyView_(query, id, includeFilters) {
  const q = query || {};
  const data = id ? (String(q.scope).toUpperCase() === 'TEAM' ? apiFantasyTeam_(id, q) : apiFantasyPlayer_(id, q)) : apiFantasy_(q);
  return { data: data, filters: includeFilters ? apiStatsFilters_() : null };
}


===== src/FixSchedule2026.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — FixSchedule2026.gs
 *
 * One-time correction of the 2026 schedule against the conference's official
 * grid (checked cell by cell, weeks 2-9; week 1 was fixed separately).
 *
 * What was wrong, and what running fixSchedule2026() does about it:
 *
 *   1. Joppatowne had no week-2 game at all. ADDS Joppatowne at Benjamin
 *      Franklin, 9/11.
 *   2. Fallston and Perryville each carried TWO week-4 games; the grid has
 *      Fallston home vs Aberdeen and Perryville home vs Edgewood, both of
 *      which exist. DELETES the spurious extra (Fallston at Perryville).
 *   3. Four non-conference games faced the wrong way - the UCBAC school
 *      travels in all of them. FLIPS home and away:
 *        wk 4  Patterson Mill  at Chesapeake-AA   (was home)
 *        wk 5  Bohemia Manor   at Sussex Tech     (was home)
 *        wk 6  Perryville      at The Seed School (was home)
 *        wk 8  Elkton          at The Seed School (was home)
 *      Outside-school names are normalized on the way ("SEED" becomes
 *      "The Seed School", "Chesapeake" becomes "Chesapeake-AA").
 *
 * Run it from the editor: pick fixSchedule2026, press Run, read the log.
 * Safe to run twice - each step checks the row is still in its wrong state
 * before touching it, and nothing with a score entered is ever altered.
 * Delete this file once the log says every step is done.
 */

function fixSchedule2026_() {
  const sh = db_().getSheetByName('Games');
  const head = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0].map(String);
  const col = function (n) {
    const i = head.indexOf(n);
    if (i < 0) throw new Error('Games has no column ' + n);
    return i;
  };
  const C = {
    id: col('GameID'), season: col('SeasonID'), week: col('Week'),
    phase: col('Phase'), type: col('GameType'),
    hid: col('HomeTeamID'), aid: col('AwayTeamID'),
    hs: col('HomeScore'), as: col('AwayScore'),
    status: col('Status'), date: col('GameDate'),
    hname: col('HomeTeamName'), aname: col('AwayTeamName')
  };
  const data = sh.getRange(2, 1, Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow() - 1), head.length).getValues();
  const out = [];
  const s_ = function (v) { return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim(); };

  const untouched = function (r, what) {
    if (s_(r[C.hs]) !== '' || s_(r[C.as]) !== '') { out.push('SKIPPED ' + what + ': a score is entered.'); return false; }
    return true;
  };

  // ---- flips: the UCBAC school travels ----
  const flips = [
    { gid: 'GAME-2026-0032', team: 'TEAM-013', opp: 'Chesapeake-AA' },
    { gid: 'GAME-2026-0036', team: 'TEAM-003', opp: 'Sussex Tech' },
    { gid: 'GAME-2026-0050', team: 'TEAM-014', opp: 'The Seed School' },
    { gid: 'GAME-2026-0062', team: 'TEAM-006', opp: 'The Seed School' }
  ];
  flips.forEach(function (f) {
    for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      const r = data[i];
      if (s_(r[C.id]) !== f.gid) continue;
      if (s_(r[C.hid]) !== f.team) {
        out.push('ok      ' + f.gid + ' already flipped (' + s_(r[C.aname]) + ' at ' + s_(r[C.hname]) + ').');
        return;
      }
      if (!untouched(r, f.gid)) return;
      const row = i + 2;
      sh.getRange(row, C.aid + 1).setValue(r[C.hid]);       // school moves to away
      sh.getRange(row, C.aname + 1).setValue(r[C.hname]);
      sh.getRange(row, C.hid + 1).setValue('');             // outside school hosts
      sh.getRange(row, C.hname + 1).setValue(f.opp);
      out.push('FLIPPED ' + f.gid + ': ' + s_(r[C.hname]) + ' at ' + f.opp + '.');
      return;
    }
    out.push('MISSING ' + f.gid + ' — not found; nothing done.');
  });

  // ---- the spurious second week-4 game ----
  for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    const r = data[i];
    if (s_(r[C.id]) !== 'GAME-2026-0034') continue;
    if (s_(r[C.aid]) === 'TEAM-007' && s_(r[C.hid]) === 'TEAM-014' && untouched(r, 'GAME-2026-0034')) {
      sh.deleteRow(i + 2);
      out.push('DELETED GAME-2026-0034 (Fallston at Perryville, week 4 — neither team plays it).');
    } else if (s_(r[C.aid]) !== 'TEAM-007' || s_(r[C.hid]) !== 'TEAM-014') {
      out.push('SKIPPED GAME-2026-0034: no longer Fallston at Perryville — look at it by hand.');
    }
    break;
  }

  // ---- Joppatowne's missing week 2 ----
  var joppW2 = data.some(function (r) {
    return s_(r[C.season]) === 'SEA-2026' && s_(r[C.week]) === '2' &&
           (s_(r[C.hid]) === 'TEAM-010' || s_(r[C.aid]) === 'TEAM-010');
  });
  if (joppW2) {
    out.push('ok      Joppatowne already has a week-2 game.');
  } else {
    var maxN = 0;
    data.forEach(function (r) {
      const m = s_(r[C.id]).match(/^GAME-2026-(\d+)$/);
      if (m) maxN = Math.max(maxN, Number(m[1]));
    });
    const gid = 'GAME-2026-' + ('0000' + (maxN + 1)).slice(-4);
    const row = new Array(head.length).fill('');
    row[C.id] = gid; row[C.season] = 'SEA-2026'; row[C.week] = 2;
    row[C.phase] = 'Week'; row[C.type] = 'NON_CONFERENCE';
    row[C.hid] = ''; row[C.hname] = 'Benjamin Franklin';
    row[C.aid] = 'TEAM-010'; row[C.aname] = 'Joppatowne';
    row[C.status] = 'SCHEDULED'; row[C.date] = new Date(2026, 8, 11);
    sh.appendRow(row);
    out.push('ADDED   ' + gid + ': Joppatowne at Benjamin Franklin, week 2 (9/11).');
  }

  if (typeof markDirty_ === 'function') markDirty_('games');
  const msg = out.join('\n') + '\n\nRun UCBAC Stats > Rebuild everything now, then delete this file.';
  /* The log, not an alert: this is run from the editor, and an alert there
     waits on a dialog in a spreadsheet tab nobody is watching until the six
     minute limit kills it. */
  Logger.log(msg);
  return msg;
}


===== src/ImportPages.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — ImportProfiles.gs
 *
 * Loads the commitments, accolades and measurables mined out of the season
 * workbooks into the database, so the player profile pages have something real
 * to show instead of empty fields.
 *
 * HOW TO USE
 *   1. In the spreadsheet: File > Import > Upload, pick Commitments_seed.csv,
 *      choose "Insert new sheet(s)", Import. Repeat for Accolades_seed.csv and
 *      Measurables_seed.csv.
 *   2. UCBAC Stats > Maintenance > Import profile seeds.
 *   3. Delete the three imported sheets afterwards if you like — nothing depends
 *      on them once the import has run.
 *
 * Safe to run twice. Every write is an update-in-place keyed on PlayerID, and
 * awards are keyed on player + season + award, so a second run corrects rather
 * than duplicates.
 *
 * Rows whose PlayerID is blank are the ones the extractor could not resolve to a
 * player without guessing. They are skipped and reported rather than attached to
 * whoever happens to share a surname.
 */

const IP_SHEETS = {
  commitments:  ['Commitments_seed', 'Commitments', 'Commitments_seed.csv'],
  accolades:    ['Accolades_seed', 'Accolades', 'Accolades_seed.csv'],
  measurables:  ['Measurables_seed', 'Measurables', 'Measurables_seed.csv']
};

const IP_AWARDS_TAB = 'Awards';

/**
 * Find a seed sheet by name, tolerantly.
 *
 * Importing a CSV whose name already exists makes Sheets append a counter, so
 * the tab arrives as "Commitments_seed (2)" and an exact-name lookup silently
 * finds nothing — the import then reports success having done nothing at all.
 * Punctuation, case and that counter are all ignored here.
 */
function _ipNormName_(s_) {
  return String(s_ === null || s_ === undefined ? '' : s_)
    .replace(/\.csv$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s*\(\d+\)\s*$/, '')
    .replace(/[\s_\-]+/g, '')
    .toLowerCase();
}

function _ipFind_(names) {
  const wanted = {};
  names.forEach(function (n) { wanted[_ipNormName_(n)] = true; });

  const sheets = db_().getSheets();
  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const real = sheets[i].getName();
    if (wanted[_ipNormName_(real)]) return real;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Append any missing columns to a tab and return the ones added.
 * Named with a prefix because Apps Script shares one global scope across files —
 * a second addColumns() elsewhere would silently replace this one.
 */
function _ipAddColumns_(tabName, columns) {
  const sh = getTab_(tabName);
  const width = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
  const head = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, width).getValues()[0].map(function (h) {
    return String(h).trim();
  });
  const missing = columns.filter(function (c) { return head.indexOf(c) < 0; });
  if (missing.length) {
    sh.getRange(1, head.length + 1, 1, missing.length).setValues([missing])
      .setFontWeight('bold');
    __tableCache = {};
  }
  return missing;
}

/** Column-name -> index map from a sheet's real header row. */
function _ipHeader_(sh) {
  const width = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
  const head = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, width).getValues()[0].map(function (h) {
    return String(h).trim();
  });
  const map = {};
  head.forEach(function (h, i) { if (h) map[h] = i; });
  return { head: head, index: map };
}

function _ipStr_(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v).trim(); }

function _ipNum_(v) {
  if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  const n = Number(v);
  return isNaN(n) ? '' : n;
}

/** The one entry point. */
function importProfileSeeds() {
  const report = [];
  var totalSkipped = 0;

  const cs = _ipFind_(IP_SHEETS.commitments);
  const as = _ipFind_(IP_SHEETS.accolades);
  const ms = _ipFind_(IP_SHEETS.measurables);

  if (!cs && !as && !ms) {
    const none = 'No seed sheets found.\n\nImport the CSVs first:\n' +
      'File > Import > Upload > Commitments_seed.csv > Insert new sheet(s).\n' +
      'Repeat for Accolades_seed.csv and Measurables_seed.csv, then run this again.';
    Logger.log(none);
    try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Import profile seeds', none,
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK); } catch (e) {}
    return none;
  }

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS)) throw new Error('Database busy — try again.');
  try {
    if (cs) { const r = _ipCommitments_(cs); report.push(r.text); totalSkipped += r.skipped; }
    if (ms) { const r = _ipMeasurables_(ms); report.push(r.text); totalSkipped += r.skipped; }
    if (as) { const r = _ipAccolades_(as);   report.push(r.text); totalSkipped += r.skipped; }
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }

  __tableCache = {};
  CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot']);
  if (typeof markDirty_ === 'function') markDirty_('profiles');

  if (totalSkipped) {
    report.push('\n' + totalSkipped + ' row(s) had no PlayerID and were skipped. Those are ' +
                'the names the extractor could not resolve without guessing — attach them ' +
                'by hand in the seed sheet and re-run if you want them in.');
  }
  const msg = report.join('\n\n');
  Logger.log(msg);
  try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Import profile seeds', msg,
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK); } catch (e) {}
  return msg;
}

/** Who a skipped seed row names, so a person can go and attach it. */
function _ipWho_(row, sHead, sheetRow) {
  const cols = ['Player', 'PlayerName', 'Name', 'DisplayName', 'FullName'];
  for (var i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
