    const c = sHead.index[cols[i]];
    if (c !== undefined && _ipStr_(row[c])) return _ipStr_(row[c]);
  }
  return 'row ' + sheetRow;
}
/** "... 3 unmatched rows skipped (no PlayerID): A, B, C" - names, not a count. */
function _ipSkipText_(list) {
  if (!list.length) return '';
  const SHOW = 25;
  return ', ' + list.length + ' unmatched row' + (list.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' skipped (no PlayerID): ' +
         list.slice(0, SHOW).join(', ') + (list.length > SHOW ? ', ... and ' + (list.length - SHOW) + ' more' : '');
}

// ── commitments -> Players ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _ipCommitments_(tabName) {
  _ipAddColumns_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS,
    ['Commitment', 'CommitmentLevel', 'CommitmentDate', 'Offers', 'Committed',
     'HudlURL', 'XHandle', 'InstagramHandle', 'MaxPrepsURL', 'Hometown', 'Bio',
     'Email', 'ProfilePhotoID', 'UpdatedAt', 'UpdatedBy']);

  const seed = getTab_(tabName);
  const sHead = _ipHeader_(seed);
  const rows = seed.getDataRange().getValues().slice(1);

  const psh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  const pHead = _ipHeader_(psh);
  const pData = psh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const cPid = pHead.index['PlayerID'];

  const rowOf = {};
  for (var r = 1; r < pData.length; r++) {
    const id = _ipStr_(pData[r][cPid]);
    if (id) rowOf[id] = r + 1;
  }

  var applied = 0, skipped = 0, missing = 0;
  const skippedWho = [], missingWho = [];
  rows.forEach(function (row, i) {
    const pid = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['PlayerID']]);
    if (!pid) { skipped++; skippedWho.push(_ipWho_(row, sHead, i + 2)); return; }
    const sheetRow = rowOf[pid];
    if (!sheetRow) { missing++; missingWho.push(pid); return; }

    const committed = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['Committed']]).toUpperCase() === 'TRUE';
    const offers = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['Offers']]);
    const commitment = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['Commitment']]);

    _ipSet_(psh, pHead, sheetRow, 'Offers', offers);
    _ipSet_(psh, pHead, sheetRow, 'Committed', committed ? 'TRUE' : '');
    // only a checked offer is a commitment; an uncommitted player keeps a blank
    // Commitment rather than being shown as committed to their first offer
    _ipSet_(psh, pHead, sheetRow, 'Commitment', committed ? commitment : '');
    _ipSet_(psh, pHead, sheetRow, 'UpdatedAt', new Date());
    _ipSet_(psh, pHead, sheetRow, 'UpdatedBy', 'seed:offers');
    applied++;
  });

  return {
    skipped: skipped,
    text: 'Commitments: ' + applied + ' players updated' +
          (missing ? ', ' + missing + ' PlayerIDs not found in Players (' + missingWho.slice(0, 25).join(', ') + ')' : '') +
          _ipSkipText_(skippedWho)
  };
}

// ── measurables -> PlayerSeasons ───────────────────────────────────────────

function _ipMeasurables_(tabName) {
  _ipAddColumns_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS,
    ['FortyTime', 'BenchMax', 'IsCaptain', 'GPA']);
  _ipAddColumns_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS, ['Stars']);

  const seed = getTab_(tabName);
  const sHead = _ipHeader_(seed);
  const rows = seed.getDataRange().getValues().slice(1);

  const ssh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
  const psHead = _ipHeader_(ssh);
  const psData = ssh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const cPid = psHead.index['PlayerID'], cSeason = psHead.index['SeasonID'];

  // the measurables come from the 2025 roster sheet
  const SEASON = 'SEA-2025';
  const rowOf = {};
  for (var r = 1; r < psData.length; r++) {
    if (_ipStr_(psData[r][cSeason]) !== SEASON) continue;
    const id = _ipStr_(psData[r][cPid]);
    if (id) rowOf[id] = r + 1;
  }

  const plh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  const pHead = _ipHeader_(plh);
  const pData = plh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const pRowOf = {};
  for (var q = 1; q < pData.length; q++) {
    const id = _ipStr_(pData[q][pHead.index['PlayerID']]);
    if (id) pRowOf[id] = q + 1;
  }

  var applied = 0, skipped = 0, missing = 0, stars = 0;
  const skippedWho = [], missingWho = [];
  rows.forEach(function (row, i) {
    const pid = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['PlayerID']]);
    if (!pid) { skipped++; skippedWho.push(_ipWho_(row, sHead, i + 2)); return; }

    const sheetRow = rowOf[pid];
    if (sheetRow) {
      // blank in the source means not measured — never write a 0
      ['HeightInches', 'WeightLbs', 'FortyTime', 'BenchMax'].forEach(function (f) {
        if (sHead.index[f] === undefined) return;
        const v = _ipNum_(row[sHead.index[f]]);
        if (v !== '') _ipSet_(ssh, psHead, sheetRow, f, v);
      });
      const jersey = _ipNum_(row[sHead.index['Jersey']]);
      if (jersey !== '' && jersey >= 0 && jersey <= 99) {
        _ipSet_(ssh, psHead, sheetRow, 'Jersey', jersey);
      }
      applied++;
    } else {
      missing++; missingWho.push(pid);
    }

    const st = _ipNum_(row[sHead.index['Stars']]);
    if (st !== '' && pRowOf[pid]) { _ipSet_(plh, pHead, pRowOf[pid], 'Stars', st); stars++; }
  });

  return {
    skipped: skipped,
    text: 'Measurables: ' + applied + ' ' + SEASON + ' roster rows updated, ' +
          stars + ' star ratings' +
          (missing ? ', ' + missing + ' players had no ' + SEASON + ' roster row (' + missingWho.slice(0, 25).join(', ') + ')' : '') +
          _ipSkipText_(skippedWho)
  };
}

// ── accolades -> Awards ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function _ipAccolades_(tabName) {
  const cols = ['AwardID', 'PlayerID', 'TeamID', 'SeasonID', 'Award', 'Detail',
                'Source', 'CreatedAt'];
  if (!hasTab_(IP_AWARDS_TAB)) {
    const sh = db_().insertSheet(IP_AWARDS_TAB);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, cols.length).setValues([cols])
      .setFontWeight('bold').setFontColor('#FFFFFF').setBackground('#1F3B54');
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
    __tabMap = null;
    __tableCache = {};
  }

  const seed = getTab_(tabName);
  const sHead = _ipHeader_(seed);
  const rows = seed.getDataRange().getValues().slice(1);

  // keyed so a re-run corrects rather than appends a second copy
  const existing = {};
  rowsOf_(IP_AWARDS_TAB).forEach(function (a) {
    existing[_ipStr_(a.PlayerID) + '|' + _ipStr_(a.SeasonID) + '|' + _ipStr_(a.Award)] = true;
  });

  const add = [], skippedWho = [];
  var skipped = 0, dupes = 0;
  rows.forEach(function (row, i) {
    const pid = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['PlayerID']]);
    if (!pid) { skipped++; skippedWho.push(_ipWho_(row, sHead, i + 2)); return; }
    const seasonId = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['SeasonID']]);
    const award = _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['Award']]);
    const key = pid + '|' + seasonId + '|' + award;
    if (existing[key]) { dupes++; return; }
    existing[key] = true;
    add.push({
      AwardID: '', PlayerID: pid,
      TeamID: _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['TeamID']]),
      SeasonID: seasonId, Award: award,
      Detail: _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['Detail']]),
      Source: _ipStr_(row[sHead.index['Source']]),
      CreatedAt: new Date()
    });
  });

  if (add.length) appendRows_(IP_AWARDS_TAB, add);

  return {
    skipped: skipped,
    text: 'Accolades: ' + add.length + ' awards added to ' + IP_AWARDS_TAB +
          (dupes ? ', ' + dupes + ' already present' : '') +
          _ipSkipText_(skippedWho)
  };
}

/** Write one cell by column NAME, never by position. */
function _ipSet_(sh, header, sheetRow, column, value) {
  const c = header.index[column];
  if (c === undefined) return false;
  sh.getRange(sheetRow, c + 1).setValue(value);
  return true;
}

/** Read layer: the awards a player has won, newest season first. */
function apiPlayerAwards_(playerId) {
  if (!hasTab_(IP_AWARDS_TAB)) return [];
  return rowsOf_(IP_AWARDS_TAB)
    .filter(function (a) { return _ipStr_(a.PlayerID) === String(playerId); })
    .map(function (a) {
      return { seasonId: _ipStr_(a.SeasonID), award: _ipStr_(a.Award),
               detail: _ipStr_(a.Detail) };
    })
    .sort(function (x, y) { return x.seasonId < y.seasonId ? 1 : -1; });
}

===== src/ImportRoster.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — ImportRoster.gs
 *
 * Rebuild the CURRENT season's rosters from the conference's roster sheet —
 * the CSV with columns School, #, Player Name, Grad., Position, Height,
 * Weight, 40 time, Bench Max, Squat Max, GPA, Offers.
 *
 * To use: File > Import > Upload the CSV > Insert new sheet(s), then run
 * UCBAC Stats > Maintenance > Import rosters (dry run). The importer finds
 * the tab by its header row, so the tab's name does not matter.
 *
 * What it does, per CSV row:
 *   - resolves the school (Bo Manor, CMW and HDG are spelled out for it)
 *   - matches the player against the Players tab by exact normalized name,
 *     creating him when he is new
 *   - moves or creates his current-season roster row under the CSV's school —
 *     this is the correction: players seated on the wrong team move
 *   - fills jersey, grad, positions, height, weight, 40, bench, squat, GPA
 *     from the CSV where the CSV has a value; a blank never erases anything
 *   - reads the Offers column: a school marked ✔ becomes his Commitment, the
 *     rest become his Offers — filled only where his profile is blank, so a
 *     player who already updated his own is never overwritten
 *
 * A current-season roster row for a player the file does not name is REMOVED,
 * with three exceptions, each kept and listed instead:
 *   - he has stats recorded this season, and deleting the seat would orphan them
 *   - a person is behind the seat: he holds an account, or has entered his own
 *     information. A file's silence is evidence about a PDF, not about whether
 *     somebody left the team, and it must not delete work a person did
 *   - his school is not in the file at all, which says nothing about him
 *
 * Names in the sheet carry stars, checkmarks and injury notes; all of that is
 * stripped before matching. ("Anthony Hall (shoulder fx/dis)" is Anthony Hall.)
 */

const IMPROSTER = {
  ALIASES: {
    'bo manor': 'bohemia manor',
    'cmw': 'c milton wright',
    'hdg': 'havre de grace',
    'harford tech': 'harford technical'
  },
  /* When a file would take this many seats off a school, AND that many is this
     share of the school's roster, it is a partial list rather than a roster and
     is refused. Both must be true: a small squad losing three of five is a real
     roster change, and a big squad losing five of forty is a graduating class.
     Emptying a team is neither. */
  WIPE_MIN: 6,
  WIPE_SHARE: 0.5
};

function importRosterDryRun_() { return importRosterRun_(false); }
function importRosterApply_()  { return importRosterRun_(true); }

function menuImportRosterDry()   { return importRosterAlert_(importRosterRun_(false)); }
function menuImportRosterApply() { return importRosterAlert_(importRosterRun_(true)); }
function importRosterAlert_(msg) {
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Roster import',
      msg.length > 6000 ? msg.slice(0, 6000) + '\n\n…full report in View > Logs' : msg,
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
  } catch (e) {}
  return msg;
}

function irNorm_(v) {
  return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
    .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z ]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

/** "Xzaiver Whittington⭐️⭐️⭐️" / "Anthony Hall (shoulder fx/dis)" -> the name. */
function irCleanName_(v) {
  return String(v || '')
    .replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, ' ')                       // injury notes
    .replace(/[⭐✅✔️⃣❌❤]/g, ' ')  // stars, checks
    .replace(/[\uD800-\uDFFF]/g, ' ')                 // any other emoji surrogate
    .replace(/["“”]/g, '')                  // "JJ" style quote marks
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

/**
 * A name as the two things a roster and a box score agree on: the first
 * initial and the surname. "K. Sorrells", "Kristian Sorrells" and "Sorrells,
 * Kristian" are one boy; a suffix is not part of who he is.
 */
const IR_SUFFIX = { jr: 1, sr: 1, ii: 1, iii: 1, iv: 1, v: 1 };
function irNameParts_(name) {
  const toks = irNorm_(name).split(' ').filter(function (t) { return t && !IR_SUFFIX[t]; });
  if (!toks.length) return null;
  return { initial: toks[0].charAt(0), surname: toks[toks.length - 1] };
}

/** 6'0, 6'4", 5'10" -> inches. Anything unreadable -> ''. */
function irHeight_(v) {
  const m = String(v || '').match(/(\d)\s*'\s*(\d{1,2})/);
  if (!m) return '';
  const inches = Number(m[1]) * 12 + Number(m[2]);
  return (inches >= 48 && inches <= 90) ? inches : '';
}

function irNum_(v, lo, hi) {
  const m = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).match(/-?\d+(\.\d+)?/);
  if (!m) return '';
  const n = Number(m[0]);
  if (isNaN(n)) return '';
  if (lo !== undefined && (n < lo || n > hi)) return '';
  return n;
}

function irGrad_(v) {
  const m = String(v || '').match(/\b(\d{2})\b|\b(20\d{2})\b/);
  if (!m) return '';
  const n = m[2] ? Number(m[2]) : 2000 + Number(m[1]);
  return (n >= 2020 && n <= 2035) ? n : '';
}

/**
 * "Culver Stockton✔️ Defiance, Howard" ->
 *   { commit: 'Culver Stockton', offers: ['Culver Stockton','Defiance','Howard'] }
 * The ✔ binds to the school before it; text after it in the same clause is the
 * next school even without a comma.
 */
function irOffers_(v) {
  var txt = String(v || '').replace(/[✅✔]️?/g, '✔,');
  var commit = '';
  const offers = [];
  txt.split(',').forEach(function (part) {
    var name = irCleanName_(part.replace(/✔/g, ''));
    var isCommit = part.indexOf('✔') >= 0;
    if (!name) return;
    if (name.length > 60) name = name.slice(0, 60);
    if (isCommit && !commit) commit = name;
    if (offers.indexOf(name) < 0) offers.push(name);
  });
  return { commit: commit, offers: offers };
}

/**
 * Everyone who has put their own information into this site.
 *
 * Protecting a field is not enough on its own. A player who signed up, entered
 * his forty, his bench and his squat, and is simply not on the MaxPreps sheet
 * his school last published would have had the whole seat deleted - and with
 * it every field the protection was carefully declining to overwrite. A roster
 * file's silence about a player is not evidence that he left the team; it is
 * evidence about a PDF.
 *
 * So a seat with a person behind it is kept and reported rather than removed.
 * If he really has left, an administrator takes the seat off deliberately,
 * which is the only way work somebody did should ever be thrown away.
 *
 * Keyed by both PlayerID and PlayerSeasonID, since a profile edit is logged
 * against whichever row it changed.
 */
function irProfileAuthors_() {
  const people = {};
  if (hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT)) {
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT).forEach(function (a) {
      const action = String(a.Action || '').trim();
      if (action !== 'PROFILE_EDIT' && action !== 'PROFILE_RENAME') return;
      const id = String(a.EntityID || '').trim();
      if (id) people[id] = true;
    });
  }
  // A registered account is a person too, even one who has typed nothing yet.
  if (hasTab_('Accounts')) {
    rowsOf_('Accounts').forEach(function (r) {
      const pid = String(r.PlayerID || '').trim();
      const status = String(r.Status || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (pid && status !== 'REJECTED' && status !== 'REVOKED') people[pid] = true;
    });
  }
  return people;
}

/**
 * Every field a person has typed for themselves, which no roster file may
 * overwrite.
 *
 * A bulk import and a player's own portal write the same cells, and the file is
 * the one that knows less: a MaxPreps sheet carries a height and a weight and
 * nothing else, while a player enters his forty, his bench, his squat, and a
 * height he has actually been measured at since. Refreshing from the file has
 * to leave those alone or every import quietly undoes a season of entries.
 *
 * The authority is the audit log, not blankness. Blankness cannot tell a value
 * a player typed from a value the last import left behind, and treating both as
 * untouchable would freeze the roster - a junior who grew an inch could never
 * be corrected. Profile.gs writes a PROFILE_EDIT row naming the entity and the
 * exact column for every field a person changes, so that, and only that, is
 * what gets held back.
 *
 * Coaches edit profiles on a player's behalf through the same path and leave
 * the same audit row. That counts: a person beats a file, whichever person.
 *
 * Keyed 'EntityID|ColumnName' - PlayerSeasonID for a seat field, PlayerID for
 * a career one.
 */
function irProtectedFields_() {
  const held = {};
  if (!hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT)) return held;        // no log yet, nothing entered
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT).forEach(function (a) {
    if (String(a.Action || '').trim() !== 'PROFILE_EDIT') return;
    const id = String(a.EntityID || '').trim();
    const field = String(a.Field || '').trim();
    if (id && field) held[id + '|' + field] = true;
  });
  return held;
}

/**
 * The imported tab, found by its header row rather than its name.
 *
 * This used to return the first sheet that looked like a roster, and last
 * season's import is still sitting in the workbook looking exactly like one.
 * A new file went in, the old tab came first, and the whole import ran against
 * a year-old roster while reporting numbers that looked perfectly reasonable.
 *
 * So: an ambiguous workbook is refused rather than guessed at. Name the sheet
 * you mean "RosterImport" and it wins outright; otherwise there must be exactly
 * one candidate. Either way importRosterRun names the sheet it read at the top
 * of its report, because the failure here is silent by nature - every number
 * downstream is plausible, just about the wrong file.
 */
function irFindTab_() {
  const found = [];
  const sheets = db_().getSheets();
  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const sh = sheets[i];
    if (sh.getLastRow() < 2 || sh.getLastColumn() < 3) continue;
    const head = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0]
      .map(function (h) { return String(h).toLowerCase().trim(); });
    if (head.indexOf('school') >= 0 && head.indexOf('player name') >= 0) found.push(sh);
  }

  /* "Not found" covers three different mistakes, and the old message named
     only one of them. So say which workbook was searched — the menu reads the
     database by ID, not whatever is on screen — and point at whichever near
     miss is actually sitting there. */
  if (!found.length) {
    const first = function (sh) { return String(sh.getRange(1, 1).getValue() || ''); };
    // A CSV pasted rather than imported lands whole in column A: every header
    // in one cell, one column wide. It reads correctly on screen and matches
    // nothing.
    const glued = sheets.filter(function (sh) {
      return sh.getLastRow() >= 2 && sh.getLastColumn() < 3 && /school\s*,/i.test(first(sh));
    });
    // and a sheet that says School but not Player Name is the stats file
    const near = sheets.filter(function (sh) {
      return sh.getLastRow() >= 2 && sh.getLastColumn() >= 3 && /^school$/i.test(first(sh).trim());
    }).map(function (sh) { return sh.getName(); });

    throw new Error('No imported roster tab found in "' + db_().getName() + '" (' +
      sheets.length + ' sheets searched).\n\n' +
      (glued.length
        ? 'The sheet "' + glued[0].getName() + '" holds the whole CSV in column A, so it ' +
          'was pasted rather than imported. Select column A and use Data > Split text to ' +
          'columns, or delete the sheet and use File > Import > Insert new sheet.'
        : 'File > Import the CSV into this spreadsheet first, choosing "Insert new sheet" — ' +
          'the importer finds it by its School / Player Name header row, not by its name.') +
      (near.length ? '\n\nSheets starting with School: ' + near.join(', ') +
                     '  (a roster file needs a Player Name column too)' : '') +
      '\n\nThe menu reads the database by ID, so a copy of the workbook will not do — ' +
      'the CSV has to go into this one.');
  }

  const named = found.filter(function (sh) {
    return /^\s*rosterimport\s*$/i.test(String(sh.getName()).replace(/[\s_-]/g, ''));
  });
  if (named.length === 1) return named[0];

  if (found.length > 1)
    throw new Error('More than one sheet looks like a roster file, and picking the ' +
                    'wrong one silently imports the wrong season:\n\n  ' +
                    found.map(function (sh) {
                      return sh.getName() + '  (' + (sh.getLastRow() - 1) + ' rows)';
                    }).join('\n  ') +
                    '\n\nRename the one you want to "RosterImport", or delete the others.');

  return found[0];
}

function importRosterRun_(apply) {
  const seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  // Class of 2026 graduated in the spring of 2026; the 2026 season is the fall
  // AFTER that walk. Anyone whose class year is not past the season's year is
  // an alumnus, and an alumnus does not get a roster seat.
  const seasonYear = Number(String(seasonId).replace(/\D/g, '')) || 0;
  const sh = irFindTab_();
  const values = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const head = values[0].map(function (h) { return String(h).toLowerCase().trim(); });
  const c = function (name) { return head.indexOf(name); };
  const cSchool = c('school'), cJersey = c('#'), cName = c('player name'),
        cGrad = c('grad.') >= 0 ? c('grad.') : c('grad'),
        cPos = c('position'), cHt = c('height'), cWt = c('weight'),
        cForty = c('40 time'), cBench = c('bench max'), cSquat = c('squat max'),
        cGpa = c('gpa'), cOffers = c('offers');

  // school name -> TeamID, aliases included
  const teamByNorm = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS).forEach(function (t) {
    const id = String(t.TeamID || '').trim();
    if (!id) return;
    [t.DisplayName, t.SchoolName, t.Slug].forEach(function (n) {
      const k = irNorm_(n);
      if (k) teamByNorm[k] = id;
    });
  });
  Object.keys(IMPROSTER.ALIASES).forEach(function (a) {
    const target = teamByNorm[IMPROSTER.ALIASES[a]];
    if (target) teamByNorm[a] = target;
  });

  // desired roster from the CSV, deduped per school by name
  const wanted = {};                 // teamId|norm -> person
  const badSchools = {};
  for (var r = 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    const school = irNorm_(values[r][cSchool]);
    const name = irCleanName_(values[r][cName]);
    if (!school || !name) continue;
    const teamId = teamByNorm[school];
    if (!teamId) { badSchools[String(values[r][cSchool])] = true; continue; }

    const key = teamId + '|' + irNorm_(name);
    const off = cOffers >= 0 ? irOffers_(values[r][cOffers]) : { commit: '', offers: [] };
    const person = wanted[key] || (wanted[key] = {
      teamId: teamId, name: name, norm: irNorm_(name),
      jersey: '', grad: '', codes: [], ht: '', wt: '', forty: '', bench: '',
      squat: '', gpa: '', commit: '', offers: []
    });
    // first non-blank wins — the sheet repeats some players
    if (!person.jersey && cJersey >= 0) person.jersey = irNum_(values[r][cJersey], 0, 99);
    if (!person.grad && cGrad >= 0) person.grad = irGrad_(values[r][cGrad]);
    if (!person.codes.length && cPos >= 0) {
      const legacy = String(values[r][cPos] || '');
      // "TE/LB" keeps its LB: see rosterCodesFromLegacy for why the plain
      // normalizer's codes were not enough
      if (legacy) person.codes = rosterCodesFromLegacy_(legacy);
    }
    if (!person.ht && cHt >= 0) person.ht = irHeight_(values[r][cHt]);
    if (!person.wt && cWt >= 0) person.wt = irNum_(values[r][cWt], 80, 450);
    if (!person.forty && cForty >= 0) person.forty = irNum_(values[r][cForty], 4, 8);
    if (!person.bench && cBench >= 0) person.bench = irNum_(values[r][cBench], 45, 700);
    if (!person.squat && cSquat >= 0) person.squat = irNum_(values[r][cSquat], 45, 1000);
    if (!person.gpa && cGpa >= 0) person.gpa = irNum_(values[r][cGpa], 0, 5);
    if (!person.commit) person.commit = off.commit;
    if (!person.offers.length) person.offers = off.offers;
  }

  // the graduated: known class year, and it is not after this season's year.
  // A blank grad is unknown, not graduated — those stay.
  var graduated = 0;
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(function (key) {
    const w = wanted[key];
    if (w.grad !== '' && Number(w.grad) <= seasonYear) {
      graduated++;
      delete wanted[key];
    }
  });

  // who exists already
  const players = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  const byNorm = {};                 // norm name -> [player rows]
  const plById0 = {};                // pid -> player row, for the stored name
  players.forEach(function (p) {
    plById0[String(p.PlayerID || '').trim()] = p;
    const k = irNorm_(p.DisplayName);
    if (!k) return;
    (byNorm[k] = byNorm[k] || []).push(p);
  });
  const seatRows = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
  const seatByPid = {};              // pid -> this-season seat row
  const teamOfPid = {};              // pid -> {teamId: true} across seasons
  seatRows.forEach(function (r) {
    const pid = String(r.PlayerID || '').trim();
    if (!pid) return;
    (teamOfPid[pid] = teamOfPid[pid] || {})[String(r.TeamID || '').trim()] = true;
    if (String(r.SeasonID || '').trim() === seasonId) seatByPid[pid] = r;
  });
  /* This season's seats by school, for the boys a file names differently from
     the way they were first entered. "K. Sorrells" was typed in from a box
     score; the roster says "Kristian Sorrells". Exact matching sees two people
     and creates the second beside the first, which already holds this
     season's stats - the duplicate the merge tools then have to undo. */
  const seatsOfTeam = {};            // teamId -> [{pid, jersey, parts}]
  Object.keys(seatByPid).forEach(function (pid) {
    const seat = seatByPid[pid];
    const tid = String(seat.TeamID || '').trim();
    if (!tid) return;
    (seatsOfTeam[tid] = seatsOfTeam[tid] || []).push({
      pid: pid,
      jersey: String(seat.Jersey === null || seat.Jersey === undefined ? '' : seat.Jersey).trim(),
      parts: irNameParts_(seat.DisplayName || '')
    });
  });
  const hasStats = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS).forEach(function (r) {
    if (String(r.SeasonID || '').trim() !== seasonId) return;
    const pid = String(r.PlayerID || '').trim();
    if (pid) hasStats[pid] = true;
  });

  /* Whose seat may not be deleted by a file: anyone who has entered their own
     information, or holds an account. Read before the removal pass below. */
  const authors = irProfileAuthors_();
  const plan = { create: [], move: [], update: [], remove: [], keepStats: [], keepEntered: [],
                 ambiguous: [] };
  const claimed = {};                // pid -> the wanted person who claimed it

  /* Pass one: exact names, every row, before any looser matching runs at all.
     A fallback for one row must never take a seat that a later row matches
     exactly. That is how "Mekhi Gibbs" came to find his own seat already
     claimed by Rocco Corriggio and settle for Dinitri's. */
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(function (key) {
    const w = wanted[key];
    const cands = (byNorm[w.norm] || []).filter(function (p) {
      return !claimed[String(p.PlayerID)];
    });
    var pid = '';
    if (cands.length === 1) pid = String(cands[0].PlayerID);
    else if (cands.length > 1) {
      // two players, one name: prefer the one who has ever worn this school
      const here = cands.filter(function (p) {
        return (teamOfPid[String(p.PlayerID)] || {})[w.teamId];
      });
      if (here.length === 1) pid = String(here[0].PlayerID);
      else { plan.ambiguous.push(w.name + ' (' + w.teamId + '): ' + cands.length +
                                 ' players share this name — left alone'); w.skip = true; return; }
    }
    if (pid) { claimed[pid] = w; w.pid = pid; }
  });

  /* Pass two: the rows nobody matched exactly, against this school's seats
     this season, by NAME. First initial and surname must agree: "K. Sorrells"
     is Kristian Sorrells, "Zyad" is Zayd Fareed, "M. Shelley Jr" is Michael
     Shelley. When that names two boys - Khyari and Khaliq Copeland - the
     jersey breaks the tie, and only then.

     A jersey on its own never matches. The seats carry the number a boy wore
     when his seat was made, and #1 belonged to M. Shelley a year before it
     belonged to Khyari Copeland; matched on the number first, this handed
     three seats to the wrong boys. A number can confirm a name. It cannot
     replace one. */
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(function (key) {
    const w = wanted[key];
    if (w.pid || w.skip) return;
    const me = irNameParts_(w.name);
    if (!me) return;
    const mine = (seatsOfTeam[w.teamId] || []).filter(function (s_) { return !claimed[s_.pid]; });
    var hits = mine.filter(function (s_) {
      return s_.parts && s_.parts.surname === me.surname && s_.parts.initial === me.initial;
    });
    var how = 'initial and surname';
    /* Two rows in the FILE answering to the same initial and surname - Khyari
       and Khaliq Copeland - and one seat on file between them. Whichever row
       came first would take it. When the file itself carries twins, a seat is
       only theirs if the jersey says so. */
    const twins = Object.keys(wanted).filter(function (k) {
      const o = wanted[k], p = o.teamId === w.teamId && irNameParts_(o.name);
      return p && p.surname === me.surname && p.initial === me.initial;
    }).length;
    if (twins > 1) {
      hits = hits.filter(function (s_) {
        return w.jersey !== '' && s_.jersey !== '' && Number(s_.jersey) === Number(w.jersey);
      });
      if (hits.length) how += ', jersey #' + w.jersey + ' confirming';
    }
    if (hits.length > 1 && w.jersey !== '') {
      const byNum = hits.filter(function (s_) {
        return s_.jersey !== '' && Number(s_.jersey) === Number(w.jersey);
      });
      if (byNum.length === 1) { hits = byNum; how += ', jersey #' + w.jersey + ' deciding'; }
    }
    if (hits.length > 1) {
      plan.ambiguous.push(w.name + ' (' + w.teamId + '): ' + hits.length +
                          ' seats share the initial and surname and no jersey tells them apart — left alone');
      w.skip = true; return;
    }
    if (hits.length !== 1) return;                          // nobody: created below
    const pid = hits[0].pid;
    claimed[pid] = w; w.pid = pid;
    const was = String((plById0[pid] || {}).DisplayName || '');
    if (irNorm_(was) !== w.norm) {
      w.renamedFrom = was;
      (plan.renamed = plan.renamed || []).push('  ' + was + ' -> ' + w.name + '   (by ' + how + ')');
    }
  });

  /* Now the seats. */
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(function (key) {
    const w = wanted[key];
    if (w.skip) return;
    if (!w.pid) { plan.create.push(w); return; }
    const pid = w.pid;
    const seat = seatByPid[pid];
    if (!seat) plan.move.push(w);                              // new seat this season
    else if (String(seat.TeamID || '').trim() !== w.teamId) {
      w.fromTeam = String(seat.TeamID || '').trim();
      w.seatRow = seat.__row;
      w.seatId = String(seat.PlayerSeasonID || '').trim();     // audit key, see fillSeat
      plan.move.push(w);                                       // the wrong-team fix
    } else {
      w.seatRow = seat.__row;
      w.seatId = String(seat.PlayerSeasonID || '').trim();
      plan.update.push(w);
    }
  });

  /* Seats this season that the file does not name.
     A file is only evidence about the schools it actually contains. Rosters
     arrive a few schools at a time - eight of fifteen in one sheet is normal -
     and reading silence about Perryville as "Perryville has no players" would
     empty every roster the file happens not to cover. So a seat is only ever
     considered for removal when its own team appears in the file. */
  const filedTeams = {};
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(function (k) { filedTeams[wanted[k].teamId] = true; });
  const plById = {};
  players.forEach(function (p) { plById[String(p.PlayerID || '').trim()] = p; });
  /* A seat the file does not name, at a school it does, whose initial and
     surname the file DID name and matched to a different record: almost
     certainly one boy under two records - "Zyad Fareed" with the stats and
     "Zayd Fareed" without. The report says so, and names the merge. */
  const twinOf = {};
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(function (k) {
    const w = wanted[k], p = w.pid && irNameParts_(w.name);
    if (p) twinOf[w.teamId + '|' + p.initial + '|' + p.surname] = w.name + ' (' + w.pid + ')';
  });
  var untouched = 0;
  Object.keys(seatByPid).forEach(function (pid) {
    if (claimed[pid]) return;
    const seat = seatByPid[pid];
    const nm = String(seat.DisplayName || pid);
    const tid = String(seat.TeamID || '');
    if (!filedTeams[tid]) { untouched++; return; }        // this file says nothing about them
    const seatId = String(seat.PlayerSeasonID || '').trim();
    /* Graduation is not the file's silence. It is a date that has passed, and
       it outranks however much a player entered about himself - otherwise a
       senior who filled in his profile would hold a roster seat forever. Only
       somebody who could still be on the team is rescued below. */
    const career = plById[pid] || {};
    const gradYear = Number(String(career.GradYear || seat.GradYear || '')
                            .replace(/\D/g, '')) || 0;
    const walked = gradYear > 0 && gradYear <= seasonYear;
    if (hasStats[pid]) {
      const p = irNameParts_(nm);
      const twin = p && twinOf[tid + '|' + p.initial + '|' + p.surname];
      plan.keepStats.push(nm + ' (' + tid + ')' + (twin
        ? '   — same initial and surname as ' + twin + ', who matched. One boy, two records? ' +
          'Merge two players by ID, absorbing ' + pid + '.'
        : ''));
    }
    else if (!walked && (authors[pid] || authors[seatId]))
      plan.keepEntered.push(nm + ' (' + tid + ')');
    else plan.remove.push({ pid: pid, name: nm, row: seat.__row, teamId: tid });
  });

  /* What a person has already entered for themselves, and therefore what this
     file may not touch. Counted here, before anything is written, so the dry
     run reports it too - knowing what an import will refuse to do is most of
     the reason to run one. */
  const held = irProtectedFields_();
  const kept = {};
  const SEAT_FIELDS = [['Jersey', 'jersey'], ['GradYear', 'grad'], ['Positions', 'codes'],
                       ['HeightInches', 'ht'], ['WeightLbs', 'wt'], ['Forty', 'forty'],
                       ['Bench', 'bench'], ['Squat', 'squat'], ['GPA', 'gpa']];
  plan.update.concat(plan.move).forEach(function (w) {
    if (!w.seatId) return;                            // a new seat has nothing to protect
    SEAT_FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
      const v = w[f[1]];
      const offered = (f[1] === 'codes') ? v.length
                                         : (v !== '' && v !== null && v !== undefined);
      /* Names, not just a count. "Jersey: 4" tells an administrator that four
         numbers on the coach's sheet were declined and nothing about which
         four — and a held-back jersey is exactly where a wrong number
         survives a corrected roster. He can only check them if he is told who
         they are. */
      if (offered && held[w.seatId + '|' + f[0]])
        (kept[f[0]] = kept[f[0]] || []).push(w.name || w.pid);
    });
  });

  const out = [];
  out.push((apply ? 'ROSTER IMPORT' : 'ROSTER IMPORT — DRY RUN') + ' for ' + seasonId);
  /* Which sheet this actually read. Everything below is plausible whichever
     file it came from, so the file has to be named before the numbers are. */
  out.push('Reading sheet "' + sh.getName() + '" — ' + (values.length - 1) + ' rows');
  out.push('');
  out.push('CSV players matched to existing careers: ' +
           (plan.move.length + plan.update.length));
  out.push('  moved to the right team: ' +
           plan.move.filter(function (w) { return w.fromTeam; }).length);
  out.push('  seated for the season:   ' +
           plan.move.filter(function (w) { return !w.fromTeam; }).length);
  out.push('  already right, refreshed: ' + plan.update.length);
  if (plan.renamed && plan.renamed.length) {
    out.push('  matched under a different spelling — the file\'s name replaces the stored one on APPLY:');
    plan.renamed.forEach(function (x) { out.push('  ' + x); });
  }
  out.push('New players created: ' + plan.create.length);
  out.push('Graduated (class of ' + seasonYear + ' or earlier) skipped: ' + graduated +
           ' — the ' + seasonId + ' season is the fall after their walk');
  out.push('Seats removed (graduated or not in CSV, no ' + seasonId + ' stats): ' +
           plan.remove.length);
  out.push('Schools in this file: ' + Object.keys(filedTeams).length +
           ' — only their rosters are touched');
  if (untouched)
    out.push('Seats left alone at schools this file does not mention: ' + untouched);
  if (plan.keepEntered.length) {
    out.push('KEPT despite missing from the file — they have an account or have');
    out.push('entered their own information. Remove a seat by hand if one really left:');
    plan.keepEntered.forEach(function (x) { out.push('  ' + x); });
  }
  if (plan.keepStats.length) {
    out.push('KEPT despite missing from CSV — they have ' + seasonId + ' stats:');
    plan.keepStats.forEach(function (x) { out.push('  ' + x); });
  }
  if (plan.ambiguous.length) {
    out.push('Left for a person:');
    plan.ambiguous.forEach(function (x) { out.push('  ' + x); });
  }
  if (Object.keys(badSchools).length)
    out.push('Unrecognized schools (rows skipped): ' +
             Object.keys(badSchools).join(', '));
  const keptCols = Object.keys(kept).sort();
  if (keptCols.length) {
    out.push('');
    out.push('Held back — a player or coach entered these, so the file is ignored.');
    out.push('Check these against the file and correct any by hand that are wrong:');
    keptCols.forEach(function (k) {
      const who = kept[k];
      const show = who.slice(0, 12).join(', ') +
                   (who.length > 12 ? ' …and ' + (who.length - 12) + ' more' : '');
      out.push('  ' + k + ' (' + who.length + '): ' + show);
    });
  }

  /* A file that names a school claims to BE that school's roster, and everyone
     it leaves out loses their seat. That is right for a roster the coach sent
     and catastrophic for a partial one: a five-row file headed "North Harford",
     meant only to add five players, took twenty-one seats off North Harford in
     a single click. Nothing protected them — they had no stats yet and had
     entered nothing themselves, which is exactly the state a roster is in early
     in the season, when a partial file is most likely to be used. Aberdeen
     survived the identical mistake a day earlier only because its players
     already had week 1 stats.

     So a file that would empty out most of a school is treated as a partial
     list rather than as a roster, and refused before anything is written.
     Nothing about the wanted behaviour changes: a real roster keeps nearly
     everyone, and taking a handful of seats off stays one click. */
  const rosterSize = {};
  Object.keys(seatByPid).forEach(function (pid) {
    const tid = String(seatByPid[pid].TeamID || '');
    if (tid) rosterSize[tid] = (rosterSize[tid] || 0) + 1;
  });
  const cut = {};
  plan.remove.forEach(function (x) { cut[x.teamId] = (cut[x.teamId] || 0) + 1; });
  const gutted = Object.keys(cut).filter(function (tid) {
    return cut[tid] >= IMPROSTER.WIPE_MIN &&
           cut[tid] >= (rosterSize[tid] || 0) * IMPROSTER.WIPE_SHARE;
  });
  if (gutted.length) {
    out.push('');
    out.push('REFUSED — this looks like a partial list, not a roster:');
    gutted.forEach(function (tid) {
      out.push('  ' + (teamNameOf_(tid) || tid) + ': the file would take away ' +
               cut[tid] + ' of its ' + (rosterSize[tid] || 0) + ' seats. A roster ' +
               'file that names a school REPLACES that school\'s roster, so every ' +
               'player it leaves out loses his place.');
    });
    out.push('');
    out.push('If you meant to ADD players, put the whole roster in the file — the');
    out.push('players already seated as well as the new ones — and run it again.');
    out.push('If those players really have left the team, take their seats off on');
    out.push('the portal Roster tab, which does it one at a time and on purpose.');
    const stop = out.join('\n');
    Logger.log(stop);
    return stop;
  }

  if (!apply) {
    out.push('');
    out.push('Nothing was written. Run Import rosters (APPLY) to do it.');
    const msg = out.join('\n');
    Logger.log(msg);
    return msg;
  }

  // ── the writes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS)) throw new Error('Busy — try again.');
  try {
    const psSheet = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
    const psHead = tabHeader_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
    const pCol = function (n) { return psHead.indexOf(n); };

    const plHead = tabHeader_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
    const plSheet = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
    const plRowOf = {};
    players.forEach(function (p) { plRowOf[String(p.PlayerID)] = p; });

    function setCell(sheet, row, colIdx, v) {
      if (colIdx >= 0 && v !== '' && v !== null && v !== undefined)
        sheet.getRange(row, colIdx + 1).setValue(v);
    }

    /* A field a person entered through the portal is never written over. The
       file refreshes everything else, so a number that only ever came from an
       import stays correctable. */
    function setSeatCell(rowIdx, seatId, col, v) {
      if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return;
      if (seatId && held[seatId + '|' + col]) return;   // already counted, above
      setCell(psSheet, rowIdx, pCol(col), v);
    }

    function fillSeat(rowIdx, w) {
      setCell(psSheet, rowIdx, pCol('TeamID'), w.teamId);      // roster fact, not a profile field
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'Jersey', w.jersey);
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'GradYear', w.grad);
      if (w.codes.length)
        setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'Positions', formatPositions_(w.codes));
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'HeightInches', w.ht);
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'WeightLbs', w.wt);
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'Forty', w.forty);
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'Bench', w.bench);
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'Squat', w.squat);
      setSeatCell(rowIdx, w.seatId, 'GPA', w.gpa);
    }

    function fillCareer(pid, w) {
      const p = plRowOf[pid];
      if (!p) return;
      /* Matched under a shorter or misspelt name: the file's is the fuller one
         and becomes the stored one, on the career and on this season's seat,
         so "K. Sorrells" stops appearing anywhere once the roster says
         Kristian. A name a person entered himself is left as he wrote it. */
      if (w.renamedFrom && !held[pid + '|DisplayName']) {
        setCell(plSheet, p.__row, plHead.indexOf('DisplayName'), w.name);
        if (w.seatRow) setSeatCell(w.seatRow, w.seatId, 'DisplayName', w.name);
      }
      /* The career graduation year follows the file unless a person set it.
         Blank-only would be wrong here: a stale year is exactly what this
         import exists to correct, and a seat whose GradYear the file refreshes
         must not disagree with the career row beside it.

         Commitment and offers stay blank-only below. Those are claims a player
         makes about himself, and a roster sheet has neither to offer. */
      if (w.grad && !held[pid + '|GradYear'])
        setCell(plSheet, p.__row, plHead.indexOf('GradYear'), w.grad);
      if (w.commit && !String(p.Commitment || '').trim())
        setCell(plSheet, p.__row, plHead.indexOf('Commitment'), w.commit);
      if (w.offers.length && plHead.indexOf('Offers') >= 0 &&
          !String(p.Offers || '').trim())
        setCell(plSheet, p.__row, plHead.indexOf('Offers'),
                JSON.stringify(w.offers.map(function (o) {
                  return { school: o, level: '' };
                })));
    }

    plan.update.concat(plan.move.filter(function (w) { return w.seatRow; }))
      .forEach(function (w) { fillSeat(w.seatRow, w); fillCareer(w.pid, w); });

    const newSeats = [];
    plan.move.filter(function (w) { return !w.seatRow; }).forEach(function (w) {
      const seat = { PlayerSeasonID: 'PS-' + seasonId.replace('SEA-', '') + '-' + w.pid,
                     PlayerID: w.pid, TeamID: w.teamId, SeasonID: seasonId,
                     DisplayName: w.name };
      if (w.jersey !== '') seat.Jersey = w.jersey;
      if (w.grad !== '') seat.GradYear = w.grad;
      if (w.codes.length) seat.Positions = formatPositions_(w.codes);
      if (w.ht !== '') seat.HeightInches = w.ht;
      if (w.wt !== '') seat.WeightLbs = w.wt;
      if (w.forty !== '') seat.Forty = w.forty;
      if (w.bench !== '') seat.Bench = w.bench;
      if (w.squat !== '') seat.Squat = w.squat;
      if (w.gpa !== '') seat.GPA = w.gpa;
      newSeats.push(seat);
      fillCareer(w.pid, w);
    });

    // brand-new players, ids allocated once for the batch
    var nextN = 0;
    players.forEach(function (p) {
      const m = String(p.PlayerID || '').match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
      if (m) nextN = Math.max(nextN, parseInt(m[1], 10));
    });
    const newPlayers = [];
    plan.create.forEach(function (w) {
      nextN++;
      var id = String(nextN);
      while (id.length < 6) id = '0' + id;
      const pid = 'PLY-' + id;
      const rec = { PlayerID: pid, DisplayName: w.name, NameNormalized: w.norm,
                    FirstSeenSeason: seasonId, CreatedFrom: 'ROSTER_IMPORT' };
      if (w.grad !== '') rec.GradYear = w.grad;
      if (w.commit) rec.Commitment = w.commit;
      if (w.offers.length && plHead.indexOf('Offers') >= 0)
        rec.Offers = JSON.stringify(w.offers.map(function (o) {
          return { school: o, level: '' };
        }));
      newPlayers.push(rec);
      const seat = { PlayerSeasonID: 'PS-' + seasonId.replace('SEA-', '') + '-' + pid,
                     PlayerID: pid, TeamID: w.teamId, SeasonID: seasonId,
                     DisplayName: w.name };
      if (w.jersey !== '') seat.Jersey = w.jersey;
      if (w.grad !== '') seat.GradYear = w.grad;
      if (w.codes.length) seat.Positions = formatPositions_(w.codes);
      if (w.ht !== '') seat.HeightInches = w.ht;
      if (w.wt !== '') seat.WeightLbs = w.wt;
      newSeats.push(seat);
    });
    if (newPlayers.length) appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS, newPlayers);
    if (newSeats.length) appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS, newSeats);

    // removals, bottom-up so the row numbers stay true while deleting
    plan.remove.sort(function (a, b) { return b.row - a.row; })
      .forEach(function (x) { psSheet.deleteRow(x.row); });

    __tableCache = {};
    CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot', 'ac-' + seasonId]);
    markDirty_('roster');

    out.push('');
    out.push('APPLIED. Derived tables recompute on the next sweep (within 15 minutes),');
    out.push('or run Rebuild everything now.');
    const msg = out.join('\n');
    Logger.log(msg);
    return msg;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

  _self, NOT _top. Apps Script serves this page inside a sandboxed iframe, and
  "_top" makes every <a href="#/..."> navigate the parent window instead of

  runs. Only the home page would render. Any external link added later needs an
  explicit target="_blank".

/* Tables use the page as their only vertical scroll surface. A table that fits
   can use native sticky positioning. A wide table keeps only its necessary
   horizontal pan; stickyHeads() moves the original header cells by the exact
   page-scroll offset, so the frozen header stays aligned and fully interactive
   without creating a second vertical scrollbar. */
.tw.fits{overflow:visible}
.tw.pan{max-height:none;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden}
/* A wide table pans sideways, and the column saying WHO the row is about must
   not pan away with it — a row of numbers with the name gone is unreadable.
   freezeLead() adds froz1 or froz2 to say how many leading columns to hold:
   one where the name is first, two where a rank sits in front of it, and it
   measures the rank so the second column knows where to stop. */
.tw.pan.froz1 tbody td:first-child,.tw.pan.froz1 tfoot td:first-child,
.tw.pan.froz2 tbody td:first-child,.tw.pan.froz2 tfoot td:first-child,
.tw.pan.froz2 tbody td:nth-child(2),.tw.pan.froz2 tfoot td:nth-child(2)
  {position:sticky;z-index:1;background:var(--card)}
.tw.pan.froz1 thead th:first-child,
.tw.pan.froz2 thead th:first-child,.tw.pan.froz2 thead th:nth-child(2)
  {position:sticky;z-index:4}
.tw.pan.froz1 thead th:first-child,.tw.pan.froz1 tbody td:first-child,
.tw.pan.froz1 tfoot td:first-child,
.tw.pan.froz2 thead th:first-child,.tw.pan.froz2 tbody td:first-child,
.tw.pan.froz2 tfoot td:first-child{left:0}
.tw.pan.froz2 thead th:nth-child(2),.tw.pan.froz2 tbody td:nth-child(2),
.tw.pan.froz2 tfoot td:nth-child(2){left:var(--froz1,0px)}
/* the edge only on the last held column, so the join reads as one block */
.tw.pan.froz1 tbody td:first-child,.tw.pan.froz1 tfoot td:first-child,
.tw.pan.froz2 tbody td:nth-child(2),.tw.pan.froz2 tfoot td:nth-child(2)
  {box-shadow:1px 0 0 var(--rule2)}

  {box-shadow:1px 0 0 var(--rule2),0 1px 0 var(--rule)}

/* ---- the light tracing the mark ----
   A thin arc travelling the edge of the tile and staying on it.

   The ring is one element the size of the tile with a two-pixel padding, a
   conic gradient behind it, and a mask that keeps only that padding: what is
   left is a 2px border with a bright run moving round it. The gradient turns
   by animating its own angle rather than by rotating the element, because
   rotating the element would take the mask with it and the ring would tumble
   instead of the light travelling.

   IT IS SIZED TO THE TILE, NOT TO THE LINK. askIcon() draws its badge as a
   rect 22 units wide with a 6.5-unit corner inside a 24-unit box, so at 48px
   the tile is 44px across with a 13px corner and sits two pixels inside the
   svg — which itself fills the anchor. Sizing the ring to the anchor instead
   put it two pixels out from the badge AND gave it the wrong corner, so it
   read as a second rounded square poking out from behind the mark rather
   than as a light on the mark. The fractions below are askIcon's own numbers;
   they move together or not at all.

   An earlier version sat outside the tile and was blurred, so it read as a
   glow leaking into the header.

   @property is what makes an angle animatable at all. Where it is missing the
   gradient simply holds still, which is a perfectly good badge — and where the
   reader has asked for less motion it holds still on purpose. */
@property --aiang{ syntax:'<angle>'; inherits:false; initial-value:0deg; }
.hask{position:relative;--aisz:48px}
.hask::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;
  width:calc(var(--aisz)*22/24);height:calc(var(--aisz)*22/24);
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  border-radius:calc(var(--aisz)*6.5/24);
  /* the * reset does not reach a pseudo-element, and without this the padding
     is added OUTSIDE the width and the ring grows back off the tile */
  box-sizing:border-box;padding:2px;
  /* above the artwork, or the band would be hidden under the badge it is
     meant to be drawn on */
  z-index:1;
  /* Transparent everywhere the light is not: a tinted base sits over the
     outer two pixels of the artwork and reads as a grey frame round the badge
     rather than as a badge with a light on it. */
  background:conic-gradient(from var(--aiang),
    transparent 0 58%,
    #1E5BFF 70%, #8A5CFF 78%, #FF3D8A 86%, #FFB300 92%,
    transparent 99%);
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite:xor;
          mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  animation:aitrace 3.6s linear infinite;
  pointer-events:none;
}
@keyframes aitrace{ to{ --aiang:360deg; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .hask::before{ animation:none } }

<script>
(function(){
  /* A close holds for the visit. A new key here (a new sponsor, a new
     creative) brings the banner back for visitors who closed the last one. */
  var SPONSOR_KEY='susquehanna-mailbox-2026';
  var bar=document.getElementById('sponsorBar'),link=document.getElementById('sponsorLink'),close=document.getElementById('sponsorClose');
  if(!bar||!link||!close)return;
  var memo='ucbac_sponsor_closed';
  try{if(sessionStorage.getItem(memo)===SPONSOR_KEY)bar.classList.add('is-closed');}catch(e){}
  close.addEventListener('click',function(){
    bar.classList.add('is-closed');
    try{sessionStorage.setItem(memo,SPONSOR_KEY);}catch(e){}
  });
  /* Each outbound click is counted on the SponsorClicks tab for the
     sponsor's report (svcSponsorClick, Advertising.gs). The link opens
     regardless; the count is best effort. */
  link.addEventListener('click',function(){
    try{
      var route=(location.hash||'#/').replace(/^#\/?/,'').split('?')[0]||'home';
      var visitor='';try{visitor=localStorage.getItem('ucbac_ask_id')||'';}catch(e){}
      google.script.run.withFailureHandler(function(){}).svcSponsorClick('banner',SPONSOR_KEY,route,visitor,window.innerWidth||0);
    }catch(e){}
  });
})();
</script>

<!--
  What the SERVER knows and this document cannot find out for itself.

  This page runs inside Apps Script's sandbox frame. Its own address is a
  googleusercontent URL with no query string and no hash, so a link from the
  Google Site - UCBACstats.com/?p=scores - is invisible here. doGet reads it
  and writes the opening route below. Same for the address of the Site itself,
  which is configuration, not something the page should hardcode.

  Both values are JSON-encoded server-side and whitelisted before that, so
  nothing arriving from a query string can break out of the string literal.

  Each is read through typeof. A template variable doGet did not set is not
  an empty string here - naming it throws ReferenceError, and the throw
  happens while the page is being built, so the visitor gets a stack trace
  instead of a website. That is a real failure mode: this file and WebApp.gs
  are pasted separately, and for the minutes between the two pastes the site
  would otherwise be down. A missing value is a missing feature, never a
  broken page.
-->
<script>
var LAUNCH_ROUTE = <?!= JSON.stringify(typeof route   === 'undefined' ? '' : (route   || '')) ?>;
var SITE_URL     = <?!= JSON.stringify(typeof siteUrl === 'undefined' ? '' : (siteUrl || '')) ?>;
var EXEC_URL     = <?!= JSON.stringify(typeof execUrl === 'undefined' ? '' : (execUrl || '')) ?>;
</script>

<script>
var BOOT=null, TEAM={}, SEASON=null;
var LAUNCH_STARTED=Date.now(), LAUNCH_CLOSED=false;

function setLaunchLogo(url){
  url=String(url||'');
  if(!/^(https?:|data:image\/)/i.test(url))return false;
  var screen=document.getElementById('launchScreen');
  var img=document.getElementById('launchLogo');
  if(!screen||!img)return false;
  function ready(){if(img.naturalWidth)screen.classList.add('has-logo');}
  img.addEventListener('load',ready,{once:true});
  img.addEventListener('error',function(){
    screen.classList.remove('has-logo');
    try{localStorage.removeItem('ucbac_brand_logo');}catch(e){}
  },{once:true});
  img.src=url;
  if(img.complete)ready();
  return true;
}
function finishLaunch(url){
  if(LAUNCH_CLOSED)return;
  var screen=document.getElementById('launchScreen');
  if(!screen){document.body.classList.remove('launching');LAUNCH_CLOSED=true;maybeMemberInvite();return;}
  if(url){
    try{localStorage.setItem('ucbac_brand_logo',String(url));}catch(e){}
    setLaunchLogo(url);
  }
  var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var exitQueued=false;
  function close(){
    if(LAUNCH_CLOSED)return;
    LAUNCH_CLOSED=true;
    document.body.classList.remove('launching');
    screen.classList.add('is-done');
    maybeMemberInvite();
    window.setTimeout(function(){if(screen.parentNode)screen.remove();},reduce?0:200);
  }
  function closeAtMinimum(){
    if(exitQueued)return;
    exitQueued=true;
    window.setTimeout(close,Math.max(0,(reduce?0:480)-(Date.now()-LAUNCH_STARTED)));
  }
  var img=document.getElementById('launchLogo');
  if(reduce||!url||screen.classList.contains('has-logo'))closeAtMinimum();
  else{
    img.addEventListener('load',closeAtMinimum,{once:true});
    img.addEventListener('error',closeAtMinimum,{once:true});
    window.setTimeout(closeAtMinimum,1000);
  }
}
try{setLaunchLogo(localStorage.getItem('ucbac_brand_logo')||'');}catch(e){}

UcbacPolicies.init({baseUrl:function(){return EXEC_URL;},call:function(fn,args){return call(fn,fn==='svcPolicies'?args:[TOKEN].concat(args||[]));},token:function(){return TOKEN;},accepted:function(){renderWho();if(parseHash().page==='ask')go();},signOut:function(){var t=TOKEN;TOKEN='';try{localStorage.removeItem('ucbac_token');}catch(e){}renderWho();location.hash='#/';if(t)call('svcSignOut',[t]).catch(function(){});}});
function rpc(fn,args){return new Promise(function(res,rej){
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(rej)[fn].apply(null,args||[]);});}

/* Only public reads belong here. Account state, portal data, uploads, analytics
   and mutations always reach the server. Memory is private to this open page. */
var PUBLIC_READ_TTL={svcHome:30000,svcStandings:60000,svcScores:30000,svcWeeks:300000,
  svcTeam:60000,svcPlayer:60000,svcGame:30000,svcCoach:60000,svcLeaders:60000,
  svcAllConference:60000,svcStatsFilters:300000,svcStats:60000,
  svcFantasyView:30000,svcFantasy:30000,svcFantasyPlayer:30000,svcFantasyTeam:30000,svcMatchup:60000};
var PUBLIC_READS=new Map(),PUBLIC_PENDING=new Map(),PUBLIC_READ_CHARS=0,PUBLIC_READ_EPOCH=0;
function publicReadKey(fn,args){
  return fn+':'+JSON.stringify(args||[],function(key,value){
    if(value&&Object.prototype.toString.call(value)==='[object Object]'){
      var sorted={};Object.keys(value).sort().forEach(function(k){sorted[k]=value[k];});return sorted;
    }
    return value;
  });
}
function dropPublicRead(key){
  var entry=PUBLIC_READS.get(key);
  if(entry){PUBLIC_READ_CHARS-=entry.json.length;PUBLIC_READS.delete(key);}
}
function clearPublicReads(){
  ++PUBLIC_READ_EPOCH;PUBLIC_READS.clear();PUBLIC_PENDING.clear();PUBLIC_READ_CHARS=0;
}
function savePublicRead(key,value,expires){
  if(value===null||value===undefined||value.error||value.ok===false)return;
  var json=JSON.stringify(value);
  if(json.length>250000)return;
  dropPublicRead(key);
  while(PUBLIC_READS.size&&(PUBLIC_READS.size>=48||PUBLIC_READ_CHARS+json.length>1000000))
    dropPublicRead(PUBLIC_READS.keys().next().value);
  PUBLIC_READS.set(key,{json:json,expires:expires});PUBLIC_READ_CHARS+=json.length;
}
function call(fn,args){
  if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(PUBLIC_READ_TTL,fn))return rpc(fn,args);
  var ttl=PUBLIC_READ_TTL[fn],key=publicReadKey(fn,args),now=Date.now();
  PUBLIC_READS.forEach(function(entry,k){if(entry.expires<=now)dropPublicRead(k);});
  var hit=PUBLIC_READS.get(key);
  if(hit){
    PUBLIC_READS.delete(key);PUBLIC_READS.set(key,hit);
    return Promise.resolve(JSON.parse(hit.json));
  }
  // A first Fantasy response includes filter options. Reuse its data-only
  // counterpart without extending its original expiry or losing the filters.
  if(fn==='svcFantasyView'&&args&&!args[2]){
    var fullArgs=args.slice();fullArgs[2]=true;
    var fullKey=publicReadKey(fn,fullArgs),full=PUBLIC_READS.get(fullKey);
    if(full){PUBLIC_READS.delete(fullKey);PUBLIC_READS.set(fullKey,full);return Promise.resolve(JSON.parse(full.json));}
    if(PUBLIC_PENDING.has(fullKey))key=fullKey;
  }
  var pending=PUBLIC_PENDING.get(key);
  if(!pending){
    var epoch=PUBLIC_READ_EPOCH;
    pending=new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
      var settled=false;
      var timer=setTimeout(function(){finish(null,new Error('This is taking longer than expected. Please try again.'));},25000);
      function finish(value,error){
        if(settled)return;settled=true;clearTimeout(timer);
        if(PUBLIC_PENDING.get(key)===pending)PUBLIC_PENDING.delete(key);
        if(error){reject(error);return;}
        try{
          var json=JSON.stringify(value);
          if(epoch===PUBLIC_READ_EPOCH)savePublicRead(key,value,Date.now()+ttl);
          resolve(json);
        }catch(e){reject(e);}
      }
      rpc(fn,args).then(function(value){finish(value);},function(error){finish(null,error);});
    });
    PUBLIC_PENDING.set(key,pending);
  }
  // Renderers may annotate or sort their payload. Never share mutable objects.
  return pending.then(function(json){return json===undefined?undefined:JSON.parse(json);});
}
function el(h){var d=document.createElement('div');d.innerHTML=h.trim();return d.firstChild;}
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){
  return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c];});}

/* Progressive select enhancement: existing values, change handlers and form
   semantics stay on the native control while the visible menu gains reliable
   touch geometry, collision handling and a complete keyboard path. */
var SMART_SELECT={host:null,select:null,trigger:null,popover:null,active:-1,uid:0,closeTimer:null};
function smartSelectName(select){
  var name=select.getAttribute('aria-label')||'';
  if(!name&&select.id){
    Array.prototype.some.call(document.getElementsByTagName('label'),function(label){
      if(label.htmlFor===select.id){name=label.textContent.trim();return true;}return false;
    });
  }
  if(!name){var fg=select.closest&&select.closest('.fg');var label=fg&&fg.querySelector('label');name=label?label.textContent.trim():'Choose an option';}
  return name||'Choose an option';
}
function smartSelectSync(select){
  if(!select||!select._smartTrigger)return;
  var option=select.options[select.selectedIndex];
  select._smartTrigger.textContent=option?option.text:'Choose...';
  select._smartTrigger.disabled=!!select.disabled;
}
function smartSelectSetActive(index){
  var pop=SMART_SELECT.popover;if(!pop)return;
  var options=pop.querySelectorAll('.smart-select-option');
  if(!options.length)return;
  index=Math.max(0,Math.min(index,options.length-1));
  while(options[index]&&options[index].disabled&&index<options.length-1)index++;
  if(options[index]&&options[index].disabled){while(index>0&&options[index].disabled)index--;}
  SMART_SELECT.active=index;
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(options,function(option,i){option.classList.toggle('is-active',i===index);});
  var active=options[index];
  if(active){pop.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',active.id);if(SMART_SELECT.trigger)SMART_SELECT.trigger.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',active.id);active.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});}
}
function smartSelectClose(returnFocus){
  var pop=SMART_SELECT.popover,trigger=SMART_SELECT.trigger;
  if(!pop)return;
  window.clearTimeout(SMART_SELECT.closeTimer);
  pop.classList.remove('is-open');
  if(trigger){trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');trigger.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');trigger.removeAttribute('aria-controls');}
  SMART_SELECT.closeTimer=window.setTimeout(function(){if(pop.parentNode)pop.parentNode.removeChild(pop);},90);
  SMART_SELECT.host=SMART_SELECT.select=SMART_SELECT.trigger=SMART_SELECT.popover=null;
  SMART_SELECT.active=-1;
  if(returnFocus&&trigger)trigger.focus();
}
function smartSelectChoose(index){
  var select=SMART_SELECT.select,pop=SMART_SELECT.popover;
  if(!select||!pop)return;
  var optionButton=pop.querySelectorAll('.smart-select-option')[index];
  if(!optionButton||optionButton.disabled)return;
  select.selectedIndex=Number(optionButton.getAttribute('data-option-index'));
  smartSelectSync(select);
  select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));
  smartSelectClose(true);
}
function smartSelectPosition(pop,trigger){
  var r=trigger.getBoundingClientRect(),gutter=12,below=window.innerHeight-r.bottom-gutter,above=r.top-gutter;
  var desired=Math.min(pop.scrollHeight||336,336),up=below<desired+8&&above>below;
  var available=Math.max(96,Math.min(336,up?above:below));
  var width=Math.min(Math.max(r.width,180),window.innerWidth-gutter*2);
  pop.style.width=width+'px';pop.style.maxHeight=available+'px';
  pop.style.left=Math.max(gutter,Math.min(r.left,window.innerWidth-width-gutter))+'px';
  pop.classList.toggle('opens-up',up);
  pop.style.top=(up?Math.max(gutter,r.top-Math.min(pop.scrollHeight,available)-8):r.bottom+8)+'px';
}
function smartSelectOpen(select,instant){
  if(!select||select.disabled)return;
  if(SMART_SELECT.select===select){smartSelectClose(true);return;}
  smartSelectClose(false);
  var trigger=select._smartTrigger,pop=document.createElement('div');
  pop.className='smart-select-popover';pop.id='smart-select-popover-'+(++SMART_SELECT.uid);
  pop.setAttribute('role','listbox');pop.setAttribute('aria-label',smartSelectName(select));
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(select.options,function(option,i){
    var item=document.createElement('button');
    item.type='button';item.className='smart-select-option';item.id=pop.id+'-option-'+i;
    item.setAttribute('role','option');item.setAttribute('data-option-index',i);
    item.setAttribute('aria-selected',option.selected?'true':'false');item.disabled=!!option.disabled;
    item.textContent=option.text;item.addEventListener('click',function(){smartSelectChoose(i);});pop.appendChild(item);
  });
  document.body.appendChild(pop);
  SMART_SELECT.host=select.parentNode;SMART_SELECT.select=select;SMART_SELECT.trigger=trigger;SMART_SELECT.popover=pop;
  trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');trigger.setAttribute('aria-controls',pop.id);
  smartSelectPosition(pop,trigger);smartSelectSetActive(Math.max(0,select.selectedIndex));
  if(instant)pop.classList.add('is-open');
  else window.requestAnimationFrame(function(){if(SMART_SELECT.popover===pop)pop.classList.add('is-open');});
}
function smartSelectKey(ev,select){
  var open=SMART_SELECT.select===select;
  if(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp'){
    ev.preventDefault();if(!open){smartSelectOpen(select,true);return;}
    smartSelectSetActive(SMART_SELECT.active+(ev.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1));return;
  }
  if(ev.key==='Home'&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectSetActive(0);return;}
  if(ev.key==='End'&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectSetActive(select.options.length-1);return;}
  if((ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' ')&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectChoose(SMART_SELECT.active);return;}
  if((ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' ')&&!open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectOpen(select,true);return;}
  if(ev.key==='Escape'&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectClose(true);return;}
  if(ev.key==='Tab'&&open)smartSelectClose(false);
}
function enhanceSelect(select){
  if(!select||select.multiple||select.getAttribute('data-smart-select'))return;
  select.setAttribute('data-smart-select','true');
  select.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');select.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  var host=document.createElement('span');host.className='smart-select'+(select.classList.contains('season')?' season-host':'');
  select.parentNode.insertBefore(host,select);host.appendChild(select);select.classList.add('smart-select-native');
  var trigger=document.createElement('button');trigger.type='button';trigger.className='smart-select-trigger';
  trigger.id='smart-select-trigger-'+(++SMART_SELECT.uid);trigger.setAttribute('role','combobox');
  trigger.setAttribute('aria-haspopup','listbox');trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');trigger.setAttribute('aria-label',smartSelectName(select));
  host.appendChild(trigger);select._smartTrigger=trigger;smartSelectSync(select);
  if(select.id){Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.getElementsByTagName('label'),function(label){if(label.htmlFor===select.id)label.htmlFor=trigger.id;});}
  trigger.addEventListener('click',function(){smartSelectOpen(select);});
  trigger.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){smartSelectKey(ev,select);});
  select.addEventListener('change',function(){smartSelectSync(select);});
}
function enhanceSelects(root){
  if(!root)return;
  if(root.tagName==='SELECT')enhanceSelect(root);
  if(root.querySelectorAll)Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('select'),enhanceSelect);
}
enhanceSelects(document);
if(typeof MutationObserver==='function')new MutationObserver(function(records){records.forEach(function(record){
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(record.addedNodes,enhanceSelects);
  var select=record.target&&record.target.tagName==='SELECT'?record.target:null;if(select&&select.getAttribute('data-smart-select'))smartSelectSync(select);
});}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){if(SMART_SELECT.popover&&!SMART_SELECT.popover.contains(ev.target)&&!SMART_SELECT.host.contains(ev.target))smartSelectClose(false);});
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){smartSelectClose(false);});
document.addEventListener('scroll',function(ev){if(SMART_SELECT.popover&&ev.target!==SMART_SELECT.popover)smartSelectClose(false);},true);

/* Is there actually a value here?
   google.script.run DROPS nulls when it serializes a payload, so a field the
   server set to null arrives in the browser as undefined. Testing `v !== null`
   therefore passes for missing data - which is how an unplayed game came to
   render its score as "undefined" and its status as FINAL. Every "do we have a
   value" test goes through this, never a bare null comparison. */
function has(v){return v!==null&&v!==undefined&&v!=='';}
var MONTHS=['January','February','March','April','May','June',
            'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
/* "2026-09-04" -> "September 4th, 2026".
   Parsed field-by-field rather than through new Date(): the browser reads a bare
   YYYY-MM-DD as UTC midnight and then prints it in local time, which west of
   Greenwich shows the day before. */
function fmtDate(d){
  if(!has(d)) return '';
  var m=String(d).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  if(!m) return String(d);
  var y=+m[1], mo=+m[2]-1, day=+m[3];
  if(mo<0||mo>11) return String(d);
  return MONTHS[mo]+' '+day+ordinal(day)+', '+y;
}
function ordinal(n){
  if(n%100>=11&&n%100<=13) return 'th';
  return {1:'st',2:'nd',3:'rd'}[n%10]||'th';
}
function team(id){return TEAM[id]||{name:id,logo:'',color:'#1F3B54'};}
/* Is this player a captain in the season being viewed? BOOT.captains ships the
   whole map once, so every page can mark a captain without each endpoint having
   to remember to carry the flag. */
function isCap(playerId,seasonId){
  var m=(BOOT&&BOOT.captains)||{};
  var byId=m[seasonId||SEASON];
  return !!(byId&&byId[playerId]);
}
/* The mark itself, defined once. Captaincy is a fact about one season, so every
   caller passes the season it is showing - a 2024 box score must not be marked
   from this year's captains, and the header's season is not the game's. */
function capMark(playerId,seasonId){
  return isCap(playerId,seasonId)?'<span class="cap" title="Team captain">C</span>':'';
}
/* One place that renders a player's name. Every table, card and list goes
   through it, so the captain mark cannot be present in one view and missing in
   another. */
/* Jersey and class ride along with every player name: "Aaron Dixon #56 --27".
   The map ships once in bootstrap per season; a player without either shows
   the bare name, and a season the map doesn't know adds nothing. */
function pmetaMark(playerId,seasonId){
  var m=BOOT.pmeta&&BOOT.pmeta[seasonId||SEASON];
  m=m&&m[playerId];
  if(!m)return '';
  var p=m.split('|'),bits=[];
  if(p[0])bits.push('#'+p[0]);
  if(p[1])bits.push('\u2019'+p[1]);
  return bits.length?' <span class="pmeta">'+esc(bits.join(' '))+'</span>':'';
}
/* A projected All-Conference place, worn as a small chip: RB1 in gold for
   First Team, RB2 in silver for Second. Honorable Mention wears nothing - a
   badge on a third of the conference marks nobody. Season-keyed like pmeta,
   so a 2025 page carries 2025's projections. */
function acbMark(playerId,seasonId){
  var m=BOOT.acbadge&&BOOT.acbadge[seasonId||SEASON];
  m=m&&m[playerId];
  if(!m)return '';
  return m.split('|').map(function(b){
    var first=b.charAt(b.length-1)==='1';
    return ' <span class="acb '+(first?'g':'s')+'" title="Projected '+
      (first?'First':'Second')+' Team · live All-Conference">'+esc(b)+'</span>';
  }).join('');
}
/* The blue check: this player holds an active account, so the page under his
   name is managed by the person it names. It sits directly after the name,
   before jersey and class, the way every network a reader already knows
   places it. */
function vMark(playerId){
  if(!(BOOT.verified&&BOOT.verified[playerId]))return '';
  return '<span class="vfy" role="img" aria-label="Verified account" '+
         'title="Verified - this player manages his own profile">✓</span>';
}
/* The same check on a school, meaning the same thing one step up: a coach
   holds an account here, so this roster and this schedule are kept by
   somebody answerable for them rather than filled in on the school's
   behalf. */
function tvMark(teamId){
  if(!(BOOT.verifiedTeams&&BOOT.verifiedTeams[teamId]))return '';
  return '<span class="vfy" role="img" aria-label="Verified team" '+
         'title="Verified - a coach at this school keeps this page">\u2713</span>';
}
function playerLink(playerId,name,seasonId){
  if(!playerId) return esc(name||'');
  return '<a href="#/player/'+esc(playerId)+'">'+esc(name||playerId)+
         vMark(playerId)+pmetaMark(playerId,seasonId)+capMark(playerId,seasonId)+
         acbMark(playerId,seasonId)+'</a>';
}
/* A team's place in the season being viewed, worn as a prefix: "(3) Aberdeen".
   No standings for that season - preseason - means no number, not a guess. */
function rankMark(teamId){
  var r=BOOT.ranks&&BOOT.ranks[SEASON]&&BOOT.ranks[SEASON][teamId];
  return r?'<span class="rkm">('+r+')</span> ':'';
}
/* How a team moved since the week before: a green triangle pointing up with
   the places gained inside it, a red one pointing down with the places lost.
   Nothing for a team that held its place, and nothing at all until there is
   an earlier week to compare with (the server sends no move for week 0 to
   week 1). */
/* Places gained or lost since last week, worn beside the rank.

   The number used to sit INSIDE the triangle, which cost it twice: nine pixels
   of bold mono in a 22x20 glyph is a coloured blob at the size it is actually
   read at, and a two-digit move overflowed the shape it was supposed to fit
   in. It reads beside the triangle at normal weight instead.

   The mark also keeps its width when there is nothing to say. The rank column
   is right-aligned, so a team that did not move used to push its own rank
   across while every team that did move sat a glyph further left - a column of
   numbers that would not line up. */
function moveMark(r){
  var m=Number(r&&r.move);
  if(!m||isNaN(m)) return '<span class="mv mv0" aria-hidden="true"></span>';
  var up=m>0, n=Math.abs(m);
  var label=(up?'Up ':'Down ')+n+(n===1?' place':' places')+' since last week';
  return '<span class="mv '+(up?'up':'down')+'" role="img" aria-label="'+label+'" title="'+label+'">'+
    /* Deliberately smaller than the rank it sits beside: a solid shape carries
       more weight than an outlined digit of the same height, and the rank is
       the number being read. */
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 10 8" width="6" height="5" aria-hidden="true">'+
    (up?'<path d="M5 0 L10 8 H0 Z"/>':'<path d="M0 0 H10 L5 8 Z"/>')+'</svg>'+n+'</span>';
}
/* And its record, worn as a suffix in the same mark: "(3) Aberdeen (2-1)".
   From the same standings; no standings, no record. */
function recordMark(teamId){
  var r=teamId&&BOOT.records&&BOOT.records[SEASON]&&BOOT.records[SEASON][teamId];
  return r?' <span class="rkm">('+esc(r)+')</span>':'';
}

            ['player','player'],['coach','coach'],['game','game'],['standings','standings'],['leaders','leaders'],

function parseHash(){
  var h=(location.hash||'#/').replace(/^#\/?/,'');
  var parts=h.split('?')[0].split('/').filter(Boolean);
  var qs={};(h.split('?')[1]||'').split('&').forEach(function(kv){
    if(!kv)return;var split=kv.indexOf('=');var key=split<0?kv:kv.slice(0,split),value=split<0?'':kv.slice(split+1);try{qs[key]=decodeURIComponent(value);}catch(e){qs[key]=value;}});
  return {page:parts[0]||'',id:parts[1]||'',qs:qs};
}
var STATS_REFRESH=null,ROUTE_LOADING_TIMER=null;
var ROUTE_VERSION=0, ROUTE_STATE=null;
/* Public view memory is bounded and lasts only for this visit. Exact filter
   URLs have independent positions; no account data is persisted. */
var VIEW_MEMORY=new Map(),VIEW_KEY='',VIEW_READY=false,VIEW_INTERRUPTED=false,VIEW_FRAME=null,FANTASY_BOARD_RETURN=null;
try{history.scrollRestoration='manual';}catch(e){}
function viewKey(){return String(SEASON||'')+'|'+(location.hash||'#/');}
function rememberView(){
  var app=document.getElementById('app');
  if(!VIEW_READY||!VIEW_KEY||!app||app.getAttribute('aria-busy')==='true')return;
  var page=app.getAttribute('data-page');
  if(!/^(stats|fantasy|teams|team|scores|allconference)$/.test(page))return;
  if(page==='fantasy'&&FANTPG)return;
  var tables=[];
  app.querySelectorAll('.tw').forEach(function(el,i){var table=el.querySelector('table');tables.push({id:table&&table.id,index:i,x:el.scrollLeft});});
  if(page==='fantasy')FANTASY_BOARD_RETURN={season:SEASON,hash:VIEW_KEY.slice(VIEW_KEY.indexOf('|')+1)};
  var snapshot={y:window.scrollY||0,tables:tables,teamTab:TEAM_TAB,teamView:TEAM_STATS_VIEW,phase:STAT_PHASE,filters:!!FILTER_EXPANDED[page]};
  VIEW_MEMORY.delete(VIEW_KEY);VIEW_MEMORY.set(VIEW_KEY,snapshot);
  while(VIEW_MEMORY.size>30)VIEW_MEMORY.delete(VIEW_MEMORY.keys().next().value);
}
document.addEventListener('scroll',function(){
  if(VIEW_FRAME!==null)return;
  VIEW_FRAME=requestAnimationFrame(function(){VIEW_FRAME=null;if(VIEW_KEY===viewKey())rememberView();});
},{passive:true,capture:true});
document.addEventListener('click',function(){rememberView();},true);
['wheel','touchstart','pointerdown','keydown'].forEach(function(name){
  document.addEventListener(name,function(){if(!VIEW_READY)VIEW_INTERRUPTED=true;},{passive:true,capture:true});
});
function finishView(){
  var version=ROUTE_VERSION,state=ROUTE_STATE;
  // Team panes are built immediately after render(). Restore once they exist,
  // before the next paint, and never pull the page after a new user gesture.
  requestAnimationFrame(function(){
    if(version!==ROUTE_VERSION)return;
    var saved=state&&state.restore;
    if(saved&&!VIEW_INTERRUPTED){
      var regions=document.querySelectorAll('#app .tw');
      (saved.tables||[]).forEach(function(t){
        var table=t.id&&document.getElementById(t.id),region=table?table.closest('.tw'):regions[t.index];
        if(region)region.scrollLeft=t.x||0;
      });
      window.scrollTo(0,Math.min(saved.y,Math.max(0,document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight)));
      stickyHeads();
    }
    if(state)state.restore=null;
    VIEW_READY=true;rememberView();
  });
}
