function compactFilters(app){
  var page=app.getAttribute('data-page');
  if(page!=='stats'&&page!=='fantasy')return;
  var panel=app.querySelector('.filters'),time=panel&&panel.querySelector('.fg-time');
  if(!time||panel.classList.contains('filter-panel'))return;
  var secondary=document.createElement('div');secondary.className='filter-secondary';secondary.id='secondary-filters';
  var summary=[];
  panel.querySelectorAll('.seg button.on').forEach(function(b){summary.push(b.textContent.trim());});
  panel.querySelectorAll('select[data-f]').forEach(function(s){
    if(s.getAttribute('data-f')!=='range'&&s.value){var option=s.options[s.selectedIndex];if(option)summary.push(option.textContent.trim());}
  });
  var query=panel.querySelector('input[data-f="q"]');if(query&&query.value)summary.push('Search: '+query.value);
  while(panel.firstChild){var child=panel.firstChild;panel.removeChild(child);if(child!==time)secondary.appendChild(child);}
  var button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='filter-toggle';
  button.setAttribute('aria-controls',secondary.id);

  panel.classList.add('filter-panel');panel.appendChild(time);panel.appendChild(button);panel.appendChild(secondary);update();
}
function filterSkeleton(page){
  function field(cls,width){return '<div class="fg filter-sk-field '+(cls||'')+'"'+(width?' style="--filter-sk-width:'+width+'px"':'')+'><i class="skeleton filter-sk-label"></i><i class="skeleton filter-sk-control"></i></div>';}
  var fields=field('fg-scope',142)+field('fg-side',page==='stats'?382:260)+field()+field()+field('',150)+field('',180);
  return '<div class="filters filter-panel'+(FILTER_EXPANDED[page]?' is-expanded':'')+'" aria-hidden="true">'+
    '<div class="fg fg-time"><i class="skeleton filter-sk-label"></i><i class="skeleton filter-sk-control"></i></div>'+
    '<div class="filter-toggle"><span class="filter-toggle-copy"><i class="skeleton filter-sk-label"></i><i class="skeleton route-sk-line" style="width:180px"></i></span></div>'+

    (page==='fantasy'?'<div class="filter-sk-context" aria-hidden="true"><i class="skeleton"></i><i class="skeleton"></i></div>':'')+

    (page==='fantasy'?'<div class="filter-sk-note" aria-hidden="true"><i class="skeleton"></i><i class="skeleton"></i></div>':'');
}
/* Bind every page read to the navigation that requested it. A stale response
   must not paint, change shared page data, or bind handlers in another page. */
function routeRequest(){
  var version=ROUTE_VERSION, hash=location.hash;
  return function(fn,args){
    return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){
      var settled=false;
      var timer=setTimeout(function(){finish(null,new Error('This is taking longer than expected. Please try again.'));},30000);
      function finish(value,error){
        if(settled)return;settled=true;clearTimeout(timer);
        if(version!==ROUTE_VERSION||hash!==location.hash){var stale=new Error('Navigation changed');stale.stale=true;reject(stale);}
        else if(error)reject(error);else resolve(value);
      }
      call(fn,args).then(function(value){finish(value);},function(error){finish(null,error);});
    });
  };
}
function routeSkeleton(page,label){
  var line='<i class="skeleton route-sk-line" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
  var table='<div class="card route-sk-table">'+Array(9).join('<div class="route-sk-row">'+line+line+line+line+'</div>')+'</div>';
  var cards='<div class="grid g3">'+Array(7).join('<div class="card route-sk-card">'+line+line+line+'</div>')+'</div>';
  var profile=/^(team|player|coach|game)$/.test(page);
  var body=/^(home|stats|fantasy|allconference|standings|leaders)$/.test(page)?table:cards;
  if(page==='stats'||(page==='fantasy'&&!parseHash().id))return '<div class="loading-shell route-skeleton route-sk-data route-sk-'+page+'" role="status" aria-label="'+esc(label)+'"><span class="sr-only">'+esc(label)+'</span>'+filterSkeleton(page)+table+'</div>';
  if(page==='home')body=(TOKEN&&(!MEMBER_AUTH_READY||BLITZ_ALLOWED)?UcbacDailySummary.skeleton():'')+table;
  if(profile)body='<div class="card route-sk-hero"><i class="skeleton route-sk-logo" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>'+line+line+line+'</div></div><div class="route-sk-tabs">'+line+line+line+'</div>'+table;
  if(page==='plays'||page==='portal'||page==='ask')body='<div class="card route-sk-form">'+Array(6).join(line)+'</div>';
  return '<div class="loading-shell route-skeleton" role="status" aria-label="'+esc(label)+'"><span class="sr-only">'+esc(label)+'</span><i class="skeleton sk-title" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="skeleton sk-sub" aria-hidden="true"></i>'+body+'</div>';
}


function statsFocusKey(app){
  var a=document.activeElement;
  if(!a||!app.contains(a))return null;
  if(a.classList.contains('smart-select-trigger')){var select=a.parentNode.querySelector('select[data-f]');if(select)return {attr:'data-f',value:select.getAttribute('data-f')};}
  if(a.hasAttribute('data-fsort'))return {attr:'data-fsort',value:a.getAttribute('data-fsort')};
  if(a.hasAttribute('data-sort'))return {attr:'data-sort',value:a.getAttribute('data-sort')};
  if(a.hasAttribute('data-f'))return {attr:'data-f',value:a.getAttribute('data-f')};
  if(a.id==='prev'||a.id==='next')return {id:a.id};
  return null;
}

function restoreStatsFocus(app,key){
  if(!key)return;
  var target=null;
  if(key.id)target=document.getElementById(key.id);
  else{
    var items=app.querySelectorAll('['+key.attr+']');
    for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++)if(items[i].getAttribute(key.attr)===key.value){target=items[i];break;}
  }
  if(target){if(target.tagName==='SELECT'){enhanceSelect(target);target=target._smartTrigger||target;}try{target.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(e){target.focus();}}
}

/* Keep a populated Stats view in place during sorts and filter changes. The
   measured table is skeletonized rather than replaced, preserving document
   height, horizontal column geometry and the user's exact page position. */
function statsRefreshState(app,table){
  return {
    scrollY:window.pageYOffset||document.documentElement.scrollTop||0,
    minHeight:app.style.minHeight||'',
    focus:statsFocusKey(app), tableScroll:table.parentNode.scrollLeft
  };
}

function showStatsTableLoading(app){
  var table=app.querySelector('#stt,#fnt');
  if(!table)return false;
  if(table.classList.contains('table-skeleton'))return true;

  if(!STATS_REFRESH)STATS_REFRESH=statsRefreshState(app,table);
  var appHeight=Math.ceil(app.getBoundingClientRect().height);
  if(appHeight)app.style.minHeight=appHeight+'px';
  app.classList.add('stats-refreshing');

  var tableWidth=Math.ceil(table.getBoundingClientRect().width);
  var heads=table.querySelectorAll('thead th');
  var widths=[];
  for(var i=0;i<heads.length;i++)widths.push(Math.ceil(heads[i].getBoundingClientRect().width));
  if(tableWidth){table.style.width=tableWidth+'px';table.style.minWidth=tableWidth+'px';}
  table.style.tableLayout='fixed';
  for(var h=0;h<heads.length;h++){
    if(widths[h])heads[h].style.width=widths[h]+'px';
    heads[h].onclick=null;
    heads[h].onkeydown=null;
    heads[h].setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');
  }
  table.classList.add('table-skeleton');
  table.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');

  var region=table.closest?table.closest('.tw'):null;
  if(region){
    region.classList.add('is-loading');
    region.setAttribute('aria-label','Updating statistics table');
  }
  var controls=app.querySelectorAll('[data-f],[data-fsort],.pager button,.smart-select-trigger');
  for(var c=0;c<controls.length;c++){
    if('disabled' in controls[c])controls[c].disabled=true;
    controls[c].setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');
  }
  var rows=table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr,tfoot tr'),rowHeights=[];
  for(var r=0;r<rows.length;r++)rowHeights.push(rows[r].getBoundingClientRect().height);
  for(var rh=0;rh<rows.length;rh++)if(rowHeights[rh])rows[rh].style.height=rowHeights[rh]+'px';
  var cells=table.querySelectorAll('tbody td,tfoot td');
  for(var j=0;j<cells.length;j++)
    cells[j].innerHTML='<span class="skeleton table-skeleton-cell" aria-hidden="true"></span>';

  var status=document.createElement('div');
  status.className='sr-only';
  status.setAttribute('role','status');
  status.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');
  status.textContent='Updating statistics table';
  app.appendChild(status);
  return true;
}

  var fn=({home:pgHome,scores:pgScores,teams:pgTeams,team:pgTeam,player:pgPlayer,coach:pgCoach,

/* Route internal links in JS rather than relying on anchor navigation.
   Inside the Apps Script iframe - and again inside a Google Sites embed - a
   fragment href can be resolved against the wrong document and escape the
   frame. Handling the click ourselves makes routing independent of that. */
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  if(ev.defaultPrevented||ev.button!==0||ev.metaKey||ev.ctrlKey||ev.shiftKey||ev.altKey)return;
  var a=ev.target;
  while(a&&a.nodeName!=='A')a=a.parentNode;
  if(!a||!a.getAttribute)return;
  var h=a.getAttribute('href')||'';
  if(h.indexOf('#/')!==0)return;                 // external links behave normally
  ev.preventDefault();
  if(location.hash===h)go(); else location.hash=h;
});

/* Section chips under a page title. Clicking one scrolls to that section of
   the same page - the Scores-page pattern, applied to pages that are one long
   scroll instead of a set of weeks. */
function secNav(items){
  return '<div class="chips secnav">'+items.map(function(x){
    return '<button type="button" data-sec="'+esc(x[0])+'">'+esc(x[1])+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div>';
}
function scrollToSec(id){
  var el=document.getElementById('sec-'+id);
  if(!el)return;
  if(el.tagName==='DETAILS')el.open=true;      // a folded section opens before it is scrolled to
  if(el.scrollIntoView)el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){

  if(b)scrollToSec(b.getAttribute('data-sec'));
});

}

/* "Share profile": one click puts the profile's link on the clipboard - the
   Hudl move. The link is the deployment's own ?p= address, because that is
   the only address that works pasted anywhere: this document's location is a
   sandbox URL nobody should be handed, and the Google Site cannot carry a
   route. */
function shareUrl(page,id){
  var u=(typeof EXEC_URL==='string'?EXEC_URL:'');
  if(!/^https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+$/i.test(u))return '';
  return u+'?p='+page+(id?'&id='+encodeURIComponent(id):'');
}
/* The link a caption ends with, or nothing at all. A card draws perfectly
   well without the site's address; the caption is the only part that wants
   it, so a missing EXEC_URL costs a line of text rather than the button. */
function shareTail(page,id){
  var u=shareUrl(page,id);
  return u?'\n\n'+u:'\n\nUCBACstats.com';
}

/* Every share on the site opens the same sheet and hands over a picture. It
   used to copy the page's address, which previews as a Google page and is not
   a thing anybody wants in a post.

   data-cardshare, not data-share: the Blitz row already uses data-share for
   its turn index, and a document-level handler reading data-share as a URL was
   quietly copying "0" to the clipboard and telling the reader "Link copied"
   every time somebody shared an answer. */
function shareBtn(page,id,label){
  if(!id) return '';
  return '<div class="qshare"><button type="button" class="linky" data-cardshare="'+
         esc(page)+':'+esc(id)+'">'+shareGlyph()+esc(label||'Share profile')+'</button></div>';
}

/* Bound here, beside the button it serves, rather than beside the card code
   two thousand lines down: a listener registered late is a listener that is
   never registered at all if anything above it throws. */
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  if(!ev.target.closest) return;
  var b=ev.target.closest('[data-cardshare]');
  if(b){ ev.preventDefault(); cardShareOpen(b.getAttribute('data-cardshare')); }
});

/* One place on the site still wants an address rather than a picture: Top
   Plays, where the point is to send somebody TO the page to upload a clip,
   not to post a stat. It keeps the old behaviour under its own attribute. */
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  var b=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-copylink]'):null;
  if(!b)return;
  var url=b.getAttribute('data-copylink');
  var label=b._label||(b._label=b.textContent);
  var done=function(){
    if(b._t)clearTimeout(b._t);
    b.classList.add('ok');b.textContent='Link copied';
    b._t=setTimeout(function(){b.classList.remove('ok');b.textContent=label;},2000);
  };
  /* execCommand is the fallback because the clipboard API needs a permission
     the sandbox frame is not always granted; the visible prompt() is the
     fallback's fallback, so the link is always obtainable. */
  var fallback=function(){
    var ta=document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value=url;ta.setAttribute('readonly','');
    ta.style.position='fixed';ta.style.left='-9999px';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();
    var okd=false;
    try{okd=document.execCommand('copy');}catch(e){}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    if(okd)done(); else prompt('Copy this link:',url);
  };
  if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText)
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done,fallback);
  else fallback();
});

  // re-rendered - go() alone would read the old season straight back out
  if(parseHash().page==='stats') sGo({season:SEASON,range:'SEASON'}); else go();
});

       stays on it rather than being moved to another page mid-thought. */
    if(v==='LAST4'||v==='ALL'){

      this.value=SEASON; return;

       move the hash too, or the page reads the old season straight back out of it. */
    var pg=parseHash().page;
    if(pg==='stats') sGo({season:v,range:'SEASON'});
    else if(pg==='fantasy') fGo({season:v,range:'SEASON'});

  };
  /* The assistant is not in this list: its mark stands by the search box. */
  document.getElementById('nav').innerHTML=
    [['','Home'],['scores','Scores'],['teams','Teams'],['stats','Stats'],
     ['fantasy','Fantasy'],['allconference','All-Conference']]
    .map(function(p){return '<a data-p="'+p[0]+'" href="#/'+p[0]+'">'+p[1]+'</a>';}).join('');
  /* Someone arriving from UCBACstats.com asked for a page, and the server had
     to tell us which: this frame cannot read the address they typed. Apply it
     only when they have not already routed themselves, so a refresh or a back
     button keeps the page they were actually on. Setting the hash fires
     hashchange, which runs go() - calling it here as well would render twice. */
  var launch=(typeof LAUNCH_ROUTE==='string'?LAUNCH_ROUTE:''), lh=location.hash||'';
  if(launch&&launch!==lh&&(lh===''||lh==='#'||lh==='#/')) location.hash=launch;
  else go();
  siteLinks();
  renderWho();
  finishLaunch(b.brand&&b.brand.logo);
}).catch(function(e){

  finishLaunch('');
});

/* The portal is this same deployment with ?page=portal - sign-in there is an
   emailed one-time code, so nothing needs to execute as the visitor. The
   address still has to come from the SERVER (BOOT.portalUrl): location.href
   inside the Apps Script sandbox is a googleusercontent frame, not the
   published page, and a link built from it opens a blank window. */
var PORTAL_URL='';
/* One site, one window. The portal renders INSIDE the site at #/portal, and
   the session token it stores is readable here (same deployment, same
   origin) - so the header greets by name, and a sign-in completed in the
   embedded portal updates this header live through the storage event. */
var TOKEN=typeof UCBAC_INITIAL_TOKEN==='string'?UCBAC_INITIAL_TOKEN:'';
if(typeof UCBAC_INITIAL_TOKEN!=='undefined')UCBAC_INITIAL_TOKEN='';
try{if(!TOKEN)TOKEN=localStorage.getItem('ucbac_token')||'';}catch(e){}
/* whether the header found a signed-in visitor: a page that would invite
   someone to make an account can skip the invitation */
var WHO_IN=false, MEMBER_AUTH_READY=false, DAILY_EPOCH=0;
var BLITZ_ALLOWED=false, BLITZ_EPOCH=0, AUTH_VERSION=0, BLITZ_TOKEN='', BLITZ_DIALOG=null;

    ++CARD_DRAW_VERSION;CARD.busy=false;CARD.spec=null;CARD.url='';CARD.blob=null;CARD.id='';}
  updateBlitzLink();
}
function blitzDenied(){

  render('<h1>Account access</h1><p class="notes">This page is unavailable for this account. You can continue browsing public football stats.</p><p>'+portalA('Open your account','signin')+' · <a href="#/">Home</a></p>');
}
function blitzFailure(e){
  if(!/BLITZ_ACCESS|ACCOUNT_UPDATE_REQUIRED/.test(String(e&&e.message||e)))return false;
  clearBlitz();if(parseHash().page==='ask')blitzDenied();renderWho();return true;
}
window.addEventListener('storage',function(ev){
  if(!ev||ev.key!=='ucbac_token')return;
  var was=TOKEN; TOKEN=ev.newValue||'';
  renderWho();
