});

/* The portal's published address - SAME TAB, always (target=_top; the sandbox
   frame cannot host it as an iframe, and a new window is exactly what we are
   rid of). Empty until bootstrap reports it. */
function portalHref(){
  var p=(BOOT&&BOOT.portalUrl)||'';
  if(p.indexOf('userCodeAppPanel')>=0||p.indexOf('googleusercontent.com')>=0)return '';
  return p;
}
function portalA(label,cls,view){
  var p=portalHref();
  if(!p) return '';
  // ?view=signup opens the portal on Create an account rather than on the code box
  if(view) p+=(p.indexOf('?')>=0?'&':'?')+'view='+encodeURIComponent(view);
  return '<a'+(cls?' class="'+cls+'"':'')+' href="'+esc(p)+'" target="_top">'+label+'</a>';
}

function renderWho(){
  var version=++AUTH_VERSION, token=TOKEN;
  if(token)UcbacDailySummary.closeInvite();
  if(BLITZ_TOKEN!==token){
    BLITZ_TOKEN=token;MEMBER_AUTH_READY=false;clearPublicReads();clearBlitz();UcbacPolicies.reset();
    if(parseHash().page==='ask')blitzDenied();
  }
  var box=document.getElementById('who'); if(!box)return;
  var foot=document.getElementById('footPortal');
  /* Rendered immediately and kept if the auth call fails: nobody stares at an
     empty corner while a round trip decides what to offer. */
  function signIn(){
    WHO_IN=false;
    /* Two doors, not one. A single "Sign in" asked a parent who has never
       been here to guess that it also makes accounts; the portal has a
       Create an account form, and ?view=signup opens straight onto it
       instead of onto the code box. */
    box.innerHTML=portalA('Create account','join','signup')+portalA('Log in','signin');
    if(foot) foot.innerHTML=portalA('Log in or create an account')+'<br>'+
      '<span style="font-size:12px">Free fan, player and coach accounts. AI tools for eligible members 18 and older.</span>';
  }
  signIn();
  if(!TOKEN){MEMBER_AUTH_READY=true;resetHomeDailySummary();maybeMemberInvite();return;}

  call('svcAuthState',[token]).then(function(a){
    if(version!==AUTH_VERSION||token!==TOKEN)return;
    MEMBER_AUTH_READY=true;
    if(!a||!a.signedIn){
      TOKEN=''; WHO_IN=false; clearBlitz();UcbacPolicies.reset();
      if(parseHash().page==='ask')blitzDenied();
      try{localStorage.removeItem('ucbac_token');}catch(e){}
      maybeMemberInvite();
      return;                              // stale token - Sign in stays up
    }
    if(a.canUseBlitz===true)BLITZ_ALLOWED=true;else {clearBlitz();if(parseHash().page==='ask')blitzDenied();}
    updateBlitzLink();UcbacPolicies.requireUpdate(a);loadHomeDailySummary();
    var nm=esc(a.name||a.email);
    WHO_IN=true;
    var count=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(a.pendingCount)||0));
    box.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="whoBtn" id="whoMenuButton" data-menu aria-label="Profile menu" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="whoMenu"'+(count?' aria-describedby="whoPending"':'')+'>'+
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21v-2a8 8 0 0 1 16 0v2"/></svg>'+
      (count?'<span class="whoCount" aria-hidden="true">'+(count>99?'99+':count)+'</span><span class="sr-only" id="whoPending">'+count+' pending account requests</span>':'')+'</button>'+
      '<div class="whoMenu" id="whoMenu" role="menu" aria-labelledby="whoMenuButton" aria-hidden="true" inert>'+
      '<a class="whoItem" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" href="'+esc(portalHref())+'" target="_top">View Profile</a>'+
      '<button type="button" class="whoItem" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1" data-a="siteSignOut">Sign Out</button></div>';
    document.getElementById('whoMenuButton').setAttribute('title','Signed in as '+(a.name||a.email||'your account'));
    if(foot) foot.innerHTML=a.status&&a.status!=='ACTIVE'?'Your request is '+esc(String(a.status).toLowerCase())+'. '+portalA('See status'):'Signed in as '+nm+' · '+portalA('Profile');
  }).catch(function(){if(version!==AUTH_VERSION||token!==TOKEN)return;MEMBER_AUTH_READY=true;clearBlitz();if(parseHash().page==='ask')blitzDenied();});
}

/* The account menu shares the same keyboard contract as the selects. */
function closeWhoMenu(refocus,instant){
  var m=document.getElementById('whoMenu'),b=document.querySelector('[data-menu]');
  if(b){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');if(refocus)b.focus({preventScroll:true});}
  if(m){m.classList.toggle('instant',!!instant);m.classList.remove('open');m.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');m.setAttribute('inert','');}
}
function openWhoMenu(focusLast,instant){
  var m=document.getElementById('whoMenu'),b=document.querySelector('[data-menu]');
  if(!m||!b)return;
  m.classList.toggle('instant',!!instant);m.removeAttribute('inert');m.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  m.classList.add('open');b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
  var items=m.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]'),item=items[focusLast?items.length-1:0];
  if(item)item.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  var m=document.getElementById('whoMenu');
  var b=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-menu]'):null;
  if(b&&m){ev.preventDefault();if(m.classList.contains('open'))closeWhoMenu(false,ev.detail===0);else openWhoMenu(false,ev.detail===0);return;}
  if(m&&!m.contains(ev.target))closeWhoMenu(false);
  var so=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-a="siteSignOut"]'):null;
  if(so){
    ev.preventDefault();
    closeWhoMenu(false,true);
    var t=TOKEN; TOKEN='';
    try{localStorage.removeItem('ucbac_token');}catch(e){}
    renderWho(); location.hash='#/';
    var login=document.querySelector('#who .signin');if(login)login.focus({preventScroll:true});
    if(t)call('svcSignOut',[t]).catch(function(){});
  }else if(m&&ev.target.closest&&ev.target.closest('#whoMenu a')){
    closeWhoMenu(false,true);
  }
});
document.addEventListener('focusin',function(ev){
  var box=document.getElementById('who');if(box&&!box.contains(ev.target))closeWhoMenu(false,true);
});
window.addEventListener('hashchange',function(){closeWhoMenu(false,true);});

document.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
  var menuButton=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-menu]'):null;
  var menu=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('#whoMenu'):null;
  if(menuButton&&(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp'||ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' ')){
    ev.preventDefault();openWhoMenu(ev.key==='ArrowUp',true);return;
  }
  if(menu&&(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp'||ev.key==='Home'||ev.key==='End')){
    ev.preventDefault();var items=Array.prototype.slice.call(menu.querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"]'));
    var at=items.indexOf(document.activeElement),next=ev.key==='Home'?0:ev.key==='End'?items.length-1:(at+(ev.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+items.length)%items.length;
    if(items[next])items[next].focus();return;
  }
  if(menu&&ev.key==='Tab'){
    closeWhoMenu(true,true);if(ev.shiftKey)ev.preventDefault();return;
  }
  if(menu&&ev.key===' '){
    ev.preventDefault();var item=ev.target.closest('[role="menuitem"]');if(item)item.click();return;
  }
  if(ev.key==='Escape'){
    if(menu||(menuButton&&menuButton.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true')){
      ev.preventDefault();closeWhoMenu(true,true);return;
    }
    closeWhoMenu(!!menu,true);
    if(SMART_SELECT.popover)smartSelectClose(true);
    closeSearch(document.activeElement!==document.getElementById('q'));
  }
});

/* - search - */
var qt,SEARCH_INDEX=-1,SEARCH_SERIAL=0,SEARCH_CLOSE_TIMER=null,SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY='ucbac_search_history_v1';
function searchItems(){return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#sres a[role="option"]'));}
function openSearch(instant){
  var box=document.getElementById('sres'),input=document.getElementById('q');if(!box||!input)return;
  window.clearTimeout(SEARCH_CLOSE_TIMER);box.hidden=false;input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
  if(instant)box.classList.add('is-open');else window.requestAnimationFrame(function(){box.classList.add('is-open');});
}
function closeSearch(refocus){
  var box=document.getElementById('sres'),input=document.getElementById('q');if(!box||!input)return;
  box.classList.remove('is-open');input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');SEARCH_INDEX=-1;
  window.clearTimeout(SEARCH_CLOSE_TIMER);SEARCH_CLOSE_TIMER=window.setTimeout(function(){box.hidden=true;},90);
  if(refocus)input.focus();
}
function setSearchActive(index){
  var items=searchItems(),input=document.getElementById('q');if(!items.length)return;
  SEARCH_INDEX=Math.max(0,Math.min(index,items.length-1));
  items.forEach(function(item,i){item.setAttribute('aria-selected',i===SEARCH_INDEX?'true':'false');});
  input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',items[SEARCH_INDEX].id);items[SEARCH_INDEX].scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
}
function getSearchHistory(){try{var h=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY)||'[]');return Array.isArray(h)?h.slice(0,10):[];}catch(e){return [];}}
function rememberSearch(link){
  if(!link)return;
  var item={href:link.getAttribute('href')||'',label:link.getAttribute('data-search-label')||'',type:link.getAttribute('data-search-type')||'',sub:link.getAttribute('data-search-sub')||''};
  if(!item.href||!item.label)return;
  var history=getSearchHistory().filter(function(old){return old.href!==item.href;});history.unshift(item);
  try{localStorage.setItem(SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY,JSON.stringify(history.slice(0,10)));}catch(e){}
}
function searchResultMarkup(item,i,prefix){
  /* item.mark is OUR OWN generated chip markup (acbMark), never user text -
     everything else here stays escaped exactly as before. */
  return '<a role="option" aria-selected="false" id="'+prefix+'-'+i+'" href="'+esc(item.href)+'" data-search-label="'+esc(item.label)+'" data-search-type="'+esc(item.type)+'" data-search-sub="'+esc(item.sub||'')+'"><span><span class="t">'+esc(item.type)+'</span> '+esc(item.label)+(item.mark||'')+(item.sub?' <span class="muted"> · '+esc(item.sub)+'</span>':'')+'</span></a>';
}
function showSearchHistory(instant){
  var history=getSearchHistory(),box=document.getElementById('sres');
  if(!history.length){closeSearch(false);return;}
  box.innerHTML='<div class="search-history-label">Recent searches</div>'+history.map(function(item,i){return searchResultMarkup(item,i,'search-history');}).join('');
  SEARCH_INDEX=-1;openSearch(instant);
}
function showSearchResults(rs,v){
  var box=document.getElementById('sres');SEARCH_INDEX=-1;
  if(!rs.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="search-empty" role="status">No players or teams match &ldquo;'+esc(v)+'&rdquo;.</div>';openSearch();return;}
  box.innerHTML=rs.map(function(r,i){return searchResultMarkup({href:r.type==='team'?('#/team/'+r.id):r.type==='coach'?('#/coach/'+r.id):('#/player/'+r.id),label:r.label,type:r.type,sub:r.sub||'',mark:r.type==='player'?vMark(r.id)+acbMark(r.id):''},i,'search-result');}).join('');openSearch();
}
document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('focus',function(){if(!this.value.trim())showSearchHistory();});
document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('input',function(){
  var input=this,v=input.value.trim(),serial=++SEARCH_SERIAL;clearTimeout(qt);
  if(!v){showSearchHistory();return;}
  if(v.length<2){closeSearch(false);return;}
  qt=setTimeout(function(){call('svcSearch',[v]).then(function(rs){if(serial===SEARCH_SERIAL&&input.value.trim()===v)showSearchResults(rs,v);})
    .catch(function(){if(serial!==SEARCH_SERIAL)return;var box=document.getElementById('sres');box.innerHTML='<div class="search-empty" role="status">Search is unavailable. Try again.</div>';openSearch();});},220);
});
document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
  var items=searchItems();
  if((ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp')&&!items.length&&!this.value.trim()){showSearchHistory(true);items=searchItems();}
  if(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp'){
    if(!items.length)return;ev.preventDefault();if(document.getElementById('sres').hidden)openSearch();
    setSearchActive(SEARCH_INDEX<0?(ev.key==='ArrowDown'?0:items.length-1):SEARCH_INDEX+(ev.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1));return;
  }
  if(ev.key==='Enter'&&SEARCH_INDEX>=0&&items[SEARCH_INDEX]){ev.preventDefault();rememberSearch(items[SEARCH_INDEX]);items[SEARCH_INDEX].click();closeSearch(false);return;}
  if(ev.key==='Escape'){ev.preventDefault();closeSearch(false);return;}
  if(ev.key==='Tab')closeSearch(false);
});
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var result=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('#sres a[role="option"]'):null;
  if(result){rememberSearch(result);closeSearch(false);return;}
  if(!e.target.closest('.searchbox'))closeSearch(false);
});

/* The search box names what it accepts, in the conference's own words:
   Cameron Durbin, Elkton, Eric Siegel. "Search players and teams" told a
   reader two of the three things that work and none of the spellings; a real
   name does both jobs at once. The names stand bare - no "Try", no quotes:
   placeholder grey already says this is a prompt and not a value, and the
   box is too narrow to spend six characters saying it twice.

   The server sends the list (BOOT.examples). Where it has not been updated
   yet, the teams and their head coaches are already in the boot payload, so
   the box still rotates - a missing field is a shorter list, never a broken
   placeholder. */
var PH = { list: [], order: [], i: 0, timer: null, base: '' };

/* Shuffled, and every name shown once before any name comes round again -
   a bag, not a dice roll. Plain randomness repeats and clusters, which reads
   as a bug in a box that only shows one word at a time. The reshuffle also
   refuses to open on the name it just closed with, so the seam between two
   passes is not the one place a repeat can happen. */
function phShuffle(){
  var a=PH.list.slice(), last=PH.order.length?PH.order[PH.order.length-1]:null;
  for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)), t=a[i]; a[i]=a[j]; a[j]=t;
  }
  if(a.length>1&&last!==null&&a[0]===last){ a.push(a.shift()); }
  PH.order=a; PH.i=0;
}
function searchExamples(){
  var b=BOOT||{};
  if(b.examples&&b.examples.length) return b.examples.slice();
  var out=[],teams=b.teams||[];
  for(var i=0;i<teams.length;i++){
    if(teams[i].name) out.push(teams[i].name);
    if(teams[i].headCoach) out.push(teams[i].headCoach);
  }
  return out;
}
function phSet(txt){
  var el=document.getElementById('q');
  if(el) el.setAttribute('placeholder',txt||PH.base);
}
function phNext(){
  PH.i++;
  if(PH.i>=PH.order.length) phShuffle();
  return PH.order[PH.i];
}
function phTick(){
  var el=document.getElementById('q');
  if(!el||!PH.order.length) return;
  /* nothing to advertise over the reader's own typing, and nothing to move
     under a cursor already in the box */
  if(el.value||document.activeElement===el||document.hidden) return;
  var next=phNext();
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){
    phSet(next); return;
  }
  el.classList.add('phf');                       // fade the placeholder out
  setTimeout(function(){ phSet(next); el.classList.remove('phf'); },200);
}
function startSearchExamples(){
  var el=document.getElementById('q');
  if(!el) return;
  /* Captured once, and only from the authored placeholder. Reading the
     attribute again on a second call would take whatever example is showing
     at that moment and enshrine a player's name as the written prompt. */
  if(!PH.base) PH.base=el.getAttribute('placeholder')||'Search players, teams and coaches';
  PH.list=searchExamples();
  PH.order=[];
  if(!PH.list.length) return;
  phShuffle(); phSet(PH.order[0]);
  if(PH.timer) clearInterval(PH.timer);
  PH.timer=setInterval(phTick,3600);
  /* the box belongs to the reader the moment it is theirs: stop cycling on
     focus, and put the plain prompt back so nothing reads as pre-filled */
  if(!el.__phBound){
    el.__phBound=1;
    el.addEventListener('focus',function(){ phSet(''); });
    el.addEventListener('blur',function(){ if(!el.value) phSet(PH.order[PH.i]); });
  }
}

/* - shared renderers - */
/* Only a TEAM-### id has a page. A playoff row against a non-conference school
   stores that school's name here instead, and linking it would lead nowhere. */
function isKnownTeam(id){ return /^TEAM-\d+$/.test(String(id||'')); }

/* Links to a team, or renders plain text when there is no page to reach. */
function teamLink(id,name,inner,cls){
  // rank and the check only decorate a plain name - callers passing custom
  // inner markup (logos, badges) place their own
  var label=inner||(rankMark(id)+esc(name||id||'')+tvMark(id));
  if(!isKnownTeam(id)) return '<span'+(cls?' class="'+cls+'"':'')+'>'+label+'</span>';
  return '<a href="#/team/'+esc(id)+'"'+(cls?' class="'+cls+'"':'')+'>'+label+'</a>';
}
function teamLogo(id,t,attrs){
  if(!t||!t.logo) return '';
  return '<img src="'+esc(t.logo)+'" width="48" height="48"'+(attrs||'')+' alt="'+esc((t.name||'')+' logo')+'">';
}

/* The card is a div, not one big anchor: each team row links to that team and
   the footer links to the box score. Nesting anchors is invalid HTML, and the
   browser silently drops the inner one - so wrapping the whole card meant the
   team names could never be clickable at all. */
function gameCard(g){
  var h=team(g.home),a=team(g.away);
  var done=has(g.hs)&&has(g.as);
  var hw=done&&g.hs>g.as, aw=done&&g.as>g.hs;
  /* Who hosts is never left to convention. Away always prints on top, but the
     tag is what says so - a reader should not need to know the ordering rule. */
  function row(id,t,score,win,fallback,role){
    var inner=teamLogo(id,t,' loading="lazy"')+
      '<span class="nm">'+rankMark(id)+esc(t.name||fallback||id)+recordMark(id)+'</span>'+
      '<span class="ha">'+role+'</span>'+
      '<span class="sc">'+(done?score:'')+'</span>';
    var cls='grow '+(done?(win?'win':'lose'):'');
    return isKnownTeam(id)
      ? '<a class="'+cls+'" href="#/team/'+esc(id)+'">'+inner+'</a>'
      : '<div class="'+cls+'">'+inner+'</div>';
  }
  return '<div class="gcard">'+
    row(g.away,a,g.as,aw,g.awayName,'AWAY')+row(g.home,h,g.hs,hw,g.homeName,'HOME')+
    '<a class="meta" href="#/game/'+esc(g.id)+'">'+
    '<span>'+esc(g.playoff?(g.roundLabel||'Playoff'):('Week '+n(g.week)))+'</span>'+
    '<span>'+esc(g.status==='FORFEIT'?'FORFEIT':(done?'Final':(fmtDate(g.date)||'Scheduled')))+
    ' &rsaquo;</span></a>'+
    '<button type="button" class="cmpbtn" data-cmp="'+esc(g.id)+'" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="cmp-'+esc(g.id)+'">Compare teams <span aria-hidden="true">&#9662;</span></button>'+ 
    '<div class="cmpbox" id="cmp-'+esc(g.id)+'" aria-live="polite"></div></div>';
}

/* Matchup comparison: collapsed on every card until asked for, then filled in
   place - same window, no navigation. Each side is its season to date going
   into that week, so a Week 9 card compares Weeks 1-8. Fetched once per card. */
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  var b=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('[data-cmp]'):null;
  if(!b)return;
  var gid=b.getAttribute('data-cmp'), box=document.getElementById('cmp-'+gid);
  if(!box)return;
  var open=box.classList.contains('open');
  box.classList.toggle('open',!open);
  b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'false':'true');
  b.innerHTML='Compare teams <span aria-hidden="true">'+(open?'&#9662;':'&#9652;')+'</span>';
  if(open||box.dataset.done)return;
  box.dataset.done='1';
  box.innerHTML=loadingView('Loading team comparison',true);
  call('svcMatchup',[gid]).then(function(m){
    box.innerHTML=m?mxTable(m):'<div class="muted" style="font-size:12px">No comparison available.</div>';
  }).catch(function(e){
    box.dataset.done='';
    box.innerHTML='<div class="muted" style="font-size:12px">'+esc(e&&e.message||e)+'</div>';
  });
});
function mxTable(m){
  var A=m.away||{},H=m.home||{};
  function nm(id){var t=TEAM[id];return t?t.name:(id||'');}
  function rec(x){return x.gp?(x.w+'-'+x.l):null;}
  var head='<div class="cmpcut">'+esc(m.cutoff)+'</div>';
  if(!A.gp&&!H.gp)
    return head+'<div class="muted" style="font-size:12px;text-align:center;padding:2px 0 4px">No games played yet this season.</div>';
  var rows=[
    ['Record',rec(A),rec(H),0],
    ['Points/G',A.ppg,H.ppg,1],['Points allowed/G',A.papg,H.papg,-1],
    ['Total yds/G',A.totYdsPG,H.totYdsPG,1],['Pass yds/G',A.passYdsPG,H.passYdsPG,1],
    ['Rush yds/G',A.rushYdsPG,H.rushYdsPG,1],['Comp %',A.compPct,H.compPct,1],
    ['Pass TD',A.passTD,H.passTD,1],['Rush TD',A.rushTD,H.rushTD,1],
    ['INT thrown',A.intThrown,H.intThrown,-1],['Fumbles lost',A.fumLost,H.fumLost,-1],
    ['Sacks',A.sacks,H.sacks,1],['TFL',A.tfl,H.tfl,1],
    ['Takeaways',A.takeaways,H.takeaways,1],['TO margin',A.toMargin,H.toMargin,1],
    ['Tackles/G',A.tacklesPG,H.tacklesPG,1]
  ];
  var h='<table class="mxt"><thead><tr><th>'+esc(nm(A.teamId))+'</th><th></th><th>'+
        esc(nm(H.teamId))+'</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    var a=r[1],b=r[2],dir=r[3];
    var aH=has(a),bH=has(b),aB=' class="n"',bB=' class="n"';
    if(dir&&aH&&bH&&a!==b){ if((a>b?1:-1)===dir)aB=' class="n bt"';else bB=' class="n bt"'; }
    h+='<tr><td'+aB+'>'+(aH?a:'-')+'</td><td class="lbl">'+esc(r[0])+'</td><td'+bB+'>'+(bH?b:'-')+'</td></tr>';
  });
  h+='</tbody></table>';
  if(A.prov||H.prov)h+='<div class="muted" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:3px">Includes player-entered stats awaiting approval.</div>';
  return head+h;
}
function sortable(id){
  var t=document.getElementById(id); if(!t)return;
  t.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(function(th,i){
    th.setAttribute('scope','col');
    th.setAttribute('role','button');
    th.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
    th.setAttribute('aria-sort','none');
    function sort(){
      var tb=t.tBodies[0], rows=[].slice.call(tb.rows);
      var dir=th.dataset.d==='1'?-1:1; th.dataset.d=dir===1?'1':'';
      rows.sort(function(x,y){
        var cx=x.cells[i], cy=y.cells[i];
        /* A blank is "never recorded", not a low score: it sorts last in BOTH
           directions, so ascending a 40 time gives the fastest man rather than
           a list of everyone nobody has timed. */
        var xb=cx.dataset.v===undefined&&!String(cx.innerText).trim();
        var yb=cy.dataset.v===undefined&&!String(cy.innerText).trim();
        if(xb&&yb) return 0;
        if(xb) return 1;
        if(yb) return -1;
        var a=cx.dataset.v!==undefined?+cx.dataset.v:cx.innerText;
        var b=cy.dataset.v!==undefined?+cy.dataset.v:cy.innerText;
        if(typeof a==='number'&&typeof b==='number') return (a-b)*dir;
        return String(a).localeCompare(String(b))*dir;});
      rows.forEach(function(r){tb.appendChild(r);});
      t.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-sort','none');});
      th.setAttribute('aria-sort',dir===1?'ascending':'descending');
    }
    th.onclick=sort;
    th.onkeydown=function(ev){if(ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' '){ev.preventDefault();sort();}};
  });
}
function tbl(id,cols,rows,rowFn){
  return '<div class="tw" role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label="Statistics table"><table id="'+id+'"><thead><tr>'+ 
    cols.map(function(c){return '<th scope="col" class="'+(c.n?'n':'')+'">'+esc(c.t)+'</th>';}).join('')+
    '</tr></thead><tbody>'+rows.map(rowFn).join('')+'</tbody></table></div>';
}

/* - pages - */
/* Friday night's board.
   No clock in here: the server decides whether the window is open and sends
   null when it is not, so there is nothing for the reader's own clock — which
   may be in another time zone entirely — to disagree with. */
function tonightBoard(t){
  if(!t||!t.games||!t.games.length) return '';
  var all=t.games.length, done=t.final>=all;
  /* The same gameCard the Scores page draws — crests, records, the AWAY/HOME
     tag, Compare teams. A second way of printing a fixture would be one more
     thing to keep in step with the first, and the reader would have to learn
     both. */
  /* Not wrapped in a card. Scores puts these straight on the page ground, and
     a panel around them would be a second frame the other page does not have -
     the same fixture in two different surrounds is exactly the difference this
     is meant to remove. */
  return '<div class="tonight">'+
    '<div class="tn-hd"><span class="eyebrow">'+
    (done?'Friday night':'Tonight')+(t.label?' &middot; '+esc(t.label):'')+'</span>'+
    '<span class="tn-n">'+t.final+' of '+all+' final</span></div>'+
    '<div class="grid g3">'+t.games.map(gameCard).join('')+'</div>'+
    '<a class="tn-all" href="#/scores">All scores &rarr;</a></div>';
}

// Private summaries never enter svcHome, PUBLIC_READS or browser storage.
function maybeMemberInvite(){
  if(TOKEN||!MEMBER_AUTH_READY||!LAUNCH_CLOSED||document.hidden)return;
  var page=parseHash().page;
  if((page&&page!=='home')||!document.getElementById('home-daily-summary'))return;
  UcbacDailySummary.showInvite(portalA('Create free account','join','signup'),portalA('Log in','signin'));
}
function homeDailySummaryMarkup(){
  if(!TOKEN)return '';
  return (!MEMBER_AUTH_READY||BLITZ_ALLOWED)?UcbacDailySummary.skeleton():'';
}
function resetHomeDailySummary(){
  ++DAILY_EPOCH;
  var mount=document.getElementById('home-daily-summary');
  if(mount){mount._dailyToken='';mount.innerHTML=homeDailySummaryMarkup();}
}
function loadHomeDailySummary(){
  var mount=document.getElementById('home-daily-summary');
  if(!mount||!TOKEN||!BLITZ_ALLOWED)return;
  var token=TOKEN,epoch=DAILY_EPOCH;
  if(mount._dailyToken===token)return;
  mount._dailyToken=token;mount.innerHTML=UcbacDailySummary.skeleton();
  function current(){return mount.isConnected&&document.getElementById('home-daily-summary')===mount&&TOKEN===token&&epoch===DAILY_EPOCH&&BLITZ_ALLOWED&&!document.hidden;}
  routeRequest()('svcDailySummary',[token]).then(function(data){
    if(!current())return;
    mount.innerHTML=UcbacDailySummary.markup(data)||'<p class="notes">Daily stories will appear here when an edition is available.</p>';
  }).catch(function(e){
    if(!current())return;
    if(blitzFailure(e))return;
    mount.innerHTML='<p class="notes">Daily stories could not load. <button type="button" class="daily-summary-more" data-daily-retry>Try again</button></p>';
  });
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  if(!e.target.closest('[data-daily-retry]'))return;
  var mount=document.getElementById('home-daily-summary');if(mount)mount._dailyToken='';loadHomeDailySummary();
});
window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(e){if(e.persisted){clearBlitz();renderWho();}});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){if(document.hidden)resetHomeDailySummary();else if(TOKEN)renderWho();else maybeMemberInvite();});

function pgHome(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  return request('svcHome',[SEASON]).then(function(d){
    /* The standings table follows the season selector, so every year the site
       knows - 2023 included - is reachable right here. A season with nothing
       scored yet falls back to the latest one with results, labeled as such. */
    var stRows=d.standings||[];
    var stSeason=d.standingsSeason||d.resultSeason;
    /* No page title: the tab row already says where the reader is. Every
       public page starts straight on its content for the same reason. */
    var h='';
    /* Top 10 Plays sits first: it is the one thing on Home that asks the
       reader to do something, and the week fills in once the server says
       which one is open. */
    h+='<a class="plays-banner" id="playsBanner" href="#/plays">'+
       '<span class="pb-k">Top 10 Plays of the Week</span>'+
       '<span class="pb-t">Submit your clip <span class="pb-w" id="playsWeek"></span></span>'+
       '<span class="pb-count" id="playsCount"></span>'+
       '<span class="pb-clock" id="playsClock"></span>'+
       '<span class="pb-go">Submit Top Plays &rarr;</span></a>';
    playsBannerWeek();
    /* Friday night's games, under the ask. The server sends this for thirteen
       hours a week and null for the other hundred and fifty-five, so six days
       out of seven this line draws nothing at all. */
    h+=tonightBoard(d.tonight);
    h+='<div id="home-daily-summary">'+homeDailySummaryMarkup()+'</div>';
    // No season eyebrow over the title. Everything below names its own season,
    // and the results and the schedule can be from two different ones - one
    // line above the masthead would be wrong for whichever it did not describe.
    /* Standings and the leaders: the table is what Home is for. The games
       themselves - last week's and next week's - live on Scores. */
    h+=secNav((d.teamLeaders&&d.teamLeaders.length)
      ? [['standings','Standings'],['teamleaders','Team Leaders'],['leaders','Leaders']]
      : [['standings','Standings'],['leaders','Leaders']]);
    /* The full standings live here now - the Standings page folded into Home,
       and old #/standings links land on this card. */
    h+='<div class="card home-section" id="sec-standings" style="margin-top:14px"><div class="home-section-head"><h2>Standings</h2><span class="home-section-season">'+esc(seasonLabel(stSeason))+'</span></div>'+
       tbl('hst',[{t:'#'},{t:'Team'},{t:'Conf W',n:1},{t:'Conf L',n:1},{t:'W',n:1},{t:'L',n:1},
                  {t:'PF',n:1},{t:'PA',n:1},{t:'Diff',n:1},{t:'Pct',n:1}],stRows,
       function(r){return '<tr><td class="n">'+r.rank+moveMark(r)+'</td><td class="nm"><a href="#/team/'+r.teamId+'">'+
         esc(r.team)+'</a></td><td class="n">'+r.cw+'</td><td class="n">'+r.cl+'</td>'+
         '<td class="n">'+r.w+'</td><td class="n">'+r.l+'</td>'+
         '<td class="n">'+(has(r.pf)?r.pf:'')+'</td><td class="n">'+(has(r.pa)?r.pa:'')+'</td>'+
         '<td class="n"'+(has(r.diff)?' style="color:'+(r.diff>=0?'var(--good)':'var(--bad)')+'"':'')+'>'+
         (has(r.diff)?(r.diff>0?'+':'')+r.diff:'')+'</td>'+
         '<td class="n">'+(has(r.pct)?Number(r.pct).toFixed(3):'')+'</td></tr>';})+'</div>';
    /* Nine boards, top three each: what men did on the field, and what they
       weigh, lift and run - under Offense, Defense and Measurables, three
       boards apiece. The server hands each board its own unit and precision,
       so a forty reads 4.52s beside a 315 lb squat.

       Every heading is a door into the Stats page, opened on the same column
       this board ranks - and every label names what it was drawn from,
       because two different things share this card: the stat boards read the
       newest season with results while the measurables read the current
       rosters, and "Passing Yards (2025)" beside "Bench (current players)"
       is the difference said out loud instead of left to be guessed. */
    var board=function(b){
      var rows=b.rows||[];
      var sid=b.seasonId||d.resultSeason;
      var scopeNote=b.measure?'current players':seasonLabel(sid);
      return '<div style="margin-bottom:4px"><a class="eyebrow lbh" href="'+lbHref(b,sid)+
         '" title="Open the full '+esc(b.label)+' table">'+esc(b.label)+
         ' <span class="lbs">('+esc(scopeNote)+')</span></a>'+
        (rows.length
          ? rows.map(function(l){
              var v=(b.dp?Number(l.value).toFixed(b.dp):l.value)+(b.unit||'');
              return '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;padding:3px 0;font-size:14px">'+
                '<span class="muted" style="width:16px;font-family:var(--mono)">'+l.rank+'</span>'+
                '<span style="flex:1;font-weight:600">'+playerLink(l.playerId,l.player,d.resultSeason)+'</span>'+
                '<span class="muted">'+teamLink(l.teamId,l.team)+'</span>'+
                '<b style="font-family:var(--mono)"'+(l.prov?' class="prov"':'')+'>'+esc(v)+'</b></div>';
            }).join('')
          : '<div class="muted" style="font-size:13px;padding:3px 0">Nothing recorded yet.</div>')+
        '</div>';
    };
    /* A school's board: the same six categories, added up by school. No
       measurables - a school does not run a forty, and the fastest roster is
       a question about averages nobody asked. */
    var teamBoard=function(b){
      var rows=b.rows||[];
      var scope=seasonLabel(b.seasonId||d.resultSeason);
      var head=LB_ALLOWED[b.cat]
        ? '<span class="eyebrow">'+esc(b.label)+' <span class="lbs">('+esc(scope)+')</span></span>'
        : '<a class="eyebrow lbh" href="'+lbHref(b,b.seasonId)+
          '" title="Open the full '+esc(b.label)+' table">'+esc(b.label)+
          ' <span class="lbs">('+esc(scope)+')</span></a>';
      return '<div style="margin-bottom:4px">'+head+
        (rows.length
          ? rows.map(function(l){
              var v=(b.dp?Number(l.value).toFixed(b.dp):l.value)+(b.unit||'');
              return '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;padding:3px 0;font-size:14px">'+
                '<span class="muted" style="width:16px;font-family:var(--mono)">'+l.rank+'</span>'+
                '<span style="flex:1;font-weight:600">'+teamLink(l.teamId,l.team)+'</span>'+
                '<b style="font-family:var(--mono)">'+esc(v)+'</b></div>';
            }).join('')
          : '<div class="muted" style="font-size:13px;padding:3px 0">Nothing recorded yet.</div>')+
        '</div>';
    };

    // schools first, then the players inside them
    var tl=leaderBoards(d.teamLeaders);
    if(tl.length){
      h+='<div class="card home-section" id="sec-teamleaders" style="margin-top:26px"><div class="home-section-head"><h2>'+
         '<a class="hdl" href="#/stats" title="Open the full statistics table">Team Statistical Leaders</a>'+
         '</h2></div><div class="pad">';
      leaderGroups(tl).forEach(function(g){
        h+='<h3 class="lbg">'+esc(g.title)+'</h3><div class="grid g3">'+g.boards.map(teamBoard).join('')+'</div>';
      });
      h+='</div></div>';
    }

    h+='<div class="card home-section" id="sec-leaders" style="margin-top:26px"><div class="home-section-head"><h2>'+
       '<a class="hdl" href="#/stats" title="Open the full statistics table">Statistical Leaders</a>'+
       '</h2></div><div class="pad">';
    leaderGroups(leaderBoards(d.leaders)).forEach(function(g){
      h+='<h3 class="lbg">'+esc(g.title)+'</h3><div class="grid g3">'+g.boards.map(board).join('')+'</div>';
    });
    h+='</div></div>';
    render(h); sortable('hst');loadHomeDailySummary();maybeMemberInvite();
    if(r&&r.qs&&r.qs.sec)scrollToSec(r.qs.sec);
  });
}
/* The boards under their side of the ball, in the order the reader expects:
   Offense, Defense, Measurables - the side each board's Stats link opens
   on, so the grouping cannot disagree with where a click leads. A board
   with no known side lands last, under its own heading, rather than lost. */
var LB_GROUPS=[['OFFENSE','Offense'],['DEFENSE','Defense'],
               ['ALLOWED','Defense · Conference Opponents'],['MEASURE','Measurables']];
function leaderGroups(boards){
  var by={},order=[];
  boards.forEach(function(b){
    var m=LB_LINK[b.cat];
    var side=b.measure?'MEASURE':(LB_ALLOWED[b.cat]?'ALLOWED':(m?m[0]:'OTHER'));
    if(!by[side]){by[side]=[];order.push(side);}
    by[side].push(b);
  });
  var out=[];
  LB_GROUPS.forEach(function(g){ if(by[g[0]]) out.push({side:g[0],title:g[1],boards:by[g[0]]}); });
  order.forEach(function(s){ if(!LB_GROUPS.some(function(g){return g[0]===s;})) out.push({side:s,title:'Other',boards:by[s]}); });
  return out;
}
/* The leaders payload has had two shapes: a flat list of ranked rows (one per
   player per category) and, since the nine-board home page, a list of boards
   that already carry their own rows, unit and precision. A deployment can hold
   a new page against an older Api.gs for as long as it takes to paste one file,
   and reading a board as if it were a row prints "undefined" three times over.
   So accept either and hand the renderer boards. */
/* Where each home board leads: the Stats page, opened on the side and column
   this board ranks. The 40 carries dir=ASC because lower is better and the
   query's default direction is DESC - without it the link would open on the
   slowest men in the conference. A board from a season other than the one in
   the header picker pins its season into the link, so the table that opens
   shows the numbers the reader just clicked. */
var LB_LINK={PassYds:['OFFENSE','PassYds'],RushYds:['OFFENSE','RushYds'],
             RecYds:['OFFENSE','RecYds'],Tackles:['DEFENSE','TacklesTotal'],
             Sacks:['DEFENSE','Sacks'],Int:['DEFENSE','Int'],
             Forty:['MEASURE','Forty','ASC'],Bench:['MEASURE','Bench'],
             Squat:['MEASURE','Squat']};
/* The allowed boards are grouped but not linked: the Stats page ranks what a
   team DID, and there is no column there for what its opponents did. A heading
   that opened the wrong table would be worse than a heading that opens
   nothing. Their home is the team's own Stats tab, under Allowed. */
var LB_ALLOWED={TotYdsAll:1,RushYdsAll:1,PassYdsAll:1,RushTDAll:1,PassTDAll:1,YPCAll:1,YPAAll:1};
function lbHref(b,sid){
  var m=LB_LINK[b.cat];
  if(!m)return '#/stats';
  var h='#/stats?side='+m[0]+'&sort='+m[1]+(m[2]?'&dir='+m[2]:'');
  if(sid&&sid!==SEASON)h+='&season='+encodeURIComponent(sid);
  return h;
}
function leaderBoards(list){
  var src=list||[];if(!src.length)return [];
  if(src[0]&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(src[0],'rows'))return src;
  var order=[],by={};
  src.forEach(function(l){
    var c=l.cat||l.label||'';
    if(!by[c]){by[c]={cat:c,label:l.label||c,unit:'',dp:0,rows:[]};order.push(c);}
    by[c].rows.push(l);});
  return order.map(function(c){
    var b=by[c];
    b.rows=b.rows.sort(function(a,z){return (a.rank||0)-(z.rank||0);}).slice(0,3);
    return b;});
}
/* This app is one wing of UCBACstats.com, not a separate address. Where a Site
   is configured, name it and offer the way back.

   target="_top" matters: the base target is _self, and this document is a frame
   inside the Apps Script sandbox, so a plain link would try to open the whole
   Site inside the frame it is already boxed into. */
function siteLinks(){
  var u=(typeof SITE_URL==='string'?SITE_URL:'');
  if(!/^https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+$/i.test(u))return;
  var host=u.replace(/^https?:\/\//i,'').replace(/^www\./i,'').replace(/\/+$/,'');
  var el=document.getElementById('footSite');
  if(el)el.innerHTML='<a href="'+esc(u)+'" target="_top" rel="noopener">&#8592; Back to '+esc(host)+'</a>';
}
function seasonLabel(id){
  id=id||SEASON||'';
  var s=((BOOT&&BOOT.seasons)||[]).filter(function(x){return x.id===id;})[0];
  var year=String(id).match(/\d{4}/);
  return s?s.label:(year?year[0]:id);
}

function pgScores(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var wk=r.qs.week;
  return Promise.all([request('svcScores',[SEASON,'']),request('svcWeeks',[SEASON])]).then(function(o){
    var games=o[0],weeks=o[1];
    function keyOf(g){return (g.playoff?'R':'W')+g.week;}
    /* No week on the link means "this week": the latest period with a result
       in the season being viewed, else the first one on the schedule. The All
       chip is still one tap away at ?week=all. */
    if(wk===undefined||wk===''){
      var played={};games.forEach(function(g){if(has(g.hs))played[keyOf(g)]=1;});
      var def='';
      weeks.forEach(function(w){if(played[w.key])def=w.key;});
      wk=def||(weeks.length?weeks[0].key:'all');
    }
    var showAll=String(wk).toLowerCase()==='all';
    var list=showAll?games:games.filter(function(g){return keyOf(g)===String(wk);});
    var h='<div class="chips"><button type="button" data-w="all" class="'+(showAll?'on':'')+'">All</button>'+
       weeks.map(function(w){
         return '<button type="button" data-w="'+esc(w.key)+'" class="'+(!showAll&&String(w.key)===String(wk)?'on':'')+
           '" title="'+esc(w.label)+'">'+esc(w.playoff?w.label:('Wk '+w.key.slice(1)))+'</button>';
       }).join('')+'</div>';
    h+= list.length?('<div class="grid g3">'+list.map(gameCard).join('')+'</div>')
                   :emptySeason('No games on the schedule for '+seasonLabel(SEASON)+' yet.');
    render(h);
    document.querySelectorAll('.chips button').forEach(function(b){
      b.onclick=function(){location.hash='#/scores?week='+b.dataset.w;};});
  });
}

/* Old #/portal links: carry them to the portal page in THIS tab. Google's
   sandbox will not render one Apps Script app inside another's iframe, so the
   portal is its own page wearing the site's header - same tab both ways. */
function pgPortal(){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var p=portalHref();
  if(!p){
    render('<div class="err">The portal address is not configured yet. An administrator '+
           'should run Check sign-in from the sheet.</div>');
    return Promise.resolve();
  }
  try{ window.top.location.href=p; }catch(e){}
  render('<div class="card pad">Opening the portal... '+portalA('Continue')+'</div>');
  return Promise.resolve();
}

/* A program's playoff history, from the bootstrap. A school's own page shows
   it; the index of schools does not - fifteen tiles of trophies buries the
   one thing that page is for, which is getting to a school. The years are the
   record and the counts are read off them, so the two can never disagree. */
function postOf(teamId){
  var m=BOOT&&BOOT.postseason,p=m&&m[teamId];
  return (p&&((p.sc&&p.sc.length)||(p.sf&&p.sf.length)||(p.rf&&p.rf.length)))?p:null;
}
function postWindows(){
  return (BOOT&&BOOT.postseasonWindows)||{semi:'1974-2025',regional:'2003-2018'};
}

function pgTeams(){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var h='<div class="grid g4">';
  h+=BOOT.teams.map(function(t){
    return '<a class="tile" href="#/team/'+t.id+'" style="--team-color:'+esc(t.color)+'">'+
      (t.logo?'<img src="'+esc(t.logo)+'" width="48" height="48" loading="lazy" alt="'+esc(t.name)+' logo">':'')+
      '<div><b>'+esc(t.name)+tvMark(t.id)+'</b><span>'+esc(t.mascot)+' · '+esc(t.county)+' · '+esc(t.cls)+'</span>'+
      '</div></a>';}).join('');
  render(h+'</div>');
  return Promise.resolve();
}

function pgTeam(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var t=team(r.id);
  return request('svcTeam',[r.id,SEASON]).then(function(d){
    if(!d){render('<div class="err">Team not found.</div>');return;}
    var st=d.standing;
    // the team read carries the playoff history; the bootstrap carries it too,
    // which covers a cached payload from before this shipped
    var ps=d.postseason||postOf(r.id);
    var h=teamStrip(r.id);
    h+='<div class="thead" style="background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(7,9,19,.84),rgba(7,9,19,.58)),linear-gradient(135deg,'+esc(t.color)+' 0%,'+esc(shade(t.color))+' 100%)">'+
      (t.logo?'<img src="'+esc(t.logo)+'" width="80" height="80" alt="'+esc(t.name)+' logo">':'')+
      '<div><h1>'+rankMark(r.id)+esc(t.name)+' '+esc(t.mascot)+tvMark(r.id)+'</h1>'+
      '<div class="sub">'+esc(t.city)+', MD · '+esc(t.county)+' County · '+esc(t.cls)+
      (has(t.headCoach)?' · HC <a href="#/coach/'+esc(r.id)+'">'+esc(t.headCoach)+'</a>':'')+
      (has(t.stadium)?' · '+esc(t.stadium):'')+'</div>'+
      recordsLine(st,d.coachRecord,d.allTime,ps)+shareBtn('team',r.id,'Share team')+'</div>'+
      '</div>';
    TEAMPG={id:r.id,standing:d.standing||{}};
    HISTORY={rows:d.history||[],allTime:d.allTime,team:t.name};
    POST={p:ps,team:t.name};
    /* the program's staff, under the hero: the head coach's name opens his
       page, assistants stand beside him by name */
    if(d.staff&&(d.staff.head||d.staff.assistants.length))
      h+='<div class="sub" style="margin:2px 2px 8px">Coaching staff: '+
         (d.staff.head?'<a href="#/coach/'+esc(r.id)+'">'+esc(d.staff.head)+'</a> (HC)':'')+
         (d.staff.assistants.length?(d.staff.head?' · ':'')+d.staff.assistants.map(function(n){
            return '<a href="#/coach/'+esc(r.id)+'">'+esc(n)+'</a>';}).join(' · '):'')+
         '</div>';
    h+=teamLinks(t);
    /* No History tab: the season records live behind the all-time record in
       the header now, which is where a reader asks the question.

       The tab a reader chose survives the move to the next team. Comparing
       two rosters means visiting two teams, and re-picking Roster on arrival
       every time made the strip above almost unusable for the one job it
       exists for. */
    if(TEAM_TABS.indexOf(TEAM_TAB)<0) TEAM_TAB=TEAM_TABS[0];
    h+='<div class="tabs" id="tt" role="tablist" aria-label="Team details">'+TEAM_TABS.map(function(k){
      var on=k===TEAM_TAB;
      return '<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(on?'true':'false')+'" class="'+(on?'on':'')+'" id="team-tab-'+k+'" aria-controls="tp" data-t="'+k+'">'+
        esc(k.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+k.slice(1))+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div>';
    h+='<div id="tp" role="tabpanel"></div>';
    render(h);

    var panes={};
    panes.schedule = d.games.length?('<div class="grid g3" style="margin-top:12px">'+d.games.map(gameCard).join('')+'</div>')
      :emptySeason('No games for '+seasonLabel(SEASON)+'.');

    /* The whole roster board: identity, then every measurable the schema
       carries, then where he is going. Each header sorts (blanks last), and
       each number cell carries data-v so the sort is numeric — a height reads
       6'1" and sorts as 73. */
    panes.roster = d.roster.length? tbl('rt',
      [{t:'#',n:1},{t:'Player'},{t:'Grad',n:1},{t:'Positions'},
       {t:'Ht',n:1},{t:'Wt',n:1},{t:'GPA',n:1},{t:'40',n:1},{t:'Bench',n:1},
       {t:'Squat',n:1},{t:'Clean',n:1},{t:'Vert',n:1},{t:'Shuttle',n:1},
       {t:'Commit'},{t:'Level'}],d.roster,function(p){
        function numCell(v,dp){
          return has(v)?'<td class="n" data-v="'+v+'">'+(dp?Number(v).toFixed(dp):v)+'</td>'
                       :'<td class="n"></td>';
        }
        return '<tr><td class="n"'+(has(p.jersey)?' data-v="'+esc(p.jersey)+'"':'')+'>'+
          esc(p.jersey)+'</td>'+
          '<td class="nm">'+playerLink(p.playerId,p.name,SEASON)+
          (p.captain&&!isCap(p.playerId,SEASON)?' <span class="cap" title="Team captain">C</span>':'')+'</td>'+
          '<td class="n">'+esc(p.grad)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.pos)+'</td>'+
          (has(p.ht)?'<td class="n" data-v="'+p.ht+'">'+Math.floor(p.ht/12)+"'"+(p.ht%12)+'"</td>'
                    :'<td class="n"></td>')+
          numCell(p.wt)+numCell(p.gpa,2)+numCell(p.forty,2)+numCell(p.bench)+
          numCell(p.squat)+numCell(p.clean)+numCell(p.vertical,1)+numCell(p.shuttle,2)+
          '<td>'+esc(p.commitment)+'</td><td>'+esc(p.commitLevel)+'</td></tr>';})
      :emptySeason('No roster recorded for '+seasonLabel(SEASON)+'.');

    /* Every column the conference records, and only the ones somebody here has
       a number in, so a lineman whose whole line is tackles for loss is not
       hidden behind a filter that never asked. */
    /* built on every show, not once: the Players/Team switch and the phase
       filter both change what this pane is, and a string baked before the first
       click cannot. The tables are rebuilt rather than hidden because which
       columns carry a number depends on the phase being asked about. */
    panes.stats = function(){
      var playerStats = playerStatsTable(d.stats) ||
        (STAT_PHASE==='all'
          ? emptySeason('No statistics recorded for '+seasonLabel(SEASON)+'.')
          : phaseEmpty());
      return statsSwitch(playerStats, teamStatsTable(d.teamStats), allowedTable(d.allowed));
    };

    function show(k){
      TEAM_TAB=k;
      var pane=panes[k];
      var target=document.getElementById('tp'), y=window.scrollY||0;
      target.style.minHeight=Math.max(0,Math.min(target.offsetHeight,window.innerHeight))+'px';
      target.innerHTML=(typeof pane==='function')?pane():pane;
      target.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','team-tab-'+k);
      window.scrollTo(0,y);
      sortable('rt');sortable('st');
      // the Players/Team switch and the phase filter each redraw this pane
      document.querySelectorAll('#sv button').forEach(function(b){
        b.onclick=function(){ TEAM_STATS_VIEW=b.dataset.sv; show('stats'); };
      });
      bindPhase(function(){ show('stats'); });
    }
    show(TEAM_TAB);
    document.querySelectorAll('#tt button').forEach(function(b){
      b.onclick=function(){
        document.querySelectorAll('#tt button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on');});
        document.querySelectorAll('#tt button').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');});
        b.classList.add('on');b.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');show(b.dataset.t);};});
  });
}
/* Which team tab the reader is on, kept across teams for the session. In
   memory, not storage: it follows a train of thought, and a tab chosen days
   ago should not decide what a new visit opens on. */
var TEAM_TABS=['schedule','roster','stats'];
var TEAM_TAB=TEAM_TABS[0];
/* and which half of the Stats tab, kept the same way */
var TEAM_STATS_VIEW='players';

/* Players or the school, over whichever table the reader asked for. The
   switch is only drawn when there is a school line to switch to - a season
   nobody has entered has one empty table, not two. */
function statsSwitch(playerHtml, teamHtml, allowedHtml){
  var opts=[['players','Players'],['team','Team']];
  if(allowedHtml) opts.push(['allowed','Allowed']);
  var seg=teamHtml?('<div class="seg" id="sv" role="tablist" aria-label="Rows" '+
    'style="margin:12px 0 2px">'+
    opts.map(function(x){
      var on=x[0]===TEAM_STATS_VIEW;
      return '<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(on?'true':'false')+'"'+
        (on?' class="on"':'')+' data-sv="'+x[0]+'">'+x[1]+'</button>';
    }).join('')+'</div>'):'';
  /* Two questions, so two controls: WHOSE rows, and WHICH phase. They are
     independent — a reader can want the school's defense — so they are never
     folded into one row of six buttons where half the combinations are unsayable. */
  var body=playerHtml;
  if(teamHtml&&TEAM_STATS_VIEW==='team') body=teamHtml;
  else if(allowedHtml&&TEAM_STATS_VIEW==='allowed') body=allowedHtml;
  return '<div class="segs">'+seg+phaseSwitch('sp')+'</div>'+body;
}

/* Every column the conference records, in the order a box score reads them.
   `sum` is a column with no cell of its own in the database - tackles are
   solo plus assisted - and `dp` is how many decimals a figure carries.

   Both tables on the Stats tab are built from this one list, so a punter's
   yards and a kicker's extra points appear on a school's page rather than
   the handful of columns chosen years ago. A column no row has a number in
   is dropped: fifteen schools do not all field a kicker, and six empty
   kicking columns say nothing about the ones that do. */
/* `ph` is the phase a column belongs to — off, def or st — and it is what the
   Offense/Defense filter reads. Thirty-six columns is the whole box score and
   more than anyone reads at once; a coach looking at his secondary should not
   pan past pass attempts and punt yards to reach interceptions.
   Special teams is its own phase rather than being split between the other
   two, because a kicker belongs to neither and hiding him behind "offense"
   would be a guess about a phase the conference records separately. */
var TEAM_STAT_FIELDS=[
  {f:'PassAtt',label:'Pass Att',ph:'off'},{f:'PassComp',label:'Comp',ph:'off'},
  {f:'PassYds',label:'Pass Yds',ph:'off'},
  {f:'PassTD',label:'Pass TD',ph:'off'},{f:'PassInt',label:'INT Thr',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RushAtt',label:'Car',ph:'off'},{f:'RushYds',label:'Rush Yds',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RushTD',label:'Rush TD',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RushFum',label:'Rush Fum',ph:'off'},
  {f:'Rec',label:'Rec',ph:'off'},{f:'RecYds',label:'Rec Yds',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RecTD',label:'Rec TD',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RecFum',label:'Rec Fum',ph:'off'},
  {f:'Pancakes',label:'Pancakes',ph:'off'},
  {f:'TackleSolo',label:'Solo',ph:'def'},{f:'TackleAssist',label:'Ast',ph:'def'},
  {f:'Tackles',label:'Tkl',sum:['TackleSolo','TackleAssist'],ph:'def'},
  {f:'TFL',label:'TFL',dp:1,ph:'def'},{f:'Sacks',label:'Sacks',dp:1,ph:'def'},
  {f:'Int',label:'INT',ph:'def'},
  {f:'PassDef',label:'PD',ph:'def'},{f:'FF',label:'FF',ph:'def'},
  {f:'FR',label:'FR',ph:'def'},{f:'DefTD',label:'Def TD',ph:'def'},
  {f:'FGM',label:'FGM',ph:'st'},{f:'FGA',label:'FGA',ph:'st'},
  {f:'XPM',label:'XPM',ph:'st'},{f:'XPA',label:'XPA',ph:'st'},
  {f:'Punts',label:'Punts',ph:'st'},{f:'PuntYds',label:'Punt Yds',ph:'st'},
  {f:'KR',label:'KR',ph:'st'},{f:'KRYds',label:'KR Yds',ph:'st'},
  {f:'PR',label:'PR',ph:'st'},{f:'PRYds',label:'PR Yds',ph:'st'},
  {f:'Blocks',label:'Blk',ph:'st'},
  /* Quarterback rating, on the 0–158.3 scale MaxPreps prints as "QB Rate" —
     which is the NFL formula, not NCAA efficiency. Both are real ratings and
     they disagree loudly: J. Lucas going 7 of 15 for 126 and a touchdown is
     98.2 one way and 139.2 the other. Coaches read MaxPreps, so this column is
     the number they already have; the Stats page carries NCAA efficiency beside
     it under its own name.
     Repeated here rather than read off the server because these rows carry
     summed atoms, not a computed line. No attempts means no rating, never a
     zero one, so tsCols() drops the column from a table with no passer in it. */
  {f:'QBRating',label:'QB Rtg',dp:1,ph:'off',calc:function(b){
    var att=Number(b.PassAtt||0);
    if(!att) return null;
    var cl=function(v){return Math.max(0,Math.min(2.375,v));};
    return (cl((Number(b.PassComp||0)/att-.3)*5)+cl((Number(b.PassYds||0)/att-3)*.25)
           +cl((Number(b.PassTD||0)/att)*20)+cl(2.375-(Number(b.PassInt||0)/att)*25))/6*100;
  }}
];
/* The same numbers read from the other end of the field.

   A defence's passing yards allowed ARE the opponent's passing yards, so this
   list is the offensive one relabelled — with one distinction that matters:
   an interception the opponent THREW is not something this defence allowed, it
   is something it took, and a fumble the opponent lost is the same. Calling
   those "allowed" would rank a good defence last. So they are labelled as
   forced, and they are the only two columns here where more is better.

   Special teams the opponent gained against you belongs here too: a kick
   return is yardage your coverage gave up. */
var TEAM_ALLOWED_FIELDS=[
  {f:'PassAtt',label:'Pass Att',ph:'off'},{f:'PassComp',label:'Comp All',ph:'off'},
  {f:'PassYds',label:'Pass Yds All',ph:'off'},{f:'PassTD',label:'Pass TD All',ph:'off'},
  {f:'PassInt',label:'INT Forced',ph:'def',good:1},
  {f:'RushAtt',label:'Car',ph:'off'},{f:'RushYds',label:'Rush Yds All',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RushTD',label:'Rush TD All',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RushFum',label:'Rush Fum Forced',ph:'def',good:1},
  {f:'Rec',label:'Rec All',ph:'off'},{f:'RecYds',label:'Rec Yds All',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RecTD',label:'Rec TD All',ph:'off'},
  {f:'RecFum',label:'Rec Fum Forced',ph:'def',good:1},
  {f:'ScrimYds',label:'Total Yds All',ph:'off',sum:['RushYds','RecYds']},
  /* Sacks and tackles for loss a team GAVE UP. They sit in the opponent's
     defensive column, but they describe this team's offensive line, not its
     defence — which is why they are phase 'off' here. */
  {f:'Sacks',label:'Sacks All',ph:'off'},{f:'TFL',label:'TFL All',ph:'off'},
  {f:'FGM',label:'FG All',ph:'st'},{f:'XPM',label:'XP All',ph:'st'},
  {f:'KR',label:'KR All',ph:'st'},{f:'KRYds',label:'KR Yds All',ph:'st'},
  {f:'PR',label:'PR All',ph:'st'},{f:'PRYds',label:'PR Yds All',ph:'st'},
  {f:'Blocks',label:'Blk Against',ph:'st'}
];
/* Which list a table is drawn from. tsCols() reads it rather than taking a
   parameter, because it is called from four places and every one of them wants
   whichever list the current view is showing. */
var TS_FIELDS=null;
function tsFieldList(){ return TS_FIELDS || TEAM_STAT_FIELDS; }

/* One field out of one row's bag, with a derived column added up. */
function tsVal(bag,c){
  if(!bag) return null;
  if(c.calc){ var d=c.calc(bag); return (d===null||isNaN(d))?null:d; }
  if(c.sum){
    var any=false,t=0;
    c.sum.forEach(function(k){ if(bag[k]!==undefined&&bag[k]!==null){any=true;t+=Number(bag[k]);} });
    return any?t:null;
  }
  var v=bag[c.f];
  return (v===undefined||v==='')?null:Number(v);
}
/* Which phase the reader asked for, kept across teams and players for the
   session the way the Players/Team switch is: a coach comparing two secondaries
   should not have to pick Defense again on every page. In memory, not storage —
   it follows a train of thought, not a preference. */
var STAT_PHASE='all';
var STAT_PHASES=[['all','All'],['off','Offense'],['def','Defense'],['st','Special']];

/* The columns any of these rows actually has a number in, within the phase
   asked for. A column filtered out of the phase is not "empty" - it is not
   being asked about - so the emptiness test runs after the phase, never before.

   A column of nothing but zeroes is empty too. It used to survive, because a
   zero is a number: a school that has never attempted a field goal carried FGM
   and FGA columns of noughts all the way across. Nought attempts is not a
   documented statistic, it is the absence of one.

   Only a column that is zero for EVERY row goes. An individual zero stays put
   beside somebody else's number, which is what makes a kicker's 0 legible next
   to another's 2. A team whose only kicker went nought for one therefore shows
   FGA and not FGM — one attempt is the fact, and a column of one nought says
   nothing the FGA does not. */
function tsCols(bags){
  return tsFieldList().filter(function(c){
    if(STAT_PHASE!=='all'&&c.ph!==STAT_PHASE) return false;
    return bags.some(function(b){
      var v=tsVal(b,c); return v!==null&&!isNaN(v)&&Number(v)!==0;
    });
  });
}

/* The phase control. Rendered wherever a stat table is, and every one of them
   reads the same STAT_PHASE, so the answer to "show me defense" is the same on
   a team page and on a player's. */
function phaseSwitch(id){
  return '<div class="seg" id="'+id+'" role="tablist" aria-label="Phase" '+
    'style="margin:12px 0 2px">'+STAT_PHASES.map(function(x){
      var on=x[0]===STAT_PHASE;
      return '<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(on?'true':'false')+'"'+
        (on?' class="on"':'')+' data-ph="'+x[0]+'">'+x[1]+'</button>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
}
/* Bind every phase control on the page to one redraw. The caller says how to
   redraw itself, because a team page swaps a tab pane and a player page
   re-renders the whole profile. */
function bindPhase(redraw){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ph]').forEach(function(b){
    b.onclick=function(){ STAT_PHASE=b.dataset.ph; redraw(); };
  });
}
/* A phase with nothing in it is a real answer, not a broken table: a lineman
   asked for his passing has none, and an empty table with headings would look
   like a fault. */
function phaseEmpty(){
  var lbl=STAT_PHASES.filter(function(x){return x[0]===STAT_PHASE;})[0];
  return '<div class="card pad muted" style="margin-top:10px">No '+
    (lbl?lbl[1].toLowerCase():'')+' statistics recorded.</div>';
}
/* A figure as printed: blank when there is none, and a decimal column shown
   to its places without a trailing nought - 2, not 2.0. */
function tsText(v,c){
  return (v===null||v===undefined||isNaN(v))?'':(c.dp?String(Number(Number(v).toFixed(c.dp))):String(v));
}
function tsCell(v,c,bold){
  var txt=tsText(v,c);
  return '<td class="n" data-v="'+(v===null||v===undefined||isNaN(v)?0:v)+'">'+(bold?'<b>'+txt+'</b>':txt)+'</td>';
}

/* The school's own line, week by week, and the season it adds up to. The
   columns are the ones on the players' table, so a reader can hold the two
   against each other; the result carries the score, which is the one thing a
   team row has that a player's has not. Not sortable: these rows are in the
   order the season was played, and a total belongs under its games. */
function teamStatsTable(ts){
  if(!ts||!ts.games||!ts.games.length) return '';
  var bags=ts.games.map(function(r){return r.stats;}).concat([ts.season]);
  var cols=tsCols(bags);
  var head=[{t:'Game'},{t:'Result'}].concat(cols.map(function(c){return {t:c.label,n:1};}));
  var rows=ts.games.map(function(r){return {game:r};});
  rows.push({total:true});
  return tbl('tst',head,rows,function(x){
    if(x.total)
      return '<tr class="tot"><td class="nm"><b>Season</b></td>'+
        '<td>'+((ts.pf||ts.pa)?esc(ts.pf+'-'+ts.pa):'')+'</td>'+
        cols.map(function(c){return tsCell(tsVal(ts.season,c),c,true);}).join('')+'</tr>';
    var r=x.game;
    var when=has(r.week)?('Week '+r.week):'Game';
    return '<tr><td class="nm">'+esc(when)+' <span class="muted">'+
      esc((r.isHome?'vs ':'at ')+(r.opp||''))+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+(r.result?esc(r.result+' '+r.pf+'-'+r.pa):'')+'</td>'+
      cols.map(function(c){return tsCell(tsVal(r.stats,c),c,false);}).join('')+'</tr>';
  });
}

/* What the defence gave up, in the same table shape, drawn from the other
   side's box score.

   The caveat is not a footnote here, it is the number's definition: only
   conference games can be counted, so the games behind the total are named and
   so are the ones left out. A reader comparing two schools must divide by the
   games each figure is built from, not by games played — the header says so
   rather than leaving it to be worked out. */
function allowedTable(al){
  if(!al) return '';
  var body='';
  if(al.games&&al.games.length){
    TS_FIELDS=TEAM_ALLOWED_FIELDS;
    try{ body=teamStatsTable(al); } finally { TS_FIELDS=null; }
  }
  var note='<div class="notes" style="margin:10px 2px 0">'
    + '<b>Conference games only.</b> These are the opponent\u2019s own numbers, so they '
    + 'exist only where we hold the opponent\u2019s line. '
    + (al.gp ? 'Built from '+al.gp+' game'+(al.gp===1?'':'s')+' \u2014 divide by that, not by games played.'
             : 'No conference game has both lines in yet.');
  if(al.skipped&&al.skipped.length)
    note+='<br>Not counted: '+al.skipped.map(function(x){
      return esc((has(x.week)?'Week '+x.week+' ':'')+(x.opp||''))+' <span class="muted">('+esc(x.why)+')</span>';
    }).join(' \u00b7 ');
  note+='</div>';
  return body ? (body+note)
              : ('<div class="card pad muted" style="margin-top:10px">Nothing to show yet.</div>'+note);
}

/* A line's numbers, whatever shape the server sent them in.
   The bag keyed by column name is new; a deployment can hold a new page
   against an older Api.gs for as long as it takes to paste one file, and a
   page that read only the bag would show every school an empty Stats tab
   for that hour. So the older named fields are folded into a bag here. */
function tsBagOf(r){
  if(r.stats) return r.stats;
  var legacy={PassYds:r.passYds,PassTD:r.passTD,PassInt:r.passInt,RushAtt:r.rushAtt,
              RushYds:r.rushYds,RushTD:r.rushTD,Rec:r.rec,RecYds:r.recYds,RecTD:r.recTD,
              TackleSolo:r.solo,TackleAssist:r.asst,TFL:r.tfl,Sacks:r.sacks,Int:r.int};
  var bag={};
  Object.keys(legacy).forEach(function(k){
    if(legacy[k]!==null&&legacy[k]!==undefined&&legacy[k]!=='') bag[k]=Number(legacy[k]);
  });
  return bag;
}

/* The roster's own lines, in the same columns. A player whose whole season
   is four punts is on this table now; before, punting had no column and he
   was simply absent from his own school's page. */
function playerStatsTable(rows){
  var live=(rows||[]).map(function(r){
    return { row:r, bag:tsBagOf(r) };
  }).filter(function(x){
    return Object.keys(x.bag).some(function(k){return Number(x.bag[k])!==0;});
  });
  if(!live.length) return '';
  var cols=tsCols(live.map(function(x){return x.bag;}));
  var head=[{t:'Player'},{t:'GP',n:1}].concat(cols.map(function(c){return {t:c.label,n:1};}));
  return tbl('st',head,live,function(x){
    var p=x.row;
    return '<tr><td class="nm">'+playerLink(p.playerId,p.name)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="n" data-v="'+(p.gp||0)+'">'+n(p.gp)+'</td>'+
      cols.map(function(c){return tsCell(tsVal(x.bag,c),c,false);}).join('')+'</tr>';
  });
}

/* The all-time record, under the team's own line: "118-121 (49%)", and the
   seasons behind it are one click away rather than crowded into the header.
   Ties are worth half a win, the way football counts. */
function recStr(w,l,t){ return w+'-'+l+(t?'-'+t:''); }
function pctWhole(p){ return p===null||p===undefined?'':Math.round(p*100)+'%'; }
var HISTORY=null,POST=null;
/* Three records, each said out loud: this season, this coach, all of it.
   They used to be two - an unlabelled number in the corner and a bare
   all-time line - which left a reader to guess which span each covered.

   Any of the three can be missing and the row simply carries the rest: a
   season with no games yet has no record, and a coach whose start year
   nobody has published cannot have a tenure computed without inventing one. */
function recItem(key,val,extra,attrs){
  return '<div class="tr"'+(attrs||'')+'><span class="tr-k">'+esc(key)+'</span>'+
    '<b>'+esc(val)+'</b>'+(extra?'<span class="tr-x">'+esc(extra)+'</span>':'')+'</div>';
}
/* One postseason figure in the header strip: the count, the years under it
   where they fit, and every year on hover or on a press. */
function postItem(label,years,foot){
  return '<div class="tr"><span class="tr-k">'+esc(label)+'</span>'+
    '<button type="button" data-post="1" title="'+esc(years.join(', '))+'">'+years.length+'</button>'+
    (foot?'<span class="tr-x">'+esc(foot)+'</span>':'')+'</div>';
}
function recordsLine(st,cr,at,p){
  var out=[];
  if(st&&(st.w||st.l||st.t))
    out.push(recItem(seasonLabel(SEASON),recStr(st.w,st.l,st.t||0),
                     has(st.cw)?recStr(st.cw,st.cl,0)+' UCBAC':''));
  if(cr&&cr.seasons)
    out.push(recItem(cr.name,recStr(cr.w,cr.l,cr.t)+' ('+pctWhole(cr.pct)+')',
                     'since '+cr.since));
  if(at&&at.seasons)
    out.push('<div class="tr"><span class="tr-k">All-time</span>'+
      '<button type="button" data-hist="1">'+esc(recStr(at.w,at.l,at.t))+
      ' ('+esc(pctWhole(at.pct))+')</button>'+
      '<span class="tr-x">every season</span></div>');
  /* The playoffs, beside the records rather than buried under a tab. State
     titles print their years outright — there are never many, and they are
     the thing a reader came for. The other two are a count and nothing else;
     the years are a hover or a press away, and the span each round covers is
     stated in the dialog, where there is room to say it properly. */
  if(p){
    if(p.sc.length) out.push(postItem('State champs',p.sc,p.sc.join(', ')));
    if(p.sf.length) out.push(postItem('State semifinals',p.sf,''));
    if(p.rf.length) out.push(postItem('Regional finals',p.rf,''));
  }
  return out.length?'<div class="trec">'+out.join('')+'</div>':'';
}
/* Every year, all three rounds, and what each column does and does not
   cover — a zero regional is not a claim that a school never won one. */
function postseasonPane(p,team){
  var w=postWindows(),h='';
  var block=function(title,years,note){
    if(!years.length) return '';
    return '<div style="margin-bottom:14px"><b>'+esc(title)+' ('+years.length+')</b>'+
      '<div style="margin-top:4px">'+esc(years.join(', '))+'</div>'+
      '<div class="muted" style="margin-top:3px;font-size:12px">'+esc(note)+'</div></div>';
  };
  h+=block('State championships',p.sc,'The title game won.');
  h+=block('State semifinal wins',p.sf,
           'The semifinal won, which is to say '+team+' reached the state final. '+
           'Every championship is also a semifinal win. Covers '+w.semi+'.');
  h+=block('Regional final wins',p.rf,
           'The regional championship game won, '+w.regional+' — the years the MPSSAA '+
           'record book covers that round. A blank here is not a claim that a school '+
           'never took a regional title of another kind.');
  if(p.note) h+='<div class="muted" style="font-size:12px">'+esc(p.note)+'</div>';
  return '<div class="card pad">'+h+'</div>';
}
function openPostseason(){
  if(!POST||!POST.p) return;
  openDialog(POST.team+' — postseason',postseasonPane(POST.p,POST.team));
}
/* An unbeaten season is 1.000, not .000 - Elkton went 13-0 in 2000, and
   three digits after a bare dot cannot hold the thousandth. */
function pctStr(p){
  if(p===null||p===undefined) return '';
  var n=Math.round(p*1000);
  return n>=1000?'1.000':('.'+('00'+n).slice(-3));
}
/* Season by season, newest first. A season nobody has established reads as a
   dash rather than a zero - the program played it, we just cannot say how. */
function historyPane(rows,allTime){
  if(!rows||!rows.length) return '<div class="card pad muted">No season records on file.</div>';
  var body=rows.map(function(r){
    var lab = r.status==='NA' ? 'no varsity team'
            : r.status==='CANCELLED' ? 'season not played'
            : r.status==='VERIFIED' ? recStr(r.w,r.l,r.t) : '—';
    var g=(r.w||0)+(r.l||0)+(r.t||0);
    var pct=r.status==='VERIFIED'&&g?pctStr((r.w+0.5*(r.t||0))/g):'';
    var muted=r.status!=='VERIFIED';
    return '<tr'+(muted?' class="muted"':'')+'><td class="n">'+r.year+'</td>'+
      '<td class="n"'+(r.status==='VERIFIED'?' data-v="'+(r.w||0)+'"':'')+'>'+esc(lab)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="n">'+esc(pct)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="src">'+esc(r.status==='VERIFIED'?(r.source||''):
        r.status==='UNVERIFIED'?'not yet verified':'')+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('');
  var head='<div class="card"><div class="tw" role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label="Season records">'+
    '<table id="hy"><thead><tr><th class="n">Season</th><th class="n">Record</th>'+
    '<th class="n">Pct</th><th>Source</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+body+'</tbody></table></div></div>';
  var notes=[];
  if(allTime&&allTime.seasons)
    notes.push('All-time '+recStr(allTime.w,allTime.l,allTime.t)+' ('+pctStr(allTime.pct)+
               ') from '+allTime.seasons+' of '+allTime.played+' seasons played.');
  if(allTime&&allTime.unknown)
    notes.push(allTime.unknown+' season'+(allTime.unknown===1?'':'s')+
               ' on file without an established record; those are left out of the total.');
  notes.push('Records are overall varsity records, postseason included.');
  return head+'<div class="notes">'+notes.map(function(t){return '· '+esc(t);}).join('<br>')+'</div>';
}

/* The one dialog: built when it is asked for and thrown away on close, so
   nothing lingers behind the page it belongs to. One at a time - opening
   another closes the first. The title is plain text; the body is markup. */
var DLG_OPENER=null;
function openDialog(title,body){
  closeDialog();
  DLG_OPENER=document.activeElement;
  var d=document.createElement('div');
  d.className='mdl'; d.id='mdl';
  d.setAttribute('role','dialog'); d.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  d.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','mdlt');
  d.innerHTML='<div class="mdl-b" data-close="1"></div><div class="mdl-c">'+
    '<div class="mdl-h"><h2 id="mdlt">'+esc(title)+'</h2>'+
    '<button type="button" class="mdl-x" data-close="1" aria-label="Close">&#215;</button></div>'+
    '<div class="mdl-s">'+body+'</div></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(d);
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  var x=d.querySelector('.mdl-x'); if(x)x.focus();
  return d;
}
function closeDialog(){
  var d=document.getElementById('mdl');
  if(!d)return;
  if(d===BLITZ_DIALOG){BLITZ_DIALOG=null;CARD.busy=false;++CARD_DRAW_VERSION;}
  d.parentNode.removeChild(d);
  document.body.style.overflow='';
  if(DLG_OPENER&&DLG_OPENER.focus){try{DLG_OPENER.focus();}catch(e){}}
  DLG_OPENER=null;
}
/* the seasons behind the record */
function openHistory(){
  if(!HISTORY||!HISTORY.rows.length) return;
  openDialog(HISTORY.team+' — season records',historyPane(HISTORY.rows,HISTORY.allTime));
  sortable('hy');
}
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  if(!ev.target.closest)return;
  if(ev.target.closest('[data-hist]')){ev.preventDefault();openHistory();return;}
  if(ev.target.closest('[data-post]')){ev.preventDefault();openPostseason();return;}
  if(document.getElementById('mdl')&&ev.target.closest('[data-close]'))closeDialog();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
  if(ev.key==='Escape'&&document.getElementById('mdl')){ev.preventDefault();closeDialog();}
});
/* a route change must not leave a dialog floating over the next page */
window.addEventListener('hashchange',closeDialog);

/* Ask UCBAC: a question box over the same numbers the rest of the site
   shows. The answer comes back from the server, which hands the model the
   rows and forbids it to invent any - so a wrong answer here should look
   like "I do not have that", not like a plausible score.

   The visitor id is a courtesy for the per-visitor daily limit, kept in this
   browser and sent with the question. It identifies nobody: it is a random
   string this page made up, and clearing site data replaces it. The real cap
   is the site-wide one on the server. */
function askVisitorId(){
  var k='ucbac_ask_id', v='';
  try{ v=localStorage.getItem(k)||''; }catch(e){}
  if(!v){
    v='v'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Date.now().toString(36);
    HIT.fresh=true;                      // never here before, as far as this browser knows
    try{ localStorage.setItem(k,v); }catch(e){}
  }
  return v;
}
/* ---- counting the pages ----
   One page that repaints itself tells the server nothing after the first
   load, so it says where it went. What travels: the route, this browser's
   own anonymous id, the window width and whoever linked in. Never waited on
   and never allowed to fail loudly - a counter that can hold up a page, or
   break one, is worse than no counter. */
var HIT={last:'',fresh:false,ref:(function(){try{return document.referrer||'';}catch(e){return '';}})()};
function hit(page,route){
  var key=page+':'+route;
  if(key===HIT.last)return;              // the same page again is the same view
  HIT.last=key;
  var fresh=HIT.fresh; HIT.fresh=false;  // only the very first view is a new reader
  try{
    call('svcHit',[page,route,askVisitorId(),HIT.ref,window.innerWidth||0,fresh])
      .catch(function(){});
  }catch(e){}
}
/* ---- Top 10 Plays ----
   A clip goes from this browser straight to Google, into the week's folder,
   by way of a one-time session address the server opens for it. The folder
   itself is never on this side: the reader sees a week name and a progress
   bar. If the direct road is closed - a network that blocks it, an old
   browser - the same chunks travel through the server instead. */
var PLAYS={info:null,file:null,busy:false};

/* The banner has two faces. While the window is open: the week, the count,
   and a clock counting down to the close. Between windows: the week that
   just closed and its count, and a clock counting down to the next open.
   When a clock reaches zero the banner asks the server again and turns. */
function playsBannerWeek(){
  call('svcPlaysInfo',['']).then(function(i){
    var el=document.getElementById('playsWeek'), c=document.getElementById('playsCount'), k=document.getElementById('playsClock');
    var b=document.getElementById('playsBanner');
    if(!el) return;
    /* the colour is the state: green while clips are being taken, red when
       they are not - and a red banner offers no count and no button */
    if(b){ b.classList.toggle('open',!!(i&&i.open)); b.classList.toggle('shut',!(i&&i.open)); }
    if(i&&i.open){
      el.textContent='· '+i.label;
      if(c) c.innerHTML=playsCountChip(i.count);
      if(k) playsClockStart(k,i.closesAt,'Closes '+(i.closesText||''),playsBannerWeek);
      return;
    }
    el.textContent=i&&i.lastLabel?'· '+i.lastLabel+' closed':'';
    if(c) c.innerHTML='';
    if(k){
      if(i&&i.opensAt) playsClockStart(k,i.opensAt,(i.nextLabel||'Submissions')+' opens '+(i.opensText||''),playsBannerWeek);
      else { playsClockStop(); k.innerHTML=i&&i.lastLabel?'<small>Closed for the season</small>':''; }
    }
  }).catch(function(){});
}
/* One clock at a time: "1d 04:12:33", ticking every second toward a moment
   the server named in ms - so it is right in any timezone. At zero it
   stops and, after a breath for the server's own clock, calls back. */
var PLAYS_CLOCK=null;
function playsClockStop(){ if(PLAYS_CLOCK){ clearInterval(PLAYS_CLOCK); PLAYS_CLOCK=null; } }
function playsClockText(ms){
  var t=Math.max(0,Math.floor(ms/1000)), d=Math.floor(t/86400); t-=d*86400;
  var h=Math.floor(t/3600); t-=h*3600; var m=Math.floor(t/60); t-=m*60;
  var two=function(n){ return (n<10?'0':'')+n; };
  return (d?d+'d ':'')+two(h)+':'+two(m)+':'+two(t);
}
function playsClockStart(el,at,label,onZero){
  playsClockStop();
  if(!el) return;
  at=Number(at)||0;
  if(!at){ el.innerHTML=''; return; }
  el.innerHTML='<small>'+esc(label)+'</small><b aria-hidden="true"></b>';
  el.setAttribute('aria-label',label);
  var b=el.querySelector('b');
  var tick=function(){
    var left=at-Date.now();
    b.textContent=playsClockText(left);
    if(left<=0){ playsClockStop(); if(onZero) setTimeout(onZero,1500); }
  };
  tick();
  PLAYS_CLOCK=setInterval(tick,1000);
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',playsClockStop);
/* how many clips are in for the week, as a phrase */
function playsCountText(n){
  n=Number(n)||0;
  return n===0?'be the first':n===1?'1 clip in':n+' clips in';
}
/* the same, as a badge: a clapperboard, the number large, the words small */
function playsCountChip(n){
  n=Number(n)||0;
  return '<span class="clipcount" role="status" aria-label="'+esc(playsCountText(n))+'">'+
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">'+
      '<path d="M3 9h18v10a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2z" fill="currentColor"/>'+
      '<path d="M3.3 8.2 2.5 5.1 19.4 1.6l.8 3.1z" fill="currentColor"/>'+
      '<path d="M6.2 4.7l1.5 2.7M10.4 3.8l1.5 2.7M14.6 2.9l1.5 2.7" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>'+
    '</svg>'+
    '<b>'+n+'</b><small>'+(n===0?'be the first':n===1?'clip in':'clips in')+'</small></span>';
}
