/* a drop zone: tap, keyboard, or drag a file onto it */
function playsWireDrop(dropId,fileId,which){
  var drop=document.getElementById(dropId), fi=document.getElementById(fileId);
  if(!drop||!fi) return;
  var pick=function(){ if(!PLAYS.busy) fi.click(); };
  drop.addEventListener('click',pick);
  drop.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){ if(ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' '){ev.preventDefault();pick();} });
  ['dragenter','dragover'].forEach(function(t){drop.addEventListener(t,function(ev){ev.preventDefault();drop.classList.add('on');});});
  ['dragleave','drop'].forEach(function(t){drop.addEventListener(t,function(ev){ev.preventDefault();drop.classList.remove('on');});});
  drop.addEventListener('drop',function(ev){ if(ev.dataTransfer&&ev.dataTransfer.files[0]) playsChoose(ev.dataTransfer.files[0],which); });
  fi.addEventListener('change',function(){ if(fi.files&&fi.files[0]) playsChoose(fi.files[0],which); });
}
/* Beneath the form: the link that opens this same screen, ready to copy.
   It is the deployment's ?p=plays address - the one address that works
   pasted into a text or a post - and it names a week only if this visit
   did, so a link shared in season keeps opening on whatever week is
   current when it is opened. */
function playsShareRow(week){
  var u=shareUrl('plays'); if(!u) return '';
  if(week) u+='&week='+encodeURIComponent(week);
  return '<button type="button" class="go share" data-copylink="'+esc(u)+'" aria-label="Copy a link to this page">Copy Link</button>';
}
function playsMsg(t,err){
  var m=document.getElementById('plMsg'); if(!m)return;
  m.textContent=t||''; m.className='pmsg'+(err?' err':'');
}
function playsResultError(message){
  var box=document.getElementById('plResultConfirmed'), error=document.getElementById('plResultError');
  if(box){ if(message) box.setAttribute('aria-invalid','true'); else box.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'); }
  if(error){ error.textContent=message||''; error.hidden=!message; }
}
/* which: 1 = the clip, 2 = the second angle of it */
function playsChoose(f,which){
  var i=PLAYS.info||{}, key=which===2?'file2':'file';
  var isVideo=(f.type&&f.type.indexOf('video/')===0)||/\.(mp4|mov|m4v|webm|mkv|avi|3gp|mpg|mpeg|hevc)$/i.test(f.name||'');
  if(!isVideo){ PLAYS[key]=null; playsMsg('That does not look like a video. Send an MP4 or MOV.',true); return; }
  if(i.maxBytes&&f.size>i.maxBytes){ PLAYS[key]=null; playsMsg('That clip is over 2 GB. Trim it and try again.',true); return; }
  PLAYS[key]=f;
  var n=document.getElementById(which===2?'plName2':'plName'); if(n) n.textContent=f.name+' · '+playsSize(f.size);
  playsMsg('');
  var go=document.getElementById('plGo'); if(go&&PLAYS.file) go.disabled=false;
}
function playsSize(b){ return b>=1073741824?(b/1073741824).toFixed(2)+' GB':b>=1048576?Math.round(b/1048576)+' MB':Math.round(b/1024)+' KB'; }
function playsProgress(done,total){
  var bar=document.getElementById('plBar'), fill=document.getElementById('plFill');
  if(bar) bar.hidden=false;
  if(fill){var pct=Math.min(100,Math.round(done/total*100));fill.style.transform='scaleX('+(pct/100)+')';}
}

/* one chunk, straight to Google; resolves to the HTTP status */
function playsPutDirect(url,blob,start,end,total,onProgress){
  return new Promise(function(res,rej){
    var x=new XMLHttpRequest();
    x.open('PUT',url,true);
    x.setRequestHeader('Content-Range','bytes '+start+'-'+end+'/'+total);
    if(x.upload&&onProgress) x.upload.onprogress=function(ev){ if(ev.lengthComputable) onProgress(ev.loaded); };
    x.onload=function(){ res(x.status); };
    x.onerror=function(){ rej(new Error('direct')); };
    x.send(blob);
  });
}
/* the same chunk, base64, by way of the server */
function playsPutRelay(ticket,blob,start,total){
  return new Promise(function(res,rej){
    var rd=new FileReader();
    rd.onerror=function(){ rej(new Error('read')); };
    rd.onload=function(){
      var b64=String(rd.result||'').split(',')[1]||'';
      call('svcPlaysChunk',[ticket,start,total,b64]).then(function(r){
        if(r&&r.ok) res(r.status); else rej(new Error((r&&r.error)||'relay'));
      },rej);
    };
    rd.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

/* the required fields, in the order they sit on the form; the first one
   missing is named and focused, and nothing is sent until all are there */
function playsForm(){
  var val=function(id){ var el=document.getElementById(id); return el?String(el.value||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim():''; };
  var need=[['plTeam','Pick the team the play belongs to.'],
            ['plFirst','Enter the player\'s first name.'],
            ['plLast','Enter the player\'s last name.'],
            ['plPos','Pick the player\'s position.'],
            ['plGrad','Pick the player\'s graduation year.']];
  var on=function(id){ var el=document.getElementById(id); return !!(el&&el.checked); };
  /* the optional sections are required in full once opened */
  if(on('plSecondOn')) need=need.concat([
    ['plFirst2','Enter the second player\'s first name.'],
    ['plLast2','Enter the second player\'s last name.'],
    ['plPos2','Pick the second player\'s position.'],
    ['plGrad2','Pick the second player\'s graduation year.']]);
  for(var k=0;k<need.length;k++){
    if(!val(need[k][0])){
      playsMsg(need[k][1],true);
      var el=document.getElementById(need[k][0]); if(el&&el.focus) el.focus();
      return null;
    }
  }
  if(on('plAngleOn')&&!PLAYS.file2){
    playsMsg('Choose the second video, or untick "Add another angle".',true);
    var d2=document.getElementById('plDrop2'); if(d2&&d2.focus) d2.focus();
    return null;
  }
  if(!on('plResultConfirmed')){
    playsMsg('');
    playsResultError('Confirm this is a varsity play (not JV) that was not overturned due to a penalty.');
    var confirmation=document.getElementById('plResultConfirmed'); if(confirmation) confirmation.focus();
    return null;
  }
  playsResultError('');
  var out={team:val('plTeam'),first:val('plFirst'),last:val('plLast'),pos:val('plPos'),grad:val('plGrad'),desc:val('plDesc'),playResultConfirmed:true,varsityConfirmed:true};
  if(on('plSecondOn')){ out.first2=val('plFirst2'); out.last2=val('plLast2'); out.pos2=val('plPos2'); out.grad2=val('plGrad2'); }
  out.angle2=on('plAngleOn')&&!!PLAYS.file2;
  return out;
}

/* One file, start to confirmation: open the session, send the chunks,
   confirm. `extra` rides along on the begin call (the angle and the
   submission it belongs to); `tag` prefixes the progress messages. */
function playsUpload(f,form,extra,tag){
  var i=PLAYS.info||{};
  var total=f.size, sent=0, relay=false, ticket='', url='', chunk=0, relayChunk=0;
  var meta={team:form.team,first:form.first,last:form.last,pos:form.pos,grad:form.grad,
            first2:form.first2||'',last2:form.last2||'',pos2:form.pos2||'',grad2:form.grad2||'',
            desc:form.desc,name:f.name,size:f.size,type:f.type,playResultConfirmed:form.playResultConfirmed===true,varsityConfirmed:form.varsityConfirmed===true,
            week:i.key||'',origin:location.origin};
  Object.keys(extra||{}).forEach(function(k){ meta[k]=extra[k]; });
  playsMsg(tag+'Starting…');
  return call('svcPlaysBegin',[meta,askVisitorId()])
  .then(function(b){
    if(!b||!b.ok) throw new Error((b&&b.error)||'The upload could not be started.');
    ticket=b.ticket; url=b.uploadUrl; chunk=b.chunk||8388608; relayChunk=b.relayChunk||4194304;
    playsProgress(0,total);
    var next=function(){
      if(sent>=total) return Promise.resolve();
      var size=relay?relayChunk:chunk, end=Math.min(sent+size,total)-1, blob=f.slice(sent,end+1);
      playsMsg(tag+(relay?'Uploading (steady route)… ':'Uploading… ')+Math.round(sent/total*100)+'%');
      var attempt=function(n){
        var p=relay?playsPutRelay(ticket,blob,sent,total)
                   :playsPutDirect(url,blob,sent,end,total,function(l){ playsProgress(sent+l,total); });
        return p.then(function(status){
          if(status===308||status===200||status===201){ sent=end+1; playsProgress(sent,total); return next(); }
          if(n<3) return attempt(n+1);
          throw new Error('Google did not accept that piece ('+status+').');
        },function(err){
          /* the direct road is closed - a blocked network, a browser that
             will not send cross-site - so take the slower one from here on */
          if(!relay&&err&&err.message==='direct'){ relay=true; return next(); }
          if(n<3) return attempt(n+1);
          throw err;
        });
      };
      return attempt(1);
    };
    return next();
  })
  .then(function(){ playsMsg(tag+'Confirming…'); return call('svcPlaysDone',[ticket]); })
  .then(function(d){
    if(!d||!d.ok) throw new Error((d&&d.error)||'The clip could not be confirmed.');
    playsProgress(total,total);
    return d;
  });
}

function playsGo(){
  var f=PLAYS.file;
  if(!f||PLAYS.busy) return;
  var form=playsForm();
  if(!form) return;
  PLAYS.busy=true;
  var btn=document.getElementById('plGo'); if(btn) btn.disabled=true;
  var confirmation=document.getElementById('plResultConfirmed'); if(confirmation) confirmation.disabled=true;
  var two=form.angle2&&PLAYS.file2;

  /* the clip first; a second angle follows it into the same submission */
  playsUpload(f,form,{angle:1},two?'Angle 1: ':'')
  .then(function(d){
    if(!two) return d;
    return playsUpload(PLAYS.file2,form,{angle:2,sub:d.sub||''},'Angle 2: ').then(function(d2){
      if(d2&&d2.count!=null) d.count=d2.count;   /* the folder's count after both */
      return d;
    });
  })
  .then(function(d){
    playsMsg('');
    /* the server counted the folder after the clip landed; only if it could
       not say do we add one ourselves */
    var c=document.getElementById('plCount');
    if(c){ var n=(d&&d.count!=null)?Number(d.count):(Number(PLAYS.info&&PLAYS.info.count)||0)+1; PLAYS.info.count=n; c.innerHTML=playsCountChip(n); }
    var box=document.getElementById('plDone');
    if(box) box.innerHTML='<div class="done"><b>Got it - thank you!</b>'+(two?'Both angles are':'Your clip is')+' in for '+esc(d.label)+
      '. Watch for the Top 10 next week.<br><br>'+
      '<button type="button" class="go" id="plAgain">Send another</button></div>';
    /* same page, same week if the link named one: re-run the router */
    var again=document.getElementById('plAgain');
    if(again) again.addEventListener('click',function(){ PLAYS.busy=false; go(); });
    playsSuccess(d,form,two);
  })
  .catch(function(e){
    playsMsg((e&&e.message)||'Something went wrong. Try again.',true);
    var g=document.getElementById('plGo'); if(g) g.disabled=false;
    if(confirmation) confirmation.disabled=false;
  })
  .then(function(){ PLAYS.busy=false; });
}

/* The moment after a clip lands: a dialog over the page that says so, and -
   to anyone not signed in - asks whether they have a player account yet,
   says what one is for, and opens the form to make one. The same dialog
   the season records use, so it closes the same ways: the x, the backdrop,
   Escape, or leaving the page. */
var PLAYS_BENEFITS=[
  'Your own page: stats, measurables, offers and your links, in one place.',
  'Enter your stats after a game; your coach approves them.',
  'A profile link to share with recruiters.',
  'Your live All-Conference rank.'
];
function playsSignupHref(){
  var p=portalHref(); if(!p) return '';
  return p+(p.indexOf('?')>=0?'&':'?')+'view=signup';
}

  var signup=playsSignupHref();
  var h='<div class="okd">'+

    '<p>'+(two?'Both angles are':'Your clip is')+' in. It is under review with the other submissions '+
      'for a spot in the Top 10 Plays of the Week.</p>';
  if(!WHO_IN&&signup){
    h+='<div class="acct"><h3>Do you have a player account?</h3>'+
       '<ul>'+PLAYS_BENEFITS.map(function(b){return '<li>'+esc(b)+'</li>';}).join('')+'</ul>'+
       '<p class="muted">Takes a minute: your email and your head coach&rsquo;s last name.</p>'+
       '<div class="acts"><a class="okd-go" href="'+esc(signup)+'" target="_top">Create a player account</a>'+
       '<button type="button" class="okd-alt" data-again="1">Send another clip</button></div></div>';
  } else {
    h+='<div class="acts"><button type="button" class="okd-alt" data-again="1">Send another clip</button></div>';
  }
  openDialog('Your clip is in!',h+'</div>');
  var again=document.querySelector('#mdl [data-again]');
  if(again) again.addEventListener('click',function(){ closeDialog(); PLAYS.busy=false; go(); });
  var first=document.querySelector('#mdl .okd-go')||again; if(first&&first.focus) first.focus();
}
function playsTeamName(id){
  var t=((PLAYS.info&&PLAYS.info.teams)||[]).filter(function(x){return x.id===id;})[0];
  return t?t.name:id;
}

/* One place to name the assistant: the nav, the page title, the heading and
   the greeting all read it from here. */
var ASK_NAME='Blitz';
var ASK={busy:false,log:[],ph:null};
var ASK_EXAMPLES=[
  'What year did Elkton score the most points?',
  'How did Bel Air do last season?',
  'Who led the conference in rushing yards?',
  'What is Perryville’s all-time record?',
  'Who plays Fallston this week?',
  'What was the score of the Aberdeen game?',
  'Who is Havre de Grace’s head coach?',
  'How is a quarterback rating calculated?',
  'What does a safety do on defense?'
];
/* The last sentence is the notice, and it belongs in the greeting rather than
   behind a box to tick: a pop-up on a site teenagers use is clicked away
   unread, and this is the one thing they should know before they type. Said
   the way it is true - the questions are read, the answers are not kept - and
   it is repeated under the box, because a greeting scrolls away. */
var ASK_GREETING='Hi, I’m '+ASK_NAME+'! Ask me anything about UCBAC football. '+
  'I keep it friendly and school-safe. '+
  'Your questions and generated share-card text are saved to improve our platform — so please don’t '+
  'type anything private.';

/* A conversation, not a search: the reader's messages on the right, the
   assistant's on the left, newest at the bottom, and the box to type in
   pinned beneath - the shape every phone already taught them. */
/* Blitz's mark: three rising bars and a spark on a blue badge - the stats,
   and the assistant. Drawn inline so it needs no file and takes its size
   from wherever it sits; the gradient id carries a suffix because the mark
   appears more than once on a page. */
function askIcon(k){
  var g='aiG'+(k||'');
  return '<svg class="ai-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">'+
    /* the many-coloured tile the assistants wear: blue into violet into pink into amber */
    '<defs><linearGradient id="'+g+'" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">'+
    '<stop offset="0" stop-color="#1E5BFF"/><stop offset=".38" stop-color="#8A5CFF"/>'+
    '<stop offset=".72" stop-color="#FF3D8A"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFB300"/></linearGradient></defs>'+
    '<rect x="1" y="1" width="22" height="22" rx="6.5" fill="url(#'+g+')" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.28)"/>'+
    '<rect x="5" y="13.5" width="3.4" height="6" rx=".9" fill="#fff"/>'+
    '<rect x="10.3" y="9.5" width="3.4" height="10" rx=".9" fill="#fff"/>'+
    '<rect x="15.6" y="5" width="3.4" height="14.5" rx=".9" fill="#fff"/>'+
    '<path d="M6.5 3.8l.6 1.6 1.6.6-1.6.6-.6 1.6-.6-1.6-1.6-.6 1.6-.6z" fill="#fff"/></svg>';
}
/* The header's Blitz button sits between the search box and the season, not
   in the nav: it is a door to the assistant, not a page in the list. Filled
   here, as soon as the mark exists, so it is never an empty box. */
(function(){
  var a=document.getElementById('askLink');
  if(!a)return;
  a.innerHTML=askIcon('nav');
  a.setAttribute('aria-label',ASK_NAME);
  a.setAttribute('title',ASK_NAME);
})();
function pgAsk(){
  if(!TOKEN){blitzDenied();return Promise.resolve();}
  var token=TOKEN,epoch=BLITZ_EPOCH,request=routeRequest();
  return request('svcBlitzAccess',[token]).then(function(a){
    if(token!==TOKEN||epoch!==BLITZ_EPOCH)return;
    if(!a||!a.allowed){clearBlitz();blitzDenied();return;}
    BLITZ_ALLOWED=true;updateBlitzLink();return renderAsk();
  });
}
function renderAsk(){
  var h='<h1 class="ask-h">'+askIcon('h')+'<span>'+esc(ASK_NAME)+'</span></h1>'+
    '<div class="chat" id="chat">'+
      '<div class="chat-log" id="chatlog" role="log" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Conversation"></div>'+
      '<form class="chat-bar" id="askform" autocomplete="off">'+
        '<label class="sr-only" for="askq">Message</label>'+
        '<textarea id="askq" rows="1" maxlength="300" placeholder=""></textarea>'+
        '<button type="submit" id="asksend" aria-label="Send">'+
          '<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">'+
          '<path d="M12 19V5"/><path d="M5 12l7-7 7 7"/></svg>'+
        '</button>'+
      '</form>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="notes">Answers come from this site’s data and can be incomplete. '+
      'Questions and generated share-card text are saved for review and improvement. '+
      'Other answers are not stored by this site. Please don’t type anything private.</div>';
  render(h);
  document.body.classList.add('chatfull');
  askDraw();
  var f=document.getElementById('askform'), ta=document.getElementById('askq');
  if(f) f.onsubmit=function(ev){ ev.preventDefault(); askSend(ta?ta.value:''); };
  if(ta){
    /* Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks a line - messaging's convention */
    ta.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
      if(ev.key==='Enter'&&!ev.shiftKey){ ev.preventDefault(); askSend(ta.value); }
    });
    ta.addEventListener('input',function(){ askGrow(ta); });
  }
  askPhStart();
  // go() attaches .catch to whatever a page returns; this one has nothing to
  // wait for, so it hands back a settled promise rather than undefined
  return Promise.resolve();
}
/* the box grows with the message, to three lines or so, then scrolls */
function askGrow(ta){
  ta.style.height='auto';
  ta.style.height=Math.min(ta.scrollHeight,120)+'px';
}
function askBubble(cls,text){
  return '<div class="msg '+cls+'"><div class="bub">'+esc(text)+'</div></div>';
}
/* Subtle on purpose: a quiet line under the answer, not a button competing
   with it. It only appears on an answer that actually worked - offering to
   share an apology would be a strange thing to do. */
function askShareRow(i){
  /* Not a .msg: it is an offer attached to the answer above it, and anything
     counting or reading the conversation should not find an extra turn here. */
  return '<div class="ask-share"><button type="button" class="linky" data-ashare="'+i+'">'
    + shareGlyph()+'Share response</button></div>';
}
function askDraw(){
  var box=document.getElementById('chatlog');
  if(!box) return;
  var h=askBubble('bot',ASK_GREETING);
  ASK.log.forEach(function(t,i){
    h+=askBubble('me',t.q);
    if(t.pending) h+='<div class="msg bot typing" aria-label="Thinking"><div class="bub"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>';
    else {
      h+=askBubble('bot'+(t.err?' err':''),t.a);
      if(!t.err&&t.a) h+=askShareRow(i);
    }
  });
  box.innerHTML=h;
  box.scrollTop=box.scrollHeight;
}

/* ---- sharing an answer ----
   The card is drawn here, in the browser, from text the server compressed:
   no image ever crosses the wire, and the four ways out of it are the same
   four the profile card uses, each offered only where it actually works.
   On a phone the native sheet carries "Save to Photos", which is the whole
   Instagram path; on a desktop, copy the image and paste it into the post. */
/* One sheet for every card the site makes. A spec names the variants, how to
   draw each, what the caption says and what to call the file; the sheet knows
   nothing about chats or games. Blitz passes three variants, a scoreboard
   passes one. */
var CARD={busy:false,spec:null,pick:0,url:'',blob:null,id:''};

/* Say which one actually went out, and by which button. The server knows a
   card was made; only this side knows whether anybody used it, and an unused
   card is a very different thing from a posted one. Fire and forget - it must
   never come between somebody and their post. */
function cardUsed(how){
  if(!CARD.id||!TOKEN||!BLITZ_ALLOWED) return;                       // only a Blitz card has one to report
  var v=(CARD.spec&&CARD.spec.variants)||[];
  /* The STYLE, not the label: the log should read "punchline", which is what
     the server called it, not "Headline", which is what the tab says. */
  var st=(v[CARD.pick]||{}).style||'';
  try{ call('svcCardUsed',[TOKEN,CARD.id,st,how]).catch(function(){}); }catch(e){}
}

function askShareOpen(i){
  var t=ASK.log[i];
  if(!t||!t.a||t.err||CARD.busy||!TOKEN||!BLITZ_ALLOWED) return;
  var token=TOKEN,epoch=BLITZ_EPOCH;
  CARD.busy=true; CARD.spec=null; CARD.pick=0; CARD.url=''; CARD.blob=null; CARD.id='';
  var dialog=BLITZ_DIALOG=openDialog('Share this answer','<div id="cardBody">'+cardSkeleton()+'</div>');
  function current(){return TOKEN===token&&BLITZ_EPOCH===epoch&&BLITZ_ALLOWED&&dialog===document.getElementById('mdl');}
  var use=function(cards,id){
    if(!current())return;
    CARD.busy=false;
    var names={punchline:'Headline',short:'Short',detailed:'Full'};
    CARD.spec={
      id:id||'', file:'ucbac-blitz',
      variants:cards.map(function(c){
        return { label:names[c.style]||'Card', style:c.style, text:c.text,
                 draw:function(){ return cardDrawBlitz(t.q,c.text); } };
      }),
      caption:function(pick){
        var c=cards[pick]||cards[0];
        return 'I asked Blitz: '+t.q+'\n\n'+((c&&c.text)||'')+
               '\n\nAsk it yourself at UCBACstats.com';
      }
    };
    cardPaint();
  };
  /* Cached on the turn, so flicking the sheet open and shut a second time
     costs nothing - the compression is the only part that is not free. */
  if(t.cards){ use(t.cards,t.cardId); return; }
  call('svcAskCard',[token,t.q,t.a]).then(function(r){
    if(!current())return;
    if(!r||r.error||!r.cards||!r.cards.length){
      CARD.busy=false;
      cardBody('<p class="notes">'+esc((r&&r.error)||'The card could not be made just now.')+'</p>');
      return;
    }
    t.cards=r.cards; t.cardId=r.cardId||'';
    use(r.cards,r.cardId);
  }).catch(function(e){
    if(!current()||blitzFailure(e))return;
    CARD.busy=false;
    cardBody('<p class="notes">The card could not be made just now.</p>');
  });
}
function cardBody(h){ var el=document.getElementById('cardBody'); if(el) el.innerHTML=h; }
function cardSkeleton(){
  return '<div class="card-skel" role="img" aria-label="Drawing your card"></div>'
    + '<p class="notes" style="text-align:center">Picking out the part worth posting\u2026</p>';
}

/* One canvas per rendering, so the choice is between finished cards rather
   than between three descriptions of a card. */
function cardPaint(){
  var v=(CARD.spec&&CARD.spec.variants)||[];
  var h='';
  /* One card needs no chooser. A row of tabs with a single tab in it is a
     control that does nothing, which reads as broken rather than as simple. */
  if(v.length>1){
    h+='<div class="card-pick" role="tablist" aria-label="Card style">';
    v.forEach(function(c,i){
      h+='<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(i===CARD.pick?'true':'false')+'" '
        +'class="'+(i===CARD.pick?'on':'')+'" data-card="'+i+'">'+esc(c.label||('Card '+(i+1)))+'</button>';
    });
    h+='</div>';
  }
  h+='<img class="card-img" id="cardImg" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAD/ACwAAAAAAQABAAACADs=" width="1080" height="1080" alt="Your share card" aria-busy="true">'
    +'<div class="card-acts" id="cardActs"></div>'
    +'<div class="notes" style="text-align:center;margin-top:10px" id="cardHint"></div>';
  cardBody(h);
  cardDraw();
}

/* Open the sheet on a finished spec: no server call, nothing to wait for.
   Blitz uses openDialog itself because its words have to be fetched first. */
function shareSheet(spec){
  if(CARD.busy) return;
  CARD.spec=spec; CARD.pick=0; CARD.url=''; CARD.blob=null; CARD.id=spec.id||'';
  openDialog(spec.title||'Share','<div id="cardBody">'+cardSkeleton()+'</div>');
  cardPaint();
}

function cardActs(){
  var el=document.getElementById('cardActs'), hint=document.getElementById('cardHint');
  if(!el) return;
  var h='';
  if(navigator.share) h+='<button type="button" class="cbtn primary" data-cardact="share">Share\u2026</button>';
  if(window.ClipboardItem&&navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.write)
    h+='<button type="button" class="cbtn" data-cardact="copy">Copy image</button>';
  h+='<button type="button" class="cbtn" data-cardact="download">Download</button>';
  h+='<button type="button" class="cbtn" data-cardact="caption">Copy caption</button>';
  h+='<span class="cmsg" id="cardMsg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-cardact]').forEach(function(b){
    if(b.dataset.cardact!=='caption')b.disabled=!CARD.blob;
  });
  if(hint) hint.innerHTML=navigator.share
    ? 'Share opens the options supported by your device. You can also download the image.'
    : 'Copy the image and paste it into your post, or download it. On a phone, press and hold the card to save it.';
}

function cardSay(m,bad){
  var el=document.getElementById('cardMsg');
  if(el){ el.textContent=m||''; el.className='cmsg'+(bad?' bad':''); }
}

var CARD_DRAW_VERSION=0;
function cardDraw(){
  var version=++CARD_DRAW_VERSION, spec=CARD.spec, pick=CARD.pick;
  var c=((spec&&spec.variants)||[])[pick];
  var img=document.getElementById('cardImg');
  CARD.url='';CARD.blob=null;
  if(img){img.src='data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAD/ACwAAAAAAQABAAACADs=';img.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');}
  cardActs();
  if(!c||!c.draw){cardSay('This card is unavailable.',true);return;}
  Promise.resolve().then(function(){return c.draw();}).then(function(url){
    if(version!==CARD_DRAW_VERSION||spec!==CARD.spec||pick!==CARD.pick||!img||!img.isConnected)return;
    CARD.url=url||'';CARD.blob=url?cardBlob(url):null;
    img.setAttribute('aria-busy','false');
    if(url){img.src=url;img.style.display='block';img.alt=spec.title||'UCBAC Stats share card';}
    cardActs();
    if(!url)cardSay('The card could not be drawn. Choose a style again to retry.',true);
  },function(){
    if(version!==CARD_DRAW_VERSION||!img||!img.isConnected)return;
    img.setAttribute('aria-busy','false');cardActs();
    cardSay('The card could not be drawn. Choose a style again to retry.',true);
  });
}

function cardBlob(dataUrl){
  try{
    var bin=atob(dataUrl.split(',')[1]||''), arr=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++) arr[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
    return new Blob([arr],{type:'image/png'});
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}

/* 1080x1080. Square because it is the one shape both networks take without
   cropping: X shows it whole, Instagram wants it. */
/* ---- the shared canvas ----
   Every card the site makes is the same object: 1080 square, the site's blue,
   the mark top left, a footer naming where it came from. Only the middle
   differs, so only the middle is written three times. */
function cardCanvas(){
  var W=1080,H=1080,c,g;
  try{ c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=W; c.height=H; g=c.getContext('2d'); }
  catch(e){ return null; }
  if(!g) return null;
  var K={W:W,H:H,PAD:76,c:c,g:g};
  K.F=function(px,w){ return (w||700)+' '+px+'px system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif'; };
  K.roundRect=function(x,y,w,h,r){
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x+r,y); g.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r); g.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    g.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r); g.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r); g.closePath();
  };
  /* Wrap by measuring, honouring newlines the caller put in. Returns the
     lines so the caller can place the block itself. */
  K.wrap=function(text,font,maxW){
    g.font=font;
    var out=[];
    String(text).split('\n').forEach(function(para){
      var words=para.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), line='';
      if(!words.length){ out.push(''); return; }
      words.forEach(function(word){
        var test=line?line+' '+word:word;
        if(g.measureText(test).width>maxW&&line){ out.push(line); line=word; }
        else line=test;
      });
      if(line) out.push(line);
    });
    return out;
  };
  /* Text at a size chosen to fill the space it is given, biggest first. */
  K.fit=function(text,ladder,maxW,maxH,weight){
    var size=0,lines=[];
    ladder.some(function(px){
      var ls=K.wrap(text,K.F(px,weight||700),maxW);
      if(ls.length*(px*1.22)<=maxH){ size=px; lines=ls; return true; }
      return false;
    });
    if(!size){
      size=ladder[ladder.length-1];
      lines=K.wrap(text,K.F(size,weight||700),maxW).slice(0,Math.max(1,Math.floor(maxH/(size*1.22))));
    }
    return {size:size,lines:lines,lh:size*1.22};
  };
  K.out=function(){ try{ return K.c.toDataURL('image/png'); }catch(e){ return ''; } };
  return K;
}

/* The ground, the mark and the footer: the parts that say "this is UCBAC
   Stats" and must look the same on every card. Returns the y the middle of
   the card may start at. */
function cardFrame(K,eyebrow){
  var g=K.g,W=K.W,H=K.H,PAD=K.PAD;
  var bg=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,W*.9,H);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#2a35ff'); bg.addColorStop(.5,'#1418D8'); bg.addColorStop(1,'#0d1046');
  g.fillStyle=bg; g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.06)'; g.lineWidth=2;
  for(var yl=1;yl<10;yl++){ g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(yl*W/10,0); g.lineTo(yl*W/10,H); g.stroke(); }

  /* The mark itself rather than a lightning emoji: an emoji renders as
     whatever thin monochrome glyph the machine happens to own. Same three
     bars and spark as askIcon(), scaled from its 24-unit box. */
  var S=72,x=PAD,y=PAD-16,u=S/24;
  var mg=g.createLinearGradient(x,y,x+S,y+S);
  mg.addColorStop(0,'#1E5BFF'); mg.addColorStop(.38,'#8A5CFF');
  mg.addColorStop(.72,'#FF3D8A'); mg.addColorStop(1,'#FFB300');
  g.fillStyle=mg; K.roundRect(x,y,S,S,S*0.27); g.fill();
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.28)'; g.lineWidth=2; g.stroke();
  g.fillStyle='#fff';
  [[5,13.5,3.4,6],[10.3,9.5,3.4,10],[15.6,5,3.4,14.5]].forEach(function(b){
    K.roundRect(x+b[0]*u,y+b[1]*u,b[2]*u,b[3]*u,0.9*u); g.fill();
  });
  g.beginPath();
  g.moveTo(x+6.5*u,y+3.8*u); g.lineTo(x+7.1*u,y+5.4*u); g.lineTo(x+8.7*u,y+6*u);
  g.lineTo(x+7.1*u,y+6.6*u); g.lineTo(x+6.5*u,y+8.2*u); g.lineTo(x+5.9*u,y+6.6*u);
  g.lineTo(x+4.3*u,y+6*u); g.lineTo(x+5.9*u,y+5.4*u); g.closePath(); g.fill();

  g.textBaseline='alphabetic'; g.textAlign='left';
  g.fillStyle='#fff'; g.font=K.F(38,800);
  g.fillText(eyebrow||'UCBAC Stats',PAD+92,PAD+16);
  g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.7)'; g.font=K.F(26,600);
  g.fillText('UCBACstats.com',PAD+92,PAD+52);

  g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.10)'; K.roundRect(PAD-16,H-PAD-64,W-(PAD-16)*2,72,20); g.fill();
  return PAD+120;
}

/* The footer line, drawn last so nothing overlaps it. */
function cardFoot(K,left,right){
  var g=K.g,PAD=K.PAD,H=K.H,W=K.W;
  g.textAlign='left';
  g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.92)'; g.font=K.F(30,700);
  g.fillText(left||'Asked on UCBACstats.com',PAD+8,H-PAD-18);
  if(right){
    g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.6)'; g.font=K.F(26,600);
    g.fillText(right,W-PAD-8-g.measureText(right).width,H-PAD-18);
  }
}

/* ---- a Blitz answer ---- */
function cardDrawBlitz(question,answer){
  return new Promise(function(res){
    var K=cardCanvas(); if(!K){ res(''); return; }
    var g=K.g,W=K.W,H=K.H,PAD=K.PAD;
    cardFrame(K,'Blitz');

    var qLines=K.wrap('\u201C'+question+'\u201D',K.F(32,600),W-PAD*2).slice(0,3);
    var qy=PAD+130;
    g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.72)'; g.font=K.F(32,600);
    qLines.forEach(function(l,i){ g.fillText(l,PAD,qy+i*44); });

    var ry=qy+qLines.length*44+22;
    g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.24)'; g.lineWidth=4;
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(PAD,ry); g.lineTo(PAD+88,ry); g.stroke();

    /* The ladder starts very large on purpose: a nine-word headline set at
       body size floats in the middle of a square with nothing around it,
       which reads as a mistake rather than as emphasis. */
    var top=ry+56,maxH=(H-PAD-110)-top;
    var fitd=K.fit(answer,[124,108,92,80,68,58,50,44,38,34,32],W-PAD*2,maxH);
    g.fillStyle='#fff'; g.font=K.F(fitd.size,700);
    var sy=top+fitd.size;
    fitd.lines.forEach(function(l){ if(l===''){ sy+=fitd.lh*0.45; return; } g.fillText(l,PAD,sy); sy+=fitd.lh; });

    cardFoot(K,'Asked on UCBACstats.com','Ask Blitz anything');
    res(K.out());
  });
}

/* ---- a final score ----
   The scoreboard as a scoreboard: the two schools, the two numbers, the
   winner at full strength and the loser dimmed exactly as the game page
   draws them. Crests are not fetched — an image that has to load turns a
   card that appears instantly into one that sometimes does not appear at
   all — so each school gets its initials in a disc instead. */
function cardDrawGame(d){
  return new Promise(function(res){
    var K=cardCanvas(); if(!K){ res(''); return; }
    var g=K.g,W=K.W,H=K.H,PAD=K.PAD;
    cardFrame(K,d.final?'Final':'Scheduled');

    g.textAlign='center';
    /* Centred between the header and the footer pill rather than hung from
       the top: a scoreboard floating in the upper half with a fifth of the
       card empty under it reads as a card that failed to finish drawing. */
    var top=150, bot=H-PAD-80;
    var noteH=d.note?80:0;
    var groupH=44+46+168+56+84+52+140+noteH;
    var y0=top+Math.max(0,(bot-top-groupH)/2);
    var eyeY=y0+34, discY=y0+44+46+84, nameY=discY+84+56+34, scoreY=nameY+52+140;

    g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.72)'; g.font=K.F(30,600);
    g.fillText(d.eyebrow||'',W/2,eyeY);

    var side=function(cx,name,score,won){
      /* The initials disc: up to three letters, which covers "BM" for
         Bohemia Manor and "HdG" for Havre de Grace. */
      var ini=String(name||'').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
                .map(function(w){ return w.charAt(0); }).join('').slice(0,3).toUpperCase();
      g.fillStyle=won||!d.final?'rgba(255,255,255,.16)':'rgba(255,255,255,.09)';
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(cx,discY,84,0,Math.PI*2); g.fill();
      g.fillStyle=won||!d.final?'#fff':'rgba(255,255,255,.6)';
      g.font=K.F(ini.length>2?48:60,800);
      g.fillText(ini,cx,discY+(ini.length>2?17:22));

      var nm=K.wrap(name||'',K.F(36,700),400).slice(0,2);
      g.fillStyle=won||!d.final?'#fff':'rgba(255,255,255,.62)';
      g.font=K.F(36,700);
      nm.forEach(function(l,i){ g.fillText(l,cx,nameY+i*44); });

      g.font=K.F(150,800);
      g.fillStyle=won||!d.final?'#fff':'rgba(255,255,255,.5)';
      g.fillText(d.final?String(score):'—',cx,scoreY);
    };
    side(W*0.28,d.awayName,d.away,d.final&&d.away>d.home);
    side(W*0.72,d.homeName,d.home,d.final&&d.home>d.away);

    g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.5)'; g.font=K.F(32,600);
    g.fillText('at',W/2,scoreY-46);

    if(d.note){
      g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.8)'; g.font=K.F(30,600);
      K.wrap(d.note,K.F(30,600),W-PAD*2).slice(0,2)
        .forEach(function(l,i){ g.fillText(l,W/2,scoreY+64+i*40); });
    }
    g.textAlign='left';
    cardFoot(K,'UCBACstats.com',d.dateText||'');
    res(K.out());
  });
}

/* ---- one player, one game ----
   The line a boy actually wants to post: his name and number at the top of
   the card, the numbers he put up underneath in tiles big enough to read in
   a feed, and the game they came from along the bottom. */
function cardDrawLine(d){
  return new Promise(function(res){
    var K=cardCanvas(); if(!K){ res(''); return; }
    var g=K.g,W=K.W,H=K.H,PAD=K.PAD;
    cardFrame(K,d.cat||'Box score');

    var name=(d.jersey?'#'+d.jersey+' ':'')+(d.name||'');
    var nf=K.fit(name,[80,70,62,54,48],W-PAD*2,150,800);
    var nLines=nf.lines.slice(0,2);

    /* Measure the whole stack, then centre it: a name high on the card with
       the tiles adrift above an empty third looks unfinished. */
    var st=(d.stats||[]).slice(0,4);
    /* Up to three go in one row; four make a square. Three in two columns
       leaves a single tile stranded on a second row, which is the very thing
       the layout is meant to avoid. */
    var cols=st.length?(st.length<=3?st.length:2):1;
    var rows=st.length?Math.ceil(st.length/cols):0;
    var gap=22, th=rows>1?150:180;
    if(cols===3) th=170;
    var stackH=nLines.length*nf.lh+44+(rows?56+rows*th+(rows-1)*gap:0);
    var top=150, bot=H-PAD-80;
    var y0=top+Math.max(0,(bot-top-stackH)/2);

    g.fillStyle='#fff'; g.font=K.F(nf.size,800);
    var ny=y0+nf.size;
    nLines.forEach(function(l,i){ g.fillText(l,PAD,ny+i*nf.lh); });

    g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.72)'; g.font=K.F(30,600);
    g.fillText(d.team||'',PAD,ny+nLines.length*nf.lh+8);

    /* The tiles. Two rows of two, or one row of three when that is all there
       is — a lone tile in a row of four looks like something failed to load. */
    if(st.length){
      var tw=(W-PAD*2-gap*(cols-1))/cols;
      var ty=ny+nLines.length*nf.lh+48;
      st.forEach(function(x,i){
        var cx=PAD+(i%cols)*(tw+gap), cy=ty+Math.floor(i/cols)*(th+gap);
        g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.10)'; K.roundRect(cx,cy,tw,th,20); g.fill();
        g.textAlign='center';
        var nsz=rows>1?66:(cols===3?70:78), lsz=cols===3?22:24;
        g.fillStyle='#fff'; g.font=K.F(nsz,800);
        g.fillText(String(x.v),cx+tw/2,cy+(rows>1?92:104));
        g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.66)'; g.font=K.F(lsz,700);
        g.fillText(String(x.k).toUpperCase(),cx+tw/2,cy+(rows>1?126:142));
        g.textAlign='left';
      });
    }
    cardFoot(K,d.game||'UCBACstats.com',d.dateText||'');
    res(K.out());
  });
}

/* The share glyph, shared by every quiet share control on the site. */
function shareGlyph(){
  return '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" '
    + 'stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">'
    + '<circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/>'
    + '<path d="M8.6 13.5l6.8 4M15.4 6.5l-6.8 4"/></svg>';
}

/* The cell at the end of a box-score row. Empty ink until the row is hovered
   or focused: a box score should read as a box score, and fifteen share icons
   down the right of it is the opposite of subtle. */
function rowShare(teamId,cat,x){
  if(!x||!x.playerId) return '<td class="shcell"></td>';
  var key=teamId+'|'+cat+'|'+x.playerId;
  return '<td class="shcell"><button type="button" class="rowshare" data-line="'+esc(key)+'" '
    + 'aria-label="Share '+esc(x.name||'this line')+'">'+shareGlyph()+'</button></td>';
}

/* What a box-score row is worth saying out loud. Zeros are left off: "0 TD"
   on a card is a sentence nobody wants to post about themselves. */
function lineStats(cat,x){
  var out=[];
  var add=function(k,v){ if(has(v)&&Number(v)!==0) out.push({k:k,v:Number(v)}); };
  if(cat==='Passing'){
    if(has(x.passComp)||has(x.passAtt)) out.push({k:'C/A',v:n(x.passComp)+'/'+n(x.passAtt)});
    add('PASS YDS',x.passYds); add('TD',x.passTD);
  } else if(cat==='Rushing'){
    add('CARRIES',x.rushAtt); add('RUSH YDS',x.rushYds); add('TD',x.rushTD);
  } else if(cat==='Receiving'){
    add('CATCHES',x.rec); add('REC YDS',x.recYds); add('TD',x.recTD);
  } else {
    var tk=(Number(x.solo)||0)+(Number(x.asst)||0);
    if(tk) out.push({k:'TACKLES',v:tk});
    add('TFL',x.tfl); add('SACKS',x.sacks); add('INT',x.int);
  }
  return out;
}

/* Both game cards read the game already on screen, so opening one costs
   nothing and works with the page offline. */
function gameShareOpen(){
  var g=GAME; if(!g) return;
  var h=team(g.home),a=team(g.away);
  var hn=h.name||g.homeName||g.home, an=a.name||g.awayName||g.away;
  var when=g.date?fmtDate(g.date):'';
  shareSheet({
    title:'Share the final', file:'ucbac-'+an+'-'+hn,
    variants:[{ label:'Final', draw:function(){ return cardDrawGame({
      final:true, away:n(g.as), home:n(g.hs), awayName:an, homeName:hn,
      eyebrow:(g.phase==='Round'?'Playoff Round ':'Week ')+n(g.week),
      dateText:when }); } }],
    caption:function(){
      return an+' '+n(g.as)+' at '+hn+' '+n(g.hs)+
             '\n\nBox score at UCBACstats.com';
    }
  });
}

function lineShareOpen(key){
  var g=GAME; if(!g) return;
  var bits=String(key).split('|'), tid=bits[0], cat=bits[1], pid=bits[2];
  var rows=(g.stats||{})[tid]||[];
  var x=rows.filter(function(r){ return r.playerId===pid&&r.cat===cat; })[0];
  if(!x) return;
  var h=team(g.home),a=team(g.away);
  var hn=h.name||g.homeName||g.home, an=a.name||g.awayName||g.away;
  var opp=tid===g.home?an:hn, vs=tid===g.home?'vs ':'at ';
  var st=lineStats(cat,x);
  if(!st.length) return;
  shareSheet({
    title:'Share this line', file:'ucbac-'+(x.name||'player'),
    variants:[{ label:cat, draw:function(){ return cardDrawLine({
      name:x.name, jersey:x.jersey, team:tname(tid), cat:cat, stats:st,
      game:vs+opp, dateText:g.date?fmtDate(g.date):'' }); } }],
    caption:function(){
      return (x.jersey?'#'+x.jersey+' ':'')+(x.name||'')+' '+vs+opp+'\n'+
             st.map(function(s){ return s.v+' '+s.k.toLowerCase(); }).join(', ')+
             '\n\nFull box score at UCBACstats.com';
    }
  });
}

document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  if(!ev.target.closest) return;
  if(ev.target.closest('[data-gshare]')){ ev.preventDefault(); gameShareOpen(); return; }
  var ln=ev.target.closest('[data-line]');
  if(ln){ ev.preventDefault(); lineShareOpen(ln.getAttribute('data-line')); }
});

/* A season or career row, as the two or three numbers worth putting on a
   card. Same rule as a box-score line: a nought is a true number and a
   miserable thing to post about yourself, so it is left off. */
function statTiles(x){
  if(!x) return [];
  var out=[], add=function(k,v){ if(has(v)&&Number(v)!==0) out.push({k:k,v:Number(v)}); };
  add('PASS YDS',x.passYds); add('PASS TD',x.passTD);
  add('RUSH YDS',x.rushYds); add('RUSH TD',x.rushTD);
  add('REC',x.rec); add('REC YDS',x.recYds); add('REC TD',x.recTD);
  var tk=(Number(x.solo)||0)+(Number(x.asst)||0);
  if(tk) out.push({k:'TACKLES',v:tk});
  add('SACKS',x.sacks); add('INT',x.int);
  /* Four tiles is what the card holds, and the biggest numbers are the ones
     worth the space. Yardage outranks a count, which is why they are added in
     that order and simply truncated. */
  return out.slice(0,4);
}
function seasonYear(id){ var m=String(id||'').match(/(\d{4})/); return m?m[1]:''; }

/* The pages keep what a card needs, so opening one costs no server call and
   works on whatever is already drawn. */
var TEAMPG=null, PLAYERPG=null, COACHPG=null;

/* Team, player and coach all take the same shape as a box-score line — a name,
   a line under it, a row of tiles — so they share its renderer rather than
   growing two more. */
function cardShareOpen(what){
  var bits=String(what||'').split(':'), page=bits[0], id=bits.slice(1).join(':');
  if(page==='team') return teamCardOpen(id);
  if(page==='player') return playerCardOpen(id);
  if(page==='coach') return coachCardOpen(id);
  if(page==='fantasy') return fantasyCardOpen(id);
}

function teamCardOpen(id){
  var d=TEAMPG; if(!d||d.id!==id) return;
  var t=team(id), st=d.standing||{};
  var rec=has(st.w)?n(st.w)+'-'+n(st.l)+(n(st.t)?'-'+n(st.t):''):'';
  var tiles=[];
  if(rec) tiles.push({k:'RECORD',v:rec});
  if(has(st.confW)) tiles.push({k:'CONFERENCE',v:n(st.confW)+'-'+n(st.confL)});
  if(has(st.pf)) tiles.push({k:'POINTS FOR',v:n(st.pf)});
  if(has(st.pa)) tiles.push({k:'ALLOWED',v:n(st.pa)});
  shareSheet({
    title:'Share '+(t.name||'this team'), file:'ucbac-'+(t.name||'team'),
    variants:[{ label:'Team', draw:function(){ return cardDrawLine({
      name:(t.name||'')+(t.mascot?' '+t.mascot:''),
      team:[t.county?t.county+' County':'',t.cls].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00B7 '),
      cat:seasonLabel()+' Season', stats:tiles,
      game:'UCBACstats.com' }); } }],
    caption:function(){
      return (t.name||'')+(rec?' \u2014 '+rec:'')+shareTail('team',id);
    }
  });
}

function playerCardOpen(id){
  var p=PLAYERPG; if(!p||p.id!==id) return;
  var cur=p.__cur||{}, t=team(cur.teamId);
  /* His newest season if it has anything in it, else the career: a card should
     show the best true thing about him, not an empty current year. */
  var src=p.__seasonTiles&&p.__seasonTiles.length?p.__seasonTiles:[];
  shareSheet({
    title:'Share this player', file:'ucbac-'+(p.name||'player'),
    variants:[{ label:'Player', draw:function(){ return cardDrawLine({
      name:p.name, jersey:cur.jersey,
      team:[t.name||'',cur.pos||'',cur.cls?'Class of '+cur.cls:''].filter(Boolean).join(' \u00B7 '),
      cat:p.__catLabel||'Career', stats:src,
      game:'UCBACstats.com' }); } }],
    caption:function(){
      return (cur.jersey?'#'+cur.jersey+' ':'')+(p.name||'')+
             (t.name?' \u2014 '+t.name:'')+shareTail('player',id);
    }
  });
}

function coachCardOpen(id){
  var c=COACHPG; if(!c||c.id!==id) return;
  var t=team(id);
  shareSheet({
    title:'Share this coach', file:'ucbac-'+(c.name||'coach'),
    variants:[{ label:'Coach', draw:function(){ return cardDrawLine({
      name:c.name, team:(t.name||'')+(c.title?' \u00B7 '+c.title:''),
      cat:'Head Coach', stats:c.tiles||[], game:'UCBACstats.com' }); } }],
    caption:function(){
      return (c.name||'')+(t.name?' \u2014 '+t.name:'')+shareTail('coach',id);
    }
  });
}

/* "2026", from the season the page is showing. */


function cardFileName(){
  var base=(CARD.spec&&CARD.spec.file)||'ucbac';
  return base.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9-]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'').toLowerCase()
    +'-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.png';
}
function cardCaption(){
  var s=CARD.spec; if(!s) return '';
  return (typeof s.caption==='function'? s.caption(CARD.pick) : (s.caption||''));
}

var CARDACT={};
CARDACT.share=function(){
  if(!navigator.share) return;
  var data={title:'UCBAC Stats',text:cardCaption()};
  if(CARD.blob&&window.File&&navigator.canShare){
    try{
      var f=new File([CARD.blob],cardFileName(),{type:'image/png'});
      if(navigator.canShare({files:[f]})) data.files=[f];
    }catch(e){}
  }
  navigator.share(data).then(function(){ cardUsed('share'); cardSay('Shared.'); },function(e){
    if(e&&e.name==='AbortError') return;
    cardSay('Sharing is not available here. Copy the image instead.',true);
  });
};
CARDACT.copy=function(){
  if(!CARD.blob||!window.ClipboardItem) return;
  try{
    navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({'image/png':CARD.blob})])
      .then(function(){ cardUsed('copy'); cardSay('Card copied \u2014 paste it into your post.'); },
            function(){ cardSay('Could not copy it. Download it instead.',true); });
  }catch(e){ cardSay('Could not copy it. Download it instead.',true); }
};
CARDACT.download=function(){
  if(!CARD.url) return;
  var a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=CARD.url; a.download=cardFileName(); a.rel='noopener';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
  cardUsed('download');
  cardSay('Downloading. If nothing arrived, press and hold the card and save it.');
};
CARDACT.caption=function(){
  var txt=cardCaption();
  if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(function(){ cardUsed('caption'); cardSay('Caption copied.'); },
                                            function(){ cardSay('Could not copy it.',true); });
  } else cardSay('Could not copy it.',true);
};

document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  if(!ev.target.closest) return;
  var sh=ev.target.closest('[data-ashare]');
  if(sh){ ev.preventDefault(); askShareOpen(Number(sh.getAttribute('data-ashare'))); return; }
  var pick=ev.target.closest('[data-card]');
  if(pick){ ev.preventDefault(); CARD.pick=Number(pick.getAttribute('data-card')); cardPaint(); return; }
  var act=ev.target.closest('[data-cardact]');
  if(act){ ev.preventDefault(); var f=CARDACT[act.getAttribute('data-cardact')]; if(f)f(); }
});
/* The earlier exchanges ride along, so "what about Bel Air?" means
   something. Only completed answers, only the last few, and the server trims
   each one again - a follow-up should cost a little context, not the whole
   afternoon's conversation. */
function askHistory(){
  return ASK.log.filter(function(t){return !t.pending&&!t.err;}).slice(-4)
    .map(function(t){return {q:t.q,a:t.a};});
}
function askSend(q){
  q=String(q||'').trim();
  if(!q||ASK.busy||!BLITZ_ALLOWED||!TOKEN) return;
  var token=TOKEN,epoch=BLITZ_EPOCH;
  function current(){return TOKEN===token&&BLITZ_EPOCH===epoch&&BLITZ_ALLOWED;}
  var ta=document.getElementById('askq');
  if(ta){ ta.value=''; askGrow(ta); }
  ASK.busy=true;
  var btn=document.getElementById('asksend'); if(btn) btn.disabled=true;
  var history=askHistory();
  var turn={q:q,a:'',pending:true,err:false};
  ASK.log.push(turn); askDraw();
  call('svcAsk',[token,q,history]).then(function(r){
    if(!current())return;
    turn.pending=false;
    turn.a=(r&&r.answer)||(r&&r.error)||'No answer came back.';
    turn.err=!(r&&r.answer);
  }).catch(function(e){
    if(!current()||blitzFailure(e))return;
    turn.pending=false; turn.err=true;
    turn.a='The assistant is unavailable right now.';
  }).then(function(){
    if(!current())return;
    ASK.busy=false;
    if(parseHash().page!=='ask')return;
    var b=document.getElementById('asksend'); if(b) b.disabled=false;
    askDraw();
    var i=document.getElementById('askq'); if(i) i.focus();
  });
}
/* Example questions cycle through the box's placeholder, the way the search
   bar shows names: an invitation in the reader's own words, not a row of
   buttons to study. Same rules as the search bar - shuffled, each shown once
   before any repeats, still while the reader is typing or the tab is hidden. */
function askPhStart(){
  var el=document.getElementById('askq');
  if(!el) return;
  askPhStop();
  var order=[], i=0;
  function shuffle(){
    var last=order.length?order[order.length-1]:null;
    order=ASK_EXAMPLES.slice();
    for(var k=order.length-1;k>0;k--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(k+1)),t=order[k];order[k]=order[j];order[j]=t;}
    if(order.length>1&&last!==null&&order[0]===last) order.push(order.shift());
    i=0;
  }
  shuffle(); el.setAttribute('placeholder',order[0]);
  ASK.ph=setInterval(function(){
    var box=document.getElementById('askq');
    if(!box||box!==el){ askPhStop(); return; }         // the page has moved on
    if(el.value||document.activeElement===el||document.hidden) return;
    i++; if(i>=order.length) shuffle();
    var next=order[i];
    if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){
      el.setAttribute('placeholder',next); return;
    }
    el.classList.add('phf');
    setTimeout(function(){ el.setAttribute('placeholder',next); el.classList.remove('phf'); },200);
  },3600);
  el.addEventListener('focus',function(){ el.setAttribute('placeholder','Ask me anything'); });
  el.addEventListener('blur',function(){ if(!el.value) el.setAttribute('placeholder',order[i]); });
}
function askPhStop(){ if(ASK.ph){ clearInterval(ASK.ph); ASK.ph=null; } }
window.addEventListener('hashchange',askPhStop);

function shade(hex){
  try{var c=hex.replace('#','');var r=parseInt(c.substr(0,2),16),g=parseInt(c.substr(2,2),16),b=parseInt(c.substr(4,2),16);
  return 'rgb('+Math.max(0,r-45)+','+Math.max(0,g-45)+','+Math.max(0,b-45)+')';}catch(e){return hex;}
}

/* A boy's game log, one line per game.
   The database holds his game as one row per category - rushing, defense,
   special teams - and the log used to print each of them: three lines for one
   Friday, each blank across the other two's columns, reading as three games.
   Here the rows of a game are added into one bag. A game any part of which is
   still awaiting approval is grey as a whole. Order is kept as sent - newest
   season first, latest week first. */
function playerGameLines(rows){
  var by={},out=[];
  (rows||[]).forEach(function(x){
    var k=x.season+'|'+(x.gameId||(x.week+'|'+x.opp));
    var g=by[k];
    if(!g){
      g=by[k]={season:x.season,gameId:x.gameId,week:x.week,opp:x.opp,
               home:x.home,away:x.away,hs:x.hs,as:x.as,prov:false,bag:{}};
      out.push(g);
    }
    if(x.prov) g.prov=true;
    var b=tsBagOf(x);
    Object.keys(b).forEach(function(f){
      if(b[f]===null||b[f]===undefined||b[f]==='') return;
      g.bag[f]=(g.bag[f]||0)+Number(b[f]);
    });
  });
  return out;
}
/* "W 26-6", read from his side of the field. Blank when the score is not in,
   or when the schedule does not say which side he was on. */
function gameResultFor(g,teamId){
  if(!g||!has(g.hs)||!has(g.as)||!teamId) return '';
  var mine,theirs;
  if(teamId===g.home){ mine=+g.hs; theirs=+g.as; }
  else if(teamId===g.away){ mine=+g.as; theirs=+g.hs; }
  else return '';
  return (mine>theirs?'W ':mine<theirs?'L ':'T ')+mine+'-'+theirs;
}

function pgPlayer(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  return request('svcPlayer',[r.id]).then(function(p){
    if(!p){render('<div class="err">Player not found.</div>');return;}
    var cur=p.seasons.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.seasonId<b.seasonId?1:-1;})[0]||{};
    var t=team(cur.teamId);
    /* What a card would say about him: his newest season with numbers in it,
       or his career if this year has not started. Zeroes are left off, so a
       lineman with no counting stats simply gets a card with none rather than
       a row of noughts. */
    (function(){
      var seasons=(p.seasonStats||[]).slice()
        .sort(function(a,b){return a.seasonId<b.seasonId?1:-1;});
      var pick=null,label='';
      for(var i=0;i<seasons.length;i++){
        if(statTiles(seasons[i]).length){ pick=seasons[i]; label=seasonYear(seasons[i].seasonId)+' Season'; break; }
      }
      if(!pick&&p.career){ pick=p.career; label='Career'; }
      p.__cur=cur;
      p.__catLabel=label||'Profile';
      p.__seasonTiles=pick?statTiles(pick):[];
      PLAYERPG=p;
    })();
    /* Every player's face is his number - or his team's logo when he has none.
       No photo pipeline: a site full of minors does not host uploads. */
    var face = cur.jersey
      ? '<div style="width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);'+
        'border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;'+
        'justify-content:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;font-size:'+
        (String(cur.jersey).length>1?'24px':'30px')+';color:#fff;flex:none">'+esc(cur.jersey)+'</div>'
      : (t.logo?teamLink(cur.teamId,t.name,teamLogo(cur.teamId,t,' style="width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:contain"')):'');
    var h='<div class="thead" style="background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(7,9,19,.84),rgba(7,9,19,.58)),linear-gradient(135deg,'+esc(t.color)+' 0%,'+esc(shade(t.color))+' 100%)">'+
      face+
      '<div><h1>'+esc(p.name)+vMark(p.id)+capMark(p.id,cur.seasonId)+acbMark(p.id,cur.seasonId)+'</h1><div class="sub">'+
      (cur.jersey?'#'+esc(cur.jersey)+' · ':'')+(cur.pos?esc(cur.pos)+' · ':'')+
      esc(t.name||'')+(p.grad?' · Class of '+esc(p.grad):'')+'</div>'+
      heroFacts(p,cur)+shareBtn('player',p.id)+'</div>';
    if(p.career) h+='<div class="rec">'+(p.career.seasons||1)+'<small>season'+((p.career.seasons||1)>1?'s':'')+'</small></div>';
    h+='</div>';

    var secs=[['profile','Profile']];
    if(p.seasonStats.length)secs.push(['seasons','Season by Season']);
    if(p.gameLog.length)secs.push(['log','Game Log']);
    if(secs.length>1)h+=secNav(secs);
    h+='<div id="sec-profile">'+playerMeta(p,cur)+'</div>';

    /* The whole box score. Season by season, the career and the game log are
       drawn from the one column list a school's Stats tab reads, so a boy's
       own page can never show less of him than his team's does. It did: the
       page named eleven columns of its own and the log four, so a safety's
       pass break-ups, forced fumbles and pick-six were on his school's table
       and missing from his. The phase filter governs all three tables at
       once, and a column no row shown has a number in is dropped. */

    /* Which school he was at each season, for reading a result from his
       side of the field. */
    var teamOfSeason={};
    p.seasons.forEach(function(s){ if(s.seasonId&&s.teamId) teamOfSeason[s.seasonId]=s.teamId; });
    p.seasonStats.forEach(function(x){
      if(x.seasonId&&x.teamId&&!teamOfSeason[x.seasonId]) teamOfSeason[x.seasonId]=x.teamId; });

    /* Every season this player actually has a line in, newest first, and the
       All that spans them. Built from his own rows rather than from the site's
       season list: a sophomore has no business being offered 2024. */
    var pSeasons=(function(){
      var seen={},out=[];
      p.seasonStats.forEach(function(x){ if(!seen[x.seasonId]){seen[x.seasonId]=1;out.push(x.seasonId);} });
      p.gameLog.forEach(function(x){ if(!seen[x.season]){seen[x.season]=1;out.push(x.season);} });
      return out.sort().reverse();
    })();
    var PLAYER_SEASON='all';
    function seasonSwitch(){
      if(pSeasons.length<2) return '';   // one season is not a choice
      return '<div class="seg" id="pys" role="tablist" aria-label="Season" '+
        'style="margin:12px 0 2px">'+
        [['all','All']].concat(pSeasons.map(function(s){return [s,seasonLabel(s)];}))
        .map(function(x){
          var on=x[0]===PLAYER_SEASON;
          return '<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(on?'true':'false')+'"'+
            (on?' class="on"':'')+' data-ys="'+esc(x[0])+'">'+esc(x[1])+'</button>';
        }).join('')+'</div>';
    }
    var inSeason=function(id){ return PLAYER_SEASON==='all'||id===PLAYER_SEASON; };

    /* A column earns its place by having a number in it - tsCols() applies the
       phase and then that test, over the rows being shown. Asked for a
       defensive lineman's offense the honest answer is nothing at all, not
       seven headings over seven blanks - and a season filter narrows the rows
       first, so the columns describe the season being looked at rather than
       the career. */
    /* Under one phase, a row with nothing in that phase goes too: asked for
       his special teams, the season he never returned a kick is not a line of
       blanks. Under All, every season he has a line in stays - a lineman's
       two games with no counting stats are still two games. */
    function withAny(rows,cols,bagOf){
      if(STAT_PHASE==='all') return rows;
      return rows.filter(function(r){
        var b=bagOf(r);
        return cols.some(function(c){ var v=tsVal(b,c); return v!==null&&!isNaN(v)&&Number(v)!==0; });
      });
    }
    function playerStatsPane(){
      var srows=p.seasonStats.filter(function(x){return inSeason(x.seasonId);});
      var lrows=playerGameLines(p.gameLog.filter(function(x){return inSeason(x.season);}));
      var sc=tsCols(srows.map(tsBagOf));
      var lc=tsCols(lrows.map(function(g){return g.bag;}));
      srows=withAny(srows,sc,tsBagOf);
      lrows=withAny(lrows,lc,function(g){return g.bag;});
      /* Career totals are the career; a season filter does not narrow them, so
         they are shown only when the reader is looking at the whole of it. */
      var cbag=(PLAYER_SEASON==='all'&&p.career)?tsBagOf(p.career):null;
      var cc=cbag?tsCols([cbag]):[];
      var s=seasonSwitch()+phaseSwitch('pp');
      if(!sc.length&&!lc.length) return s+phaseEmpty();
      if(srows.length&&sc.length){
        s+='<div id="sec-seasons"><h2>Season by Season</h2>'+tbl('ss',
          [{t:'Season'},{t:'Team'},{t:'GP',n:1}].concat(sc.map(function(c){return {t:c.label,n:1};})),
          srows,function(x){
            var bag=tsBagOf(x);
            return '<tr'+(x.prov?' class="prov" title="includes player-entered stats awaiting approval"':'')+
              '><td class="nm">'+esc(seasonLabel(x.seasonId))+'</td><td><a href="#/team/'+esc(x.teamId)+'">'+
              esc(tname(x.teamId))+'</a></td><td class="n" data-v="'+(x.gp||0)+'">'+n(x.gp)+'</td>'+
              sc.map(function(c){return tsCell(tsVal(bag,c),c,false);}).join('')+'</tr>';});
        if(cc.length){
          var c=p.career;
          s+='<div class="card'+(c.prov?' prov':'')+'" style="margin-top:10px"><div class="hd">Career Totals'+
            (c.prov?' <span style="font-weight:400;font-size:11px">includes unapproved player-entered stats</span>':'')+'</div>'+
            '<div class="pad" style="display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-family:var(--mono)">'+
            [['Seasons',c.seasons],['GP',c.gp]].concat(cc.map(function(f){return [f.label,tsText(tsVal(cbag,f),f)];}))
            .filter(function(x){return x[1];}).map(function(x){
              return '<div><div class="eyebrow">'+esc(x[0])+'</div><b style="font-size:19px">'+esc(x[1])+'</b></div>';}).join('')+
            '</div></div>';}
        s+='</div>';
      }
      if(lrows.length&&lc.length){
        s+='<div id="sec-log"><h2>Game Log</h2>'+tbl('gl',
          [{t:'Season'},{t:'Wk',n:1},{t:'Opp'},{t:'Result'}].concat(lc.map(function(c){return {t:c.label,n:1};})),
          lrows,function(g){
            return '<tr'+(g.prov?' class="prov" title="includes player-entered stats awaiting approval"':'')+
              '><td>'+esc(seasonLabel(g.season))+'</td><td class="n" data-v="'+(g.week||0)+'">'+n(g.week)+'</td>'+
              '<td>'+esc(g.opp)+'</td><td>'+esc(gameResultFor(g,teamOfSeason[g.season]))+'</td>'+
              lc.map(function(c){return tsCell(tsVal(g.bag,c),c,false);}).join('')+'</tr>';})+'</div>';
      }
      return s;
    }

    if(p.seasonStats.length||p.gameLog.length) h+='<div id="pstats"></div>';
    else h+='<div class="card pad muted" style="margin-top:16px">No statistics recorded for this player.</div>';
    render(h);
    /* One redraw for the whole stats block, so the phase control on a player's
       page behaves exactly like the one on a team's. */
    (function drawStats(){
      var box=document.getElementById('pstats');
      if(!box) return;
      box.innerHTML=playerStatsPane();
      sortable('ss'); sortable('gl');
      bindPhase(drawStats);
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-ys]').forEach(function(b){
        b.onclick=function(){ PLAYER_SEASON=b.dataset.ys; drawStats(); };
      });
      stickyHeads();
    })();
  });
}

/* The head coach's page: his program's colors, what he has chosen to say
   about himself, and the season under him. Fields a coach left blank are
   omitted - same rule as a player's hero. */
function pgCoach(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var t=team(r.id);
  return request('svcCoach',[r.id]).then(function(c){
    if(!c||!t){render('<div class="err">No coach page for that team.</div>');return;}
    var facts=[];
    if(has(c.age)) facts.push(['AGE',c.age]);
    if(has(c.highSchool)) facts.push(['HIGH SCHOOL',c.highSchool]);
    if(has(c.almaMater)) facts.push(['ALMA MATER',c.almaMater]);
    if(has(c.hcSince)) facts.push(['HC SINCE',c.hcSince+(c.hcYears?' · year '+c.hcYears:'')]);
    if(has(c.yearsCoaching)) facts.push(['YRS COACHING',c.yearsCoaching]);
    (function(){
      var tiles=[];
      if(c.standing&&has(c.standing.w)) tiles.push({k:'RECORD',v:n(c.standing.w)+'-'+n(c.standing.l)});
      if(c.standing&&has(c.standing.cw)) tiles.push({k:'CONFERENCE',v:n(c.standing.cw)+'-'+n(c.standing.cl)});
      if(has(c.hcYears)) tiles.push({k:'YEAR AS HC',v:c.hcYears});
      COACHPG={id:r.id,name:c.name,title:'Head Coach',tiles:tiles};
    })();
    var h=teamStrip(r.id);
    h+='<div class="thead" style="background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(7,9,19,.84),rgba(7,9,19,.58)),linear-gradient(135deg,'+esc(t.color)+' 0%,'+esc(shade(t.color))+' 100%)">'+
      (t.logo?'<img src="'+esc(t.logo)+'" width="80" height="80" alt="'+esc(t.name)+' logo">':'')+
      '<div><h1>'+esc(c.name)+'</h1>'+
      '<div class="sub">Head Coach · <a href="#/team/'+esc(r.id)+'" style="color:inherit">'+
      esc(c.team)+'</a>'+(c.x?' · <a href="https://x.com/'+esc(c.x)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:inherit">@'+esc(c.x)+'</a>':'')+
      (c.ig?' · <a href="https://instagram.com/'+esc(c.ig)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:inherit" title="Instagram">@'+esc(c.ig)+' <small>IG</small></a>':'')+'</div>'+
      (facts.length?'<div class="hfacts">'+facts.map(function(f){
        return '<span class="hf"><span class="hf-k">'+esc(f[0])+'</span> '+esc(f[1])+'</span>';
      }).join('')+'</div>':'')+shareBtn('coach',r.id)+'</div>'+
      (c.standing?'<div class="rec">'+c.standing.w+'-'+c.standing.l+'<small>'+c.standing.cw+'-'+c.standing.cl+' conference</small></div>':'')+
      '</div>';
    if(has(c.highlights))
      h+='<div class="card pad" style="margin-top:10px;border-top:3px solid var(--accent)">'+
         '<span class="eyebrow" style="margin:0">Highlights</span> '+esc(c.highlights)+'</div>';
    /* every assistant is his own card: the same fields the head coach wears,
       filled through the same portal form. A coach who has entered nothing is
       a name - present, findable, and invited to say more. */
    var aps=c.staffProfiles||[];
    if(aps.length){
      h+='<h2 style="margin:16px 2px 8px">Coaching staff</h2><div class="grid g2">'+
        aps.map(function(a){
          var bits=[];
          if(has(a.age)) bits.push('Age '+a.age);
          if(has(a.highSchool)) bits.push(esc(a.highSchool));
          if(has(a.almaMater)) bits.push(esc(a.almaMater));
          if(has(a.yearsCoaching)) bits.push(a.yearsCoaching+' yrs coaching');
          return '<div class="card pad"><b>'+esc(a.name)+'</b>'+
            ' <span class="muted" style="font-size:12px">'+esc(a.type)+'</span>'+
            (a.x?' · <a href="https://x.com/'+esc(a.x)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">@'+esc(a.x)+'</a>':'')+
            (a.ig?' · <a href="https://instagram.com/'+esc(a.ig)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Instagram">@'+esc(a.ig)+' <small>IG</small></a>':'')+
            (bits.length?'<div class="muted" style="font-size:13px;margin-top:3px">'+bits.join(' · ')+'</div>':'')+
            (has(a.highlights)?'<div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:3px">'+esc(a.highlights)+'</div>':'')+
            '</div>';
        }).join('')+'</div>';
    } else if(c.staff&&c.staff.length){
      h+='<div class="card pad" style="margin-top:10px"><span class="eyebrow" style="margin:0">Assistant coaches</span> '+
         c.staff.map(esc).join(' · ')+'</div>';
    }
    h+='<p style="margin-top:12px"><a href="#/team/'+esc(r.id)+'">&#8592; '+esc(c.team)+' team page</a></p>';
    render(h);
  });
}

var GAME=null;      // the game on screen, for the cards drawn from it
function pgGame(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  return request('svcGame',[r.id]).then(function(g){
    if(!g){render('<div class="err">Game not found.</div>');return;}
    var h=team(g.home),a=team(g.away),done=has(g.hs)&&has(g.as);
    GAME=g;
    var ids=Object.keys(g.stats||{});
    var out=ids.length?secNav([['matchup','Matchup']].concat(ids.map(function(tid){
      return [tid,tname(tid)];}))):'';
    out+='<div class="card" id="sec-matchup" style="margin-bottom:14px"><div class="pad" style="text-align:center">'+
      '<div class="eyebrow">'+(g.phase==='Round'?'Playoff Round ':'Week ')+n(g.week)+' · '+
      esc(g.status==='FORFEIT'?'Forfeit':(done?'Final':'Scheduled'))+'</div>'+
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:26px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
      teamScore(a,g.as,done&&g.as>g.hs,g.awayName,g.away,'AWAY')+
      '<span class="muted" style="font-family:var(--mono)">at</span>'+
      teamScore(h,g.hs,done&&g.hs>g.as,g.homeName,g.home,'HOME')+'</div>'+
      (done?'<div class="qshare"><button type="button" class="linky" data-gshare="1">'+
            shareGlyph()+'Share the final</button></div>':'')+
      '</div></div>';

    if(!ids.length){
      out+='<div class="card pad muted">No player statistics were reported for this game.</div>';
    } else {
      ids.forEach(function(tid){
        var rows=g.stats[tid], byCat={};
        rows.forEach(function(x){(byCat[x.cat]=byCat[x.cat]||[]).push(x);});
        out+='<h2 id="sec-'+esc(tid)+'">'+teamLink(tid,tname(tid))+'</h2>';
        Object.keys(byCat).forEach(function(cat){
          var cols,fn;
          /* A share cell at the end of every row. It is empty until the row
             is hovered or focused, so a box score reads as a box score and
             the offer is there the moment somebody looks for it. */
          if(cat==='Passing'){cols=[{t:'Player'},{t:'C/A',n:1},{t:'Yds',n:1},{t:'TD',n:1},{t:'INT',n:1},{t:''}];
            fn=function(x){return '<tr'+(x.prov?' class="prov" title="player-entered, awaiting approval"':'')+'><td class="nm">'+plink(x,g.season)+'</td><td class="n">'+
              n(x.passComp)+'/'+n(x.passAtt)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.passYds)+'</td><td class="n">'+
              n(x.passTD)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.passInt)+'</td>'+rowShare(tid,cat,x)+'</tr>';};}
          else if(cat==='Rushing'){cols=[{t:'Player'},{t:'Att',n:1},{t:'Yds',n:1},{t:'TD',n:1},{t:''}];
            fn=function(x){return '<tr'+(x.prov?' class="prov" title="player-entered, awaiting approval"':'')+'><td class="nm">'+plink(x,g.season)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.rushAtt)+
              '</td><td class="n">'+n(x.rushYds)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.rushTD)+'</td>'+rowShare(tid,cat,x)+'</tr>';};}
          else if(cat==='Receiving'){cols=[{t:'Player'},{t:'Rec',n:1},{t:'Yds',n:1},{t:'TD',n:1},{t:''}];
            fn=function(x){return '<tr'+(x.prov?' class="prov" title="player-entered, awaiting approval"':'')+'><td class="nm">'+plink(x,g.season)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.rec)+
              '</td><td class="n">'+n(x.recYds)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.recTD)+'</td>'+rowShare(tid,cat,x)+'</tr>';};}
          else {cols=[{t:'Player'},{t:'Solo',n:1},{t:'Ast',n:1},{t:'TFL',n:1},{t:'Sacks',n:1},{t:'INT',n:1},{t:''}];
            fn=function(x){return '<tr'+(x.prov?' class="prov" title="player-entered, awaiting approval"':'')+'><td class="nm">'+plink(x,g.season)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.solo)+
              '</td><td class="n">'+n(x.asst)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.tfl)+'</td><td class="n">'+
              n(x.sacks)+'</td><td class="n">'+n(x.int)+'</td>'+rowShare(tid,cat,x)+'</tr>';};}
          out+='<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:10px"><div class="hd">'+esc(cat)+'</div>'+
               tbl('',cols,byCat[cat],fn)+'</div>';
        });
      });
    }
    render(out);
  });
}
/* Box-score name cell. The season comes from the GAME, not from the header -
   reading a 2024 box score with this year's selector up must not mark this
   year's captains, or leave last year's unmarked. */
function plink(x,seasonId){return playerLink(x.playerId,x.name,seasonId);}
function teamScore(t,sc,win,fallback,teamId,role){
  var badge=teamLogo(teamId,t,' style="width:56px;height:56px;object-fit:contain"')+
    '<div style="font-weight:700;margin-top:4px">'+rankMark(teamId)+esc(t.name||fallback||teamId||'')+'</div>';
  return '<div style="text-align:center">'+teamLink(teamId,t.name,badge)+
    (role?'<div style="font:600 9px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.09em;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:2px">'+role+'</div>':'')+
    '<div style="font:800 34px var(--mono);'+(win?'':'opacity:.55')+'">'+(has(sc)?sc:'-')+'</div></div>';
}

/* Standings is a section of Home now - one table fewer to hunt for. The route
   survives so old links and bookmarks land on that same table, mid-scroll. */
function pgStandings(){
  var request=routeRequest();
  location.hash='#/?sec=standings';
  return Promise.resolve();
}

/* Leaders was the same question as Stats asked with fewer controls - one
   category, top twenty-five, no filters. It is now a preset on the Stats page
   rather than a second table to keep in step with the first. Old links keep
   working: the category comes across as the sort column. */
function pgLeaders(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var cat=r.qs.cat||'PassYds';
  var side=DEFENSE_KEYS[cat]?'DEFENSE':'OFFENSE';
  // hash assignment, like every other navigation in this file - the router is
  // already listening for it, and it keeps the back button working
  location.hash='#/stats?sort='+encodeURIComponent(cat)+'&side='+side;
  return Promise.resolve();
}
var DEFENSE_KEYS={TacklesTotal:1,TackleSolo:1,TackleAssist:1,TFL:1,Sacks:1,
                  Int:1,PassDef:1,FF:1,FR:1,DefTD:1};

/* - All-Conference - */
var TIERS=[['First Team','ft'],['Second Team','st'],['Honorable Mention','hm']];

function pgAllConference(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  return request('svcAllConference',[SEASON]).then(function(d){
    /* The formula version rides along as the tooltip, not the text: "live"
       is what the reader needs to know, and it is red and blinking to say so. */
    var h='<div class="muted"><span class="live"'+(d.formulaVersion?' title="Formula '+esc(d.formulaVersion)+'"':'')+
          '><i aria-hidden="true"></i>live projection</span></div>';

    /* Closed until asked for. Anyone on this page a second time already knows
       how it works, and the rankings - not the manual - are the page. Points,
       not sentences, per the house rule. */
    h+='<details class="acf" style="margin-top:12px"><summary>How this page works</summary>'+
       '<ul style="margin:6px 0 0 18px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55">'+
       '<li>Stats only - no votes, no reputation.</li>'+
       '<li>Ranked within position, conference-wide.</li>'+
       '<li>Each stat &rarr; percentile &rarr; position&rsquo;s published weights (<i>How this position is scored</i>, under each section).</li>'+
       '<li>Recomputes as stats are entered.</li>'+
       '<li>Live projection - not official selections.</li>'+
       '</ul>'+acEligibilityBlock(d)+'</details>';

    if(!d.positions||!d.positions.length){
      h+=emptySeason('No projection yet for '+seasonLabel(SEASON)+'. It appears once '+
                     'rosters carry positions and games have been played.');
      render(h); return;
    }

    h+=secNav(d.positions.map(function(p,i){return ['pos'+i,p.label];}));
    d.positions.forEach(function(p,i){
      h+='<div class="card acpos" id="sec-pos'+i+'"><div class="achead"><b>'+esc(p.label)+'</b>';
      if(p.slots) h+='<span class="muted"> &middot; '+p.slots+' First Team</span>';
      if(p.poolSchools) h+='<span class="muted"> &middot; '+p.poolSize+
                           ' eligible from '+p.poolSchools+' school'+(p.poolSchools===1?'':'s')+'</span>';
      h+='</div>';
      h+=acFormulaBlock(p);

      var awarded=p.players.filter(function(x){return x.tier&&x.tier!=='Outside'&&x.playerId;});

      // only warn about a thin pool when there is a ranking to qualify; a
      // position with nobody in it explains itself below
      if(p.thin&&awarded.length) h+='<div class="thin">Drawn from too few schools to be a '+
                    'conference ranking yet - shown for transparency.</div>';

      if(!awarded.length){
        h+='<div class="pad muted">No eligible '+esc(p.label)+(/s$/i.test(p.label)?'':'s')+
           ' yet - this section fills in as stats are entered.</div></div>';
        return;
      }
      TIERS.forEach(function(t){
        var rows=awarded.filter(function(x){return x.tier===t[0];});
        if(!rows.length) return;
        h+='<div class="tier '+t[1]+'"><div class="tlabel">'+t[0]+'</div>'+
           rows.map(function(x){
             var tm=team(x.teamId);
             return '<div class="acrow">'+
               (tm.logo?teamLink(x.teamId,tm.name,teamLogo(x.teamId,tm,'')):'<i class="nologo"></i>')+
               '<span class="nm">'+playerLink(x.playerId,x.player,SEASON)+'</span>'+
               '<a class="tm" href="#/team/'+esc(x.teamId)+'">'+esc(x.team)+'</a>'+
               (x.score==null?'':'<span class="sc" title="Position score, 0-100: each stat '+
                 'becomes a percentile within the position, combined by the published '+
                 'weights above. Open How this position is scored.">'+
                 '<span class="sc-k">Score</span>'+x.score.toFixed(1)+'</span>')+
               '<span class="cf'+(x.status==='Provisional'?' prov':'')+'">'+
                 esc(x.status==='Provisional'?'provisional':(x.confidenceLabel||''))+'</span>'+
               '</div>';}).join('')+'</div>';
      });
      h+='</div>';
    });

    h+='<div class="card pad muted small">Scores are percentile-based within each '+
       'position and carry no coach voting, reputation or class-year adjustment.</div>';
    render(h);
  });
}

/* Eligibility, under How this page works: the rules every ranked player
   meets, then a row per position that opens to the rules particular to it.
   Both come from the server, written beside the thresholds they describe;
   a payload from before they were published falls back to the threshold
   line the formula block already carries. */
function acEligibilityBlock(d){
  var common=(d.eligibility&&d.eligibility.length)?d.eligibility:
    ['Listed at the position on the team roster.','Stats from 2 or more conference games.'];
  var pos=d.positions||[];
  var h='<div class="ace"><div class="ace-t">Eligibility</div><ul>'+
    common.map(function(s){return '<li>'+esc(s)+'</li>';}).join('')+
    (pos.length?'<li>A minimum workload that differs by position - open one:</li>':'')+'</ul>';
  pos.forEach(function(p){
    var rules=(p.eligibility&&p.eligibility.length)?p.eligibility:acRulesFallback(p);
    if(!rules.length)return;
    h+='<details class="acf ace-p"><summary>'+esc(p.label)+'</summary><ul>'+
       rules.map(function(s){return '<li>'+esc(s)+'</li>';}).join('')+'</ul></details>';
  });
  return h+'</div>';
}
function acRulesFallback(p){
  var f=p.formula||{};
  if(f.threshold)return ['Minimum: '+f.threshold+'.'];
  if(f.note)return [f.note];
  return [];
}

/* The expandable formula under each position header - rendered straight from
   the server's weight table, so what readers see is what the ranking ran. */
function acFormulaBlock(p){
  var f=p.formula;
  if(!f||(!f.weights.length&&!f.note))return '';
  var body;
  if(!f.weights.length){
    body='<div class="muted" style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.55">'+esc(f.note)+'</div>';
  } else {
    body='<div class="muted" style="font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px">Each stat becomes a '+
      'percentile among eligible '+esc(p.label)+'s, then counts this much of the score'+
      (f.threshold?' &middot; eligibility: '+esc(f.threshold):'')+':</div>'+
      '<div class="acfw">'+f.weights.map(function(w){
        return '<div class="acfrow"><span class="pctb"><i style="width:'+Math.min(100,w.pct*3)+'%"></i></span>'+
          '<b>'+w.pct+'%</b><span>'+esc(w.label)+(w.lower?' <em>(lower is better)</em>':'')+
          /* A metric that is itself a formula shows it here. QB rating is the
             only one so far, and it carries more of a quarterback's score than
             any other single term — a reader asked to accept that should be
             able to see the arithmetic rather than take the name on trust. */
          (w.detail?' <em class="acdet">('+esc(w.detail)+')</em>':'')+'</span></div>';
      }).join('')+'</div>';
  }
  return '<details class="acf"><summary>How this position is scored</summary>'+body+'</details>';
}


/* The profile block under a player's header: commitment, measurables, awards and
   their own links. Every field is optional - a blank one is omitted rather than
   rendered as an empty row, because most players have most of these blank. */
/* Everything a player reports about himself, worn in the hero under his name
   rather than parked in cards below the fold: who he is and what he measures,
   read in the order a recruiter reads them. One blank field is omitted, not
   shown as a dash - most players have most of these blank, and a strip of
