   dashes says nothing. Same numbers as the roster board and the Measurables
   side of Stats. */
function heroFacts(p,cur){
  var facts=[];
  /* His place at his position in the live projections - "RB5" - ONLY here on
     his own page, never beside names elsewhere. The server already refused to
     rank anyone outside the top fifteen or without a game played. */
  var rk=BOOT&&BOOT.acrank&&BOOT.acrank[cur.seasonId||SEASON];
  rk=rk&&rk[p.id];
  if(rk) facts.push(['AC RANK',rk.split('|').join(' · ')]);
  if(has(cur.ht)) facts.push(['HT',Math.floor(cur.ht/12)+"'"+(cur.ht%12)+'"']);
  if(has(cur.wt)) facts.push(['WT',cur.wt+' lb']);
  [['gpa','GPA',2,''],['forty','40',2,'s'],['bench','BENCH',0,''],
   ['squat','SQUAT',0,''],['clean','CLEAN',0,''],
   ['vertical','VERT',1,'"'],['shuttle','SHUTTLE',2,'s']]
  .forEach(function(m){
    if(has(cur[m[0]])) facts.push([m[1],Number(cur[m[0]]).toFixed(m[2])+m[3]]);
  });
  if(has(p.hometown)) facts.push(['FROM',p.hometown]);
  if(!facts.length) return '';
  return '<div class="hfacts">'+facts.map(function(f){
    return '<span class="hf"><span class="hf-k">'+esc(f[0])+'</span> '+esc(f[1])+'</span>';
  }).join('')+'</div>';
}

function playerMeta(p,cur){
  var out='';

  if(has(p.commitment))
    out+='<div class="card pad" style="margin-top:10px;border-top:3px solid var(--accent)">'+
         '<span class="eyebrow" style="margin:0">Committed</span> <b>'+esc(p.commitment)+'</b>'+
         (has(p.commitmentLevel)?' <span class="muted">'+esc(p.commitmentLevel)+'</span>':'')+'</div>';
  if(p.offers&&p.offers.length)
    out+='<div class="card pad" style="margin-top:10px"><span class="eyebrow" style="margin:0">Offers</span> '+
         p.offers.map(function(o){
           return '<span class="pill" style="margin:2px 4px 2px 0">'+esc(o.school)+
             (o.level?' <span class="muted">'+esc(o.level)+'</span>':'')+'</span>';
         }).join('')+'</div>';

  if((p.awards||[]).length){
    var by={};
    p.awards.forEach(function(a){(by[a.seasonId]=by[a.seasonId]||[]).push(a);});
    out+='<h2>Accolades</h2><div class="card"><div class="pad">'+
      Object.keys(by).sort().reverse().map(function(sid){
        return '<div style="margin-bottom:8px"><span class="eyebrow">'+esc(seasonLabel(sid))+'</span>'+
          by[sid].map(function(a){
            return '<div style="font-size:14px">'+esc(a.award)+
              (has(a.detail)&&a.detail!=='Selected'?' <span class="muted">- '+esc(a.detail)+'</span>':'')+
              '</div>';}).join('')+'</div>';}).join('')+
      '</div></div>';
  }

  var L=p.links||{}, links=[];
  function add(u,label,base){
    if(!has(u))return;
    var url=/^https?:/i.test(u)?u:((base||'')+String(u).replace(/^@/,''));
    if(!base&&!/^https?:/i.test(u))return;
    links.push('<a href="'+esc(url)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+esc(label)+'</a>');
  }
  add(L.hudl,'Hudl'); add(L.maxpreps,'MaxPreps');
  add(L.x,'X','https://x.com/'); add(L.instagram,'Instagram','https://instagram.com/');
  if(links.length) out+='<div class="tlinks">'+links.join('')+'</div>';

  if(has(p.bio)) out+='<div class="card pad" style="margin-top:10px">'+esc(p.bio)+'</div>';
  return out;
}

/* Team's own links. base target is _self for in-app routing, so anything leaving
   the site has to say target="_blank" itself.

   Every value here is a spreadsheet cell, so nothing becomes an href until it
   looks like one: a scheme test keeps "javascript:" out of the page, and keeps a
   school NAME from being linked as though it were a school ADDRESS. */
function teamLinks(t){
  var out=[];
  function add(url,label){
    if(!has(url)||!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url))return;
    out.push('<a href="'+esc(url)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+esc(label)+'</a>');
  }
  function handle(h,base,label){
    if(!has(h))return;
    add(/^https?:/i.test(h)?h:(base+String(h).replace(/^@/,'')),label);
  }
  add(t.hudl,'Hudl'); add(t.maxpreps,'MaxPreps'); add(t.schoolUrl||t.school,'School site');
  handle(t.x,'https://x.com/','X'); handle(t.ig,'https://instagram.com/','Instagram');
  add(t.facebook,'Facebook'); add(t.youtube,'YouTube'); add(t.tiktok,'TikTok');
  return out.length?('<div class="tlinks">'+out.join('')+'</div>'):'';
}

/* - Stats - */
var SF=null;                                   /* filter options, fetched once */
var SQFOCUS=false;                             /* hand the search box its focus back */

/* The filter state lives in the hash so a filtered view is linkable and the back
   button works. Anything left at its default is omitted, keeping URLs readable.
   The season is part of that state: a link that reproduced every filter except
   which year they were read for is not a link to what the sender was looking at. */
var SDEF={scope:'PLAYER',side:'OFFENSE',range:'SEASON',season:'',county:'',team:'',pos:'',
          q:'',sort:'',dir:'DESC',page:'0',min:'',allowed:''};

/* Allowed implies Teams. The server settles this too — it must, because a
   hand-typed link can say anything — but doing it here as well keeps the
   Scope control from showing "Players" over a table of schools. */
function sFixSide(o){
  if(o.side==='MEASURE'&&o.scope==='TEAM') o.side='ALL';
  /* Allowed only means something for a team's defence. Leaving it set while
     the reader moves to Offense, or to Players, would quietly serve them a
     table they did not ask for under a heading that says otherwise. */
  if(!(o.scope==='TEAM'&&o.side==='DEFENSE')) o.allowed='';
  return o;
}

function sQuery(qs){
  var o={};
  Object.keys(SDEF).forEach(function(k){o[k]=(qs[k]!==undefined&&qs[k]!=='')?qs[k]:SDEF[k];});
  return sFixSide(o);
}
function sHash(o){
  var parts=[];
  Object.keys(SDEF).forEach(function(k){
    if(String(o[k])!==String(SDEF[k])&&o[k]!=='') parts.push(k+'='+encodeURIComponent(o[k]));});
  return '#/stats'+(parts.length?'?'+parts.join('&'):'');
}
function sGo(patch){
  var o=sQuery(parseHash().qs);
  Object.keys(patch).forEach(function(k){o[k]=patch[k];});
  if(!('page' in patch)) o.page='0';           /* any filter change returns to page 1 */
  /* stamp the season being read, and drop it again for the ranges that span
     several - carrying one there would claim a precision the table does not have */
  if(o.range==='SEASON'){ if(!patch.season) o.season=SEASON; }
  else o.season='';
  location.hash=sHash(o);
}

function pgStats(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var o=sQuery(r.qs);
  /* Somebody else's link arrives with their season on it. Adopt it before asking
     the server and move the header select with it, so the table and the control
     in the corner never disagree about what year this is. */
  if(o.range==='SEASON'&&o.season&&o.season!==SEASON&&
     (BOOT.seasons||[]).some(function(x){return x.id===o.season;})){
    SEASON=o.season;
    var sl=document.getElementById('season'); if(sl){sl.value=SEASON;smartSelectSync(sl);}
  }
  var need = SF ? Promise.resolve(SF) : request('svcStatsFilters').then(function(f){SF=f;return f;});
  // Options and results are independent, so neither waits for the other.
  var single=(o.range!=='LAST4'&&o.range!=='ALL');
  var seasonId=single?(o.range==='SEASON'?SEASON:o.range):'';
  var data=request('svcStats',[{
    scope:o.scope,side:o.side,timeRange:single?'SEASON':o.range,seasonId:seasonId,
    county:o.county,teamId:o.team,position:o.pos,search:o.q,
    minGames:o.min===''?null:Number(o.min),sortBy:o.sort||null,sortDir:o.dir,
    limit:50,offset:Number(o.page||0)*50
  }]);
  return Promise.all([need,data]).then(function(values){renderStats(values[0],o,values[1]);});
}

/* `label` names the group to a screen reader when the filter key is not a word
   anybody says out loud - "fmt" is a hash key, "Scoring" is the control. */
function seg(name,opts,cur,label){
  return '<div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="'+esc(label||(name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+name.slice(1)))+'">'+opts.map(function(x){
    return '<button type="button" data-f="'+name+'" data-v="'+esc(x[0])+'" class="'+(String(cur)===String(x[0])?'on':'')+'">'+
      esc(x[1])+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div>';
}
function sel(name,label,opts,cur){
  var id='stats-filter-'+name;
  return '<div class="fg"><label for="'+id+'">'+esc(label)+'</label><select id="'+id+'" data-f="'+name+'">'+
    opts.map(function(x){
      return '<option value="'+esc(x[0])+'"'+(String(cur)===String(x[0])?' selected':'')+'>'+
        esc(x[1])+'</option>';}).join('')+'</select></div>';
}

/* A blank cell stays blank. Nobody reported it, and a 0 here would be a claim
   that somebody tried and failed - which is exactly what every unreported KR and
   PR column would say if this returned a number for an absent value. */
/* Position picker: majors as group headings, their sub-positions indented
   beneath. Choosing Linebacker includes both inside and outside; choosing
   Inside Linebacker narrows to players actually listed there. */
function posSelect(f,cur){
  var opts=(f.positions||[]);
  var cnt=function(x){return has(x.players)?' ('+x.players+')':'';};
  var out='<div class="fg"><label for="stats-filter-pos">Position</label><select id="stats-filter-pos" data-f="pos">'+
    '<option value=""'+(cur?'':' selected')+'>All positions</option>';
  opts.filter(function(x){return !x.isSub;}).forEach(function(m){
    var subs=opts.filter(function(x){return x.isSub&&x.major===m.code;});
    if(!subs.length){
      out+='<option value="'+esc(m.code)+'"'+(cur===m.code?' selected':'')+'>'+
        esc(m.label||m.code)+cnt(m)+'</option>';
      return;
    }
    out+='<optgroup label="'+esc(m.label||m.code)+'">'+
      '<option value="'+esc(m.code)+'"'+(cur===m.code?' selected':'')+'>All '+
      esc(m.label||m.code)+cnt(m)+'</option>'+
      subs.map(function(x){
        return '<option value="'+esc(x.code)+'"'+(cur===x.code?' selected':'')+'>'+
          esc(x.label||x.code)+cnt(x)+'</option>';}).join('')+
      '</optgroup>';
  });
  return out+'</select></div>';
}

function fmtCell(v,c){
  if(!has(v)) return '';
  if(c.format==='ftin') return Math.floor(Number(v)/12)+'&prime;'+(Number(v)%12)+'&Prime;';   // 73 -> 6′1″
  if(c.format==='pct1') return Number(v).toFixed(1)+'%';
  if(c.format==='dec1') return Number(v).toFixed(1);
  if(c.format==='dec2') return Number(v).toFixed(2);
  return esc(v);                     // text columns come straight off the sheet
}

function renderStats(f,o,d){
  var isPlayer=o.scope==='PLAYER';
  var m=d.meta||{};
  /* Straight to the filters: the tab says Stats, and the scope, season and
     count are all readable off the filters and the table itself. */
  var h='<div class="filters">';
  h+='<div class="fg fg-scope"><span class="fg-label">Scope</span>'+seg('scope',[['PLAYER','Players'],['TEAM','Teams']],o.scope)+'</div>';
  /* Measurables sit beside the three sides of the ball: the same table, filled
     from the roster instead of the box score — who runs the fastest 40, who
     squats the most. Players only; a team has no forty time. */
  var sideOpts=[['OFFENSE','Offense'],['DEFENSE','Defense'],['SPECIAL','Special'],['ALL','All']];
  if(o.scope!=='TEAM') sideOpts.push(['MEASURE','Measurables']);
  h+='<div class="fg fg-side"><span class="fg-label">Side</span>'+seg('side',sideOpts,o.side)+'</div>';
  /* What a defence RECORDED and what it ALLOWED are two different tables, and
     the second only exists for a team looking at its defence: a yard allowed
     is read off the other side's box score, and a single player has no share
     of one. So it appears exactly where it applies and nowhere else, rather
     than sitting in the Side row confusing the other four choices. */
  if(o.scope==='TEAM'&&o.side==='DEFENSE')
    h+='<div class="fg fg-def"><span class="fg-label">Defense</span>'+
       seg('allowed',[['','Recorded'],['1','Allowed']],o.allowed)+'</div>';
  var timeOpts=[];
  (f.seasons||[]).forEach(function(x){
    var id=x.id||x; timeOpts.push([id, x.label||seasonLabel(id)]);});
  timeOpts.push(['LAST4','Last 4 Years']);
  /* Every season summed IS a career, for a person — the rows are keyed on the
     player, so a boy who transferred still adds up to one line. It was only
     ever called the wrong thing: "All Time" reads as the conference's history,
     which is what it means for a TEAM and not what it means for a player. */
  timeOpts.push(['ALL',isPlayer?'Career':'All Time']);
  h+=sel('range','Time',timeOpts,o.range==='SEASON'?SEASON:o.range).replace('class="fg"','class="fg fg-time"');
  h+=sel('county','County',[['','All counties']].concat((f.counties||[]).map(function(c){
      return [c.key,c.label+' ('+c.teams+')'];})),o.county);
  /* Only the teams in the chosen county. Both filters are applied server-side and
     a Harford team under a Cecil county returns nothing, which reads as a bug
     rather than as the contradiction it is. */
  h+=sel('team','Team',[['','All teams']].concat((f.teams||[]).filter(function(t){
      return !o.county||t.county===o.county;}).map(function(t){
      return [t.id||t.teamId,t.name||t.label];})),o.team);
  if(isPlayer)
    h+=posSelect(f,o.pos);
  h+='<div class="fg"><label for="stats-filter-q">Search</label><input id="stats-filter-q" type="search" data-f="q" value="'+esc(o.q)+'" placeholder="Player name"></div>';
  h+='</div>';

  // The presets Leaders used to be. Each is just a sort on this same table, so
  // the numbers behind a leaderboard and the numbers behind the full table can
  // never drift apart the way two separate pages would.
  var presets = isPlayer
    ? (o.side==='MEASURE'
        ? [['Forty','40-Yard Dash'],['Bench','Bench'],['Squat','Squat'],
           ['Clean','Clean'],['Vertical','Vertical'],['Shuttle','Shuttle'],
           ['GPA','GPA'],['HeightInches','Height'],['WeightLbs','Weight']]
      : o.side==='DEFENSE'
        ? [['TacklesTotal','Tackles'],['Sacks','Sacks'],['TFL','TFL'],
           ['Int','Interceptions'],['PassDef','Pass Breakups'],['FF','Forced Fumbles']]
        : [['PassYds','Passing Yards'],['PassTD','Passing TD'],['RushYds','Rushing Yards'],
           ['RushTD','Rushing TD'],['RecYds','Receiving Yards'],['RecTD','Receiving TD'],
           ['TotalYds','All-Purpose Yards']])
    : [['PointsScored','Points For'],['PointsAllowed','Points Against'],
       ['TotalYds','Total Yards'],['RushYds','Rushing'],['PassYds','Passing']];
  var activeSort = o.sort || m.sortBy;
  h+='<div class="chips">'+presets.map(function(pr){
       return '<button type="button" data-f="sort" data-v="'+esc(pr[0])+'" class="'+
         (activeSort===pr[0]?'on':'')+'">'+esc(pr[1])+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div>';

  /* The sort the server actually applied. o.sort is blank until someone clicks a
     header, so trusting it alone leaves the default-sorted column unmarked - and
     the first click on it does nothing, because there is no direction to flip. */
  var eff=o.sort||m.sortBy||'', effDir=m.sortDir||o.dir||'DESC';

  if(!d.rows.length){
    h+= (o.range==='SEASON')
      ? emptySeason('Nothing matches these filters for '+seasonLabel(SEASON)+'.')
      : '<div class="card pad muted">Nothing matches these filters.</div>';
    render(h); wireStats(o,m,d.columns); return;
  }

  /* A column nobody in this view reported is dropped rather than printed as a
     stripe of blanks - kick and punt returns are unreported in every season on
     file, so "Special" would otherwise be a screen of empty columns. The count
     is stated under the table so the omission is visible, and the sorted column
     always stays, or the order would have no visible cause. */
  var gone=(m.emptyColumns||[]);
  var cols=(d.columns||[]).filter(function(c){return gone.indexOf(c.key)<0||c.key===eff;});
  var dropped=(d.columns||[]).length-cols.length;

  /* A chosen category reads beside the name, not wherever the canon puts it -
     a phone shows two columns, and the one somebody picked must be one of
     them. Only an explicit choice moves (a chip, a header, an arriving link);
     the default sort leaves the table in its natural order. */
  if(o.sort){
    var si=-1; cols.forEach(function(c,i){ if(c.key===eff) si=i; });
    if(si>1) cols.splice(1,0,cols.splice(si,1)[0]);
  }
  var tot=d.totals||{};

  h+='<div class="card"><div class="tw" role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label="Statistics table"><table id="stt"><thead><tr>'+ 
     cols.map(function(c){
       return '<th scope="col" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-sort="'+(c.key===eff?(effDir==='ASC'?'ascending':'descending'):'none')+'" class="'+(c.numeric===false?'':'n')+(c.key===eff?' son':'')+
         '" data-sort="'+esc(c.key)+'" title="'+
         esc((c.group||c.label)+(c.derived?' · derived on read, never stored':''))+'">'+
         esc(c.label)+(c.key===eff?(effDir==='ASC'?' -':' -'):'')+'</th>';}).join('')+
     '</tr></thead><tbody>'+
     d.rows.map(function(row){
       /* a player's captaincy belongs to a season, and a multi-season row spans
          several - mark him from the newest one the row actually covers */
       var rs=(row.seasonIds&&row.seasonIds[0])||(o.range==='SEASON'?SEASON:'');
       return '<tr'+(row.prov?' class="prov" title="includes player-entered stats awaiting approval"':'')+'>'+cols.map(function(c){
         if(c.key==='player') return '<td class="nm">'+playerLink(row.playerId,row.player,rs)+'</td>';
         if(c.key==='team')   return '<td>'+(row.teamId?'<a href="#/team/'+esc(row.teamId)+'">'+
                                             esc(row.team)+'</a>':esc(row.team))+'</td>';
         return '<td class="'+(c.numeric===false?'':'n')+'">'+fmtCell(row[c.key],c)+'</td>';
       }).join('')+'</tr>';}).join('')+
     '</tbody><tfoot><tr>'+
     cols.map(function(c,i){
       if(i===0) return '<td class="nm">Total · '+esc(String(m.total||d.rows.length))+'</td>';
       return '<td class="'+(c.numeric===false?'':'n')+'">'+fmtCell(tot[c.key],c)+'</td>';
     }).join('')+
     '</tr></tfoot></table></div></div>';

  var page=Number(o.page||0), total=Number(m.total||d.rows.length), last=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(total/50)-1);
  if(last>0)
    h+='<div class="pager"><span class="muted">'+(page*50+1)+'-'+(page*50+d.rows.length)+' of '+total+'</span>'+
       '<button type="button" id="prev"'+(page<=0?' disabled':'')+'>Previous</button>'+ 
       '<button type="button" id="next"'+(page>=last?' disabled':'')+'>Next</button></div>';

  var foot=[];
  if(dropped) foot.push(dropped+' column'+(dropped===1?'':'s')+' hidden: nobody in this '+
                        'view reported '+(dropped===1?'it':'them')+'.');
  if(total>d.rows.length) foot.push('The totals row covers all '+total+
                                    ' matching rows, not just this page.');
  /* An Allowed figure is read off the OTHER side's box score, so it is only as
     honest as the opponent's filing. A school missing from this board has not
     been forgotten - not enough of its opponents' lines are confirmed in, and
     saying so is better than a silent absence that reads as a broken page. */
  if(m.allowed&&(m.allowedThin||[]).length)
    foot.push((m.allowedThin.length===1?'One school is':m.allowedThin.length+' schools are')+
      ' not ranked here yet - fewer than '+m.allowedMinGames+' of their opponents\u2019 box '+
      'scores are confirmed complete: '+
      m.allowedThin.map(function(x){return x.team+' ('+x.games+')';}).join(', ')+'.');
  if(foot.length) h+='<div class="notes">'+foot.map(function(t){return '· '+esc(t);}).join('<br>')+'</div>';

  render(h); wireStats(o,m,d.columns);
}

/* Changing one filter can leave another one meaningless or contradictory. Clear
   those in the same hash write, so the page never asks the server a question
   whose answer is guaranteed to be an empty table. */
function sSideEffects(f,p,cols){
  if(f==='county') p.team='';                  // a team from another county matches nothing
  if(f==='scope'){ p.sort=''; p.pos=''; }      // team rows have neither that sort key nor a position
  if(f==='side')  p.sort='';                   // the sorted column may not be in the new side
  /* a preset chip opens its column in the column's own direction - the 40 and
     the shuttle fastest first - instead of inheriting whatever direction the
     last sort happened to leave in the hash */
  if(f==='sort'){
    var col=(cols||[]).filter(function(c){return c.key===p.sort;})[0];
    p.dir=col&&col.asc?'ASC':'DESC';
  }
  return p;
}
function wireStats(o,m,cols){
  var eff=o.sort||(m&&m.sortBy)||'', effDir=(m&&m.sortDir)||o.dir||'DESC';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-f]').forEach(function(el){
    var f=el.getAttribute('data-f');
    if(el.tagName==='BUTTON') el.onclick=function(){
      var p={};p[f]=el.getAttribute('data-v');sGo(sSideEffects(f,p,cols));};
    else if(el.tagName==='SELECT') el.onchange=function(){
      var p={};p[f]=el.value;sGo(sSideEffects(f,p,cols));};
    else if(el.tagName==='INPUT'){
      // the whole page re-renders on the hash change, so remember to hand the
      // box back its focus - searching is almost always followed by refining
      el.onkeydown=function(ev){if(ev.key==='Enter'){SQFOCUS=true;var p={};p[f]=el.value;sGo(p);}};
    }
  });
  if(SQFOCUS){
    SQFOCUS=false;
    var qi=document.querySelector('#app input[data-f="q"]');
    if(qi){qi.focus(); try{qi.setSelectionRange(qi.value.length,qi.value.length);}catch(e){}}
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('#stt thead th').forEach(function(th){
    function applySort(){
      var k=th.getAttribute('data-sort'); if(!k)return;
      /* clicking the active column flips direction; a new column starts
         descending, because most stats read "most first" — except the ones
         where lower is better (a 40 time, the shuttle), which open fastest
         first. */
      var col=(cols||[]).filter(function(c){return c.key===k;})[0];
      var fresh=col&&col.asc?'ASC':'DESC';
      sGo({sort:k, dir:(k===eff)?(effDir==='DESC'?'ASC':'DESC'):fresh});
    }
    th.onclick=applySort;
    th.onkeydown=function(ev){if(ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' '){ev.preventDefault();applySort();}};
  });
  var pv=document.getElementById('prev'), nx=document.getElementById('next');
  if(pv) pv.onclick=function(){sGo({page:String(Math.max(0,Number(o.page||0)-1))});};
  if(nx) nx.onclick=function(){sGo({page:String(Number(o.page||0)+1)});};
  // the season jump is the shared [data-jump] button, wired once on the document
}

/* - Fantasy -
   The same statistics, read the way a fantasy league reads them. There is no
   league here and nothing to draft: it is a scoring lens over the box score,
   which is why every page ends at one player and shows him the arithmetic
   rather than a standing.

   It borrows the Stats page's filter controls wholesale - seg(), sel() and
   posSelect() all speak [data-f], and the two pages are never on screen at
   once - so a filter row that behaves differently on the two pages is not a
   thing that can happen. */
var FDEF={scope:'PLAYER',side:'',range:'CURRENT',season:'',county:'',team:'',pos:'',q:'',
          sort:'PRED',dir:'DESC',page:'0'};

function fQuery(qs){
  var o={};
  Object.keys(FDEF).forEach(function(k){o[k]=(qs[k]!==undefined&&qs[k]!=='')?qs[k]:FDEF[k];});
  return o;
}
function fHash(o,id){
  var parts=[];
  Object.keys(FDEF).forEach(function(k){
    if(String(o[k])!==String(FDEF[k])&&o[k]!=='') parts.push(k+'='+encodeURIComponent(o[k]));});
  return '#/fantasy'+(id?'/'+id:'')+(parts.length?'?'+parts.join('&'):'');
}
/* Changing the scoring format while reading one boy's card must leave you on
   that boy's card, so the id is carried unless the caller names another. */
function fGo(patch,id){
  var h=parseHash(), o=fQuery(h.qs);
  Object.keys(patch).forEach(function(k){o[k]=patch[k];});
  if(!('page' in patch)) o.page='0';
  if(o.range==='SEASON'){ if(!patch.season) o.season=SEASON; } else o.season='';
  location.hash=fHash(o,id===undefined?h.id:id);
}

var FANTPG=null;                               /* what the share card reads */

function pgFantasy(r){
  var request=routeRequest();
  var o=fQuery(r.qs);
  if(o.range==='SEASON'&&o.season&&o.season!==SEASON&&
     (BOOT.seasons||[]).some(function(x){return x.id===o.season;})){
    SEASON=o.season;
    var sl=document.getElementById('season'); if(sl){sl.value=SEASON;smartSelectSync(sl);}
  }
  var week=o.range.indexOf('@')>0?o.range.split('@'):null;
  var single=o.range!=='CURRENT'&&o.range!=='LAST4'&&o.range!=='ALL'&&!week;
  var q={scope:o.scope,side:o.side,timeRange:week?'WEEK':single?'SEASON':o.range,
    seasonId:week?week[0]:single?(o.range==='SEASON'?SEASON:o.range):'',
    weekKey:week?week[1]:'',county:o.county,teamId:o.team,position:o.pos,search:o.q,
    sortBy:o.sort,sortDir:o.dir,limit:50,offset:Number(o.page||0)*50};
  return request('svcFantasyView',[q,r.id||'',!SF]).then(function(view){
    if(view.filters)SF=view.filters;
    if(r.id)renderFantasyPlayer(o,view.data);
    else renderFantasyBoard(SF||{},o,view.data);
  });
}

function fpt(v){ return has(v)?Number(v).toFixed(1):''; }
/* "SPECIAL TEAMS PTS" under a number is a caption longer than the number. */
var FSHORT={OFFENSE:'OFFENSE',DEFENSE:'DEFENSE',SPECIAL:'SPECIAL TEAMS'};
function fsideShort(m){ return FSHORT[(m&&m.side)||'OFFENSE']||'OFFENSE'; }
function fpos(v){ return String(v||'').split('|').filter(Boolean).join('/'); }

/* The filter row, shared by the board and by one player's card: the scoring
   format and the range are what a card is computed under, so they have to be
   changeable while looking at one. */
function fFilters(f,o,onPlayer,m){
  var team=o.scope==='TEAM';
  var h='<div class="filters">';
  /* A defence is scored on a different table from a linebacker - takeaways,
     sacks and what it gave up, rather than tackles - so it is a scope of its
     own rather than a position filter. */
  h+='<div class="fg fg-scope"><span class="fg-label">Scope</span>'+
     seg('scope',[['PLAYER','Players'],['TEAM','Team Defense']],o.scope,'Scope')+'</div>';
  /* One part of the game at a time, and no All: a two-way player's offensive
     and defensive points are scored on two different tables, so a combined
     total would rank him against nobody. The control reads the side the
     SERVER settled on - a position filter can imply one - or the two would
     disagree about which board is on screen. */
  if(!team)
    h+='<div class="fg fg-side"><span class="fg-label">Side</span>'+
       seg('side',((m&&m.sides)||[{key:'OFFENSE',label:'Offense'},
                                  {key:'DEFENSE',label:'Defense'},
                                  {key:'SPECIAL',label:'Special Teams'}])
             .map(function(x){return [x.key,x.label];}),
           (m&&m.side)||o.side||'OFFENSE','Side')+'</div>';
  var timeOpts=[['CURRENT','Current week'+(m&&m.currentWeekLabel?' · '+m.currentWeekLabel:'')]];
  if(m&&m.timeOptions) m.timeOptions.forEach(function(x){timeOpts.push([x.value,x.label]);});
  else (f.seasons||[]).forEach(function(x){var id=x.id||x;timeOpts.push([id,(x.label||id)+' season']);});
  timeOpts.push(['LAST4','Last 4 Years']);
  timeOpts.push(['ALL','Career']);
  h+=sel('range','Time',timeOpts,o.range==='SEASON'?SEASON:o.range).replace('class="fg"','class="fg fg-time"');
  if(!onPlayer){
    if(!team) h+=posSelect(f,o.pos);
    h+=sel('county','County',[['','All counties']].concat((f.counties||[]).map(function(c){
        return [c.key,c.label+' ('+c.teams+')'];})),o.county);
    h+=sel('team','Team',[['','All teams']].concat((f.teams||[]).filter(function(t){
        return !o.county||t.county===o.county;}).map(function(t){
        return [t.id||t.teamId,t.name||t.label];})),o.team);
    h+='<div class="fg"><label for="stats-filter-q">Search</label><input id="stats-filter-q" '+
       'type="search" data-f="q" value="'+esc(o.q)+'" placeholder="'+
       (team?'School':'Player name')+'"></div>';
  }
  return h+'</div>';
}

/* Every category and what it is worth, whether or not anybody scored in it.
   Folded away by default - it is a reference, not the point of the page - but
   present, because a score nobody can check is a number somebody made up. */
function fScoringKey(d){
  var rules=d.scoring||[];
  if(!rules.length) return '';
  var m=d.meta||{};
  var last='';
  return '<details class="fkey"><summary>How '+
    esc(m.scope==='TEAM'?'Team Defense':(m.sideLabel||'Offense'))+
    ' scoring works here</summary><div class="card"><div class="tw" role="region" tabindex="0" '+
    'aria-label="Scoring key"><table class="fsc"><thead><tr><th scope="col">Scoring Category</th>'+
    '<th scope="col" class="n">Pts Per</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
    rules.map(function(x){
      var head='';
      if(x.group!==last){ last=x.group;
        head='<tr class="fgrp"><td colspan="2">'+esc(x.group)+'</td></tr>'; }
      return head+'<tr><td>'+esc(x.label)+fHouse(x.house)+'</td>'+
             '<td class="n">'+esc(x.ptsLabel)+'</td></tr>';
    }).join('')+'</tbody></table></div></div>'+
    '<div class="notes">'+esc(fKeyNote(m))+'</div></details>';
}

/* Say where a category came from rather than passing it off as canon. IDP is
   the standard individual-defensive-player table every league that scores
   defenders uses; the pancake is ours, because the conference records it. */
function fHouse(kind){
  if(kind==='IDP') return '<span class="fhouse" title="Standard IDP scoring - '+
    'individual defensive players">IDP</span>';
  if(kind==='UCBAC') return '<span class="fhouse" title="Not a standard fantasy '+
    'category. The conference records pancakes, and a lineman deserves a score.">UCBAC</span>';
  return '';
}
function fKeyNote(m){
  var tail=' A number nobody recorded is not a number we will invent, and a category '+
    'nobody filed is left off a card rather than counted as a nought.';
  if(m.scope==='TEAM')
    return 'The standard Team Defense (D/ST) table — a different scoring system from '+
      'the one an individual defender is scored on, not a sum of it. Points allowed '+
      'are banded PER GAME and added up, which is the whole point of the band: a '+
      'defence that gave up 140 across ten games played ten ordinary games, and '+
      'running its season total through the table would call it a 46+ defence. '+
      'Three standard categories are absent because the conference does not record '+
      'them: the kickoff return touchdown, the punt return touchdown and the safety. '+
      'Interception and fumble returns both score 6 and both land in one field here, '+
      'so those are exact.'+tail;
  return 'Standard '+(m.formatLabel||'PPR')+' scoring ('+(m.formatNote||'')+'), plus the '+
    'standard IDP table so defenders score, plus one category of our own for the line. '+
    'Two things a standard league scores are absent, both for the same reason — the '+
    'conference does not record them: the two-point conversion, worth 2 apiece, and '+
    'the distance of a field goal, which is why every field goal here is a flat 3 '+
    'rather than 3, 4 or 5.'+tail;
}

function fPeriodSummary(m){
  var when=m.periodLabel||(m.seasons||[]).map(function(x){return x.label;}).join(', ');
  return '<div class="fcontext" aria-live="polite"><strong>Results: '+esc(when||'No scheduled week')+'</strong>'+
    '<span>Prediction: '+esc(m.prediction?m.prediction.label:'No upcoming week')+'</span></div>';
}
function fPredictionNote(m){
  return '<details class="fprediction-note"><summary>How predictions work</summary><p>'+
    esc(m.prediction?m.prediction.method:'')+' Predictions stay on the upcoming week when you view older results. '+
    'A dash in Prediction means no estimate is available. Weekly totals use game-level records; season-only totals are excluded. '+
    'Estimates reflect the statistics submitted and may be incomplete.</p></details>';
}
function fPredictionCell(row){
  var valid=has(row.prediction);
  var note=valid?(row.predictionTeam?'For '+row.predictionTeam+'. ':'')+'Based on '+row.predictionGames+' recorded game'+(row.predictionGames===1?'':'s')+
    (row.predictionProvisional?'; includes statistics awaiting approval':''):'No estimate: no prior game records or no upcoming fixture';
  return '<td class="n fprediction" title="'+esc(note)+'" aria-label="'+esc(valid?'Prediction '+fpt(row.prediction)+'. '+note:note)+'">'+
    (valid?fpt(row.prediction):'&mdash;')+'</td>';
}

function fActualCell(value,label,points){
  if(has(value))return '<td class="n">'+(points?fpt(value):esc(String(value)))+'</td>';
  var note=label+' has not been recorded for the selected period yet.';
  return '<td class="n" title="'+esc(note)+'" aria-label="'+esc(note)+'">&mdash;</td>';
}

function renderFantasyBoard(f,o,d){
  FANTPG=null;
  var m=d.meta||{}, team=o.scope==='TEAM';
  var h=fFilters(f,o,false,m)+fPeriodSummary(m);
  h+='<div class="chips">'+[['PTS','Total points'],['PPG','Points per game'],['PRED','Prediction']]
      .map(function(pr){
        return '<button type="button" data-fsort="'+esc(pr[0])+'" class="'+
          (o.sort===pr[0]?'on':'')+'">'+esc(pr[1])+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div>';

  if(!(d.rows||[]).length){
    h+=(o.range==='SEASON')
      ? emptySeason(team?'No defence has a game on file for these filters yet.'
                        :('Nobody has scored a '+((m.sideLabel||'Offense').toLowerCase())+
                          ' fantasy point under these filters yet.'))
      : '<div class="card pad muted">No game-level fantasy results match these filters yet. Choose another week or a full year in Time.</div>';
    h+=fPredictionNote(m)+fScoringKey(d);
    render(h); wireFantasy(o); return;
  }

  /* Every scoring category is a column, so the board shows WHERE the points
     came from without opening anybody: receptions, rushing yards, sacks. The
     server drops the ones nobody in this view recorded, and each heading says
     what it pays. */
  var cols=d.columns||[];
  /* The sorted column reads beside the name rather than wherever the scoring
     table puts it — a phone shows a few columns, and the one somebody picked
     must be one of them. */
  var eff=m.sortBy||o.sort||FDEF.sort;
  var si=-1; cols.forEach(function(c,i){ if(c.key===eff) si=i; });
  if(si>0){
    var picked=cols[si];
    cols=cols.slice(0,si).concat(cols.slice(si+1));
    cols.unshift(picked);
  }

  h+='<p class="notes" id="fantasy-results-note">G, PTS and PTS/G show results for the selected period. '+
    'A dash means the value has not been recorded yet.</p>';

  var head=function(key,label,title,asc){
    return '<th scope="col" class="n'+(eff===key?' son':'')+(key==='PRED'?' fprediction':'')+'" data-fsort="'+esc(key)+'"'+
      (asc?' data-fasc="1"':'')+
      ' role="button" tabindex="0" aria-sort="'+(eff===key?(o.dir==='ASC'?'ascending':'descending'):'none')+'"'+
      (title?' title="'+esc(title)+'"':'')+'>'+esc(label)+(key==='PRED'?'<small>'+esc(m.prediction?m.prediction.label:'No upcoming week')+'</small>':'')+'</th>';
  };

  h+='<div class="card"><div class="tw" role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label="Fantasy points">'+
     '<table id="fnt" aria-describedby="fantasy-results-note"><thead><tr>'+
     '<th scope="col" class="n plain">#</th>'+
     '<th scope="col" class="plain">'+(team?'Defense':'Player')+'</th>'+
     (team?'':'<th scope="col" class="plain fhide">Team</th>'+
            '<th scope="col" class="plain fhide">Pos</th>')+
     head('PRED','Prediction','Estimated fantasy points for '+(m.prediction?m.prediction.label:'the upcoming week'))+
     '<th scope="col" class="n plain" title="Games with recorded statistics in the selected period">G</th>'+
     head('PTS','PTS','Total '+(team?'Team Defense':(m.sideLabel||'Offense'))+' points')+
     head('PPG','PTS/G','Points per game')+
     cols.map(function(c){
       var pays=c.ptsLabel==='banded'
         ? 'scored in per-game bands'
         : c.ptsLabel+' point'+(c.ptsLabel==='1'?'':'s')+' each';
       return head(c.key,c.label,c.full+' — '+pays+(c.house?' ('+c.house+')':''),c.asc);
     }).join('')+
     '</tr></thead><tbody>'+
     d.rows.map(function(row){
       var cats=row.cats||{};
       return '<tr'+(row.prov?' class="prov" title="includes player-entered stats awaiting approval"':'')+'>'+
         '<td class="n">'+esc(has(row.rank)?String(row.rank):'')+'</td>'+
         '<td class="nm"><a href="'+esc(fHash(o,row.playerId))+'">'+esc(row.player)+'</a>'+
           (team?'':'<span class="fsub">'+
             esc([row.team,fpos(row.positions)].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))+'</span>')+'</td>'+
         (team?'':'<td class="fhide">'+
            (row.teamId?'<a href="#/team/'+esc(row.teamId)+'">'+esc(row.team)+'</a>':esc(row.team))+'</td>'+
            '<td class="fhide">'+esc(fpos(row.positions))+'</td>')+
         fPredictionCell(row)+
         fActualCell(row.gp,'Games played',false)+
         fActualCell(row.fpts,'Fantasy points',true)+
         fActualCell(row.fppg,'Points per game',true)+
         cols.map(function(c){
           /* blank, not 0: nobody reported it, and a nought here would claim
              he tried and failed at it */
           return '<td class="n">'+esc(has(cats[c.key])?String(cats[c.key]):'')+'</td>';
         }).join('')+'</tr>';}).join('')+
     '</tbody></table></div></div>';

  var page=Number(o.page||0), total=Number(m.total||d.rows.length),
      last=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(total/50)-1);
  if(last>0)
    h+='<div class="pager"><span class="muted">'+(page*50+1)+'-'+(page*50+d.rows.length)+
       ' of '+total+'</span><button type="button" id="prev"'+(page<=0?' disabled':'')+
       '>Previous</button><button type="button" id="next"'+(page>=last?' disabled':'')+
       '>Next</button></div>';

  var foot=[team
      ? 'Pick a school to see every point its defence scored, band by band.'
      : ('These are '+((m.sideLabel||'Offense').toLowerCase())+' points only \u2014 a '+
         'two-way player\u2019s offensive and defensive points are scored on different '+
         'tables and are never added together. Pick a name to see where his came from.'),
            'Every column is a scoring category — tap a heading to lead the board on it.']
    .concat(m.warnings||[]);
  h+='<div class="notes">'+foot.map(function(t){return '· '+esc(t);}).join('<br>')+'</div>';
  h+=fPredictionNote(m)+fScoringKey(d);
  render(h); wireFantasy(o);
}

/* One player: the four columns asked for, in the order a scoring settings page
   shows them, and the total underneath where a total belongs. */
function renderFantasyPlayer(o,d){
  FANTPG=null;
  var team=o.scope==='TEAM';
  var back='<div class="chips"><button type="button" data-fback="1">← All fantasy scores</button></div>';
  if(!d||!d.found){
    render(back+fFilters(SF||{},o,true,(d&&d.meta)||null)+
      '<div class="card pad muted">'+(team
        ? 'This defence has no game on file in the range you are looking at.'
        : 'This player has no fantasy points in the range you are looking at.')+
      '</div>'+fScoringKey(d||{}));
    wireFantasy(o); return;
  }
  var m=d.meta||{};
  FANTPG={ id:d.playerId, d:d, o:o };

  var sub=team
    ? ['Team Defense',has(d.pa)?d.pa+' points allowed':''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')
    : [d.team,fpos(d.positions),d.grad?'Class of '+d.grad:''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  var h=back+fFilters(SF||{},o,true,m)+fPeriodSummary(m);
  h+='<div class="fhead"><div class="fwho"><h2>'+esc(d.player)+'</h2>'+
     '<div class="muted">'+esc(sub)+'</div></div>'+
     '<div class="fscores">'+
     '<div class="fscore">'+(has(d.total)?fpt(d.total):'&mdash;')+'<small>'+
       esc(team?'TEAM DEFENSE PTS':(fsideShort(m)+' PTS'))+'</small></div>'+
     (has(d.fppg)?'<div class="fscore sub">'+fpt(d.fppg)+'<small>PTS / game</small></div>':'')+
     (has(d.prediction)?'<div class="fscore sub">'+fpt(d.prediction)+'<small>Prediction</small></div>':'')+
     '</div></div>';
  if(!has(d.total))h+='<p class="notes">Results have not been recorded for this player or team in the selected week.</p>';

  var when=m.periodLabel||(m.seasons||[]).map(function(x){return x.label;}).join(', ');
  var line=[];
  if(when) line.push(when);
  if(has(d.gp)) line.push(d.gp+' game'+(Number(d.gp)===1?'':'s'));
  if(d.rank) line.push(fOrdinal(d.rank)+' of '+d.of+
    (team?' defences in the conference'
        :(' '+(m.sideLabel||'Offense').toLowerCase()+' scorers in the conference')));
  if(line.length) h+='<div class="notes">'+esc(line.join(' · '))+'</div>';

  var last='';
  h+='<div class="card"><div class="tw" role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label="Scoring breakdown">'+
     '<table id="fbrk" class="fsc"><thead><tr><th scope="col">Scoring Category</th>'+
     '<th scope="col" class="n">Pts Per</th><th scope="col" class="n">#</th>'+
     '<th scope="col" class="n">Score</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
     (d.rows||[]).map(function(x){
       var head='';
       if(x.group!==last){ last=x.group;
         head='<tr class="fgrp"><td colspan="4">'+esc(x.group)+'</td></tr>'; }
       return head+'<tr><td>'+esc(x.label)+fHouse(x.house)+'</td>'+
         '<td class="n">'+esc(x.ptsLabel)+'</td>'+
         '<td class="n">'+esc(String(x.count))+'</td>'+
         '<td class="n">'+fpt(x.score)+'</td></tr>';}).join('')+
     '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>Total</td><td class="n"></td><td class="n"></td>'+
     fActualCell(d.total,'Fantasy points',true)+'</tr></tfoot></table></div></div>';

  if(has(d.total))h+=shareBtn('fantasy',d.playerId,'Share this score');
  h+='<div class="notes">· <a href="'+(team?'#/team/':'#/player/')+esc(d.playerId)+'">'+
     (team?'See the full team page and statistics':'See his full profile and statistics')+'</a></div>';
  if(d.gpPartial) h+='<div class="notes">· '+
    esc('Points per game is blank: a season in this range was filed as a total with no game count behind it.')+'</div>';
  h+=fPredictionNote(m)+fScoringKey(d);
  render(h); wireFantasy(o);
}

/* "1st", "22nd", "13th" - the teens are the whole reason this is a function. */
function fOrdinal(n){
  var v=Number(n)||0, t=v%100;
  if(t>=11&&t<=13) return v+'th';
  return v+({1:'st',2:'nd',3:'rd'}[v%10]||'th');
}

function wireFantasy(o){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-f]').forEach(function(el){
    var f=el.getAttribute('data-f');
    /* Changing one filter can leave another meaningless. Clear those in the
       same hash write, so the page never asks a question whose answer is
       guaranteed to be an empty table - and a scope change goes back to the
       board, because a player id means nothing under Team Defense. */
    var side=function(p){
      if(f==='county') p.team='';
      if(f==='scope'){ p.pos=''; p.side=''; p.sort=FDEF.sort; p.dir='DESC'; }
      /* A sort key belongs to one side's table, and the server refuses one
         from another - so a side change starts the board over rather than
         silently falling back. */
      if(f==='side'){ p.sort=FDEF.sort; p.dir='DESC'; }
      /* Picking a position hands the side back to the server, which reads one
         off the position: asking for linebackers on the offensive board is
         asking for an empty screen. */
      if(f==='pos') p.side='';
      return p;
    };
    if(el.tagName==='BUTTON') el.onclick=function(){
      var p=side({}); p[f]=el.getAttribute('data-v');
      fGo(p, (f==='scope'||f==='side')?'':undefined);};
    else if(el.tagName==='SELECT') el.onchange=function(){
      var p=side({}); p[f]=el.value;
      fGo(p, f==='scope'?'':undefined);};
    else if(el.tagName==='INPUT') el.onkeydown=function(ev){
      if(ev.key==='Enter'){SQFOCUS=true;var p={};p[f]=el.value;fGo(p,'');}};
  });
  /* Chips and column headings are the same control: both say "lead the board
     on this". Clicking the column already leading flips the direction, which
     is the only way to ask who has the FEWEST interceptions thrown. */
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-fsort]').forEach(function(el){
    var k=el.getAttribute('data-fsort');
    /* Fewest points allowed is the good end, so that one column opens
       ascending; everything else opens most-first. */
    var fresh=el.getAttribute('data-fasc')?'ASC':'DESC';
    var go=function(){
      fGo({sort:k, dir:(k===(o.sort||FDEF.sort))?((o.dir||'DESC')==='DESC'?'ASC':'DESC'):fresh},'');
    };
    el.onclick=go;
    if(el.tagName==='TH') el.onkeydown=function(ev){
      if(ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' '){ev.preventDefault();go();}};
  });
  if(SQFOCUS){
    SQFOCUS=false;
    var qi=document.querySelector('#app input[data-f="q"]');
    if(qi){qi.focus(); try{qi.setSelectionRange(qi.value.length,qi.value.length);}catch(e){}}
  }
  var bk=document.querySelector('[data-fback]');
  if(bk) bk.onclick=function(){
    if(FANTASY_BOARD_RETURN&&FANTASY_BOARD_RETURN.season===SEASON)location.hash=FANTASY_BOARD_RETURN.hash;
    else fGo({},'');
  };
  var pv=document.getElementById('prev'), nx=document.getElementById('next');
  if(pv) pv.onclick=function(){fGo({page:String(Math.max(0,Number(o.page||0)-1))});};
  if(nx) nx.onclick=function(){fGo({page:String(Number(o.page||0)+1)});};
}

/* The card. Same renderer as every other line on the site: his name, what he
   plays under it, and the numbers in tiles. The two biggest categories ride
   beside the total, because "184.6 points" alone says nothing about how. */
function fantasyCardOpen(id){
  var p=FANTPG; if(!p||p.id!==id) return;
  var d=p.d, m=d.meta||{}, team=m.scope==='TEAM';
  var tiles=[{k:team?'TEAM DEFENSE PTS':(fsideShort(m)+' PTS'),v:fpt(d.total)}];
  if(has(d.fppg)) tiles.push({k:'PTS / GAME',v:fpt(d.fppg)});
  /* The two categories that paid him most, shown as WHAT HE DID rather than
     what it scored: "136.4 rushing yards" would be a lie about a boy who ran
     for 1,364, and the total above it is the fantasy number already. */
  (d.rows||[]).slice().sort(function(a,b){return (b.score||0)-(a.score||0);})
    .slice(0,4-tiles.length).forEach(function(x){
      /* the short heading where there is one: "SHUTOUT - 0 POINTS ALLOWED"
         does not belong under a number on a card */
      tiles.push({k:String(x.short||x.label).toUpperCase(),v:x.count});});
  var when=m.periodLabel||(m.seasons||[]).map(function(x){return x.label;}).join(', ');
  shareSheet({
    title:'Share this score', file:'ucbac-fantasy-'+(d.player||'player'),
    variants:[{ label:'Fantasy', draw:function(){ return cardDrawLine({
      name:d.player,
      team:team?('Team Defense'+(has(d.pa)?' · '+d.pa+' points allowed':''))
               :[d.team,fpos(d.positions)].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
      cat:'Fantasy · '+(team?'Team Defense':(m.sideLabel||'Offense')), stats:tiles,
      game:'UCBACstats.com', dateText:when }); } }],
    caption:function(){
      return (d.player||'')+' — '+fpt(d.total)+' '+
             (team?'team defense':(m.sideLabel||'Offense').toLowerCase())+' fantasy points'+
             (when?' ('+when+')':'')+
             (d.rank?', '+fOrdinal(d.rank)+(team?' defence':'')+' in the UCBAC':'')+
             '\n\nScore any player yourself at UCBACstats.com';
    }
  });
}

/* Decide, per table, how its header should be frozen. Tables that fit use
   native page-relative sticky positioning. Wide tables keep horizontal panning
   only; positionPanHeads() translates their original header cells as the page
   moves, preserving sort clicks, keyboard focus and column alignment without a
   nested vertical scrollbar.

   Measuring means first taking the classes off: .fits removes the very
   overflow being measured, so leaving it on would report every table as
   fitting the moment it stopped scrolling. */
/* Hold the name column still while the rest of a wide table pans.
   The name cell is marked .nm wherever a table names a player or a team, and it
   is either the first column or sits directly behind a rank, so those two
   shapes are the only ones held - anything else is left alone rather than
   freezing a column that turns out to be a statistic. The rank's width is
   measured from the header, which is one row rather than hundreds, and handed
   to the CSS as --froz1 so no cell needs a style of its own. */
function freezeLead(w,t){
  w.style.removeProperty('--froz1');
  var body=t.tBodies&&t.tBodies[0], row=body&&body.rows[0];
  if(!row)return;
  var lead=0;
  for(var c=0;c<row.cells.length&&c<2;c++){
    if(row.cells[c].classList&&row.cells[c].classList.contains('nm')){lead=c+1;break;}
  }
  if(!lead)return;
  w.classList.add(lead===1?'froz1':'froz2');
  if(lead===2){
    var head=t.tHead&&t.tHead.rows[0], first=head&&head.cells[0];
    if(!first)first=row.cells[0];
    w.style.setProperty('--froz1',Math.round(first.getBoundingClientRect().width)+'px');
  }
}

function stickyHeads(){
  var hd=document.querySelector('header');
  if(hd&&hd.offsetHeight)
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--headTop',hd.offsetHeight+'px');
  var tws=document.querySelectorAll('.tw');
  for(var i=0;i<tws.length;i++){
    var w=tws[i], t=w.querySelector('table');
    if(!t)continue;
    w.classList.remove('fits','pan','froz1','froz2');
    var oldHeads=t.querySelectorAll('thead th');
    for(var h=0;h<oldHeads.length;h++)oldHeads[h].style.transform='';
    var wide=t.scrollWidth>w.clientWidth+1;
    w.classList.add(wide?'pan':'fits');
    if(wide)freezeLead(w,t);
    var card=w.closest?w.closest('.card'):null;
    if(card)card.classList.add('table-card');
    /* Only a pane somebody can actually scroll earns a place in the tab order.
       A region that fits is a tab stop that goes nowhere. */
    var loading=w.classList.contains('is-loading');
    if(wide){
      w.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
      w.setAttribute('aria-label',loading?'Updating statistics table':'Horizontally scrollable statistics table');
    }else{
      w.removeAttribute('tabindex');
      w.setAttribute('aria-label',loading?'Updating statistics table':'Statistics table');
    }
  }
  positionPanHeads();
}
var HEADS_T=null;
function stickyHeadsSoon(){clearTimeout(HEADS_T);HEADS_T=setTimeout(stickyHeads,60);}
/* Read all table geometry first, then write the transforms together. The scroll
   listener below is passive and schedules at most one update per animation
   frame, so the page remains the scrolling surface without layout thrashing. */
function positionPanHeads(){
  var hd=document.querySelector('header');
  var top=hd&&hd.offsetHeight?hd.offsetHeight:0;
  var pans=document.querySelectorAll('.tw.pan'), updates=[];
  for(var i=0;i<pans.length;i++){
    var w=pans[i],t=w.querySelector('table'),head=t&&t.tHead;
    if(!t||!head)continue;
    var rect=w.getBoundingClientRect();
    var max=Math.max(0,t.offsetHeight-head.offsetHeight);
    var shift=Math.max(0,Math.min(max,top-rect.top));
    updates.push([head,Math.round(shift)]);
  }
  for(var j=0;j<updates.length;j++){
    var heads=updates[j][0].querySelectorAll('th');
    var transform='translateY('+updates[j][1]+'px)';
    for(var k=0;k<heads.length;k++)heads[k].style.transform=transform;
  }
}
var HEADS_FRAME=null;
function positionPanHeadsSoon(){
  if(HEADS_FRAME!==null)return;
  var raf=window.requestAnimationFrame||function(fn){return window.setTimeout(fn,16);};
  HEADS_FRAME=raf(function(){HEADS_FRAME=null;positionPanHeads();});
}
if(typeof window!=='undefined'&&window.addEventListener){
  window.addEventListener('resize',stickyHeadsSoon);
  window.addEventListener('scroll',positionPanHeadsSoon,{passive:true});
}
/* Tables arrive by several routes - a page render, a team tab, a matchup
   opening in place - so watch for them rather than trying to remember every
   call site. Only childList is observed; the classes above are attributes, so
   this cannot set itself off. */
if(typeof MutationObserver==='function'){
  var appEl=document.getElementById('app');
  if(appEl)new MutationObserver(stickyHeadsSoon).observe(appEl,{childList:true,subtree:true});
}

function render(h){
  clearTimeout(ROUTE_LOADING_TIMER);ROUTE_LOADING_TIMER=null;
  var app=document.getElementById('app');
  /* Only Blitz takes the whole screen, and only while it is the page being
     looked at. Cleared here rather than in each of the other pages, so a route
     added later cannot forget to. */
  document.body.classList.remove('chatfull');
  var statsState=STATS_REFRESH;
  STATS_REFRESH=null;
  app.innerHTML=h;
  compactFilters(app);
  app.classList.remove('stats-refreshing');
  app.setAttribute('aria-busy','false');
  var title=app.querySelector('h1');
  var status=document.getElementById('routeStatus');
  if(status)status.textContent=(title?title.textContent:'Page')+' loaded';
  stickyHeads();
  if(statsState){
    app.style.minHeight=statsState.minHeight;
    var maxY=Math.max(0,document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight);
    window.scrollTo(0,Math.min(statsState.scrollY,maxY));
    restoreStatsFocus(app,statsState.focus);
    var table=app.querySelector('#stt,#fnt');if(table)table.parentNode.scrollLeft=statsState.tableScroll||0;
  }else{
    app.style.minHeight='';
    if(ROUTE_STATE&&ROUTE_STATE.same){
      window.scrollTo(0,Math.min(ROUTE_STATE.scrollY,Math.max(0,document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight)));
    }else{try{app.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(e){app.focus();}}
  }
  finishView();
}

document.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
  var tab=ev.target.closest&&ev.target.closest('[role="tab"]');
  if(!tab||!['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End'].includes(ev.key))return;
  var list=tab.closest('[role="tablist"]');if(!list)return;
  var tabs=Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')).filter(function(t){return !t.disabled;});
  var i=tabs.indexOf(tab);if(i<0)return;
  ev.preventDefault();
  i=ev.key==='Home'?0:ev.key==='End'?tabs.length-1:(i+(ev.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1)+tabs.length)%tabs.length;
  tabs[i].focus({preventScroll:true});
});

/** One-time, owner-requested player merge. No website deployment is required.
 * Exact pairs come from Merge-list-v1.tsv. Preview, backup, lock, audit, rebuild.
 * This file sends no mail and changes no account roles, policy records or stats.
 */
function mergeList20260921Preview() { return ml21Preview_(); }
function mergeList20260921Apply() { return ml21Apply_(); }
function mergeList20260921Rebuild() { return ml21Finish_(); }

function ml21Config_() {
  return {
    key: 'MERGE_LIST_20260921_V1',
    db: 'CONFIGURE_PRIVATE_RESOURCE_ID',
    owner: 'contact@example.invalid',
    pairs: [] /* private dataset removed */,
    held: [] /* private dataset removed */,
    sourceHash: 'e1fe781b2bdd2161bb12d180cfb6710e12fec2b3f0788f11364a296c754db013'
  };
}
function ml21Assert_(ok, message) { if (!ok) throw new Error(message); }
function ml21Text_(v) { return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim(); }
function ml21Blank_(v) { return v === null || v === undefined || v === ''; }
function ml21Owner_() {
  const c = ml21Config_();
  ml21Assert_(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase() === c.owner, 'Owner execution required.');
  ml21Assert_(CONFIG.DB_ID === c.db && db_().getId() === c.db, 'Wrong database.');
  return c;
}
function ml21Read_() {
  const out = {};
  ['Players','PlayerSeasons','PlayerGameStats','Accounts','Awards','StatCorrections','AuditLog'].forEach(function(name) {
    const sh = db_().getSheetByName(name);
    ml21Assert_(!!sh, 'Missing source table: ' + name);
    const range = sh.getDataRange(), data = range.getValues(), headers = data[0].map(ml21Text_);
    ml21Assert_(!range.getFormulas().some(function(r) { return r.some(Boolean); }), 'Source formulas require review: ' + name);
    out[name] = {headers:headers, rows:data.slice(1).map(function(v,i) {
      const row = {__row:i+2}; headers.forEach(function(h,j) { row[h] = v[j]; }); return row;
    })};
  });
  return out;
}
function ml21Fingerprint_(tables, pairs) {
  const input = {pairs:pairs, tables:{}};
  Object.keys(tables).filter(function(n) { return n !== 'AuditLog'; }).sort().forEach(function(n) {
    input.tables[n] = tables[n].rows.map(function(row) {
      const copy = Object.assign({},row);
      if(n === 'Accounts') delete copy.LastSeenAt;
      return copy;
    });
  });
  return authHash_(JSON.stringify(input));
}

/** Pure planner: keeper values win; blanks and earlier first-seen season carry over.
 * Only requested identities are combined. Every raw stat cell except PlayerID stays intact.
 */
function ml21Plan_(tables, pairs) {
  const remap = {}, groups = {}, playerById = {}, before = {}, after = {};
  const wanted = {};
  pairs.forEach(function(p) { wanted[p.absorb] = true; wanted[p.keep] = true; });
  Object.keys(tables).forEach(function(n) {
    before[n] = tables[n].rows;
    after[n] = before[n].map(function(r) { return Object.assign({},r); });
  });
  after.Players.forEach(function(p) {
    const id = ml21Text_(p.PlayerID); if(!wanted[id]) return;
    ml21Assert_(!playerById[id], 'Duplicate Players identity: ' + id); playerById[id] = p;
  });
  pairs.forEach(function(p) {
    ml21Assert_(p.absorb !== p.keep && !remap[p.absorb], 'Duplicate/cyclic merge source.');
    ml21Assert_(playerById[p.absorb] && playerById[p.keep], 'Missing player: '+p.absorb+' -> '+p.keep);
    remap[p.absorb] = p.keep; (groups[p.keep] = groups[p.keep] || []).push(p.absorb);
  });
  Object.keys(remap).forEach(function(id) { ml21Assert_(!remap[remap[id]], 'Chained merges are not supported.'); });
  const conflicts = [], carried = [], moved = {}, seatRemap = {}, seatDropped = [];
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(keep) {
    const ids = [keep].concat(groups[keep]);
    const accountEmails = {};
    before.Accounts.forEach(function(a) { if(ids.indexOf(ml21Text_(a.PlayerID)) >= 0) accountEmails[ml21Text_(a.Email).toLowerCase()] = true; });
    ml21Assert_(Object.keys(accountEmails).filter(Boolean).length <= 1, 'Multiple accounts would share '+keep);
    const birthDates = {};
    ids.forEach(function(id) { const v = playerById[id].BirthDate; if(!ml21Blank_(v)) birthDates[JSON.stringify(v)] = true; });
    ml21Assert_(Object.keys(birthDates).length <= 1, 'Birth dates disagree for '+keep);
    groups[keep].forEach(function(absorb) {
      const a = playerById[absorb], k = playerById[keep];
      tables.Players.headers.forEach(function(field) {
        if(field === 'PlayerID') return;
        if(ml21Blank_(k[field]) && !ml21Blank_(a[field])) {
          k[field] = a[field]; carried.push({player:keep,from:absorb,field:field});
        } else if(field === 'FirstSeenSeason' && /^SEA-\d{4}$/.test(ml21Text_(a[field])) &&
                  /^SEA-\d{4}$/.test(ml21Text_(k[field])) && a[field] < k[field]) {
          k[field] = a[field];
        } else if(!ml21Blank_(a[field]) && !ml21Blank_(k[field]) && JSON.stringify(a[field]) !== JSON.stringify(k[field])) {
          conflicts.push({table:'Players',keep:keep,absorb:absorb,field:field});
        }
      });
    });
  });
  ['PlayerGameStats','PlayerSeasons','Accounts','Awards','StatCorrections'].forEach(function(name) {
    const fields = name === 'Accounts' ? ['PlayerID','RequestedPlayerID'] : ['PlayerID'];
    fields.forEach(function(field) {
      ml21Assert_(tables[name].headers.indexOf(field) >= 0, 'Missing '+name+'.'+field);
      let count = 0;
      after[name].forEach(function(r) { const to = remap[ml21Text_(r[field])]; if(to) { r[field] = to; count++; } });
      moved[name+'.'+field] = count;
    });
  });
  const seatGroups = {};
  after.PlayerSeasons.forEach(function(s) {
    if(!groups[ml21Text_(s.PlayerID)]) return;
    const key = ml21Text_(s.PlayerID)+'|'+ml21Text_(s.SeasonID);
    (seatGroups[key] = seatGroups[key] || []).push(s);
  });
  Object.keys(seatGroups).forEach(function(key) {
    const seats = seatGroups[key];
    if(seats.length < 2 || !seats.some(function(s) { return remap[ml21Text_(before.PlayerSeasons[s.__row-2].PlayerID)]; })) return;
    function originalKeeper(s) { return ml21Text_(before.PlayerSeasons[s.__row-2].PlayerID) === ml21Text_(s.PlayerID); }
    function size(s) { return tables.PlayerSeasons.headers.filter(function(h) { return !ml21Blank_(s[h]); }).length; }
    seats.sort(function(a,b) { return Number(originalKeeper(b))-Number(originalKeeper(a)) || size(b)-size(a) || a.__row-b.__row; });
    const keeper = seats[0];
    seats.slice(1).forEach(function(s) {
      tables.PlayerSeasons.headers.forEach(function(field) {
        if(field === 'PlayerSeasonID' || field === 'PlayerID') return;
        if(ml21Blank_(keeper[field]) && !ml21Blank_(s[field])) keeper[field] = s[field];
        else if(!ml21Blank_(s[field]) && !ml21Blank_(keeper[field]) && JSON.stringify(s[field]) !== JSON.stringify(keeper[field]))
          conflicts.push({table:'PlayerSeasons',keep:keeper.PlayerID,season:keeper.SeasonID,field:field});
      });
      if(ml21Text_(s.PlayerSeasonID) && ml21Text_(s.PlayerSeasonID) !== ml21Text_(keeper.PlayerSeasonID)) {
        ml21Assert_(ml21Text_(keeper.PlayerSeasonID), 'Surviving season row needs an ID.');
        seatRemap[ml21Text_(s.PlayerSeasonID)] = keeper.PlayerSeasonID;
      }
      seatDropped.push(s.__row);
    });
  });
  let auditMoved = 0;
  after.AuditLog.forEach(function(row) {
    const id = ml21Text_(row.EntityID), type = ml21Text_(row.EntityType);
    const to = type === 'Player' ? remap[id] : type === 'PlayerSeason' ? seatRemap[id] : null;
    if(to) { row.EntityID = to; auditMoved++; }
  });
  moved['AuditLog.EntityID'] = auditMoved;
  const deletes = {
    Players:before.Players.filter(function(p) { return remap[ml21Text_(p.PlayerID)]; }).map(function(p) { return p.__row; }),
    PlayerSeasons:seatDropped
  };
  const changes = {};
  Object.keys(tables).forEach(function(name) {
    changes[name] = [];
    after[name].forEach(function(row,i) {
      if((deletes[name] || []).indexOf(row.__row) >= 0) return;
      tables[name].headers.forEach(function(field,c) {
        if(JSON.stringify(row[field]) !== JSON.stringify(before[name][i][field]))
          changes[name].push({row:row.__row,col:c+1,field:field,value:row[field]});
      });
    });
  });
  return {remap:remap,seatRemap:seatRemap,changes:changes,deletes:deletes,after:after,
    summary:{pairs:pairs.length,keepers:Object.keys(groups).length,moved:moved,
      profilesRemoved:deletes.Players.length,seasonsConsolidated:seatDropped.length,
      rawStatRows:before.PlayerGameStats.length,fieldsCarried:carried.length,keeperConflictsPreserved:conflicts.length},
    conflicts:conflicts};
}
function ml21Preview_() {
  const c = ml21Owner_(), tables = ml21Read_(), plan = ml21Plan_(tables,c.pairs);
  const hash = ml21Fingerprint_(tables,c.pairs);
  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty(c.key+'_PREVIEW',JSON.stringify({hash:hash,at:Date.now()}));
  const result = {status:'PREVIEW_NO_DATABASE_WRITES',sourceHash:c.sourceHash,hash:hash,summary:plan.summary,held:c.held};
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result)); return result;
}
function ml21WriteChanges_(tables, plan) {
  Object.keys(plan.changes).forEach(function(name) {
    const sh = db_().getSheetByName(name), cells = plan.changes[name], byCol = {};
    cells.forEach(function(c) { (byCol[c.col] = byCol[c.col] || []).push(c); });
    Object.keys(byCol).forEach(function(col) {
      const list = byCol[col].sort(function(a,b) { return a.row-b.row; });
      let start = 0;
      while(start < list.length) {
        let end = start+1;
        while(end < list.length && list[end].row === list[end-1].row+1) end++;
        sh.getRange(list[start].row,Number(col),end-start,1).setValues(list.slice(start,end).map(function(c) { return [c.value]; }));
        start = end;
      }
    });
  });
  Object.keys(plan.deletes).forEach(function(name) {
    const rows = plan.deletes[name].slice().sort(function(a,b) { return b-a; }), sh = db_().getSheetByName(name);
    let i = 0;
    while(i < rows.length) {
      let j = i+1; while(j < rows.length && rows[j] === rows[j-1]-1) j++;
      sh.deleteRows(rows[j-1],j-i); i = j;
    }
  });
}
function ml21Apply_() {
  const c = ml21Owner_(), props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties(), lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  ml21Assert_(lock.tryLock(5000), 'Database busy; nothing changed.');
  let state;
  try {
    state = JSON.parse(props.getProperty(c.key+'_STATE') || 'null');
    if(state) { Logger.log(JSON.stringify(state)); ml21Assert_(state.status === 'COMPLETE', 'Previous run exists; inspect its checkpoint before retrying.'); return state; }
    const tables = ml21Read_(), plan = ml21Plan_(tables,c.pairs);
    const preview = JSON.parse(props.getProperty(c.key+'_PREVIEW') || 'null');
    ml21Assert_(preview && Date.now()-preview.at < 3600000 && preview.hash === ml21Fingerprint_(tables,c.pairs), 'Source changed or preview expired; run Preview again.');
    const folder = DriveApp.getFolderById('CONFIGURE_PRIVATE_RESOURCE_ID');
    const backup = DriveApp.getFileById(c.db).makeCopy('UCBAC_Database — before player merges — '+new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-'),folder);
    backup.setDescription('Recovery snapshot before owner-requested Merge-list-v1.tsv; SHA256 '+c.sourceHash+'. Original database '+c.db+'.');
    state = {status:'WRITING',backupId:backup.getId(),backupUrl:backup.getUrl(),startedAt:new Date().toISOString(),summary:plan.summary};
    props.setProperty(c.key+'_STATE',JSON.stringify(state)); Logger.log('BACKUP '+backup.getUrl());
    ml21WriteChanges_(tables,plan); SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    __tableCache = {};
    const check = ml21Read_();
    ml21Assert_(!check.Players.rows.some(function(p) { return plan.remap[ml21Text_(p.PlayerID)]; }), 'An absorbed profile remains.');
    ['PlayerSeasons','PlayerGameStats','Accounts','Awards','StatCorrections'].forEach(function(name) {
      check[name].rows.forEach(function(row) {
        ml21Assert_(!plan.remap[ml21Text_(row.PlayerID)] && (name !== 'Accounts' || !plan.remap[ml21Text_(row.RequestedPlayerID)]), 'Unmoved reference in '+name);
      });
    });
    ml21Assert_(check.PlayerGameStats.rows.length === tables.PlayerGameStats.rows.length, 'Raw stat row count changed.');
    check.PlayerGameStats.rows.forEach(function(row,i) {
      tables.PlayerGameStats.headers.forEach(function(field) {
        const expected = field === 'PlayerID' ? (plan.remap[ml21Text_(tables.PlayerGameStats.rows[i][field])] || tables.PlayerGameStats.rows[i][field]) : tables.PlayerGameStats.rows[i][field];
        ml21Assert_(JSON.stringify(row[field]) === JSON.stringify(expected), 'Unexpected stat change at row '+row.__row+', '+field);
      });
    });
    const now = new Date();
    appendRows_('AuditLog',c.pairs.map(function(p) {
      return {AuditID:Utilities.getUuid(),Timestamp:now,UserID:c.owner,Role:'ADMIN',Action:'PLAYER_MERGE',EntityType:'Player',EntityID:p.keep,Field:'PlayerID',OldValue:p.absorb,NewValue:p.keep,RequestID:c.key,
        Notes:JSON.stringify({source:'Merge-list-v1.tsv',sourceHash:c.sourceHash,absorbName:p.absorbName,keepName:p.keepName,backupId:state.backupId,rule:'Keep designated profile values; fill blanks; preserve raw statistics and account links.'})};
    }));
    markDirty_('player-merge-list'); clearApiCache_();
    state.status = 'MERGED_REBUILD_PENDING'; props.setProperty(c.key+'_STATE',JSON.stringify(state));
    Logger.log(JSON.stringify(state));
  } catch(e) {
    if(state && state.status === 'WRITING') { state.status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW'; state.error = String(e.message || e); props.setProperty(c.key+'_STATE',JSON.stringify(state)); }
    throw e;
  } finally { lock.releaseLock(); }
  return ml21Finish_();
}
function ml21Finish_() {
  const c = ml21Owner_(), props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const state = JSON.parse(props.getProperty(c.key+'_STATE') || 'null');
  ml21Assert_(state && ['MERGED_REBUILD_PENDING','COMPLETE'].indexOf(state.status) >= 0, 'No verified merge awaiting rebuild.');
  if(state.status === 'COMPLETE') { Logger.log(JSON.stringify(state)); return state; }
  __tableCache = {};
  const result = runRebuild_('manual');
  ml21Assert_(String(result).indexOf('skipped') < 0, 'Rebuild busy; run the Rebuild function again.');
  state.status = 'COMPLETE'; state.completedAt = new Date().toISOString(); state.rebuild = result;
  props.setProperty(c.key+'_STATE',JSON.stringify(state)); Logger.log(JSON.stringify(state)); return state;
}


===== src/MergePlayers.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — MergePlayers.gs
 *
 * Rejoins players who were split across two PlayerIDs.
 *
 * RepairPlayerIds.gs fixed the opposite fault: 151 IDs each held two different
 * people, so careers were two players added together. Renumbering separated them
 * correctly, but it did not then ask whether a renumbered ID and an existing one
 * were the SAME person seen in different seasons. Thirty-six were: Collin Rogers
 * holds 2025 and 2026 under one ID and 2024 under another, so his career now
 * undercounts by a season. That is the same failure as before wearing the other
 * face — one person reported as two instead of two reported as one.
 *
 * The merge rule is deliberately narrow, because a wrong merge invents a career
 * exactly the way the original bug did:
 *
 *   same normalized name  AND  same team  AND  no season in common
 *   AND  graduation years agree once formatting is normalized, or one is blank
 *
 * Two IDs that share a season are two people who happen to share a name -
 * UNLESS they share the season on the same team wearing the same number. A
 * team issues a number once, so "Isaiah Deyo #55" twice on Edgewood's 2026
 * roster is one player entered twice (a roster import beside an account he
 * registered himself, as a rule), and that pair is merged. Same season with
 * different numbers, or one number blank, is left alone and reported.
 *
 * ALWAYS run mergeSplitPlayersDryRun() first.
 */

const MP_SUFFIX = { jr: 1, sr: 1, ii: 1, iii: 1, iv: 1 };

function _mpNorm_(s_) {
  const toks = String(s_ === null || s_ === undefined ? '' : s_)
    .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/)
    .filter(function (t) { return t && !MP_SUFFIX[t]; });
  return toks.join('');
}

/** '2026', "26, '26.0' all mean the same class. Blank stays blank. */
function _mpGrad_(v) {
  const digits = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
  if (!digits) return '';
  const two = digits.length >= 4 ? digits.slice(2, 4) : digits.slice(0, 2);
  return two.length === 2 ? two : '';
}

/**
 * Find every cluster of PlayerIDs that are the same person.
 * Returns { merges: [{keep, absorb[], name, teamId, seasons}], conflicts: [...] }
 */
function _mpPlan_() {
  const players = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS), function (p) {
    return String(p.PlayerID || '').trim();
  });

  const teamOf = {}, seasonsOf = {}, seatOf = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).forEach(function (ps) {
    const pid = String(ps.PlayerID || '').trim();
    const tid = String(ps.TeamID || '').trim();
    if (!pid || !tid || !players[pid]) return;
    const sid = String(ps.SeasonID || '').trim();
    (teamOf[pid] = teamOf[pid] || {})[tid] = true;
    (seasonsOf[pid] = seasonsOf[pid] || {})[sid] = true;
    // the seat itself: which team, what number - the test for "entered twice"
    (seatOf[pid] = seatOf[pid] || {})[sid] = { team: tid, jersey: String(ps.Jersey === null || ps.Jersey === undefined ? '' : ps.Jersey).trim() };
  });

  // group by (team, normalized name)
  const groups = {};
  Object.keys(teamOf).forEach(function (pid) {
    const name = _mpNorm_(players[pid].DisplayName);
    if (!name) return;
    Object.keys(teamOf[pid]).forEach(function (tid) {
      const key = tid + '|' + name;
      (groups[key] = groups[key] || {})[pid] = true;
    });
  });

  const merges = [], conflicts = [];
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function (key) {
    const ids = Object.keys(groups[key]).sort();
    if (ids.length < 2) return;
    const tid = key.split('|')[0];

    /* A season in common means different people who share a name - unless
       both seats are on this team wearing the same number, which is one
       player entered twice. Every shared season must pass that test. */
    var shared = false, twice = true, sameSeasons = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      for (var j = i + 1; j < ids.length; j++) {
        Object.keys(seasonsOf[ids[i]] || {}).forEach(function (s_) {
          if (!(seasonsOf[ids[j]] || {})[s_]) return;
          shared = true; sameSeasons[s_] = true;
          const a = (seatOf[ids[i]] || {})[s_] || {}, b = (seatOf[ids[j]] || {})[s_] || {};
          if (!(a.team === tid && b.team === tid && a.jersey && a.jersey === b.jersey)) twice = false;
        });
      }
    }
    const grads = {};
    ids.forEach(function (pid) {
      const g = _mpGrad_((players[pid] || {}).GradYear);
      if (g) grads[g] = true;
    });
    const gradConflict = Object.keys(grads).length > 1;

    if ((shared && !twice) || gradConflict) {
      conflicts.push({
        teamId: tid, name: String(players[ids[0]].DisplayName || ''), ids: ids,
        reason: shared && !twice
          ? 'share a season with different numbers — different people who share a name (if it is one player, remove the extra row on the portal Roster tab)'
          : 'graduation years disagree: ' + Object.keys(grads).join(' vs ')
      });
      return;
    }

    // keep the lowest-numbered id: it is the one the rest of the data grew around
    const keep = ids[0];
    const seasons = {};
    ids.forEach(function (pid) {
      Object.keys(seasonsOf[pid] || {}).forEach(function (s_) { seasons[s_] = true; });
    });
    merges.push({
      keep: keep, absorb: ids.slice(1), teamId: tid,
      name: String(players[keep].DisplayName || ''),
      seasons: Object.keys(seasons).sort(),
      // the same number in the same season: one player entered twice
      twice: shared ? Object.keys(sameSeasons).sort() : []
    });
  });

  return { merges: merges, conflicts: conflicts,
           unseated: _mpUnseated_(players, teamOf) };
}

function mergeSplitPlayersDryRun_() { return _mpRun_(false); }
function mergeSplitPlayersApply_()  { return _mpRun_(true); }

/* historical record comment removed */
function mergePlayersByIdDryRun_(absorbId, keepId) {
  return _mpRun_(false, _mpPairPlan_(absorbId, keepId));
}
function mergePlayersByIdApply_(absorbId, keepId) {
  return _mpRun_(true, _mpPairPlan_(absorbId, keepId));
}

function _mpPairPlan_(absorbId, keepId) {
  const absorb = String(absorbId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const keep = String(keepId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!absorb || !keep) throw new Error('Two PlayerIDs are needed, like PLY-EXAMPLE and PLY-EXAMPLE.');
  if (absorb === keep) throw new Error(keep + ' cannot absorb itself.');

  const byId = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS).forEach(function (p) {
    const id = String(p.PlayerID || '').trim();
    if (id) byId[id] = p;
  });
  [absorb, keep].forEach(function (id) {
    if (!byId[id])
      throw new Error(id + ' is not on the Players tab. If something still refers ' +
                      'to it, run Maintenance > Restore orphaned players first — ' +
                      'a career cannot be merged into a row that is not there.');
  });

  const seasons = {}, teams = {};
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).forEach(function (r) {
    const pid = String(r.PlayerID || '').trim();
    if (pid !== absorb && pid !== keep) return;
    if (String(r.SeasonID || '').trim()) seasons[String(r.SeasonID).trim()] = true;
    if (String(r.TeamID || '').trim()) teams[String(r.TeamID).trim()] = true;
  });

  return {
    merges: [{ keep: keep, absorb: [absorb], teamId: Object.keys(teams).join('/'),
               name: String(byId[keep].DisplayName || '') + '  <- ' +
                     String(byId[absorb].DisplayName || ''),
               seasons: Object.keys(seasons).sort(), twice: [] }],
    conflicts: []
  };
}

/**
 * Players who share a name with somebody, and hold no seat in any season.
 *
 * The grouping above is built from PlayerSeasons, so a Players row with no
 * seat never enters a group and the merge tool cannot see it at all — it is
 * not refused, it is invisible. Nine such rows are why "Jeremiah Smith" sits
 * unresolvable on the stat resolver: two records answer to the name, so the
 * resolver will not guess, and the merge tool never offers to remove one.
 *
 * Nothing is merged from this. A row with no seat is not automatically a
 * duplicate — CreatedFrom says where it came from, and the answer differs:
 * a boy who registered an account and was never rostered is a real person
 * with a real claim on his stats, while a row a roster import made twice is
 * an artifact. So this reports the evidence and leaves the decision alone.
 */
/**
 * What a player record actually holds, across every table that names one.
 *
 * CreatedFrom turned out to be blank on almost all of these — they predate the
 * column — so provenance cannot decide it. This can. A record with no seat, no
 * stat row, no account, no award, no correction and no audit entry holds
 * nothing: there is no career behind it and nobody can sign in as it. Whether
 * it was once a real boy is then beside the point, because removing it takes
 * nothing away from anyone, and leaving it makes his namesake's stats
 * unresolvable forever.
 *
 * A record that holds something is a different matter entirely, and this only
 * counts. It never decides.
 */
function _mpHoldings_(pids) {
  const want = {};
  pids.forEach(function (p) { want[p] = {}; });
  const targets = [CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS, CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS,
                   'Accounts', 'Awards', CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS]
                  .filter(function (t) { return t && hasTab_(t); });
  targets.forEach(function (tab) {
    rowsOf_(tab).forEach(function (r) {
      const p = String(r.PlayerID || '').trim();
      if (want[p]) want[p][tab] = (want[p][tab] || 0) + 1;
    });
  });
  if (hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT)) {
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT).forEach(function (a) {
      const p = String(a.EntityID || '').trim();
      if (want[p] && String(a.EntityType || '').trim() === 'Player')
        want[p][CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT] = (want[p][CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT] || 0) + 1;
    });
  }
  return want;
}

/** '' when the record holds nothing at all, else 'Accounts 1, Awards 2'. */
function _mpHoldingText_(h) {
  return Object.keys(h || {}).sort().map(function (t) { return t + ' ' + h[t]; }).join(', ');
}

function _mpUnseated_(players, teamOf) {
  const byName = {};
  Object.keys(players).forEach(function (pid) {
    const n = _mpNorm_(players[pid].DisplayName);
    if (n) (byName[n] = byName[n] || []).push(pid);
  });
  const out = [];
  Object.keys(byName).forEach(function (n) {
    const ids = byName[n].sort();
    if (ids.length < 2) return;
    const seated = ids.filter(function (p) { return teamOf[p]; });
    const loose = ids.filter(function (p) { return !teamOf[p]; });
    if (!seated.length || !loose.length) return;
    out.push({ name: String(players[ids[0]].DisplayName || ''), seated: seated, loose: loose,
               players: players });
  });
  out.sort(function (a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });

  // what each loose record holds, counted once across every table
  const loosePids = [];
  out.forEach(function (u) { u.loose.forEach(function (p) { loosePids.push(p); }); });
  const held = loosePids.length ? _mpHoldings_(loosePids) : {};
  out.forEach(function (u) { u.held = held; });
  return out;
}

function _mpUnseatedReport_(unseated) {
  if (!unseated || !unseated.length) return [];
  const held = unseated[0].held || {};
  const inert = function (pid) { return !Object.keys(held[pid] || {}).length; };

  var empty = 0, holding = 0;
  unseated.forEach(function (u) {
    u.loose.forEach(function (p) { if (inert(p)) empty++; else holding++; });
  });

  const out = ['', 'NEVER SEATED — a second record for the name, on no roster in any season:'];
  unseated.slice(0, 25).forEach(function (u) {
    const P = u.players;
    out.push('  ' + u.name);
    u.seated.forEach(function (pid) {
      out.push('      ' + pid + '  on a roster' +
               (P[pid].GradYear ? ', class of ' + P[pid].GradYear : ''));
    });
