<script>
/* Shared by the public shell and the portal. Policy text always comes from
   the same server bundle that validates the acknowledgment. No prechecked boxes. */
window.UcbacPolicies=(function(){
  var config=null,bundle=null,loading=null,dialog=null,epoch=0,reviewId=0;
  var reviewStates=new WeakMap();
  function escape(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c];});}
  function get(){
    if(bundle)return Promise.resolve(bundle);
    if(!loading)loading=config.call('svcPolicies',[]).then(function(r){bundle=r;loading=null;return r;},function(e){loading=null;throw e;});
    return loading;
  }
  /* Native links must perform their own navigation. A browser can open a tab
     without giving window.open() a usable WindowProxy, especially in a sandbox.
     Record the link activation, not that unreliable return value. Review methods
     remain browser-reported interaction; they are never proof of reading. */
  var savedReview=null,REVIEW_STORAGE='ucbac_policy_review_v2';
  function documents(b){return '<p class="policy-hint">Open each policy below, then return here to continue. Links open in a new tab.</p><div class="policy-documents">'+b.documents.map(function(d){
    var base=String(config.baseUrl()||'').split('?')[0],url=base+'?page=policy&doc='+encodeURIComponent(d.kind);
    return '<a class="policy-doc-link" href="'+escape(url)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-open-policy="'+escape(d.kind)+'" aria-label="Open '+escape(d.title)+' (opens in a new tab)"><span>'+escape(d.title)+'</span><span class="policy-doc-state" aria-hidden="true">Open</span></a>';
  }).join('')+'</div><p class="policy-progress" data-policy-progress role="status" aria-live="polite">0 of 3 policies opened.</p>';}
  function bindReview(scope,owner){
    owner=String(owner||'registration').trim().toLowerCase();
    var state={},id=++reviewId,bundleId=bundle.bundleId;
    try{var stored=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(REVIEW_STORAGE)||'null');if(stored)savedReview=stored;}catch(ignore){}
    if(savedReview&&savedReview.owner===owner&&savedReview.bundleId===bundleId&&Date.now()-savedReview.at>=0&&Date.now()-savedReview.at<86400000){
      ['terms','privacy','data'].forEach(function(k){if(savedReview.methods&&['opened','scrolled'].indexOf(savedReview.methods[k])>=0)state[k]=savedReview.methods[k];});
    }
    reviewStates.set(scope,state);
    var status=scope.querySelector('[data-policy-progress]'),consent=scope.querySelector('[data-policy-consent]'),submit=scope.querySelector('[data-policy-agree]');
    status.id='policy-progress-'+id;
    if(consent)consent.setAttribute('aria-describedby',status.id);
    if(submit)submit.setAttribute('aria-describedby',status.id);
    function refresh(){
      var count=0;scope.querySelectorAll('[data-open-policy]').forEach(function(link){
        var opened=!!state[link.dataset.openPolicy];if(opened){count++;link.setAttribute('data-reviewed','true');}else link.removeAttribute('data-reviewed');
        link.querySelector('.policy-doc-state').textContent=opened?'Opened':'Open';
        link.setAttribute('aria-label','Open '+link.querySelector('span').textContent+' (opens in a new tab)'+(opened?' — already opened':''));
      });
      status.textContent=count===3?'All 3 policies opened. You can now acknowledge them.':count+' of 3 policies opened. Open the remaining '+(3-count)+' to continue.';
      if(consent)consent.disabled=count!==3;
      if(submit)submit.disabled=count!==3||submit.getAttribute('aria-busy')==='true';
    }
    function opened(ev){
      if(ev.type==='auxclick'&&ev.button!==1)return;
      state[this.dataset.openPolicy]='opened';
      savedReview={owner:owner,bundleId:bundleId,at:Date.now(),methods:Object.assign({},state)};
      try{sessionStorage.setItem(REVIEW_STORAGE,JSON.stringify(savedReview));}catch(ignore){}
      refresh();
    }
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-open-policy]').forEach(function(link){link.addEventListener('click',opened);link.addEventListener('auxclick',opened);});
    refresh();
  }
  function clearReview(){savedReview=null;try{sessionStorage.removeItem(REVIEW_STORAGE);}catch(ignore){}}
  function checks(){return '<div class="policy-checks"><label><input type="checkbox" data-policy-consent required disabled><span>I agree to the Terms of Use and acknowledge the Privacy Policy and Data and Publication Policy.</span></label></div>';}
  function payload(scope,agreed){
    if(!bundle||!scope||scope.getAttribute('data-policy-bundle')!==bundle.bundleId)throw new Error('Wait for the policies to load, then open them.');
    var state=reviewStates.get(scope)||{},out={bundleId:bundle.bundleId,review:{}};
    ['terms','privacy','data'].forEach(function(k){if(!state[k])throw new Error('Open all three policy links before continuing. Your progress appears below the links.');out.review[k]=state[k];});
    var consent=scope.querySelector('[data-policy-consent]');
    if(agreed!==true&&!(consent&&consent.checked))throw new Error('Check the box to agree to the terms and acknowledge the policies.');
    out.terms=true;out.privacy=true;out.data=true;
    return out;
  }
  function close(){if(dialog){dialog.close();dialog.remove();dialog=null;}}
  function reset(){epoch++;close();}
  function make(title){
    close();var d=document.createElement('dialog');d.className='policy-dialog';d.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','policy-title');
    d.innerHTML='<h2 id="policy-title">'+escape(title)+'</h2>';document.body.appendChild(d);dialog=d;d.showModal();return d;
  }
  function signup(el){
    el.innerHTML='<p role="status">Loading terms and policies…</p>';
    get().then(function(b){if(!el.isConnected)return;el.setAttribute('data-policy-bundle',b.bundleId);
      el.innerHTML='<p>Review the terms and policies before creating your account.</p>'+documents(b)+checks();
      bindReview(el);
    }).catch(function(){if(!el.isConnected)return;el.innerHTML='<p role="alert">The policies could not load.</p><button type="button" class="policy-link">Try again</button>';el.querySelector('button').onclick=function(){signup(el);};});
  }
  function requireUpdate(auth){
    if(!auth||!auth.accountUpdateRequired)return false;
    if(dialog&&dialog.dataset.required==='yes')return true;
    var needsDob=auth.accountUpdateBirthDateRequired!==false;
    var quarterly=auth.accountUpdateReason==='quarterly';
    var title=needsDob?'Update your account':quarterly?'Quarterly policy review':'Terms and policies';
    var intro=needsDob?'Please enter your date of birth and review our terms and policies to continue using your account.':quarterly?'Every three months, we ask you to review and acknowledge our terms and policies to continue using your account.':'Please review and acknowledge our updated terms and policies to continue using your account.';
    var token=config.token(),version=epoch,d=make(title);d.dataset.required='yes';d.setAttribute('closedby','none');
    d.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();}},true);
    d.addEventListener('cancel',function(e){e.preventDefault();});
    d.innerHTML+='<p>'+escape(intro)+'</p><div data-policy-content><p role="status">Loading terms and policies…</p></div>';
    function signOut(){reset();config.signOut();}
    function current(){return d===dialog&&token===config.token()&&version===epoch;}
    function load(){get().then(function(b){
      if(!current())return;
      var box=d.querySelector('[data-policy-content]');
      var birthField=needsDob?'<label for="policy-dob">Date of birth</label><input id="policy-dob" type="date" autocomplete="bday" required><p id="policy-dob-echo"></p><p>Your full birth date is kept private. See the Privacy Policy for how it is used.</p>':'';
      box.innerHTML='<form id="policy-update-form">'+birthField+documents(b)+'<p class="policy-consent-copy">By choosing Agree &amp; Continue, you agree to the Terms of Use and acknowledge the Privacy Policy and Data and Publication Policy.</p><p class="policy-error" role="alert" id="policy-error"></p><div class="policy-actions"><button type="button" data-policy-signout>Sign Out</button><button type="submit" class="policy-primary" data-policy-agree disabled>Agree &amp; Continue</button></div></form>';
      var form=box.querySelector('form');form.setAttribute('data-policy-bundle',b.bundleId);bindReview(form,auth.email);
      form.querySelector('[data-policy-signout]').onclick=signOut;
      var saving=false;
      form.onsubmit=function(ev){ev.preventDefault();if(saving||!form.reportValidity())return;
        var error=d.querySelector('#policy-error'),button=form.querySelector('[type=submit]'),p;
        try{p={policies:payload(form,true)};if(needsDob)p.dob=form.querySelector('#policy-dob').value;}catch(e){error.textContent=e.message;return;}
        saving=true;button.disabled=true;button.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');button.textContent='Saving…';error.textContent='';
        config.call('svcCompleteAccountUpdate',[p]).then(function(a){if(!current())return;clearReview();close();config.accepted(a);}).catch(function(e){
          if(!current())return;saving=false;button.disabled=false;button.removeAttribute('aria-busy');button.textContent='Agree & Continue';error.textContent=String(e&&e.message||e);
        });
      };
      if(needsDob){
        /* The same seeded-day trap as the sign-up form: a phone's date picker
           opens on a day the person never chose. Here it is worse, because a
           wrong day does not just store a wrong date - it stops matching the
           one on file and locks the account out with nothing to act on. So the
           date is said back in words before it is submitted. */
        var dobEl=form.querySelector('#policy-dob'), dobEcho=form.querySelector('#policy-dob-echo');
        var MON=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July',
                 'August','September','October','November','December'];
        var say=function(){
          var m=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(String(dobEl.value||'').trim());
          if(!m||+m[2]<1||+m[2]>12){dobEcho.textContent='Check the day as well as the month and year.';return;}
          dobEcho.innerHTML='You entered <b>'+(+m[3])+' '+MON[+m[2]-1]+' '+m[1]+'</b>. Please check the day.';
        };
        dobEl.addEventListener('input',say); dobEl.addEventListener('change',say); say();
      }
      form.querySelector(needsDob?'#policy-dob':'[data-open-policy]').focus();
    }).catch(function(){if(!current())return;var box=d.querySelector('[data-policy-content]');box.innerHTML='<p role="alert">The policies could not load. Your account has not been updated.</p><div class="policy-actions"><button type="button" data-policy-signout>Sign Out</button><button type="button" data-policy-retry>Try Again</button></div>';box.querySelector('[data-policy-retry]').onclick=load;box.querySelector('[data-policy-signout]').onclick=signOut;});}
    load();return true;
  }
  return {init:function(c){config=c;},get:get,signup:signup,payload:payload,requireUpdate:requireUpdate,reset:reset};
})();
</script>

<script>
var PORTAL_LAUNCH_STARTED=Date.now(), PORTAL_LAUNCH_CLOSED=false;

function setPortalLaunchLogo(url){
  url=String(url||'');
  if(!/^(https?:|data:image\/)/i.test(url))return false;
  var screen=document.getElementById('launchScreen');
  var img=document.getElementById('launchLogo');
  if(!screen||!img)return false;
  function ready(){if(img.naturalWidth)screen.classList.add('has-logo');}
  img.addEventListener('load',ready,{once:true});
  img.addEventListener('error',function(){
    screen.classList.remove('has-logo');
    try{localStorage.removeItem('ucbac_brand_logo');}catch(e){}
  },{once:true});
  img.src=url;
  if(img.complete)ready();
  return true;
}
function finishPortalLaunch(url){
  if(PORTAL_LAUNCH_CLOSED)return;
  var screen=document.getElementById('launchScreen');
  if(!screen){document.documentElement.classList.remove('launching');PORTAL_LAUNCH_CLOSED=true;return;}
  if(url){
    try{localStorage.setItem('ucbac_brand_logo',String(url));}catch(e){}
    setPortalLaunchLogo(url);
  }
  var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var exitQueued=false;
  function close(){
    if(PORTAL_LAUNCH_CLOSED)return;
    PORTAL_LAUNCH_CLOSED=true;
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('launching');
    screen.classList.add('is-done');
    window.setTimeout(function(){if(screen.parentNode)screen.remove();},reduce?0:200);
  }
  function closeAtMinimum(){
    if(exitQueued)return;
    exitQueued=true;
    window.setTimeout(close,Math.max(0,(reduce?0:480)-(Date.now()-PORTAL_LAUNCH_STARTED)));
  }
  var img=document.getElementById('launchLogo');
  if(reduce||!url||screen.classList.contains('has-logo'))closeAtMinimum();
  else{
    img.addEventListener('load',closeAtMinimum,{once:true});
    img.addEventListener('error',closeAtMinimum,{once:true});
    window.setTimeout(closeAtMinimum,1000);
  }
}
try{setPortalLaunchLogo(localStorage.getItem('ucbac_brand_logo')||'');}catch(e){}

/* -
   The signed-in portal. One page, four audiences.

     no account -> ask for one          PENDING -> wait for a person
     PLAYER     -> own profile, own statistics, ask for a correction
     COACH      -> roster (captains included), scores, stat entry, links, approvals
     ADMIN      -> all of that for any team, plus conference coverage

   Nothing here decides who may do what - the server decides that on every call,
   and these views only choose what is worth putting on screen. A refusal comes
   back as a sentence somebody wrote to be read, so it is printed as one rather
   than swallowed.

   Every numeric box submits blank as blank. A cleared height is "not reported";
   a zero says he is nought inches tall, and the difference between those two is
   what the rest of this database is built on.
   - */

var STATE = {
  auth: null,          // svcAuthState
  boot: null,          // svcBootstrap - teams and seasons for the pickers
  options: [],         // position chips
  teamId: '', seasonId: '',
  view: '',
  roster: null,        // svcRoster for teamId + seasonId
  ta: null,            // svcTeamAdmin for teamId + seasonId
  prof: null,          // svcMyProfile
  mine: null,          // svcPlayer for my own id
  awards: null,
  corrections: null,
  pending: null,       // svcPendingAccounts
  pendCorr: null,      // svcPendingCorrections - every school for an admin
  box: null,           // the box score being edited
  boxLoading: null,
  capt: null,          // the captain list being edited
  su: null,            // the create-account form being filled in
  patch: null,         // profile draft
  linkPatch: null,     // team-links draft
  pos: null,           // profile position draft
  corr: null,          // correction request draft
  login: null,         // the sign-in form's own state
  flash: null,
  busy: false
};

/* - the session token -
   Sign-in is an emailed one-time code (Auth.gs); redeeming it yields a token
   the server can turn back into an email. It lives in localStorage so a
   sign-in survives the tab. In browsers that wall off storage inside this
   sandbox frame (Safari, mostly) the fallback is the page variable - sign-in
   then lasts until the tab closes, which is worse but never broken. */
var TOKEN = '';
try { TOKEN = localStorage.getItem('ucbac_token') || ''; } catch(e){}

function setToken(t){
  if (TOKEN !== (t || '')) UcbacPolicies.reset();
  TOKEN = t || '';
  try {
    if (TOKEN) localStorage.setItem('ucbac_token', TOKEN);
    else localStorage.removeItem('ucbac_token');
  } catch(e){}
}

/* The svc functions that take no identity. Everything else gets the session
   token prepended as its first argument - the server wrappers expect it there
   and bind it for the request. */
var PUBLIC_SVC = { svcBootstrap:1, svcHome:1, svcScores:1, svcWeeks:1, svcStandings:1,
                   svcLeaders:1, svcTeam:1, svcPlayer:1, svcGame:1, svcSearch:1,
                   svcAllConference:1, svcStatsFilters:1, svcStats:1, svcPlayerAwards:1,
                   svcPositionOptions:1, svcRequestLoginCode:1, svcRedeemLoginCode:1,
                   svcRegisterStart:1, svcPlaysInfo:1, svcForgotEmail:1, svcTeamCrest:1,
                   /* the page counter carries no session and must not be handed one */
                   svcHit:1, svcPolicies:1, svcHomeDocument:1 };

/* Say the school's name, never its row key. TEAM-006 is bookkeeping. */
function tnameOf(id){
  var t = (STATE.boot && STATE.boot.teams || []).filter(function(x){ return x.id === id; })[0];
  return (t && t.name) || String(id || '');
}
/* Same rule for seasons: "2026 Season", never SEA-2026. */
function snameOf(id){
  var x = (STATE.boot && STATE.boot.seasons || []).filter(function(s){ return s.id === id; })[0];
  return ((x && x.label) || String(id || '').replace('SEA-','')) + ' Season';
}
/* The same All-Conference chip the public site wears - RB1 gold, RB2 silver,
   nothing for Honorable Mention - so a coach's roster agrees with the page a
   parent is looking at. Data rides in on the shared bootstrap. */
function acbMark(playerId, seasonId){
  var m = STATE.boot && STATE.boot.acbadge && STATE.boot.acbadge[seasonId || STATE.seasonId];
  m = m && m[playerId];
  if (!m) return '';
  return m.split('|').map(function(b){
    var first = b.charAt(b.length-1) === '1';
    return ' <span class="acb '+(first?'g':'s')+'" title="Projected '+
      (first?'First':'Second')+' Team · live All-Conference">'+esc(b)+'</span>';
  }).join('');
}
/* The public site's blue check, on the coach's roster too: this player holds
   an active account and manages his own profile - which is exactly the row a
   coach does not need to fill in himself. */
function vMark(playerId){
  if (!(STATE.boot && STATE.boot.verified && STATE.boot.verified[playerId])) return '';
  return '<span class="vfy" role="img" aria-label="Verified account" '+
         'title="Verified - this player manages his own profile">✓</span>';
}

function call(fn, args){
  var a = (args||[]).slice();
  if (!PUBLIC_SVC[fn]) a.unshift(TOKEN);
  return new Promise(function(res, rej){
    google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(res).withFailureHandler(rej)[fn].apply(null, a);
  });
}
function esc(s){ return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){
  return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]; }); }
function msgOf(e){ return String(e && e.message || e || 'Something went wrong.'); }

/* Native selects remain the source of truth. The visible layer adds a larger
   touch target, a clear caret, fast feedback, collision-safe placement and
   Arrow/Enter/Escape handling without changing any existing data-h contract. */
var SMART_SELECT={host:null,select:null,trigger:null,popover:null,active:-1,uid:0,closeTimer:null};
function smartSelectName(select){
  var name=select.getAttribute('aria-label')||'';
  if(!name&&select.id){Array.prototype.some.call(document.getElementsByTagName('label'),function(label){if(label.htmlFor===select.id){name=label.textContent.trim();return true;}return false;});}
  if(!name){var parent=select.parentElement,label=parent&&parent.querySelector('label.f');name=label?label.textContent.trim():'Choose an option';}
  return name||'Choose an option';
}
function smartSelectSync(select){
  if(!select||!select._smartTrigger)return;
  var option=select.options[select.selectedIndex];select._smartTrigger.textContent=option?option.text:'Choose...';select._smartTrigger.disabled=!!select.disabled;
}
function smartSelectSetActive(index){
  var pop=SMART_SELECT.popover;if(!pop)return;
  var options=pop.querySelectorAll('.smart-select-option');if(!options.length)return;
  index=Math.max(0,Math.min(index,options.length-1));
  while(options[index]&&options[index].disabled&&index<options.length-1)index++;
  if(options[index]&&options[index].disabled){while(index>0&&options[index].disabled)index--;}
  SMART_SELECT.active=index;
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(options,function(option,i){option.classList.toggle('is-active',i===index);});
  var active=options[index];if(active){pop.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',active.id);if(SMART_SELECT.trigger)SMART_SELECT.trigger.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',active.id);active.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});}
}
function smartSelectClose(returnFocus){
  var pop=SMART_SELECT.popover,trigger=SMART_SELECT.trigger;if(!pop)return;
  window.clearTimeout(SMART_SELECT.closeTimer);pop.classList.remove('is-open');if(trigger){trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');trigger.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');trigger.removeAttribute('aria-controls');}
  SMART_SELECT.closeTimer=window.setTimeout(function(){if(pop.parentNode)pop.parentNode.removeChild(pop);},90);
  SMART_SELECT.host=SMART_SELECT.select=SMART_SELECT.trigger=SMART_SELECT.popover=null;SMART_SELECT.active=-1;
  if(returnFocus&&trigger)trigger.focus();
}
function smartSelectChoose(index){
  var select=SMART_SELECT.select,pop=SMART_SELECT.popover;if(!select||!pop)return;
  var item=pop.querySelectorAll('.smart-select-option')[index];if(!item||item.disabled)return;
  select.selectedIndex=Number(item.getAttribute('data-option-index'));smartSelectSync(select);
  select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));smartSelectClose(true);
}
function smartSelectPosition(pop,trigger){
  var r=trigger.getBoundingClientRect(),gutter=12,below=window.innerHeight-r.bottom-gutter,above=r.top-gutter;
  var desired=Math.min(pop.scrollHeight||336,336),up=below<desired+8&&above>below,available=Math.max(96,Math.min(336,up?above:below));
  var width=Math.min(Math.max(r.width,180),window.innerWidth-gutter*2);
  pop.style.width=width+'px';pop.style.maxHeight=available+'px';pop.style.left=Math.max(gutter,Math.min(r.left,window.innerWidth-width-gutter))+'px';
  pop.classList.toggle('opens-up',up);pop.style.top=(up?Math.max(gutter,r.top-Math.min(pop.scrollHeight,available)-8):r.bottom+8)+'px';
}
function smartSelectOpen(select,instant){
  if(!select||select.disabled)return;if(SMART_SELECT.select===select){smartSelectClose(true);return;}smartSelectClose(false);
  var trigger=select._smartTrigger,pop=document.createElement('div');pop.className='smart-select-popover';pop.id='smart-select-popover-'+(++SMART_SELECT.uid);
  pop.setAttribute('role','listbox');pop.setAttribute('aria-label',smartSelectName(select));
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(select.options,function(option,i){
    var item=document.createElement('button');item.type='button';item.className='smart-select-option';item.id=pop.id+'-option-'+i;
    item.setAttribute('role','option');item.setAttribute('data-option-index',i);item.setAttribute('aria-selected',option.selected?'true':'false');item.disabled=!!option.disabled;
    item.textContent=option.text;item.addEventListener('click',function(){smartSelectChoose(i);});pop.appendChild(item);
  });
  document.body.appendChild(pop);SMART_SELECT.host=select.parentNode;SMART_SELECT.select=select;SMART_SELECT.trigger=trigger;SMART_SELECT.popover=pop;
  trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');trigger.setAttribute('aria-controls',pop.id);smartSelectPosition(pop,trigger);smartSelectSetActive(Math.max(0,select.selectedIndex));
  if(instant)pop.classList.add('is-open');else window.requestAnimationFrame(function(){if(SMART_SELECT.popover===pop)pop.classList.add('is-open');});
}
function smartSelectKey(ev,select){
  var open=SMART_SELECT.select===select;
  if(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp'){ev.preventDefault();if(!open){smartSelectOpen(select,true);return;}smartSelectSetActive(SMART_SELECT.active+(ev.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1));return;}
  if(ev.key==='Home'&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectSetActive(0);return;}
  if(ev.key==='End'&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectSetActive(select.options.length-1);return;}
  if((ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' ')&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectChoose(SMART_SELECT.active);return;}
  if((ev.key==='Enter'||ev.key===' ')&&!open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectOpen(select,true);return;}
  if(ev.key==='Escape'&&open){ev.preventDefault();smartSelectClose(true);return;}
  if(ev.key==='Tab'&&open)smartSelectClose(false);
}
function enhanceSelect(select){
  /* the observer runs after the fact: a select replaced before it fires has
     no parent any more, and nothing to enhance */
  if(!select||!select.parentNode||select.multiple||select.getAttribute('data-smart-select'))return;
  select.setAttribute('data-smart-select','true');select.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');select.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');var host=document.createElement('span');host.className='smart-select'+(select.className?' '+select.className:'');
  ['width','minWidth','maxWidth','marginTop','marginRight','marginBottom','marginLeft'].forEach(function(prop){if(select.style[prop])host.style[prop]=select.style[prop];});
  select.parentNode.insertBefore(host,select);host.appendChild(select);select.classList.add('smart-select-native');
  var trigger=document.createElement('button');trigger.type='button';trigger.className='smart-select-trigger';trigger.id='smart-select-trigger-'+(++SMART_SELECT.uid);
  trigger.setAttribute('role','combobox');trigger.setAttribute('aria-haspopup','listbox');trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');trigger.setAttribute('aria-label',smartSelectName(select));
  host.appendChild(trigger);select._smartTrigger=trigger;smartSelectSync(select);
  if(select.id){Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.getElementsByTagName('label'),function(label){if(label.htmlFor===select.id)label.htmlFor=trigger.id;});}
  trigger.addEventListener('click',function(){smartSelectOpen(select);});trigger.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){smartSelectKey(ev,select);});
  select.addEventListener('change',function(){smartSelectSync(select);});
}
function enhanceSelects(root){
  if(!root)return;if(root.tagName==='SELECT')enhanceSelect(root);
  if(root.querySelectorAll)Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('select'),enhanceSelect);
}
enhanceSelects(document);
if(typeof MutationObserver==='function')new MutationObserver(function(records){records.forEach(function(record){
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(record.addedNodes,enhanceSelects);
  var select=record.target&&record.target.tagName==='SELECT'?record.target:null;if(select&&select.getAttribute('data-smart-select'))smartSelectSync(select);
});}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){if(SMART_SELECT.popover&&!SMART_SELECT.popover.contains(ev.target)&&!SMART_SELECT.host.contains(ev.target))smartSelectClose(false);});
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){smartSelectClose(false);});
document.addEventListener('scroll',function(ev){if(SMART_SELECT.popover&&ev.target!==SMART_SELECT.popover)smartSelectClose(false);},true);

/* What goes into a value="" box. Blank stays blank - null, undefined and '' all
   render as an empty box and never as 0, which would read as a reported zero.
   Escaped because a rejected entry is echoed back as the person typed it. */
function cell(v){ return (v===null||v===undefined) ? '' : esc(v); }

/* What a numeric box submits. Blank is null, which every normalizer on the
   server reads as "not reported". Junk goes back as the string the person
   actually typed, so the refusal can name it instead of saying NaN. */
function readNum(el){
  var t = String(el.value == null ? '' : el.value).trim();
  if (t === '') return null;
  var n = Number(t);
  return isNaN(n) ? t : n;
}
function readText(el){ return String(el.value == null ? '' : el.value).trim(); }

/* A number nobody reported is not a zero and must never print as one. */
function orBlank(v){
  return (v===null||v===undefined||v==='') ? '<span class="blank">not reported</span>' : esc(v);
}
function num(v){ return (v===null||v===undefined||v==='') ? '' : esc(v); }
/* 73 -> 6′1″. A height is said in feet everywhere it is read, never in inches. */
function ftIn(v){
  if (v===null||v===undefined||v==='') return '';
  var n = Number(v); if (isNaN(n)) return esc(v);
  return Math.floor(n/12)+'&prime;'+(n%12)+'&Prime;';
}

/* A game date is a calendar day, not an instant, and must not go through
   new Date(): the browser reads a bare YYYY-MM-DD as UTC midnight and prints
   it in local time, so every Friday fixture west of Greenwich came out as the
   Thursday before it. Read the three fields and build the date from them. */
function dateShort(iso){
  if (!iso) return '';
  /* Anchored: a DATE-ONLY string is a calendar day and is read field by field.
     A full timestamp - "2026-09-11T02:00:00Z", an account created at ten the
     previous evening - is a real instant and still goes through new Date(),
     which converts it to the reader's zone correctly. */
  var m = String(iso).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
  if (m) return (+m[2])+'/'+(+m[3])+'/'+m[1];
  try { var d = new Date(iso); if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d.toLocaleDateString(); } catch(e){}
  return String(iso).slice(0,10);
}
/* A timestamp IS an instant — an audit row, a sign-in — so this one is right
   to go through new Date(). Only the date-only values above were wrong. */
function dateLong(iso){
  if (!iso) return '';
  try { var d = new Date(iso); if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d.toLocaleString(); } catch(e){}
  return String(iso);
}
function plural(n, one, many){ return n + ' ' + (n===1 ? one : (many || one + 's')); }
function has(list, k){ return (list||[]).indexOf(k) >= 0; }

function banner(id, kind, html){
  document.getElementById(id).innerHTML = html
    ? '<div class="banner '+kind+'" role="'+(kind==='bad'?'alert':'status')+'">'+html+'</div>' : '';
}
/* Two slots, because they carry two different facts and both are true at once.
   #alert is the view talking about itself ("four players have no position");
   #notice is what happened to the last save. One slot meant a redraw wiped the
   refusal that caused it, which is how an edit goes missing without a word. */
function alertBox(kind, html){ banner('alert', kind, html); }
function noticeBox(kind, html){ banner('notice', kind, html); }
/* Both slots sit above the whole view. On a long page that is off screen, and
   an answer nobody can see is the same as no answer. Call this when there is
   nowhere nearer to put it. */
function noticeSeen(){
  var el = document.getElementById('notice');
  if (!el || !el.firstChild) return;
  var box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (box.top >= 0 && box.bottom <= (window.innerHeight || 0)) return;
  try { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' }); }
  catch(e){ el.scrollIntoView(); }
}
function loadingCard(label,rows){
  rows=rows||3;
  return '<div class="card loading-card" role="status" aria-label="'+esc(label||'Loading')+'">'+
    '<i class="skeleton sk-heading"></i><i class="skeleton sk-copy"></i>'+ 
    Array(rows+1).join('<i class="skeleton sk-row"></i>')+'</div>';
}
function enhanceUI(root){
  if(!root)return;
  root.querySelectorAll('button:not([type])').forEach(function(b){b.type='button';});
  root.querySelectorAll('label.f:not([for])').forEach(function(label,i){
    var control=label.nextElementSibling;
    if(!control||!/^(INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(control.tagName)){
      var parent=label.parentElement;
      control=parent&&parent.querySelector('input,select,textarea');
    }
    if(!control)return;
    if(!control.id)control.id='portal-field-'+Date.now()+'-'+i;
    label.setAttribute('for',control.id);
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(function(control){
    if(control.getAttribute('aria-label'))return;
    if(control.id&&document.querySelector('label[for="'+CSS.escape(control.id)+'"]'))return;
    var cell=control.closest('td,th');
    var row=control.closest('tr');
    if(cell&&row){
      var table=control.closest('table');
      var headers=table?table.querySelectorAll('thead th'):[];
      var head=headers[cell.cellIndex] ? headers[cell.cellIndex].textContent.trim() : '';
      var person=row.querySelector('.nm');
      var subject=person ? person.textContent.trim() : '';
      if(control.type==='checkbox'&&!head)head=row.closest('thead')?'Select all roster rows':'Select player';
      control.setAttribute('aria-label',(head||control.getAttribute('placeholder')||'Field')+(subject?' for '+subject:''));
    }
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('.scroll').forEach(function(region){
    region.setAttribute('role','region');region.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
    if(!region.getAttribute('aria-label'))region.setAttribute('aria-label','Scrollable data table');
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[id$="Msg"]').forEach(function(msg){msg.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');});
  enhanceSelects(root);
  // Reserve validation space before interaction so blur does not move the next target.
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-validate-scope] input,[data-validate-scope] select').forEach(function(control){
    if(shouldValidate(control))validationSlot(control);
  });
}

/* Blur-first validation. A field stays quiet while it is being entered for the
   first time. After blur exposes a problem, every input rechecks it so the
   error disappears the instant the value is acceptable. */
var VALIDATION_UID=0;
function validationLabel(control){
  var name=control.getAttribute('aria-label')||'';
  if(!name&&control.id){Array.prototype.some.call(document.getElementsByTagName('label'),function(label){if(label.htmlFor===control.id||label.htmlFor===(control._smartTrigger&&control._smartTrigger.id)){name=label.textContent.trim();return true;}return false;});}
  if(!name){var parent=control.parentElement,label=parent&&parent.querySelector('label.f');name=label?label.textContent.trim():control.getAttribute('placeholder')||'This field';}
  return name.replace(/\s*\*\s*$/,'')||'This field';
}
function shouldValidate(control){
  if(!control||control.disabled||control.readOnly||control.type==='checkbox'||control.type==='radio')return false;
  /* Inline verdicts belong to account registration and nowhere else. The
     listeners below are document-wide, and without this gate every filled
     text box in the portal earned a "Looks good." on blur - under a stat
     entry, under a coach's roster edit, under the search box - which turns a
     reassurance into noise. A form opts in by carrying data-validate-scope;
     the registration card is the one that does. Everything else keeps its
     own feedback: the server's sentences, which were always the authority. */
  if(!control.closest||!control.closest('[data-validate-scope]'))return false;
  return !!(control.required||control.value||control.type==='email'||control.pattern||control.minLength>0||control.getAttribute('data-validate'));
}
function validationError(control){
  if(!shouldValidate(control))return '';
  var value=String(control.value||'').trim(),label=validationLabel(control);
  if(control.required&&!value)return 'Enter '+label.toLowerCase()+'.';
  if(!value)return '';
  if(control.getAttribute('data-validate')==='person-name'){
    if(value.length<2)return label+' needs at least two characters.';
    if(!/^[A-Za-z\u00C0-\u024F.' -]+$/.test(value))return 'Use letters, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens for '+label.toLowerCase()+'.';
  }
  if(control.getAttribute('data-validate')==='six-digit-code'&&!/^\d{6}$/.test(value))return 'Enter the six-digit code using numbers only.';
  if(control.type==='email'&&!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(value))return 'Enter a complete email address, such as contact@example.invalid.';
  if(control.minLength>0&&value.length<control.minLength)return label+' needs at least '+control.minLength+' characters.';
  if(control.validity){
    if(control.validity.rangeUnderflow||control.validity.rangeOverflow)return 'Choose a '+label.toLowerCase()+' within the allowed range.';
    if(control.validity.patternMismatch)return 'Check the required format for '+label.toLowerCase()+'.';
    if(control.validity.badInput)return 'Enter a valid '+label.toLowerCase()+'.';
  }
  return '';
}
function validationSlot(control){
  if(!control.id)control.id='portal-validation-field-'+(++VALIDATION_UID);
  var id=control.id+'-feedback',feedback=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!feedback){
    feedback=document.createElement('div');feedback.id=id;feedback.className='field-feedback';
    var anchor=control.closest&&control.closest('.smart-select')||control;
    anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(feedback,anchor.nextSibling);
  }
  return feedback;
}
function validationFeedback(control,message,valid){
  if(!control.id)control.id='portal-validation-field-'+(++VALIDATION_UID);
  var id=control.id+'-feedback',feedback=document.getElementById(id),visual=control.closest&&control.closest('.smart-select')||control;
  if(!feedback)feedback=validationSlot(control);
  feedback.className='field-feedback '+(valid?'is-valid':'is-error');feedback.setAttribute('aria-live',valid?'polite':'assertive');feedback.textContent=message;
  control.setAttribute('aria-describedby',id);control.setAttribute('aria-invalid',valid?'false':'true');
  if(control._smartTrigger){control._smartTrigger.setAttribute('aria-describedby',id);control._smartTrigger.setAttribute('aria-invalid',valid?'false':'true');}
  visual.classList.toggle('is-valid',valid);visual.classList.toggle('is-invalid',!valid);
}
function clearValidationFeedback(control){
  var visual=control.closest&&control.closest('.smart-select')||control;
  visual.classList.remove('is-valid','is-invalid');control.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
  if(control._smartTrigger)control._smartTrigger.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
  var feedback=control.id&&document.getElementById(control.id+'-feedback');if(feedback){feedback.textContent='';feedback.className='field-feedback';feedback.removeAttribute('aria-live');}
}
function validateControl(control,showSuccess){
  if(!shouldValidate(control)){clearValidationFeedback(control);return true;}
  var error=validationError(control);
  if(error){validationFeedback(control,error,false);control.setAttribute('data-validation-live','true');return false;}
  if(showSuccess)validationFeedback(control,'Looks good.',true);else clearValidationFeedback(control);
  control.setAttribute('data-validation-live','true');return true;
}
function validateScope(root){
  var fields=Array.prototype.slice.call((root||document).querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea')).filter(shouldValidate),first=null;
  fields.forEach(function(control){control.setAttribute('data-validation-touched','true');if(!validateControl(control,true)&&!first)first=control;});
  if(first){var focusTarget=first._smartTrigger||first;focusTarget.focus();}
  return !first;
}
document.addEventListener('focusout',function(ev){
  var control=ev.target;if(!control||!/^(INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(control.tagName)||!shouldValidate(control))return;
  control.setAttribute('data-validation-touched','true');validateControl(control,true);
},true);
document.addEventListener('input',function(ev){
  var control=ev.target;if(!control||!/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(control.tagName)||!control.getAttribute('data-validation-live'))return;
  validateControl(control,true);
});
document.addEventListener('change',function(ev){
  var control=ev.target;if(!control||control.tagName!=='SELECT'||!shouldValidate(control))return;
  control.setAttribute('data-validation-touched','true');validateControl(control,true);
});

}

/* - unsaved work -
   Dirty state is kept per view, not globally, because the edit buffer behind
   each view survives a tab switch. Losing a half-typed roster because somebody
   looked at the schedule is not a thing this page should do. */
var DIRTY = {};
function dirtySet(){ return DIRTY[STATE.view] || (DIRTY[STATE.view] = {}); }
function dirtyCount(){ return Object.keys(dirtySet()).length; }
function markDirty(key){ dirtySet()[key] = true; barCount(); }
function setDirty(obj){ DIRTY[STATE.view] = obj || {}; barCount(); }
function clearDirty(){ setDirty({}); }

/* - the save bar -
   One bar, re-pointed by whichever view is showing. A view with nothing to save
   hides it rather than leaving a dead button on the screen. */
var BAR = { save:null, reset:null };

function barShow(cfg){
  BAR.save = cfg.save || null;
  BAR.reset = cfg.reset || null;
  document.getElementById('bar').style.display = cfg.save ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('btnSave').textContent = cfg.label || 'Save';
  document.getElementById('btnReset').style.display = cfg.reset ? '' : 'none';
  barCount();
}
function barHide(){
  BAR.save = null; BAR.reset = null;
  document.getElementById('bar').style.display = 'none';
}
function barMsg(text, kind){
  var m = document.getElementById('msg');
  m.textContent = text;
  m.className = 'msg' + (kind ? ' ' + kind : '');
}
/* Held across the repaint that follows a save, so the outcome is still on
   screen when the redrawn page arrives. */
function flash(text, kind){ STATE.flash = { text:text, kind:kind }; }

function barCount(){
  var n = dirtyCount();
  document.getElementById('btnSave').disabled = STATE.busy || !n;
  if (STATE.busy) return;
  if (STATE.flash){ barMsg(STATE.flash.text, STATE.flash.kind); STATE.flash = null; return; }
  barMsg(n ? plural(n, 'unsaved change') : '', '');
}
function busy(on, text){
  STATE.busy = !!on;
  var bar=document.getElementById('bar');
  if(bar)bar.setAttribute('aria-busy',on?'true':'false');
  document.getElementById('btnSave').disabled = on || !dirtyCount();
  if (on && text) barMsg(text, '');
}

document.getElementById('btnSave').addEventListener('click', function(){
  if (BAR.save && !STATE.busy) BAR.save();
});
document.getElementById('btnReset').addEventListener('click', function(){
  if (BAR.reset && !STATE.busy) BAR.reset();
});

/* - event dispatch -
   Every view repaints #view whole, so a listener bound to a row dies the moment
   anything re-renders. These live on document and dispatch by data-a (click) or
   data-h (edit), which survives every repaint. */
var ACT = {}, INP = {};

document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
  var el = ev.target;
  while (el && el !== document && !(el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('data-a'))) el = el.parentNode;
  if (!el || el === document || !el.getAttribute) return;
  var fn = ACT[el.getAttribute('data-a')];
  if (!fn) return;
  ev.preventDefault();
  fn(el, ev);
});

/* A select fires input AND change, so every handler below is written to be
   safe when it runs twice on the same edit. */
function onEdit(ev){
  var el = ev.target;
  if (!el || !el.getAttribute) return;
  var fn = INP[el.getAttribute('data-h')];
  if (fn) fn(el, ev);
}
document.addEventListener('input', onEdit);
document.addEventListener('change', onEdit);

/* - position picker -
   One multi-select dropdown serving the roster editor, the registration form
   and a player's own profile. `own` names whose codes it edits - 'reg',
   'profile', 'add', or a playerSeasonId - and one set of handlers resolves it.

   A row of eighteen chips was the whole width of the roster table; a closed
   dropdown is one cell. The panel offers the seven majors plus TE/ATH and
   special teams; a major with sub-positions (OL, DL, LB, DB) reveals them once
   it is selected. Selecting a sub stores the sub code in the major's place -
   ILB is a Linebacker everywhere positions are matched, so nothing is lost and
   the finer fact is kept. Unselecting the last sub falls back to the bare
   major rather than unselecting the position the person just refined. */

function posCodesOf(own){
  if (own === 'profile') return STATE.pos || (STATE.pos = []);
  if (own === 'add'){ STATE.add = STATE.add || { positions: [] }; return STATE.add.positions; }
  var p = rosterRow(own);
  return p ? p.positions : null;
}

/** The owner-specific consequences of a change, in one place. */
function posChanged(own){
  if (own === 'profile'){ STATE.patch.positions = STATE.pos; markDirty('positions'); return; }
  if (own === 'add') return;
  var p = rosterRow(own);
  if (!p) return;
  markDirty(own);
  var tr = document.querySelector('tr[data-ps="'+own+'"]');
  if (tr) tr.className = rosterRowClass(p);
  countIncomplete();
}

function posMajorOn(codes, o){
  if (codes.indexOf(o.code) >= 0) return true;
  return (o.subs||[]).some(function(x){ return codes.indexOf(x.code) >= 0; });
}

function posSummary(codes){
  return codes.length ? codes.join(', ') : 'Select...';
}

function posPicker(codes, own){
  if (!STATE.options.length)
    return '<div class="sub">The position list did not load. Reload the page.</div>';
  return '<div class="pk" data-pk="'+esc(own)+'">'
    + '<button type="button" class="pk-btn'+(codes.length?'':' empty')+'" data-a="posOpen" '
    + 'data-own="'+esc(own)+'" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="position-panel-'+esc(own)+'">'+esc(posSummary(codes))+'<i class="chev" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>'
    + '<div class="pk-panel" id="position-panel-'+esc(own)+'" data-panel="'+esc(own)+'" role="group" aria-label="Choose positions" style="display:none"></div>'
    + '</div>';
}

function posPanelHtml(own){
  var codes = posCodesOf(own) || [];
  var sides = [['OFF','Offense'],['DEF','Defense'],['ST','Special teams']];
  var h = '';
  sides.forEach(function(sd){
    var opts = STATE.options.filter(function(o){ return o.side === sd[0]; });
    if (!opts.length) return;
    h += '<div class="pk-grp">'+sd[1]+'</div>';
    opts.forEach(function(o){
      var on = posMajorOn(codes, o);
      h += '<label class="pk-row"><input type="checkbox" '+(on?'checked':'')
        + ' data-a="posTgl" data-own="'+esc(own)+'" data-code="'+o.code+'">'
        + '<span>'+esc(o.label)
        + (o.ranked ? '' : ' <em class="pk-note">tracked, no award</em>')+'</span></label>';
      if (on && (o.subs||[]).length){
        h += '<div class="pk-subs">'+o.subs.map(function(x){
          var son = codes.indexOf(x.code) >= 0;
          return '<label class="pk-sub"><input type="checkbox" '+(son?'checked':'')
            + ' data-a="posTgl" data-own="'+esc(own)+'" data-code="'+x.code+'"'
            + ' data-major="'+o.code+'">'+esc(x.label)+'</label>';
        }).join('')+'</div>';
      }
    });
  });
  return h + '<div class="pk-hint">Every position he actually plays. Sub-positions are '
    + 'optional - Linebacker alone is a complete answer.</div>';
}

function posRefresh(own){
  var codes = posCodesOf(own) || [];
  var wrap = document.querySelector('.pk[data-pk="'+own+'"]');
  if (!wrap) return;
  var btn = wrap.querySelector('.pk-btn');
  if (btn){
    btn.innerHTML = esc(posSummary(codes)) + '<i class="chev" aria-hidden="true"></i>';
    btn.className = 'pk-btn' + (codes.length ? '' : ' empty');
  }
  var panel = wrap.querySelector('.pk-panel');
  if (panel && panel.style.display !== 'none') panel.innerHTML = posPanelHtml(own);
}

function posCloseAll(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.pk-panel').forEach(function(p){
    window.clearTimeout(p._closeTimer);p.classList.remove('is-open');
    p._closeTimer=window.setTimeout(function(){if(!p.classList.contains('is-open'))p.style.display='none';},90);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.pk-btn').forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');});
}

ACT.posOpen = function(el,ev){
  var own = el.getAttribute('data-own');
  var wrap = document.querySelector('.pk[data-pk="'+own+'"]');
  var panel = wrap && wrap.querySelector('.pk-panel');
  if (!panel) return;
  var open = panel.classList.contains('is-open');
  posCloseAll();
  if (open) return;
  window.clearTimeout(panel._closeTimer);
  el.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
  panel.innerHTML = posPanelHtml(own);
  /* Fixed positioning, measured at open. The roster table scrolls inside its
     own box, and an absolutely positioned panel would be clipped by it. */
  var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  panel.style.display = 'block';
  panel.style.position = 'fixed';
  panel.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - 268)) + 'px';
  var gutter=12,below=window.innerHeight-r.bottom-gutter,above=r.top-gutter;
  var desired=Math.min(panel.scrollHeight||320,320),up=below<desired+8&&above>below;
  var available=Math.max(96,Math.min(320,up?above:below));
  panel.style.maxHeight=available+'px';panel.classList.toggle('opens-up',up);
  panel.style.bottom='';panel.style.top=(up?Math.max(gutter,r.top-Math.min(panel.scrollHeight,available)-8):r.bottom+8)+'px';
  if(ev&&ev.keyboard)panel.style.transition='none';
  window.requestAnimationFrame(function(){panel.classList.add('is-open');
    if(ev&&ev.keyboard){var choices=panel.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');if(choices.length)choices[ev.last?choices.length-1:0].focus();}
    if(ev&&ev.keyboard)window.requestAnimationFrame(function(){panel.style.transition='';});
  });
};

document.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
  var trigger=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('.pk-btn'):null;
  var panel=ev.target.closest?ev.target.closest('.pk-panel'):null;
  if(trigger&&(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp')){
    ev.preventDefault();var own=trigger.getAttribute('data-own'),open=document.querySelector('.pk-panel[data-panel="'+own+'"]');
    if(!open||!open.classList.contains('is-open'))ACT.posOpen(trigger,{keyboard:true,last:ev.key==='ArrowUp'});
    else{var checks=open.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]');if(checks.length)checks[ev.key==='ArrowUp'?checks.length-1:0].focus();}
    return;
  }
  if(panel&&(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='ArrowUp'||ev.key==='Home'||ev.key==='End')){
    ev.preventDefault();var items=Array.prototype.slice.call(panel.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'));
    var at=items.indexOf(document.activeElement),next=ev.key==='Home'?0:ev.key==='End'?items.length-1:Math.max(0,Math.min(items.length-1,at+(ev.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)));
    if(items[next])items[next].focus();return;
  }
  if(panel&&ev.key==='Enter'&&ev.target.matches('input[type="checkbox"]')){ev.preventDefault();ev.target.click();return;}
  if(ev.key!=='Escape')return;
  var openPanel=document.querySelector('.pk-panel.is-open');if(!openPanel)return;
  var panelOwner=openPanel.getAttribute('data-panel');posCloseAll();
  var btn=document.querySelector('.pk-btn[data-own="'+panelOwner+'"]');if(btn)btn.focus();
});

ACT.posTgl = function(el){
  var own = el.getAttribute('data-own');
  var codes = posCodesOf(own);
  if (!codes) return;
  var code = el.getAttribute('data-code');
  var major = el.getAttribute('data-major');
  var opt = STATE.options.filter(function(o){ return o.code === code; })[0];

  function drop(c){ var i = codes.indexOf(c); if (i >= 0) codes.splice(i, 1); }

  if (major){
    // a sub-position under its major
    if (el.checked){
      codes.push(code);
      drop(major);                                  // the sub refines the major
    } else {
      drop(code);
      var m = STATE.options.filter(function(o){ return o.code === major; })[0];
      var left = (m && m.subs || []).some(function(x){ return codes.indexOf(x.code) >= 0; });
      if (!left) codes.push(major);                 // refined no further: still the major
    }
  } else if (el.checked){
    codes.push(code);
  } else {
    drop(code);
    (opt && opt.subs || []).forEach(drop);          // the major goes, its subs go
  }
  posRefresh(own);
  posChanged(own);
};

/* Clicking anywhere that is not a picker closes any open panel; so does
   scrolling, because the panel is pinned to the viewport and the trigger it
   belongs to has moved. */
document.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
  var t = ev.target;
  while (t && t !== document.body){
    if (t.className && String(t.className).indexOf('pk') === 0) return;
    t = t.parentNode;
  }
  posCloseAll();
});
document.addEventListener('scroll', function(ev){
  // scrolling INSIDE the panel is just reading the list; every other scroll
  // moves the trigger out from under the pinned panel
  var t = ev.target;
  if (t && t.className && String(t.className).indexOf('pk-panel') >= 0) return;
  posCloseAll();
}, true);

/* - refusals -
   A refused edit stays unsaved. The portal this replaces emptied its pending
   set before it read refused[], so a rejected value disappeared from the queue
   while staying on the screen, and the page then showed numbers the sheet did
   not hold. */
function keepRefused(sentIds, refused){
  var kept = {}, matched = 0;
  (refused||[]).forEach(function(line){
    var hit = sentIds.filter(function(id){ return String(line).indexOf(id + ':') === 0; })[0];
    if (hit){ kept[hit] = true; matched++; }
  });
  // A refusal this page cannot attribute to a row is one it must not discard:
  // hold everything rather than quietly dropping somebody's edit.
  if (matched < (refused||[]).length) sentIds.forEach(function(id){ kept[id] = true; });
  setDirty(kept);
}
function refusalHtml(refused){
  return '<b>Not saved:</b><ul style="margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:18px">'
    + refused.map(function(r){ return '<li>'+esc(r)+'</li>'; }).join('') + '</ul>';
}
function schemaWarning(missing){
  if (!missing || !missing.length) return '';
  return '<div class="banner bad"><b>The workbook is missing '
    + plural(missing.length,'column')+':</b> '+esc(missing.join(', '))
    + '. An administrator must run <b>ensureSchema()</b> before these can be saved. '
    + 'Until then the server refuses them by name rather than writing them nowhere.</div>';
}

/* -
   CREATE AN ACCOUNT - seven answers, one card

   Role, school, first name, last name, date of birth, the head coach's last
   name, email - in that order. The coach's name is the knowledge check: a
   player who passes it is live the moment the emailed code proves his inbox,
   with no human in the loop. A coach request always waits for a conference
   administrator, because a coach account can rewrite a roster.

   Someone already signed in (an address that proved itself but never
   registered) submits the same form without a second code - the session is
   the verification, and the email field is locked to it.
   - */

function suInit(){
  if (!STATE.su) STATE.su = { role:'FAN', teamId:'', first:'', last:'', dob:'',
                              coachLast:'', email:'', attest:false, consent:false, busy:false };
  return STATE.su;
}

/* What the date picker will even offer. A player must be 13 through 19 today,
   so the calendar opens on the years where that is possible; a coach must be
   an adult. The server enforces the same bounds - these just stop the picker
   from starting at the current year and scrolling through a decade. */
/* SAY THE DATE BACK IN WORDS. A native date picker on a phone opens on a
   seeded day - iOS uses the max attribute, and max here is built from today,
   so its DAY is today's day. Someone who spins the year and the month wheels
   and never touches the day wheel submits a date that is right in two parts
   out of three, and looks entirely ordinary.

   It is not theoretical: across 124 accounts, 15 had a birth DAY equal to the
   day they registered, where chance predicts about four (p = 2.5e-05). One of
   them wrote in to say he could not sign in, because the policy screen asks
   for the date again and it no longer matched.

   A wrong digit in a date box is invisible. "28 May 2009" is not, and neither
   is the age beside it, so this prints both under the field as it is typed. */
function dobEcho(v){
  var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(String(v||'').trim());
  if (!m) return 'Check the day as well as the month and year.';
  var MON = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July',
             'August','September','October','November','December'];
  var y = +m[1], mo = +m[2], d = +m[3];
  if (mo < 1 || mo > 12) return 'Check the day as well as the month and year.';
  var now = new Date(), age = now.getFullYear() - y;
  if (now.getMonth()+1 < mo || (now.getMonth()+1 === mo && now.getDate() < d)) age--;
  return 'You entered <b>' + d + ' ' + MON[mo-1] + ' ' + y + '</b> \u2014 age ' + age
       + '. Please check the day.';
}

function suDobBounds(role){
  function iso(d){ return d.getFullYear()+'-'+('0'+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)
                        +'-'+('0'+d.getDate()).slice(-2); }
  var now = new Date();
  if (role === 'FAN'){
    return 'max="'+iso(new Date(now.getFullYear()-13, now.getMonth(), now.getDate()))+'"';
  }
  if (role === 'COACH'){
    var mx = new Date(now.getFullYear()-18, now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    return 'max="'+iso(mx)+'"';
  }
  // youngest allowed: 13 today. oldest: 19 today (20th birthday not yet passed).
  var max = new Date(now.getFullYear()-13, now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  var min = new Date(now.getFullYear()-20, now.getMonth(), now.getDate()+1);
  return 'min="'+iso(min)+'" max="'+iso(max)+'"';
}

function suSay(t, bad){
  var el = document.getElementById('suMsg');
  if (el){ el.textContent = t; el.className = 'sub grow'+(bad?' err':''); }
}

/* switching role drops the tick: it was agreed to as a player, and a coach
   was never shown it */
ACT.suRole = function(el){ var r=suInit(); r.role = el.getAttribute('data-role');
  r.attest=false; r.consent=false; viewSignup(); };
ACT.suCoachType = function(el){ suInit().coachType = el.getAttribute('data-ct'); viewSignup(); };

/* Read the chosen stats file: the server reads it against the selected game
   (grey lines, into the approvals queue) and mails it to the administrators. */
ACT.sfSend = function(el){
  var inp = document.getElementById('sfFile');
  var f = inp && inp.files && inp.files[0];
  var pick = document.querySelector('[data-h="sfGame"]');
  var gameId = (pick && pick.value) || STATE.sfGame || '';
  function say(t){ var m = document.getElementById('sfMsg'); if (m) m.textContent = t; }
  if (!gameId){ say('Pick the game first.'); return; }
  if (!f){ say('Choose a file first.'); return; }
  if (f.size > 7*1024*1024){ say('That file is over the 7 MB limit.'); return; }
  el.disabled = true; say('Sending and reading the file... this can take half a minute.');
  var rd = new FileReader();
  rd.onload = function(){
    var b64 = String(rd.result).split(',')[1] || '';
    call('svcEmailStatsFile', [f.name, f.type, b64, gameId]).then(function(r){
      el.disabled = false; say((r && r.message) || 'Sent.'); if (inp) inp.value = '';
      if (!(r && r.saved)) return;
      // the lines are on that game's box score now, official: redraw what is open
      STATE.ta = null; STATE.history = null; STATE.sfMsg = (r && r.message) || '';
      if (STATE.box && STATE.box.gameId === gameId) loadBox(gameId);
      else withTeamAdmin(function(d){ renderBox(d); });
    }).catch(function(e){ el.disabled = false; say(String(e && e.message || e)); });
  };
  rd.onerror = function(){ el.disabled = false; say('Could not read that file.'); };
  rd.readAsDataURL(f);
};

ACT.suSend = function(el){
  if(!validateScope(document.getElementById('view'))){suSay('Check the highlighted fields and try again.',true);return;}
  var r = suInit();
  if (r.role==='PLAYER' && !r.attest){
    suSay('Tick the box to confirm you play varsity football for this school.', true);
    return;
  }
  if (!r.consent){
    suSay(r.role==='FAN' ? 'Confirm the fan account notice.' : 'Tick the box to confirm you understand what this site publishes.', true);
    return;
  }
  var policies;
  try { policies = UcbacPolicies.payload(document.getElementById('signup-policies')); }
  catch(e) { suSay(e.message, true); return; }
  var payload = { policies:policies, role:r.role, teamId:r.teamId, first:r.first, last:r.last,
                  dob:r.dob, coachLast:r.coachLast, email:r.email,
                  attest:!!r.attest, consent:!!r.consent,
                  coachType:(r.role==='COACH'?(r.coachType||'HEAD'):'') };
  el.disabled = true; r.busy = true;
  suSay('Checking\u2026');

  if (STATE.auth && STATE.auth.signedIn){
    // the session already proves the address; no second code
    call('svcRegisterFinalize', [payload]).then(function(res){
      STATE.su = null;
      STATE.loginNote = (res && res.message) || 'Done.';
      boot(true);
    }).catch(function(e){
      r.busy = false; el.disabled = false;
      suSay(msgOf(e), true);
    });
    return;
  }

  call('svcRegisterStart', [payload]).then(function(res){
    r.busy = false;
    // hand off to the shared code-entry step; redeeming creates the account
    STATE.login = { email: r.email, stage:'code', msg:'', busy:false };
    viewLogin();
    var lm = document.getElementById('suMsg') || document.getElementById('loginMsg');
    // The one thing people actually need told, in a way nobody can miss.
    if (lm) lm.innerHTML = '<b style="color:var(--bad)">Check spam folder</b>';
    else loginSay('Check spam folder', true);
  }).catch(function(e){
    r.busy = false; el.disabled = false;
    suSay(msgOf(e), true);
  });
};

/* An ACTIVE account that grants nothing: a coach with no team on his row, or a
   player nobody linked to a roster record. Both are an administrator's job and
   neither is the person's fault, so say which it is. */
/* -
   SIGNING IN - an emailed one-time code

   Two steps on one card: type an email, get a six-digit code, type it back.
   The redeemed code becomes a long-lived token this browser keeps, so the
   next visit skips both steps. No Google account is required and no Google
   permission screen ever appears - which also means this works for the
   school addresses coaches actually live in.
   - */

function viewLogin(){
  barHide();
  alertBox('', '');
  var L = STATE.login || (STATE.login = { email:'', stage:'email', msg:'', busy:false });

  var h = '<div class="card" style="max-width:460px"><h2>Sign in</h2>'
    + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px">Sign in to your fan, player or coach account. Members 18 and older can access Blitz AI and daily summaries when available. '
    + 'We’ll email you a six-digit code. No password or Google account needed.</div>';

  if (L.stage === 'email'){
    h += '<label class="f">Your email</label>'
      + '<input type="email" data-h="loginEmail" value="'+esc(L.email)+'" inputmode="email" required '
      + 'placeholder="contact@example.invalid" autocomplete="email">'
      + '<div class="row end" style="margin-top:12px">'
      + '<span class="sub grow" id="loginMsg">'+esc(L.msg)+'</span>'
      /* the way in when the code came from an administrator instead of the
         mail system - same code, same box, nothing sent from here */
      + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="loginHave"'+(L.busy?' disabled':'')+'>'
      + 'I already have a code</button>'
      + '<button type="button" class="primary" data-a="loginSend"'+(L.busy?' disabled':'')+'>'
      + 'Email me a code</button></div>'
      /* forgotten which address the account is under: a reminder goes to it */
      + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button type="button" class="mini" data-a="loginForgot">'
      + 'Forgot your email?</button></div>';
  } else if (L.stage === 'forgot'){
    var F = L.forgot || (L.forgot = { teamId: '', name: '' });
    h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px">Tell us who you are. A reminder goes to the '
      + 'address on your player account - it is never shown here.</div>'
      + '<div class="form">'
      + '<div><label class="f" for="forgot-team">School</label>'
      + '<select id="forgot-team" data-h="forgotTeam" required><option value="">Choose your school</option>'
      + ((STATE.boot && STATE.boot.teams) || []).map(function(t){
          return '<option value="'+esc(t.id)+'"'+(t.id===F.teamId?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(t.name)+'</option>';
        }).join('')
      + '</select></div>'
      + '<div><label class="f" for="forgot-name">Your name</label>'
      + '<input type="text" id="forgot-name" data-h="forgotName" value="'+esc(F.name)+'" required '
      + 'placeholder="First and last name" autocomplete="name"></div>'
      + '</div>'
      + '<div class="row end" style="margin-top:12px">'
      + '<span class="sub grow" id="loginMsg">'+esc(L.msg)+'</span>'
      + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="loginBack"'+(L.busy?' disabled':'')+'>Back</button>'
      + '<button type="button" class="primary" data-a="forgotSend"'+(L.busy?' disabled':'')+'>Send reminder</button>'
      + '</div><div id="forgotOut"></div>';
  } else if (L.stage === 'found'){
    var R = L.found || {};
    h += '<div class="banner ok" style="margin-top:4px"><b>There is an email on file for '+esc(R.name)
      + ' ('+esc(R.team)+').</b> A reminder was just sent to it with the sign-in steps. '
      + 'Open that inbox - and its spam folder - to see the address.</div>'
      + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px"><b>Then sign in:</b> come back here, enter that email, '
      + 'press <b>Email me a code</b>, and type the six-digit code that arrives. No password needed.</div>'
      + '<div class="row end">'
      + '<button type="button" class="primary" data-a="loginBack">Back to sign in</button></div>';
  } else {
    h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:8px">A code was sent to <b>'+esc(L.email)
      + '</b>. It works for ten minutes.</div>'
      + '<label class="f">Six-digit code</label>'
      + '<input type="text" class="jn" style="width:140px;letter-spacing:.18em" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" '
      + 'data-h="loginCode" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" required minlength="6" pattern="[0-9]{6}" data-validate="six-digit-code" '
      + 'placeholder="000000">'
      + '<div class="row end" style="margin-top:12px">'
      + '<span class="sub grow" id="loginMsg">'+esc(L.msg)+'</span>'
      + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="loginBack"'+(L.busy?' disabled':'')+'>Different email</button>'
      + '<button type="button" class="primary" data-a="loginGo"'+(L.busy?' disabled':'')+'>Sign in</button>'
      + '</div>';
  }
  h += '</div>'
    + '<div class="card"><h2>First time here?</h2>'
    + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px">Players create their own account and '
    + 'are live as soon as their email is verified. Coach accounts are reviewed by the '
    + 'conference. The public site never needs any of this.</div>'
    + '<div class="row"><button type="button" data-a="suNew">Create an account</button>'
    /* the sign-up link, onto the clipboard, for a teammate or a whole group chat */
    + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="invite">Invite others</button></div>'
    + '<div id="inviteOut"></div></div>';
  paint(h);
}

/* The address that opens the portal on Create an account - the same link the
   Top 10 success screen offers. */
function inviteLink(){
  var p = String((STATE.boot && STATE.boot.portalUrl) || '');
  if (!p || p.indexOf('googleusercontent') >= 0) return '';
  return p + (p.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'view=signup';
}
function copyText(t){
  return new Promise(function(res, rej){
    function legacy(){
      try {
        var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = t; ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
        ta.style.position = 'fixed'; ta.style.opacity = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
        var ok = document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(ta);
        ok ? res() : rej(new Error('copy'));
      } catch (e){ rej(e); }
    }
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText)
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(res, legacy);
    else legacy();
  });
}
ACT.invite = function(el){
  var link = inviteLink(), out = document.getElementById('inviteOut');
  if (!link){
    if (out) out.innerHTML = '<div class="sub err">The portal address is not known yet - try again in a moment.</div>';
    return;
  }
  var was = el.textContent;
  function say(t){ el.textContent = t; setTimeout(function(){ el.textContent = was; }, 2200); }
  copyText(link).then(function(){
    say('Link copied');
    if (out) out.innerHTML = '<div class="sub">Copied. Send it to anyone who should have an account.</div>';
  }, function(){
    // a browser that will not hand over the clipboard: show the link to copy by hand
    say('Copy the link below');
    if (out) out.innerHTML = '<input type="text" readonly value="'+esc(link)+'" aria-label="Invitation link" onfocus="this.select()">';
    var i = out && out.querySelector('input'); if (i){ i.focus(); i.select(); }
  });
};

function loginSay(t, bad){
  STATE.login.msg = t;
  var el = document.getElementById('loginMsg');
  if (el){ el.textContent = t; el.className = 'sub grow'+(bad?' err':''); }
}

INP.loginEmail = function(el){ if(STATE.login)STATE.login.email = readText(el); };
/* The code box meets people halfway. Whatever lands in it - typed, pasted as
   "123 456" or a whole copied email line, or autofilled from Mail via
   autocomplete=one-time-code - is stripped to its six digits, and the moment
   six are present it signs in by itself: nobody should have to find a button
   after their phone just filled the box. */
INP.loginCode  = function(el){
  if(!STATE.login)return; // A final blur/change can arrive after successful sign-in.
  var d = String(el.value||'').replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,6);
  if (el.value !== d) el.value = d;
  STATE.login.code = d;
  if (d.length === 6) loginAutoGo();
};
function loginAutoGo(){
  var L = STATE.login;
  if (!L || L.busy) return;
  var b = document.querySelector('[data-a="loginGo"]');
  if (b && !b.disabled) ACT.loginGo(b);
}
document.addEventListener('paste', function(ev){
  var el = ev.target;
  if (!el || el.getAttribute('data-h') !== 'loginCode') return;
  var t = (ev.clipboardData && ev.clipboardData.getData('text')) || '';
  var d = t.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,6);
  if (!d) return;
  ev.preventDefault();
  el.value = d; STATE.login.code = d;
  if (d.length === 6) loginAutoGo();
});
/* Clicking the empty box offers the clipboard: if it holds exactly a six-digit
   code, it is filled and submitted. Blocked in some browsers (the Apps Script
   sandbox does not delegate clipboard-read to Chrome) - then this does nothing
   and pasting still works. Only an exact bare code is accepted; the clipboard
   may hold anything, and anything else is none of this page's business. */
document.addEventListener('focusin', function(ev){
  var el = ev.target;
  if (!el || el.getAttribute('data-h') !== 'loginCode' || el.value) return;
  if (!(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.readText)) return;
  navigator.clipboard.readText().then(function(t){
    var m = /^\s*(\d{6})\s*$/.exec(String(t||''));
    if (!m || el.value) return;
    el.value = m[1]; STATE.login.code = m[1];
    loginAutoGo();
  }).catch(function(){});
});

  loginSay('Sending...');
  call('svcRequestLoginCode', [L.email]).then(function(r){
    L.busy = false; L.stage = 'code'; L.msg = '';
    viewLogin();
    // The one thing people actually need told, in letters nobody can miss.

    if (lm){ lm.innerHTML = '<b style="color:var(--bad)">Check spam folder</b>'; lm.className='sub grow'; }
    else loginSay('Check spam folder', true);
  }).catch(function(e){
    L.busy = false; el.disabled = false;
    loginSay(msgOf(e), true);
  });
};

  });
};
