// A fresh sign-in returns Home; opening View Profile with a saved session does not.
var HOME_AFTER_LOGIN=PORTAL_VIEW==='home', HOME_PENDING=false, HOME_MOUNTED=false;
var HOME_DOCUMENT=null, HOME_FRAME=null;
function prepareHomeDocument(){
  if(!HOME_DOCUMENT)HOME_DOCUMENT=call('svcHomeDocument',[]).catch(function(e){HOME_DOCUMENT=null;throw e;});
  return HOME_DOCUMENT;
}
/* Mount owned Home HTML locally, without another /exec request or a blocked
   top navigation. The child has its own styles, event handlers and globals. */
function mountSignedInHome(html,token){
  if(!HOME_AFTER_LOGIN||token!==TOKEN||!STATE.auth||!STATE.auth.signedIn||STATE.auth.accountUpdateRequired)return false;
  if(typeof html!=='string'||html.indexOf('parent.ucbacAttachHome(window)')<0)throw new Error('Home is unavailable. Please try again.');
  var frame=document.createElement('iframe');
  frame.id='signedInHome';frame.title='UCBAC Stats Home';
  frame.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:var(--bg);display:block';
  window.ucbacAttachHome=function(child){
    if(frame!==HOME_FRAME||child!==frame.contentWindow||token!==TOKEN)throw new Error('Home session changed.');
    delete window.ucbacAttachHome;
    return {google:google,token:token};
  };
  HOME_FRAME=frame;HOME_MOUNTED=true;HOME_AFTER_LOGIN=false;
  ++AUTH_BOOT_VERSION;++PORTAL_VERSION;UcbacPolicies.reset();smartSelectClose(false);
  document.documentElement.classList.remove('launching');PORTAL_LAUNCH_CLOSED=true;
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  frame.srcdoc=html;
  frame.addEventListener('load',function(){frame.contentWindow.focus();},{once:true});
  document.body.replaceChildren(frame);
  document.title='UCBAC Football Scores, Standings & Stats';
  try{google.script.history.replace({}, {}, '/');}catch(ignore){}
  return true;
}
function returnHomeAfterLogin(){
  var a=STATE.auth||{};
  if(!HOME_AFTER_LOGIN||!a.signedIn||a.accountUpdateRequired)return false;
  if(HOME_PENDING||HOME_MOUNTED)return true;
  HOME_PENDING=true;var token=TOKEN;
  renderWho();
  prepareHomeDocument().then(function(html){
    HOME_PENDING=false;mountSignedInHome(html,token);
  }).catch(function(){
    HOME_PENDING=false;if(token!==TOKEN||HOME_MOUNTED||!HOME_AFTER_LOGIN)return;
    document.getElementById('tabs').innerHTML='';
    paint('<div class="card"><h2>Home could not load</h2><p role="alert">You are signed in. Check your connection, then try again.</p><button type="button" class="primary" data-a="retryHome">Try again</button></div>');
    finishPortalLaunch(STATE.boot&&STATE.boot.brand&&STATE.boot.brand.logo);
    var retry=document.querySelector('[data-a="retryHome"]');if(retry)retry.focus();
  });
  return true;
}
ACT.retryHome=function(el){el.disabled=true;el.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');returnHomeAfterLogin();};

ACT.loginGo = function(el){
  var L = STATE.login;
  if(!validateScope(document.getElementById('view'))){loginSay('Check the six-digit code.',true);return;}
  if (!L.code || String(L.code).replace(/\D/g,'').length !== 6){
    loginSay('Type the six-digit code from the email.', true); return;
  }
  el.disabled = true; L.busy = true;
  loginSay('Checking...');
  prepareHomeDocument().catch(function(){});
  call('svcRedeemLoginCode', [L.email, L.code]).then(function(r){
    setToken(r.token);
    STATE.login = null;
    STATE.su = null;
    STATE.auth = r.auth;
    // a registration finalized during redemption reports itself here
    if (r.note) STATE.loginNote = r.note;
    // everything cached before sign-in was fetched as nobody
    STATE.prof = null; STATE.roster = null; STATE.ta = null; STATE.pending = null;
    HOME_AFTER_LOGIN=!/could not/i.test(String(r.note||''));
    if(returnHomeAfterLogin())return;
    boot(true);
  }).catch(function(e){
    L.busy = false; el.disabled = false;
    loginSay(msgOf(e), true);
  });
};

ACT.signOut = function(){
  HOME_AFTER_LOGIN=false;
  // revoke first - call() prepends TOKEN, so it must still be set here
  call('svcSignOut', []).catch(function(){});
  setToken('');
  STATE.auth = null; STATE.prof = null; STATE.roster = null; STATE.ta = null;
  STATE.mine = null; STATE.myTeam = null; STATE.corrections = null; STATE.share = null;
  STATE.pendCorr = null;
  STATE.pending = null; STATE.login = null;

  /* Signing out is leaving, so land on the public site, not on a login form
     nobody asked for. The public address comes from the server (the portal URL
     minus its query) - location.href in this sandbox is a googleusercontent
     frame and navigating to it opens a blank page. */
  /* Embedded in the site: the site's header hears the token removal through
     the storage event and swaps the name back to Sign in - no navigation
     needed, the person is already on the site. */
  if (window.EMBED){ boot(true); return; }

  var pub = String((STATE.boot && STATE.boot.portalUrl) || '').split('?')[0];
  if (pub){
    try { window.top.location.href = pub; return; } catch(e){}
    try { window.open(pub, '_top'); return; } catch(e){}
  }
  boot(true);
};

function viewNoRole(){
  var a = STATE.auth;
  barHide();
  alertBox('', '');
  paint('<div class="card"><h2>Your account is active but nothing is attached to it</h2>'
    + '<div class="sub"><p style="margin-top:0">Signed in as <b>'+esc(a.email)+'</b>'
    + (a.role && a.role !== 'PUBLIC' ? ' with the role <b>'+esc(a.role)+'</b>' : '')+'.</p>'
    + '<p>A coach account needs a team and a player account needs to be linked to a roster '
    + 'record before there is anything here to show. An administrator attaches it.</p>'
    + '<p style="margin-bottom:0">The public site is unaffected.</p></div>'
    + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:14px">'
    + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="reload">Check again</button></div></div>');
}

/* -
   ROSTER - the editor that was already here
   - */

/* the rules of the roster, as a list a coach can take in at a glance */
var ROSTER_INTRO =
  '<ul class="rules">'
  + '<li>Every row is yours to edit. Press <b>Save roster</b> when you are done.</li>'
  + '<li>Pick every position a player actually plays; he is eligible for All-Conference at each one.</li>'
  + '<li>Offensive Athlete needs a second offensive position.</li>'
  + '<li>Leave a measurement empty if nobody has taken it. Empty means not reported, never zero.</li>'
  + '<li>Tick rows to remove players from this roster.</li>'
  + '</ul>';

function loadRoster(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  if (STATE.roster) return Promise.resolve(STATE.roster);
  return call('svcRoster', [STATE.teamId, STATE.seasonId]).then(function(d){if(!isCurrent())return;
    STATE.roster = d;
    if (d.options && d.options.length) STATE.options = d.options;
    return d;
  });
}

function viewRoster(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  if (!STATE.roster) paintLoading('Loading roster',4);
  loadRoster().then(function(){if(isCurrent())renderRoster();}).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">Roster unavailable.</div>');
    barHide();
  });
}

function rosterRowClass(p){
  var c = [];
  if (!p.positions.length) c.push('needs');
  if (dirtySet()[p.playerSeasonId]) c.push('dirty');
  return c.join(' ');
}

/** The measurable columns, from the server's list - one source with the sheet. */
function rosterMeasurables(){
  return (STATE.roster && STATE.roster.measurables) || [];
}

/* The unit a column is entered in, for its heading: "HT (ft)", "WT (lbs)".
   The server names it; the two the sheet has always carried are known here
   too, so a heading is never bare while an older Schema.gs is deployed. */
var MEAS_UNIT = { heightInches: 'ft', weightLbs: 'lbs' };
function measUnit(m){ return m.unit !== undefined ? m.unit : (MEAS_UNIT[m.key] || ''); }
function measHead(m){
  var u = measUnit(m);
  return esc(m.short) + (u ? ' <span class="u">('+esc(u)+')</span>' : '');
}

/* Feet and inches, each its own spinner: the arrow keys step them, and
   inches roll into feet at either end. Stored, as ever, as inches. */
function ftInBoxes(handler, ps, inches){
  var set = inches !== '' && inches !== null && inches !== undefined;
  var ft = set ? Math.floor(Number(inches)/12) : '', inch = set ? Number(inches)%12 : '';
  var common = ' data-h="'+handler+'"'+(ps ? ' data-ps="'+ps+'"' : '');
  return '<span class="ftin">'
    + '<input type="number" min="4" max="7" step="1" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Feet" placeholder="ft"'
    + common+' data-part="ft" value="'+ft+'"><span>&prime;</span>'
    + '<input type="number" min="-1" max="12" step="1" inputmode="numeric" aria-label="Inches" placeholder="in"'
    + common+' data-part="in" value="'+inch+'"><span>&Prime;</span></span>';
}
/* Reads a pair back: total inches, or null when feet is blank. Twelve inches
   becomes the next foot and minus one the last inch of the foot below, and
   the boxes are rewritten to say so. */
function readFtIn(el){
  var wrap = el.closest ? el.closest('.ftin') : el.parentNode;
  var f = wrap.querySelector('[data-part="ft"]'), i = wrap.querySelector('[data-part="in"]');
  var ft = readNum(f), inch = readNum(i);
  if (ft === null || typeof ft !== 'number'){
    if (inch !== null && el === i && typeof inch === 'number'){ f.value = 5; ft = 5; }   // inches typed first: a sensible foot
    else return null;
  }
  if (inch === null || typeof inch !== 'number') inch = 0;
  var total = ft*12 + inch;
  if (total < 0) total = 0;
  ft = Math.floor(total/12); inch = total % 12;
  if (String(f.value) !== String(ft)) f.value = ft;
  if (el === i && (String(i.value) !== String(inch))) i.value = inch;
  else if (el === f && i.value === '') i.value = inch;
  return total;
}

function renderRoster(){
  var d = STATE.roster;
  STATE.sel = STATE.sel || {};
  if (!STATE.capt) STATE.capt = (d.captains || []).slice();
  var meas = rosterMeasurables();
  var levels = d.commitmentLevels || [];

  var rows = d.roster.map(function(p){
    var ps = esc(p.playerSeasonId);
    var sug = (!p.positions.length && p.suggested && p.suggested.length)
      ? '<div class="sub">Suggested: '+esc(p.suggested.join(', '))+'</div>' : '';
    var h = '<tr class="'+rosterRowClass(p)+'" data-ps="'+ps+'">'
      + '<td><input type="checkbox" data-h="rosSel" data-ps="'+ps+'"'
      + (STATE.sel[p.playerSeasonId]?' checked':'')+'></td>'
      + '<td><input type="text" class="jn" data-h="ros" data-k="jersey" data-ps="'+ps+'" value="'+esc(p.jersey)+'"></td>'
      + '<td><div class="nm">'
      + (p.playerId
         ? '<a data-a="rosterProf" data-pid="'+esc(p.playerId)+'" style="cursor:pointer;'
           + 'text-decoration:underline" title="Open his full profile - everything the '
           + 'player can edit">'+esc(p.name)+'</a>'+vMark(p.playerId)+acbMark(p.playerId)
         : esc(p.name))
      + '</div>'+sug+'</td>'
      + '<td style="text-align:center"><input type="checkbox" data-h="rosCapt" '
      + 'data-pid="'+esc(p.playerId)+'"'
      + (STATE.capt.indexOf(p.playerId)>=0?' checked':'')+'></td>'
      + '<td><input type="text" class="yr" data-h="rosTxt" data-k="grad" data-ps="'+ps+'" value="'+esc(p.grad)+'"></td>';
    meas.forEach(function(m){
      if (m.key === 'heightInches'){ h += '<td>'+ftInBoxes('rosHt', ps, p.heightInches)+'</td>'; return; }
      h += '<td><input type="number" class="sm" step="'+m.step+'" '
        + 'data-h="ros" data-k="'+m.key+'" data-ps="'+ps+'" value="'+cell(p[m.key])+'"></td>';
    });
    h += '<td><input type="text" style="width:120px" data-h="rosTxt" data-k="commitment" '
      + 'data-ps="'+ps+'" value="'+esc(p.commitment||'')+'" placeholder="-"></td>'
      + '<td><select data-h="rosTxt" data-k="commitmentLevel" data-ps="'+ps+'">'
      + '<option value="">-</option>'
      + levels.map(function(x){
          return '<option value="'+esc(x)+'"'+(x===p.commitmentLevel?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(x)+'</option>';
        }).join('')
      + '</select></td>'
      + '<td>'+posPicker(p.positions, p.playerSeasonId)+'</td></tr>';
    return h;
  }).join('');

  // apiSaveRoster still asks the older Coaches tab whether the caller may write.
  // An account approved through this portal is not in it, and finding that out
  // by pressing Save and losing the work is not an acceptable way to learn it.
  var me = d.me || {};
  var cannotSave = me.role !== 'ADMIN' && me.teamId !== STATE.teamId;

  var nSel = Object.keys(STATE.sel).length;
  var head = '<th style="width:30px"><input type="checkbox" data-h="rosSelAll"'
    + (nSel && nSel === d.roster.length ? ' checked' : '')+'></th>'
    + '<th style="width:46px">#</th><th class="l" style="width:170px">Player</th>'
    + '<th style="width:30px" title="Captain - up to '+(d.maxCaptains||8)+'">C</th>'
    + '<th style="width:100px">Grad</th>'
    + meas.map(function(m){
        return '<th style="width:'+(m.key === 'heightInches' ? 150 : 108)+'px">'+measHead(m)+'</th>'; }).join('')
    + '<th class="l" style="width:130px">Commit</th><th class="l" style="width:86px">Level</th>'
    + '<th class="l" style="min-width:130px">Positions</th>';
  var nCols = 8 + meas.length;

  paint((cannotSave
      ? '<div class="banner bad"><b>This account cannot save roster changes for '
        + esc(tnameOf(STATE.teamId))+'.</b> It is not a coach account for this school - '
        + 'if that is wrong, an administrator can fix the account in a minute. '
        + 'Everything else on this page works normally.</div>'
      : '')
    + '<div class="card">'
    + ROSTER_INTRO
    + '<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:10px" id="selBar">'+selBarHtml()+'</div>'
    + '<div class="scroll roster"><table><thead><tr>'+head+'</tr></thead><tbody>'
    + (rows || '<tr><td colspan="'+nCols+'" class="sub">No players on this roster yet. Add '
       + 'them below, or approve their account requests.</td></tr>')
    + '</tbody></table></div>'
    + '<div class="legend">'
    + '<span><i class="dot" style="background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--warn) 45%,transparent)"></i>Needs positions</span>'
    + '</div></div>'

    + '<div class="card"><h2>Add a player</h2>'
    + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:10px">For someone who is not going to claim his '
    + 'own account. Measurables and commitment can be filled in on the row once he is on '
    + 'the roster.</div>'
    + '<div class="row" style="flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end">'
    + '<div><label class="f">First name</label>'
    + '<input type="text" style="width:110px" data-h="addFirst" value="'+esc((STATE.add&&STATE.add.first)||'')+'"></div>'
    + '<div><label class="f">Last name</label>'
    + '<input type="text" style="width:130px" data-h="addLast" value="'+esc((STATE.add&&STATE.add.last)||'')+'"></div>'
    + '<div><label class="f">Grad</label>'
    + '<input type="text" class="yr" data-h="addGrad" value="'+esc((STATE.add&&STATE.add.grad)||'')+'"></div>'
    + '<div><label class="f">Jersey</label>'
    + '<input type="text" class="jn" data-h="addJersey" value="'+esc((STATE.add&&STATE.add.jersey)||'')+'"></div>'
    + '<div><label class="f">Positions</label>'+posPicker((STATE.add&&STATE.add.positions)||[], 'add')+'</div>'
    + '<button type="button" class="mini primary" data-a="rosAdd">Add player</button>'
    + '<span class="sub" id="addMsg"></span>'
    + '</div></div>');

  countIncomplete();
  barShow({ label:'Save roster', save:saveRoster, reset:function(){
    STATE.roster = null; STATE.sel = {}; STATE.capt = null;
    clearDirty(); viewRoster(); } });
}

/* - selection and removal -
   Removal is a two-press button rather than a native confirm: the first press
   arms it and says what it will do, the second does it. Removing takes the
   player off THIS season's roster; his career record and other seasons stay. */

function selBarHtml(){
  var n = Object.keys(STATE.sel).length;
  if (!n) return '';
  var armed = STATE.armRemove;
  return '<b>'+plural(n,'player')+' selected</b>'
    + '<button type="button" class="mini danger" data-a="rosRemove">'
    + (armed ? 'Press again to remove '+plural(n,'player') : 'Remove selected')+'</button>'
    + (armed ? '<span class="sub">Removes them from the '+esc(snameOf(STATE.seasonId))
             + ' only - careers and other seasons are kept. A player with stats this '
             + 'season is refused.</span>' : '');
}

function selBarRefresh(){
  var el = document.getElementById('selBar');
  if (el) el.innerHTML = selBarHtml();
}

INP.rosSel = function(el){
  var ps = el.getAttribute('data-ps');
  if (el.checked) STATE.sel[ps] = true; else delete STATE.sel[ps];
  STATE.armRemove = false;
  selBarRefresh();
};
INP.rosSelAll = function(el){
  STATE.sel = {};
  if (el.checked)
    STATE.roster.roster.forEach(function(p){ STATE.sel[p.playerSeasonId] = true; });
  STATE.armRemove = false;
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-h="rosSel"]').forEach(function(x){
    x.checked = el.checked;
  });
  selBarRefresh();
};

ACT.rosRemove = function(){
  var ids = Object.keys(STATE.sel);
  if (!ids.length) return;
  if (!STATE.armRemove){ STATE.armRemove = true; selBarRefresh(); return; }
  STATE.armRemove = false;

  busy(true, 'Removing...');
  call('svcDeletePlayers', [STATE.teamId, STATE.seasonId, ids]).then(function(r){
    busy(false);
    STATE.roster = null; STATE.sel = {}; clearDirty();
    if (r.refused && r.refused.length){
      noticeBox('bad', refusalHtml(r.refused));
      flash('Removed '+r.removed+'. '+plural(r.refused.length,'refusal')+' above.', 'err');
    } else {
      noticeBox('', '');
      flash('Removed '+plural(r.removed,'player')+' from this season\u2019s roster.', 'good');
    }
    viewRoster();
  }).catch(function(e){
    busy(false);
    barMsg(msgOf(e), 'err');
  });
};

/* - adding - */

/* First and last are typed apart - one box for "Name" invites "Smith, John",
   nicknames, and a school pasted in - and joined only at the send. */
INP.addFirst  = function(el){ STATE.add = STATE.add || {positions:[]}; STATE.add.first = el.value; };
INP.addLast   = function(el){ STATE.add = STATE.add || {positions:[]}; STATE.add.last = el.value; };
INP.addGrad   = function(el){ STATE.add = STATE.add || {positions:[]}; STATE.add.grad = readText(el); };
INP.addJersey = function(el){ STATE.add = STATE.add || {positions:[]}; STATE.add.jersey = readText(el); };

ACT.rosAdd = function(el){
  var a = STATE.add || {positions:[]};
  var msg = document.getElementById('addMsg');
  function say(t, bad){ if (msg){ msg.textContent = t; msg.className = 'sub'+(bad?' err':''); } }
  var full = (String(a.first||'').trim()+' '+String(a.last||'').trim()).trim();
  if (!String(a.first||'').trim() || !String(a.last||'').trim()){
    say('First and last name are both required.', true); return; }
  if (!a.positions.length){ say('Pick at least one position.', true); return; }

  el.disabled = true;
  say('Adding...');
  call('svcAddPlayer', [STATE.teamId, STATE.seasonId, {
    name: full, grad: a.grad, jersey: a.jersey, positions: a.positions
  }]).then(function(){
    STATE.add = null;
    STATE.roster = null;
    flash('Added '+full+'.', 'good');
    viewRoster();
  }).catch(function(e){
    el.disabled = false;
    say(msgOf(e), true);
  });
};

function countIncomplete(){
  var n = STATE.roster.roster.filter(function(p){ return !p.positions.length; }).length;
  if (n) alertBox('', '<b>'+plural(n,'player')+'</b> have no position selected. They will '
    + 'not appear in All-Conference rankings until you set one.');
  else alertBox('ok', 'Every player has at least one position. All-Conference eligibility is '
    + 'complete for this roster.');
}

function rosterRow(ps){
  return STATE.roster.roster.filter(function(x){ return x.playerSeasonId === ps; })[0];
}

INP.ros = function(el){
  var p = rosterRow(el.getAttribute('data-ps'));
  if (!p) return;
  var k = el.getAttribute('data-k');
  // A jersey is text because "00" is a number a player wears; blank clears it
  // rather than making him number nought.
  p[k] = (k === 'jersey') ? (readText(el) || null) : readNum(el);
  markDirty(p.playerSeasonId);
  var tr = el.closest ? el.closest('tr') : null;
  if (tr) tr.className = rosterRowClass(p);
};

/* the height pair: both boxes report through the same handler */
INP.rosHt = function(el){
  var p = rosterRow(el.getAttribute('data-ps'));
  if (!p) return;
  p.heightInches = readFtIn(el);
  markDirty(p.playerSeasonId);
  var tr = el.closest ? el.closest('tr') : null;
  if (tr) tr.className = rosterRowClass(p);
};

/* grad, commitment and level are text, not numbers - readNum would turn a
   commitment of "Towson University" into null and call that an edit */
INP.rosTxt = function(el){
  var p = rosterRow(el.getAttribute('data-ps'));
  if (!p) return;
  p[el.getAttribute('data-k')] = el.value;
  markDirty(p.playerSeasonId);
  var tr = el.closest ? el.closest('tr') : null;
  if (tr) tr.className = rosterRowClass(p);
};

function saveRoster(){
  var ids = Object.keys(dirtySet());
  var meas = rosterMeasurables();
  var edits = STATE.roster.roster.filter(function(p){ return ids.indexOf(p.playerSeasonId) >= 0; })
    .map(function(p){
      var e = { playerSeasonId: p.playerSeasonId, positions: p.positions,
                jersey: p.jersey, grad: p.grad,
                commitment: p.commitment, commitmentLevel: p.commitmentLevel };
      meas.forEach(function(m){ e[m.key] = p[m.key]; });
      return e;
    });
  var captDirty = !!dirtySet()['__captains'];
  if (!edits.length && !captDirty) return;

  if (captDirty && STATE.capt.length > (STATE.roster.maxCaptains || 8)){
    barMsg(plural(STATE.capt.length,'captain')+' selected; the limit is '
           + (STATE.roster.maxCaptains || 8) + '.', 'err');
    return;
  }

  busy(true, 'Saving...');
  var step = edits.length
    ? call('svcSaveRoster', [STATE.teamId, STATE.seasonId, edits])
    : Promise.resolve({ saved: 0, refused: [] });

  step.then(function(r){
    /* Captains save through their own endpoint - the list is all-or-nothing on
       the server, so it rides after the row edits and reports its own refusal
       without taking theirs down. */
    var next = captDirty
      ? call('svcSetCaptains', [STATE.teamId, STATE.seasonId, STATE.capt])
          .then(function(){ return ''; })
          .catch(function(e){ return msgOf(e); })
      : Promise.resolve('');
    return next.then(function(captErr){
      busy(false);
      var problems = (r.refused || []).slice();
      if (captErr) problems.push('Captains: ' + captErr);

      if (problems.length){
        keepRefused(ids, r.refused || []);
        if (captErr) markDirty('__captains');
        noticeBox('bad', refusalHtml(problems));
        // "above" is only true if it is on the screen; a long roster puts the
        // list of refusals several screens up from the save bar that names it
        noticeSeen();
        flash('Saved '+r.saved+(captDirty && !captErr ? ' and the captain list' : '')
              +'. '+plural(problems.length,'problem')+' above.', 'err');
      } else {
        clearDirty();
        STATE.capt = null;         // re-derived from the sheet on the next read
        STATE.roster = null;
        noticeBox('', '');
        flash('Saved '+plural(r.saved,'player')
              +(captDirty ? ' and the captain list' : '')
              +'. Rankings recompute within fifteen minutes.', 'good');
        viewRoster();
        return;
      }
      renderRoster();
    });
  }).catch(function(e){
    busy(false);
    /* The save bar carries a single line; a server refusal is a sentence worth
       reading in full, and losing it is how an edit goes missing without a
       word. Both, and scrolled to if need be. */
    barMsg(msgOf(e), 'err');
    noticeBox('bad', '<b>Not saved.</b> '+esc(msgOf(e)));
    noticeSeen();
  });
}

/* The C column. Toggles buffer into STATE.capt and save with the roster -
   captains stopped being their own tab because naming one is a roster fact,
   not a separate chore. */
INP.rosCapt = function(el){
  var pid = el.getAttribute('data-pid');
  var i = STATE.capt.indexOf(pid);
  if (el.checked && i < 0) STATE.capt.push(pid);
  if (!el.checked && i >= 0) STATE.capt.splice(i, 1);
  markDirty('__captains');
  var max = (STATE.roster && STATE.roster.maxCaptains) || 8;
  if (STATE.capt.length > max)
    barMsg(plural(STATE.capt.length,'captain')+' selected; the limit is '+max+'.', 'err');
  else barMsg(plural(STATE.capt.length,'captain')+' selected.', '');
};

/* -
   TEAM ADMIN - one payload behind Scores, Stat entry, Captains, Links, Approvals
   - */

function loadTeamAdmin(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  if (STATE.ta) return Promise.resolve(STATE.ta);
  return call('svcTeamAdmin', [STATE.teamId, STATE.seasonId]).then(function(d){if(!isCurrent())return;
    STATE.ta = d;
    return d;
  });
}
function withTeamAdmin(render){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  if (!STATE.ta) paintLoading('Loading scores',4);
  loadTeamAdmin().then(function(d){if(isCurrent())render(d);}).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">Unavailable.</div>');
    barHide();
  });
}

/* - Scores - */

function viewScores(){
  withTeamAdmin(function(d){
    var rows = d.games.map(function(g){
      var st = g.status ? String(g.status).toUpperCase() : 'SCHEDULED';
      var id = esc(g.id);
      return '<tr class="'+(dirtySet()[g.id]?'dirty':'')+'" data-g="'+id+'">'
        + '<td class="sub">'+num(g.week)+'</td>'
        + '<td><div class="nm">'+(g.isHome?'vs ':'at ')+esc(g.opponentName)+'</div>'
        + '<div class="sub">'+esc(dateShort(g.date))
        + (g.statRows?' · '+plural(g.statRows,'stat line'):'')+'</div></td>'
        + '<td><input type="number" class="sm" data-h="scr" data-k="team" data-g="'+id+'" value="'+cell(g.teamScore)+'"></td>'
        + '<td><input type="number" class="sm" data-h="scr" data-k="opp" data-g="'+id+'" value="'+cell(g.opponentScore)+'"></td>'
        + '<td><select data-h="scr" data-k="status" data-g="'+id+'">'
        + d.editable.statuses.map(function(x){
            return '<option value="'+esc(x)+'"'+(x===st?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(x)+'</option>';
          }).join('')
        + '</select>'
        /* A forfeit is decided by who forfeited, not by a score, so the status
           brings its own question. The sides are named as the standings read
           them - HOME or AWAY - and shown as the two schools.
           The question lives in a wrapper of its own, hidden as a whole: the
           page dresses every select in a styled control beside it, and hiding
           the bare select left the control standing on every row. */
        + '<div data-fbwrap="'+id+'" style="margin-top:6px"'+(st==='FORFEIT'?'':' hidden')+'>'
        + '<select data-h="scr" data-k="forfeit" data-g="'+id+'" aria-label="Who forfeited">'
        + '<option value="">Who forfeited?</option>'
        + '<option value="'+(g.isHome?'AWAY':'HOME')+'"'+(g.forfeitBy===(g.isHome?'AWAY':'HOME')?' selected':'')+'>'
        + esc(g.opponentName)+' forfeited</option>'
        + '<option value="'+(g.isHome?'HOME':'AWAY')+'"'+(g.forfeitBy===(g.isHome?'HOME':'AWAY')?' selected':'')+'>'
        + esc(d.team.name)+' forfeited</option>'
        + '</select></div></td></tr>';
    }).join('');

    paint('<div class="card"><h2>Results · '+esc(snameOf(STATE.seasonId))+'</h2>'
      + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px">Leave both boxes empty until the game '
      + 'has been played. An empty box means <b>not played</b>; a 0 means the team was held '
      + 'scoreless, and the standings, the point differential and every per-game average '
      + 'believe whichever one you type. '
      + 'For a <b>forfeit</b>, set the status and say who forfeited - no score is needed; '
      + 'the win is recorded from that.'
      + (d.editable.forfeitIsAdminOnly
          ? ' You can record a forfeit but you cannot record one away - a forfeit is a '
            + 'conference ruling, not a scorekeeping detail, so only an administrator can '
            + 'change one back.' : '')
      + '</div>'
      + '<div class="scroll"><table><thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="width:50px">Wk</th><th>Opponent</th>'
      + '<th style="width:92px">'+esc(d.team.name)+'</th>'
      + '<th style="width:92px">Opponent</th>'
      + '<th style="width:200px">Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
      + (rows || '<tr><td colspan="5" class="sub">No games on the schedule for '
         + esc(snameOf(STATE.seasonId))+'.</td></tr>')
      + '</tbody></table></div></div>');

    alertBox('', '');
    barShow({ label:'Save scores', save:saveScores, reset:function(){
      STATE.ta = null; clearDirty(); viewScores(); } });
  });
}

function gameRowOf(id){
  return STATE.ta.games.filter(function(g){ return g.id === id; })[0];
}

INP.scr = function(el){
  var g = gameRowOf(el.getAttribute('data-g'));
  if (!g) return;
  var k = el.getAttribute('data-k');
  var tr = el.closest ? el.closest('tr') : null;
  if (k === 'status'){
    g.status = el.value;
    // the who-forfeited question appears with the status that needs it
    var fb = tr ? tr.querySelector('[data-fbwrap]') : null;
    if (fb) fb.hidden = (String(g.status).toUpperCase() !== 'FORFEIT');
  }
  else if (k === 'forfeit') g.forfeitBy = el.value;
  else if (k === 'team') g.teamScore = readNum(el);
  else g.opponentScore = readNum(el);
  markDirty(g.id);
  if (tr) tr.className = 'dirty';
};

function saveScores(){
  var ids = Object.keys(dirtySet());
  if (!ids.length) return;
  busy(true, 'Saving '+plural(ids.length,'game')+'--');

  var ok = 0, failed = {}, notes = [];
  // One game per call, in sequence. A save holds the script lock for its whole
  // length, so firing fifteen at once would leave fourteen waiting on it.
  var chain = Promise.resolve();
  ids.forEach(function(id){
    chain = chain.then(function(){
      var g = gameRowOf(id);
      if (!g) return;
      var hs = g.isHome ? g.teamScore : g.opponentScore;
      var as = g.isHome ? g.opponentScore : g.teamScore;
      var forfeit = String(g.status||'').toUpperCase() === 'FORFEIT';
      // a forfeit naming nobody is the one the standings skip: refused here,
      // in the row's own words, before a round trip says the same
      if (forfeit && !g.forfeitBy){
        failed[id] = true;
        notes.push((g.isHome?'vs ':'at ') + g.opponentName + ': who forfeited? Pick the team that did not play.');
        return;
      }
      return call('svcSaveGameScore', [id, hs, as, g.status, forfeit ? g.forfeitBy : '']).then(function(r){
        ok++;
        g.hs = r.homeScore; g.as = r.awayScore; g.status = r.status;
        g.forfeitBy = r.forfeitBy || '';
        g.teamScore     = g.isHome ? r.homeScore : r.awayScore;
        g.opponentScore = g.isHome ? r.awayScore : r.homeScore;
      }).catch(function(e){
        failed[id] = true;
        notes.push((g.isHome?'vs ':'at ') + g.opponentName + ': ' + msgOf(e));
      });
    });
  });

  chain.then(function(){
    busy(false);
    setDirty(failed);
    if (notes.length){
      noticeBox('bad', refusalHtml(notes));
      flash('Saved '+ok+'. '+plural(notes.length,'game')+' refused.', 'err');
    } else {
      noticeBox('', '');
      flash('Saved '+plural(ok,'game')+'. Standings recompute within fifteen minutes.', 'good');
    }
    viewScores();
  });
}

/* - Stat entry - */

/* The key apiGame() reports each measure under. It projects sixteen of the
   thirty-two, so every other column loads empty - which is exactly why only a
   box somebody touched is ever sent: a partial read must not be able to clear a
   number nobody looked at. */
var BOX_KEY = {
  PassAtt:'passAtt', PassComp:'passComp', PassYds:'passYds', PassTD:'passTD',
  PassInt:'passInt', RushAtt:'rushAtt', RushYds:'rushYds', RushTD:'rushTD',
  Rec:'rec', RecYds:'recYds', RecTD:'recTD',
  TackleSolo:'solo', TackleAssist:'asst', TFL:'tfl', Sacks:'sacks', Int:'int'
};

var FIELD_LABEL = {
  PassAtt:'Att', PassComp:'Comp', PassYds:'Yds', PassTD:'TD', PassInt:'INT',
  RushAtt:'Att', RushYds:'Yds', RushTD:'TD', RushFum:'Fum',
  Rec:'Rec', RecYds:'Yds', RecTD:'TD', RecFum:'Fum',
  TackleSolo:'Solo', TackleAssist:'Asst', TFL:'TFL', Sacks:'Sacks',
  Int:'INT', FF:'FF', FR:'FR', PassDef:'PD', DefTD:'TD',
  FGM:'FGM', FGA:'FGA', XPM:'XPM', XPA:'XPA', Punts:'Punts', PuntYds:'Punt yds',
  KR:'KR', KRYds:'KR yds', PR:'PR', PRYds:'PR yds'
};

/* The same measures spelled out, for a player choosing one to dispute and for
   every tooltip. Int and PassInt are opposite sides of one play and the short
   labels cannot carry that. Anything unlisted falls back to its column name. */
var FIELD_LONG = {
  PassAtt:'Pass attempts', PassComp:'Completions', PassYds:'Passing yards',
  PassTD:'Passing touchdowns', PassInt:'Interceptions thrown',
  RushAtt:'Rush attempts', RushYds:'Rushing yards', RushTD:'Rushing touchdowns',
  RushFum:'Fumbles rushing', Rec:'Receptions', RecYds:'Receiving yards',
  RecTD:'Receiving touchdowns', RecFum:'Fumbles receiving',
  TackleSolo:'Solo tackles', TackleAssist:'Assisted tackles', TFL:'Tackles for loss',
  Sacks:'Sacks', Int:'Interceptions caught', FF:'Forced fumbles',
  FR:'Fumbles recovered', PassDef:'Passes defended', DefTD:'Defensive touchdowns',
  FGM:'Field goals made', FGA:'Field goals attempted', XPM:'Extra points made',
  XPA:'Extra points attempted', Punts:'Punts', PuntYds:'Punt yards',
  KR:'Kick returns', KRYds:'Kick return yards', PR:'Punt returns',
  PRYds:'Punt return yards'
};
function fieldLong(f){ return FIELD_LONG[f] || f; }

function viewStats(){
  withTeamAdmin(function(d){
    if (!d.editable.statsEntryReady){
      barHide();
      alertBox('', '');
      paint('<div class="card"><h2>Stat entry is not available on this workbook</h2>'
        + '<div class="sub">PlayerGameStats has no <b>grain</b> or no <b>category</b> column, '
        + 'and without them a stat line cannot be keyed to a game at all. Entering anything '
        + 'would write rows nothing could read back. An administrator should check the '
        + 'import.</div></div>');
      return;
    }
    if (STATE.box && STATE.box.teamId !== STATE.teamId) STATE.box = null;
    renderBox(d);
  });
}

/* The submission history at the foot of Stat Entry: this school's weeks,
   the four boxes and the verdict, from the same tracker the administrator
   reads conference-wide. Drawn from what is held, fetched when stale, and
   swapped in place when it arrives - the box score above is never redrawn
   for it. */
function historyCard(){
  var key = STATE.teamId + '|' + STATE.seasonId;
  var fresh = STATE.history && STATE.history.key === key && STATE.history.data;
  if (!fresh) refreshHistory();
  return '<div id="historyCard">'
    + (fresh ? dashTracker(STATE.history.data, 'Submission history') : loadingCard('Loading submission history', 2))
    + '</div>';
}
function refreshHistory(){
  var key = STATE.teamId + '|' + STATE.seasonId;
  if (STATE.historyBusy === key) return;
  STATE.historyBusy = key;
  call('svcStatsTracker', [STATE.seasonId, STATE.teamId])
    .then(function(tr){ return tr; }, function(e){ return { error: msgOf(e) }; })
    .then(function(tr){
      STATE.historyBusy = null;
      STATE.history = { key: key, data: tr };
      var el = document.getElementById('historyCard');
      if (el && STATE.view === 'stats'){ el.innerHTML = dashTracker(tr, 'Submission history'); enhanceUI(el); }
    });
}

/* a game's line on either picker: the week, the opponent, what is filed */
function gameLabel(g){
  return 'Week ' + (g.week===null?'?':g.week) + ' · ' + (g.isHome?'vs ':'at ') + g.opponentName + ' · '
    + (g.statRows ? plural(g.statRows,'line')+' filed' : 'nothing filed');
}
/* the games a stats file can be uploaded for: every one already played -
   its day has come, or a score is on it. The future has no stats. */
function uploadableGames(d){
  var t = new Date();
  var today = t.getFullYear()+'-'+('0'+(t.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+'-'+('0'+t.getDate()).slice(-2);
  var past = d.games.filter(function(g){
    var scored = g.teamScore !== null && g.teamScore !== undefined && g.teamScore !== '';
    return scored || !g.date || String(g.date) <= today;
  });
  return past;
}

/* The short road for a coach whose stats live in a spreadsheet, a PDF or a
   phone photo, first on the page and never in the way: pick any game already
   played, send the file. It is read on the spot and every line that matches
   the roster lands on that game's box score as official - nothing to
   approve, and a later upload replaces it. The administrators get the file
   too, so nothing read wrongly is the last word. */
function uploadCard(d){
  var games = uploadableGames(d);
  var sel = STATE.sfGame || (STATE.box ? STATE.box.gameId : '');
  if (sel && !games.some(function(g){ return g.id === sel; })) sel = '';
  var msg = STATE.sfMsg || (sel ? '' : 'Pick the game first.');
  STATE.sfMsg = '';
  return '<div class="card" id="sfCard"><h2>Upload a stats file</h2>'
    + '<ul class="rules">'
    + '<li>A spreadsheet, PDF, Word file or a photo of the sheet, up to 7 MB.</li>'
    + '<li>Any game already played.</li>'
    + '<li>Read automatically. Lines matched to your roster land on the box score as official - nothing to approve.</li>'
    + '<li>Upload again any time. The newest upload replaces the last.</li>'
    + '<li>Names it cannot match go to the administrators with the file.</li>'
    + '</ul>'
    + '<div class="row" style="flex-wrap:wrap">'
    + '<select data-h="sfGame" aria-label="Game for the file" style="max-width:360px"><option value="">Which game?</option>'
    + games.map(function(g){
        return '<option value="'+esc(g.id)+'"'+(sel===g.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(gameLabel(g))+'</option>'; }).join('')
    + '</select>'
    + '<input type="file" id="sfFile" accept="image/*,.pdf,.csv,.txt,.xlsx,.xls,.docx,.doc">'
    + '<button type="button" class="mini primary" data-a="sfSend"'+(sel?'':' disabled')+'>Upload and read it</button>'
    + '<span class="sub grow" id="sfMsg">'+esc(msg)+'</span></div>'
    + (games.length ? '' : '<div class="sub" style="margin-top:8px">No game has been played yet this season.</div>')
    + '</div>';
}
INP.sfGame = function(el){
  STATE.sfGame = el.value;
  var btn = document.querySelector('[data-a="sfSend"]'), m = document.getElementById('sfMsg');
  if (btn) btn.disabled = !el.value;
  if (m) m.textContent = el.value ? '' : 'Pick the game first.';
};

function renderBox(d){
  var b = STATE.box;
  var h = schemaWarning(d.editable.missingColumns);

  h += uploadCard(d);

  h += '<div class="card"><h2>Which game?</h2>'
    + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:8px">Enter or correct a box score by hand.</div>'
    + '<select data-h="boxGame"><option value="">Choose a game...</option>'
    + d.games.map(function(g){
        return '<option value="'+esc(g.id)+'"'+(b && b.gameId===g.id?' selected':'')+'>'
             + esc(gameLabel(g))+'</option>'; }).join('')
    + '</select></div>';

  if (!b){
    paint(h + '<div class="card sub">Pick a game to enter or correct its box score. '
      + 'Everything is recorded game by game, which is what lets a season total be summed '
      + 'rather than typed.</div>' + historyCard());
    barHide();
    alertBox('', '');
    return;
  }

  var cats = d.editable.categories;
  var cat = cats.filter(function(c){ return c.category === b.cat; })[0] || cats[0];
  b.cat = cat.category;
  var fields = cat.fields;
  var lines = b.lines[b.cat] || [];
  var half = d.editable.halfFields || [];
  var unknown = fields.filter(function(f){ return !BOX_KEY[f]; });

  h += '<div class="card"><div class="tabs" style="margin-bottom:12px">'
    + cats.map(function(c){
        var n = (b.lines[c.category] || []).length;
        return '<button type="button" data-a="boxCat" data-cat="'+esc(c.category)+'" class="'
          + (b.cat===c.category?'on':'')+'">'+esc(c.category)
          + (n?'<span class="badge quiet">'+n+'</span>':'')+'</button>';
      }).join('')
    + '</div>';

  h += '<div class="scroll"><table><thead><tr><th style="width:190px">Player</th>'
    + fields.map(function(f){
        return '<th class="num" title="'+esc(fieldLong(f))+'">'
             + esc(FIELD_LABEL[f]||f)+'</th>'; }).join('')
    + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  if (!lines.length){
    h += '<tr><td colspan="'+(fields.length+1)+'" class="sub">No '+esc(b.cat)
       + ' lines for this game yet. Add a player below.</td></tr>';
  }
  lines.forEach(function(ln, i){
    if (!ln.playerId){
      // An imported line that never resolved to a player has nothing to key an
      // update on, so it is shown and left alone rather than half-edited.
      h += '<tr><td><div class="nm">'+esc(ln.name || 'unnamed')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="sub">Imported without a player id, so it cannot be edited here.</div></td>'
        + fields.map(function(f){ return '<td class="num sub">'+num(ln.existing[f])+'</td>'; }).join('')
        + '</tr>';
      return;
    }
    h += '<tr class="'+(Object.keys(ln.edits).length?'dirty':'')+'">'
      + '<td><div class="nm">'+esc(ln.name)+'</div>'
      + (ln.isNew?'<div class="sub">new line</div>':'')+'</td>'
      + fields.map(function(f){
          var known = !!BOX_KEY[f];
          var v = (ln.edits[f] !== undefined) ? ln.edits[f] : ln.existing[f];
          return '<td><input type="number" class="stat'+(known?'':' unknown')+'"'
            + (half.indexOf(f)>=0 ? ' step="0.5"' : ' step="1"')
            + ' data-h="boxCell" data-i="'+i+'" data-f="'+esc(f)+'"'
            + ' title="'+esc(fieldLong(f))
            + (known ? '' : ' - not shown by the box-score read; leave it alone and it is '
                          + 'not changed')
            + '" value="'+cell(v)+'"></td>'; }).join('')
      + '</tr>';
  });
  h += '</tbody></table></div>';

  var avail = d.roster.filter(function(p){
    return !lines.some(function(l){ return l.playerId === p.playerId; });
  });
  h += '<div class="row" style="margin-top:12px">'
    + '<select data-h="boxAdd" style="max-width:300px">'
    + '<option value="">Add a player to '+esc(b.cat)+'--</option>'
    + avail.map(function(p){
        return '<option value="'+esc(p.playerId)+'">'
             + (p.jersey!=='' ? '#'+esc(p.jersey)+' ' : '')+esc(p.name)+'</option>'; }).join('')
    + '</select>'
    + '<span class="sub grow">Only players on this season&rsquo;s roster can appear in a box '
    + 'score.</span></div>';

  h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-top:12px">An empty box is left exactly as it is. To '
    + 'record that something did not happen, type <b>0</b>; to take a number back out, clear '
    + 'the box you typed it into. A blank means nobody reported it, which is not the same '
    + 'claim as a zero.';
  if (unknown.length){
    h += '<br><br>These columns load empty because the box-score read does not return them: '
      + '<b>'+esc(unknown.map(fieldLong).join(', '))+'</b>. Whatever is on file for them is '
      + 'still there - leave them alone and nothing changes.';
  }
  h += '</div></div>';

  paint(h + historyCard());
  alertBox('', '');
  barShow({ label:'Save box score', save:saveBox, reset:function(){
    var gid = b.gameId;
    STATE.box = null; STATE.ta = null; clearDirty();
    withTeamAdmin(function(d2){ if (gid) loadBox(gid); else renderBox(d2); });
  } });
}

INP.boxGame = function(el){
  var gid = el.value;
  if (STATE.boxLoading === gid) return;      // input and change both fire
  STATE.boxLoading = gid;
  if (!gid){ STATE.box = null; clearDirty(); renderBox(STATE.ta); return; }
  if (STATE.box && STATE.box.gameId === gid) return;
  loadBox(gid);
};

function loadBox(gameId){
  paintLoading('Loading the box score',5);
  clearDirty();
  STATE.boxLoading = gameId;
  call('svcGame', [gameId]).then(function(g){
    var byCat = {};
    STATE.ta.editable.categories.forEach(function(c){ byCat[c.category] = []; });
    ((g && g.stats && g.stats[STATE.teamId]) || []).forEach(function(x){
      if (!byCat[x.cat]) byCat[x.cat] = [];
      var existing = {};
      Object.keys(BOX_KEY).forEach(function(f){
        var v = x[BOX_KEY[f]];
        if (v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== '') existing[f] = v;
      });
      byCat[x.cat].push({ playerId: x.playerId, name: x.name, existing: existing,
                          edits: {}, isNew: false });
    });
    STATE.box = { gameId: gameId, teamId: STATE.teamId,
                  cat: STATE.ta.editable.categories[0].category, lines: byCat };
    STATE.boxLoading = null;
    renderBox(STATE.ta);
  }).catch(function(e){
    STATE.boxLoading = null;
    STATE.box = null;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    renderBox(STATE.ta);
  });
}

ACT.boxCat = function(el){
  if (!STATE.box) return;
  STATE.box.cat = el.getAttribute('data-cat');
  renderBox(STATE.ta);
};

INP.boxAdd = function(el){
  var pid = el.value;
  el.value = '';                             // input and change both fire
  if (!pid || !STATE.box) return;
  var p = STATE.ta.roster.filter(function(x){ return x.playerId === pid; })[0];
  if (!p) return;
  (STATE.box.lines[STATE.box.cat] = STATE.box.lines[STATE.box.cat] || [])
    .push({ playerId: p.playerId, name: p.name, existing: {}, edits: {}, isNew: true });
  renderBox(STATE.ta);
};

INP.boxCell = function(el){
  if (!STATE.box) return;
  var ln = (STATE.box.lines[STATE.box.cat] || [])[Number(el.getAttribute('data-i'))];
  if (!ln) return;
  // Only a box somebody touched is ever sent. An untouched field is absent from
  // the payload, and the server leaves an absent field exactly as it is.
  ln.edits[el.getAttribute('data-f')] = readNum(el);
  markDirty(STATE.box.cat + '|' + ln.playerId);
  var tr = el.closest ? el.closest('tr') : null;
  if (tr) tr.className = 'dirty';
};

function saveBox(){
  var b = STATE.box;
  if (!b) return;
  var send = [], keys = [], skipped = [];

  Object.keys(b.lines).forEach(function(cat){
    b.lines[cat].forEach(function(ln){
      if (!ln.playerId) return;
      var touched = Object.keys(ln.edits);
      if (!touched.length) return;
      var allBlank = touched.every(function(f){ return ln.edits[f] === null; });
      // A brand new line holding nothing but blanks would append a stat row with
      // no statistics in it, and that row would then count as an appearance in
      // his games played and drag every per-game average down with it.
      if (ln.isNew && allBlank && !Object.keys(ln.existing).length){
        skipped.push(ln.name + ' (' + cat + '): every box was left empty, so no line was created.');
        return;
      }
      var row = { playerId: ln.playerId, category: cat };
      touched.forEach(function(f){ row[f] = ln.edits[f]; });
      send.push(row);
      keys.push(cat + '|' + ln.playerId);
    });
  });

  if (!send.length){
    clearDirty();
    if (skipped.length){ noticeBox('', refusalHtml(skipped)); barMsg('Nothing to save.', ''); }
    return;
  }
  if (send.length > STATE.ta.editable.maxStatRows){
    noticeBox('bad', 'That is '+send.length+' stat lines in one save; the limit is '
      + STATE.ta.editable.maxStatRows+'. Save one category, then the next.');
    return;
  }

  busy(true, 'Saving '+plural(send.length,'stat line')+'--');
  call('svcSavePlayerStats', [b.gameId, STATE.teamId, send]).then(function(r){
    busy(false);
    var notes = (r.refused || []).slice();

    // The server labels a refusal "row N", counting from one, in the order sent.
    var failed = {};
    notes.forEach(function(line){
      var m = /^row (\d+)/.exec(String(line));
      if (m && keys[Number(m[1]) - 1]) failed[keys[Number(m[1]) - 1]] = true;
    });
    if (notes.length && !Object.keys(failed).length)
      keys.forEach(function(k){ failed[k] = true; });      // unattributable: hold it all

    // Whatever saved is now on file, so it stops being an unsent edit.
    Object.keys(b.lines).forEach(function(cat){
      b.lines[cat].forEach(function(ln){
        if (!ln.playerId || failed[cat + '|' + ln.playerId]) return;
        Object.keys(ln.edits).forEach(function(f){
          if (ln.edits[f] === null) delete ln.existing[f];
          else ln.existing[f] = ln.edits[f];
        });
        ln.edits = {};
        if (Object.keys(ln.existing).length) ln.isNew = false;
      });
    });

    notes = notes.concat(skipped);
    setDirty(failed);
    if (notes.length){
      noticeBox('bad', refusalHtml(notes));
      flash('Saved '+plural(r.saved,'line')+'. '+plural(notes.length,'refusal')+'.', 'err');
    } else {
      noticeBox('', '');
      flash('Saved '+plural(r.saved,'line')+'. Totals recompute within fifteen minutes.', 'good');
    }
    // the history at the foot of the page counts what was just saved
    if (r.saved){ STATE.history = null; refreshHistory(); }

    STATE.ta = null;                        // the filed-line counts have moved
    withTeamAdmin(renderBox);
  }).catch(function(e){
    busy(false);
    barMsg(msgOf(e), 'err');
  });
}


/* - Team links - */

var LINK_LABEL = {
  hudlUrl:'Hudl', schoolUrl:'School website', facebookUrl:'Facebook',
  youTubeUrl:'YouTube', tikTokUrl:'TikTok', xHandle:'X handle',
  instagramHandle:'Instagram handle', headCoach:'Head coach',
  stadiumName:'Stadium'
};

function viewLinks(){
  withTeamAdmin(function(d){
    if (!STATE.linkPatch) STATE.linkPatch = {};
    var h = schemaWarning((d.editable.missingColumns||[]).filter(function(c){
      return c.indexOf('IsCaptain') < 0; }));

    h += '<div class="card"><h2>'+esc(d.team.name)+'</h2>'
      + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:14px">Any web address, as long as it starts '
      + 'with <b>https</b>. A handle is the handle by itself, not a link.</div>'
      + '<div class="form">'
      + d.editable.linkFields.map(function(k){
          var isUrl = k.indexOf('Url') > 0, isHandle = /Handle$/.test(k);
          var v = (STATE.linkPatch[k] !== undefined) ? STATE.linkPatch[k] : (d.links[k]||'');
          return '<div'+(isUrl?' class="wide"':'')+'><label class="f">'
            + esc(LINK_LABEL[k] || k)+'</label>'
            + '<input type="text" data-h="link" data-k="'+esc(k)+'" value="'+esc(v)+'"'
            + (isUrl?' placeholder="https://--"':isHandle?' placeholder="@handle"':'')+'></div>';
        }).join('')
      + '</div></div>';

    paint(h);
    alertBox('', '');
    barShow({ label:'Save links', save:saveLinks, reset:function(){
      STATE.linkPatch = null; STATE.ta = null; clearDirty(); viewLinks(); } });
  });
}

INP.suAttest = function(el){ suInit().attest = !!el.checked; };
INP.suConsent = function(el){ suInit().consent = !!el.checked; };
INP.link = function(el){
  var k = el.getAttribute('data-k');
  STATE.linkPatch[k] = readText(el);
  markDirty(k);
};

function saveLinks(){
  var keys = Object.keys(dirtySet());
  if (!keys.length) return;
  var patch = {};
  keys.forEach(function(k){ patch[k] = STATE.linkPatch[k]; });

  busy(true, 'Saving...');
  call('svcSaveTeamLinks', [STATE.teamId, patch]).then(function(r){
    busy(false);
    var still = {};
    keys.forEach(function(k){ if (!has(r.saved, k)) still[k] = true; });

    if (r.refused && r.refused.length){
      setDirty(still);
      noticeBox('bad', refusalHtml(r.refused));
      flash(plural(r.refused.length,'field')+' refused.', 'err');
      renderLinksAgain();
    } else {
      clearDirty();
      STATE.linkPatch = null;
      STATE.ta = null;
      noticeBox('', '');
      flash((r.saved||[]).length ? 'Saved '+plural(r.saved.length,'field')+'.' : 'Nothing changed.',
            'good');
      viewLinks();
    }
  }).catch(function(e){
    busy(false);
    barMsg(msgOf(e), 'err');
  });
}
/* A partial save keeps the refused text on screen so it can be corrected, and
   drops the accepted text so the boxes agree with the sheet. */
function renderLinksAgain(){
  var keep = {};
  Object.keys(dirtySet()).forEach(function(k){ keep[k] = STATE.linkPatch[k]; });
  STATE.linkPatch = keep;
  STATE.ta = null;
  viewLinks();
}

/* - Approvals - */

function viewApprovals(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  paintLoading('Loading approvals',4);
  barHide();
  alertBox('', '');
  Promise.all([
    loadTeamAdmin(),
    // A coach with no pending queue is not an error, and a thrown "coaches only"
    // must not take the corrections list down with it.
    call('svcPendingAccounts').catch(function(){if(!isCurrent())return; return { pending: [], totals: null }; }),
    call('svcPendingPlayerStats').catch(function(){if(!isCurrent())return; return []; }),
    /* Corrections come from their own endpoint, scoped by role, NOT from the
       team payload: an administrator's badge counts the whole conference and
       his list has to match it. Asking svcTeamAdmin would show him only the
       school in the picker. */
    call('svcPendingCorrections').catch(function(){if(!isCurrent())return; return null; })
  ]).then(function(r){if(!isCurrent())return;
    var pa = r[1] || {};
    STATE.pending = pa.pending || [];
    STATE.acctTotals = pa.totals || null;
    STATE.pendStats = r[2] || [];
    // null means the call failed outright; fall back to the team payload's own
    STATE.pendCorr = r[3] || null;
    renderApprovals(r[0], STATE.pending);
  }).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">Unavailable.</div>');
  });
}

function renderApprovals(d, pending){
  var a = STATE.auth;
  var h = '';

  // the running headcount, always visible above the queue
  var tt = STATE.acctTotals;
  if (tt){
    h += '<div class="card"><div class="row" style="gap:26px">'
      + '<div><div class="eyebrow" style="font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;'
      + 'letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)">Player accounts</div>'
      + '<b style="font-size:24px">'+Number(tt.players||0)+'</b></div>'
      + '<div><div class="eyebrow" style="font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;'
      + 'letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)">Coach accounts</div>'
      + '<b style="font-size:24px">'+Number(tt.coaches||0)+'</b></div>'
      + '<div><div class="eyebrow" style="font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;'
      + 'letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)">Waiting</div>'
      + '<b style="font-size:24px">'+Number(tt.pending||0)+'</b></div>'
      + '</div></div>';
  }

  h += '<div class="card"><h2>Account requests'
    + (pending.length?'<span class="badge">'+pending.length+'</span>':'')+'</h2>';

  if (!pending.length){
    h += '<div class="sub">Nothing waiting.</div>';
  } else {
    h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px">'
      + (a.isAdmin
          ? 'Every request in the conference. A coach request can be approved only by an '
            + 'administrator, which is you.'
          : 'Player requests naming your school. A coach request goes to an administrator, '
            + 'not to you.')
      + '</div>'
      + pending.map(function(p){
          var detail = [];
          if (p.coachType) detail.push(p.coachType==='HEAD'?'head coach':'assistant coach');
          if (p.age !== null && p.age !== undefined) detail.push('age '+esc(p.age));
          if (p.dob) detail.push('born '+esc(p.dob));
          if (p.coachLast)
            detail.push('says the head coach is --'+esc(p.coachLast)+'--'
              + (p.coachVerified ? '' : ' <span class="warnc">(could not be checked)</span>'));
          var id = esc(p.accountId);

          return '<div class="req">'
            + '<div class="row"><span class="nm">'+esc(p.displayName)+'</span>'
            + '<span class="pill">'+esc(p.requestedRole)+'</span>'
            + '<span class="sub">'+esc(p.teamName)+'</span>'
            + '<span class="sub" style="margin-left:auto">'+esc(dateShort(p.createdAt))+'</span></div>'
            + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:4px">'+esc(p.email)+'</div>'
            + (detail.length?'<div class="kv" style="margin-top:4px">'+detail.join(' · ')+'</div>':'')
            + (p.note?'<div class="kv" style="margin-top:6px">--'+esc(p.note)+'--</div>':'')
            + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px">'
            + '<input type="text" class="grow" data-h="apNote" data-id="'+id+'" '
            + 'placeholder="Note for them (optional)">'
            + '<button type="button" class="mini primary" data-a="apYes" data-id="'+id+'">Approve</button>'
            + '<button type="button" class="mini danger" data-a="apNo" data-id="'+id+'">Reject</button>'
            + '</div></div>';
        }).join('')
      + '<div class="sub">Approving a player creates or links his roster record for '
      + esc(snameOf(STATE.seasonId))+'; anything he sent can be corrected in the roster editor '
      + 'afterwards. The request email carries the same approve and reject links.</div>';
  }
  h += '</div>';

  /* Every school for an administrator, his own for a coach - the same reach
     the Approvals badge counts. STATE.pendCorr is null only if that call
     failed, and then the team payload's own list is better than nothing. */
  var cor = STATE.pendCorr || d.corrections || [];
  h += '<div class="card"><h2>Stat corrections'
    + (cor.length?'<span class="badge">'+cor.length+'</span>':'')+'</h2>';
  if (!cor.length){
    h += '<div class="sub">Nothing waiting'
      + (a.isAdmin ? ' anywhere in the conference.' : ' for '+esc(d.team.name)+'.')+'</div>';
  } else {
    h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px">A player has asked for a number to '
      + 'change. Nothing has moved yet: approving writes the new value into the box score '
      + 'and the totals catch up on the next rebuild, rejecting leaves the published number '
      + 'exactly where it is. He is told which, either way.'
      + (a.isAdmin ? ' Every school is here, whichever one the picker is on.' : '')+'</div>'
      + cor.map(function(c){
          var id = esc(c.correctionId);
          return '<div class="req">'
            + '<div class="row"><span class="nm">'+esc(c.player)+'</span>'
            + '<span class="pill">'+esc(fieldLong(c.field))+'</span>'
            + (c.teamName ? '<span class="sub">'+esc(c.teamName)+'</span>' : '')
            + '<span class="sub">'+esc(c.seasonId)
            + (c.gameId ? ' · week '+(c.week===null?'?':esc(c.week)) : ' · season total')
            + '</span>'
            + '<span class="sub" style="margin-left:auto">'+esc(dateShort(c.requestedAt))+'</span></div>'
            + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:6px">On file <b>'+orBlank(c.oldValue)
            + '</b> · he says <b>'+orBlank(c.newValue)+'</b></div>'
            + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:6px">--'+esc(c.reason)+'--</div>'
            + '<div class="sub" style="margin-top:4px">'+esc(c.requestedBy)+' · '+id+'</div>'
            + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px">'
            + '<input type="text" class="grow" data-h="coNote" data-id="'+id+'" '
            + 'placeholder="Note for them (optional)">'
            /* A correction against a game with no box score cannot be applied,
               and the server has already said so by the time this is drawn.
               Offering Approve anyway spends a click to buy an error message.
               Reject stays: a request can be turned down whatever the sheet
               holds. */
            + (!c.blocked
                ? '<button type="button" class="mini primary" data-a="coYes" data-id="'+id+'">Approve</button>'
                : (c.addable
                    /* He has no line in that game at all. Approving can still
                       do the whole job: open the line holding this one number,
                       every other cell blank. Says what it will do, because it
                       writes a row rather than changing one. */
                    ? '<button type="button" class="mini primary" data-a="coAdd" data-id="'+id+'">'
                      + 'Approve and add the line</button>'
                    : '<button type="button" class="mini" disabled title="'+esc(c.blocked)+'">Approve</button>'))
            + '<button type="button" class="mini danger" data-a="coNo" data-id="'+id+'">Reject</button>'
            + '</div>'
            + (c.blocked
                ? '<div class="req-note ' + (c.addable ? '' : 'bad') + '">'
                  + (c.addable
                      ? 'He has no ' + esc(String(c.category || 'matching').toLowerCase())
                        + ' line in this game. <b>Approve and add the line</b> opens one holding '
                        + esc(fieldLong(c.field)) + ' ' + orBlank(c.newValue)
                        + ' and nothing else — every other number on it stays blank, not zero. '
                        + 'Fill the rest in Stat entry if more of his game is missing.'
                      : esc(c.blocked))
                  + '</div>'
                : '')
            + '</div>';
        }).join('');
  }
  h += '</div>';

  /* - player-entered stats -
     Live on the site in grey. Approve turns them black; reject deletes them;
     entering the official box score in Stat Entry replaces them without
     touching this queue. */
  var ps = STATE.pendStats || [];
  h += '<div class="card"><h2>Stats waiting for approval'
    + (ps.length?'<span class="badge">'+ps.length+'</span>':'')+'</h2>';
  if (!ps.length){
    h += '<div class="sub">Nothing waiting. Only lines players enter themselves under My Stats '
      + 'land here, in grey on the site until a coach or an administrator confirms them. A '
      + 'coach\'s own uploads and box scores are official as they land. '
      + 'Lines waiting here are counted in the morning summary email.</div>';
  } else {
    h += ps.map(function(g){
        var nums = g.lines.map(function(l){
          return '<span class="pill">'+esc(l.category)+'</span> '
            + Object.keys(l).filter(function(k){ return k!=='category'; })
                .map(function(k){ return esc(FIELD_LABEL[k]||k)+' '+esc(l[k]); }).join(' \u00b7 ');
        }).join('<br>');
        return '<div class="req">'
          + '<div class="row"><span class="nm">'+esc(g.player)+'</span>'
          + '<span class="pill">player entered</span>'
          + '<span class="sub">'+esc(g.teamName)+'</span>'
          + '<span class="sub">'+(g.week!==null?'week '+esc(g.week):'')+(g.opponent?' \u00b7 vs '+esc(g.opponent):'')+'</span>'
          + '<span class="sub" style="margin-left:auto">'+esc(dateShort(g.enteredAt))+'</span></div>'
          + '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:6px">'+nums+'</div>'
          + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px">'
          + '<button type="button" class="mini primary" data-a="psYes" data-g="'+esc(g.gameId)+'" data-p="'+esc(g.playerId)+'">Approve</button>'
          + '<button type="button" class="mini danger" data-a="psNo" data-g="'+esc(g.gameId)+'" data-p="'+esc(g.playerId)+'">Reject</button>'
          + '</div></div>';
      }).join('')
      + '<div class="sub">Approving keeps the numbers exactly as entered and turns them '
      + 'black across the site. Rejecting removes them entirely and tells the player. '
      + 'Entering the official box score yourself replaces them without this queue.</div>';
  }
  h += '</div>';

  paint(h);
}

/* - deciding one item in a queue -

   Three queues behave the same way and all three used to lose their answer.
   The outcome went to #notice, which sits above the whole view: a queue runs
   down the screen, so somebody deciding the fifth request read a sentence
   several screens above him and saw nothing. Worse, a REFUSAL - the server
   answering {ok:false}, "already ACTIVE", "not authorized" - still triggered
   the full repaint, so the list came back with the request still in it and no
   word about why. Clicked, reset, nothing happened.

   Now the answer is printed in the card whose button was pressed, the repaint
   happens only when the decision actually took, and a refusal leaves the card
   and its reason on screen to be read. */

function reqCardOf(el){ return (el && el.closest) ? el.closest('.req') : null; }

/** Print an outcome inside a card, and hand back whether there was one. */
function reqNote(el, kind, html){
  var card = reqCardOf(el);
  if (!card) return false;
  var line = card.querySelector('.req-note');
  if (!line){
    line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'req-note';
    line.setAttribute('role', kind === 'bad' ? 'alert' : 'status');
    card.appendChild(line);
  }
  line.className = 'req-note ' + (kind || '');
  line.innerHTML = html || '';
  return true;
}

/** Buttons off, the card greyed: this one is answered and going away. */
function reqSettled(el, html){
  var card = reqCardOf(el);
  if (card){
    card.className = 'req settled';
    card.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){ b.disabled = true; });
  }
  reqNote(el, 'ok', html);
}

/**
 * The shared shape of a decision.
 *  run   - returns the promise for the call
 *  ok    - what to clear and do when the server says it took
 * A false `ok` from the server is a refusal, not a success: say so where the
 * click was and leave everything else alone.
 */
function decideItem(el, run, onOk){
  el.disabled = true;
  noticeBox('', '');
  run().then(function(r){
    var took = !!(r && r.ok !== false);
    var msg = esc((r && r.message) || (took ? 'Done.' : 'Nothing was changed.'));
    if (!took){
      el.disabled = false;
      noticeBox('bad', '<b>'+msg+'</b>');
      if (!reqNote(el, 'bad', '<b>'+msg+'</b>')) noticeSeen();
      return;
    }
    reqSettled(el, '<b>'+msg+'</b>');
    noticeBox('ok', '<b>'+msg+'</b>');
    onOk();
  }).catch(function(e){
    el.disabled = false;
    var msg = esc(msgOf(e));
    noticeBox('bad', '<b>'+msg+'</b>');
    if (!reqNote(el, 'bad', '<b>'+msg+'</b>')) noticeSeen();
  });
}

function decidePlayerStats(el, decision){
  var gid = el.getAttribute('data-g'), pid = el.getAttribute('data-p');
  decideItem(el, function(){ return call('svcReviewPlayerStats', [gid, pid, decision]); },
    function(){
      STATE.pendStats = null; STATE.ta = null;
      refreshAuthThen(viewApprovals);
    });
}
ACT.psYes = function(el){ decidePlayerStats(el, 'APPROVE'); };
ACT.psNo  = function(el){ decidePlayerStats(el, 'REJECT'); };

var NOTES = {};
INP.apNote = function(el){ NOTES['a'+el.getAttribute('data-id')] = el.value; };
INP.coNote = function(el){ NOTES['c'+el.getAttribute('data-id')] = el.value; };

function decideAccount(el, approve){
  var id = el.getAttribute('data-id');
  decideItem(el, function(){ return call('svcApproveAccount', [id, approve, NOTES['a'+id] || '']); },
    function(){
      STATE.ta = null; STATE.roster = null;   // an approval can add a roster row
      refreshAuthThen(viewApprovals);
    });
}
ACT.apYes = function(el){ decideAccount(el, true); };
ACT.apNo  = function(el){ decideAccount(el, false); };

function decideCorrection(el, verdict){
  var id = el.getAttribute('data-id');
  decideItem(el, function(){ return call('svcReviewCorrection', [id, verdict, NOTES['c'+id] || '']); },
    function(){
      STATE.ta = null; STATE.pendCorr = null;
      // through the auth refresh so the corrections half of the badge goes down
      // with the queue, the same as an account decision already does
      refreshAuthThen(viewApprovals);
    });
}
ACT.coYes = function(el){ decideCorrection(el, 'APPROVE'); };
ACT.coNo  = function(el){ decideCorrection(el, 'REJECT'); };
/* Approve for a game the player has no line in: it writes the line rather than
   refusing. Its own verb, so the approve link in a coach's email - which can
   only say APPROVE - keeps the careful behaviour. */
ACT.coAdd = function(el){ decideCorrection(el, 'APPROVE_ADD'); };

/* - the coach's own public page (head coaches fill it; the site shows it) - */

  barHide(); alertBox('','');
  call('svcMyCoachProfile',[]).then(function(d){if(!isCurrent())return;

/* the count left on the highlights line, the way X shows it: "142 characters
   remaining", turning red at ten */
var CP_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX = 160;
function cpRemaining(v){
  var left = CP_HIGHLIGHTS_MAX - String(v || '').length;
  return '<span class="'+(left <= 10 ? 'err' : 'sub')+'">'+left+' character'+(left === 1 ? '' : 's')+' remaining</span>';
}
INP.cp = function(el){
  var k = el.getAttribute('data-k');
  (STATE.cpatch=STATE.cpatch||{})[k] = el.value;
  if (k === 'highlights'){
    var c = document.getElementById('cpCount');
    if (c) c.innerHTML = cpRemaining(el.value);
  }
};
ACT.cpSave = function(el){
  var msg=document.getElementById('cpMsg');
  var say=function(t,bad){ if(msg){msg.textContent=t;msg.className='sub grow'+(bad?' err':'');} };
  if(!STATE.cpatch||!Object.keys(STATE.cpatch).length){ say('Nothing to save yet.'); return; }
  el.disabled=true; say('Saving...');
  call('svcSaveCoachProfile',[STATE.cpatch]).then(function(r){
    el.disabled=false;
    say(r.message, !!(r.refused&&r.refused.length));
    if(r.saved) STATE.cpatch={};
  }).catch(function(e){ el.disabled=false; say(msgOf(e), true); });
};

/* - box scores received -
   Which schools' lines are confirmed all in. It lives on the stat-submission
   tracker rather than on a page of its own, because it IS that grid: the same
   school, the same week, the same game, asked one question further. A separate
   checklist meant reading the same fifteen rows twice to answer "did it come
   in" and then "was all of it there".

   It gates something: a defence's Allowed figures are read off the OTHER
   side's box score, so an unconfirmed line is not a good line, it is a
   missing one. */

function scovPatch(){ return STATE.scovPatch || (STATE.scovPatch = {}); }
function scovKey(g, tid){ return g + '|' + tid; }

/* What the box says right now: the saved value, unless it has been clicked. */
function scovOn(r){
  var k = scovKey(r.game.id, r.teamId);
  var p = scovPatch();
  return (k in p) ? p[k] : !!r.statsIn;
}

INP.scov = function(el){
  var k = el.getAttribute('data-k');
  scovPatch()[k] = el.checked;
  markDirty('scov:' + k);
  scovCount();
};

/* Repaint the week's tally in place rather than redrawing the whole tracker:
   a rebuild closes every open week and throws away the reader's place in a
   fifteen-row table they are working down. */
function scovCount(){
  var tr = STATE.tracker;
  if (!tr || !tr.weeks) return;
  tr.weeks.forEach(function(w){
    var cov = w.rows.filter(function(r){ return r.covApplies; });
    var got = cov.filter(scovOn).length;
    var el = document.querySelector('[data-scovtally="'+w.key+'"]');
    if (el && cov.length){
      el.textContent = got + ' of ' + cov.length + ' received';
      el.className = 'tk ' + (got === cov.length ? 'ok' : got ? 'warn' : 'bad');
    }
  });
}

ACT.scovAll = function(el){
  var tr = STATE.tracker; if (!tr) return;
  var wk = el.getAttribute('data-w'), on = el.getAttribute('data-on') === '1';
  (tr.weeks.filter(function(w){ return w.key === wk; })[0] || { rows: [] }).rows
    .forEach(function(r){
      if (!r.covApplies) return;
      var k = scovKey(r.game.id, r.teamId);
      scovPatch()[k] = on;
      markDirty('scov:' + k);
      var box = document.querySelector('input[data-h="scov"][data-k="'+k+'"]');
      if (box) box.checked = on;
    });
  scovCount();
};

ACT.scovBaseline = function(el){
  if (!confirm('Mark every played conference game in ' + snameOf(STATE.seasonId) +
               ' as received?\n\nUse this to baseline a season that is already ' +
               'history. Going forward, tick week by week.')) return;
  el.disabled = true;
  busy(true, 'Baselining\u2026');
  call('svcBaselineStatsCoverage', [STATE.seasonId]).then(function(r){
    busy(false); scovDone(r.message);
  }).catch(function(e){
    busy(false); el.disabled = false; alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
  });
};

function scovDone(message){
  STATE.tracker = null; STATE.scovPatch = {}; clearDirty();
  flash(message, 'ok');
  var v = VIEWS[STATE.view];
  if (v) v.show(); else viewDashboard();
}

function saveScov(){
  var p = scovPatch(), keys = Object.keys(p);
  if (!keys.length) return;
  var marks = keys.map(function(k){
    var b = k.split('|');
    return { gameId:b[0], teamId:b[1], complete:!!p[k] };
  });
  busy(true, 'Saving\u2026');
  call('svcSetStatsCoverage', [marks]).then(function(r){
    busy(false); scovDone(r.message);
  }).catch(function(e){
    busy(false); alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
  });
}

/* The cell itself. A coach sees the state and no box: the tick is an
   administrator's, and offering a control that will be refused is its own
   kind of lie. */
function scovCell(r, admin){
  if (!r.game) return '<td>-</td>';
  if (!r.covApplies)
    return '<td><span class="sub" title="'
      + (r.game.played
          ? 'A non-conference opponent never sends us a line, so no Allowed figure can be built from this game.'
          : 'Not played yet.')
      + '">&mdash;</span></td>';
  var on = scovOn(r);
  if (!admin)
    return '<td>'+(on ? '<span class="tk ok">received</span>'
                      : '<span class="tk bad">not confirmed</span>')+'</td>';
  var k = scovKey(r.game.id, r.teamId);
  return '<td><label class="scovbox"><input type="checkbox" data-h="scov" data-k="'+esc(k)+'"'
       + (on ? ' checked' : '')+'> received</label></td>';
}

function viewCoverage(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  paintLoading('Loading coverage',5);
  barHide();
  alertBox('', '');
  call('svcCoverage', [STATE.seasonId]).then(function(d){if(!isCurrent())return;
    var c = d.coverage;
    var lb = d.build && d.build.lastBuild ? d.build.lastBuild : 'never';
    if (lb !== 'never' && lb !== 'unknown') lb = dateLong(lb);

    /* This page answers one question and has to say which: how much of the
       conference the All-Conference projections can actually see. It was
       shipped as bare fractions under the word "Declared", which read as a
       riddle even to the administrator who asked for it. */
    paint('<div class="card">'
      + '<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>All-Conference coverage</b>'
      + '<span class="sub" style="margin-left:auto">last rebuild '+esc(lb)
      + (d.build && d.build.dirty ? ' · <span class="warnc">changes pending</span>' : '')
      + '</span></div>'
      + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:10px">A player only appears in the '
      + 'All-Conference projections if his roster record names a position &mdash; the site '
      + 'cannot rank a linebacker it does not know is a linebacker. This table shows, '
      + 'school by school, how many rostered players have a position on file. Right now '
      + 'that is <b>'+c.declared+' of '+c.players+' players</b> at '
      + '<b>'+c.schoolsDeclared+' of '+c.totalSchools+' schools</b>, so the projections '
      + 'are drawn from a <b>'+esc(String(c.label).toLowerCase())+'</b> slice of the '
      + 'conference. Coverage never changes a ranking; it says how much of the field '
      + 'the ranking saw.</div>'
      + '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:10px">To raise a school’s number, fill '
      + 'the Positions column on its roster: the Roster tab here, a roster import, or '
      + 'players picking their own positions all count, and rankings refresh within '
      + '15 minutes of any change &mdash; no rebuild needed.</div>'
      + '<table><thead><tr><th>School</th><th style="width:150px">Positions on file</th>'
      + '<th style="width:150px"></th></tr></thead><tbody>'
      + c.byTeam.map(function(t){
          var pct = t.roster ? Math.round(100*t.declared/t.roster) : 0;
          var col = pct >= 90 ? 'var(--ok)' : (pct >= 50 ? 'var(--warn)' : 'var(--bad)');
          return '<tr><td>'+esc(t.team)+'</td>'
            + '<td>'+(t.roster ? t.declared+' of '+t.roster+' players'
                               : '<span class="sub">no roster yet</span>')+'</td>'
            + '<td><div style="background:var(--line);border-radius:4px;height:8px;width:120px"'
            + ' role="img" aria-label="'+pct+'% of roster">'
            + '<div style="background:'+col+';height:8px;border-radius:4px;width:'+pct+'%"></div>'
            + '</div></td></tr>'; }).join('')
      + '</tbody></table></div>');
  }).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">Coverage unavailable.</div>');
  });
}

/* -
   MY PROFILE - what a person knows about himself
   - */

function loadProfile(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  if (STATE.prof) return Promise.resolve(STATE.prof);
  // With STATE.profFor set, this is a coach opening one of his players -
  // same payload, same form, saves routed with the player's id.
  return call('svcMyProfile', STATE.profFor ? [STATE.profFor] : []).then(function(d){if(!isCurrent())return;
    STATE.prof = d;
    STATE.patch = {};
    STATE.pos = null;
    return d;
  });
}

function viewProfile(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  if (!STATE.prof) paintLoading('Loading your profile',4);
  Promise.all([
    loadProfile(),
    STATE.awards ? Promise.resolve(STATE.awards)
                 : call('svcPlayerAwards', [STATE.profFor || STATE.auth.playerId]).catch(function(){if(!isCurrent())return; return []; })
  ]).then(function(r){if(!isCurrent())return;
    STATE.awards = r[1] || [];
    renderProfile();
  }).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">Profile unavailable.</div>');
    barHide();
  });
}

/* - quick actions -
   My Profile is one long page: identity, then a season's measurables, then a
   commitment, offers, links, accolades and every earlier season. On a phone
   that is a lot of thumb between the top and the thing somebody opened it to
   change. So each card registers itself as it is built and a row of jumps is
   printed above them all, in the order they appear.

   Registered on the way past rather than listed up front, because which cards
   exist depends on the player: a freshman has no earlier seasons and nobody
   with no accolades gets an Accolades jump to an empty card. */
var PF_SECS = [];
function pfSec(id, label){ PF_SECS.push([id, label]); return ''; }
function pfJumps(){
  if (PF_SECS.length < 3) return '';   // two cards do not need a table of contents
  return '<nav class="pfjump" aria-label="Jump to a section">'
    + PF_SECS.map(function(s){
        return '<a href="#pf-'+esc(s[0])+'" data-a="pfJump" data-sec="'+esc(s[0])+'">'
             + esc(s[1])+'</a>'; }).join('')
    + '</nav>';
}
/* Scrolled rather than jumped: an anchor would drop the reader at the card with
   no sense of having moved, and on a phone the portal's own header would cover
   the heading it landed on. */
ACT.pfJump = function(el){
  var box = document.getElementById('pf-'+el.getAttribute('data-sec'));
  if (!box) return;
  var top = box.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 12;
  try { window.scrollTo({ top: top, behavior: 'smooth' }); }
  catch(e){ window.scrollTo(0, top); }
};

function pfVal(key, fallback){
  return (STATE.patch && STATE.patch[key] !== undefined) ? STATE.patch[key] : fallback;
}

function renderProfile(){
  var d = STATE.prof, ed = d.editable;
  PF_SECS = [];
  var cur = d.seasons.filter(function(x){ return x.seasonId === ed.seasonId; })[0] || null;
  if (!STATE.pos) STATE.pos = cur ? cur.positions.slice() : [];

  var h = schemaWarning(ed.missingColumns);

  if (STATE.profFor)
    h += '<div class="row" style="margin-bottom:10px">'
      + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="profBack">&lsaquo; Back to roster</button>'
      + '<span class="sub grow">Editing <b>'+esc(d.player.name)+'</b>&rsquo;s profile - the same '
      + 'fields the player sees, with your name on the change log.</span></div>';

  // his own page carries the share card; a coach editing him does not
  if (!STATE.profFor) h += shareCardHtml();

  /* The two things the header menu used to offer, now on the page the menu
     stood in front of. His public page is what everyone else sees, so it opens
