}

function viewDashboard(){
  if(STATE.auth&&STATE.auth.isFan){viewFanDashboard();return;}
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  paintLoading('Loading dashboard',5);
  barHide();
  alertBox('', '');
  var a = STATE.auth || {};
  var admin = !!a.isAdmin;
  // a player who is neither a coach nor an administrator gets his own
  if (!admin && !a.isCoach && a.playerId){ viewPlayerDashboard(); return; }
  var season = STATE.seasonId;
  var quiet = function(p, fallback){ return p.catch(function(){if(!isCurrent())return; return fallback; }); };
  Promise.all(admin ? [
    quiet(call('svcAuthState'), null),
    quiet(call('svcPendingAccounts'), { pending: [], totals: null }),
    call('svcStatsTracker', [season]).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return; return { error: msgOf(e) }; }),
    quiet(call('svcPlaysInfo', ['']), null)
  ] : [
    quiet(call('svcAuthState'), null),
    Promise.resolve(null),
    quiet(loadTeamAdmin(), null),                       // games, roster - the same load Scores and Roster use
    quiet(call('svcPlaysInfo', ['']), null),
    quiet(call('svcStandings', [season]), []),
    quiet(call('svcAllConference', [season]), null),
    quiet(call('svcLeaders', [season]), [])
  ]).then(function(r){if(!isCurrent())return;
    if (STATE.view !== 'dashboard') return;          // moved on while it loaded
    if (r[0]){ STATE.auth = r[0]; renderWho(); renderTabs(); }
    if (admin){
      STATE.acctTotals = (r[1] && r[1].totals) || null;
      STATE.tracker = r[2];
      STATE.scovPatch = {};
      paint(dashTiles(r[3]) + dashTracker(r[2]));
      /* The tracker is the only thing on this page anybody edits, so the bar
         belongs to it. Nothing to save until a box is clicked. */
      if (r[2] && r[2].isAdmin && !r[2].error)
        barShow({ label:'Save stats received', save:saveScov, reset:function(){
          STATE.scovPatch = {}; clearDirty(); viewDashboard(); } });
      return;
    }
    paint(dashTiles(r[3]) + dashSeason(r[2], r[4])
      + '<div class="dash-two">' + dashAC(r[5]) + dashTopFive(r[6]) + '</div>');
  }).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">Unavailable.</div>');
  });
}

/* A player's dashboard: his profile and his line, his corrections, the
   Top 10 window, his team's season, and where he stands in the projection
   and on the leader boards. Everything comes from the public reads and his
   own profile - a player holds no team tool. */
function viewPlayerDashboard(){
  var isCurrent=portalViewCurrent();
  var season = STATE.seasonId, pid = STATE.auth.playerId;
  var quiet = function(p, fallback){ return p.catch(function(){if(!isCurrent())return; return fallback; }); };
  Promise.all([
    quiet(call('svcAuthState'), null),
    quiet(loadProfile(), null),
    quiet(STATE.mine ? Promise.resolve(STATE.mine)
                     : call('svcPlayer', [pid]).then(function(p){if(!isCurrent())return; STATE.mine = p; return p; }), null),
    quiet(call('svcStandings', [season]), []),
    quiet(call('svcAllConference', [season]), null),
    quiet(call('svcLeaders', [season]), []),
    quiet(call('svcMyCorrections'), []),
    quiet(call('svcPlaysInfo', ['']), null)
  ]).then(function(r){if(!isCurrent())return;
    if (STATE.view !== 'dashboard') return;
    if (r[0]){ STATE.auth = r[0]; renderWho(); renderTabs(); }
    var prof = r[1], cur = null;
    if (prof) cur = (prof.seasons || []).filter(function(x){ return x.seasonId === prof.editable.seasonId; })[0] || null;
    var tid = (cur && cur.teamId) || STATE.auth.teamId || '';
    STATE.corrections = r[6] || [];
    // his team's schedule - the public read - for the last game and the next
    var team = !tid ? Promise.resolve(null)
      : (STATE.myTeam && STATE.myTeam.team === tid && STATE.myTeam.seasonId === season)
        ? Promise.resolve(STATE.myTeam)
        : quiet(call('svcTeam', [tid, season]).then(function(t){if(!isCurrent())return; if (t) t.seasonId = season; STATE.myTeam = t; return t; }), null);
    return team.then(function(t){if(!isCurrent())return;
      if (STATE.view !== 'dashboard') return;
      paint(dashPlayerTiles(prof, cur, r[2], r[6] || [], r[7])
        + dashSeason(dashTeamGames(t, tid), r[3], tid)
        + '<div class="dash-two">' + dashAC(r[4], pid) + dashTopFive(r[5], pid) + '</div>');
    });
  }).catch(function(e){if(!isCurrent())return;
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">Unavailable.</div>');
  });
}

/* the public team read, reshaped into the games the season tiles expect */
function dashTeamGames(t, tid){
  if (!t || !t.games) return null;
  return { games: t.games.map(function(g){
    var home = g.home === tid;
    return { week: g.week, isHome: home, date: g.date,
             opponentName: (home ? g.awayName : g.homeName) || tnameOf(home ? g.away : g.home),
             teamScore: home ? g.hs : g.as, opponentScore: home ? g.as : g.hs };
  }) };
}

/* what a player's tiles say: his profile, his line, his corrections, Top 10 */
function dashPlayerTiles(prof, cur, mine, corr, pi){
  var season = STATE.seasonId;
  var h = '<div class="dash-tiles">';
  // the profile: what is filled in this season, and what is not
  if (!prof)
    h += dashTile('', 'My profile', 'Unavailable', 'Try again in a moment', 'profile');
  else if (!cur)
    h += dashTile('hot', 'My profile', 'Not on a roster', 'Your coach adds you to the '+esc(snameOf(season))+' roster', 'profile');
  else {
    var filled = function(v){ return v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== ''; };
    var checks = [['height', filled(cur.heightInches)], ['weight', filled(cur.weightLbs)],
                  ['positions', !!(cur.positions && cur.positions.length)],
                  ['grad year', filled(prof.player.gradYear)], ['bio', filled(prof.player.bio)]];
    var missing = checks.filter(function(c){ return !c[1]; }).map(function(c){ return c[0]; });
    h += dashTile(missing.length ? 'hot' : 'calm', 'My profile',
                  (checks.length - missing.length)+' of '+checks.length,
                  missing.length ? 'Missing: '+esc(missing.join(', ')) : 'Complete - jersey, measurables and positions are in',
                  'profile');
  }
  // his line this season
  var log = ((mine && mine.gameLog) || []).filter(function(x){ return x.season === season; });
  var gameIds = {}; log.forEach(function(x){ gameIds[x.gameId || x.week] = 1; });
  var nGames = Object.keys(gameIds).length, grey = log.filter(function(x){ return x.prov; }).length;
  var ss = ((mine && mine.seasonStats) || []).filter(function(x){ return x.seasonId === season; })[0];
  h += dashTile('', 'My stats', nGames+' game'+(nGames === 1 ? '' : 's')+' logged',
                dashMyLine(ss) || (grey ? grey+' line'+(grey === 1 ? '' : 's')+' awaiting approval' : 'Enter a game on My Stats'),
                'mystats');
  // corrections he has filed
  var open = corr.filter(function(c){ return c.status === 'PENDING'; }).length;
  h += dashTile(open ? 'hot' : 'calm', 'Stat corrections', open,
                open ? 'Waiting on your coach' : (corr.length ? 'All decided' : 'None filed'), 'mystats');
  h += dashPlaysTile(pi);
  return h + '</div>';
}

/* the biggest thing on his season line, in five words: "412 passing yds" */
function dashMyLine(ss){
  if (!ss) return '';
  var n = function(v){ return Number(v || 0); };
  var picks = [[n(ss.passYds), 'passing yds'], [n(ss.rushYds), 'rushing yds'], [n(ss.recYds), 'receiving yds'],
               [n(ss.solo) + n(ss.asst), 'tackles'], [n(ss.sacks), 'sacks'], [n(ss.int), 'interceptions']]
    .filter(function(p){ return p[0] > 0; }).sort(function(a, b){ return b[0] - a[0]; });
  if (!picks.length) return '';
  return picks.slice(0, 2).map(function(p){ return p[0]+' '+p[1]; }).join(' · ')+(ss.prov ? ' · some awaiting approval' : '');
}

function dashTile(cls, head, n, sub, view){
  var inner = '<div class="tk-h">'+head+'</div><div class="tk-n">'+n+'</div><div class="tk-s">'+sub+'</div>';
  return view
    ? '<button type="button" class="tile '+cls+'" data-a="tab" data-v="'+view+'">'+inner+'</button>'
    : '<div class="tile '+cls+'">'+inner+'</div>';
}
function ordinal(n){
  n = Number(n); var r = n % 100;
  return n + ((r >= 11 && r <= 13) ? 'th' : ['th','st','nd','rd'][n % 10] || 'th');
}
function scored(g){
  var has = function(v){ return v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== ''; };
  return !!g && has(g.teamScore) && has(g.opponentScore);
}

/* the season at a glance: where the school stands, its record, the last
   game with a score, the next one, and the roster */
function dashSeason(d, standings, teamId){
  if (!d) return '';
  var tid = teamId || STATE.teamId, games = d.games || [];
  // the game tiles open Scores where there is a Scores tab; a player has none
  var sv = tabList().indexOf('scores') >= 0 ? 'scores' : '';
  var wk = function(g){ return g.week === null || g.week === undefined ? 99 : Number(g.week); };
  var played = games.filter(scored).sort(function(a, b){ return wk(b) - wk(a); });
  var w = 0, l = 0, t = 0, pf = 0, pa = 0;
  played.forEach(function(g){
    var us = Number(g.teamScore), them = Number(g.opponentScore);
    pf += us; pa += them; if (us > them) w++; else if (us < them) l++; else t++;
  });
  var rec = w+'-'+l+(t ? '-'+t : '');
  var st = (standings || []).filter(function(x){ return x.teamId === tid; })[0];
  var h = '<div class="dash-tiles">';
  if (st && st.rank)
    h += dashTile('', 'Conference rank', ordinal(st.rank)+(standings.length ? ' of '+standings.length : ''),
                  'Record '+st.w+'-'+st.l+(st.t ? '-'+st.t : '')+' · conference '+st.cw+'-'+st.cl
                  + (st.pf !== null && st.pa !== null ? ' · PF '+st.pf+' · PA '+st.pa : '')
                  + (st.move ? ' · '+(st.move > 0 ? 'up ' : 'down ')+Math.abs(st.move)+' since last week' : ''));
  else
    h += dashTile('', 'Record', rec, played.length ? 'PF '+pf+' · PA '+pa+' · standings not built yet' : 'No game played yet');
  var last = played[0];
  if (last){
    var us = Number(last.teamScore), them = Number(last.opponentScore);
    h += dashTile(us > them ? 'calm' : us < them ? 'hot' : '', 'Last game',
                  (us > them ? 'W ' : us < them ? 'L ' : 'T ')+us+'-'+them,
                  'Week '+(last.week === null ? '?' : esc(last.week))+' · '+(last.isHome ? 'vs ' : 'at ')+esc(last.opponentName), sv);
  }
  var next = games.filter(function(g){ return !scored(g); }).sort(function(a, b){ return wk(a) - wk(b); })[0];
  h += next
    ? dashTile('', 'Next game', (next.isHome ? 'vs ' : 'at ')+esc(next.opponentName),
               'Week '+(next.week === null ? '?' : esc(next.week))+(next.date ? ' · '+esc(dateShort(next.date)) : ''), sv)
    : dashTile('', 'Next game', 'None left', 'Every game has a score', sv);
  if (d.roster){
    var roster = d.roster, v = (STATE.boot && STATE.boot.verified) || {};
    var withAcct = roster.filter(function(p){ return v[p.playerId]; }).length;
    h += dashTile('', 'Roster', roster.length+' player'+(roster.length === 1 ? '' : 's'),
                  withAcct+' with an account · '+(roster.length - withAcct)+' without', 'roster');
  }
  return h + '</div>';
}

/* the school's players inside the All-Conference projection, by position -
   or, given a player id, that one player wherever he ranks */
function dashAC(ac, pid){
  var team = tnameOf(STATE.teamId);
  var h = '<div class="card"><h2>All-Conference tracking</h2>';
  if (!ac || !ac.positions) return h + '<div class="sub">The projection has not been built yet.</div></div>';
  var rows = [];
  ac.positions.forEach(function(p){
    (p.players || []).forEach(function(x){
      if (pid ? x.playerId !== pid : x.teamId !== STATE.teamId) return;
      rows.push({ pos: p.label, code: p.code, rank: x.rank, pool: p.poolSize, player: x.player,
                  tier: x.tier, status: x.status, thin: p.thin });
    });
  });
  if (!rows.length)
    return h + '<div class="sub">'+(pid ? 'You are not in the projection yet.' : 'No '+esc(team)+' player is in the projection yet.')
      + ' A player enters it once his stats clear the minimum for a position he is listed at.</div></div>';
  var chip = function(r){
    var tier = r.tier || '';
    var cls = /First/.test(tier) ? 'ok' : /Second/.test(tier) ? 'warn' : 'none';
    return '<span class="tk '+cls+'">'+esc(tier || 'Outside')+'</span>'
      + (r.status === 'Provisional' ? ' <span class="sub">provisional</span>' : '');
  };
  h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:10px">Live projection, rebuilt with the totals. First Team is the '
    + 'top of the ballot, Second Team the next; the rest are in range but outside.</div>'
    + '<div class="scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Player</th><th>Position</th><th>Rank</th><th>Projected</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
    + rows.map(function(r){
        return '<tr><td class="nm">'+esc(r.player)+'</td><td class="pos">'+esc(r.pos)+'</td>'
          + '<td>'+(r.rank ? '#'+esc(r.rank)+(r.pool ? ' <span class="sub">of '+esc(r.pool)+'</span>' : '') : '-')
          + (r.thin ? ' <span class="sub" title="Too few schools in this pool for a conference ranking yet">thin pool</span>' : '')+'</td>'
          + '<td>'+chip(r)+'</td></tr>';
      }).join('')
    + '</tbody></table></div></div>';
  return h;
}

/* every conference top five the school holds, from the leader boards - or,
   given a player id, every one that player holds */
function dashTopFive(lb, pid){
  var team = tnameOf(STATE.teamId);
  var h = '<div class="card"><h2>Conference top five</h2>';
  var mine = (lb || []).filter(function(x){ return (pid ? x.playerId === pid : x.teamId === STATE.teamId) && x.rank !== null && x.rank <= 5; })
    .sort(function(a, b){ return a.rank - b.rank || String(a.label).localeCompare(String(b.label)); });
  if (!mine.length) return h + '<div class="sub">'+(pid ? 'You are not in a top five yet.' : 'Nobody from '+esc(team)+' is in a top five yet.')+'</div></div>';
  h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:10px">Where '+(pid ? 'you stand' : esc(team)+' players stand')+' in the top five of any stat category, conference-wide.</div>'
    + '<div class="scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Rank</th><th>Player</th><th>Category</th><th class="num">Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
    + mine.map(function(x){
        return '<tr'+(x.prov ? ' class="provrow" title="includes stats awaiting approval"' : '')+'>'
          + '<td><span class="tk '+(x.rank === 1 ? 'ok' : 'none')+'">#'+esc(x.rank)+'</span></td>'
          + '<td class="nm">'+esc(x.player)+'</td><td>'+esc(x.label || x.cat)+'</td><td class="num">'+esc(x.value)+'</td></tr>';
      }).join('')
    + '</tbody></table></div></div>';
  return h;
}

function dashTiles(pi){
  var a = STATE.auth || {}, tt = STATE.acctTotals;
  var n = function(v){ return Number(v || 0); };
  var wait = function(k, head){
    var c = n(a[k]);
    return dashTile(c ? 'hot' : 'calm', head, c, c ? 'Open Approvals' : 'Nothing waiting', 'approvals');
  };
  var h = '<div class="dash-tiles">'
    + wait('pendingAccounts', 'Account requests')
    + wait('pendingCorrections', 'Stat corrections')
    + wait('pendingStats', 'Stats to approve')
    + (a.isAdmin && tt ? dashTile('', 'Accounts', n(tt.players) + n(tt.coaches),
                                  n(tt.players)+' players · '+n(tt.coaches)+' coaches', 'approvals') : '');
  return h + dashPlaysTile(pi) + '</div>';
}

/* the Top 10 Plays window, open or shut, on every dashboard */
function dashPlaysTile(pi){
  var n = function(v){ return Number(v || 0); };
  if (pi && pi.open)
    return dashTile('go', 'Top 10 Plays', esc(pi.label)+' open',
                    n(pi.count)+' clip'+(n(pi.count)===1?'':'s')+' in · closes '+esc(pi.closesText || ''));
  if (pi)
    return dashTile('shut', 'Top 10 Plays', pi.lastLabel ? esc(pi.lastLabel)+' closed' : 'Closed',
                    (pi.lastLabel ? n(pi.lastCount)+' clip'+(n(pi.lastCount)===1?'':'s')+' in' : '')
                    + (pi.nextLabel && pi.opensText ? (pi.lastLabel ? ' · ' : '')+esc(pi.nextLabel)+' opens '+esc(pi.opensText) : ''));
  return '';
}

/* one chip per box, always a number: the named players with stats on that
   side, or the total on file. Red when nothing is in or too few players are,
   amber when some of it is waiting in Approvals, green otherwise. */
function dashBox(b, meta){
  if (!b || b.empty) return '<span class="tk bad">None</span>';
  var n = Number(b.n || 0);
  var text = meta.unit === 'players' ? n+' player'+(n===1?'':'s') : n+' '+esc(meta.unit);
  var cls = b.short ? 'bad' : b.pending ? 'warn' : 'ok';
  return '<span class="tk '+cls+'"'
    + (b.pending ? ' title="Some of this is waiting in Approvals"' : b.short ? ' title="Fewer than '+STATE.minPlayers+' players"' : '')
    + '>'+text+'</span>';
}
/* the reason a row is short of complete, in words */
function dashShort(r, boxes){
  return (r.short || []).map(function(k){
    var b = boxes.filter(function(x){ return x.key === k; })[0] || {};
    var n = Number(r.boxes[k] && r.boxes[k].n || 0);
    return 'Only '+n+' player'+(n===1?'':'s')+' on '+String(b.label || k).replace(/^individual /, '');
  }).join(' · ');
}
function dashRank(r){ return !r.game ? 3 : !r.complete ? 0 : r.pending ? 1 : 2; }

/* the verdict on one team's week */
function dashStatus(r, boxes){
  return r.complete
    ? '<span class="tk ok">All stats submitted</span>'
      + (r.pending ? ' <span class="tk warn">Awaiting approval</span>' : '')
    : r.missing.length === boxes.length
      ? '<span class="tk bad">Nothing submitted</span>'
      : r.missing.length
        ? '<span class="tk bad">Missing: '+esc(r.missing.join(', '))+'</span>'
        : '<span class="tk bad">'+esc(dashShort(r, boxes))+'</span>';
}
function dashResult(g){
  if (!g.played || g.us === null || g.them === null) return '<span class="sub">no score yet</span>';
  return (g.us > g.them ? 'W ' : g.us < g.them ? 'L ' : 'T ')+g.us+'-'+g.them;
}

function dashTracker(tr, title){
  var one = tr && tr.team;
  var h = '<div class="card"><h2>'+esc(title || 'Stat submissions')+' · '+(one ? esc(tr.team.name)+' · ' : '')+esc(snameOf(STATE.seasonId))+'</h2>';
  if (!tr || tr.error){
    return h + '<div class="sub err">'+esc(tr && tr.error || 'Unavailable.')+'</div></div>';
  }
  STATE.minPlayers = Number(tr.minPlayers || 0);
  var admin = !!tr.isAdmin;
  var cov = tr.coverage || { received:0, played:0, pct:0, minGames:3 };
  h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px">'+(one ? 'Each week you played.' : 'Each school, each week it played.')
    + ' Team boxes carry the totals on file - yards on offense, tackles on defense. Individual boxes count the '
    + 'named players with stats on that side; a side counts as submitted at '+STATE.minPlayers+' players or more. '
    + 'Amber is in and waiting in Approvals.</div>';
  /* Stats In is a different question from the boxes beside it. The boxes say
     what arrived; this says somebody looked and it was ALL of it - which is
     what the other side's Allowed figures are built on, and cannot be worked
     out from the numbers, because one carry for five yards is a complete-
     looking fragment. */
  h += '<div class="sub" style="margin-bottom:12px"><b>Stats in</b> is the last column, and it '
    + 'is the one the <b>Allowed</b> boards read. A defence\u2019s allowed figures come off the '
    + 'other side\u2019s box score, so a game counts for the opponent only once this school\u2019s '
    + 'line is confirmed complete here. Until it is ticked it contributes nothing, which is the '
    + 'safe way round. A team needs '+esc(String(cov.minGames))+' confirmed games before it is '
    + 'ranked. <b>'+cov.received+' of '+cov.played+'</b> received this season ('+cov.pct+'%).</div>';
  if (!tr.weeks.length)
    return h + '<div class="sub">No games have been played yet.</div></div>';
  if (admin && !one)
    h += '<div class="row" style="gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px"><button type="button" class="mini" '
      + 'data-a="scovBaseline">Mark the whole season received\u2026</button></div>';
  var boxes = tr.boxes || [];
  if (one){
    /* one school: a plain table, newest week first, no folds to open */
    h += '<div class="scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Week</th><th>Opponent</th><th>Result</th>'
      + boxes.map(function(b){ return '<th>'+esc(b.label)+'</th>'; }).join('')
      + '<th>Status</th><th style="width:150px">Stats in</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
      + tr.weeks.map(function(w){
          return w.rows.filter(function(r){ return r.game; }).map(function(r){
            return '<tr'+(r.complete ? '' : ' class="needs"')+' data-week="'+esc(w.key)+'"><td class="nm">'+esc(w.label)+'</td>'
              + '<td>'+(r.game.home ? 'vs ' : 'at ')+esc(r.game.opponent)+'</td><td>'+dashResult(r.game)+'</td>'
              + boxes.map(function(b){ return '<td>'+dashBox(r.boxes[b.key], b)+'</td>'; }).join('')
              + '<td class="st">'+dashStatus(r, boxes)+'</td>'+scovCell(r, admin)+'</tr>';
          }).join('');
        }).join('')
      + '</tbody></table></div>';
    return h + '</div>';
  }
  h += tr.weeks.map(function(w){
    var rows = w.rows.slice().sort(function(x, y){ return dashRank(x) - dashRank(y) || x.team.localeCompare(y.team); });
    var got = w.rows.filter(function(r){ return r.covApplies && scovOn(r); }).length;
    var covN = Number(w.covPlayed || 0);
    var sum = '<summary>'+esc(w.label)
      + '<span class="sub">'+w.complete+' of '+w.teams+' complete</span>'
      + (w.pending ? '<span class="tk warn">'+w.pending+' awaiting approval</span>' : '')
      + (w.missing ? '<span class="tk bad">'+w.missing+' missing</span>'
                   : (w.teams ? '<span class="tk ok">All stats submitted</span>' : ''))
      /* A week with no conference game in it has nothing to receive, and a
         "0 of 0" pill beside the others is noise pretending to be a warning. */
      + (covN ? '<span data-scovtally="'+esc(w.key)+'" class="tk '
                + (got === covN ? 'ok' : got ? 'warn' : 'bad')+'">'
                + got+' of '+covN+' received</span>' : '')
      + '</summary>';
    var tools = (admin && covN)
      ? '<div class="row" style="gap:8px;margin:8px 0">'
        + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="scovAll" data-on="1" data-w="'+esc(w.key)+'">'
        + 'Tick the whole week</button>'
        + '<button type="button" class="mini" data-a="scovAll" data-on="0" data-w="'+esc(w.key)+'">'
        + 'Untick the week</button></div>' : '';
    var tbl = '<div class="scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Team</th><th>Opponent</th>'
      + boxes.map(function(b){ return '<th>'+esc(b.label)+'</th>'; }).join('')
      + '<th>Status</th><th style="width:150px">Stats in</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
      + rows.map(function(r){
          if (!r.game)
            return '<tr class="provrow"><td class="nm">'+esc(r.team)+'</td><td>-</td>'
              + boxes.map(function(){ return '<td>-</td>'; }).join('')
              + '<td class="st"><span class="tk none">No game</span></td><td>-</td></tr>';
          var opp = (r.game.home ? 'vs ' : 'at ')+esc(r.game.opponent)
            + (r.game.played ? '' : ' <span class="sub">(no score yet)</span>');
          return '<tr'+(r.complete ? '' : ' class="needs"')+'><td class="nm">'+esc(r.team)+'</td><td>'+opp+'</td>'
            + boxes.map(function(b){ return '<td>'+dashBox(r.boxes[b.key], b)+'</td>'; }).join('')
            + '<td class="st">'+dashStatus(r, boxes)+'</td>'+scovCell(r, admin)+'</tr>';
        }).join('')
      + '</tbody></table></div>';
    return '<details class="wk" data-week="'+esc(w.key)+'">'+sum+tools+tbl+'</details>';
  }).join('');
  return h + '</div>';
}


/* -
   SHELL - tabs, pickers, routing

var VIEWS = {
  dashboard: { label:'Dashboard',  show:viewDashboard },
  profile:   { label:'My Profile', show:viewProfile   },
  coachprof: { label:'My Coach Page', show:viewCoachProfile },
  mystats:   { label:'My Stats',   show:viewMyStats   },
  roster:    { label:'Roster',     show:viewRoster    },
  scores:    { label:'Scores',     show:viewScores    },
  stats:     { label:'Stat Entry', show:viewStats     },
  links:     { label:'Team Links', show:viewLinks     },
  approvals: { label:'Approvals',  show:viewApprovals },
  coverage:  { label:'Coverage',   show:viewCoverage  }
};

function tabList(){
  var a = STATE.auth, out = [];
  if (!a) return out;
  // A coach or an administrator who is also on a roster edits his own profile
  // through the same two tabs a player does.
  if (a.playerId) out.push('profile','mystats');
  // a coach edits the public page that carries his name; admins without a
  // coaching row have no such page, and the view says so if opened anyway
  if (a.isCoach) out.push('coachprof');
  if (a.isCoach || a.isAdmin) out.push('roster','scores','stats','links','approvals');
  if (a.isAdmin) out.push('coverage');
  // everyone with a role lands on a dashboard; everything else is a tab it opens
  if (a.isCoach || a.isAdmin || a.isFan || a.playerId) out.unshift('dashboard');
  return out;
}

function renderTabs(){
  var tabs = tabList();
  var el = document.getElementById('tabs');
  if (!tabs.length){ el.style.display = 'none'; el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  el.style.display = '';
  el.className = 'tabs';
  el.setAttribute('role','tablist');
  el.innerHTML = tabs.map(function(k){
    var badge = (k === 'approvals' && STATE.auth.pendingCount)
      ? '<span class="badge">'+STATE.auth.pendingCount+'</span>' : '';
    return '<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="'+(STATE.view===k?'true':'false')+'" data-a="tab" data-v="'+k+'" class="'+(STATE.view===k?'on':'')+'">'
      + esc(VIEWS[k].label)+badge+'</button>';
  }).join('');
}

ACT.tab = function(el){ navigate(el.getAttribute('data-v')); };

function navigate(name){
  if (location.hash === '#/' + name) go(name);
  else location.hash = '#/' + name;
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', function(){ route(); });

function route(){
  var tabs = tabList();
  if (!tabs.length) return;
  var want = String(location.hash || '').replace(/^#\/?/, '');
  go(tabs.indexOf(want) >= 0 ? want : tabs[0]);
}

/* The portal counts itself the same way the site does, and just as coarsely:
   which section, never whose. The browser id is the same anonymous one, and
   nothing about the signed-in account travels with it. */
var PHIT = { last: '', id: '', ref: (function(){ try { return document.referrer || ''; } catch(e){ return ''; } })() };
function phit(view){
  if (view === PHIT.last) return;
  PHIT.last = view;
  if (!PHIT.id){
    try { PHIT.id = localStorage.getItem('ucbac_ask_id') || ''; } catch(e){}
    if (!PHIT.id) PHIT.id = 'p' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  }
  try { call('svcHit', ['portal', view, PHIT.id, PHIT.ref, window.innerWidth || 0, false]).catch(function(){}); }
  catch(e){}
}

function go(name){
  if (STATE.auth && STATE.auth.accountUpdateRequired){UcbacPolicies.requireUpdate(STATE.auth);return;}
  if (!VIEWS[name]) return;
  ++PORTAL_VERSION;
  smartSelectClose(false);
  var nextView=name!==STATE.view;
  phit(name);
  STATE.view = name;
  STATE.corr = null;
  renderTabs();
  renderCtx();
  barHide();
  alertBox('', '');
  noticeBox('', '');
  try { VIEWS[name].show(); }
  catch (e){
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card sub">That page could not be drawn.</div>');
  }
  var view=document.getElementById('view');
  if(nextView)window.scrollTo(0,0);
  try{view.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(e){view.focus();}
}

/* The site's header, worn by the portal: every link is a SAME-TAB trip back
   to the public site. Built from the server-reported address - location.href
   in this sandbox is a googleusercontent frame, and links built from it go
   nowhere. */
function renderSitebar(){
  var el = document.getElementById('sitebar');
  if (!el || window.EMBED) return;
  var base = String((STATE.boot && STATE.boot.portalUrl) || '').split('?')[0];
  if (!base || base.indexOf('googleusercontent') >= 0){ el.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  function L(hash, label){
    return '<a href="'+base+(hash?'#/'+hash:'')+'" target="_top">'+label+'</a>';
  }
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="in">'
    + '<a class="sb-brand" href="'+base+'" target="_top">UCBAC<span>Stats</span></a>'
    + '<nav aria-label="Public site navigation">'+L('','Home')+L('scores','Scores')+L('teams','Teams')+L('stats','Stats')
    + L('allconference','All-Conference')
    + '</nav>'
    + '<span class="sb-here">Profile</span></div>';
  el.style.display = 'block';
}

/* the person, and what they are: "Kaleb Myers · Coach". The school is on
   every page that concerns it; the masthead is the site bar's. */
var ROLE_WORD = { ADMIN: 'Administrator', COACH: 'Coach', PLAYER: 'Player', FAN: 'Fan' };
function renderWho(){
  var a = STATE.auth;
  var bits = [];
  if (a.role && a.role !== 'PUBLIC') bits.push(ROLE_WORD[a.role] || a.role);
  if (a.status && a.status !== 'ACTIVE' && a.status !== 'NONE') bits.push(a.status);
  var h1 = document.querySelector('.wrap>header h1');
  if (h1) h1.style.display = a.signedIn ? 'none' : '';
  document.getElementById('who').innerHTML = a.signedIn
    ? '<span class="me">'+esc(a.name || a.email)+(bits.length ? ' · '+esc(bits.join(' · ')) : '')+'</span>'
      + ' <a href="#" data-a="signOut" class="sub" style="color:inherit">sign out</a>'
    : 'not signed in';
}

/* The tools that work on one team in one season - the only places the team
   and season pickers appear. The dashboard, Approvals and Coverage stand on
   their own. */
var CTX_VIEWS = { roster:1, scores:1, stats:1, links:1 };

function renderCtx(){
  var a = STATE.auth, el = document.getElementById('ctx');
  if (!a || !(a.isCoach || a.isAdmin) || !STATE.boot){ el.innerHTML = ''; el.removeAttribute('data-sig'); return; }
  if (!CTX_VIEWS[STATE.view]){ el.innerHTML = ''; el.removeAttribute('data-sig'); return; }
  /* redrawn on every navigation, but only rebuilt when something it shows
     has changed - the pickers keep their enhanced state otherwise */
  var sig = (a.isAdmin ? 'A' : 'C') + '|' + STATE.teamId + '|' + STATE.seasonId + '|' + STATE.boot.teams.length + '|' + STATE.boot.seasons.length;
  if (el.getAttribute('data-sig') === sig && el.firstChild) return;
  el.setAttribute('data-sig', sig);

  var h = '';
  if (a.isAdmin){
    h += '<label class="sr-only" for="portal-team">Team</label><select id="portal-team" aria-label="Team" data-h="pickTeam" style="width:auto">'
      + STATE.boot.teams.map(function(t){
          return '<option value="'+esc(t.id)+'"'+(t.id===STATE.teamId?' selected':'')+'>'
               + esc(t.name)+'</option>'; }).join('')
      + '</select>';
  }
  h += '<label class="sr-only" for="portal-season">Season</label><select id="portal-season" aria-label="Season" data-h="pickSeason" style="width:auto">'
    + STATE.boot.seasons.map(function(x){
        return '<option value="'+esc(x.id)+'"'+(x.id===STATE.seasonId?' selected':'')+'>'
             + esc(x.label)+'</option>'; }).join('')
    + '</select>';
  el.innerHTML = h;
}

/* Everything below is keyed to one team and one season. Changing either throws
   the lot away rather than showing one school's roster beside another's games. */
function dropTeamData(){
  STATE.roster = null; STATE.ta = null; STATE.box = null;
  STATE.boxLoading = null; STATE.capt = null; STATE.pending = null;
  STATE.linkPatch = null; STATE.history = null;
  // a selection is row positions in a roster that no longer exists
  STATE.sel = {}; STATE.armRemove = false; STATE.add = null;
  ['roster','scores','stats','links','approvals'].forEach(function(v){
    DIRTY[v] = {};
  });
}
INP.pickTeam = function(el){
  if (el.value === STATE.teamId) return;
  STATE.teamId = el.value;
  dropTeamData();
  renderCtx();
  go(STATE.view);
};
INP.pickSeason = function(el){
  if (el.value === STATE.seasonId) return;
  STATE.seasonId = el.value;
  dropTeamData();
  renderCtx();
  go(STATE.view);
};

function refreshAuthThen(after){
  call('svcAuthState').then(function(a){
    STATE.auth = a;
    renderWho();
    renderTabs();
    if (after) after();
  }).catch(function(){ if (after) after(); });
}

ACT.retryBoot = function(){ boot(true); };

/* - boot - */

var AUTH_BOOT_VERSION=0;
function boot(again){
  var version=++AUTH_BOOT_VERSION,token=TOKEN;
  if (!again) paintLoading('Signing in',3);
  Promise.all([
    call('svcAuthState'),
    STATE.boot ? Promise.resolve(STATE.boot) : call('svcBootstrap'),
    // Fetched once here rather than per view: the registration form, the roster
    // editor and a player's own profile all render the same chips.
    STATE.options.length ? Promise.resolve(STATE.options)
                         : call('svcPositionOptions').catch(function(){ return []; })
  ]).then(function(r){
    if(version!==AUTH_BOOT_VERSION||token!==TOKEN)return;
    STATE.auth = r[0];
    STATE.boot = r[1];
    if (r[2] && r[2].length) STATE.options = r[2];

    if (!STATE.seasonId) STATE.seasonId = STATE.boot.currentSeason;
    /* A coach is BOUND to his own school. A default picked before sign-in
       resolved (the first team on the list) must never survive into a coach's
       session - that is how Elkton's coach was shown Aberdeen's roster. */
    var bound = STATE.auth.teamId || '';
    if (STATE.auth.role === 'COACH' && bound && STATE.teamId !== bound){
      STATE.teamId = bound;
      dropTeamData();
    }
    if (!STATE.teamId)
      STATE.teamId = bound || ((STATE.boot.teams[0] || {}).id || '');
    renderWho();
    renderCtx();
    renderSitebar();

    var a = STATE.auth;
    if (UcbacPolicies.requireUpdate(a)){
      document.getElementById('tabs').innerHTML='';
      paint('<div class="card"><h2>Account update</h2><p>Complete the account update to continue, or sign out to browse public stats.</p></div>');
      finishPortalLaunch(STATE.boot.brand&&STATE.boot.brand.logo);
      return;
    }
    if(returnHomeAfterLogin())return;
    if (a.status === 'ACTIVE' && tabList().length){
      route();
      showLoginNote();
      finishPortalLaunch(STATE.boot.brand&&STATE.boot.brand.logo);
      return;
    }

    renderTabs();
    if (!a.signedIn) (PORTAL_VIEW === 'signup' ? viewSignup : viewLogin)();
    else if (a.status === 'NONE' || a.status === 'REJECTED') viewSignup();
    else if (a.status === 'PENDING' || a.status === 'SUSPENDED') viewPending();
    else viewNoRole();
    showLoginNote();
    finishPortalLaunch(STATE.boot.brand&&STATE.boot.brand.logo);
  }).catch(function(e){
    if(version!==AUTH_BOOT_VERSION||token!==TOKEN)return;
    document.getElementById('who').textContent = 'not signed in';
    alertBox('bad', esc(msgOf(e)));
    paint('<div class="card"><h2>The portal could not start</h2><p class="sub">Check your connection, then reload this page.</p><button type="button" class="primary" data-a="retryBoot">Try again</button></div>');
    finishPortalLaunch('');
  });
}

/* The one-sentence outcome of a registration that rode in with the sign-in -
   shown AFTER the routed view paints, because every view starts by clearing
   the alert box. */
function showLoginNote(){
  if (!STATE.loginNote) return;
  alertBox(/could not/i.test(STATE.loginNote) ? 'bad' : 'ok', esc(STATE.loginNote));
  STATE.loginNote = null;
}

UcbacPolicies.init({baseUrl:function(){return POLICY_EXEC_URL;},call:call,token:function(){return TOKEN;},signOut:function(){ACT.signOut();},accepted:function(a){STATE.auth=a;if(!returnHomeAfterLogin())boot(true);}});

  tabs[i].focus({preventScroll:true});
});

===== src/Positions.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — Positions.gs
 *
 * The single source of truth for position. The roster editor, the All-Conference
 * engine and the public site all read this list — there is no second copy and no
 * free text anywhere downstream.
 *
 * A player carries a SET of positions, stored pipe-delimited in
 * PlayerSeasons.Positions ("RB|CB|ATH"). He is eligible for All-Conference
 * ranking at every position in that set. The duplicate-resolution rules in
 * AllConference.gs decide which award he ultimately occupies.
 *
 * Historical rows carry free text instead ("WR/DB", "OT/G/DT", "T, DT"). The
 * normalizer below maps that vocabulary onto these codes. It was validated
 * against all 743 historical roster rows with zero unrecognized tokens.
 */

const POSITIONS = [
  // code   label                 side       slots  (slots = First Team seats)
  // Major positions. A coach picks one of these; the sub-position is optional
  // and only narrows what was already chosen. Keeping the major position
  // mandatory is what stops the roster drifting back into the free text this
  // replaced, where half the conference was "LB" and the rest was "MLB", "Mike",
  // "OLB" or "LB/DB" and none of it could be compared.
  { code: 'QB',   label: 'Quarterback',        side: 'OFF', slots: 1 },
  { code: 'RB',   label: 'Running Back',       side: 'OFF', slots: 2,
    subs: [{ code: 'HB', label: 'Halfback' }, { code: 'FB', label: 'Fullback' }] },
  { code: 'WR',   label: 'Wide Receiver',      side: 'OFF', slots: 2 },
  { code: 'TE',   label: 'Tight End',          side: 'OFF', slots: 2, ranksAs: 'WR' },
  { code: 'OL',   label: 'Offensive Line',     side: 'OFF', slots: 2,
    subs: [{ code: 'C', label: 'Center' }, { code: 'G', label: 'Guard' },
           { code: 'T', label: 'Tackle' }] },
  { code: 'ATH',  label: 'Athlete',            side: 'OFF', slots: 1 },
  { code: 'LB',   label: 'Linebacker',         side: 'DEF', slots: 2,
    subs: [{ code: 'ILB', label: 'Inside LB' }, { code: 'OLB', label: 'Outside LB' }] },
  { code: 'DL',   label: 'Defensive Line',     side: 'DEF', slots: 2,
    subs: [{ code: 'NG', label: 'Nose Guard' }, { code: 'DT', label: 'Defensive Tackle' },
           { code: 'EDGE', label: 'Edge' }] },
  { code: 'DB',   label: 'Defensive Back',     side: 'DEF', slots: 2,
    subs: [{ code: 'S', label: 'Safety' }, { code: 'CB', label: 'Cornerback' }] },
  // Special teams carry no award in phase 1 but are tracked so the roster is
  // complete and kicking stats have somewhere to attach.
  { code: 'K',    label: 'Kicker',             side: 'ST',  slots: 0, unranked: true },
  { code: 'P',    label: 'Punter',             side: 'ST',  slots: 0, unranked: true },
  { code: 'LS',   label: 'Long Snapper',       side: 'ST',  slots: 0, unranked: true },
  { code: 'RET',  label: 'Returner',           side: 'ST',  slots: 0, unranked: true }
];

// Ironman is not selectable. It is earned by qualifying on both sides.
const IRONMAN = { code: 'IRONMAN', label: 'Ironman', side: 'BOTH', slots: 2 };

/**
 * Every selectable code, major and sub alike, mapped to what it is.
 *
 * A sub-position is a filter, not a separate position: ILB and OLB are both
 * Linebacker, and a player listed ILB must still appear when someone filters on
 * LB. `major` is what he belongs to; `isSub` is how the UI knows to nest it.
 */
const POS_BY_CODE = (function () {
  const m = {};
  POSITIONS.forEach(function (p) {
    m[p.code] = { code: p.code, label: p.label, side: p.side, slots: p.slots,
                  unranked: !!p.unranked, ranksAs: p.ranksAs, major: p.code,
                  isSub: false, subs: (p.subs || []).map(function (x) { return x.code; }) };
    (p.subs || []).forEach(function (x) {
      m[x.code] = { code: x.code, label: x.label, side: p.side, slots: p.slots,
                    unranked: !!p.unranked, major: p.code, isSub: true, subs: [] };
    });
  });
  m[IRONMAN.code] = { code: IRONMAN.code, label: IRONMAN.label, side: IRONMAN.side,
                      slots: IRONMAN.slots, major: IRONMAN.code, isSub: false, subs: [] };
  return m;
})();

/** The major position a code belongs to. An unknown code is its own major. */
function majorOf_(code) {
  const p = POS_BY_CODE[String(code || '').toUpperCase()];
  return p ? p.major : String(code || '').toUpperCase();
}

/**
 * Does a player's selection satisfy a filter?
 * Filtering on LB matches ILB and OLB; filtering on ILB matches only ILB.
 */
function positionMatches_(selected, filterCode) {
  const want = String(filterCode || '').toUpperCase();
  if (!want) return true;
  const wantIsMajor = !!(POS_BY_CODE[want] && !POS_BY_CODE[want].isSub);
  for (var i = 0; i < (selected || []).length; i++) {
    const code = String(selected[i]).toUpperCase();
    if (code === want) return true;
    if (wantIsMajor && majorOf_(code) === want) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** Positions that actually receive a ranking. TE ranks inside the WR pool. */
function rankedPositions_() {
  return POSITIONS.filter(function (p) { return !p.unranked && !p.ranksAs; })
                  .map(function (p) { return p.code; })
                  .concat([IRONMAN.code]);
}

/**
 * The award pools a code competes for.
 *
 * All-Conference awards at the specific position — Inside Linebacker and Outside
 * Linebacker are separate ballots — but the roster only requires the major one.
 * A player listed just "LB" is therefore eligible for BOTH linebacker pools and
 * the duplicate-resolution pass keeps whichever he ranks better in. Excluding
 * him instead would punish a player for his coach's brevity.
 *
 * The other way round, a sub-position with no ballot of its own competes in
 * its major's: a halfback or fullback is a Running Back, a guard is Offensive
 * Line, a nose guard is Defensive Line. Only the sub-positions listed in
 * AC_WEIGHTS (ILB, OLB, S, CB, EDGE) are ballots in their own right.
 */
const POOL_EXPANSION = {
  LB: ['ILB', 'OLB'],
  DB: ['S', 'CB'],
  DL: ['DL', 'EDGE'],
  NG: ['DL'], DT: ['DL'],
  C: ['OL'], G: ['OL'], T: ['OL'],
  HB: ['RB'], FB: ['RB']
};

function poolsOf_(code) {
  const c = String(code || '').toUpperCase();
  if (POOL_EXPANSION[c]) return POOL_EXPANSION[c].slice();
  const p = POS_BY_CODE[c];
  if (p && p.ranksAs) return [p.ranksAs];
  return [c];
}

/** The single pool a code most belongs to. TE competes as WR. */
function poolOf_(code) { return poolsOf_(code)[0]; }

function isOffense_(code) { const p = POS_BY_CODE[code]; return !!p && p.side === 'OFF'; }
function isDefense_(code) { const p = POS_BY_CODE[code]; return !!p && p.side === 'DEF'; }

/** "RB|CB|ATH" -> ['RB','CB','ATH']; unknown codes are dropped, never guessed. */
function parsePositions_(v) {
  if (!v) return [];
  return String(v).split(/[|,;/]+/)
    .map(function (x) { return x.trim().toUpperCase(); })
    .filter(function (x) { return !!POS_BY_CODE[x]; })
    .filter(function (x, i, a) { return a.indexOf(x) === i; });
}

function formatPositions_(list) { return (list || []).join('|'); }

/**
 * Validate a coach's selection at roster-entry time. Returns an error string,
 * or '' when the selection is acceptable.
 */
function validatePositions_(list) {
  const codes = parsePositions_(formatPositions_(list));
  if (!codes.length) return 'Select at least one position.';
  if (codes.length > 4) return 'Select at most four positions.';
  if (codes.indexOf('ATH') >= 0 && codes.filter(isOffense_).length < 2)
    return 'Offensive Athlete requires a second offensive position — Athlete ' +
           'recognizes production in more than one role.';
  return '';
}

// ── historical free-text normalization ─────────────────────────────────────
// Every token observed across the 2023-2026 roster data. Nothing is matched by
// similarity: an unrecognized token is reported for review, never absorbed.

const LEGACY_TOKEN = {
  QB: 'QB',
  RB: 'RB', HB: 'HB', TB: 'HB', FB: 'FB',        // halfback and fullback refine RB
  WR: 'WR', SE: 'WR', SB: 'WR',
  TE: 'TE',
  OL: 'OL', T: 'OL', OT: 'OL', G: 'OL', OG: 'OL', C: 'OL',
  LT: 'OL', RT: 'OL', LG: 'OL', RG: 'OL',
  ATH: 'ATH',
  MLB: 'ILB', ILB: 'ILB', MIKE: 'ILB',
  OLB: 'OLB', SAM: 'OLB', WILL: 'OLB', WLB: 'OLB', SLB: 'OLB',
  S: 'S', SS: 'S', FS: 'S', SAF: 'S', SAFETY: 'S',
  CB: 'CB', CORNER: 'CB', CORNERBACK: 'CB',
  OC: 'OL',                       // "offensive center" on Harford Tech's sheet
  DE: 'EDGE', EDGE: 'EDGE', RUSH: 'EDGE', BUCK: 'EDGE',
  DT: 'DL', NG: 'DL', NT: 'DL', DL: 'DL',
  K: 'K', KICKER: 'K', P: 'P', PUNTER: 'P',
  LS: 'LS', 'LONG SNAPPER': 'LS', SNAPPER: 'LS',
  // RET could not survive a round trip. Every other canonical code is a key on
  // itself here, so a string already written in this project's own vocabulary
  // re-normalizes to itself - but RET was reachable only through KR and PR, and
  // a sheet that said RET or RETURNER lost it silently. Rising Sun's 2026
  // roster carries four returners, spelled out, and every one of them would
  // have arrived with no return role at all.
  RET: 'RET', KR: 'RET', PR: 'RET', RETURNER: 'RET', RETURN: 'RET'
};

// "LB" and "DB" are real tokens but not specific enough to award on. They are
// carried through as review flags rather than resolved by guesswork.
const LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS = { LB: ['ILB', 'OLB'], DB: ['S', 'CB'] };

/* Words that turn up where a position goes and are not positions. They are
   listed so they can be DROPPED quietly. Left out, they come back as unknown
   tokens, which raises an ERROR in the exception queue and asks somebody to
   resolve an injury into a defensive assignment. Availability is not a role and
   a blank is the right answer for it - Rising Sun's sheet writes "Hurt" in the
   defensive column for three players. */
const LEGACY_NOT_A_POSITION = {
  HURT: 1, INJURED: 1, INJURY: 1, OUT: 1, 'OUT FOR SEASON': 1, 'N/A': 1,
  NA: 1, NONE: 1, TBD: 1, '?': 1, '-': 1, '--': 1, X: 1
};

/**
 * Convert a legacy free-text position string to canonical codes.
 * Returns { codes: [...], ambiguous: [...], unknown: [...] }.
 */
function normalizeLegacyPosition_(raw) {
  const out = { codes: [], ambiguous: [], unknown: [] };
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return out;
  const txt = String(raw).trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!txt || txt === 'NONE' || txt === 'N/A' || txt === '-') return out;
  if (/^[\d.]+$/.test(txt)) return out;          // a stray number leaked in ("26.0")

  txt.split(/[\/,;|&]+|\s+AND\s+/).forEach(function (piece) {
    const tok = piece.trim();
    if (!tok) return;
    if (LEGACY_NOT_A_POSITION[tok]) return;      // availability, not a role
    if (LEGACY_TOKEN[tok]) {
      const c = LEGACY_TOKEN[tok];
      if (out.codes.indexOf(c) < 0) out.codes.push(c);
    } else if (LEGACY_AMBIGUOUS[tok]) {
      if (out.ambiguous.indexOf(tok) < 0) out.ambiguous.push(tok);
    } else {
      out.unknown.push(tok);
    }
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * The codes a ROSTER row keeps from a legacy string: everything resolved,
 * plus a bare LB or DB as the major position it names. "LB" is too vague to
 * award on, which is why the normalizer sets it aside for review, but it is
 * exactly what a coach's sheet means by "TE/LB", and a major position is a
 * legal roster entry - the roster editor accepts one without a sub-position.
 * Dropping it filed a two-way tight end as a tight end alone, and the
 * defensive boards then had nothing to show for him but his offense.
 */
function rosterCodesFromLegacy_(raw) {
  const n = normalizeLegacyPosition_(raw);
  const out = n.codes.slice();
  n.ambiguous.forEach(function (tok) {
    if (POS_BY_CODE[tok] && out.indexOf(tok) < 0) out.push(tok);
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Remove every POSITION_REVIEW row from the exception queue.
 *
 * backfillPositions() appends its findings, so without this a second run would
 * stack another full set on top of the first and the queue would grow without
 * ever being right.
 */
function clearPositionReviewExceptions_() {
  if (!hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.EXCEPTIONS)) return 0;
  const sh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.EXCEPTIONS);
  const data = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  if (data.length < 2) return 0;
  const cType = data[0].map(String).indexOf('Type');
  if (cType < 0) return 0;
  var removed = 0;
  for (var r = data.length - 1; r >= 1; r--) {
    if (String(data[r][cType]).trim() === 'POSITION_REVIEW') { sh.deleteRow(r + 1); removed++; }
  }
  __tableCache = {};
  return removed;
}

/**
 * Backfill PlayerSeasons.Positions from the legacy columns.
 *
 * Ambiguous and empty rows go to the exception queue so a coach resolves them in
 * the roster editor rather than the system inventing an answer. Safe to re-run:
 * it clears its own previous findings first.
 */
function backfillPositions() {
  const purged = clearPositionReviewExceptions_();
  const sh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
  const data = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const head = data[0].map(String);

  var colPos = head.indexOf('Positions');
  if (colPos < 0) {
    colPos = head.length;
    sh.getRange(1, colPos + 1).setValue('Positions');
  }
  const legacy = ['Position', 'OffensePosition', 'DefensePosition']
    .map(function (c) { return head.indexOf(c); }).filter(function (i) { return i >= 0; });
  const cSeason = head.indexOf('SeasonID'), cPlayer = head.indexOf('PlayerID');

  const writes = [], exceptions = [];
  var filled = 0, review = 0, empty = 0;

  for (var r = 1; r < data.length; r++) {
    const parts = legacy.map(function (i) { return data[r][i]; })
                        .filter(function (v) { return v !== '' && v !== null; });
    const agg = { codes: [], ambiguous: [], unknown: [] };
    parts.forEach(function (p) {
      const n = normalizeLegacyPosition_(p);
      n.codes.forEach(function (c) { if (agg.codes.indexOf(c) < 0) agg.codes.push(c); });
      n.ambiguous.forEach(function (a) { if (agg.ambiguous.indexOf(a) < 0) agg.ambiguous.push(a); });
      agg.unknown = agg.unknown.concat(n.unknown);
    });

    writes.push([formatPositions_(agg.codes)]);
    if (agg.codes.length) filled++;
    if (agg.ambiguous.length || agg.unknown.length || !agg.codes.length) {
      if (!agg.codes.length && !agg.ambiguous.length && !agg.unknown.length) empty++;
      else review++;
      // These keys must match the Exceptions header exactly. appendRows() maps
      // objects onto the sheet by column name, so an invented field name lands
      // in no column at all and the row is written blank.
      exceptions.push({
        ExceptionID: '',
        Type: 'POSITION_REVIEW',
        Severity: agg.unknown.length ? CONFIG.SEVERITY.ERROR
                : (agg.ambiguous.length ? CONFIG.SEVERITY.WARNING : CONFIG.SEVERITY.INFO),
        SourceRef: String(data[r][cSeason] || '') + ' ' + String(data[r][cPlayer] || ''),
        RawValue: parts.join(' / '),
        SuggestedMatch: formatPositions_(agg.codes),
        Confidence: '',
        Note: agg.ambiguous.length
                ? 'Ambiguous: ' + agg.ambiguous.join(',') + ' — the coach must choose'
                : (agg.unknown.length ? 'Unrecognized: ' + agg.unknown.join(',')
                                      : 'No position on file'),
        Status: 'OPEN'
      });
    }
  }

  if (writes.length) sh.getRange(2, colPos + 1, writes.length, 1).setValues(writes);
  if (exceptions.length && hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.EXCEPTIONS)) {
    appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.EXCEPTIONS, exceptions);
  }
  const msg = 'Positions backfilled: ' + filled + ' rows resolved, ' + review +
              ' need coach review, ' + empty + ' had no position on file.' +
              (purged ? '\nCleared ' + purged + ' stale POSITION_REVIEW rows first.' : '');
  Logger.log(msg);
  return msg;
}

===== src/Profile.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — Profile.gs
 *
 * What a signed-in PLAYER may do to his own record, and nothing else.
 *
 * The whole file is one idea: a player owns the things a person knows about
 * himself — his height, his handle, where he committed — and owns none of the
 * things a scorekeeper knows about him. Stats are never written here. A player
 * who believes a number is wrong files a correction, a coach or an administrator
 * decides, and until then the published number does not move. That asymmetry is
 * the point; without it the leaderboard is a self-report.
 *
 * Three guards exist because this page is public and it names a minor:
 *
 *   DisplayName may change, because names change and imports mangle them, but a
 *   change that does not share a surname with the name already on file is
 *   refused. Renaming a profile into a different person is how one account
 *   quietly becomes another, and the rename is audited and mailed either way.
 *
 *   A link is stored only when it is https and its host is one we recognize —
 *   the film and recruiting sites, plus whatever school domains the Teams tab
 *   declares. An arbitrary URL on a page about a sixteen-year-old is not a
 *   feature.
 *
 *   Bio is stripped of markup and capped. It is rendered on the public site.
 *
 * Authorization is decided here, on the server, before anything is read or
 * written. The svc* wrappers are callable by any signed-in Google account, so a
 * hostile caller passing someone else's PlayerID is the case every function has
 * to survive: none of them take a player id at all — the identity comes from the
 * Accounts row, never from the argument list.
 */

// Literals rather than CONFIG lookups where a top-level constant is involved:
// Apps Script evaluates every file's top-level statements before any function
// runs, so nothing here may depend on another file's constants. Everything below
// reaches for CONFIG inside a function body, where it is defined.
const PROFILE = {

  BIO_MAX: 600,
  TEXT_MAX: 80,
  REASON_MIN: 12,
  REASON_MAX: 500,

  // A player with two dozen unreviewed disputes is not disputing, he is
  // flooding the coach's queue. Reviewed ones do not count against him.
  OPEN_CORRECTION_CAP: 25,

  // MailApp's daily quota is per-account and shared with everything else this
  // project sends, so a sweep never tries to drain the whole queue at once.
  MAIL_BATCH: 50,

  // Never spent by the notification sweep: kept back for sign-in codes, which
  // have a person waiting at a form. A day where the queue ate the last mail
  // was a day nobody could sign in at all.
  MAIL_RESERVE: 15,

  /**
   * Hosts a player-supplied link may point at. Matched on the exact host or any
   * subdomain of it. hcps.org and ccps.org are the two county school systems the
   * conference sits in; any additional school host comes from Teams.SchoolURL at
   * runtime, so adding a school never means editing this list.
   */
  URL_HOSTS: ['hudl.com', 'maxpreps.com', 'x.com', 'twitter.com', 'instagram.com',
              'hcps.org', 'ccps.org'],

  // Free text here would be unrankable and unfilterable the moment anyone wanted
  // to count commitments by level, which is the first thing anyone wants.
  COMMITMENT_LEVELS: ['D1', 'D2', 'D3', 'NAIA', 'JUCO', 'PREP', 'WALK_ON', 'UNDECIDED'],

  /**
   * The Players columns a player may write, and how each is validated.
   * `key` is what the client sends; `col` is the sheet header. appendRows() and
   * updateCells() both match on the header exactly, so `col` is checked against
   * the real header row before anything is written.
   */
  /* No commitmentDate and no profilePhotoId, on purpose. The date added a
     third question to a two-question fact (school, level). The photo became a
     jersey-number avatar instead: a photo pipeline on a site full of minors
     is moderation work nobody signed up for. Offers are the schools recruiting
     him — several of them, each a school and a level. */
  PLAYER_FIELDS: [
    { key: 'displayName',       col: 'DisplayName',       kind: 'NAME' },
    { key: 'gradYear',          col: 'GradYear',          kind: 'YEAR' },
    { key: 'commitment',        col: 'Commitment',        kind: 'TEXT' },
    { key: 'commitmentLevel',   col: 'CommitmentLevel',   kind: 'LEVEL' },
    { key: 'offers',            col: 'Offers',            kind: 'OFFERS' },
    { key: 'hudlUrl',           col: 'HudlURL',           kind: 'URL' },
    { key: 'xHandle',           col: 'XHandle',           kind: 'HANDLE' },
    { key: 'instagramHandle',   col: 'InstagramHandle',   kind: 'HANDLE' },
    { key: 'maxPrepsUrl',       col: 'MaxPrepsURL',       kind: 'URL' },
    { key: 'hometown',          col: 'Hometown',          kind: 'TEXT' },
    { key: 'bio',               col: 'Bio',               kind: 'BIO' }
  ],

  MAX_OFFERS: 30,

  /**
   * The PlayerSeasons columns a player may write that are not measurables.
   * Use profileSeasonFields() — it appends the measured numbers.
   */
  SEASON_FIELDS_FIXED: [
    { key: 'jersey',    col: 'Jersey',    kind: 'JERSEY' },
    { key: 'positions', col: 'Positions', kind: 'POSITIONS' }
  ],

  /**
   * Named refusals. Anything not on an editable list is refused anyway, but
   * these four are the ones a client will actually try, and a reason a person
   * can read beats "not an editable field".
   */
  NEVER: {
    iscaptain: 'a captain is named by his coach, not by himself',
    teamid:    'your team is set by your coach',
    playerid:  'identity is not editable',
    stars:     'a rating is entered by an administrator'
  },

  // ensureOpsTabs() creates the first eleven; Schema.gs appends the last five.
  CORRECTION_COLS: ['CorrectionID', 'StatID', 'GameID', 'PlayerID', 'Field',
                    'OldValue', 'NewValue', 'CorrectedBy', 'Role', 'CorrectedAt',
                    'Reason', 'Status', 'ReviewedBy', 'ReviewedAt', 'SeasonID', 'TeamID']
};

/**
 * Every PlayerSeasons column a player may write, measurables included.
 *
 * A function rather than a field on PROFILE because MEASURABLES is a top-level
 * const in another file. Apps Script evaluates all .gs files into one global
 * scope in an order this code does not control, so a const literal that reads
 * another file's const is a load error on the days the order goes the other
 * way. Read at call time it is always there.
 *
 * The measurables come from that one list rather than being restated here, so a
 * player and his coach can never be offered different fields.
 */
function profileSeasonFields_() {
  return PROFILE.SEASON_FIELDS_FIXED.concat(MEASURABLES.map(function (m) {
    return { key: m.key, col: m.col, kind: 'MEASURABLE' };
  }));
}

// ── identity ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * The caller, refusing anyone who is not an ACTIVE account bound to a player.
 *
 * No function in this file accepts a PlayerID from the client. The only player
 * anyone can reach here is the one their own Accounts row names, which is what
 * makes "may never edit another player" true rather than merely intended.
 */
function profileWhoami_() {
  const me = accountsWhoami_();
  if (!me.email) throw new Error('Sign in with your Google account first.');

  if (me.status === 'PENDING')
    throw new Error('Your account is still waiting for approval. Until then you ' +
                    'can read the site but not edit a profile.');
  if (me.status === 'REJECTED')
    throw new Error('This account was not approved. Speak to your head coach.');
  if (me.status === 'SUSPENDED')
    throw new Error('This account is suspended. Contact an administrator.');
  if (me.status !== 'ACTIVE')
    throw new Error('This account is not active. Register first.');

  if (!me.playerId)
    throw new Error('This account is not linked to a player. Ask your coach or an ' +
                    'administrator to link it before editing a profile.');
  return me;
}

/**
 * Who a profile call acts ON. Without a playerId it is the signed-in player
 * himself. With one, it is a coach or administrator editing one of their own
 * players — same fields, same validation, their name on the change log. A
 * coach can edit anything his player can edit, and nothing of anyone else's.
 */
function profileTarget_(playerId) {
  playerId = s_(playerId);
  if (!playerId) return profileWhoami_();

  const me = accountsWhoami_();
  if (!me.email) throw new Error('Sign in first.');
  const seat = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.PlayerID) === playerId && s_(r.SeasonID) === CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  })[0];
  const teamId = seat ? s_(seat.TeamID) : '';
  const ok = me.role === 'ADMIN' ||
             (me.role === 'COACH' && me.teamId && me.teamId === teamId);
  if (!ok)
    throw new Error('Only ' + (teamNameOf_(teamId) || 'that player\'s team') +
                    '\'s coach or an administrator can edit this profile.');
  return { email: me.email, role: me.role, teamId: me.teamId, playerId: playerId };
}

// ── validation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Every normalizer below returns the value to store, or throws with a message a
// player can act on. Blank always returns '' and never 0 — a cleared height is
// "not reported", and a zero would publish him as nought inches tall.

/** Plain single-line text: no markup, no control characters, capped. */
function profileText_(v, max) {
  const txt = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[<>]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  const cap = max || PROFILE.TEXT_MAX;
  if (txt.length > cap)
    throw new Error('That is ' + txt.length + ' characters; the limit is ' + cap + '.');
  return txt;
}

/**
 * Bio, stripped of markup and capped.
 *
 * Over-length throws rather than truncating. A silently cut sentence is a worse
 * outcome than a refusal: the player never learns the end of it was dropped, and
 * the public page carries the half of it that survived.
 */
function profileBio_(v) {
  var txt = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v);
  txt = txt.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')                    // tags
           .replace(/&[#a-zA-Z0-9]{1,10};/g, ' ')       // entities, escaped or not
           .replace(/[<>]/g, ' ')                       // a stray bracket is still markup
           .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]/g, ' ')
           .replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ')
           .replace(/[ \t]*\n[ \t]*/g, '\n')
           .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
           .trim();
  if (txt.length > PROFILE.BIO_MAX)
    throw new Error('Your bio is ' + txt.length + ' characters; the limit is ' +
                    PROFILE.BIO_MAX + '. Shorten it and save again.');
  return txt;
}

/** The host of an https URL, lowercased, or '' when it is not one. */
function profileHostOf_(url) {
  const m = /^https:\/\/([^\/\?#\s]+)(?:[\/\?#][^\s]*)?$/i.exec(String(url || '').trim());
  if (!m) return '';
  const authority = m[1];
  if (authority.indexOf('@') >= 0) return '';      // userinfo disguises the real host
  return authority.split(':')[0].toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Every host a player link may point at: the fixed list, plus the host of each
 * school's own site as declared in Teams.SchoolURL.
 *
 * Memoized per execution. A workbook that has not been through ensureSchema()
 * has no SchoolURL column yet and simply contributes no school hosts.
 */
var __profileHosts = null;
function profileAllowedHosts_() {
  if (__profileHosts) return __profileHosts;
  const out = PROFILE.URL_HOSTS.slice();
  if (hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS) && tabHeader_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS).indexOf('SchoolURL') >= 0) {
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS).forEach(function (t) {
      const h = profileHostOf_(s_(t.SchoolURL)).replace(/^www\./, '');
      if (h && out.indexOf(h) < 0) out.push(h);
    });
  }
  __profileHosts = out;
  return out;
}

/** The host itself, or a subdomain of it. "nothudl.com" is not "hudl.com". */
function profileHostAllowed_(host, allowed) {
  for (var i = 0; i < allowed.length; i++) {
    const d = allowed[i];
    if (host === d) return true;
    if (host.length > d.length + 1 &&
        host.slice(host.length - d.length - 1) === '.' + d) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** https only, allowlisted host only. Anything else is refused, never stored. */
function profileUrl_(v) {
  const txt = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim();
  if (!txt) return '';
  if (txt.length > 300) throw new Error('That link is too long.');
  if (!/^https:\/\//i.test(txt))
    throw new Error('Links must start with https:// — "' + txt.slice(0, 40) + '" does not.');

  const host = profileHostOf_(txt);
  const allowed = profileAllowedHosts_();
  if (!host || !profileHostAllowed_(host.replace(/^www\./, ''), allowed))
    throw new Error('Links are accepted only from ' + allowed.join(', ') +
                    '. "' + (host || txt.slice(0, 40)) + '" is not one of them.');
  return txt;
}

/** A bare handle, stored with its @. A pasted link is refused, not guessed at. */
function profileHandle_(v) {
  const raw = profileText_(v, 40).replace(/^@+/, '');
  if (!raw) return '';
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,30}$/.test(raw))
    throw new Error('Enter the handle by itself — letters, numbers, underscore — ' +
                    'not a link. "' + raw.slice(0, 30) + '" is not a handle.');
  return '@' + raw;
}

function profileGradYear_(v) {
  const txt = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim();
  if (!txt) return '';
  const now = new Date().getFullYear();
  const n = Number(txt);
  if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(txt) || n < 1950 || n > now + 6)
    throw new Error('Graduation year "' + txt + '" is not a year between 1950 and ' +
                    (now + 6) + '.');
  return n;
}

function profileLevel_(v) {
  const txt = profileText_(v, 20).toUpperCase().replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_');
  if (!txt) return '';
  if (PROFILE.COMMITMENT_LEVELS.indexOf(txt) < 0)
    throw new Error('Commitment level must be one of ' +
                    PROFILE.COMMITMENT_LEVELS.join(', ') + '.');
  return txt;
}

/**
 * A calendar date, stored as a Date.
 *
 * Only YYYY-MM-DD is accepted from a client. Anything looser gets parsed
 * differently by every browser and every locale, and a commitment dated the
 * wrong side of a signing period is worse than no date at all.
 */
function profileDate_(v) {
  if (v instanceof Date) return v;
  const txt = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim();
  if (!txt) return '';
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(txt);
  if (!m) throw new Error('Enter the date as YYYY-MM-DD. "' + txt + '" is not.');

  const y = Number(m[1]), mo = Number(m[2]), d = Number(m[3]);
  const dt = new Date(y, mo - 1, d);
  if (dt.getFullYear() !== y || dt.getMonth() !== mo - 1 || dt.getDate() !== d)
    throw new Error('"' + txt + '" is not a real date.');

  const now = new Date().getFullYear();
  if (y < 2000 || y > now + 2)
    throw new Error('Commitment date "' + txt + '" is outside 2000–' + (now + 2) + '.');
  return dt;
}

/** A Drive file id, or one lifted out of a Drive link the player pasted. */
function profileFileId_(v) {
  const txt = String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).trim();
  if (!txt) return '';
  const link = /\/d\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,100})|[?&]id=([A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,100})/.exec(txt);
  const id = link ? (link[1] || link[2]) : txt;
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,100}$/.test(id))
    throw new Error('That is not a Drive file id. Upload the photo, then paste its ' +
                    'file id or its Drive link.');
  return id;
}

/**
 * A measurable, in range. The range is not fussiness — an unbounded number here
 * ends up on the public page and in the All-Conference pool, where a 6-inch
 * lineman is noticed by everyone except the code.
 */
function profileMeasure_(v, lo, hi, label) {
  const n = numOrBlank_(v);
  if (n === '') return '';
  if (n < lo || n > hi)
    throw new Error(label + ' "' + v + '" is outside ' + lo + '–' + hi + '.');
  return n;
}

/**
 * The offers list: [{school, level}] in, JSON out. Blank list stores ''.
 * Each school is plain text; each level comes from the same controlled list
 * as the commitment, or blank for "level unknown".
 */
function profileOffers_(v) {
  var list = v;
  if (typeof list === 'string') {
    if (!list.trim()) return '';
    try { list = JSON.parse(list); } catch (e) { throw new Error('Offers are unreadable.'); }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) throw new Error('Offers must be a list.');
  const out = [];
  list.forEach(function (o) {
    const school = profileText_(o && o.school, 60);
    if (!school) return;                            // an empty row is just a row
    const level = profileLevel_(o && o.level || '');
    out.push({ school: school, level: level });
  });
  if (out.length > PROFILE.MAX_OFFERS)
    throw new Error('That is ' + out.length + ' offers; the limit is ' +
                    PROFILE.MAX_OFFERS + '.');
  return out.length ? JSON.stringify(out) : '';
}

/** Read the stored Offers cell back into a list. Junk reads as no offers. */
function profileParseOffers_(raw) {
  const txt = String(raw === null || raw === undefined ? '' : raw).trim();
  if (!txt || txt.charAt(0) !== '[') return [];
  try {
    const list = JSON.parse(txt);
    return Array.isArray(list) ? list.filter(function (o) {
      return o && String(o.school || '').trim();
    }).map(function (o) {
      return { school: String(o.school), level: String(o.level || '') };
    }) : [];
  } catch (e) { return []; }
}

/** One value, validated for its field. Throws with a message meant for a player. */
function profileValue_(field, raw, ctx) {
  switch (field.kind) {
    case 'NAME':      return profileDisplayName_(raw, ctx.currentName);
    case 'TEXT':      return profileText_(raw, PROFILE.TEXT_MAX);
    case 'BIO':       return profileBio_(raw);
    case 'URL':       return profileUrl_(raw);
    case 'HANDLE':    return profileHandle_(raw);
    case 'YEAR':      return profileGradYear_(raw);
    case 'LEVEL':     return profileLevel_(raw);
    case 'DATE':      return profileDate_(raw);
    case 'FILEID':    return profileFileId_(raw);
    case 'JERSEY':    return normalizeJersey_(raw);
    case 'OFFERS':    return profileOffers_(raw);
    // One validator for every measured number, sharing its range with the
    // coach's roster editor. INCHES and POUNDS below are the older spellings of
    // the same two fields, kept because other callers still name them.
    case 'MEASURABLE': return measurableValue_(field.key, raw);
    case 'INCHES':    return profileMeasure_(raw, 48, 90, 'Height');
    case 'POUNDS':    return profileMeasure_(raw, 80, 450, 'Weight');
    case 'GPA':       return normalizeGpa_(raw);
    case 'POSITIONS': return profilePositions_(raw);
  }
  throw new Error('No validator for ' + field.key + '.');
}

function profilePositions_(v) {
  const codes = parsePositions_(formatPositions_(v || []));
  const err = validatePositions_(codes);
  if (err) throw new Error(err);
  return formatPositions_(codes);
}

/**
 * A name change, guarded by its surname.
 *
 * Fixing "Deshawn" to "DeShawn", or an import's "Reinhardt Iii" to
 * "Reinhardt III", is exactly what this field is for. Turning Reinhardt into
 * Rodriguez is not a correction, it is one account becoming another — and the
 * account is already bound to a PlayerID whose stats and All-Conference standing
 * would go with the new name. Identity is exact-match only, so the surname must
 * survive; anything else needs a person.
 */
function profileDisplayName_(v, current) {
  const name = profileText_(v, 60);
  if (!name) throw new Error('A name cannot be blank.');
  if (!/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'\.\- ]*$/.test(name))
    throw new Error('A name may hold only letters, spaces, apostrophes, hyphens and ' +
                    'periods. "' + name + '" does not.');
  if (name.split(' ').filter(function (t) { return !!t; }).length < 2)
    throw new Error('Enter your first and last name.');

  const was = acctNameParts_(current), now = acctNameParts_(name);
  if (!now.last) throw new Error('Enter your first and last name.');
  if (was.last && now.last !== was.last)
    throw new Error('This profile is on file as "' + current + '". A name change that ' +
                    'drops the surname has to be made by a coach or an administrator — ' +
                    'a profile carries a player\'s stats, and renaming it moves them.');
  return name;
}

/** Did the cell actually change? Dates compare by instant, blanks by emptiness. */
function profileSame_(a, b) {
  if (a instanceof Date || b instanceof Date) {
    if (!(a instanceof Date) || !(b instanceof Date)) return false;
    return a.getTime() === b.getTime();
  }
  const x = (a === null || a === undefined) ? '' : String(a).trim();
  const y = (b === null || b === undefined) ? '' : String(b).trim();
  return x === y;
}

// ── read ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * The caller's own profile, plus exactly what the form is allowed to offer.
 *
 * `editable` is generated from the same registry the save path validates
 * against, and filtered to the columns the workbook really has, so the UI can
 * never render a field the server would then refuse. Stats are not here at all —
 * the public player page already carries them, and nothing on this page edits
 * one.
 */
function apiMyProfile_(forPlayerId) {
  const me = profileTarget_(forPlayerId);

  const player = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS).filter(function (p) {
    return s_(p.PlayerID) === me.playerId;
  })[0];
  /* The account names a PlayerID the Players tab has lost. Nothing the player
     can do about it and nothing he did wrong, so the message says so and names
     the one-click repair rather than leaving an administrator to guess:
     UCBAC Stats > Maintenance > Restore orphaned players. */
  if (!player)
    throw new Error('Your profile row is missing from the database — this is our ' +
                    'fault, not yours, and your statistics are safe. Email ' +
                    'contact@example.invalid and quote ' + me.playerId + '. ' +
                    '(Administrator: Maintenance > Restore orphaned players.)');

  const teams = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS), function (t) { return s_(t.TeamID); });
  const seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;

  const seasons = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.PlayerID) === me.playerId;
  }).map(function (r) {
    const t = teams[s_(r.TeamID)] || {};
    const out = {
      playerSeasonId: s_(r.PlayerSeasonID),
      seasonId: s_(r.SeasonID),
      teamId: s_(r.TeamID),
      teamName: s_(t.DisplayName) || s_(r.TeamID),
      jersey: s_(r.Jersey),
      positions: parsePositions_(r.Positions),
      // read-only here, and the only reason it travels at all is so the page can
      // show the C without offering a switch
      isCaptain: s_(r.IsCaptain).toUpperCase() === 'TRUE',
      editable: s_(r.SeasonID) === seasonId
    };
    // num() already returns null for a blank cell, which is what has to reach
    // the form — an empty box, not a zero the player has to notice and clear.
    MEASURABLES.forEach(function (m) { out[m.key] = num_(r[m.col]); });
    return out;
  }).sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.seasonId < b.seasonId ? 1 : (a.seasonId > b.seasonId ? -1 : 0);
  });

  const playerHead = tabHeader_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  const seasonHead = tabHeader_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
  const missing = [];

  const playerFields = PROFILE.PLAYER_FIELDS.filter(function (f) {
    if (playerHead.indexOf(f.col) >= 0) return true;
    missing.push(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS + '.' + f.col);
    return false;
  }).map(function (f) { return f.key; });

  const seasonFields = profileSeasonFields_().filter(function (f) {
    if (seasonHead.indexOf(f.col) >= 0) return true;
    missing.push(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS + '.' + f.col);
    return false;
  }).map(function (f) { return f.key; });

  const current = seasons.filter(function (r) { return r.seasonId === seasonId; })[0] || null;

  return {
    player: {
      playerId: me.playerId,
      name: s_(player.DisplayName),
      gradYear: s_(player.GradYear),
      hometown: s_(player.Hometown),
      bio: s_(player.Bio),
      updatedAt: (player.UpdatedAt instanceof Date)
        ? player.UpdatedAt.toISOString() : s_(player.UpdatedAt),
      updatedBy: s_(player.UpdatedBy)
    },
    seasons: seasons,
    links: {
      hudlUrl: s_(player.HudlURL),
      maxPrepsUrl: s_(player.MaxPrepsURL),
      xHandle: s_(player.XHandle),
      instagramHandle: s_(player.InstagramHandle)
    },
    commitment: {
      commitment: s_(player.Commitment),
      commitmentLevel: s_(player.CommitmentLevel)
    },
    offers: profileParseOffers_(player.Offers),
    editable: {
      seasonId: seasonId,
      hasCurrentSeason: !!current,
      playerSeasonId: current ? current.playerSeasonId : '',
      fields: playerFields,
      seasonFields: seasonFields,
      // Labels, ranges and step for the measured numbers, so the player's form
      // and the coach's roster editor render one identical set of inputs.
      measurables: MEASURABLES,
      commitmentLevels: PROFILE.COMMITMENT_LEVELS.slice(),
      allowedHosts: profileAllowedHosts_(),
      bioMaxChars: PROFILE.BIO_MAX,
      // the surname the rename guard will hold you to
      surname: acctNameParts_(s_(player.DisplayName)).last,
      correctableFields: SUM_FIELDS.slice(),
      // the category vocabulary the stat-entry form renders — the same one
      // the coach's box-score editor uses, from the same constant
      statCategories: (typeof TEAMADMIN !== 'undefined') ? TEAMADMIN.CATEGORIES : {},
      statCategoryOrder: (typeof TEAMADMIN !== 'undefined') ? TEAMADMIN.CATEGORY_ORDER : [],
      // named so the page can say why rather than just greying a control
      readOnly: Object.keys(PROFILE.NEVER),
      missingColumns: missing
    }
  };
}

/**
 * A player enters his own line for one of his team's games.
 *
 * The write goes through the same machinery the coach's box-score editor
 * uses — same validation, same upsert key, same audit — with the self flag
 * set, so the rows land marked PLAYER_ENTRY: published at once, in grey,
 * counted into totals that also turn grey, and queued for the coach to
 * approve, reject, or supersede with the official line. His coach and the
 * administrators are told there is something to look at.
 */
function apiSubmitMyStats_(gameId, rows) {
  const me = profileWhoami_();
  gameId = s_(gameId);
  if (!gameId) throw new Error('Which game?');

  const g = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).filter(function (x) {
    return s_(x.GameID) === gameId;
  })[0];
  if (!g) throw new Error('Unknown game "' + gameId + '".');
  const seasonId = s_(g.SeasonID) || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;

  // his team for THAT game's season — a 2024 game gets his 2024 team
  const seat = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.PlayerID) === me.playerId && s_(r.SeasonID) === seasonId;
  })[0];
  if (!seat)
    throw new Error('You are not on a roster for the ' +
                    seasonId.replace('SEA-', '') + ' season, so there is no ' +
                    'team to record these under.');
  const teamId = s_(seat.TeamID);
  if (s_(g.HomeTeamID) !== teamId && s_(g.AwayTeamID) !== teamId)
    throw new Error('That game is not one of ' + (teamNameOf_(teamId) || 'your team') + "'s.");

  /* Entry opens the morning AFTER the game. Numbers typed in at halftime are
     guesses; Saturday's entry is Friday's stats with a night's sleep on them. */
  const gdate = apiDateStr_(g.GameDate);
  if (gdate && apiTodayStr_() <= gdate)
    throw new Error('Stat entry for this game opens the day after it is played. ' +
                    'Come back tomorrow.');

  /* The window for self-entry is BEFORE the official box score exists. One
     official line for this game and team — a coach's entry, an approved entry,
     an import — closes it: from then on the player's road is a correction
     request, which lands on the same Approvals badge. Two entry paths onto the
     same recorded game would make every disagreement a race. */
  const official = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS).some(function (r) {
    return s_(r.GameID) === gameId && s_(r.TeamID) === teamId &&
           s_(r.grain || r.Grain) === CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME &&
           s_(r.SourceType) !== 'PLAYER_ENTRY';
  });
  if (official)
    throw new Error('Your coach has already entered statistics for this game. If a ' +
