                    'number is missing or wrong, request a correction below — it goes ' +
                    'to your coach the same way.');

  /* No mail to the coach — the Approvals badge is the notification. Forty
     players entering Friday's stats must not be forty messages. */
  return apiSavePlayerStats_(gameId, teamId, rows,
                            { playerId: me.playerId, email: me.email });
}

// ── write ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Validate one field out of the patch and stage the cell that changes.
 *
 * Nothing is written here — updates are collected so each tab is touched once,
 * after every field has had its say. A field the caller did not name is left
 * alone; a field whose column is missing is refused by name rather than written
 * nowhere, which is what updateCells() would quietly do with it.
 *
 * `out` carries the running result: saved, refused, audit, and the two flags the
 * caller acts on afterwards — whether the name changed and whether anything the
 * roster depends on did.
 */
function profileApplyField_(f, row, head, tabName, updates, patch, ctx, out) {
  const raw = (patch[f.key] !== undefined) ? patch[f.key] : patch[f.col];
  if (raw === undefined) return;

  if (head.indexOf(f.col) < 0) {
    out.refused.push(f.key + ': ' + tabName + ' has no ' + f.col + ' column. ' +
                     'An administrator must run ensureSchema_().');
    return;
  }

  var value;
  try {
    value = profileValue_(f, raw, ctx);
  } catch (err) {
    out.refused.push(f.key + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)));
    return;
  }

  const before = row[f.col];
  if (profileSame_(before, value)) return;        // nothing to write, nothing to audit

  const onPlayers = (tabName === CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  updates.push({ row: row.__row, field: f.col, value: value });
  out.audit.push(auditRow_(ctx.me, 'PROFILE_EDIT',
                          onPlayers ? 'Player' : 'PlayerSeason',
                          onPlayers ? ctx.me.playerId : s_(row.PlayerSeasonID),
                          f.col, before, value, ctx.seasonId));
  out.saved.push(f.key);

  if (f.kind === 'NAME') { out.renamedFrom = s_(before); out.renamedTo = String(value); }
  // a name, a jersey or a position changes what the site and the ballot render
  if (!onPlayers || f.kind === 'NAME') out.rosterTouched = true;
}

/**
 * Save a patch of the caller's own profile.
 *
 * `patch` is a flat object keyed by the `key` names apiMyProfile() hands out
 * (the sheet header works too). A key that is absent is left alone; a key whose
 * value is blank clears the cell. Every field is validated on its own and a bad
 * one lands in `refused` with its reason — one mistyped height does not throw
 * away eleven good fields, which is the difference between a form a teenager
 * fills in once and a form he gives up on.
 *
 * Returns { ok, saved:[keys written], refused:[strings] }.
 */
function apiSaveProfile_(patch, forPlayerId) {
  const me = profileTarget_(forPlayerId);
  patch = patch || {};

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS))
    throw new Error('Another save is in progress. Try again in a moment.');

  try {
    // another execution may have written to either tab since this one read it
    delete __tableCache[CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS];
    delete __tableCache[CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS];

    const seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
    const playerRow = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS).filter(function (p) {
      return s_(p.PlayerID) === me.playerId;
    })[0];
    if (!playerRow)
      throw new Error('Your profile row is missing from the database — this is our ' +
                      'fault, not yours, and nothing you entered was lost. Email ' +
                      'contact@example.invalid and quote ' + me.playerId + '. ' +
                      '(Administrator: Maintenance > Restore orphaned players.)');

    const seasonRow = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).filter(function (r) {
      return s_(r.PlayerID) === me.playerId && s_(r.SeasonID) === seasonId;
    })[0] || null;

    const playerHead = tabHeader_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
    const seasonHead = tabHeader_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
    const ctx = { me: me, seasonId: seasonId, currentName: s_(playerRow.DisplayName) };

    const saved = [], refused = [], audit = [];
    const playerUpdates = [], seasonUpdates = [];

    // Anything the caller named that is not on a registry is refused by name.
    // Silence here would read as success, and the player would keep typing into
    // a field that goes nowhere.
    const known = {};
    PROFILE.PLAYER_FIELDS.concat(profileSeasonFields_()).forEach(function (f) {
      known[f.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
      known[f.col.toLowerCase()] = true;
    });
    Object.keys(patch).forEach(function (k) {
      const lower = String(k).toLowerCase();
      if (known[lower]) return;
      if (PROFILE.NEVER[lower]) { refused.push(k + ': ' + PROFILE.NEVER[lower]); return; }
      if (SUM_FIELDS.indexOf(String(k)) >= 0 || CONFIG.DERIVED_FIELDS.indexOf(String(k)) >= 0) {
        refused.push(k + ': stats are never edited here — file a correction instead.');
        return;
      }
      refused.push(k + ': not a field you can edit.');
    });

    const out = { saved: saved, refused: refused, audit: audit,
                  renamedFrom: '', renamedTo: '', rosterTouched: false };

    PROFILE.PLAYER_FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
      profileApplyField_(f, playerRow, playerHead, CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS,
                        playerUpdates, patch, ctx, out);
    });

    profileSeasonFields_().forEach(function (f) {
      const raw = (patch[f.key] !== undefined) ? patch[f.key] : patch[f.col];
      if (raw === undefined) return;
      if (!seasonRow) {
        refused.push(f.key + ': you have no ' + seasonId + ' roster row yet. Your coach ' +
                     'adds you to the roster, then this can be edited.');
        return;
      }
      profileApplyField_(f, seasonRow, seasonHead, CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS,
                        seasonUpdates, patch, ctx, out);
    });

    const renamedFrom = out.renamedFrom, renamedTo = out.renamedTo;

    if (playerUpdates.length) {
      // stamped only when something else on the row actually moved, so the
      // column keeps meaning "last edited" rather than "last opened"
      if (playerHead.indexOf('UpdatedAt') >= 0)
        playerUpdates.push({ row: playerRow.__row, field: 'UpdatedAt', value: new Date() });
      if (playerHead.indexOf('UpdatedBy') >= 0)
        playerUpdates.push({ row: playerRow.__row, field: 'UpdatedBy', value: me.email });
      updateCells_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS, playerUpdates);
    }
    if (seasonUpdates.length) updateCells_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS, seasonUpdates);

    if (audit.length) { ensureOpsTabs_(); appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, audit); }

    if (renamedTo) {
      // A rename passes the surname guard and is still the single most abusable
      // edit on the page, so the people who could spot a wrong one are told
      // rather than left to find it in the log.
      appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, [auditRow_(me, 'PROFILE_RENAME', 'Player', me.playerId,
        'DisplayName', renamedFrom, renamedTo, 'self-service rename by ' + me.email)]);
      // the audit row is the record; nobody is mailed about a rename
    }

    if (out.rosterTouched) {
      CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot', 'ac-' + seasonId]);
      // a rebuild is not run inline — profiles are edited in bursts the week a
      // season opens, and the sweep trigger collapses a burst into one recompute
      markDirty_('roster');
    }

    return { ok: refused.length === 0, saved: saved, refused: refused };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

// ── corrections ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Queue mail for later delivery, in ONE write.
 *
 * queueNotifications() in Accounts.gs stamps every row EntityType 'Account'; a
 * correction is not an account, and the review queue reads that column to find
 * what a message is about. Same table, same discipline, one parameter more.
 * Nothing here sends: delivery has its own quota and its own failure modes, and
 * a bounced message must never roll back a correction that was already filed.
 * Must be called under the script lock — it allocates ids.
 */
function profileQueueNotifications_(recipients, kind, subject, body, entityType, entityId, teamId) {
  const to = (recipients || []).filter(function (e) { return !!s_(e); });
  if (!to.length || !hasTab_(ACCT.NOTIFY)) return 0;
  acctAssertHeaders_(ACCT.NOTIFY, ACCT.NOTIFY_COLS);

  // one allocation for the batch; appendRows would otherwise force a fresh read
  // of the whole tab for every single recipient
  var n = parseInt(nextIdLocked_(ACCT.NOTIFY, 'NotificationID', 'NTF-', 6)
                     .replace(/\D/g, ''), 10);
  const now = new Date();
  return appendRows_(ACCT.NOTIFY, to.map(function (e) {
    var seq = String(n++);
    while (seq.length < 6) seq = '0' + seq;
    return {
      NotificationID: 'NTF-' + seq, ToEmail: s_(e), Kind: kind, Subject: subject,
      Body: body, EntityType: entityType, EntityID: s_(entityId), TeamID: s_(teamId),
      CreatedAt: now, SentAt: '', Status: 'QUEUED'
    };
  }));
}

/**
 * What the database currently holds for this player, field and game.
 *
 * Read from the sheet rather than believed from the client. The client's idea of
 * the current value is what he saw on a cached page; the coach reviewing this
 * needs the number that is actually stored, and a mismatch between the two is
 * itself worth telling him about.
 *
 * Returns '' when nothing is on file. Blank is not zero: "we never recorded a
 * tackle for him" and "he made none" are different claims, and a correction that
 * flattened the first into the second would be a correction that lied.
 */
function profileCurrentStat_(playerId, seasonId, gameId, field) {
  if (gameId) {
    var total = null;
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS).forEach(function (r) {
      if (s_(r.PlayerID) !== playerId || s_(r.GameID) !== gameId) return;
      if (s_(r.grain || r.Grain) !== CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME) return;   // SEASON_REF is never summed
      const v = numOrNull_(r[field]);
      if (v === null) return;
      total = (total === null ? 0 : total) + v;
    });
    return total === null ? '' : total;
  }

  if (!hasTab_('PlayerSeasonStats')) return '';
  const row = rowsOf_('PlayerSeasonStats').filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.PlayerID) === playerId && s_(r.SeasonID) === seasonId;
  })[0];
  if (!row) return '';
  const v = numOrNull_(row[field]);
  return v === null ? '' : v;
}

/**
 * A stat a player believes is wrong.
 *
 *   payload { seasonId, gameId|null, field, currentValue, proposedValue, reason }
 *
 * Nothing is changed. A row is written PENDING and the people who can decide are
 * told, with enough in the message — season, week, opponent, field, what is on
 * file, what he says it should be, and why — that a coach can act on it without
 * going looking for the rest.
 *
 * Only the atoms in SUM_FIELDS can be disputed. A derived figure is computed on
 * read from those atoms, so "my completion percentage is wrong" is really a
 * claim about attempts or completions, and correcting the derived number would
 * store something the next rebuild throws away.
 */
function apiRequestCorrection_(payload) {
  const me = profileWhoami_();
  payload = payload || {};

  const seasonId = s_(payload.seasonId) || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  const gameId = s_(payload.gameId);
  const field = s_(payload.field);

  if (!field) throw new Error('Which stat?');
  if (CONFIG.DERIVED_FIELDS.indexOf(field) >= 0)
    throw new Error(field + ' is worked out from the numbers behind it and is never ' +
                    'stored. Correct the attempts, yards or completions instead.');
  if (SUM_FIELDS.indexOf(field) < 0)
    throw new Error('"' + field + '" is not a stat this database keeps.');

  const known = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.SEASONS).some(function (x) {
    return s_(x.SeasonID) === seasonId;
  });
  if (!known) throw new Error('Unknown season "' + seasonId + '".');

  // The roster row is what proves this is his own stat line, and it is where the
  // team comes from — the client never gets to name a team.
  const mine = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.PlayerID) === me.playerId && s_(r.SeasonID) === seasonId;
  })[0];
  if (!mine)
    throw new Error('You have no roster row for ' + seasonId + ', so there is nothing ' +
                    'of yours to correct in it.');
  const teamId = s_(mine.TeamID);

  var gameNote = '';
  if (gameId) {
    const g = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).filter(function (x) { return s_(x.GameID) === gameId; })[0];
    if (!g) throw new Error('Unknown game "' + gameId + '".');
    if (s_(g.SeasonID) !== seasonId)
      throw new Error('Game ' + gameId + ' is not in ' + seasonId + '.');
    if (s_(g.HomeTeamID) !== teamId && s_(g.AwayTeamID) !== teamId)
      throw new Error('Your team did not play in game ' + gameId + '.');
    const home = s_(g.HomeTeamID) === teamId;
    gameNote = 'Week ' + (num_(g.Week) === null ? '?' : num_(g.Week)) + ', ' +
               (home ? 'vs ' : 'at ') +
               (home ? (s_(g.AwayTeamName) || s_(g.AwayTeamID))
                     : (s_(g.HomeTeamName) || s_(g.HomeTeamID)));
  }

  // Blank is a legitimate proposal: "this was never reported" is a different and
  // often truer claim than "this was zero".
  const rawProposed = payload.proposedValue;
  var proposed = '';
  if (!(rawProposed === '' || rawProposed === null || rawProposed === undefined)) {
    const n = numOrNull_(rawProposed);
    if (n === null) throw new Error('"' + rawProposed + '" is not a number.');
    if (n < -1000 || n > 1000)
      throw new Error('A ' + field + ' of ' + n + ' is not a plausible correction.');
    if (n * 2 !== Math.round(n * 2))
      throw new Error('Stats are whole numbers, or halves for sacks and tackles for loss.');
    proposed = n;
  }

  const reason = profileText_(payload.reason, PROFILE.REASON_MAX);
  if (reason.length < PROFILE.REASON_MIN)
    throw new Error('Say what happened, in at least ' + PROFILE.REASON_MIN +
                    ' characters. A coach has to be able to check it.');

  const onFile = profileCurrentStat_(me.playerId, seasonId, gameId, field);
  if (profileSame_(onFile, proposed))
    throw new Error('The database already holds ' +
                    (onFile === '' ? 'no value' : onFile) + ' for that. Nothing to change.');

  // What he was looking at, when it is not what is stored. Usually a cached page
  // or a season total where he meant one game, and the coach should know which.
  const claimed = payload.currentValue;
  const stale = !(claimed === undefined) && !profileSame_(claimed, onFile)
    ? '\nHe reported seeing "' + s_(claimed) + '", which is not what is on file.' : '';

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS)) throw new Error('Busy — try again.');

  try {
    ensureOpsTabs_();
    delete __tableCache[CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS];
    acctAssertHeaders_(CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS, PROFILE.CORRECTION_COLS);

    const existing = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS).filter(function (r) {
      return s_(r.PlayerID) === me.playerId && profileCorrectionStatus_(r) === 'PENDING';
    });
    if (existing.length >= PROFILE.OPEN_CORRECTION_CAP)
      throw new Error('You already have ' + existing.length + ' corrections waiting. ' +
                      'Wait for those to be reviewed before filing more.');

    const duplicate = existing.some(function (r) {
      return s_(r.Field) === field && s_(r.SeasonID) === seasonId && s_(r.GameID) === gameId;
    });
    if (duplicate)
      throw new Error('You already have a correction waiting for ' + field +
                      (gameId ? ' in that game.' : ' in ' + seasonId + '.'));

    const correctionId = nextIdLocked_(CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS, 'CorrectionID', 'CORR-', 6);

    appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS, [{
      CorrectionID: correctionId,
      // PlayerGameStats carries no StatID column, so there is no id to put here.
      // The row is identified by GameID + PlayerID + Field, which is exactly what
      // the reviewer searches on. A made-up id would only look authoritative.
      StatID: '',
      GameID: gameId,
      PlayerID: me.playerId,
      Field: field,
      OldValue: onFile,
      NewValue: proposed,
      CorrectedBy: me.email,
      Role: me.role,
      CorrectedAt: new Date(),
      Reason: reason,
      Status: 'PENDING',
      ReviewedBy: '',
      ReviewedAt: '',
      SeasonID: seasonId,
      TeamID: teamId
    }]);

    appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, [auditRow_(me, 'CORRECTION_REQUEST', 'StatCorrection',
      correctionId, field, onFile, proposed,
      seasonId + (gameId ? ' ' + gameId : '') + ' — ' + reason)]);

    /* The coaches ARE mailed, with links that settle it from the inbox.
       (CorrectionMail.gs. The badge alone was the notification once, on the
       theory that forty emails a week is how all forty get ignored — but a
       school whose coach has no account had no badge to look at either, and
       those requests sat until somebody made a phone call. One email that can
       be answered in one click is the smaller cost.) Never throws: a
       correction that is filed and not mailed is still filed. */
    if (typeof corrNotifyCoaches_ === 'function') corrNotifyCoaches_(correctionId);

    /* The owner reads every filing in the morning email, with the links that
       settle it. No note per filing: the day's hundred messages are for codes. */

    return { ok: true, correctionId: correctionId };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/** Blank is not approved. An unfilled Status is a correction nobody reviewed. */
function profileCorrectionStatus_(row) {
  const v = s_(row && row.Status).toUpperCase();
  return v || 'PENDING';
}

/**
 * The caller's own corrections, newest first — filed, decided and all.
 * A player who cannot see what happened to his dispute files it again.
 */
function apiMyCorrections_() {
  const me = profileWhoami_();
  if (!hasTab_(CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS)) return [];

  const games = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES), function (g) { return s_(g.GameID); });

  return rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.CORRECTIONS).filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.PlayerID) === me.playerId;
  }).map(function (r) {
    const g = games[s_(r.GameID)] || {};
    return {
      correctionId: s_(r.CorrectionID),
      seasonId: s_(r.SeasonID),
      gameId: s_(r.GameID),
      week: num_(g.Week),
      field: s_(r.Field),
      // blank travels as null, never as 0 — the page must be able to print
      // "not reported" rather than a number nobody recorded
      oldValue: num_(r.OldValue),
      newValue: num_(r.NewValue),
      reason: s_(r.Reason),
      status: profileCorrectionStatus_(r),
      reviewedBy: s_(r.ReviewedBy),
      reviewedAt: (r.ReviewedAt instanceof Date) ? r.ReviewedAt.toISOString() : s_(r.ReviewedAt),
      createdAt: (r.CorrectedAt instanceof Date) ? r.CorrectedAt.toISOString() : s_(r.CorrectedAt)
    };
  }).sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? 1 : (a.createdAt > b.createdAt ? -1 : 0);
  });
}

// ── delivery ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** An address MailApp could conceivably deliver to. */
function profileMailable_(email) {
  return /^[^@\s,;<>]+@[^@\s,;<>]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$/.test(String(email || '').trim());
}

/**
 * Send whatever is queued in Notifications and mark it SENT.
 *
 * Call this from the sweep, NOT from inside runRebuild() — that function already
 * holds the script lock and LockService locks are not reentrant, so a nested call
 * would block on itself for the full timeout and then give up.
 *
 * Each row is marked the instant its message goes out rather than in one batch at
 * the end. A batched write that never lands because the execution timed out would
 * re-send every message in the batch on the next sweep, and the people on the
 * receiving end of that are coaches.
 *
 * Failures are not retried into oblivion. A send that fails for a reason that
 * might pass later — quota, a transient Google error — is left PENDING and the
 * reason goes to the AuditLog, where somebody can read it. An address that is not
 * an address can never succeed, so it is marked FAILED once instead of consuming
 * a slot in every sweep from now until someone notices.
 */
function sendPendingNotifications_(limit) {
  if (!hasTab_(ACCT.NOTIFY)) return 'No ' + ACCT.NOTIFY + ' tab — nothing to send.';

  const head = tabHeader_(ACCT.NOTIFY);
  const need = ['NotificationID', 'ToEmail', 'Subject', 'Body', 'SentAt', 'Status'];
  const missing = need.filter(function (h) { return head.indexOf(h) < 0; });
  // A trigger that throws mails the owner a stack trace every fifteen minutes.
  // Report it and stop.
  if (missing.length)
    return ACCT.NOTIFY + ' is missing column(s): ' + missing.join(', ') +
           '. Run ensureSchema_(). Nothing sent.';

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) return 'another delivery is already running — skipped';

  try {
    delete __tableCache[ACCT.NOTIFY];
    const queued = rowsOf_(ACCT.NOTIFY).filter(function (r) {
      const st = s_(r.Status).toUpperCase();
      return (st === 'QUEUED' || st === 'PENDING' || st === '') && !s_(r.SentAt);
    });
    if (!queued.length) return 'nothing queued';

    var quota = 0;
    try {
      quota = MailApp.getRemainingDailyQuota();
    } catch (e) {
      return 'mail quota unreadable (' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e) + ') — ' +
             queued.length + ' left queued';
    }
    if (quota <= PROFILE.MAIL_RESERVE)
      return 'remaining mail quota (' + quota + ') is reserved for sign-in codes — ' +
             queued.length + ' left queued, retried next sweep';

    const budget = Math.min(queued.length, quota - PROFILE.MAIL_RESERVE,
                            limit || PROFILE.MAIL_BATCH);
    const me = { email: 'system', role: 'SYSTEM' };
    const failures = [];
    var sent = 0, failed = 0, stopped = '';

    for (var i = 0; i < budget; i++) {
      const r = queued[i];
      const to = s_(r.ToEmail);
      const id = s_(r.NotificationID);

      if (!profileMailable_(to)) {
        updateCells_(ACCT.NOTIFY, [{ row: r.__row, field: 'Status', value: 'FAILED' }]);
        failures.push(auditRow_(me, 'NOTIFY_FAILED', 'Notification', id, 'Status',
          s_(r.Status), 'FAILED', '"' + to + '" is not a deliverable address'));
        failed++;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        MailApp.sendEmail({
          to: to,
          subject: s_(r.Subject) || 'UCBAC Stats',
          body: s_(r.Body) + '\n\n— UCBAC Stats. This message was sent automatically; ' +
                'replies to it are not read.',
          name: 'UCBAC Stats'
        });
      } catch (e) {
        const why = (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)).slice(0, 240);
        updateCells_(ACCT.NOTIFY, [{ row: r.__row, field: 'Status', value: 'PENDING' }]);
        failures.push(auditRow_(me, 'NOTIFY_DEFERRED', 'Notification', id, 'Status',
          s_(r.Status), 'PENDING', why));
        Logger.log('sendPendingNotifications: ' + id + ' deferred — ' + why);

        // Once the quota is gone every remaining send fails the same way, and
        // each attempt costs an execution second for nothing.
        if (/quota|too many times|limit/i.test(why)) {
          stopped = 'stopped at the daily quota';
          break;
        }
        continue;
      }

      updateCells_(ACCT.NOTIFY, [
        { row: r.__row, field: 'Status', value: 'SENT' },
        { row: r.__row, field: 'SentAt', value: new Date() }
      ]);
      sent++;
    }

    if (failures.length) { ensureOpsTabs_(); appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, failures); }

    const left = queued.length - sent - failed;
    const msg = 'sent ' + sent + ', ' + failed + ' undeliverable, ' + left + ' left queued' +
                (stopped ? ' (' + stopped + ')' : '') +
                '. Quota remaining: ' + Math.max(0, quota - sent) + '.';
    Logger.log('sendPendingNotifications: ' + msg);
    return msg;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

===== src/RepairPlayerIds.js =====
/* historical record comment removed */

function _rpNorm_(s_) {
  return String(s_ === null || s_ === undefined ? '' : s_)
    .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
}

/** Build the collision plan without touching anything. */
function _rpPlan_() {
  const players = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);

  const byId = {};
  players.forEach(function (p) {
    const id = String(p.PlayerID || '').trim();
    if (!id) return;
    (byId[id] = byId[id] || []).push(String(p.DisplayName || '').trim());
  });

  var maxId = 0;
  Object.keys(byId).forEach(function (id) {
    const m = id.match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
    if (m) maxId = Math.max(maxId, parseInt(m[1], 10));
  });

  const collisions = {};
  Object.keys(byId).forEach(function (id) {
    const names = byId[id].filter(function (n, i, a) { return n && a.indexOf(n) === i; });
    if (names.length > 1) collisions[id] = names;
  });

  // The first name listed keeps the original ID; every later name is renumbered.
  const assign = {};                       // oldId -> { name -> newId }
  var next = maxId;
  Object.keys(collisions).sort().forEach(function (id) {
    assign[id] = {};
    collisions[id].forEach(function (name, i) {
      if (i === 0) { assign[id][name] = id; return; }
      next++;
      var s_ = String(next);
      while (s_.length < 6) s_ = '0' + s_;
      assign[id][name] = 'PLY-' + s_;
    });
  });

  return { collisions: collisions, assign: assign, maxId: maxId, nextAfter: next };
}

/** Strip suffixes and split into comparable name parts. */
function _rpParts_(s_) {
  const toks = String(s_ === null || s_ === undefined ? '' : s_)
    .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z\s]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/)
    .filter(function (t) { return t && ['jr', 'sr', 'ii', 'iii', 'iv'].indexOf(t) < 0; });
  if (!toks.length) return { first: '', last: '', all: '' };
  return { first: toks[0], last: toks[toks.length - 1], all: toks.join('') };
}

/**
 * Which name in `names` does this raw string refer to? '' when undecidable.
 * Walks the same ladder the import adapter uses: exact, then surname plus first
 * initial, then a surname prefix. A tie at any rung is left unresolved rather
 * than guessed — a wrong attribution here silently invents a career.
 */
function _rpResolve_(raw, names) {
  const r = _rpParts_(raw);
  if (!r.all) return '';
  const cand = names.map(function (n) { return { name: n, p: _rpParts_(n) }; });

  var hit = cand.filter(function (c) { return c.p.all === r.all; });
  if (hit.length === 1) return hit[0].name;

  // surname must agree, either outright or as a prefix ("kirby" / "kirbye")
  const surOk = cand.filter(function (c) {
    const a = c.p.last, b = r.last;
    if (!a || !b) return false;
    return a === b || (a.length >= 4 && b.length >= 4 &&
                       (a.indexOf(b) === 0 || b.indexOf(a) === 0));
  });
  if (surOk.length === 1) return surOk[0].name;

  // same surname on both sides — separate them on the first name or its initial
  if (surOk.length > 1) {
    hit = surOk.filter(function (c) {
      const a = c.p.first, b = r.first;
      if (!a || !b) return false;
      return a === b || a.indexOf(b) === 0 || b.indexOf(a) === 0 || a[0] === b[0];
    });
    if (hit.length === 1) return hit[0].name;
  }
  return '';
}

function repairPlayerIdsDryRun_() { return _rpRun_(false); }
function repairPlayerIdsApply_()  { return _rpRun_(true); }

function _rpRun_(apply) {
  const plan = _rpPlan_();
  const ids = Object.keys(plan.collisions);
  if (!ids.length) return 'No PlayerID collisions found. Nothing to repair.';

  const log = [];
  log.push((apply ? 'APPLYING' : 'DRY RUN — nothing will be written') + '\n');
  log.push('Colliding PlayerIDs: ' + ids.length);
  log.push('Highest existing ID: PLY-' + plan.maxId + '  ->  new IDs run to PLY-' + plan.nextAfter);

  // ── PlayerGameStats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const statSheet = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS);
  const stats = statSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const sh = stats[0].map(String);
  const cPid = sh.indexOf('PlayerID'), cRaw = sh.indexOf('player_raw');
  if (cPid < 0 || cRaw < 0) throw new Error('PlayerGameStats is missing PlayerID or player_raw.');

  var moved = 0, kept = 0;
  const unresolved = [];
  const statCol = [];
  for (var i = 1; i < stats.length; i++) {
    const id = String(stats[i][cPid] || '').trim();
    const map = plan.assign[id];
    if (!map) { statCol.push([stats[i][cPid]]); continue; }
    const name = _rpResolve_(stats[i][cRaw], plan.collisions[id]);
    if (!name) {
      unresolved.push('  row ' + (i + 1) + '  ' + id + '  raw="' + stats[i][cRaw] +
                      '"  candidates: ' + plan.collisions[id].join(' | '));
      statCol.push([stats[i][cPid]]);
      continue;
    }
    const newId = map[name];
    if (newId !== id) moved++; else kept++;
    statCol.push([newId]);
  }
  log.push('\nPlayerGameStats: ' + kept + ' rows keep their ID, ' + moved +
           ' rows move to a new ID, ' + unresolved.length + ' unresolved.');

  // ── PlayerSeasons ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const psSheet = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
  const ps = psSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const ph = ps[0].map(String);
  const pPid = ph.indexOf('PlayerID'), pName = ph.indexOf('DisplayName'),
        pSeason = ph.indexOf('SeasonID');

  // Two thirds of PlayerSeasons rows carry no name. They are attributed from the
  // stat rows just split above: which season, and which team, each new ID landed
  // on. Team is the stronger signal — colliding players are almost always at
  // different schools.
  const pTeam = ph.indexOf('TeamID');
  const cStatSeason = sh.indexOf('SeasonID'), cStatTeam = sh.indexOf('TeamID');
  const seasonOf = {}, teamOf = {};
  for (var j = 1; j < stats.length; j++) {
    const nid = statCol[j - 1][0];
    if (!nid) continue;
    (seasonOf[nid] = seasonOf[nid] || {})[String(stats[j][cStatSeason] || '')] = true;
    if (cStatTeam >= 0)
      (teamOf[nid] = teamOf[nid] || {})[String(stats[j][cStatTeam] || '')] = true;
  }

  var psMoved = 0; const psUnresolved = [];
  const psCol = [];
  for (var k = 1; k < ps.length; k++) {
    const id = String(ps[k][pPid] || '').trim();
    const map = plan.assign[id];
    if (!map) { psCol.push([ps[k][pPid]]); continue; }
    var name = pName >= 0 ? _rpResolve_(ps[k][pName], plan.collisions[id]) : '';

    if (!name) {
      const season = pSeason >= 0 ? String(ps[k][pSeason] || '') : '';
      const team   = pTeam   >= 0 ? String(ps[k][pTeam]   || '') : '';
      var cands = Object.keys(map);
      if (season) cands = cands.filter(function (nm) {
        const nid = map[nm];
        return seasonOf[nid] && seasonOf[nid][season];
      });
      if (cands.length > 1 && team) cands = cands.filter(function (nm) {
        const nid = map[nm];
        return teamOf[nid] && teamOf[nid][team];
      });
      if (cands.length === 1) name = cands[0];
    }
    if (!name) {
      psUnresolved.push('  row ' + (k + 1) + '  ' + id + '  season=' +
        (pSeason >= 0 ? ps[k][pSeason] : '?') + '  team=' +
        (pTeam >= 0 ? ps[k][pTeam] : '?') + '  candidates: ' + plan.collisions[id].join(' | '));
      psCol.push([ps[k][pPid]]);
      continue;
    }
    if (map[name] !== id) psMoved++;
    psCol.push([map[name]]);
  }
  log.push('PlayerSeasons:   ' + psMoved + ' rows move to a new ID, ' +
           psUnresolved.length + ' unresolved.');

  // ── Players ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const plSheet = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  const pl = plSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const lh = pl[0].map(String);
  const lPid = lh.indexOf('PlayerID'), lName = lh.indexOf('DisplayName');
  const plCol = [];
  const usedName = {};
  for (var q = 1; q < pl.length; q++) {
    const id = String(pl[q][lPid] || '').trim();
    const map = plan.assign[id];
    if (!map) { plCol.push([pl[q][lPid]]); continue; }
    const nm = String(pl[q][lName] || '').trim();
    plCol.push([map[nm] !== undefined ? map[nm] : pl[q][lPid]]);
    usedName[id + '|' + nm] = true;
  }

  if (unresolved.length) log.push('\nUNRESOLVED PlayerGameStats rows:\n' + unresolved.slice(0, 40).join('\n') +
    (unresolved.length > 40 ? '\n  ...and ' + (unresolved.length - 40) + ' more' : ''));
  if (psUnresolved.length) log.push('\nUNRESOLVED PlayerSeasons rows:\n' + psUnresolved.slice(0, 40).join('\n') +
    (psUnresolved.length > 40 ? '\n  ...and ' + (psUnresolved.length - 40) + ' more' : ''));

  if (!apply) {
    log.push('\nNothing was written. Review the unresolved rows above, then run ' +
             'repairPlayerIdsApply_().');
    const out = log.join('\n');
    Logger.log(out);
    return out;
  }

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS)) throw new Error('Database busy — try again.');
  try {
    if (statCol.length) statSheet.getRange(2, cPid + 1, statCol.length, 1).setValues(statCol);
    if (psCol.length)   psSheet.getRange(2, pPid + 1, psCol.length, 1).setValues(psCol);
    if (plCol.length)   plSheet.getRange(2, lPid + 1, plCol.length, 1).setValues(plCol);
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }

  __tableCache = {};
  CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot']);
  log.push('\nWritten. Now run rebuildDerived_() — every career and season total ' +
           'computed before this repair was built on merged identities.');
  const out = log.join('\n');
  Logger.log(out);
  return out;
}


===== src/ResolveStats.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — ResolveStats.gs
 *
 * Thirty percent of the imported stat rows never resolved to a PlayerID — the
 * source workbooks spelled names one way and the rosters another. Those rows
 * still count in team totals (keyed on the raw name), but the PLAYER pages and
 * player leaderboards can only show rows that name a player, so every one of
 * them is a player "missing" from a leaderboard he earned a place on.
 *
 * Two passes, both menu-driven with a dry run:
 *
 *   RESOLVE — attach orphaned rows to players who already exist. Three tiers,
 *   each exact and each accepted only when it matches exactly ONE player:
 *     1. the whole normalized name  ("aaron dixon" = "Aaron Dixon")
 *     2. first + last token, same team  ("Jaxon Simms" = 'Jaxon "JJ" Simms')
 *     3. first initial + last token, same team  ("G. Johnson" = Gary Johnson)
 *   Anything matching two players is left alone and listed — guessing between
 *   two boys with one name attributes one boy's season to the other.
 *
 *   CREATE — for raw names that match nobody, create the player and seat him
 *   for the seasons his rows cover. These are mostly 2024 players who predate
 *   every imported roster. Some will be misspellings of players who do exist
 *   ("Cole Lindeblad" / "Cole Lindelad"); creating them makes their production
 *   visible today, and the merge tool folds a misspelling into the real career
 *   the day somebody spots it. Invisible production helps nobody.
 */

function resolveStatsDryRun_()  { return resolveStatsRun_(false); }
function resolveStatsApply_()   { return resolveStatsRun_(true); }
function menuResolveStatsDry()   { return rsAlert_(resolveStatsRun_(false)); }
function menuResolveStatsApply() { return rsAlert_(resolveStatsRun_(true)); }
function rsAlert_(msg) {
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Resolve stat rows',
      msg.length > 6000 ? msg.slice(0, 6000) + '\n\n…full report in View > Logs' : msg,
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
  } catch (e) {}
  return msg;
}

const RS_SUFFIX = { jr: 1, sr: 1, ii: 1, iii: 1, iv: 1, v: 1 };

function rsToks_(v) {
  return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v)
    .toLowerCase().replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, ' ').replace(/[^a-z ]/g, ' ')
    .split(/\s+/).filter(function (t) { return t && !RS_SUFFIX[t]; });
}

/**
 * Lines in a box score that are not a person.
 *
 * A scorer who has written down six carries by name and still owes forty
 * yards puts the difference on a line called "Rest of team". It is real
 * production and it already counts in the team totals, which are keyed on
 * the raw name rather than on a PlayerID. But there is nobody behind it.
 *
 * The resolver's CREATE pass exists to make invisible production visible, on
 * the reasoning that a name matching nobody is a player who predates the
 * rosters. That reasoning does not hold here: creating "Rest of team" would
 * seat a fiction on a roster, and from there it would appear on a team page
 * and rank on a leaderboard against boys who exist. So these are left where
 * they are, counted and named, and never created.
 */
const RS_NOT_A_PERSON = {
  'team': 1, 'team total': 1, 'team totals': 1, 'total': 1, 'totals': 1,
  'other': 1, 'others': 1, 'unknown': 1, 'unlisted': 1, 'misc': 1,
  'miscellaneous': 1, 'various': 1, 'bench': 1, 'reserves': 1,
  'opponent': 1, 'opponents': 1, 'scramble': 1, 'scrambles': 1,
  'n a': 1, 'none': 1, 'tbd': 1
};
function rsNotAPerson_(raw) {
  const key = rsToks_(raw).join(' ');
  if (!key) return true;
  if (RS_NOT_A_PERSON[key]) return true;
  // "rest of team", "rest of the squad", "team rushing", "team passing"
  return /^rest of\b/.test(key) || /^team\b/.test(key);
}

/**
 * The rows two boys could equally own, named.
 *
 * "Left alone, two players share the name: 33" is true and useless — it says
 * work remains without saying what. Every one of these needs a person who
 * knows the teams to decide, and the only thing that makes that possible is
 * seeing the stat row's own team and season next to both candidates and
 * theirs. Usually one candidate never played for that school, and the answer
 * is obvious the moment the two are side by side.
 */
function rsCollisionReport_(collisions, nameOf, teamOf) {
  const keys = Object.keys(collisions);
  if (!keys.length) return [];
  const named = function (tid) {
    if (!tid || tid === '?') return 'no team';
    return (typeof teamNameOf_ === 'function' ? teamNameOf_(tid) : '') || tid;
  };
  const list = keys.map(function (k) { return collisions[k]; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return b.rows - a.rows; });

  const out = ['', 'Names two players share — each needs somebody to decide:'];
  list.forEach(function (c) {
    const seats = Object.keys(c.seats).map(function (s) {
      const p = s.split('|');
      return named(p[1]) + ' ' + String(p[0]).replace('SEA-', '');
    }).sort();
    out.push('  ' + c.raw + ' — ' + c.rows + ' row' + (c.rows === 1 ? '' : 's') +
             ' on ' + (seats.join(', ') || 'no team'));
    Object.keys(c.pids).forEach(function (pid) {
      const teams = Object.keys(teamOf[pid] || {}).filter(Boolean).map(named);
      out.push('      ' + pid + '  ' + (nameOf[pid] || '(no name)') +
               '  — ' + (teams.join(', ') || 'never seated'));
    });
  });
  out.push('  Settle one by putting the PlayerID into the row\'s PlayerID cell.');
  return out;
}

function resolveStatsRun_(apply) {
  const players = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  const teamOf = {};                       // pid -> {teamId:true} across seasons
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).forEach(function (r) {
    const pid = String(r.PlayerID || '').trim();
    if (pid) (teamOf[pid] = teamOf[pid] || {})[String(r.TeamID || '').trim()] = true;
  });

  // the three candidate indexes
  const byExact = {}, byFL = {}, byIL = {};
  const nameOf = {};                       // pid -> DisplayName, for the report
  function add(map, key, pid) { (map[key] = map[key] || {})[pid] = true; }
  players.forEach(function (p) {
    const t = rsToks_(p.DisplayName);
    if (!t.length) return;
    const pid = String(p.PlayerID);
    nameOf[pid] = String(p.DisplayName || '').trim();
    add(byExact, t.join(' '), pid);
    if (t.length >= 2) {
      add(byFL, t[0] + '|' + t[t.length - 1], pid);
      add(byIL, t[0].charAt(0) + '|' + t[t.length - 1], pid);
    }
  });

  function inTeam(set, teamId) {
    return Object.keys(set || {}).filter(function (pid) {
      return (teamOf[pid] || {})[teamId];
    });
  }

  /* Which of the shared names are held by a record with nothing behind it.
     Only names two or more records answer to are worth the lookup. */
  const inert = {};
  (function () {
    if (typeof _mpHoldings_ !== 'function') return;    // MergePlayers.gs
    const shared = [];
    Object.keys(byExact).forEach(function (k) {
      const ids = Object.keys(byExact[k]);
      if (ids.length > 1) ids.forEach(function (p) { shared.push(p); });
    });
    if (!shared.length) return;
    const held = _mpHoldings_(shared);
    shared.forEach(function (p) {
      if (!Object.keys(held[p] || {}).length) inert[p] = true;
    });
  })();

  /**
   * Candidates worth considering.
   *
   * Thirty-one Players rows share a name with somebody and hold nothing at
   * all — no roster seat in any season, no stat row, no account, no award, no
   * correction, no history. There is no career behind such a record and
   * nobody can sign in as it, so it cannot be the owner of a stat line. But
   * it counted as a second candidate, and two candidates is zero candidates,
   * so its namesake's rows were unresolvable for as long as it existed.
   *
   * Ignoring it decides nothing about who the row belongs to. It removes a
   * possibility that was never real. If EVERY candidate is empty the
   * ambiguity stands, because then there is no better answer either.
   */
  function live(set) {
    const ids = Object.keys(set || {});
    const kept = ids.filter(function (p) { return !inert[p]; });
    return kept.length ? kept : ids;
  }

  /** One PlayerID or ''. Never a guess: two candidates is zero candidates. */
  function resolve(raw, teamId) {
    const t = rsToks_(raw);
    if (!t.length) return '';
    const exact = live(byExact[t.join(' ')]);
    if (exact.length === 1) return exact[0];
    if (exact.length > 1) {
      const here = inTeam(byExact[t.join(' ')], teamId).filter(function (p) { return !inert[p]; });
      return here.length === 1 ? here[0] : '';
    }
    if (t.length < 2) return '';
    const fl = inTeam(byFL[t[0] + '|' + t[t.length - 1]], teamId);
    if (fl.length === 1) return fl[0];
    const il = inTeam(byIL[t[0].charAt(0) + '|' + t[t.length - 1]], teamId);
    if (il.length === 1) return il[0];
    return '';
  }

  // sweep the orphans
  const sh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS);
  const values = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const head = values[0].map(String);
  const cPid = head.indexOf('PlayerID'), cRaw = head.indexOf('player_raw'),
        cTeam = head.indexOf('TeamID'), cSeason = head.indexOf('SeasonID');
  if (cPid < 0 || cRaw < 0)
    throw new Error(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS + ' is missing PlayerID or player_raw.');

  var attached = 0, ambiguous = 0, notPeople = 0;
  const notPersonNames = {};               // norm -> raw, for the report
  /* The rows nobody can resolve without knowing the boys. Naming the two
     candidates turns "33 rows left alone" from a dead end into a short list
     somebody with the roster in front of him can actually finish. */
  const collisions = {};                   // norm -> {raw, rows, pids, seats:{}}
  const unmatched = {};                    // norm -> {raw, rows, seasons:{sid:{teamId}}}
  const fills = [];                        // {row, pid}
  for (var r = 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    if (String(values[r][cPid] || '').trim()) continue;
    const raw = String(values[r][cRaw] || '').trim();
    if (!raw) continue;
    if (rsNotAPerson_(raw)) {              // a bucket line, not a boy
      notPeople++;
      notPersonNames[rsToks_(raw).join(' ')] = raw;
      continue;
    }
    const teamId = String(values[r][cTeam] || '').trim();
    const pid = resolve(raw, teamId);
    if (pid) { fills.push({ row: r, pid: pid }); attached++; continue; }

    const t = rsToks_(raw);
    const key = t.join(' ');
    const realCandidates = live(byExact[key]);
    const anyExact = realCandidates.length;
    if (anyExact > 1) {
      ambiguous++;
      const still = {};
      realCandidates.forEach(function (p) { still[p] = true; });
      const c = collisions[key] ||
                (collisions[key] = { raw: raw, rows: 0, pids: still, seats: {} });
      c.rows++;
      const sid0 = String(values[r][cSeason] || '').trim();
      if (sid0 || teamId) c.seats[(sid0 || '?') + '|' + (teamId || '?')] = true;
      continue;
    }

    const u = unmatched[key] || (unmatched[key] = { raw: raw, rows: 0, seats: {} });
    u.rows++;
    const sid = String(values[r][cSeason] || '').trim();
    if (sid && teamId) u.seats[sid + '|' + teamId] = true;
  }

  const unmatchedList = Object.keys(unmatched).map(function (k) { return unmatched[k]; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return b.rows - a.rows; });

  const out = [];
  out.push((apply ? 'RESOLVE STAT ROWS' : 'RESOLVE STAT ROWS — DRY RUN'));
  out.push('');
  out.push('Rows attached to existing players: ' + attached);
  out.push('Left alone, two players share the name: ' + ambiguous);
  const notPersonList = Object.keys(notPersonNames).map(function (k) { return notPersonNames[k]; });
  if (notPeople) {
    out.push('Left alone, not a person: ' + notPeople + ' row' + (notPeople === 1 ? '' : 's') +
             ' (' + notPersonList.join(', ') + ')');
    out.push('  These already count in the team totals. Nobody is created for them.');
  }
  out.push('Names matching nobody: ' + unmatchedList.length + ' players across ' +
           unmatchedList.reduce(function (n, u) { return n + u.rows; }, 0) + ' rows.');
  /* Only worth explaining when it is about to happen. Printed against a count
     of zero it reads as a warning that something is going to be created. */
  if (unmatchedList.length) {
    out.push('These are created as new players and seated for the seasons their rows');
    out.push('cover — mostly 2024 players who predate every imported roster. A few');
    out.push('will be misspellings of players who exist; run Merge split players');
    out.push('(dry run) afterwards to spot and fold those.');
  }

  if (!apply) {
    if (unmatchedList.length) {
      out.push('');
      out.push('Top unmatched names:');
      unmatchedList.slice(0, 15).forEach(function (u) {
        out.push('  ' + u.raw + '  (' + u.rows + ' rows)');
      });
    }
    rsCollisionReport_(collisions, nameOf, teamOf).forEach(function (l) { out.push(l); });
    out.push('');
    out.push('Nothing was written. Run Resolve stat rows (APPLY) to do it.');
    const msg = out.join('\n');
    Logger.log(msg);
    return msg;
  }

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS)) throw new Error('Busy — try again.');
  try {
    // tier fills, one setValue per cell — a few hundred, once ever
    fills.forEach(function (f) {
      sh.getRange(f.row + 1, cPid + 1).setValue(f.pid);
    });

    // creations: ids allocated once for the batch
    var nextN = 0;
    players.forEach(function (p) {
      const m = String(p.PlayerID || '').match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
      if (m) nextN = Math.max(nextN, parseInt(m[1], 10));
    });
    const newPlayers = [], newSeats = [], pidOf = {};
    unmatchedList.forEach(function (u) {
      nextN++;
      var id = String(nextN);
      while (id.length < 6) id = '0' + id;
      const pid = 'PLY-' + id;
      pidOf[rsToks_(u.raw).join(' ')] = pid;
      newPlayers.push({
        PlayerID: pid, DisplayName: u.raw,
        NameNormalized: rsToks_(u.raw).join(' '),
        CreatedFrom: 'STAT_RESOLVER'
      });
      Object.keys(u.seats).forEach(function (k) {
        const sid = k.split('|')[0], teamId = k.split('|')[1];
        newSeats.push({
          PlayerSeasonID: 'PS-' + sid.replace('SEA-', '') + '-' + pid,
          PlayerID: pid, TeamID: teamId, SeasonID: sid, DisplayName: u.raw
        });
      });
    });
    if (newPlayers.length) appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS, newPlayers);
    if (newSeats.length) appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS, newSeats);

    // second sweep: point the unmatched rows at their new players
    var created = 0;
    for (var r2 = 1; r2 < values.length; r2++) {
      if (String(values[r2][cPid] || '').trim()) continue;
      const raw2 = String(values[r2][cRaw] || '').trim();
      if (!raw2) continue;
      const pid2 = pidOf[rsToks_(raw2).join(' ')];
      if (pid2) { sh.getRange(r2 + 1, cPid + 1).setValue(pid2); created++; }
    }
    // rows filled by the tier pass are skipped above because the in-memory
    // `values` still shows them blank — refill from the fills list instead
    // (already written); nothing further to do for them.

    __tableCache = {};
    CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot']);
    markDirty_('stats');

    out.push('');
    out.push('APPLIED: ' + attached + ' rows attached, ' + newPlayers.length +
             ' players created, ' + created + ' rows pointed at them.');
    out.push('Derived tables recompute on the next sweep, or run Rebuild everything now.');
    const msg = out.join('\n');
    Logger.log(msg);
    return msg;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

===== src/Roster.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — Roster.gs
 *
 * Coach-facing roster management. Position is chosen here, from the controlled
 * list in Positions.gs, and nowhere else. A player may hold several positions
 * and becomes All-Conference eligible at each one.
 *
 * This file must run under a deployment configured "Execute as: User accessing
 * the web app" so Session.getActiveUser() identifies the coach. The public site
 * runs as a separate deployment executing as the owner.
 */

/** Who is calling, and what may they touch? */
function whoami_() {
  const email = authEmail_();
  if (!email) return { email: '', role: 'PUBLIC', teamId: '', name: '' };

  ensureCoachesTab_();
  const rows = rowsOf_('Coaches');
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (String(rows[i].Email || '').toLowerCase().trim() !== email) continue;
    if (String(rows[i].Active).toUpperCase() === 'FALSE') break;
    return { email: email,
             role: String(rows[i].Role || 'COACH').toUpperCase(),
             teamId: String(rows[i].TeamID || '').trim(),
             name: String(rows[i].DisplayName || email) };
  }
  return { email: email, role: 'PUBLIC', teamId: '', name: email };
}

function ensureCoachesTab_() {
  if (hasTab_('Coaches')) return;
  const sh = db_().insertSheet('Coaches');
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 6).setValues([[
    'Email', 'DisplayName', 'TeamID', 'Role', 'Active', 'AddedAt'
  ]]).setFontWeight('bold');
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
}

/* Who is asking: the Accounts tab first, the Coaches tab second. A coach
   approved through the portal is a coach whether or not the older tab
   lists him - the roster must open to every coach the portal let in. */
function rosterWho_() {
  return (typeof accountsWhoami_ === 'function') ? accountsWhoami_() : whoami_();
}

/** Throws unless the caller may edit this team. Admins may edit any team. */
function assertCanEdit_(teamId) {
  const me = rosterWho_();
  if (me.role === 'ADMIN') return me;
  if (me.role === 'COACH' && me.teamId && me.teamId === teamId) return me;
  throw new Error('Not authorized to edit ' + (teamId || 'this roster') +
                  '. Signed in as ' + (me.email || 'nobody') + '.');
}

// ── read ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** The position list the UI renders as selectable chips. */
function apiPositionOptions_() {
  return POSITIONS.map(function (p) {
    return { code: p.code, label: p.label, side: p.side,
             ranked: !p.unranked, pool: poolOf_(p.code),
             // The optional refinements — Guard under OL, Edge under DL. The
             // client offers them only once the major is selected.
             subs: (p.subs || []).map(function (x) {
               return { code: x.code, label: x.label };
             }) };
  });
}

function apiRoster_(teamId, seasonId) {
  const me = rosterWho_();
  teamId = teamId || me.teamId;
  seasonId = seasonId || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  if (!teamId) throw new Error('No team. Ask an administrator to add you to the Coaches tab.');

  const players = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS), function (p) { return String(p.PlayerID); });
  const rows = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).filter(function (r) {
    return String(r.TeamID).trim() === teamId && String(r.SeasonID).trim() === seasonId;
  }).map(function (r) {
    const p = players[String(r.PlayerID)] || {};
    // legacy rows may still carry free text; surface the suggestion but never
    // save it silently — the coach confirms it.
    var codes = parsePositions_(r.Positions);
    var suggested = [];
    if (!codes.length) {
      const legacy = [r.Position, r.OffensePosition, r.DefensePosition]
        .filter(function (v) { return v !== '' && v !== null && v !== undefined; }).join(' / ');
      const n = normalizeLegacyPosition_(legacy);
      suggested = n.codes;
    }
    const out = {
      playerSeasonId: String(r.PlayerSeasonID || ''),
      playerId: String(r.PlayerID || ''),
      name: String(p.DisplayName || r.DisplayName || ''),
      jersey: String(r.Jersey === null || r.Jersey === undefined ? '' : r.Jersey),
      isCaptain: String(r.IsCaptain || '').toUpperCase().trim() === 'TRUE' ||
                 r.IsCaptain === true,
      grad: String(p.GradYear || r.GradYear || ''),
      // Commitment is a career fact and lives on Players, so it is the same on
      // every season's row rather than something a coach re-enters each year.
      commitment: String(p.Commitment || ''),
      commitmentLevel: String(p.CommitmentLevel || ''),
      positions: codes,
      suggested: suggested,
      needsPositions: codes.length === 0
    };
    // Blank must survive the trip as null, not 0 — see MEASURABLES in Schema.gs.
    MEASURABLES.forEach(function (m) {
      const v = r[m.col];
      out[m.key] = (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) ? null : Number(v);
      if (isNaN(out[m.key])) out[m.key] = null;
    });
    return out;
  }).sort(function (a, b) {
    return (Number(a.jersey) || 999) - (Number(b.jersey) || 999) ||
           a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  });

  return { teamId: teamId, seasonId: seasonId, me: me, roster: rows,
           options: apiPositionOptions_(),
           measurables: MEASURABLES,
           commitmentLevels: PROFILE.COMMITMENT_LEVELS,
           // captains are edited on this same page; the list and the cap ride
           // along so the editor never needs a second fetch to draw the C column
           captains: rows.filter(function (r) { return r.isCaptain; })
                         .map(function (r) { return r.playerId; }),
           maxCaptains: (typeof TEAMADMIN !== 'undefined' && TEAMADMIN.MAX_CAPTAINS) || 8,
           incomplete: rows.filter(function (r) { return r.needsPositions; }).length };
}

/**
 * Conference-wide position coverage, for chasing the schools that have not
 * declared yet. Admin only — a coach sees their own roster and nobody else's.
 */
function apiCoverage_(seasonId) {
  const me = rosterWho_();
  if (me.role !== 'ADMIN') throw new Error('Administrators only.');
  seasonId = seasonId || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  const cov = acRosterCoverage_(seasonId);
  var status = {};
  try { status = buildStatus_(); } catch (e) { status = { lastBuild: 'unknown' }; }
  return { coverage: cov, build: status, seasonId: seasonId };
}

// ── write ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Save roster edits. `edits` is a list of
 *   { playerSeasonId, positions:[codes], jersey, heightInches, weightLbs, gpa }
 * Positions are validated against the controlled list; anything else is refused.
 */
function apiSaveRoster_(teamId, seasonId, edits) {
  const me = assertCanEdit_(teamId);
  seasonId = seasonId || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS))
    throw new Error('Another save is in progress. Try again in a moment.');

  try {
    const sh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
    const data = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
    const head = data[0].map(String);

    // Every measurable column, plus Positions. A workbook that predates one of
    // them gets it now rather than silently dropping what the coach typed.
    const need = ['Positions'].concat(MEASURABLES.map(function (m) { return m.col; }));
    need.forEach(function (c) {
      if (head.indexOf(c) < 0) { head.push(c); sh.getRange(1, head.length).setValue(c); }
    });
    const col = {};
    ['PlayerSeasonID', 'PlayerID', 'TeamID', 'SeasonID', 'Jersey', 'Positions']
      .concat(MEASURABLES.map(function (m) { return m.col; }))
      .forEach(function (c) { col[c] = head.indexOf(c); });

    const rowOf = {};
    for (var r = 1; r < data.length; r++) {
      const id = String(data[r][col.PlayerSeasonID] || '');
      if (id) rowOf[id] = r + 1;                        // 1-based sheet row
    }

    const audit = [];
    const playerPatch = {};        // PlayerID -> career fields, written once below
    var saved = 0, refused = [];

    edits.forEach(function (e) {
      const rowIdx = rowOf[String(e.playerSeasonId || '')];
      if (!rowIdx) { refused.push(e.playerSeasonId + ': not found'); return; }
      const rowTeam = String(data[rowIdx - 1][col.TeamID] || '').trim();
      if (rowTeam !== teamId && me.role !== 'ADMIN') {
        refused.push(e.playerSeasonId + ': belongs to another team'); return;
      }

      const codes = parsePositions_(formatPositions_(e.positions || []));
      const err = validatePositions_(codes);
      if (err) { refused.push((e.playerSeasonId || '?') + ': ' + err); return; }

      /* Validate the whole row BEFORE writing any of it. Writing as we go would
         leave a refused row half-saved — a new weight stored beside the old 40
         time, with nothing on screen saying which half took. The career fields
         are validated here too, for the same reason: a bad grad year must not
         surface after the positions have already been written. */
      var values, career = {};
      try {
        values = { jersey: e.jersey === undefined ? undefined : normalizeJersey_(e.jersey) };
        MEASURABLES.forEach(function (m) {
          if (e[m.key] !== undefined) values[m.key] = measurableValue_(m.key, e[m.key]);
        });
        if (e.grad !== undefined) career.GradYear = profileGradYear_(e.grad);
        if (e.commitment !== undefined)
          career.Commitment = profileText_(e.commitment, 120);
        if (e.commitmentLevel !== undefined)
          career.CommitmentLevel = profileLevel_(e.commitmentLevel);
      } catch (ex) {
        refused.push((e.playerSeasonId || '?') + ': ' + ex.message);
        return;
      }

      const before = String(data[rowIdx - 1][col.Positions] || '');
      sh.getRange(rowIdx, col.Positions + 1).setValue(formatPositions_(codes));

      if (values.jersey !== undefined && col.Jersey >= 0)
        sh.getRange(rowIdx, col.Jersey + 1).setValue(values.jersey);
      MEASURABLES.forEach(function (m) {
        if (values[m.key] !== undefined && col[m.col] >= 0)
          sh.getRange(rowIdx, col[m.col] + 1).setValue(values[m.key]);
      });

      // Graduation year and commitment are career facts on the Players tab, not
      // season facts. Validated above; written in one pass per player below.
      const pid = String(data[rowIdx - 1][col.PlayerID] || '');
      if (pid && Object.keys(career).length) {
        playerPatch[pid] = playerPatch[pid] || {};
        Object.keys(career).forEach(function (k) { playerPatch[pid][k] = career[k]; });
      }

      if (before !== formatPositions_(codes)) {
        audit.push(auditRow_(me, 'ROSTER_EDIT', 'PlayerSeason', e.playerSeasonId,
                            'Positions', before, formatPositions_(codes),
                            teamId + ' ' + seasonId));
      }
      saved++;
    });

    rosterWritePlayerFields_(playerPatch, refused);

    if (audit.length) { ensureOpsTabs_(); appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, audit); }
    CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot', 'ac-' + seasonId]);
    // a rebuild is not run inline — rosters change in bursts, and the sweep
    // trigger collapses a burst into a single recompute
    markDirty_('roster');

    return { saved: saved, refused: refused };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**
 * Write career fields onto the Players tab, one row per player.
 *
 * `patch` is PlayerID -> { HeaderName: value }. The header names are checked
 * against the real header row rather than assumed: a workbook without a
 * Commitment column must refuse the edit and say so, because appendRows and
 * updateCells both match by header and an unmatched name writes nothing at all
 * while reporting success.
 */
function rosterWritePlayerFields_(patch, refused) {
  const ids = Object.keys(patch || {});
  if (!ids.length) return 0;

  const sh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  const data = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const head = data[0].map(String);
  const cId = head.indexOf('PlayerID');
  if (cId < 0) { refused.push('Players has no PlayerID column'); return 0; }

  const rowOf = {};
  for (var r = 1; r < data.length; r++) {
    const id = String(data[r][cId] || '');
    if (id) rowOf[id] = r + 1;
  }

  var n = 0;
  ids.forEach(function (pid) {
    const rowIdx = rowOf[pid];
    if (!rowIdx) { refused.push(pid + ': not on the Players tab'); return; }
    Object.keys(patch[pid]).forEach(function (colName) {
      const c = head.indexOf(colName);
      if (c < 0) {
        refused.push(pid + ': Players has no ' + colName +
                     ' column — an administrator must run ensureSchema_()');
        return;
      }
      sh.getRange(rowIdx, c + 1).setValue(patch[pid][colName]);
      n++;
    });
  });
  return n;
}

/**
 * Take players off a roster.
 *
 * Removes the PlayerSeasons row, not the player. The Players row is left alone
 * on purpose: it carries his career, his other seasons and whatever his stat
 * rows point at, and deleting it to undo a typo would take all of that with it.
 *
 * A player with recorded stats for the season is refused. Every stat row joins
 * back through this row for team, position and eligibility, so removing it
 * would leave numbers attributed to a player who, as far as the season is
 * concerned, was never on the team.
 */
function apiDeletePlayers_(teamId, seasonId, playerSeasonIds) {
  const me = assertCanEdit_(teamId);
  seasonId = seasonId || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;

  const want = (playerSeasonIds || []).map(String).filter(function (x) { return !!x; });
  if (!want.length) return { removed: 0, refused: [] };

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS))
    throw new Error('Another save is in progress. Try again in a moment.');

  try {
    const sh = getTab_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS);
    const data = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
    const head = data[0].map(String);
    const cId = head.indexOf('PlayerSeasonID'),
          cPlayer = head.indexOf('PlayerID'),
          cTeam = head.indexOf('TeamID'),
          cSeason = head.indexOf('SeasonID'),
          cName = head.indexOf('DisplayName');

    // How many stat rows each player has this season, counted once.
    const statCount = {};
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS).forEach(function (st) {
      if (String(st.SeasonID || '').trim() !== seasonId) return;
      const pid = String(st.PlayerID || '');
      if (pid) statCount[pid] = (statCount[pid] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const refused = [], remove = [], audit = [];

    want.forEach(function (psid) {
      var rowIdx = -1;
      for (var r = 1; r < data.length; r++) {
        if (String(data[r][cId] || '') === psid) { rowIdx = r; break; }
      }
      if (rowIdx < 0) { refused.push(psid + ': not found'); return; }

      const row = data[rowIdx];
      const rowTeam = String(row[cTeam] || '').trim();
      if (rowTeam !== teamId && me.role !== 'ADMIN') {
        refused.push(psid + ': belongs to another team'); return;
      }
      if (String(row[cSeason] || '').trim() !== seasonId) {
        refused.push(psid + ': belongs to another season'); return;
      }

      const pid = String(row[cPlayer] || '');
      const name = String(row[cName] || pid);
      const n = statCount[pid] || 0;
      if (n) {
        refused.push(name + ': has ' + n + ' stat row' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') +
                     ' this season. Remove the stats first, or leave him on the ' +
                     'roster — deleting him would orphan them.');
        return;
      }

      remove.push(rowIdx + 1);                     // 1-based sheet row
      audit.push(auditRow_(me, 'ROSTER_REMOVE', 'PlayerSeason', psid, '',
                          name, '', teamId + ' ' + seasonId));
    });

    // Delete from the bottom up: removing a row shifts every row beneath it,
    // and top-down deletion would take the wrong ones from the second onward.
    remove.sort(function (a, b) { return b - a; })
          .forEach(function (rowIdx) { sh.deleteRow(rowIdx); });

    if (audit.length) { ensureOpsTabs_(); appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, audit); }
    if (remove.length) {
      delete __tableCache[CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS];
      CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot', 'ac-' + seasonId]);
      markDirty_('roster');
    }
    return { removed: remove.length, refused: refused };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**
 * Build an AuditLog row matching the schema ensureOpsTabs() creates. appendRows
 * maps objects onto the sheet by header name, so these keys must be exact or the
 * row lands blank.
 */
function auditRow_(me, action, entityType, entityId, field, oldV, newV, notes) {
  return {
    AuditID: '', Timestamp: new Date(), UserID: me.email, Role: me.role,
    Action: action, EntityType: entityType, EntityID: entityId, Field: field || '',
    OldValue: oldV === undefined || oldV === null ? '' : String(oldV),
    NewValue: newV === undefined || newV === null ? '' : String(newV),
    RequestID: '', Notes: notes || ''
  };
}

/**
 * Allocate the next PlayerID. Must be called while already holding the script
 * lock — nextId() in Database.gs takes the lock itself and would deadlock if
 * nested inside one.
 */
function nextPlayerIdLocked_() {
  const rows = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS);
  var max = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const m = String(rows[i].PlayerID || '').match(/(\d+)\s*$/);
    if (m) max = Math.max(max, parseInt(m[1], 10));
  }
  var n = String(max + 1);
  while (n.length < 6) n = '0' + n;
  return 'PLY-' + n;
}

/** NFHS rule 1-4-3: 0 through 99, no leading zeros. Blank stays blank. */
function normalizeJersey_(v) {
  if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  const n = Number(String(v).trim());
  if (isNaN(n) || n < 0 || n > 99 || Math.floor(n) !== n)
    throw new Error('Jersey "' + v + '" is not a legal number (0-99).');
  return n;
}

function normalizeGpa_(v) {
  if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  const n = Number(v);
  if (isNaN(n) || n < 0 || n > 5) throw new Error('GPA "' + v + '" is out of range.');
  return Math.round(n * 1000) / 1000;
}

function numOrBlank_(v) {
  if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  const n = Number(v);
  return isNaN(n) ? '' : n;
}

/** Add a player who is not yet on the roster. */
function apiAddPlayer_(teamId, seasonId, player) {
  const me = assertCanEdit_(teamId);
  seasonId = seasonId || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;

  const name = String(player.name || '').trim();
  if (!name) throw new Error('A name is required.');
  const codes = parsePositions_(formatPositions_(player.positions || []));
  const err = validatePositions_(codes);
  if (err) throw new Error(err);

  // Validated before the lock is taken. A refusal that costs nobody the script
  // lock is a refusal that cannot make a second coach wait for a typo.
  const grad = profileGradYear_(player.grad);
  const commitment = profileText_(player.commitment || '', 120);
  const commitmentLevel = profileLevel_(player.commitmentLevel || '');
  const jersey = normalizeJersey_(player.jersey);
  const measured = {};
  MEASURABLES.forEach(function (m) {
    measured[m.col] = measurableValue_(m.key, player[m.key]);
  });

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS)) throw new Error('Busy — try again.');
  try {
    // allocate inside our own lock; nextId() would take the lock again and hang
    const playerId = nextPlayerIdLocked_();
    appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS, [{
      PlayerID: playerId, DisplayName: name,
      NameNormalized: name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z ]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      GradYear: grad, FirstSeenSeason: seasonId,
      Commitment: commitment, CommitmentLevel: commitmentLevel,
      CreatedFrom: 'ROSTER_EDITOR:' + me.email
    }]);
    const seasonRow = {
      PlayerSeasonID: 'PS-' + seasonId.replace('SEA-', '') + '-' + playerId,
      PlayerID: playerId, TeamID: teamId, SeasonID: seasonId,
      Jersey: jersey, Positions: formatPositions_(codes),
      DisplayName: name, GradYear: grad
    };
    Object.keys(measured).forEach(function (c) { seasonRow[c] = measured[c]; });
    appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS, [seasonRow]);
    ensureOpsTabs_();
    appendRows_(CONFIG.TABS.AUDIT, [auditRow_(me, 'ROSTER_ADD', 'Player', playerId,
      '', '', name + ' (' + formatPositions_(codes) + ')', teamId + ' ' + seasonId)]);
    CacheService.getScriptCache().removeAll(['boot', 'ac-' + seasonId]);
    // a rebuild is not run inline — rosters change in bursts, and the sweep
    // trigger collapses a burst into a single recompute
    markDirty_('roster');
    return { playerId: playerId };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

===== src/Schema.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — Schema.gs
 *
 * Every schema migration lives here and nowhere else. ensureSchema() is the one
 * function to run after a deploy: it creates the tabs the account, correction and
 * notification layers need, and appends the columns the newer modules read.
 *
 * Three rules it never breaks:
 *   1. Columns are only ever APPENDED. Nothing is reordered, renamed or removed —
 *      the seed workbook's column order is load-bearing for the import adapters,
 *      and a removed column takes its data with it.
 *   2. No data cell is ever written. Only row 1 is touched.
 *   3. Running it twice changes nothing. Run it after every deploy.
 *
 * tabHeader() is as much the point of this file as the migrations are.
 * appendRows() maps an object onto the sheet BY COLUMN NAME, so a key that is not
 * a real header lands in no column and the row is written blank — no exception,
 * no warning, just an empty row. That bug has shipped twice. Read the header
 * before you build the object; never remember it.
 */

const SCHEMA = {

  // Tabs this file owns. The ops tabs (AuditLog, StatSubmissions,
  // StatCorrections) are still created by ensureOpsTabs() in Database.gs.
  TABS: {
    ACCOUNTS:      'Accounts',
    NOTIFICATIONS: 'Notifications'
  },

  ACCOUNTS: ['AccountID', 'Email', 'Role', 'Status', 'PlayerID', 'TeamID',
             'DisplayName', 'RequestedRole', 'RequestedTeamID', 'RequestedPlayerID',
             'Note', 'CreatedAt', 'ApprovedBy', 'ApprovedAt', 'LastSeenAt'],

  NOTIFICATIONS: ['NotificationID', 'ToEmail', 'Kind', 'Subject', 'Body',
                  'EntityType', 'EntityID', 'TeamID', 'CreatedAt', 'SentAt', 'Status'],

  TEAMS_ADD: ['HudlURL', 'SchoolURL', 'FacebookURL', 'YouTubeURL', 'TikTokURL',
              'HeadCoach', 'StadiumName'],

  // BirthDate is collected at registration and never published anywhere —
  // it exists so a person claiming a name can be told apart from the name.
  // Offers holds a JSON list of {school, level} — the schools recruiting him,
  // beside the one Commitment he has made.
  PLAYERS_ADD: ['Commitment', 'CommitmentLevel', 'CommitmentDate', 'HudlURL',
                'XHandle', 'InstagramHandle', 'MaxPrepsURL', 'Hometown', 'Bio',
                'Email', 'ProfilePhotoID', 'UpdatedAt', 'UpdatedBy', 'BirthDate',
                'Offers'],

  // Who put a stat line in. Blank and IMPORT and COACH_ENTRY are official;
  // PLAYER_ENTRY is a player's own claim, published in grey until a coach or
  // administrator approves it or an official entry supersedes it.
  PLAYER_STATS_ADD: ['SourceType', 'EnteredBy', 'EnteredAt', 'Pancakes', 'Blocks'],

  /* Positions is already present on the live workbook; listing it here is what
     makes a fresh import safe, and addColumns() skips it when it exists.

     The four lifts are season-scoped like height and weight, not career facts:
     a junior's bench is not a senior's, and storing one number per player would
     quietly overwrite last year's every time somebody retested. */
  PLAYER_SEASONS_ADD: ['IsCaptain', 'GPA', 'Positions',
                       'Forty', 'Bench', 'Squat', 'Clean', 'Vertical', 'Shuttle'],

  CORRECTIONS_ADD: ['Status', 'ReviewedBy', 'ReviewedAt', 'SeasonID', 'TeamID'],

  /* Who forfeited: the forfeiting side's TeamID, or its name when it has no
     row here (an outside opponent). The standings read it before they read
     the Notes column, and the Scores page writes it. */
  GAMES_ADD: ['ForfeitBy'],

  /* The 2023 team sheet reports points scored and fumble recoveries, which the
     original TeamSeasons tab had no columns for. */
  TEAM_SEASONS_ADD: ['PointsFor', 'DefFR']
};

/**
 * The measured numbers a roster row carries, in the order they are shown.
 *
 * One list, read by the roster editor, the player's own profile and both save
 * paths. Two lists would drift, and the drift would look like a coach and a
 * player disagreeing about what a player is allowed to report about himself.
 *
 * Every range is a refusal boundary, not a hint. A 40 time of 2.1 seconds and a
 * bench of 4 pounds are both typing mistakes, and a published measurable nobody
 * can defend is worse than a blank one — which is why blank stays blank here and
 * never becomes zero.
 */
const MEASURABLES = [
  // `unit` is the word beside the column heading — "HT (ft)", "WT (lbs)".
  // Height is stored in inches and entered and shown as feet and inches.
  { key: 'heightInches', col: 'HeightInches', label: 'Ht (ft)', short: 'Ht', unit: 'ft',
    min: 48, max: 90,   step: 1,    dp: 0 },
  { key: 'weightLbs',    col: 'WeightLbs',    label: 'Wt (lbs)', short: 'Wt', unit: 'lbs',
    min: 80, max: 450,  step: 1,    dp: 0 },
  { key: 'gpa',          col: 'GPA',          label: 'GPA',     short: 'GPA', unit: '',
    min: 0,  max: 5,    step: 0.01, dp: 3 },
  { key: 'forty',        col: 'Forty',        label: '40 (sec)', short: '40', unit: 'sec',
    min: 4,  max: 8,    step: 0.01, dp: 2 },
  { key: 'bench',        col: 'Bench',        label: 'Bench (lbs)', short: 'Bench', unit: 'lbs',
    min: 45, max: 700,  step: 5,    dp: 0 },
  { key: 'squat',        col: 'Squat',        label: 'Squat (lbs)', short: 'Squat', unit: 'lbs',
    min: 45, max: 1000, step: 5,    dp: 0 },
  { key: 'clean',        col: 'Clean',        label: 'Clean (lbs)', short: 'Clean', unit: 'lbs',
    min: 45, max: 600,  step: 5,    dp: 0 },
  { key: 'vertical',     col: 'Vertical',     label: 'Vertical (in)', short: 'Vert', unit: 'in',
    min: 10, max: 50,   step: 0.5,  dp: 1 },
  { key: 'shuttle',      col: 'Shuttle',      label: '5-10-5 Shuttle (sec)', short: 'Shuttle', unit: 'sec',
    min: 3.5, max: 8,   step: 0.01, dp: 2 }
];

function measurableByKey_(key) {
  for (var i = 0; i < MEASURABLES.length; i++)
    if (MEASURABLES[i].key === key) return MEASURABLES[i];
  return null;
}

/**
 * A measurable's stored value, or '' for blank. Throws on anything else.
 *
 * Blank is emphatically not zero. A cleared 40 time means nobody has timed him;
 * a zero would publish him as the fastest player in conference history.
 */
function measurableValue_(key, raw) {
  const m = measurableByKey_(key);
  if (!m) throw new Error('"' + key + '" is not a measurable.');
  if (raw === '' || raw === null || raw === undefined) return '';

  const n = Number(raw);
  if (isNaN(n)) throw new Error(m.label + ' "' + raw + '" is not a number.');
  if (n < m.min || n > m.max)
    throw new Error(m.label + ' "' + raw + '" is outside ' + m.min + '–' + m.max + '.');

  const f = Math.pow(10, m.dp);
  return Math.round(n * f) / f;
}

// ── the primitive every other module should reach for ───────────────────────

/**
 * The real header row of a tab, trimmed.
 *
 * Reads the sheet rather than readTable()'s per-execution memo, so a column added
 * earlier in this same execution is visible immediately.
 *
 * Call this before building any object for appendRows(). appendRows() matches
 * object keys against these exact strings — an invented key lands in no column
 * and the row is written blank. Check, do not guess.
 */
function tabHeader_(tabName) {
  const sh = getTab_(tabName);
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastCol < 1) return [];
  return sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0]
           .map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); });
}

/**
 * Append whichever of `columnNames` the tab does not already have.
 * Returns the names actually added, in the order they were written.
 *
 * Existing columns are never moved and no cell below row 1 is touched, so this is
 * safe on a tab holding five thousand rows of live data.
 */
function addColumns_(tabName, columnNames) {
  const sh = getTab_(tabName);
  const head = tabHeader_(tabName);
  const missing = [];

  (columnNames || []).forEach(function (c) {
    const name = String(c).trim();
    if (!name) return;
    if (head.indexOf(name) >= 0) return;
    if (missing.indexOf(name) >= 0) return;      // a repeat in the caller's list

    // A header matching apart from case or spacing is a rename, not an addition.
    // Appending a second column would split one field across two, leaving the
    // data in the old one and every future read pointed at the new one.
    for (var i = 0; i < head.length; i++) {
      if (head[i] && normName_(head[i]) === normName_(name)) {
        Logger.log('addColumns: ' + tabName + ' has "' + head[i] + '", not "' + name +
                   '". Left alone — appendRows_() matches headers exactly, so rename ' +
                   'the header by hand before anything writes to it.');
        return;
      }
    }
    missing.push(name);
  });

  if (!missing.length) return [];

  const first = head.length + 1;
  const short = (first + missing.length - 1) - sh.getMaxColumns();
  if (short > 0) sh.insertColumnsAfter(sh.getMaxColumns(), short);

  const cells = sh.getRange(1, first, 1, missing.length);
  cells.setValues([missing]);

  // Match whatever the existing header row looks like rather than imposing the
  // ops-tab palette on a tab that does not use it.
  if (head.length) {
    const model = sh.getRange(1, 1);
    cells.setFontWeight(model.getFontWeight())
         .setFontColor(model.getFontColor())
         .setBackground(model.getBackground());
  } else {
    cells.setFontWeight('bold').setFontColor('#FFFFFF').setBackground('#1F3B54');
  }
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);

  delete __tableCache[tabName];
  return missing;
}

/**
 * Create a tab with these headers, or bring an existing one up to them.
 * Returns { tab, created, added } — `added` is every header on a tab this call
 * created, and only the appended ones on a tab that already existed.
 */
