               return c.label + ' ' + c.filed + '/' + c.roster;
             }).join(', ') + '.');
  }

  var sideFields = statsFieldsFor_(q.allowed ? 'ALLOWED' : q.side).map(function (f) { return f.key; });
  var allEmpty = sideFields.length && sideFields.every(function (k) { return empties[k]; });
  if (allEmpty) {
    out.push('Nothing has been reported in any of these columns for the seasons ' +
             'selected. The columns are shown so the gap is visible rather than ' +
             'looking like a page that failed to load.');
  }
  return out;
}

// ── query, build, cache ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Coerce a caller's query into the canonical shape everything below assumes.
 * Anything unrecognized falls back to a documented default rather than throwing —
 * a stale bookmark should render the default table, not an error panel.
 */
function statsNormalizeQuery_(query) {
  const raw = query || {};
  const q = {};
  q.scope = String(raw.scope || 'PLAYER').toUpperCase() === 'TEAM' ? 'TEAM' : 'PLAYER';
  q.side = String(raw.side || 'ALL').toUpperCase();
  if (STATS_SIDES.indexOf(q.side) < 0) q.side = 'ALL';
  // measurables belong to players; a team has no forty time
  if (q.side === 'MEASURE' && q.scope === 'TEAM') q.side = 'ALL';
  /* What a defence ALLOWED, rather than what it recorded. Its own flag rather
     than a sixth side, because it is a way of reading the defensive board and
     not a fifth part of the field — and because a reader turning it on and off
     should not lose their place in the Side control.
     It means nothing anywhere else: a yard allowed is read off the other
     side's box score, so a player has no share of one and an offence has no
     use for the idea. Anything else asking for it is simply not asking for
     it. */
  q.allowed = (q.scope === 'TEAM' && q.side === 'DEFENSE' &&
               String(raw.allowed || '') !== '' && String(raw.allowed) !== '0');

  // The position has to be resolved BEFORE the side, the columns and the default
  // sort, all of which depend on it. Read after them, it is still undefined and
  // a linebacker filter quietly sorts on total yards.
  q.position = s_(raw.position).toUpperCase();
  if (q.position && !POS_BY_CODE[q.position]) q.position = '';

  // Filtering to a defensive position and still being shown passing columns is
  // noise. A position implies its side unless the caller asked for another.
  if (q.position && q.side === 'ALL') {
    const implied = statsSideForPosition_(q.position);
    if (implied) q.side = implied;
  }
  q.timeRange = String(raw.timeRange || 'SEASON').toUpperCase();
  if (['SEASON', 'LAST4', 'ALL'].indexOf(q.timeRange) < 0) q.timeRange = 'SEASON';

  q.seasonId = s_(raw.seasonId);
  q.county   = s_(raw.county);
  q.teamId   = s_(raw.teamId);
  q.search   = s_(raw.search).slice(0, 40);

  /* The allowed board SHOWS offensive columns, so those are the ones it must
     be sortable by. Asked for as DEFENSE it offered tackles and sacks — none
     of which are in the table — so every header click on that board was
     rejected and fell back to a default sort on a column nobody could see. */
  const sortable = statsSortableKeys_(q.scope, q.allowed ? 'ALLOWED' : q.side);
  // Sorting a quarterback filter on total yards buries the passer behind whoever
  // also ran; the position, when given, decides what "best" means here.
  const POSITION_SORT = { QB: 'PassYds', RB: 'RushYds', WR: 'RecYds', TE: 'RecYds',
                          ATH: 'TotalYds', LB: 'TacklesTotal', DL: 'Sacks',
                          DB: 'Int', K: 'FGM', P: 'PuntYds' };
  q.sortBy = s_(raw.sortBy);
  if (!sortable[q.sortBy]) {
    const byPos = q.position ? POSITION_SORT[majorOf_(q.position)] : '';
    /* PER GAME on the allowed board, never the total. The games it is built
       from differ school to school — one team's opponents all filed, the
       next team's did not — so a total ranks on who was counted least. */
    q.sortBy = q.allowed ? 'TotalYdsPG'
             : (byPos && sortable[byPos]) ? byPos : STATS_DEFAULT_SORT[q.scope][q.side];
  }
  const sortField = sortable[q.sortBy];
  q.sortDir = String(raw.sortDir || '').toUpperCase() === 'ASC' ? 'ASC'
            : (String(raw.sortDir || '').toUpperCase() === 'DESC' ? 'DESC'
            : ((sortField.format === 'text' || sortField.asc) ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'));

  // The qualifier defaults to nothing so a counting-stat table shows everyone.
  // It only defaults to a real floor when the caller sorts by a rate, which is
  // the one case where a two-carry season would otherwise lead the conference.
  var asked = numOrNull_(raw.minGames);
  if (asked !== null && asked >= 0) {
    q.minGames = Math.floor(asked);
    q.minGamesReason = 'requested';
  } else if (sortField.rate) {
    q.minGames = STATS_RATE_MIN_GAMES;
    q.minGamesReason = 'default for a rate-sorted table';
  } else {
    q.minGames = 0;
    q.minGamesReason = 'none applied';
  }

  var limit = numOrNull_(raw.limit);
  q.limit = limit === null ? STATS_DEFAULT_LIMIT
          : Math.max(1, Math.min(STATS_MAX_LIMIT, Math.floor(limit)));
  var offset = numOrNull_(raw.offset);
  q.offset = offset === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.floor(offset));
  return q;
}

function statsCacheKey_(q) {
  return STATS_CACHE_PREFIX + [q.scope, q.side, q.allowed ? 'ALW' : '', q.timeRange, q.seasonId, q.county,
    q.teamId, q.position, q.minGames, q.sortBy, q.sortDir, q.limit, q.offset,
    q.search.toLowerCase()].join('|');
}

/** Blanks sort last in BOTH directions — nobody who filed nothing tops a table. */
function statsSorter_(key, dir, idKey) {
  const mul = dir === 'ASC' ? 1 : -1;
  return function (x, y) {
    var a = x[key], b = y[key];
    var an = (a === null || a === undefined || a === '');
    var bn = (b === null || b === undefined || b === '');
    if (an && bn) return String(x[idKey]).localeCompare(String(y[idKey]));
    if (an) return 1;
    if (bn) return -1;
    var c;
    if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') c = (a - b) * mul;
    else c = String(a).localeCompare(String(b)) * mul;
    // A stable tiebreak keeps a row from moving between pages as you page through.
    return c || String(x[idKey]).localeCompare(String(y[idKey]));
  };
}

function statsBuild_(q) {
  const sIdx = statsSeasonIndex_();
  const withData = statsSeasonsWithData_(q.scope, q.side);
  if (!q.seasonId) {
    for (var i = 0; i < sIdx.newestFirst.length; i++) {
      if (withData[sIdx.newestFirst[i]]) { q.seasonId = sIdx.newestFirst[i]; break; }
    }
    if (!q.seasonId) q.seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  }

  const range = statsResolveSeasons_(q, sIdx, withData);
  const ctx = {
    seasonIdx: sIdx, seasons: range.seasons, inRange: range.inRange,
    excluded: range.excluded, teams: statsTeamIndex_(),
    source: statsSeasonSource_().source, unresolvedStatRows: 0, positionCoverage: []
  };

  var rows = [];
  if (ctx.seasons.length) {
    rows = (q.side === 'MEASURE') ? statsMeasureRows_(q, ctx)
         : q.allowed ? statsAllowedRows_(q, ctx)
         : (q.scope === 'TEAM') ? statsTeamRows_(q, ctx) : statsPlayerRows_(q, ctx);
  }

  if (q.search) {
    var needle = q.search.toLowerCase();
    rows = rows.filter(function (r) {
      return String(r.player || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(needle) >= 0 ||
             String(r.team || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(needle) >= 0;
    });
  }

  /* A defence whose opponents have barely filed has no allowed figure worth
     ranking, and on a board of totals it would LEAD by having been counted
     least. Dropped, and named — a school that vanishes without explanation
     reads as a site that has forgotten it exists. */
  const allowedThin = [];
  if (q.allowed) {
    rows = rows.filter(function (r) {
      if ((r.allowedGames || 0) >= STATSCOV.MIN_GAMES) return true;
      allowedThin.push({ team: r.team, games: r.allowedGames || 0 });
      return false;
    });
    allowedThin.sort(function (a, b) { return a.team.localeCompare(b.team); });
  }

  const excluded = { belowMinGames: 0, unknownGamesPlayed: 0 };
  if (q.minGames > 0) {
    rows = rows.filter(function (r) {
      var gp = numOrNull_(r.gp);
      // A partial count is a floor: it can prove a row qualifies, never that it
      // does not. An indeterminate row is excluded and counted, not assumed.
      if (gp !== null && gp >= q.minGames) return true;
      if (gp === null || r.gpPartial) { excluded.unknownGamesPlayed++; return false; }
      excluded.belowMinGames++;
      return false;
    });
  }

  const columns = statsColumns_(q.scope, q.side, q, ctx);
  const keys = columns.map(function (c) { return c.key; });
  const idKey = q.scope === 'TEAM' ? 'teamId' : 'playerId';

  // Round to what the client will display, before sorting, so the order always
  // matches the numbers on screen.
  columns.forEach(function (c) {
    if (!c.numeric) return;
    rows.forEach(function (r) { r[c.key] = statsRound_(r[c.key], c.format); });
  });

  const empties = {};
  columns.forEach(function (c) { empties[c.key] = true; });
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    columns.forEach(function (c) {
      if (r[c.key] !== null && r[c.key] !== undefined && r[c.key] !== '') empties[c.key] = false;
    });
  });

  const totals = statsProject_(statsTotals_(q, rows, columns), keys);
  const grains = {};
  rows.forEach(function (r) { if (r.grain) grains[r.grain] = (grains[r.grain] || 0) + 1; });

  const warnings = statsWarnings_(q, ctx, rows, keys, empties);

  rows.sort(statsSorter_(q.sortBy, q.sortDir, idKey));
  const total = rows.length;
  const page = rows.slice(q.offset, q.offset + q.limit).map(function (r) {
    return statsProject_(r, keys);
  });

  const payload = {
    scope: q.scope,
    rows: page,
    columns: columns,
    totals: totals,
    meta: {
      scope: q.scope, side: q.side, timeRange: q.timeRange,
      seasonId: q.seasonId,
      seasons: ctx.seasons.map(function (id) {
        return { id: id, label: sIdx.byId[id].label, year: sIdx.byId[id].year,
                 status: sIdx.byId[id].status };
      }),
      seasonsExcluded: ctx.excluded,
      county: q.county, teamId: q.teamId, position: q.position, search: q.search,
      allowed: !!q.allowed,
      allowedMinGames: STATSCOV.MIN_GAMES,
      allowedThin: allowedThin,
      inferredPositions: ctx.inferredPositions || 0,
      minGames: q.minGames, minGamesDefault: STATS_RATE_MIN_GAMES,
      minGamesReason: q.minGamesReason, excluded: excluded,
      sortBy: q.sortBy, sortDir: q.sortDir,
      limit: q.limit, offset: q.offset, total: total,
      returned: page.length,
      grains: grains,
      /* The client hides an empty column so "Special" is not a screen of
         blanks. On the measurables board the columns ARE the subject — a coach
         needs to see that Squat exists and nobody has filled it, not find it
         quietly missing — so that board keeps every column. */
      emptyColumns: q.side === 'MEASURE' ? []
                    : keys.filter(function (k) { return empties[k]; }),
      source: ctx.source,
      warnings: warnings,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  };

  // cacheGet() skips its put above 95,000 characters without saying so, which
  // would leave this endpoint re-running its full producer on every request while
  // looking perfectly healthy. Say so here instead.
  try {
    payload.meta.bytes = JSON.stringify(payload).length;
    if (payload.meta.bytes >= 95000) {
      Logger.log('apiStats: payload ' + payload.meta.bytes + ' chars exceeds the script ' +
                 'cache limit and will not be cached. Key: ' + statsCacheKey_(q));
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  return payload;
}

/**
 * Footer totals across every matching row, not just the page.
 *
 * Ratios are recomputed from the summed atoms — averaging a column of averages
 * would weight a two-carry back the same as a two-hundred-carry one. Per-game
 * columns stay blank: a sum of games played across different players is not a
 * denominator anything can be divided by.
 */
function statsTotals_(q, rows, columns) {
  const sums = {};
  SUM_FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
    var v = statsSum_(rows.map(function (r) { return r[f]; }));
    if (v !== null) sums[f] = v;
  });

  const t = { count: rows.length };
  t[q.scope === 'TEAM' ? 'team' : 'player'] = 'Total';
  statsEmitSums_(t, sums);

  if (q.scope === 'TEAM') {
    t.PointsScored  = statsSum_(rows.map(function (r) { return r.PointsScored; }));
    t.PointsAllowed = statsSum_(rows.map(function (r) { return r.PointsAllowed; }));
    t.PointDiff = (t.PointsScored === null || t.PointsAllowed === null)
                ? null : t.PointsScored - t.PointsAllowed;
    ['w', 'l', 't', 'gp', 'boxGames'].forEach(function (k) {
      t[k] = statsSum_(rows.map(function (r) { return r[k]; }));
    });
  } else {
    t.gp = statsSum_(rows.map(function (r) { return r.gp; }));
  }

  statsDerive_(t, false);
  columns.forEach(function (c) { if (c.numeric) t[c.key] = statsRound_(t[c.key], c.format); });
  return t;
}

/**
 * The filterable stats table.
 *
 * query {scope, side, timeRange, seasonId, county, teamId, position, minGames,
 *        sortBy, sortDir, limit, offset, search}
 * -> {scope, rows[], columns[], totals, meta}
 *
 * Cached under a key derived from the whole query. Nothing here reads an
 * identity, so there is nothing user-specific to leak into a shared cache entry —
 * and nothing user-specific may ever be added to this payload for that reason.
 */
function apiStats_(query) {
  const q = statsNormalizeQuery_(query);
  return cacheGet_(statsCacheKey_(q), STATS_CACHE_TTL, function () { return statsBuild_(q); });
}

/**
 * Everything the Stats page needs to build its controls, every list derived from
 * the data that actually exists.
 *
 * Seasons carry flags rather than being filtered out: the UI should be able to
 * show that 2026 is on the calendar and empty, which is true, instead of
 * pretending the season does not exist.
 */
function apiStatsFilters_() {
  return cacheGet_(STATS_CACHE_PREFIX + 'filters', STATS_CACHE_TTL, function () {
    const sIdx = statsSeasonIndex_();
    const teamIdx = statsTeamIndex_();

    const hasPlayerStats = {}, hasGameDetail = {}, statRows = {};
    statsSeasonSource_().rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var sid = s_(r.SeasonID);
      if (!sid) return;
      hasPlayerStats[sid] = true;
      statRows[sid] = (statRows[sid] || 0) + 1;
      if (s_(r.SourceGrain) === CONFIG.GRAIN.GAME) hasGameDetail[sid] = true;
    });
    const hasScores = {};
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).forEach(function (g) {
      if (numOrNull_(g.HomeScore) === null || numOrNull_(g.AwayScore) === null) return;
      hasScores[s_(g.SeasonID)] = true;
    });

    const seasons = sIdx.newestFirst.map(function (id) {
      var x = sIdx.byId[id];
      return { id: id, label: x.label, year: x.year, status: x.status,
               hasPlayerStats: !!hasPlayerStats[id], hasGameDetail: !!hasGameDetail[id],
               hasScores: !!hasScores[id], players: statRows[id] || 0,
               tackleConvention: x.tackleConvention };
    });
    const withPlayerData = sIdx.newestFirst.filter(function (id) { return hasPlayerStats[id]; });
    const withAnyData = sIdx.newestFirst.filter(function (id) {
      return hasPlayerStats[id] || hasScores[id];
    });

    const teams = Object.keys(teamIdx).map(function (id) { return teamIdx[id]; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });

    const countyCount = {};
    teams.forEach(function (t) { if (t.county) countyCount[t.county] = (countyCount[t.county] || 0) + 1; });
    const counties = Object.keys(countyCount).sort().map(function (c) {
      return { key: c, label: c + ' County', teams: countyCount[c] };
    });

    // A position is only offered when a player carrying it has statistics to
    // show. Positions were barely filed before 2025; offering the full list
    // would return an empty table that reads as "this player had no season".
    const hasStats = {};
    statsSeasonSource_().rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var pid = s_(r.PlayerID), sid = s_(r.SeasonID);
      if (pid && sid) hasStats[pid + '|' + sid] = true;
    });
    const posPlayers = {}, posSeasons = {};
    rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).forEach(function (r) {
      var pid = s_(r.PlayerID), sid = s_(r.SeasonID);
      if (!pid || !hasStats[pid + '|' + sid]) return;
      parsePositions_(r.Positions).forEach(function (c) {
        (posPlayers[c] = posPlayers[c] || {})[pid] = true;
        posSeasons[c] = posSeasons[c] || {};
        posSeasons[c][sid] = (posSeasons[c][sid] || 0) + 1;
      });
    });
    // Majors and their sub-positions, each with how many players it would find.
    // A major's count includes everyone under it, so choosing Linebacker never
    // shows fewer players than choosing Inside Linebacker beneath it.
    const positions = [];
    POSITIONS.forEach(function (p) {
      const own = posPlayers[p.code] || {};
      const rolled = {};
      Object.keys(own).forEach(function (k) { rolled[k] = true; });
      (p.subs || []).forEach(function (sub) {
        Object.keys(posPlayers[sub.code] || {}).forEach(function (k) { rolled[k] = true; });
      });
      const total = Object.keys(rolled).length;
      if (total) {
        positions.push({ code: p.code, label: p.label, side: p.side, major: p.code,
                         isSub: false, players: total, seasons: posSeasons[p.code] });
      }
      (p.subs || []).forEach(function (sub) {
        const n = Object.keys(posPlayers[sub.code] || {}).length;
        if (!n) return;
        positions.push({ code: sub.code, label: sub.label, side: p.side, major: p.code,
                         isSub: true, players: n, seasons: posSeasons[sub.code] });
      });
    });

    const seen = {}, categories = [];
    STATS_FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
      var k = f.side + '|' + f.group;
      if (seen[k]) return;
      seen[k] = true;
      categories.push({ key: f.group.toUpperCase(), label: f.group, side: f.side });
    });

    const timeRanges = STATS_TIME_RANGES.map(function (t) {
      var covers = t.key === 'ALL' ? withPlayerData
                 : (t.key === 'LAST4' ? withPlayerData.slice(0, STATS_LAST_N) : []);
      return { key: t.key, label: t.label, seasons: covers,
               teamSeasons: t.key === 'ALL' ? withAnyData
                          : (t.key === 'LAST4' ? withAnyData.slice(0, STATS_LAST_N) : []) };
    });

    return {
      seasons: seasons,
      defaultSeason: withPlayerData[0] || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON,
      teams: teams,
      counties: counties,
      positions: positions,
      categories: categories,
      sides: STATS_SIDES,
      timeRanges: timeRanges,
      minGamesDefault: STATS_RATE_MIN_GAMES,
      limitDefault: STATS_DEFAULT_LIMIT,
      limitMax: STATS_MAX_LIMIT
    };
  });
}


===== src/StatsCoverage.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — StatsCoverage.gs
 *
 * Which box scores are actually IN, said by a person rather than guessed.
 *
 * A defence's "allowed" figures are read off the other side's box score: a
 * team's rushing yards allowed ARE its opponent's rushing yards. That makes
 * the allowed board only as honest as the opponent's filing, and the failure
 * is silent and backwards — a school whose opponent filed one carry for five
 * yards leads the conference in fewest rushing yards allowed, and looks like
 * the best run defence in two counties.
 *
 * The old guard asked "did every counted game report this field". A one-carry
 * fragment DOES report rushing yards, so the guard passed. Presence is not
 * completeness, and no threshold on volume or points can tell a fragment from
 * a real low-output night without sometimes being wrong in both directions.
 *
 * So it is not inferred. An administrator ticks a box per team per game — "the
 * whole box score for this team in this game is in" — and a game nobody has
 * ticked contributes nothing to the opponent's allowed figures. Unticked is
 * the default, because the alternative is to assume completeness, and assuming
 * completeness is the bug.
 *
 * It gates ONLY what depends on somebody else's filing. A team's own numbers
 * appear on the leaderboards whether or not their box score is complete: an
 * incomplete box score is still real production, and hiding it would lose true
 * numbers to fix a different problem.
 */

const STATSCOV = {
  TAB: 'StatsCoverage',
  COLUMNS: ['GameID', 'TeamID', 'SeasonID', 'Week', 'Phase',
            'Complete', 'MarkedBy', 'MarkedAt', 'Note'],
  /* An allowed figure built from one or two games is not a season's worth of
     anything, and on a board that ranks TOTALS it would lead by having played
     less. Below this a team is dropped from the allowed board and named in
     the footnotes rather than left in to win on a technicality. */
  MIN_GAMES: 3
};

function statsCovKey_(gameId, teamId) { return s_(gameId) + '|' + s_(teamId); }

function statsCovEnsureTab_() {
  if (hasTab_(STATSCOV.TAB)) return false;
  const sh = db_().insertSheet(STATSCOV.TAB);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, STATSCOV.COLUMNS.length).setValues([STATSCOV.COLUMNS])
    .setFontWeight('bold').setFontColor('#FFFFFF').setBackground('#1F3B54');
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  __tabMap = null;
  return true;
}

/**
 * GameID|TeamID -> true, for every box score marked complete.
 *
 * Absence is the answer for everything else, which is the whole point: a game
 * nobody has looked at is not complete, and a tab that does not exist yet
 * means nothing is.
 */
var __statsCovMap = null;
function statsCovMap_() {
  if (__statsCovMap) return __statsCovMap;
  const map = {};
  if (hasTab_(STATSCOV.TAB)) {
    rowsOf_(STATSCOV.TAB).forEach(function (r) {
      if (!isTrue_(r.Complete)) return;
      const g = s_(r.GameID), t = s_(r.TeamID);
      if (g && t) map[statsCovKey_(g, t)] = true;
    });
  }
  __statsCovMap = map;
  return map;
}

/** Is THIS team's box score for THIS game in? */
function statsCovComplete_(gameId, teamId) {
  return !!statsCovMap_()[statsCovKey_(gameId, teamId)];
}

// ── the admin's grid ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function statsCovAssertAdmin_() {
  const me = (typeof rosterWho_ === 'function') ? rosterWho_() : whoami_();
  if (!me || me.role !== 'ADMIN') throw new Error('Administrators only.');
  return me;
}

/** Every conference game in a season, oldest first, with both sides named. */
function statsCovGames_(seasonId) {
  const teams = statsTeamIndex_();
  const out = [];
  rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).forEach(function (g) {
    if (s_(g.SeasonID) !== seasonId) return;
    const home = s_(g.HomeTeamID), away = s_(g.AwayTeamID);
    // Both sides ours, or the allowed figure can never be built from it at all
    // and there is nothing for anybody to tick.
    if (!teams[home] || !teams[away]) return;
    out.push({ id: s_(g.GameID), week: num_(g.Week), phase: s_(g.Phase),
               order: gameOrder_(g), home: home, away: away,
               hs: numOrNull_(g.HomeScore), as: numOrNull_(g.AwayScore) });
  });
  out.sort(function (a, b) { return a.order - b.order; });
  return out;
}

/* Neither the grid nor the evidence is built here.
   apiStatsTracker in TeamAdmin.gs puts statsIn on every row it already draws,
   because it IS the same grid: the same school, the same week, the same game.
   A second checklist meant reading the same fifteen rows twice to answer "did
   it come in" and then "was all of it there" — and the tracker's own boxes
   already say what arrived, in more detail than a count of lines ever did. */

/**
 * Tick or untick. `marks` is [{gameId, teamId, complete}].
 *
 * The whole tab is rewritten in one go rather than cell by cell: it is a few
 * hundred rows at most, and a single write cannot leave half a save behind.
 */
function apiSetStatsCoverage_(marks) {
  const me = statsCovAssertAdmin_();
  if (!marks || !marks.length) return { saved: 0, message: 'Nothing to save.' };
  statsCovEnsureTab_();

  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(CONFIG.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS))
    throw new Error('Another save is in progress. Try again in a moment.');
  try {
    const games = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES), function (g) { return s_(g.GameID); });
    const existing = {};
    rowsOf_(STATSCOV.TAB).forEach(function (r) {
      const k = statsCovKey_(r.GameID, r.TeamID);
      if (k !== '|') existing[k] = r;
    });

    const stamp = new Date().toISOString();
    var saved = 0;
    marks.forEach(function (m) {
      const gid = s_(m.gameId), tid = s_(m.teamId);
      if (!gid || !tid) return;
      const g = games[gid];
      if (!g) return;                       // a tick for a game that is not there
      const k = statsCovKey_(gid, tid);
      const row = existing[k] || (existing[k] = { GameID: gid, TeamID: tid });
      row.SeasonID = s_(g.SeasonID);
      row.Week = num_(g.Week);
      row.Phase = s_(g.Phase);
      row.Complete = m.complete ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';
      row.MarkedBy = s_(me.email) || s_(me.userId) || 'admin';
      row.MarkedAt = stamp;
      saved++;
    });

    const out = Object.keys(existing).map(function (k) {
      const r = existing[k];
      const o = {};
      STATSCOV.COLUMNS.forEach(function (c) { o[c] = (r[c] === undefined ? '' : r[c]); });
      return o;
    });
    replaceRows_(STATSCOV.TAB, out, STATSCOV.COLUMNS);
    __statsCovMap = null;
    try { clearApiCache_(); } catch (ignore) {}
    return { saved: saved, message: saved + ' game' + (saved === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' updated.' };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**
 * Mark every played conference game in a season as received.
 *
 * For the seasons that are already history: they were imported wholesale and
 * are as complete as they are ever going to be, and leaving them unticked
 * would empty the allowed board for every year on the site. Going forward the
 * checklist is kept week by week.
 */
function apiBaselineStatsCoverage_(seasonId) {
  statsCovAssertAdmin_();
  seasonId = s_(seasonId) || CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  const marks = [];
  statsCovGames_(seasonId).forEach(function (g) {
    if (g.hs === null || g.as === null) return;      // not played is not received
    marks.push({ gameId: g.id, teamId: g.home, complete: true });
    marks.push({ gameId: g.id, teamId: g.away, complete: true });
  });
  if (!marks.length) return { saved: 0, message: 'No played conference games in ' + seasonId + '.' };
  const r = apiSetStatsCoverage_(marks);
  return { saved: r.saved,
           message: 'Baselined ' + seasonId + ': ' + r.saved + ' team-games marked received.' };
}

// ── from the spreadsheet menu ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function menuBaselineCoverage() {
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const seasons = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.SEASONS).map(function (r) { return s_(r.SeasonID); })
    .filter(Boolean);
  const ask = ui.prompt('Baseline stats coverage',
    'Mark every PLAYED conference game in a season as "stats received", so the ' +
    'Allowed boards can be built from it.\n\nSeasons: ' + seasons.join(', ') +
    '\n\nType one season ID, or ALL:', ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL);
  if (ask.getSelectedButton() !== ui.Button.OK) return;
  const want = s_(ask.getResponseText()).toUpperCase();
  if (!want) return;

  statsCovEnsureTab_();
  const list = (want === 'ALL') ? seasons : [s_(ask.getResponseText())];
  const said = [];
  list.forEach(function (sid) {
    const marks = [];
    statsCovGames_(sid).forEach(function (g) {
      if (g.hs === null || g.as === null) return;
      marks.push({ gameId: g.id, teamId: g.home, complete: true });
      marks.push({ gameId: g.id, teamId: g.away, complete: true });
    });
    if (!marks.length) { said.push(sid + ': no played conference games'); return; }
    said.push(sid + ': ' + statsCovWriteDirect_(marks) + ' team-games');
  });
  ui.alert('Stats coverage', said.join('\n') + '\n\nThe Allowed boards refresh within 15 minutes.',
           ui.ButtonSet.OK);
}

/**
 * The same write as apiSetStatsCoverage, without the sign-in check.
 *
 * The menu already runs as the workbook's owner — there is no portal session
 * behind it to check a role against, and asking for one would make the menu
 * item impossible to use from the very place the data lives.
 */
function statsCovWriteDirect_(marks) {
  statsCovEnsureTab_();
  const games = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES), function (g) { return s_(g.GameID); });
  const existing = {};
  rowsOf_(STATSCOV.TAB).forEach(function (r) {
    const k = statsCovKey_(r.GameID, r.TeamID);
    if (k !== '|') existing[k] = r;
  });
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString();
  var n = 0;
  marks.forEach(function (m) {
    const gid = s_(m.gameId), tid = s_(m.teamId);
    const g = games[gid];
    if (!gid || !tid || !g) return;
    const k = statsCovKey_(gid, tid);
    const row = existing[k] || (existing[k] = { GameID: gid, TeamID: tid });
    row.SeasonID = s_(g.SeasonID);
    row.Week = num_(g.Week);
    row.Phase = s_(g.Phase);
    row.Complete = m.complete ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';
    row.MarkedBy = 'menu';
    row.MarkedAt = stamp;
    n++;
  });
  const out = Object.keys(existing).map(function (k) {
    const r = existing[k], o = {};
    STATSCOV.COLUMNS.forEach(function (c) { o[c] = (r[c] === undefined ? '' : r[c]); });
    return o;
  });
  replaceRows_(STATSCOV.TAB, out, STATSCOV.COLUMNS);
  __statsCovMap = null;
  try { clearApiCache_(); } catch (ignore) {}
  return n;
}


===== src/StatsExtract.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — StatsExtract.gs
 *
 * Reads a box score out of whatever a coach sent - a photo, a PDF, a
 * spreadsheet, a paragraph - with the same Gemini key Blitz uses, into the
 * plain rows StatsImport understands. Two doors:
 *
 *   The inbox   Drop the files coaches send into the Drive folder
 *               "UCBAC Stats inbox" (made on first use). Stats > Read the
 *               inbox reads every file there, appends its rows to the
 *               StatsImport tab, and moves the file to a "done" folder
 *               inside. Then dry run, then APPLY, as with any import.
 *   The portal  A coach uploads a file against a game. It is read at once,
 *               matched to his roster, and written as FILE_IMPORT: official
 *               on landing, replaced by his next upload for the same game.
 *               Names that do not match go to the StatsImport tab for a
 *               person. The file is still mailed to the administrators, as
 *               it always was.
 *
 * The model is asked only for numbers it can see. It is handed the roster,
 * so "J. Smith" comes back as the roster's spelling when that is the only
 * Smith, and it is told the site's conventions: sacks apart from tackles
 * for loss, a lone tackle count as solo tackles, a blank where the sheet
 * is blank. Every reading still passes through the resolver and the
 * review queue; nothing the model says is published as official on its
 * own word.
 */

const STATSEXTRACT = {
  INBOX: 'UCBAC Stats inbox',
  DONE: 'done',
  FOLDER_PROP: 'STATS_INBOX_FOLDER',
  MAX_BYTES: 12 * 1024 * 1024,
  MAX_PLAYERS: 120,
  MAX_TRIES: 3,
  MAX_OUTPUT: 8000,
  TEXT: { 'text/plain': 1, 'text/csv': 1, 'text/tab-separated-values': 1, 'text/markdown': 1, 'application/json': 1 },
  INLINE: { 'image/jpeg': 1, 'image/png': 1, 'image/webp': 1, 'image/heic': 1, 'image/heif': 1, 'application/pdf': 1 },
  // office files go through Drive: uploaded as a Google file, exported as text
  CONVERT: {
    'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet':
      { to: 'application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet', out: 'text/csv' },
    'application/vnd.ms-excel':
      { to: 'application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet', out: 'text/csv' },
    'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document':
      { to: 'application/vnd.google-apps.document', out: 'text/plain' },
    'application/msword':
      { to: 'application/vnd.google-apps.document', out: 'text/plain' }
  },
  BY_EXT: { jpg: 'image/jpeg', jpeg: 'image/jpeg', png: 'image/png', webp: 'image/webp', heic: 'image/heic',
            heif: 'image/heif', pdf: 'application/pdf', csv: 'text/csv', txt: 'text/plain', tsv: 'text/tab-separated-values',
            md: 'text/markdown', xlsx: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
            xls: 'application/vnd.ms-excel',
            docx: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', doc: 'application/msword' }
};

/** What the model is asked to return: the site's own fields, nothing else. */
function seSchema_() {
  const stat = { type: 'INTEGER' }, half = { type: 'NUMBER' };
  const player = { name: { type: 'STRING' }, jersey: { type: 'INTEGER' } };
  STATSIMPORT.FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
    player[f] = TEAMADMIN.HALF_FIELDS.indexOf(f) >= 0 ? half : stat;
  });
  return {
    type: 'OBJECT',
    properties: {
      team: { type: 'STRING' }, opponent: { type: 'STRING' }, week: { type: 'INTEGER' },
      gameDate: { type: 'STRING' }, teamScore: { type: 'INTEGER' }, opponentScore: { type: 'INTEGER' },
      players: { type: 'ARRAY', items: { type: 'OBJECT', properties: player, required: ['name'] } },
      notes: { type: 'STRING' }
    },
    required: ['players']
  };
}

/** The standing instruction: what the numbers mean here. */
function seRules_(ctx) {
  const lines = [
    'You read American high school football box scores for a statistics site. Return JSON only.',
    'Extract per-player statistics for ONE team from the document. Use only numbers you can see; never invent, estimate or total.',
    'Fields: ' + STATSIMPORT.FIELDS.join(', ') + '. Omit a field the document does not give. Never write 0 for a blank.',
    'Conventions: a single "tackles" number goes in TackleSolo; a solo/assist split goes in TackleSolo and TackleAssist.',
    'Sacks and TFL (tackles for loss) are separate; do not count a sack as a TFL unless the document does.',
    'Passing: PassComp is completions, PassAtt attempts, PassInt interceptions THROWN. Int is interceptions CAUGHT by a defender.',
    'PassDef is pass break-ups. FF forced fumbles, FR fumble recoveries, DefTD defensive touchdowns. RushFum/RecFum are fumbles lost.',
    '"2-point conversions" have no field: leave them out. Kick returns KR/KRYds, punt returns PR/PRYds.',
    'Blocks is blocked kicks - a punt, field goal or extra point stopped at the line. Box scores often print it under defense; it belongs in Blocks.',
    'Skip rows that are team totals, opponents, or coaches. A name written twice in different sections is one player.',
    'jersey: the number beside the name if shown. name: the player as written, with the roster\'s spelling when one roster name clearly matches.',
    'team, opponent, week, gameDate, teamScore, opponentScore: fill from the document when present, else omit.'
  ];
  if (ctx && ctx.team) lines.push('The team is ' + ctx.team + (ctx.opponent ? ', playing ' + ctx.opponent : '') + (ctx.week ? ', week ' + ctx.week : '') + '.');
  if (ctx && ctx.roster && ctx.roster.length) {
    lines.push('ROSTER (name #jersey): ' + ctx.roster.map(function (r) { return r.name + (r.jersey !== null && r.jersey !== undefined ? ' #' + r.jersey : ''); }).join('; '));
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/** A file's parts for the request: text as text, images and PDFs inline, office files converted. */
function seParts_(fileName, mimeType, bytes) {
  var mime = s_(mimeType).toLowerCase().split(';')[0];
  const ext = (String(fileName || '').toLowerCase().match(/\.([a-z0-9]+)$/) || [])[1] || '';
  if (!mime || mime === 'application/octet-stream') mime = STATSEXTRACT.BY_EXT[ext] || mime;
  if (STATSEXTRACT.TEXT[mime] || (mime.indexOf('text/') === 0)) {
    return [{ text: 'DOCUMENT (' + fileName + '):\n' + Utilities.newBlob(bytes).getDataAsString().slice(0, 60000) }];
  }
  if (STATSEXTRACT.INLINE[mime]) {
    return [{ inlineData: { mimeType: mime, data: Utilities.base64Encode(bytes) } }];
  }
  const conv = STATSEXTRACT.CONVERT[mime];
  if (conv) {
    return [{ text: 'DOCUMENT (' + fileName + ', converted to text):\n' + seConvertToText_(fileName, mime, bytes, conv).slice(0, 60000) }];
  }
  throw new Error('"' + fileName + '" is a ' + (mime || ext || 'file') + ', which cannot be read. Send a photo, PDF, spreadsheet, Word file or plain text.');
}

/**
 * An office file -> text, by way of Drive: uploaded converting to the Google
 * kind, exported as text, deleted. All through the REST API with the
 * script's own token, so no extra service or scope is needed.
 */
function seConvertToText_(fileName, mime, bytes, conv) {
  const token = ScriptApp.getOAuthToken();
  const boundary = 'ucbac' + Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g, '');
  const meta = JSON.stringify({ name: 'stats-extract ' + fileName, mimeType: conv.to });
  const body = Utilities.newBlob(
    '--' + boundary + '\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n' + meta + '\r\n' +
    '--' + boundary + '\r\nContent-Type: ' + mime + '\r\n\r\n').getBytes()
    .concat(bytes)
    .concat(Utilities.newBlob('\r\n--' + boundary + '--').getBytes());
  const up = UrlFetchApp.fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart', {
    method: 'post', contentType: 'multipart/related; boundary=' + boundary,
    headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }, payload: body, muteHttpExceptions: true
  });
  if (up.getResponseCode() !== 200)
    throw new Error('Drive would not convert "' + fileName + '" (' + up.getResponseCode() + ').');
  const id = s_(JSON.parse(up.getContentText()).id);
  try {
    const ex = UrlFetchApp.fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/' + encodeURIComponent(id) +
      '/export?mimeType=' + encodeURIComponent(conv.out),
      { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }, muteHttpExceptions: true });
    if (ex.getResponseCode() !== 200)
      throw new Error('Drive would not export "' + fileName + '" as text (' + ex.getResponseCode() + ').');
    return ex.getContentText();
  } finally {
    try { UrlFetchApp.fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/' + encodeURIComponent(id),
      { method: 'delete', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }, muteHttpExceptions: true }); } catch (e) {}
  }
}

/**
 * Ask the model for JSON in the shape of seSchema(). The remembered model
 * first, then the best of the list, as Blitz does; a request the model
 * rejects for its thinking settings is sent again without them.
 */
function seGenerate_(parts, ctx) {
  if (__AUTH_BOUND && !blitzAccess_(accountsWhoami_()).allowed)
    throw new Error("Automatic reading is unavailable for this account.");
  const key = chatKey_();
  if (!key) throw new Error('The reader is not switched on: no ' + CHAT.KEY_PROP + ' in Script Properties.');
  const props_ = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const pinned = String(props_.getProperty(CHAT.MODEL_PROP) || '').trim();
  var models = pinned ? [pinned] : chatDiscoverModels_().slice(0, STATSEXTRACT.MAX_TRIES);
  var expanded = !pinned;
  if (!models.length) throw new Error('No model is available to read the file.');

  const base = {
    systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: seRules_(ctx) }] },
    contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: parts.concat([{ text: 'Extract the box score as JSON.' }]) }]
  };
  const shapes = [
    { temperature: 0, maxOutputTokens: STATSEXTRACT.MAX_OUTPUT, responseMimeType: 'application/json',
      responseSchema: seSchema_(), thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 0 } },
    { temperature: 0, maxOutputTokens: STATSEXTRACT.MAX_OUTPUT, responseMimeType: 'application/json',
      responseSchema: seSchema_() }
  ];
  var lastErr = '', tried = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < models.length && tried.length < STATSEXTRACT.MAX_TRIES; i++) {
    const m = models[i];
    tried.push(m);
    var code = 0, text = '';
    for (var sh = 0; sh < shapes.length; sh++) {
      const res = UrlFetchApp.fetch(
        'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/' + encodeURIComponent(m) +
        ':generateContent?key=' + encodeURIComponent(key),
        { method: 'post', contentType: 'application/json', muteHttpExceptions: true,
          payload: JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: base.systemInstruction, contents: base.contents,
                                    generationConfig: shapes[sh] }) });
      code = res.getResponseCode();
      if (code === 400 && sh === 0) { lastErr = 'thinkingConfig refused'; continue; }
      if (code !== 200) { lastErr = 'HTTP ' + code + ' from ' + m + ': ' + res.getContentText().slice(0, 200); break; }
      var parsed;
      try { parsed = JSON.parse(res.getContentText()); } catch (e) { lastErr = 'bad JSON envelope'; break; }
      const cand = (parsed.candidates || [])[0] || {};
      text = ((cand.content || {}).parts || []).map(function (p) { return s_(p.text); }).join('').trim();
      if (text) break;
      lastErr = 'empty answer from ' + m;
    }
    if (code === 200 && text) {
      var data;
      try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { lastErr = m + ' returned text that is not JSON'; data = null; }
      if (data && Array.isArray(data.players)) {
        if (m !== pinned) props_.setProperty(CHAT.MODEL_PROP, m);
        data.model = m;
        return data;
      }
    }
    if (m === pinned && (code === 404 || code === 429 || code === 503)) props_.deleteProperty(CHAT.MODEL_PROP);
    if (!expanded) {
      expanded = true;
      chatDiscoverModels_().forEach(function (n) { if (tried.indexOf(n) < 0 && models.indexOf(n) < 0) models.push(n); });
    }
  }
  throw new Error('The file could not be read. Tried ' + tried.join(', ') + '. ' + lastErr);
}

/**
 * A file -> what the model read: { team, opponent, week, players: [{ name,
 * jersey, <fields> }], notes, model }. Numbers are cleaned here: blanks
 * stay blank, anything that is not a number is dropped.
 */
function seExtract_(fileName, mimeType, bytes, ctx) {
  if (!bytes || !bytes.length) throw new Error('"' + fileName + '" is empty.');
  if (bytes.length > STATSEXTRACT.MAX_BYTES) throw new Error('"' + fileName + '" is over 12 MB.');
  const data = seGenerate_(seParts_(fileName, mimeType, bytes), ctx);
  const players = [];
  (data.players || []).slice(0, STATSEXTRACT.MAX_PLAYERS).forEach(function (p) {
    if (!p || !s_(p.name)) return;
    const row = { name: s_(p.name).slice(0, 60), jersey: num_(p.jersey) };
    var any = false;
    STATSIMPORT.FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
      const v = numOrNull_(p[f]);
      if (v === null) return;
      row[f] = v; any = true;
    });
    if (any) players.push(row);
  });
  return { team: s_(data.team), opponent: s_(data.opponent), week: num_(data.week), gameDate: s_(data.gameDate),
           teamScore: num_(data.teamScore), opponentScore: num_(data.opponentScore),
           players: players, notes: s_(data.notes).slice(0, 300), model: s_(data.model) };
}

/** The reading as StatsImport rows, School/Week/Opponent as given or as read. */
function seRows_(read, school, week, opponent, tag) {
  return read.players.map(function (p) {
    const row = { School: school || read.team, Week: week !== undefined && week !== '' ? week : (read.week === null ? '' : read.week),
                  Opponent: opponent || read.opponent, Player: p.name, '#': p.jersey === null ? '' : p.jersey,
                  Result: 'EXTRACTED', Note: tag || '' };
    STATSIMPORT.FIELDS.forEach(function (f) { if (p[f] !== undefined) row[f] = p[f]; });
    return row;
  });
}

// ── the inbox ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** The inbox folder, made in My Drive on first use and remembered by id. */
function seInboxFolder_() {
  const props_ = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const id = String(props_.getProperty(STATSEXTRACT.FOLDER_PROP) || '');
  if (id) { try { return DriveApp.getFolderById(id); } catch (e) {} }
  const it = DriveApp.getFoldersByName(STATSEXTRACT.INBOX);
  const folder = it.hasNext() ? it.next() : DriveApp.createFolder(STATSEXTRACT.INBOX);
  props_.setProperty(STATSEXTRACT.FOLDER_PROP, folder.getId());
  return folder;
}

function seDoneFolder_(inbox) {
  const it = inbox.getFoldersByName(STATSEXTRACT.DONE);
  return it.hasNext() ? it.next() : inbox.createFolder(STATSEXTRACT.DONE);
}

/**
 * Read every file in the inbox onto the StatsImport tab. The school is
 * whatever the document says, resolved against the Teams tab; a school or
 * week the model could not tell is left blank for a person to fill in
 * before the dry run. Files are moved to "done" once read.
 */
function seReadInbox_() {
  const inbox = seInboxFolder_();
  const done = seDoneFolder_(inbox);
  const out = ['READ THE INBOX — ' + inbox.getName()];
  const files = inbox.getFiles();
  var n = 0;
  while (files.hasNext()) {
    const f = files.next();
    n++;
    const name = f.getName();
    try {
      const read = seExtract_(name, f.getMimeType(), f.getBlob().getBytes(), null);
      const teamId = siTeamByName_(read.team);
      // the document's own words stay on the row either way, as a clue for
      // the person who has to fill in the school
      const school = teamId ? teamNameOf_(teamId) : read.team;
      const rows = seRows_(read, school, read.week === null ? '' : read.week, read.opponent, 'from ' + name +
                          (read.model ? ' (' + read.model + ')' : '') + (read.notes ? ' — ' + read.notes : ''));
      siAppend_(rows);
      f.moveTo(done);
      out.push('  ' + name + ': ' + rows.length + ' players' +
               (teamId ? ' for ' + school
                       : ' — school not recognized' + (read.team ? ' ("' + read.team + '")' : '') + ', fill in the School column') +
               (read.week !== null ? ', week ' + read.week : ', week unknown') +
               (read.opponent ? ' vs ' + read.opponent : ''));
    } catch (e) {
      out.push('  ' + name + ': NOT READ — ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
    }
  }
  if (!n) out.push('  The folder is empty. Drop the coaches\' files in and run this again.');
  else out.push('Next: Stats > Import (dry run), check the Result column, then Import (APPLY).');
  return out.join('\n');
}

// ── the portal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * A coach's upload against one of his games: read, matched to his roster,
 * written as FILE_IMPORT - official, overwriting whatever the game held for
 * those players, so an upload can be repeated for any game at any time.
 * Returns what happened, for the message back to him. Throws only when
 * nothing could be read; a name that does not match is not an error, it is
 * a row on the StatsImport tab for the administrator.
 */
function statsExtractForPortal_(me, gameId, fileName, mimeType, bytes) {
  if (!blitzAccess_(me).allowed) throw new Error("Automatic reading is unavailable for this account.");
  const teamId = s_(me.teamId);
  const seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  const g = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).filter(function (x) { return s_(x.GameID) === s_(gameId); })[0];
  if (!g) throw new Error('Unknown game ' + gameId + '.');
  if (s_(g.HomeTeamID) !== teamId && s_(g.AwayTeamID) !== teamId)
    throw new Error('That game is not ' + (teamNameOf_(teamId) || 'your team') + '\'s.');
  const opponent = s_(g.HomeTeamID) === teamId ? s_(g.AwayTeamName) : s_(g.HomeTeamName);
  const roster = siRoster_(teamId, s_(g.SeasonID) || seasonId);
  const read = seExtract_(fileName, mimeType, bytes,
                         { team: teamNameOf_(teamId), opponent: opponent, week: num_(g.Week), roster: roster });

  const lines = [], matched = [], unmatched = [];
  read.players.forEach(function (p) {
    const who = siResolvePlayer_(roster, p.name, p.jersey);
    if (who.error) { unmatched.push(p); return; }
    const L = siLines_(p, who.pid);
    if (L.error || !L.lines.length) { unmatched.push(p); return; }
    L.lines.forEach(function (l) { lines.push(l); });
    matched.push({ name: who.name, how: who.how });
  });

  var saved = 0, refused = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i += TEAMADMIN.MAX_STAT_ROWS) {
    const res = teamAdminWriteStats_(me, s_(g.GameID), teamId, lines.slice(i, i + TEAMADMIN.MAX_STAT_ROWS),
                                    { sourceType: 'FILE_IMPORT' });
    saved += res.saved || 0;
    refused = refused.concat(res.refused || []);
  }
  if (unmatched.length) {
    siAppend_(seRows_({ players: unmatched, team: teamNameOf_(teamId), opponent: opponent, week: num_(g.Week) },
                    teamNameOf_(teamId), num_(g.Week), opponent,
                    'portal upload ' + fileName + ' by ' + me.email + ': not on the roster'));
  }
  return { read: read.players.length, matched: matched, unmatched: unmatched.map(function (p) { return p.name; }),
           saved: saved, refused: refused, model: read.model, notes: read.notes };
}

// ── menu and editor entry points ────────────────────────────────────────────
function menuStatsInbox_()  { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(seReadInbox_()); }
function statsReadInbox_()  { Logger.log(seReadInbox_()); }
function menuStatsInboxOpen_() {
  const f = seInboxFolder_();
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Drop coaches\' files into the Drive folder "' + f.getName() + '":\n' + f.getUrl() +
                               '\n\nThen Stats > Read the inbox.');
}


===== src/StatsImport.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — StatsImport.gs
 *
 * A box score arrives as whatever a coach has: a photo of a notebook page,
 * a spreadsheet in his own layout, a paragraph of text. Getting it into
 * PlayerGameStats used to mean an administrator normalizing it by hand and
 * pasting forty-eight-column rows into the tab, one PlayerID at a time.
 * This file is the tab and the menu that replace the paste:
 *
 *   StatsImport tab     one row per player per game, in plain columns -
 *                       School, Week, Opponent, Player, #, then the stat
 *                       fields by name. A person can fill it; so can the
 *                       extractor in StatsExtract.gs reading a coach's file.
 *   Stats > Import (dry run)   resolves every row - which game, which
 *                       player - and writes the answer beside it, in the
 *                       Result and Note columns. Nothing else moves.
 *   Stats > Import (APPLY)     writes the resolved rows through the very
 *                       path the coach portal uses (teamAdminWriteStats), so
 *                       a line landed here is indistinguishable from one a
 *                       coach typed: GAME grain, one row per category,
 *                       an existing line updated rather than duplicated.
 *
 * Nothing is guessed silently. A name that is not on the roster exactly is
 * matched by jersey, by initial and surname, or by surname alone - and only
 * when that leaves ONE candidate. The row says how it was matched. Anything
 * else is refused with a reason and left on the tab for a person.
 */

const STATSIMPORT = {
  TAB: 'StatsImport',
  KEYS: ['School', 'Week', 'Opponent', 'Player', '#'],
  // the stat columns, in the order a coach reads a box score
  FIELDS: ['PassAtt', 'PassComp', 'PassYds', 'PassTD', 'PassInt',
           'RushAtt', 'RushYds', 'RushTD', 'RushFum',
           'Rec', 'RecYds', 'RecTD', 'RecFum', 'Pancakes',
           'TackleSolo', 'TackleAssist', 'TFL', 'Sacks', 'Int', 'FF', 'FR', 'PassDef', 'DefTD',
           'FGM', 'FGA', 'XPM', 'XPA', 'Punts', 'PuntYds', 'KR', 'KRYds', 'PR', 'PRYds',
           'Blocks'],
  OUT: ['Result', 'Note'],
  // an administrator's import is the official line
  SOURCE: 'COACH_ENTRY',
  // how a school is written on a coach's sheet, beyond its display name
  ALIASES: {
    cmw: 'C. Milton Wright', cmilton: 'C. Milton Wright', miltonwright: 'C. Milton Wright',
    bomanor: 'Bohemia Manor', bohemia: 'Bohemia Manor', bmhs: 'Bohemia Manor',
    hdg: 'Havre de Grace', havre: 'Havre de Grace',
    pmill: 'Patterson Mill', pm: 'Patterson Mill', pmhs: 'Patterson Mill',
    nh: 'North Harford', nhhs: 'North Harford', ne: 'North East', nehs: 'North East',
    ht: 'Harford Tech', tech: 'Harford Tech', hths: 'Harford Tech', harfordtechnical: 'Harford Tech',
    joppa: 'Joppatowne', jhs: 'Joppatowne', rs: 'Rising Sun', rshs: 'Rising Sun',
    bahs: 'Bel Air', belair: 'Bel Air', ehs: 'Elkton', fhs: 'Fallston', ahs: 'Aberdeen',
    phs: 'Perryville', ewhs: 'Edgewood'
  }
};

function siHeader_() { return STATSIMPORT.KEYS.concat(STATSIMPORT.FIELDS, STATSIMPORT.OUT); }

/** letters and digits only, lower case: "Ke'Mar Parsons" and "kemar parsons" agree */
function siNorm_(v) { return String(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : v).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); }

/** the same without a generational suffix, so "DJ Webster Jr." meets "DJ Webster" */
function siNormBare_(v) {
  return siNorm_(String(v || '').replace(/[,.\s]+(jr|sr|ii|iii|iv)\.?\s*$/i, ''));
}

/** The tab, created with its header the first time it is asked for. */
function siEnsureTab_() {
  if (hasTab_(STATSIMPORT.TAB)) return getTab_(STATSIMPORT.TAB);
  const sh = db_().insertSheet(STATSIMPORT.TAB);
  const h = siHeader_();
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, h.length).setValues([h]).setFontWeight('bold');
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  sh.setFrozenColumns(4);
  delete __tableCache[STATSIMPORT.TAB];
  return sh;
}

/** Rows keyed by header name, appended under whatever header the tab has. */
function siAppend_(rows) {
  if (!rows || !rows.length) return 0;
  siEnsureTab_();
  return appendRows_(STATSIMPORT.TAB, rows);
}

/** Who is writing when the menu runs: the sheet's owner, an administrator. */
function siMe_() {
  var email = '';
  try { email = String(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail() || ''); } catch (e) { email = ''; }
  return { email: email || 'sheet', role: 'ADMIN', teamId: '' };
}

/**
 * A school as a coach writes it -> its TeamID. Display name, school name,
 * slug, id, an alias, or a unique prefix of the display name.
 */
function siTeamByName_(name) {
  const want = siNorm_(name);
  if (!want) return '';
  const teams = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.TEAMS);
  var hit = '';
  teams.forEach(function (t) {
    if (hit) return;
    if (siNorm_(t.TeamID) === want || siNorm_(t.DisplayName) === want ||
        siNorm_(t.SchoolName) === want || siNorm_(t.Slug) === want) hit = s_(t.TeamID);
  });
  if (hit) return hit;
  const alias = STATSIMPORT.ALIASES[want];
  if (alias) return siTeamByName_(alias);
  const pref = teams.filter(function (t) { return siNorm_(t.DisplayName).indexOf(want) === 0; });
  return pref.length === 1 ? s_(pref[0].TeamID) : '';
}

/**
 * The game a row belongs to. `week` may be a week number or a GameID;
 * `opponent` settles a week with two games (Fallston's week 4) and may
 * stand alone when the week is blank. Returns { game } or { error }.
 */
function siResolveGame_(teamId, week, opponent) {
  const seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  const mine = rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.GAMES).filter(function (g) {
    return s_(g.SeasonID) === seasonId && (s_(g.HomeTeamID) === teamId || s_(g.AwayTeamID) === teamId);
  });
  const wk = s_(week);
  if (/^GAME-/i.test(wk)) {
    const g = mine.filter(function (x) { return s_(x.GameID).toUpperCase() === wk.toUpperCase(); })[0];
    return g ? { game: g } : { error: 'Game ' + wk + ' is not one of ' + (teamNameOf_(teamId) || teamId) + '\'s ' + seasonId.replace('SEA-', '') + ' games.' };
  }
  const n = num_(wk);
  const opp = siNorm_(opponent);
  if (n === null && !opp) return { error: 'Give the week (or the GameID) and, if the week had two games, the opponent.' };
  var cands = n === null ? mine.slice() : mine.filter(function (g) { return num_(g.Week) === n; });
  if (opp) {
    const oppId = siTeamByName_(opponent);
    cands = cands.filter(function (g) {
      const other = s_(g.HomeTeamID) === teamId ? { id: s_(g.AwayTeamID), name: s_(g.AwayTeamName) }
                                                 : { id: s_(g.HomeTeamID), name: s_(g.HomeTeamName) };
      if (oppId && other.id === oppId) return true;
      const on = siNorm_(other.name);
      return !!on && (on === opp || on.indexOf(opp) === 0 || opp.indexOf(on) === 0);
    });
  }
  if (cands.length === 1) return { game: cands[0] };
  if (!cands.length) {
    if (n === null && !opp) return { error: 'Give the week (or the GameID) and, if the week had two games, the opponent.' };
    return { error: (teamNameOf_(teamId) || teamId) + ' has no ' + seasonId.replace('SEA-', '') + ' game' +
                    (n !== null ? ' in week ' + n : '') + (opp ? ' against "' + s_(opponent) + '"' : '') + '.' };
  }
  return { error: (teamNameOf_(teamId) || teamId) + ' has ' + cands.length + ' games' +
                  (n !== null ? ' in week ' + n : '') + ': name the opponent (' +
                  cands.map(function (g) { return s_(g.HomeTeamID) === teamId ? s_(g.AwayTeamName) : s_(g.HomeTeamName); }).join(', ') + ').' };
}

/** A team's roster for the season: what a stat line may be attached to. */
function siRoster_(teamId, seasonId) {
  const players = indexBy_(rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYERS), function (p) { return s_(p.PlayerID); });
  return rowsOf_(CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_SEASONS).filter(function (r) {
    return s_(r.TeamID) === teamId && s_(r.SeasonID) === seasonId && s_(r.PlayerID);
  }).map(function (r) {
    const p = players[s_(r.PlayerID)] || {};
    const name = s_(p.DisplayName) || s_(r.DisplayName) || s_(r.PlayerID);
    const parts = name.replace(/[,.\s]+(jr|sr|ii|iii|iv)\.?\s*$/i, '').trim().split(/\s+/);
    return { pid: s_(r.PlayerID), name: name, norm: siNorm_(name), bare: siNormBare_(name),
             jersey: num_(r.Jersey), first: siNorm_(parts[0] || ''), last: siNorm_(parts[parts.length - 1] || '') };
  });
}

/**
 * Which roster player a written name is. Exact first; then the safe
 * fallbacks, each only when it leaves one candidate. Returns
 * { pid, name, how } or { error, near }.
 */
function siResolvePlayer_(roster, name, jersey) {
  const raw = s_(name);
  const nm = siNorm_(raw), bare = siNormBare_(raw), j = num_(jersey);
  const one = function (list, how) {
    return list.length === 1 ? { pid: list[0].pid, name: list[0].name, how: how } : null;
  };
  var hit = null;
  if (nm) {
    const exact = roster.filter(function (r) { return r.norm === nm || r.bare === bare; });
    hit = one(roster.filter(function (r) { return r.norm === nm; }), 'exact') ||
          one(roster.filter(function (r) { return r.bare === bare; }), 'exact');
    if (hit) return hit;
    /* The name is on the roster more than once. Wearing the same number it
       is one player entered twice, and nothing typed on this tab can choose
       between two ids - the roster has to be mended first. */
    if (exact.length > 1) {
      // a number on the row picks between two people who share a name
      if (j !== null) {
        hit = one(exact.filter(function (r) { return r.jersey === j; }), 'jersey');
        if (hit) return hit;
      }
      const nums = exact.map(function (r) { return r.jersey === null ? 'no number' : '#' + r.jersey; });
      const same = nums.every(function (n) { return n === nums[0]; });
      return { error: '"' + raw + '" is on the roster ' + exact.length + ' times (' + nums.join(', ') + ')' +
                      (same ? ' - one player entered twice. Run UCBAC Stats > Maintenance > Merge split players (dry run), then (APPLY), and import again.'
                            : ' - if that is one player, remove the extra row on the portal Roster tab; if two, give the number here.'),
               near: exact.map(function (r) { return r.name + (r.jersey !== null ? ' #' + r.jersey : ''); }) };
    }
  }
  // the written name split the same way the roster's was
  const parts = raw.replace(/[,.\s]+(jr|sr|ii|iii|iv)\.?\s*$/i, '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const first = siNorm_(parts[0] || ''), last = siNorm_(parts[parts.length - 1] || '');
  const surname = parts.length >= 2 ? last : (parts.length === 1 ? first : '');
  if (j !== null) {
    const byJ = roster.filter(function (r) { return r.jersey === j; });
    // a jersey is trusted when the name does not contradict it
    hit = one(byJ.filter(function (r) { return !surname || r.last === surname || (parts.length === 1 && r.first === first); }), 'jersey');
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  if (parts.length >= 2 && surname) {
    hit = one(roster.filter(function (r) { return r.last === surname && r.first.charAt(0) === first.charAt(0); }), 'initial');
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  if (surname) {
    hit = one(roster.filter(function (r) { return r.last === surname; }), 'surname');
    if (hit) return hit;
  }
  const near = roster.filter(function (r) {
    return (surname && r.last === surname) || (j !== null && r.jersey === j);
  }).map(function (r) { return r.name + (r.jersey !== null ? ' #' + r.jersey : ''); });
  return { error: raw ? '"' + raw + '"' + (j !== null ? ' #' + j : '') + ' is not on the roster' : 'no player name',
           near: near };
}

/**
 * One tab row -> the category lines the writer takes, or { error }.
 * Blank cells are absent, never zero; a cell that is not a number refuses
 * the whole row, since half a line is worse than none.
 */
function siLines_(row, playerId) {
  const out = [];
  var bad = '';
  TEAMADMIN.CATEGORY_ORDER.forEach(function (cat) {
    const line = { playerId: playerId, category: cat };
    var any = false;
    TEAMADMIN.CATEGORIES[cat].forEach(function (f) {
      if (STATSIMPORT.FIELDS.indexOf(f) < 0) return;
      const v = row[f];
      if (v === '' || v === null || v === undefined) return;
      const n = numOrNull_(v);
      if (n === null) { bad = bad || (f + ' "' + v + '" is not a number'); return; }
      line[f] = n; any = true;
    });
    if (any) out.push(line);
  });
  if (bad) return { error: bad };
  return { lines: out };
}

/**
 * The run. `apply` false writes only Result and Note beside every row;
 * true also writes the resolved lines to PlayerGameStats. Returns the
 * report as text, for the menu dialog or the log.
 */
function siRun_(apply) {
  const me = siMe_();
  const sh = siEnsureTab_();
  const values = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const head = values[0].map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); });
  const col = {};
  head.forEach(function (h, i) { if (h && col[h] === undefined) col[h] = i; });
  ['School', 'Player'].forEach(function (c) {
    if (col[c] === undefined) throw new Error(STATSIMPORT.TAB + ' has no ' + c + ' column. The header is: ' + siHeader_().join(', '));
  });
  // Result and Note live at the end; added if a hand-made tab lacks them
  STATSIMPORT.OUT.forEach(function (c) {
    if (col[c] === undefined) {
      const at = head.length;
      sh.getRange(1, at + 1).setValue(c).setFontWeight('bold');
      head.push(c); col[c] = at;
    }
  });
  if (values.length < 2) return STATSIMPORT.TAB + ' is empty. Paste rows under the header: ' + siHeader_().join(', ') + '.';

  const seasonId = CONFIG.CURRENT_SEASON;
  const rosters = {}, games = {}, groups = {};
  const results = [];        // [sheetRow, Result, Note]
  const refusals = [];       // { row, who, why } - the dialog says WHY, not just how many
  var counted = 0, resolved = 0, refused = 0;

  for (var r = 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    const v = values[r];
    const cell = function (c) { return col[c] === undefined ? '' : v[col[c]]; };
    const row = {};
    head.forEach(function (h, i) { row[h] = v[i]; });
    const blank = STATSIMPORT.KEYS.concat(STATSIMPORT.FIELDS).every(function (c) {
      const x = cell(c); return x === '' || x === null || x === undefined;
    });
    if (blank) continue;
    counted++;
    const note = function (res, why) {
      results.push([r + 1, res, why || '']);
      if (res.indexOf('REFUSED') === 0) {
        refused++;
        refusals.push({ row: r + 1, who: s_(cell('Player')) || s_(cell('School')) || '(blank)', why: why || '' });
      }
    };

    const teamId = siTeamByName_(cell('School'));
    if (!teamId) { note('REFUSED', 'school "' + s_(cell('School')) + '" is not a UCBAC team'); continue; }
    const gk = teamId + '|' + s_(cell('Week')) + '|' + s_(cell('Opponent'));
    if (!games[gk]) games[gk] = siResolveGame_(teamId, cell('Week'), cell('Opponent'));
    if (games[gk].error) { note('REFUSED', games[gk].error); continue; }
    const g = games[gk].game;
    if (!rosters[teamId]) rosters[teamId] = siRoster_(teamId, seasonId);
    const who = siResolvePlayer_(rosters[teamId], cell('Player'), cell('#'));
    if (who.error) {
      note('REFUSED', who.error + (who.near && who.near.length ? '. Did you mean: ' + who.near.join(', ') + '?' : ''));
      continue;
    }
    const lines = siLines_(row, who.pid);
    if (lines.error) { note('REFUSED', lines.error); continue; }
    if (!lines.lines.length) { note('REFUSED', 'no statistics on the row'); continue; }

    const gid = s_(g.GameID);
    const grp = groups[teamId + '|' + gid] || (groups[teamId + '|' + gid] = { teamId: teamId, gameId: gid, game: g, rows: [] });
    grp.rows.push({ sheetRow: r + 1, pid: who.pid, name: who.name, how: who.how, lines: lines.lines });
    resolved++;
    const opp = s_(g.HomeTeamID) === teamId ? s_(g.AwayTeamName) : s_(g.HomeTeamName);
    note('RESOLVED', who.name + (who.how !== 'exact' ? ' (matched by ' + who.how + ')' : '') +
         ' · ' + gid + ' week ' + s_(g.Week) + ' vs ' + opp + ' · ' +
         lines.lines.map(function (l) { return l.category; }).join('/'));
  }

  const out = [];
  out.push((apply ? 'STATS IMPORT' : 'STATS IMPORT — DRY RUN') + ' for ' + seasonId);
  out.push('Rows read: ' + counted + ' · resolved: ' + resolved + ' · refused: ' + refused);
  /* A count of refusals is nothing a person can act on. Each one, with the
     row it sits on, who the row names, and the reason - the same words
     written beside it in the Note column. */
  if (refusals.length) {
    const SHOW = 40;
    out.push('');
    /* A refusal is about its own row and nothing else - every other row is
       written regardless. Saying "fix these, then run again" read as a
       precondition and stopped an import that was ready to go, so it says what
       it means: these rows wait, the rest do not. */
    out.push('REFUSED - these ' + refusals.length + ' rows only. The other ' +
             resolved + ' are unaffected and will be written:');
    refusals.slice(0, SHOW).forEach(function (x) {
      out.push('  row ' + x.row + ' · ' + x.who + ': ' + x.why);
    });
    if (refusals.length > SHOW)
      out.push('  ... and ' + (refusals.length - SHOW) + ' more; every row\'s reason is in its Note column');
    out.push('');
  }
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function (k) {
    const grp = groups[k];
    const opp = s_(grp.game.HomeTeamID) === grp.teamId ? s_(grp.game.AwayTeamName) : s_(grp.game.HomeTeamName);
    out.push('  ' + (teamNameOf_(grp.teamId) || grp.teamId) + ' · ' + grp.gameId + ' week ' + s_(grp.game.Week) +
             ' vs ' + opp + ': ' + grp.rows.length + ' players, ' +
             grp.rows.reduce(function (n, x) { return n + x.lines.length; }, 0) + ' lines');
    const loose = grp.rows.filter(function (x) { return x.how !== 'exact'; });
    if (loose.length) out.push('    matched loosely (check): ' + loose.map(function (x) { return x.name + ' by ' + x.how; }).join('; '));
  });

  if (apply) {
    var saved = 0;
    Object.keys(groups).forEach(function (k) {
      const grp = groups[k];
      // the writer takes up to MAX_STAT_ROWS lines a call
      const flat = [];
      grp.rows.forEach(function (x) { x.lines.forEach(function (l) { flat.push({ line: l, row: x }); }); });
      for (var i = 0; i < flat.length; i += TEAMADMIN.MAX_STAT_ROWS) {
        const batch = flat.slice(i, i + TEAMADMIN.MAX_STAT_ROWS);
        const res = teamAdminWriteStats_(me, grp.gameId, grp.teamId, batch.map(function (b) { return b.line; }),
                                        { sourceType: STATSIMPORT.SOURCE });
        saved += res.saved || 0;
        (res.refused || []).forEach(function (msg) {
          const m = /^row (\d+)/.exec(msg);
          const b = m ? batch[Number(m[1]) - 1] : null;
          if (b) results.push([b.row.sheetRow, 'REFUSED', msg.replace(/^row \d+\s*/, '')]);
          out.push('  refused: ' + msg);
        });
      }
    });
    // every resolved row that was not refused by the writer is saved
    const refusedRows = {};
    results.forEach(function (x) { if (x[1] === 'REFUSED') refusedRows[x[0]] = true; });
    results.forEach(function (x) { if (x[1] === 'RESOLVED' && !refusedRows[x[0]]) x[1] = 'SAVED'; });
    out.push('Lines written to ' + CONFIG.TABS.PLAYER_STATS + ': ' + saved);
    if (saved) { teamAdminBustCache_(seasonId); markDirty_('stats'); out.push('Totals catch up on the next rebuild (or Rebuild everything now).'); }
  } else {
    /* This is the dry run, and the last line it prints is the one a person acts
       on. It used to make fixing the refusals sound like the next step, when
       the next step is APPLY: refused rows keep their place on the tab for a
       later pass, and never hold up the ones that resolved. */
    out.push(refused
      ? 'Nothing written — this is the dry run. Stats > Import (APPLY) writes the ' +
        resolved + ' resolved row' + (resolved === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' and leaves the ' +
        refused + ' refused one' + (refused === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' on the tab for later.'
      : 'Nothing written — this is the dry run. Stats > Import (APPLY) writes all ' +
        resolved + ' row' + (resolved === 1 ? '' : 's') + '.');
  }
  out.push('Every row\'s verdict is beside it on the ' + STATSIMPORT.TAB + ' tab, in the Result and Note columns.');

  // the verdicts, beside the rows; the last verdict for a row wins
  const byRow = {};
  results.forEach(function (x) { byRow[x[0]] = x; });
  Object.keys(byRow).forEach(function (k) {
    const x = byRow[k];
    sh.getRange(x[0], col.Result + 1, 1, 2).setValues([[x[1], x[2]]]);
  });
  delete __tableCache[STATSIMPORT.TAB];
  return out.join('\n');
}

/** Clear the rows that were saved, keeping refused ones for another pass. */
function siClearSaved_() {
  const sh = siEnsureTab_();
  const values = sh.getDataRange().getValues();
  const head = values[0].map(function (h) { return String(h).trim(); });
  const c = head.indexOf('Result');
  if (c < 0) return 0;
  var n = 0;
  for (var r = values.length - 1; r >= 1; r--) {
    if (String(values[r][c] || '').trim() === 'SAVED') { sh.deleteRow(r + 1); n++; }
  }
  delete __tableCache[STATSIMPORT.TAB];
  return n;
}

// ── menu and editor entry points ────────────────────────────────────────────
// Menu items may show a dialog; the editor-run twins only log, so a function
// picked from the toolbar never waits six minutes on a dialog nobody sees.
function menuStatsImportTab()   { const sh = siEnsureTab_(); db_().setActiveSheet(sh); }
function menuStatsImportDry()   { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(siRun_(false)); }
function menuStatsImportApply() { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(siRun_(true)); }
function menuStatsImportClear() { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Removed ' + siClearSaved_() + ' saved row(s) from ' + STATSIMPORT.TAB + '.'); }
function statsImportDryRun_()    { Logger.log(siRun_(false)); }
function statsImportApply_()     { Logger.log(siRun_(true)); }


===== src/TeamAdmin.js =====
/**
 * UCBAC Stats — TeamAdmin.gs
 *
 * What a signed-in COACH may do for his own team, and nothing else.
 *
 * Everything here is a write a scorekeeper makes: the Friday score, the week's
 * box score, who the captains are, where the film lives, and what to do about a
 * player who says a number is wrong. Profile.gs is the mirror image — a player
 * owns what a person knows about himself and may only ASK for a stat to move.
 * This file is where asking turns into moving, and it is the only place a
 * measure reaches PlayerGameStats from a person rather than from an import.
 *
 * Four rules the whole file is built on:
 *
 *   Authorization first. Every entry point calls assertTeamAdmin() before it
 *   reads a row, let alone writes one. The svc* wrappers are callable by any
 *   signed-in Google account, so a hostile caller passing another school's
 *   TeamID, GameID or CorrectionID is the case each function has to survive.
 *   A team is proved twice: once for the caller, once for the row.
 *
 *   Blank is not zero. A blank stat cell means "not reported"; a 0 means
 *   "reported, and it was none". A coach who leaves the receiving column empty
 *   has not claimed his receivers gained nothing. Every value written from here
 *   goes through teamAdminStat(), which returns '' for blank and never 0.
 *
 *   A forfeit survives. The 2023 import lost a forfeit by overwriting it with
 *   the opponent's win, and nobody noticed until the standings were published.
 *   A forfeit is a conference ruling, not a scorekeeping detail, so a coach can
 *   record one but cannot record one away — only an administrator can, and the
 *   change is audited by name.
 *
 *   Nothing rebuilds inline. Scores and box scores arrive in a burst on Friday
 *   night and Saturday morning; markDirty() lets the sweep trigger collapse the
 *   burst into one recompute. A save that also rebuilt would hold the script
 *   lock for a minute while fourteen other coaches waited on it.
 *
 * This file must run under a deployment configured "Execute as: User accessing
 * the web app" — the only configuration in which Session.getActiveUser()
 * identifies the coach rather than returning a blank string.
 */

// Literals rather than CONFIG lookups: Apps Script evaluates every file's
// top-level statements before any function runs, so nothing here may depend on
// another file's constants. Everything below reaches for CONFIG, SUM_FIELDS and
// the PROFILE helpers inside a function body, where they are defined.
const TEAMADMIN = {

  GAME_STATUSES: ['SCHEDULED', 'FINAL', 'FORFEIT', 'CANCELLED', 'POSTPONED'],

  // A running clock and a mercy rule put the real ceiling near 80. 150 is loose
  // enough never to refuse a real game and tight enough to catch a fat finger
  // that would otherwise land in the standings as a 640-point differential.
  MAX_SCORE: 150,

  // NFHS 1-2-4 puts at most four captains at the coin toss. Teams name more than
  // that — seniors, a game captain, a permanent captain — so this is a bound on
  // absurdity rather than a rule: eight is a leadership group, twenty is nobody.
  MAX_CAPTAINS: 8,

  // One team's box score for one game is roughly twenty-five to forty rows once
  // a player who both rushed and caught passes is counted twice. The cap bounds
  // the cell-by-cell write below it, not the sport.
  MAX_STAT_ROWS: 80,

  STAT_MAX: 1000,

  // Sacks and tackles for loss are shared and recorded in halves. Everything
  // else is a count and a half of one is a typo.
  HALF_FIELDS: ['Sacks', 'TFL'],

  // Yardage runs backwards. A count never does — "minus two receptions" is not
  // a thing that happened.
  SIGNED_FIELDS: ['PassYds', 'RushYds', 'RecYds', 'PuntYds', 'KRYds', 'PRYds'],

  /**
   * The PlayerGameStats `category` vocabulary, and which measures belong to
   * each. Together these are exactly SUM_FIELDS partitioned — no measure is in
   * two categories and none is missing, which is what lets the upsert key be
   * (GameID, PlayerID, category) without a player's rushing line quietly
   * overwriting his receiving line.
   *
   * A row is refused if it carries a field from another category. A Passing row
   * holding tackles would be summed once as passing and once as defense the
   * next time the grain resolver ran over it.
   */
  CATEGORIES: {
    Passing:   ['PassAtt', 'PassComp', 'PassYds', 'PassTD', 'PassInt'],
    Rushing:   ['RushAtt', 'RushYds', 'RushTD', 'RushFum'],
    Receiving: ['Rec', 'RecYds', 'RecTD', 'RecFum'],
    // Pancake blocks: the one offensive-line stat collected, and what the OL
    // All-Conference projection ranks on
    Blocking:  ['Pancakes'],
    Defense:   ['TackleSolo', 'TackleAssist', 'TFL', 'Sacks', 'Int', 'FF', 'FR',
                'PassDef', 'DefTD'],
    /* A blocked kick is a special-teams play wherever the man who made it
       lines up, so it is entered here rather than under Defense, which is
       where a box score usually prints it. */
    SpecTeams: ['FGM', 'FGA', 'XPM', 'XPA', 'Punts', 'PuntYds', 'KR', 'KRYds',
                'PR', 'PRYds', 'Blocks']
  },

  CATEGORY_ORDER: ['Passing', 'Rushing', 'Receiving', 'Blocking', 'Defense', 'SpecTeams'],

  /**
   * The Teams columns a coach may write, and how each is validated.
   *
   * A URL field takes any https address. These are filled in by a coach or an
   * administrator who had to sign in to reach the page, and a school's own site
   * is wherever the school put it — no list kept here could stay ahead of them.
   */
  LINK_FIELDS: [
    { key: 'hudlUrl',     col: 'HudlURL',     kind: 'URL' },
    { key: 'schoolUrl',   col: 'SchoolURL',   kind: 'URL' },
    { key: 'facebookUrl', col: 'FacebookURL', kind: 'URL' },
    { key: 'youTubeUrl',  col: 'YouTubeURL',  kind: 'URL' },
    { key: 'tikTokUrl',   col: 'TikTokURL',   kind: 'URL' },
    // the program's own X and Instagram, as handles: the site links them itself
    { key: 'xHandle',         col: 'XHandle',         kind: 'HANDLE', pattern: /^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,15}$/,  what: 'an X handle' },
    { key: 'instagramHandle', col: 'InstagramHandle', kind: 'HANDLE', pattern: /^[A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,30}$/, what: 'an Instagram handle' },
    { key: 'headCoach',   col: 'HeadCoach',   kind: 'TEXT' },
    { key: 'stadiumName', col: 'StadiumName', kind: 'TEXT' }
  ],

  // The columns this file writes to PlayerGameStats, apart from the measures.
  // Checked against the real header before anything is built for appendRows().
  STAT_KEY_COLS: ['GameID', 'PlayerID', 'TeamID', 'SeasonID'],

  DECISIONS: ['APPROVE', 'REJECT']
};

// ── authorization ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Prove the caller may write for this team, before anything is read.
 *
 * assertCanEdit() in Roster.gs is the gate every coach-facing write in this
 * project already goes through, and it reads the Coaches tab — which predates
 * accounts and still carries the administrators who bootstrapped the system. A
 * coach approved through Accounts.gs has no Coaches row at all, so the account
 * grant is tested second. Same rule both ways: ADMIN may write for any team, a
 * COACH only for his own, and everybody else throws.
 *
 * Returns the accountsWhoami() shape, so the audit row names the caller by the
 * role he actually holds rather than by the table he was found in.
 */
function assertTeamAdmin_(teamId) {
  teamId = s_(teamId);
  const me = accountsWhoami_();

  var granted = false;
  try { assertCanEdit_(teamId); granted = true; } catch (e) { granted = false; }

  if (!granted && me.role === 'ADMIN') granted = true;
  if (!granted && me.role === 'COACH' && me.teamId && me.teamId === teamId) granted = true;

  if (!granted)
    throw new Error('Not authorized to edit ' +
                    (teamNameOf_(teamId) || 'this team') +
                    '. Signed in as ' + (me.email || 'nobody') + '.');
  return me;
}

/**
 * The team a caller acts for when the function signature carries no TeamID.
 *
 * apiSaveGameScore() and apiReviewCorrection() are addressed by GameID and
 * CorrectionID, and the team those belong to is not known until the row is read
 * — but authorization has to happen before the read, not after it. So the
 * caller's OWN team is what is asserted here, and the row's team is asserted
 * again once it is in hand. An administrator has no team of his own and passes
 * on the first test by role.
 */
function teamAdminSelf_() {
  const me = accountsWhoami_();
  return assertTeamAdmin_(me.teamId);
}

/** Throws unless this caller may act on a row belonging to `teamId`. */
